2103.14259|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测中标签分配（label assignment）问题，指出现有方法多为每个真值独立定义正负样本，缺乏全局视角。②作者创新性地将标签分配建模为最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）问题，将每个anchor与gt之间的单位运输代价定义为分类损失与回归损失的加权和，通过Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解最小代价的最优传输方案，从而得到全局最优的分配结果。③相比ATSS、SimOTA等已有分配策略，OTA从全局优化角度统一处理所有gt与anchor的匹配，尤其在拥挤场景下避免了独立分配导致的冲突。④在COCO上，配备OTA的FCOS-ResNet-50在1X scheduler下达到40.7% mAP，超越所有现有分配方法，并在CrowdHuman上验证了其在拥挤场景中的优越性。
2103.14259|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the label assignment problem in object detection, where existing methods independently define positive/negative samples for each ground-truth. The authors formulate the assignment procedure as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem, defining the unit transportation cost between each anchor and ground-truth as a weighted sum of classification and regression losses, and solve it via Sinkhorn-Knopp Iteration to obtain a globally optimal assignment. On COCO, a single FCOS-ResNet-50 with OTA achieves 40.7% mAP under the 1X scheduler, outperforming all existing assigning methods, with further validation on CrowdHuman demonstrating superiority in crowd scenarios.
2103.14259|v2.assessment: 该工作将最优传输理论引入目标检测标签分配，提供了全局优化视角，方法简洁有效且代码开源，对检测器训练策略研究有较高参考价值。
2103.14259|v2.contribution: 提出将目标检测中的标签分配问题形式化为最优传输问题，并利用Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解全局最优分配方案。
2103.14259|v2.innovation: 首次从全局最优传输视角统一建模anchor与gt的匹配，替代了传统的独立逐gt分配策略。
2103.14259|v2.result: 在COCO上FCOS-ResNet-50达到40.7% mAP（1X scheduler），超越所有现有分配方法，并在CrowdHuman拥挤场景中表现优越。

2203.16220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对红外与可见光图像融合用于目标检测时，现有方法未充分考虑下游检测任务需求且缺乏多场景多模态基准的问题。作者提出了目标感知的双对抗学习框架，通过设计目标感知的对抗损失使融合图像保留更多有利于检测的语义信息，并构建了一个涵盖多种场景的多模态融合基准数据集。相比传统融合方法仅优化视觉质量，该方法将检测性能纳入优化目标，实现了融合与检测的联合优化。在多个场景下的实验表明，该方法在目标检测精度上优于现有融合算法，并提供了全面的基准评测。
2203.16220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing infrared and visible image fusion methods for object detection often neglect downstream detection requirements and lack multi-scenario multi-modality benchmarks. The authors propose a target-aware dual adversarial learning framework that preserves more detection-friendly semantic information via target-aware adversarial losses, and construct a multi-scenario multi-modality benchmark. Unlike traditional fusion methods optimizing visual quality only, this approach jointly optimizes fusion and detection, achieving superior detection accuracy across diverse scenarios.
2203.16220|v2.assessment: 该工作将图像融合与目标检测任务紧密结合，并提供了多场景基准，对多模态感知研究有重要参考价值。
2203.16220|v2.contribution: 提出了目标感知的双对抗学习融合框架及多场景多模态基准数据集。
2203.16220|v2.innovation: 将检测任务的目标感知信息引入对抗学习，实现融合与检测的联合优化。
2203.16220|v2.result: 在多个场景下目标检测精度优于现有融合方法，并建立了全面的评测基准。

2203.16089|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中标注数据稀缺且标注形式多样（如半监督、弱监督、噪声标注等）的问题，提出了一种统一的Omni-Supervised目标检测框架Omni-DETR。该方法基于DETR架构，通过设计一种基于伪标签的在线蒸馏机制，能够灵活利用多种形式的监督信号进行训练。相比传统方法仅针对单一监督形式，Omni-DETR首次实现了在统一框架下融合多种监督信息，并在多个基准上取得了优于或媲美专用方法的性能。实验表明，该方法在COCO等数据集上显著提升了检测精度，尤其在标注稀缺场景下表现突出。
2203.16089|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity and diversity of annotations in object detection by proposing Omni-DETR, a unified omni-supervised detection framework. Built on DETR, it employs an online distillation mechanism with pseudo-labels to flexibly leverage various supervision forms. Unlike prior methods tailored to a single supervision type, Omni-DETR integrates multiple supervision signals in one framework, achieving superior or comparable performance on COCO and other benchmarks, especially under scarce annotations.
2203.16089|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将多种监督形式统一到基于Transformer的检测框架中，对弱监督和半监督检测研究有重要推动作用。
2203.16089|v2.contribution: 提出了统一的Omni-Supervised目标检测框架Omni-DETR，支持多种监督形式。
2203.16089|v2.innovation: 基于DETR的在线蒸馏机制，灵活融合半监督、弱监督和噪声标注等多种监督信号。
2203.16089|v2.result: 在COCO等基准上取得优于或媲美专用方法的检测精度，尤其在标注稀缺时提升显著。

2206.11459|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对微弱目标（insubstantial object）检测中目标信号弱、易被背景淹没的问题，构建了一个专门的基准数据集并提出了基于时空聚合的基线方法。作者利用视频中的时空信息，设计了一种时空聚合模块来增强微弱目标的特征响应，从而提升检测性能。相比单帧检测方法，该基线通过聚合多帧时空线索显著提高了微弱目标的召回率和精度。在自建数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性，并提供了详细的基准评测。
2206.11459|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of detecting insubstantial objects whose weak signals are easily overwhelmed by background. The authors construct a dedicated benchmark dataset and propose a spatio-temporal aggregation baseline that enhances weak object features by aggregating multi-frame cues. Compared to single-frame methods, the baseline significantly improves recall and precision on the proposed dataset, providing a comprehensive evaluation.
2206.11459|v2.assessment: 该工作为微弱目标检测提供了新的数据集和时空聚合思路，对视频目标检测研究有参考意义。
2206.11459|v2.contribution: 构建了微弱目标检测基准数据集，并提出了时空聚合基线方法。
2206.11459|v2.innovation: 利用时空聚合增强微弱目标的特征响应，提升检测性能。
2206.11459|v2.result: 在自建数据集上显著提高了微弱目标的召回率和精度。

2207.11169|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有小样本目标检测（FSOD）研究多局限于单一相似域、缺乏跨域评估的问题，提出了一个多域小样本目标检测基准MoFSOD，包含来自10个不同领域的数据集。作者系统分析了冻结层、不同架构和预训练数据集对FSOD性能的影响，发现微调（FT）在多域基准上是一个强有力的基线，性能与SOTA算法相当或更优；同时发现不同架构对下游小样本任务有显著影响，即使预训练性能相近。该工作为FSOD的跨域评估提供了重要基准和实证结论。
2207.11169|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing few-shot object detection (FSOD) research that focuses on a single similar domain, by proposing MoFSOD, a multi-domain FSOD benchmark with 10 datasets from diverse domains. The authors systematically analyze the impacts of freezing layers, architectures, and pre-training datasets, revealing that fine-tuning (FT) is a strong baseline on multi-domain benchmarks, performing on par or better than SOTA, and that architectures significantly affect downstream few-shot tasks. This work provides a crucial benchmark and empirical insights for cross-domain FSOD evaluation.
2207.11169|v2.assessment: 该工作挑战了FSOD领域的传统认知，提供了多域基准和重要实证发现，对推动鲁棒FSOD研究有重要价值。
2207.11169|v2.contribution: 提出了多域小样本目标检测基准MoFSOD，并揭示了微调作为强基线等关键发现。
2207.11169|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估多域FSOD，发现微调优于SOTA及架构对下游任务的显著影响。
2207.11169|v2.result: 在多域基准上微调性能与SOTA相当或更优，并提供了全面的实证分析。

A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_cn: 该论文针对大规模类别目标检测（21,000类）中类别数量庞大、标注数据稀缺的挑战，提出了一种简单有效的方法并构建了相应的基准。作者通过利用大规模图像分类数据集中的弱监督信息，结合检测框架进行训练，实现了对海量类别的检测。相比传统检测方法仅能处理数百类，该方法将检测类别扩展至21,000类，并在基准上验证了其有效性。实验表明，该方法在如此大规模类别下仍能取得合理的检测性能，为开放世界检测提供了新思路。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of large-scale object detection with 21,000 categories, where massive categories and scarce annotations are critical. The authors propose a simple yet effective approach leveraging weak supervision from large-scale image classification datasets within a detection framework. Unlike traditional detectors limited to hundreds of classes, this method scales to 21,000 categories and demonstrates reasonable detection performance, offering new insights for open-world detection.
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.assessment: 该工作将目标检测的类别规模推向极端，对开放集检测和大规模识别研究有启发意义。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.contribution: 提出了面向21,000类目标检测的简单方法及基准。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.innovation: 利用大规模分类数据弱监督信息扩展检测类别至21,000类。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.result: 在21,000类基准上取得了合理的检测性能。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,._arxiv_id: A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21, 000-Category Object Detection.

Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于DETR的人-物交互（HOI）检测中查询（query）质量不高导致检测性能受限的问题，提出了硬正样本查询挖掘方法。作者分析了DETR中查询与真实交互的匹配机制，设计了一种硬正样本挖掘策略，通过优先选择与目标交互更匹配的查询进行训练，提升了HOI检测的准确性。相比原始DETR-based HOI方法，该方法在HICO-DET等基准上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了查询挖掘的有效性。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited performance of DETR-based human-object interaction (HOI) detection due to suboptimal query quality, by proposing a hard-positive query mining approach. The authors analyze the query-ground truth matching in DETR and design a mining strategy that prioritizes queries better matched to target interactions. Compared to original DETR-based HOI methods, this approach achieves significant improvements on HICO-DET and other benchmarks.
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.assessment: 该工作针对DETR在HOI检测中的查询匹配问题提出了有效改进，对基于Transformer的交互检测研究有参考价值。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.contribution: 提出了用于DETR-based HOI检测的硬正样本查询挖掘方法。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.innovation: 通过优先挖掘与目标交互更匹配的硬正样本查询来提升检测性能。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.result: 在HICO-DET等基准上取得了显著的HOI检测性能提升。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D._arxiv_id: Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for DETR-Based Human-Object Interaction Detection.

Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中 DETR 类方法难以泛化到未见类别的问题，本文提出 Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Matching。方法在 DETR 框架中引入条件匹配机制，利用类别文本嵌入动态调整查询与预测的匹配过程，从而支持任意词汇的类别检测。相比固定类别分类器的传统 DETR，该方法无需重新训练即可检测新类别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对自动驾驶开放场景感知具有参考价值。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection where DETR-based detectors struggle to generalize to unseen categories. It proposes a conditional matching mechanism within DETR that dynamically adjusts query-prediction matching using class text embeddings, enabling detection of arbitrary vocabulary categories without retraining. While no quantitative results are provided in the abstract, the approach is relevant to open-set perception in autonomous driving.
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.assessment: 开放词汇检测是自动驾驶长尾场景的重要方向，条件匹配思路对 DETR 类方法有启发，但缺少实验数据难以判断实际效果。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.contribution: 提出基于条件匹配的开放词汇 DETR 检测框架。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.innovation: 利用类别文本嵌入动态调整 DETR 的查询匹配过程以支持任意词汇。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_cn: 针对实例级视觉-语言任务缺乏统一架构的问题，本文提出 X-DETR，一个可处理多种实例级视觉-语言任务的通用架构。方法基于 DETR 框架，通过统一的查询机制和任务特定的头部设计，支持指代分割、实例分割、视觉定位等多种任务。相比为每个任务单独设计模型的已有工作，X-DETR 实现了多任务统一。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of a unified architecture for instance-wise vision-language tasks by proposing X-DETR, a versatile framework built on DETR. It employs a unified query mechanism with task-specific heads to support referring segmentation, instance segmentation, and visual grounding. Unlike prior task-specific models, X-DETR unifies multiple tasks, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.assessment: 多任务统一的实例级视觉-语言架构对多模态感知有参考价值，但缺少实验细节。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.contribution: 提出统一处理多种实例级视觉-语言任务的 X-DETR 架构。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.innovation: 基于 DETR 查询机制实现多任务统一建模。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins._arxiv_id: X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Instance-wise Vision-Language Tasks.

2203.10638|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中单车感知受限的问题，本文提出 V2X-ViT，利用车路协同（V2X）通信提升感知性能。方法构建了异构多智能体自注意力和多尺度窗口自注意力交替的 Transformer 架构，有效融合车辆与路侧基础设施的信息，并统一处理异步信息共享、位姿误差和 V2X 组件异构性等挑战。作者基于 CARLA 和 OpenCDA 构建了大规模 V2X 感知数据集，实验表明 V2X-ViT 在 3D 目标检测上取得新的 SOTA，并在噪声环境下保持鲁棒性能。
2203.10638|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes V2X-ViT, a cooperative perception framework that leverages Vehicle-to-Everything communication to enhance autonomous driving perception. It introduces a Transformer with alternating heterogeneous multi-agent self-attention and multi-scale window self-attention to fuse information across vehicles and infrastructure while handling asynchrony, pose errors, and heterogeneity. A large-scale V2X dataset is built using CARLA and OpenCDA, and experiments show V2X-ViT achieves new state-of-the-art 3D detection performance with robustness under noisy conditions.
2203.10638|v2.assessment: 车路协同感知是自动驾驶的重要前沿，V2X-ViT 在架构设计和数据集构建上均有实质贡献，实验充分且开源，值得重点关注。
2203.10638|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Transformer 的 V2X 协同感知框架并构建大规模数据集。
2203.10638|v2.innovation: 异构多智能体自注意力与多尺度窗口自注意力交替的融合架构。
2203.10638|v2.result: 在 3D 目标检测上取得新 SOTA，并在噪声环境下保持鲁棒。

2111.14330|v2.summary_cn: 针对 DETR 类检测器在高分辨率特征图上计算效率低的问题，本文提出 Sparse DETR。观察到仅更新部分编码器 token 对检测性能影响很小，方法选择性地只更新预期被解码器引用的 token，并在选中 token 上施加辅助检测损失以提升性能。相比 Deformable DETR，Sparse DETR 仅用 10% 的编码器 token 即取得更好性能，显著降低计算开销。
2111.14330|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational inefficiency of DETR-based detectors on high-resolution feature maps by proposing Sparse DETR. Observing that updating only a subset of encoder tokens barely degrades detection performance, it selectively updates tokens expected to be referenced by the decoder and applies an auxiliary detection loss on selected tokens. Sparse DETR outperforms Deformable DETR using only 10% of encoder tokens, substantially reducing computation.
2111.14330|v2.assessment: 稀疏化编码器 token 的思路简洁有效，对 DETR 类检测器的效率优化有实际价值，实验对比充分。
2111.14330|v2.contribution: 提出选择性更新编码器 token 的稀疏 DETR 检测器。
2111.14330|v2.innovation: 基于解码器引用预测的 token 稀疏化与辅助检测损失。
2111.14330|v2.result: 仅用 10% 编码器 token 即超越 Deformable DETR。

MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_cn: 针对零样本 NAS 在目标检测中效率与性能难以兼顾的问题，本文重新审视最大熵原理并提出 MAE-DET。方法利用最大熵原理设计零样本代理指标，无需训练即可评估检测架构质量，从而高效搜索检测骨干网络。相比需要大量训练评估的 NAS 方法，MAE-DET 显著降低搜索成本。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_en: This paper revisits the maximum entropy principle for zero-shot NAS in object detection and proposes MAE-DET. It designs a zero-shot proxy based on maximum entropy to evaluate detection architectures without training, enabling efficient backbone search. Compared to training-based NAS methods, MAE-DET substantially reduces search cost, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.assessment: 零样本 NAS 对检测骨干搜索有实用价值，但摘要信息有限，与核心感知任务相关度中等。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.contribution: 提出基于最大熵原理的零样本 NAS 检测骨干搜索方法。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.innovation: 将最大熵原理引入零样本检测架构评估。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin._arxiv_id: MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Principle in Zero-Shot NAS for Efficient Object Detection.

2210.05593|v2.summary_cn: 针对 3D 点云目标检测依赖大量标注数据、新类别标注成本高的问题，本文研究少样本 3D 点云目标检测。提出 Prototypical VoteNet，包含原型投票模块（PVM）和原型头模块（PHM）：PVM 利用从基类学到的类无关几何原型精炼新类局部特征，PHM 利用类原型增强每个目标的全局特征以辅助定位与分类，并采用 episodic 训练策略。作者贡献了 FS-ScanNet 和 FS-SUNRGBD 两个新基准数据集，实验验证了方法的有效性。
2210.05593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot 3D point cloud object detection where only a few annotated samples of novel classes are available alongside abundant base-class data. It proposes Prototypical VoteNet with a Prototypical Vote Module (PVM) that refines novel-class local features using class-agnostic geometric prototypes learned from base classes, and a Prototypical Head Module (PHM) that enhances global features via class prototypes under episodic training. Two new benchmarks, FS-ScanNet and FS-SUNRGBD, are contributed, and extensive experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2210.05593|v2.assessment: 少样本 3D 检测是降低标注成本的重要方向，原型学习与 episodic 训练的结合合理，新基准数据集对社区有贡献。
2210.05593|v2.contribution: 提出少样本 3D 点云检测的 Prototypical VoteNet 及两个新基准数据集。
2210.05593|v2.innovation: 利用类无关几何原型和类原型分别精炼局部与全局特征。
2210.05593|v2.result: 在 FS-ScanNet 和 FS-SUNRGBD 上验证了方法的有效性。

2210.01391|v2.summary_cn: 针对2D图像与3D点云因几何异质性难以直接进行多模态融合的问题，本文提出Bridged Transformer（BrT），一种端到端的3D目标检测架构。BrT利用object queries桥接3D与2D空间，统一Transformer中的不同数据表示，并通过point-to-patch投影进行特征聚合以增强图像与点云的相关性。该方法可无缝融合点云与多视角图像，在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2数据集上超越了当时的最先进方法。
2210.01391|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of multimodal fusion caused by the geometric heterogeneity between 2D images and 3D point clouds, this paper proposes Bridged Transformer (BrT), an end-to-end architecture for 3D object detection. BrT leverages object queries to bridge 3D and 2D spaces, unifying different data representations within a Transformer, and adopts point-to-patch projection for feature aggregation to strengthen image-point correlations. It seamlessly fuses point clouds with multi-view images and surpasses state-of-the-art methods on SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2.
2210.01391|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种简洁有效的Transformer桥接机制，为点云与图像的多模态融合提供了新思路，在室内3D检测基准上验证了有效性，值得关注。
2210.01391|v2.contribution: 提出Bridged Transformer，利用object queries统一桥接3D点云与2D图像表示，实现端到端多模态3D目标检测。
2210.01391|v2.innovation: 通过object queries桥接异构的2D/3D空间，并结合point-to-patch投影增强跨模态特征关联。
2210.01391|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2数据集上超越了当时的最先进方法。

2104.06401|v2.summary_cn: 本文研究无监督目标检测问题，不依赖图像级类别标签，而是从音视频对应关系中提取监督信号，用音频来'教'检测器。作者设计了一个自监督对比学习框架，联合学习目标的分类与定位，然后仅用这些自监督标签和框训练基于图像的检测器。该方法在目标检测和声源定位任务上超越了以往的无监督和弱监督检测器，并且仅需每个伪类一个标签即可对齐到真实类别，还能检测飞机、猫等非乐器类通用物体。
2104.06401|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised object detection without image-level class labels by extracting supervisory signals from audio-visual correspondence, using audio to 'teach' the detector. The authors design a self-supervised contrastive framework that jointly learns to classify and localize objects, then trains an image-based detector using only these self-supervised labels and boxes. The method outperforms previous unsupervised and weakly-supervised detectors on object detection and sound source localization, and can align to ground-truth classes with as little as one label per pseudo-class.
2104.06401|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用音视频对应作为免费监督信号，为无监督目标检测开辟了新途径，实验充分且展示了跨类别的泛化能力，具有较高启发性。
2104.06401|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于音视频对应的自监督目标检测框架，无需任何人工标注即可训练检测器。
2104.06401|v2.innovation: 利用音频作为监督信号来'教'视觉检测器，并通过对比学习联合实现分类与定位。
2104.06401|v2.result: 在目标检测和声源定位任务上超越以往无监督/弱监督方法，仅需每伪类一个标签即可对齐真实类别。

2202.04639|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对目标检测预训练中的定位与识别两个关键因素，提出点级区域对比（point-level region contrast）自监督预训练方法。该方法直接从不同区域采样点对进行对比学习，相比区域聚合表示对输入区域质量变化更鲁棒，并通过在线知识蒸馏隐式改进初始区域分配。实验表明，该方法在多个任务和数据集上超越了最先进的检测与分割预训练方法，并提供了充分的消融研究和可视化分析。
2202.04639|v2.summary_en: Motivated by the two key factors in detection—localization and recognition—this paper presents point-level region contrast, a self-supervised pre-training approach for object detection. It performs contrastive learning by directly sampling individual point pairs from different regions, which is more robust to changes in input region quality than aggregated region representations, and implicitly improves initial region assignments via online knowledge distillation. Experiments show improvements over state-of-the-art pre-training methods for detection and segmentation across multiple tasks and datasets.
2202.04639|v2.assessment: 该工作从定位与识别的矛盾出发，提出点级对比预训练策略，方法设计合理且实验扎实，对检测预训练领域有重要参考价值。
2202.04639|v2.contribution: 提出点级区域对比自监督预训练方法，通过采样点对进行对比学习以提升检测预训练效果。
2202.04639|v2.innovation: 用点级采样替代区域聚合表示进行对比学习，并结合在线知识蒸馏改进区域分配。
2202.04639|v2.result: 在多个检测与分割任务和数据集上超越最先进的预训练方法。

2203.11496|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-相机融合3D检测在恶劣光照和传感器失配等劣质图像条件下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出TransFusion，一种基于Transformer的鲁棒融合方案。其核心是软关联机制：检测头第一层解码器用稀疏object queries从点云预测初始框，第二层解码器自适应地将object queries与有用图像特征融合，利用空间和上下文关系让注意力机制自主决定从图像中取何处、何种信息。该方法在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先性能，并显著提升了在图像退化条件下的鲁棒性。
2203.11496|v2.summary_en: To address the insufficient robustness of LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection under inferior image conditions such as bad illumination and sensor misalignment, this paper proposes TransFusion, a robust fusion solution based on Transformers. Its core is a soft-association mechanism: the first decoder layer predicts initial boxes from the point cloud using sparse object queries, and the second layer adaptively fuses object queries with useful image features, letting attention determine where and what information to take from images. It achieves leading performance on benchmarks like nuScenes and significantly improves robustness under degraded image conditions.
2203.11496|v2.assessment: 该工作直击LiDAR-相机融合的鲁棒性痛点，软关联机制设计优雅且实用，在自动驾驶3D检测领域具有很高的影响力和参考价值。
2203.11496|v2.contribution: 提出TransFusion，通过基于Transformer的软关联机制实现鲁棒的LiDAR-相机融合3D目标检测。
2203.11496|v2.innovation: 用注意力驱动的软关联替代基于标定矩阵的硬关联，自适应决定图像特征融合的位置与内容。
2203.11496|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能，并在图像退化条件下显著提升鲁棒性。

2106.04550|v2.summary_cn: 现有目标检测自监督预训练方法大多只预训练骨干网络，忽略了检测架构的关键部分。本文提出DETReg，一种预训练整个检测网络（包括定位和嵌入组件）的自监督方法。预训练时，DETReg预测目标定位以匹配无监督区域提议生成器的结果，同时将对应特征嵌入与自监督图像编码器的嵌入对齐。基于DETR系列实现，在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship基准上微调均优于竞争基线，在仅1%标签和少样本设置下性能提升尤为明显。
2106.04550|v2.summary_en: Existing self-supervised pretraining methods for object detection largely focus on pretraining the backbone, neglecting key parts of the detection architecture. This paper introduces DETReg, a self-supervised method that pretrains the entire detection network, including localization and embedding components, by predicting object localizations to match an unsupervised region proposal generator while aligning feature embeddings with a self-supervised image encoder. Implemented with DETR-family detectors, it improves over competitive baselines on COCO, PASCAL VOC, and Airbus Ship, especially in low-data regimes such as 1% labels and few-shot settings.
2106.04550|v2.assessment: 该工作指出预训练应覆盖整个检测网络而非仅骨干，思路清晰且低数据场景下收益显著，对检测预训练研究有较好推动作用。
2106.04550|v2.contribution: 提出DETReg，首次对包括定位和嵌入组件在内的整个目标检测网络进行自监督预训练。
2106.04550|v2.innovation: 联合利用无监督区域提议生成器和自监督图像编码器来预训练完整检测架构。
2106.04550|v2.result: 在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship上优于竞争基线，仅1%标签和少样本设置下提升尤为显著。

2206.06608|v2.summary_cn: 半监督目标检测中，mean teacher自训练存在标签不匹配问题，导致严重的确认偏差。本文从分布级和实例级两个互补视角提出LabelMatch框架。分布级上，基于蒙特卡洛采样从标注数据近似未标注数据的类别分布，引入重分布mean teacher，用自适应标签分布感知的置信度阈值生成无偏伪标签；实例级上，针对师生模型间的标签分配歧义，提出proposal self-assignment机制，将学生提议注入教师以生成准确伪标签。实验表明该方法在半监督检测基准上取得了显著提升。
2206.06608|v2.summary_en: In semi-supervised object detection, the label mismatch problem in mean-teacher self-training leads to severe confirmation bias. This paper proposes LabelMatch from two complementary perspectives: at the distribution level, it approximates the class distribution of unlabeled data from labeled data via Monte Carlo Sampling and introduces a re-distribution mean teacher with adaptive label-distribution-aware confidence thresholds to generate unbiased pseudo labels; at the instance level, it presents proposal self-assignment to address label assignment ambiguity across teacher-student models. Experiments show significant improvements on semi-supervised detection benchmarks.
2206.06608|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地剖析了半监督检测中的标签不匹配问题，并从分布和实例两个层面给出简洁有效的解决方案，对自训练框架有重要改进意义。
2206.06608|v2.contribution: 提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级两个视角解决半监督目标检测中的标签不匹配问题。
2206.06608|v2.innovation: 引入重分布mean teacher的自适应阈值和proposal self-assignment机制来生成无偏伪标签。
2206.06608|v2.result: 在半监督目标检测基准上取得显著性能提升。

2203.02112|v2.summary_cn: 单目3D检测中Pseudo-LiDAR方法因图像到LiDAR的跨模态生成差距大而受限。本文提出Pseudo-Stereo框架，通过图像级生成、特征级生成和特征克隆三种虚拟视图生成方式，将单目输入转化为伪立体对，并设计基于视差特征图采样动态核的视差感知动态卷积以缓解深度估计误差导致特征退化。分析表明深度损失仅在特征级生成中有效，而估计深度图在图像级和特征级均有效。在KITTI上取得当时单目3D检测的最优性能。
2203.02112|v2.summary_en: Pseudo-LiDAR monocular 3D detectors suffer from the large image-to-LiDAR generation gap. This paper proposes a Pseudo-Stereo framework with three virtual view generation schemes (image-level, feature-level, and feature-clone) plus a disparity-wise dynamic convolution that samples kernels from the disparity map to adaptively filter features and mitigate depth-error-induced degradation. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection on KITTI at submission time.
2203.02112|v2.assessment: 将单目检测重构为伪立体范式，思路新颖且分析扎实，对单目3D检测研究者有较强参考价值。
2203.02112|v2.contribution: 提出Pseudo-Stereo单目3D检测框架及三种虚拟视图生成方法与视差感知动态卷积。
2203.02112|v2.innovation: 用图像到图像生成替代图像到LiDAR生成以缩小跨模态差距，并引入视差动态卷积自适应滤波。
2203.02112|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得当时单目3D检测的最优性能。

2204.07300|v2.summary_cn: 现有半监督目标检测方法多基于anchor-based检测器，忽略了实际应用中anchor-free检测器的需求。本文提出基于密集学习的anchor-free半监督检测算法DSL，包含自适应过滤策略生成多层级精确的像素级伪标签、聚合教师模型产生稳定伪标签，以及跨尺度与打乱块间的不确定性一致性正则项。在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上大幅超越现有方法，刷新SSOD最优性能。
2204.07300|v2.summary_en: Most semi-supervised object detection methods are anchor-based, ignoring the demand for anchor-free detectors. This paper proposes DSL, an anchor-free SSOD algorithm with an Adaptive Filtering strategy for multi-level dense pseudo-labels, an Aggregated Teacher for stable pseudo-labels, and an uncertainty-consistency regularization across scales and shuffled patches. It sets new state-of-the-art SSOD results on MS-COCO and PASCAL-VOC by a large margin.
2204.07300|v2.assessment: 填补了anchor-free半监督检测的空白，三个模块设计合理，实验充分，对检测领域有实用价值。
2204.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向anchor-free检测器的密集学习半监督目标检测算法DSL。
2204.07300|v2.innovation: 结合自适应过滤、聚合教师与不确定性一致性正则实现高质量像素级伪标签。
2204.07300|v2.result: 在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上大幅超越现有方法，刷新SSOD最优性能。

2204.12463|v2.summary_cn: 现有稀疏卷积网络对所有稀疏数据一视同仁，忽略了不同空间位置体素对3D检测贡献的差异。本文提出Focal Sparse Convolution（Focals Conv）及其多模态融合变体Focals Conv-F，通过位置级重要性预测使特征稀疏性可学习，可即插即用地替换现有Sparse CNN中的普通卷积并端到端联合训练。首次证明空间可学习稀疏性对复杂3D检测至关重要，在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上验证有效性，并在投稿时于nuScenes测试榜超越所有单模型方法。
2204.12463|v2.summary_en: Existing sparse CNNs treat all sparse data equally, ignoring position-wise importance differences. This paper introduces Focal Sparse Convolution (Focals Conv) and its multi-modal fusion variant (Focals Conv-F), which make feature sparsity learnable via position-wise importance prediction and can plug-and-play replace plain convolutions in existing Sparse CNNs. Experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo validate the approach, outperforming all single-model entries on the nuScenes test benchmark at submission time.
2204.12463|v2.assessment: 将可学习稀疏性引入3D稀疏卷积，通用性强、实验覆盖三大基准，是3D检测领域的重要基础性工作。
2204.12463|v2.contribution: 提出可学习位置级稀疏性的Focals Conv及多模态融合变体Focals Conv-F。
2204.12463|v2.innovation: 首次证明空间可学习稀疏性对3D检测至关重要，并实现即插即用的稀疏卷积增强。
2204.12463|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo上验证有效，投稿时nuScenes测试榜超越所有单模型方法。

2203.07363|v2.summary_cn: 视频伪装目标检测中目标与背景相似，需依赖时序运动信息，但现有方法用单应性或光流表示运动，会累积运动估计与分割误差。本文提出统一运动估计与目标分割的VCOD框架，构建稠密相关体隐式捕捉相邻帧运动，并用最终分割监督联合优化隐式运动估计与分割，同时用时空Transformer强化时序一致性。方法在VCOD任务上取得优于现有方法的效果。
2203.07363|v2.summary_en: Video camouflaged object detection relies on temporal motion, but existing methods using homography or optical flow accumulate motion and segmentation errors. This paper proposes a unified framework that builds a dense correlation volume to implicitly capture inter-frame motion and jointly optimizes implicit motion estimation and segmentation under final segmentation supervision, with a spatio-temporal transformer for temporal consistency. It outperforms existing VCOD methods.
2203.07363|v2.assessment: 隐式运动建模思路对视频分割有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低，属边缘相关。
2203.07363|v2.contribution: 提出统一运动估计与分割的隐式运动处理视频伪装目标检测框架。
2203.07363|v2.innovation: 用稠密相关体隐式捕捉运动并以分割监督联合优化，避免显式光流误差累积。
2203.07363|v2.result: 在视频伪装目标检测任务上优于现有方法。

2203.09704|v2.summary_cn: LiDAR点云稀疏不规则，多视图方法虽结合BEV与RV信息，但现有方法要么仅用融合特征精修单视图提议，要么忽略全局空间上下文。本文提出双跨视图空间注意力（VISTA）即插即用融合模块，用卷积替换标准注意力中的MLP，在全局空间上下文中自适应融合多视图特征，并解耦分类与回归任务、引入注意力方差约束。在多个3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
2203.09704|v2.summary_en: Multi-view LiDAR detectors combining BEV and RV either refine single-view proposals or fuse features without global spatial context. This paper proposes VISTA, a plug-and-play Dual Cross-View Spatial Attention module that replaces the MLP in standard attention with convolution to adaptively fuse multi-view features in global spatial context, decoupling classification and regression with an attention variance constraint. It achieves leading performance on 3D detection benchmarks.
2203.09704|v2.assessment: 跨视图注意力融合设计简洁有效，即插即用特性对多视图3D检测研究有直接借鉴意义。
2203.09704|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的双跨视图空间注意力融合模块VISTA。
2203.09704|v2.innovation: 以卷积替代注意力MLP并在全局空间上下文中自适应融合BEV与RV特征。
2203.09704|v2.result: 在3D检测基准上取得领先性能。

2203.03800|v2.summary_cn: 目标检测器对分布外（OOD）目标缺乏监督信号，导致过度自信预测，可靠性不足。本文提出基于时空未知蒸馏（STUD）的未知感知检测框架，先在空间维度识别未知候选提议，再跨多视频帧聚合形成决策边界附近的多样未知目标，并用基于能量的不确定性正则损失对比性地塑造分布内与蒸馏未知目标间的不确定性空间。在OOD检测任务上取得最优性能，FPR95较此前最佳方法降低超过10%。
2203.03800|v2.summary_en: Object detectors produce overconfident predictions on OOD objects due to lacking unknown supervision. This paper proposes STUD, an unknown-aware detection framework that identifies unknown candidate proposals spatially, aggregates them across video frames to form diverse unknowns near the decision boundary, and applies an energy-based uncertainty regularization loss to contrastively shape the uncertainty space. It achieves state-of-the-art OOD detection, reducing FPR95 by over 10% versus the previous best.
2203.03800|v2.assessment: 利用野外视频蒸馏未知目标解决OOD检测，思路新颖且指标提升显著，对开放集检测研究有较高价值。
2203.03800|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空未知蒸馏的未知感知目标检测框架STUD。
2203.03800|v2.innovation: 从野外视频中蒸馏决策边界附近的未知目标并用能量正则对比塑造不确定性空间。
2203.03800|v2.result: OOD检测达最优，FPR95较此前最佳方法降低超过10%。

2203.14940|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，基于视觉语言模型的方法依赖精心设计的文本提示，人工调参成本高，而现有的面向图像分类的提示学习方案直接迁移到检测任务上效果次优。本文提出 DetPro，学习连续提示表示用于开放词汇检测，包含两个关键设计：背景解释方案将图像背景中的候选框纳入提示训练，上下文分级方案区分前景与背景候选框的上下文。相比分类导向的提示学习方法，DetPro 更适配检测任务的区域级监督特性。在 COCO 和 LVIS 等基准上，DetPro 在开放词汇检测设定下取得了优于手工提示与分类提示学习方法的性能。
2203.14940|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection with vision-language models relies on carefully engineered text prompts, and existing prompt-learning methods designed for image classification transfer sub-optimally to detection. This paper proposes DetPro, which learns continuous prompt representations for open-vocabulary detection with two key designs: a background interpretation scheme that incorporates proposals from image backgrounds into prompt training, and a context grading scheme that separates foreground and background proposals. DetPro outperforms hand-crafted prompts and classification-oriented prompt learning baselines on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks such as COCO and LVIS.
2203.14940|v2.assessment: 该工作将提示学习从分类迁移到检测，针对区域级监督的适配设计合理，对开放词汇检测与视觉语言模型结合方向有参考价值。
2203.14940|v2.contribution: 提出面向开放词汇目标检测的连续提示学习方法 DetPro，通过背景解释与上下文分级两个方案解决分类提示学习在检测任务上的次优问题。
2203.14940|v2.innovation: 将图像背景候选框纳入提示训练，并按上下文对候选框分级，使提示学习适配检测的区域级监督。
2203.14940|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上优于手工提示与分类导向的提示学习方法。

2307.08095|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对半监督目标检测（SSOD）中DETR框架存在的两个问题：一对一匹配在伪标签不准确时产生错误匹配导致训练低效，以及DETR缺乏输入query与预测输出的确定性对应关系，阻碍了基于一致性的正则化方法的应用。作者提出了Semi-DETR，首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器，包含三阶段混合匹配策略（结合一对多和一对一分配以提升第一阶段训练效率并为第二阶段提供高质量伪标签）、跨视角Query一致性方法（学习不同视角下object query的语义特征不变性而无需确定性query对应）以及基于代价的伪标签挖掘模块（动态挖掘更多伪框）。相比已有SSOD方法，Semi-DETR首次将DETR架构成功应用于半监督检测，解决了匹配和一致性问题。
2307.08095|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in DETR-based semi-supervised object detection: incorrect matching caused by one-to-one assignment with inaccurate pseudo labels, and the lack of deterministic query-prediction correspondence that hinders consistency regularization. The authors propose Semi-DETR, the first transformer-based end-to-end semi-supervised object detector, featuring a Stage-wise Hybrid Matching strategy combining one-to-many and one-to-one assignments, a Cross-view Query Consistency method, and a Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining module. Semi-DETR overcomes the limitations of existing SSOD methods by enabling effective consistency learning and high-quality pseudo label generation within the DETR framework.
2307.08095|v2.assessment: 这是首个将DETR成功应用于半监督目标检测的工作，对SSOD和Transformer检测交叉领域有重要参考价值。
2307.08095|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器Semi-DETR，解决了DETR在SSOD中的匹配和一致性问题。
2307.08095|v2.innovation: 提出阶段式混合匹配策略和跨视角Query一致性方法，在无需确定性query对应的情况下实现一致性正则化。
2307.08095|v2.result: 在SSOD基准上取得了优于已有方法的性能，验证了DETR框架在半监督检测中的有效性。

Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_cn: 本文针对野外场景下3D目标检测缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，提出了Omni3D——一个大规模3D目标检测基准和模型。Omni3D整合了多个现有3D数据集，涵盖室内外多种场景，并提出了Cube R-CNN模型，通过预测3D框的中心、尺寸和朝向等参数实现单目3D检测。相比已有工作，Omni3D在数据规模和场景多样性上有显著提升，Cube R-CNN通过2D-3D关联实现了跨数据集的泛化能力。该工作为3D目标检测在野外场景的研究提供了重要的基准和基线方法。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale unified benchmark for 3D object detection in the wild by introducing Omni3D, a large benchmark and model for 3D object detection. Omni3D consolidates multiple existing 3D datasets covering diverse indoor and outdoor scenes, and proposes Cube R-CNN, which predicts 3D box parameters including center, dimensions, and orientation for monocular 3D detection. Compared to prior work, Omni3D significantly improves data scale and scene diversity, while Cube R-CNN achieves cross-dataset generalization through 2D-3D association.
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.assessment: Omni3D为野外3D目标检测提供了重要的大规模基准和强基线，对推动该领域发展具有里程碑意义。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.contribution: 构建了大规模统一的3D目标检测基准Omni3D，并提出了Cube R-CNN模型。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.innovation: 整合多源3D数据集构建统一基准，提出可跨数据集泛化的单目3D检测模型Cube R-CNN。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.result: 在多个3D检测数据集上验证了Cube R-CNN的有效性和泛化能力，为野外3D检测设立了新基准。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for._arxiv_id: Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for 3D Object Detection in the Wild.

Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_cn: 本文针对目标检测和分割任务通常需要独立框架的问题，提出了Mask DINO——一个统一的基于Transformer的检测与分割框架。Mask DINO在DINO的基础上引入了一个掩码分支，通过共享的query表示同时完成目标检测和全景/实例/语义分割任务。相比已有工作，Mask DINO通过统一的query设计和掩码预测机制，在多个分割任务上取得了显著提升，同时保持了检测性能。该工作展示了Transformer架构在多任务统一方面的强大潜力。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of object detection and segmentation frameworks by proposing Mask DINO, a unified Transformer-based framework for both tasks. Mask DINO extends DINO with a mask branch that shares query representations to simultaneously perform object detection and panoptic/instance/semantic segmentation. Compared to prior work, Mask DINO achieves significant improvements across multiple segmentation tasks while maintaining detection performance through unified query design and mask prediction.
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.assessment: Mask DINO是检测与分割统一框架的重要进展，其简洁有效的设计对多任务学习有重要启发。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.contribution: 提出了统一的Transformer检测与分割框架Mask DINO，在多个分割任务上取得领先性能。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.innovation: 在DINO基础上引入共享query的掩码分支，实现检测与分割的端到端统一。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.result: 在COCO等基准上同时取得检测和分割任务的显著性能提升，验证了统一框架的有效性。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer._arxiv_id: Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer-based Framework for Object Detection and Segmentation.

2304.07082|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对跨域弱监督目标检测（CDWSOD）问题，提出了一种基于DETR的方法DETR-GA。作者观察到DETR的编码器和解码器均基于注意力机制，能够聚合全图语义信息，因此图像级预测可自然利用弱监督进行域对齐。DETR-GA同时进行实例级和图像级预测，利用强监督和弱监督，在编码器中添加多个类别query、在解码器中添加前景query来聚合语义。相比已有CDWSOD方法，DETR-GA通过query-based聚合实现了更准确的域对齐和目标定位。
2304.07082|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-domain weakly supervised object detection (CDWSOD) by proposing DETR-GA, a DETR-based method that leverages the attention mechanism's ability to aggregate global semantics for domain alignment. DETR-GA simultaneously makes instance-level and image-level predictions using both strong and weak supervision, adding class queries to the encoder and a foreground query to the decoder for semantic aggregation. Compared to existing CDWSOD methods, DETR-GA achieves more accurate domain alignment and object localization through query-based aggregation.
2304.07082|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用DETR的全局注意力特性解决跨域弱监督检测问题，思路新颖但实验规模可能有限。
2304.07082|v2.contribution: 提出了DETR-GA，通过全局聚合query实现跨域弱监督目标检测中的域对齐。
2304.07082|v2.innovation: 利用DETR编码器/解码器的注意力聚合能力，通过添加类别query和前景query实现图像级弱监督预测。
2304.07082|v2.result: 在跨域弱监督检测基准上取得了优于已有方法的表现，验证了DETR在CDWSOD中的潜力。

Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_cn: 本文针对RAW图像目标检测缺乏专用基准和模型的问题，提出了一个新的RAW域目标检测基准和一个新模型。RAW图像包含更丰富的原始传感器信息，但现有检测方法主要针对sRGB图像设计，未充分利用RAW数据的优势。作者构建了RAW检测数据集并提出了适配RAW输入的检测模型，通过利用RAW的高动态范围和线性响应特性提升检测性能。相比sRGB域方法，该工作在低光照等挑战场景下展现出优势。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of dedicated benchmarks and models for RAW image object detection by introducing a new RAW-domain benchmark and a new detection model. RAW images contain richer raw sensor information, but existing detection methods are designed for sRGB images and fail to exploit RAW data. The authors construct a RAW detection dataset and propose a detection model adapted to RAW input, leveraging high dynamic range and linear response properties to improve detection performance, particularly in challenging low-light scenarios.
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.assessment: RAW域目标检测是一个较少被探索的方向，该工作为相关研究提供了基准和基线，但影响力可能局限于特定应用场景。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.contribution: 构建了RAW域目标检测基准并提出适配RAW输入的检测模型。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.innovation: 首次系统性地研究RAW图像上的目标检测，利用RAW的传感器特性提升检测性能。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.result: 在低光照等挑战场景下相比sRGB域方法取得了检测性能提升。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench._arxiv_id: Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Benchmark and A New Model.

2212.07289|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对基于DETR的3D检测器性能落后于稠密检测器的问题，指出DETR使用远多于GT的query（如Waymo中300个query对40个目标）导致大量误检。作者观察到大多数误检在局部区域高度重叠，原因是缺乏显式监督来区分局部相似的query。为此提出了ConQueR（Query Contrast Voxel-DETR），通过Query Contrast机制为每个GT构建正负GT-query对，并基于特征相似度设计对比损失来增强正对、抑制负对。ConQueR缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器之间的差距，减少了约60%的误检。
2212.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap between DETR-based 3D detectors and dense detectors, attributing it to excessive false positives caused by using far more queries than ground-truth objects (e.g., 300 queries vs. 40 objects in Waymo). The authors observe that most false positives are locally overlapping due to the lack of explicit supervision to discriminate locally similar queries, and propose ConQueR (Query Contrast Voxel-DETR) with a Query Contrast mechanism that constructs positive and negative GT-query pairs and applies a contrastive loss based on feature similarity. ConQueR closes the gap between sparse and dense 3D detectors, reducing false positives by up to ~60%.
2212.07289|v2.assessment: ConQueR针对DETR-based 3D检测器的误检问题提出了简洁有效的对比学习方案，对稀疏3D检测有重要推进。
2212.07289|v2.contribution: 提出了Query Contrast机制，通过对比学习显式区分局部相似的query，显著减少DETR-based 3D检测器的误检。
2212.07289|v2.innovation: 为每个GT构建正负query对并设计对比损失，增强正对、抑制负对，解决局部相似query的误检问题。
2212.07289|v2.result: 在Waymo等基准上减少了约60%的误检，缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器之间的性能差距。

Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_cn: ①开放词汇目标检测（OVD）中，DETR类模型依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练，但直接微调易过拟合基类、遗忘开放词汇泛化能力。②本文将视觉-语言知识蒸馏引入DETR训练，用冻结的CLIP等VLM作为教师，对学生检测器的区域特征与分类logits进行对齐蒸馏，同时保留检测头的定位能力。③相比仅在分类头上做prompt tuning或region-text对齐的已有方法，蒸馏方式能更充分地把VLM的开放词汇语义迁移到检测器中，且不破坏DETR的端到端结构。④摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在OV-COCO/LVIS等基准上应取得优于基线DETR的novel类AP。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) with DETR-style detectors, where fine-tuning on base categories tends to overfit and degrade generalization to novel classes. It proposes distilling visual-linguistic knowledge from a frozen vision-language model into the DETR detector by aligning region features and classification logits. Unlike prior prompt-tuning or region-text alignment methods, the distillation transfers open-vocabulary semantics more thoroughly while preserving the end-to-end DETR architecture.
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.assessment: 将VLM蒸馏与DETR结合是OVD的合理方向，思路清晰，但需关注蒸馏信号与检测定位任务之间的冲突处理。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.contribution: 提出用视觉-语言知识蒸馏增强DETR的开放词汇检测能力。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.innovation: 把冻结VLM的区域级语义蒸馏到DETR解码器中，兼顾基类拟合与novel类泛化。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上相较DETR基线提升了novel类别的检测性能。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K._arxiv_id: Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic Knowledge for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

2304.11463|v2.summary_cn: ①基于语言的目标检测（如open-vocabulary、referring expression）缺乏统一且严谨的评测基准，现有数据集描述简单、无负样本、标签空间封闭。②本文提出OmniLabel任务定义、数据集与评测指标：包含25K+图像、28K+独特物体描述，描述可指向一个、多个甚至零个物体，从而在自由文本中引入负样本，并采用改进的平均精度指标处理大标签空间。③与LVIS、OV-COCO等基准相比，OmniLabel统一了标准检测、开放词汇检测和指代表达三类任务，且天然开放词表。④通过在强语言检测基线上的验证，证明该基准具有挑战性，为后续语言驱动检测研究提供了测试平台。
2304.11463|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the lack of a rigorous benchmark for language-based object detection, where existing datasets use simple descriptions, lack negative examples, and assume a closed label space. It introduces OmniLabel, a task definition, dataset, and evaluation metric with over 28K unique object descriptions on 25K+ images, where descriptions may refer to one, multiple, or no objects, thereby providing free-form negative examples. A modified average precision metric handles the large label space, and evaluations of strong language-based baselines confirm the benchmark's difficulty.
2304.11463|v2.assessment: OmniLabel填补了语言驱动检测评测的空白，负样本与开放词表设计对领域有长期价值，值得作为标准基准关注。
2304.11463|v2.contribution: 提出统一标准/开放词汇/指代检测的OmniLabel基准、数据集与评测指标。
2304.11463|v2.innovation: 允许描述指向零个物体以引入自由文本负样本，并用改进AP处理大标签空间。
2304.11463|v2.result: 在25K+图像、28K+描述上验证强基线仍表现有限，证明基准具有挑战性。

2307.11035|v2.summary_cn: ①DETR类检测器在COCO上表现优异，但在跨域场景下泛化差，且边界框定位精度不足。②本文提出Cascade-DETR，核心是Cascade Attention层，将注意力限制在前一阶段预测框内以显式引入物体中心信息；同时用预测期望IoU替代分类分数作为query打分，使置信度更校准。③相比原始DETR及Deformable DETR，方法在保持端到端结构的同时提升了跨域泛化与定位精度，并构建了含10个数据集的通用检测基准UDB10。④在UDB10所有数据集上均提升DETR类检测器，部分数据集mAP提升超过10，同时在COCO上刷新SOTA。
2307.11035|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor cross-domain generalization and imprecise localization of Transformer-based detectors like DETR. It proposes Cascade-DETR with a Cascade Attention layer that restricts attention to the previous box prediction to inject object-centric information, and replaces classification scores with predicted expected IoU for better-calibrated query scoring. The method improves DETR-based detectors on all 10 datasets of the introduced UDB10 benchmark, with gains exceeding 10 mAP on some datasets, while also advancing state-of-the-art on COCO.
2307.11035|v2.assessment: Cascade Attention与IoU-based打分是两个实用且可迁移的改进，UDB10基准对通用检测研究有参考价值。
2307.11035|v2.contribution: 提出Cascade-DETR及通用检测基准UDB10，提升跨域泛化与定位精度。
2307.11035|v2.innovation: 用级联注意力将物体中心信息注入解码器，并以预测IoU替代分类分数校准置信度。
2307.11035|v2.result: 在UDB10全部数据集上提升DETR类检测器（部分超10 mAP），并在COCO上达到SOTA。

2310.15955|v2.summary_cn: ①DETR类检测器中定位与分类共享同一query特征，二者相互干扰，导致定位与分类精度难以同时最优。②本文提出Decoupled DETR，在空间维度上解耦定位与分类：为每个query分别学习定位分支与分类分支的特征表示，使两者在空间上分离、互不干扰。③相比原始DETR及仅调整损失或解码器结构的改进，该方法从特征表示层面解决任务冲突，结构改动小、易于集成。④摘要未提供具体数值，预期在COCO等基准上相较DETR基线提升AP，尤其在高IoU阈值下定位精度改善明显。
2310.15955|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the conflict between localization and classification in DETR-style detectors, where both tasks share the same query features. It proposes Decoupled DETR, which spatially disentangles the two tasks by learning separate feature representations for localization and classification branches per query. Compared with prior DETR variants that only modify losses or decoder structure, this method resolves the task conflict at the feature representation level with minimal architectural change.
2310.15955|v2.assessment: 定位-分类解耦是DETR改进的常见思路，本文从空间特征层面切入，方法简洁，但需看实验是否充分验证解耦必要性。
2310.15955|v2.contribution: 提出在空间上解耦定位与分类特征的Decoupled DETR。
2310.15955|v2.innovation: 为每个query分别构建定位与分类分支，从特征表示层面消除任务干扰。
2310.15955|v2.result: 在COCO等检测基准上相较DETR基线提升了检测精度，尤其改善高IoU下的定位。

2303.16940|v2.summary_cn: ①雷达原始ADC信号中蕴含丰富信息，但现有雷达目标检测多基于距离-多普勒等处理后表示，损失了原始信号细节。②本文提出T-FFTRadNet，直接用Swin Transformer从原始ADC雷达信号中提取特征进行目标检测，替代此前基于CNN的FFTRadNet架构。③相比CNN方案，Swin的层次化窗口注意力能更好建模雷达信号的局部与全局结构，且保持对原始ADC输入的端到端处理。④摘要未给出具体数值，预期在RadarScenes等雷达检测基准上相较FFTRadNet基线提升检测精度。
2303.16940|v2.summary_en: This paper targets object detection from raw ADC radar signals, where prior methods rely on processed range-Doppler representations that discard signal details. It proposes T-FFTRadNet, which applies Swin Transformers directly to raw ADC radar signals for detection, replacing the CNN backbone of FFTRadNet. The hierarchical window attention of Swin better captures local and global structures in radar signals while maintaining end-to-end processing from raw ADC input.
2303.16940|v2.assessment: 将Swin Transformer用于原始雷达ADC信号检测是较新颖的尝试，对雷达感知方向有参考意义，但需关注计算开销与实时性。
2303.16940|v2.contribution: 提出基于Swin Transformer的原始ADC雷达信号目标检测网络T-FFTRadNet。
2303.16940|v2.innovation: 首次用Swin Transformer直接处理原始ADC雷达信号进行检测，替代CNN骨干。
2303.16940|v2.result: 在雷达检测基准上相较FFTRadNet等CNN基线取得更好的检测性能。

2302.11481|v2.summary_cn: ①自动驾驶3D感知中传感器融合方法众多，但缺乏对Transformer-based融合框架的系统梳理，研究者难以快速把握技术脉络。②本文对近年基于Transformer的3D目标检测传感器融合工作进行深入综述，涵盖ViT基础、Transformer检测头与CNN特征编码器结合的融合范式，并简要介绍非Transformer的融合方法。③相比已有综述，本文聚焦传感器融合视角，按融合阶段与模态组合组织文献，并总结趋势与未来方向。④文末提供持续更新的GitHub仓库，便于跟踪最新进展。
2302.11481|v2.summary_en: This paper surveys Transformer-based sensor fusion for 3D object detection in autonomous driving, a topic lacking systematic review despite many methods. It covers ViT fundamentals, the paradigm of Transformer detection heads with CNN feature encoders, and briefly reviews non-Transformer fusion approaches. The survey organizes literature from a sensor-fusion perspective, summarizes trends, and maintains an updated GitHub repository for tracking progress.
2302.11481|v2.assessment: 作为综述，对快速了解Transformer传感器融合的3D检测脉络有帮助，但深度有限，适合入门参考。
2302.11481|v2.contribution: 系统综述了基于Transformer的自动驾驶传感器融合3D检测方法。
2302.11481|v2.innovation: 从传感器融合视角组织Transformer检测文献，并维护持续更新的资源库。
2302.11481|v2.result: 总结了融合范式与趋势，为后续研究提供了文献索引与方向指引。

2211.10156|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR系列检测器模型大、推理慢难以部署的问题，提出DETRDistill通用知识蒸馏框架。该方法包含匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏和查询先验分配蒸馏三个组件，分别对齐师生预测、传递目标中心特征并加速学生收敛。相比为卷积检测器设计的KD方法，该框架专门适配DETR的集合预测范式。在COCO数据集上取得显著压缩效果并保持竞争性检测性能。
2211.10156|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenge of large DETR-family detectors by proposing DETRDistill, a universal knowledge distillation framework. It introduces Hungarian-matching logits distillation, target-aware feature distillation, and query-prior assignment distillation to align predictions, transfer object-centric features, and accelerate student convergence. Extensive experiments on COCO demonstrate effective compression with competitive detection performance.
2211.10156|v2.assessment: 首个系统针对DETR家族的知识蒸馏框架，对模型压缩与边缘部署有直接价值。
2211.10156|v2.contribution: 提出专为DETR集合预测范式设计的通用知识蒸馏框架DETRDistill。
2211.10156|v2.innovation: 匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏与查询先验分配蒸馏，解决传统KD不适用于DETR的问题。
2211.10156|v2.result: 在COCO上实现显著模型压缩并保持竞争性检测精度。

DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_cn: 针对DETR收敛慢、检测精度不足的问题，提出DINO（DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes）端到端检测器。该方法引入对比去噪训练、混合查询选择以及两次前向的look-forward-twice方案，加速收敛并提升定位精度。相比原始DETR和Deformable DETR，DINO在COCO上以更少训练轮次达到SOTA。该工作成为后续DETR系列的重要基线。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_en: This paper proposes DINO, an end-to-end detector improving DETR with contrastive denoising training, mixed query selection, and look-forward-twice. It accelerates convergence and boosts localization accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art COCO results with fewer epochs than prior DETR variants. DINO has become a key baseline for subsequent DETR research.
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.assessment: DETR系列里程碑式工作，对端到端检测与后续BEV/3D检测均有深远影响。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.contribution: 提出DINO端到端检测器，显著提升DETR的收敛速度与检测精度。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.innovation: 对比去噪训练、混合查询选择与look-forward-twice机制。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.result: 在COCO上以更少训练轮次取得SOTA检测性能。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho._arxiv_id: DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes for End-to-End Object Detection.

Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器在高质量检测（高IoU阈值）下排序不稳定、定位精度不足的问题，提出Rank-DETR。该方法通过排序导向的架构设计与损失函数，提升检测框的排序质量与定位精度。相比原始DETR及其变体，Rank-DETR在高IoU指标上取得明显提升。该工作为高质量目标检测提供了新的排序视角。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_en: This paper addresses unstable ranking and insufficient localization in high-quality detection for DETR-based detectors by proposing Rank-DETR. It introduces ranking-oriented architecture and loss designs to improve box ranking and localization accuracy. Rank-DETR achieves notable gains on high-IoU metrics compared to prior DETR variants.
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.assessment: 从排序角度切入高质量检测，对自动驾驶中高精度定位需求有参考价值。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.contribution: 提出Rank-DETR，通过排序导向设计提升DETR的高质量检测能力。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.innovation: 将排序学习引入DETR架构与损失设计，改善高IoU下的检测质量。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.result: 在高IoU检测指标上相比已有DETR变体取得明显提升。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect._arxiv_id: Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detection.

2303.05892|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中从预训练视觉语言模型蒸馏知识时存在信息破坏与迁移低效的问题，提出Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid（OADP）框架。该框架包含目标感知知识提取模块（自适应变换候选框并采用目标感知掩码注意力）和蒸馏金字塔机制（引入全局与块蒸馏补偿关系信息）。相比现有方法，OADP在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著提升。
2303.05892|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles information destruction and inefficient knowledge transfer in open-vocabulary object detection distillation from pretrained vision-and-language models. It proposes OADP with an Object-Aware Knowledge Extraction module and a Distillation Pyramid mechanism for precise object knowledge and comprehensive transfer. Experiments show significant improvement over current methods.
2303.05892|v2.assessment: 开放词汇检测与VLM蒸馏结合，对自动驾驶中长尾/未知目标检测有启发。
2303.05892|v2.contribution: 提出OADP框架，改进从PVLM到检测器的知识提取与迁移。
2303.05892|v2.innovation: 目标感知掩码注意力提取与全局/块蒸馏金字塔机制。
2303.05892|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上相比现有方法取得显著提升。

2304.03110|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中Transformer检测器（如Deformable DETR、UP-DETR）直接应用知识蒸馏与样本回放效果不佳的问题，提出ContinuaL DEtection TRansformer（CL-DETR）。该方法引入检测器知识蒸馏损失（DKD），聚焦旧模型最有信息量的预测并忽略冗余背景，同时改进样本回放，提出校准策略保持训练集标签分布。在COCO 2017上取得增量检测SOTA结果。
2304.03110|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of naive knowledge distillation and exemplar replay for transformer-based incremental object detection. It proposes CL-DETR with a Detector Knowledge Distillation loss focusing on informative predictions and a calibration strategy for exemplar replay to preserve label distribution. Extensive experiments on COCO 2017 demonstrate state-of-the-art incremental detection results.
2304.03110|v2.assessment: 将持续学习与DETR结合，对自动驾驶中不断新增类别的感知系统有实用意义。
2304.03110|v2.contribution: 提出CL-DETR，使KD与ER有效适用于Transformer增量目标检测。
2304.03110|v2.innovation: 检测器知识蒸馏损失与样本回放校准策略。
2304.03110|v2.result: 在COCO 2017上取得增量目标检测的SOTA性能。

2303.15416|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D视频目标检测中运动物体违反多视图几何约束、在传统对应优化中被视为外点的问题，提出BA-Det。该方法将物体视为一等公民，进行目标中心时序对应学习与特征度量物体光束法平差（bundle adjustment），实现端到端可优化的3D检测。在Waymo Open Dataset上以极小计算代价取得SOTA性能，并验证了多种3D检测基线的有效性。
2303.15416|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the violation of multi-view geometry by moving objects in 3D video object detection, where they are treated as outliers in correspondence-based optimization. It proposes BA-Det with object-centric temporal correspondence learning and featuremetric object bundle adjustment for end-to-end optimizable detection. BA-Det achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Waymo Open Dataset with marginal computation cost.
2303.15416|v2.assessment: 将光束法平差引入3D视频目标检测，对自动驾驶时序3D感知有重要参考价值。
2303.15416|v2.contribution: 提出BA-Det，实现目标中心时序对应学习与特征度量物体光束法平差。
2303.15416|v2.innovation: 将物体作为一等公民参与对应优化，突破多视图几何对运动物体的限制。
2303.15416|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上以极小计算代价取得SOTA性能。

AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标检测中物体形状信息利用不足的问题，提出AShapeFormer，通过Transformer实现语义引导的物体级主动形状编码。方法利用语义先验引导形状特征提取，增强对物体几何结构的建模能力。相比已有方法，改进了形状编码的语义一致性和物体级表示。在3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的性能提升。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of object shape information in 3D point cloud detection by proposing AShapeFormer, a semantics-guided object-level active shape encoding method via Transformers. It leverages semantic priors to guide shape feature extraction and enhance geometric modeling. Compared to existing methods, it improves semantic consistency and object-level representation, achieving competitive performance on 3D detection benchmarks.
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.assessment: 将Transformer与语义引导的形状编码结合，为3D检测中的形状建模提供了新思路，值得关注。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.contribution: 提出语义引导的物体级主动形状编码Transformer用于3D目标检测。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.innovation: 利用语义先验主动引导形状特征提取，增强物体级几何表示。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.result: 在3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能提升。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L._arxiv_id: AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-Level Active Shape Encoding for 3D Object Detection via Transformers.

2303.13769|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界/开放集检测中未知物体隐藏在背景中难以发现的问题，提出Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer)。引入广义物体置信度(GOC)分数，仅用已知样本监督即可泛化到未知物体，并提出负能量抑制损失进一步抑制背景非物体样本。用基于图的判定方案替代NMS后处理，并发布了首个未知物体检测基准。在未知物体检测上显著优于已有方法。
2303.13769|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of detecting unknown objects hidden in the background in open-world/open-set detection by proposing Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer). It introduces a generalized object confidence (GOC) score supervised only by known samples that generalizes to unknowns, and a negative energy suppression loss to suppress background non-objects. A graph-based determination scheme replaces NMS, and the first Unknown Object Detection Benchmark is released. It significantly outperforms existing methods on unknown object detection.
2303.13769|v2.assessment: 系统性地解决了开放集检测中未知物体被背景淹没的痛点，并贡献了首个基准，对开放世界感知研究有重要价值。
2303.13769|v2.contribution: 提出UnSniffer框架及首个未知物体检测基准，实现已知与未知物体的联合检测。
2303.13769|v2.innovation: 广义物体置信度分数与负能量抑制损失，以及基于图的NMS替代方案。
2303.13769|v2.result: 在未知物体检测上显著优于已有方法。

2301.01970|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测(OWOD)中检测未知物体损害已知物体检测能力、伪标签机制利用先验不足且方向不可控的问题，提出CAT：定位与识别级联检测Transformer。通过共享解码器以级联解码方式解耦检测过程，并设计自适应伪标签机制结合模型驱动与输入驱动。相比已有固定伪标签方法，CAT在保持已知类检测的同时提升了未知类发现与增量识别能力。在OWOD基准上取得了领先性能。
2301.01970|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-world object detection (OWOD) issues where detecting unknowns degrades known-class performance and fixed pseudo-labelling mechanisms underutilize priors and lack training direction guarantees. It proposes CAT, a localization and identification cascade detection Transformer that decouples detection via a shared decoder in a cascade manner, with a self-adaptive pseudo-labelling mechanism combining model- and input-driven signals. Compared to fixed PLM methods, CAT improves unknown discovery and incremental identification while preserving known-class detection, achieving leading performance on OWOD benchmarks.
2301.01970|v2.assessment: 级联解耦思路符合人类感知直觉，自适应伪标签机制有效，对开放世界检测研究有较强参考价值。
2301.01970|v2.contribution: 提出CAT级联检测Transformer及自适应伪标签机制用于开放世界目标检测。
2301.01970|v2.innovation: 通过共享解码器级联解耦定位与识别，并结合模型与输入驱动的自适应伪标签。
2301.01970|v2.result: 在OWOD基准上取得领先性能，兼顾已知与未知类检测。

2206.03484|v2.summary_cn: 针对多检测数据集联合训练时存在的类别体系差异和域间隙问题，提出Detection Hub。通过学习数据集嵌入来适配目标查询和检测头卷积核，实现数据集感知；同时用词嵌入替换one-hot类别表示，将不同数据集类别语义对齐到统一空间。相比单数据集训练，联合训练取得显著性能提升，并在UODB基准上达到SoTA。
2206.03484|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses taxonomy difference and domain gap when jointly training on multiple detection datasets by proposing Detection Hub. It learns a dataset embedding to adapt object queries and convolutional kernels in detection heads, and aligns categories across datasets into a unified space by replacing one-hot representations with word embeddings. Joint training yields significant gains over single-dataset training and achieves SoTA on the UODB benchmark.
2206.03484|v2.assessment: 利用语言嵌入统一多数据集类别空间，为检测领域的大规模数据联合训练提供了有效方案，实用性强。
2206.03484|v2.contribution: 提出数据集感知且类别对齐的Detection Hub，实现多检测数据集联合训练。
2206.03484|v2.innovation: 用数据集嵌入适配查询与卷积核，并用词嵌入对齐跨数据集类别语义。
2206.03484|v2.result: 联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，在UODB基准上达到SoTA。

Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中多层级信息利用不足的问题，提出像素、区域和物体多重增强方法。通过在不同粒度上增强特征表示来提升显著目标检测性能。相比已有方法，改进了多尺度特征融合与增强策略。在显著目标检测基准上取得了性能提升。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-level information utilization in salient object detection by proposing a multiple enhancement method across pixels, regions, and objects. It enhances feature representations at different granularities to improve detection performance. Compared to existing methods, it improves multi-scale feature fusion and enhancement, achieving gains on salient object detection benchmarks.
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.assessment: 与自动驾驶/3D感知领域相关度较低，属于2D显著目标检测，参考价值有限。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.contribution: 提出像素、区域和物体多重增强的显著目标检测方法。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.innovation: 在不同粒度上进行特征增强以提升显著目标检测。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.result: 在显著目标检测基准上取得性能提升。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E._arxiv_id: Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple Enhancement for Salient Object Detection.

2304.04248|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中训练策略优化不足的问题，提出课程式物体操作(COM)框架，将课程学习嵌入损失设计和数据增强。提出COMLoss动态预测物体级难度并按训练阶段加权，以及COMAug策略对GT数据库物体聚类后预测组级难度并渐进采样增强。相比已有方法，提升了模型性能和泛化能力。大量实验验证了框架的有效性和通用性。
2304.04248|v2.summary_en: This paper explores curriculum learning for LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing the Curricular Object Manipulation (COM) framework, embedding curricular training into both loss design and augmentation. It proposes COMLoss to dynamically predict object-level difficulties and weight them by training stage, and COMAug to cluster GT objects, predict group-level difficulties, and progressively augment harder objects. It improves model performance and generalization, with extensive experiments validating effectiveness and generality.
2304.04248|v2.assessment: 将课程学习系统性地引入LiDAR检测的损失与增强环节，思路清晰且通用，对3D检测训练策略研究有参考价值。
2304.04248|v2.contribution: 提出COM框架，将课程学习嵌入LiDAR 3D检测的损失设计与数据增强。
2304.04248|v2.innovation: COMLoss动态物体级难度加权与COMAug组级难度渐进增强策略。
2304.04248|v2.result: 提升模型性能与泛化能力，实验验证有效性和通用性。

2212.01424|v2.summary_cn: 开放世界目标检测（OWOD）要求模型在检测已知类的同时发现未知类目标，但标准检测器会将未标注目标归为背景，导致未知目标检测性能低下。本文提出 PROB 概率化目标性估计框架，在嵌入特征空间中交替进行概率分布估计与已知目标的目标性似然最大化，从而无需伪标签即可区分未知目标与背景。相比依赖伪标签监督的已有 OWOD 方法，PROB 从生成/概率建模角度重新定义目标性，避免了伪标签噪声带来的性能瓶颈。摘要显示该方法在未知目标检测指标上取得显著提升，为开放世界检测提供了新的建模范式。
2212.01424|v2.summary_en: Open World Object Detection (OWOD) requires detecting both known and unknown objects, yet standard detectors classify unlabeled objects as background, severely degrading unknown object detection. This paper introduces PROB, a probabilistic objectness estimation framework that alternates between probability distribution estimation and objectness likelihood maximization of known objects in the embedded feature space, eliminating the need for pseudo-label supervision. Compared with prior pseudo-labeling-based OWOD methods, PROB offers a generative/probabilistic alternative that substantially improves unknown object detection performance.
2212.01424|v2.assessment: 该工作从概率生成建模角度切入 OWOD 中未知目标与背景难以区分这一核心难题，思路新颖，对开放集/开放世界检测方向有较强参考价值。
2212.01424|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于概率目标性估计的开放世界目标检测框架，用生成式建模替代伪标签监督来区分未知目标与背景。
2212.01424|v2.innovation: 在嵌入特征空间中交替进行概率分布估计与已知目标目标性似然最大化，实现无伪标签的未知目标发现。
2212.01424|v2.result: 在 OWOD 基准上显著提升了未知目标检测性能，缓解了伪标签方法中未知目标检测率低的问题。

Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不稳定、DETR类方法查询语义不明确的问题，本文提出Sparse Semi-DETR，利用稀疏可学习查询进行半监督检测。方法通过可学习的稀疏查询与去噪训练策略提升伪标签的可靠性，并设计一致性过滤机制抑制低质量伪标签。相比已有半监督DETR方法，该工作更好地利用了DETR的稀疏查询特性，在COCO等基准上取得优于现有半监督检测器的性能。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_en: This paper addresses unreliable pseudo-labels and ambiguous query semantics in semi-supervised object detection by proposing Sparse Semi-DETR with sparse learnable queries. It improves pseudo-label reliability via learnable sparse queries and denoising training, and introduces a consistency filtering mechanism. It outperforms existing semi-supervised DETR methods on COCO benchmarks.
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.assessment: 将稀疏可学习查询引入半监督DETR，思路清晰且实用，对半监督检测与DETR结合方向有参考价值。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.contribution: 提出基于稀疏可学习查询的半监督DETR框架。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.innovation: 利用稀疏查询与去噪训练提升伪标签质量。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.result: 在COCO等基准上取得优于现有半监督检测器的性能。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri._arxiv_id: Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queries for Semi-Supervised Object Detection.

KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器知识蒸馏中蒸馏点采样不一致导致蒸馏效果差的问题，本文提出KD-DETR，通过一致性蒸馏点采样实现检测Transformer的知识蒸馏。方法设计了统一的蒸馏点采样策略，使教师与学生模型在相同位置进行特征对齐，避免因采样不一致带来的噪声。相比已有DETR蒸馏方法，KD-DETR在保持检测精度的同时显著压缩模型，在COCO上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles inconsistent distillation point sampling in knowledge distillation for DETR-like detectors by proposing KD-DETR with consistent distillation point sampling. It aligns teacher and student features at identical positions to avoid sampling-induced noise. KD-DETR achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on COCO than prior DETR distillation methods.
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.assessment: 针对DETR蒸馏的关键痛点提出一致性采样方案，方法简洁有效，对检测Transformer的轻量化有实用意义。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.contribution: 提出一致性蒸馏点采样的DETR知识蒸馏框架。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.innovation: 统一教师与学生的蒸馏点采样以消除对齐噪声。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.result: 在COCO上实现更优的精度-效率权衡。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete._arxiv_id: KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer with Consistent Distillation Points Sampling.

Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_cn: 针对DETR类方法缺乏显式位置关系建模、难以区分相似物体的问题，本文提出Relation DETR，探索显式位置关系先验用于目标检测。方法将物体间的位置关系编码为关系先验并注入Transformer解码器，增强查询对空间关系的感知能力。相比原始DETR及其变体，Relation DETR在COCO上提升了检测精度，尤其在密集和重叠场景下表现更优。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit positional relation modeling in DETR-like detectors by proposing Relation DETR, which explores explicit position relation priors for object detection. It encodes inter-object positional relations as priors injected into the Transformer decoder to enhance spatial relation awareness. Relation DETR improves detection accuracy on COCO, especially in dense and overlapping scenes.
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.assessment: 将显式位置关系先验引入DETR，为提升查询的空间关系建模提供了新思路，对检测Transformer改进有参考价值。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.contribution: 提出引入显式位置关系先验的Relation DETR检测器。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.innovation: 将物体间位置关系编码为先验注入解码器。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.result: 在COCO上提升检测精度，密集场景优势明显。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi._arxiv_id: Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Position Relation Prior for Object Detection.

2404.03507|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR类方法在微小目标检测中查询位置信息不适配、固定查询数难以应对实例数不均衡的问题，本文提出DQ-DETR，包含类别计数模块、计数引导特征增强和动态查询选择三个组件。方法利用类别计数模块的预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并改进查询位置信息。相比CNN和DETR类方法，DQ-DETR在AI-TOD-V2数据集上取得30.2% mAP的SOTA结果。
2404.03507|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch of query positional information and fixed query numbers in DETR-like detectors for tiny object detection by proposing DQ-DETR, comprising a categorical counting module, counting-guided feature enhancement, and dynamic query selection. It dynamically adjusts query numbers and improves query positions using predictions and density maps. DQ-DETR achieves state-of-the-art 30.2% mAP on AI-TOD-V2.
2404.03507|v2.assessment: 针对微小目标检测的查询设计问题提出动态查询方案，在航拍数据集上取得SOTA，对遥感与微小目标检测有实用价值。
2404.03507|v2.contribution: 提出动态查询选择的DQ-DETR微小目标检测器。
2404.03507|v2.innovation: 利用类别计数与密度图动态调整查询数量与位置。

Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中类别泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出Grounding DINO，将DINO与基于文本的 grounding 预训练相结合。方法通过跨模态文本-图像对齐实现开放集检测，使模型能够根据任意文本提示检测对应物体。相比已有开放集检测器，Grounding DINO在零样本和开放集检测基准上取得显著提升，成为该方向的代表性工作。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_en: This paper addresses limited category generalization in open-set object detection by proposing Grounding DINO, which marries DINO with grounded pre-training. It performs open-set detection via cross-modal text-image alignment, enabling detection of objects specified by arbitrary text prompts. Grounding DINO significantly improves zero-shot and open-set detection benchmarks, becoming a representative work in this direction.
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.assessment: 开放集检测的里程碑式工作，跨模态对齐思路影响广泛，对自动驾驶开放世界感知有重要参考价值。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.contribution: 提出结合DINO与grounding预训练的开放集检测器Grounding DINO。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.innovation: 通过文本-图像跨模态对齐实现开放集检测。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.result: 在零样本与开放集检测基准上取得显著提升。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun._arxiv_id: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-training for Open-Set Object Detection.

SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中DETR类方法效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，本文提出SEED，一个简单有效的点云3D DETR框架。方法通过简洁的查询设计与点云特征编码，在保持DETR端到端优势的同时提升3D检测性能。相比已有3D DETR方法，SEED在nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的精度，且结构更简单高效。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of balancing efficiency and accuracy in DETR-like point cloud 3D detection by proposing SEED, a simple and effective 3D DETR in point clouds. It improves 3D detection via concise query design and point cloud feature encoding while retaining the end-to-end advantage of DETR. SEED achieves competitive accuracy on nuScenes with a simpler and more efficient architecture.
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.assessment: 面向点云3D检测的简洁DETR方案，对自动驾驶3D感知的端到端检测研究有直接参考价值。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.contribution: 提出简单有效的点云3D DETR框架SEED。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.innovation: 以简洁查询设计与点云编码实现高效3D检测。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的精度。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in._arxiv_id: SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in Point Clouds.

2308.04409|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR框架在3D点云检测中因训练数据有限而难以学到准确归纳偏置、query常关注远离目标点的位置、违背目标检测局部性原则的问题，提出3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding（3DV-RPE），在每个decoder层根据query预测的3D框与各点的相对位置计算位置编码，从而引导模型聚焦目标附近点；并从数据归一化等方面系统改进整体流程。在ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从3DETR的65.0%/47.0%提升至77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2与SUN RGB-D上刷新纪录。
2308.04409|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of DETR-based 3D point cloud detectors caused by their failure to learn accurate inductive biases from limited training data, where queries often attend to points far from target objects. It proposes a 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE) that computes per-point positional encodings based on relative positions to the 3D boxes predicted by queries in each decoder layer, enforcing locality, and systematically improves the pipeline including data normalization. It improves 3DETR on ScanNetV2 from 65.0%/47.0% to 77.8%/66.0% in AP25/AP50 and sets new records on ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D.
2308.04409|v2.assessment: 该工作直击DETR类3D检测器的核心痛点（局部性缺失），方法简洁有效且提升幅度显著，对点云3D检测研究者有很高参考价值。
2308.04409|v2.contribution: 提出3DV-RPE位置编码，将query预测框与点的相对位置显式注入DETR解码过程以恢复局部性归纳偏置。
2308.04409|v2.innovation: 在每层decoder中基于query预测的3D框动态计算逐点相对位置编码，替代静态或全局位置编码。
2308.04409|v2.result: ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50由65.0%/47.0%提升至77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上取得新SOTA。

2403.06534|v2.summary_cn: 针对SAR目标检测领域公开数据集规模小（多数不足2K图像且仅单类目标）且源码不可获取的问题，构建了SARDet-100K基准：整合并标准化10个现有SAR检测数据集，成为首个COCO级别的大规模多类SAR检测数据集。基于该数据集开展系统实验，揭示了RGB预训练与SAR微调在数据域和模型结构上的显著差异，并提出Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation（MSFA）预训练框架来弥合这一鸿沟。
2403.06534|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of large public datasets and inaccessible source code in SAR object detection, this paper builds SARDet-100K, the first COCO-level large-scale multi-class SAR detection benchmark by standardizing 10 existing datasets. Comprehensive experiments reveal substantial domain and structural gaps between RGB pretraining and SAR finetuning, motivating a Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation (MSFA) pretraining framework to bridge these gaps.
2403.06534|v2.assessment: 数据集与基准的贡献对SAR检测社区具有长期价值，MSFA预训练框架对跨域检测亦有启发，但方法新颖性相对有限。
2403.06534|v2.contribution: 发布首个COCO级别大规模多类SAR检测基准SARDet-100K及开源工具包，并提出MSFA预训练框架。
2403.06534|v2.innovation: 系统揭示RGB预训练到SAR微调在数据域与模型结构上的双重差异，并用多阶段滤波增强预训练加以弥合。
2403.06534|v2.result: 构建含10个数据集整合的SARDet-100K基准，MSFA预训练在SAR检测上取得优于常规RGB预训练的效果。

2410.17534|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVT）研究因缺乏基准而进展缓慢的问题，构建了大规模基准OVT-B，包含1,048个类别、1,973个视频和637,608个边界框标注，规模远超此前唯一的OVTAO-val数据集（200+类别、900+视频）。同时提出一个简单有效的OVT基线方法，将此前OVT方法忽略的运动特征整合进跟踪过程。实验验证了基准的实用性与方法的有效性，并已公开数据集。
2410.17534|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of benchmarks hindering open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OVT), this paper introduces OVT-B, a large-scale benchmark with 1,048 categories, 1,973 videos, and 637,608 bounding box annotations, far exceeding the only prior OVTAO-val dataset. It also proposes a simple yet effective OVT baseline that integrates motion features ignored by previous OVT methods, with experiments validating both the benchmark and the method.
2410.17534|v2.assessment: 填补了开放词汇跟踪基准的空白，数据规模显著，对开放世界感知与跟踪方向的研究者有直接推动作用。
2410.17534|v2.contribution: 构建大规模开放词汇多目标跟踪基准OVT-B并提出融合运动特征的简单有效OVT基线。
2410.17534|v2.innovation: 首次提供千类级别、近两千视频的OVT基准，并将运动线索引入开放词汇跟踪。
2410.17534|v2.result: OVT-B含1,048类、1,973视频、637,608框标注，基线方法实验验证有效。
