2403.10191|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中依赖人工定义类别或大规模标注的问题，本文提出生成式区域-语言预训练方法，利用图像-文本对中的区域-语言对应关系进行预训练。方法通过生成式建模将区域特征与语言描述对齐，无需类别标签即可实现开放端检测。相比现有开放集检测方法，该方法在零样本和开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著提升，展示了生成式预训练在检测任务中的潜力。
2403.10191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-ended object detection without predefined categories by proposing a generative region-language pretraining approach. It aligns region features with language descriptions via generative modeling, enabling open-vocabulary detection without category labels. The method achieves notable improvements on zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection benchmarks compared to existing approaches.
2403.10191|v2.assessment: 该工作将生成式预训练引入开放端检测，思路新颖，对开放世界感知有重要参考价值。
2403.10191|v2.contribution: 提出生成式区域-语言预训练框架，实现无需类别标签的开放端目标检测。
2403.10191|v2.innovation: 利用生成式建模对齐区域与语言，摆脱对固定类别集的依赖。
2403.10191|v2.result: 在零样本和开放词汇检测基准上取得显著性能提升。

2403.05061|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点云稀疏、噪声大导致基于雷达的3D目标检测性能远低于LiDAR的问题，本文提出RadarDistill，通过知识蒸馏将LiDAR特征中的丰富信息迁移到雷达检测网络中。方法设计了特征级蒸馏损失，使雷达网络学习LiDAR特征的空间结构和语义信息。在nuScenes等基准上，RadarDistill显著提升了雷达检测精度，缩小了与LiDAR检测的差距，且不增加推理成本。
2403.05061|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance gap between radar-based and LiDAR-based 3D object detection caused by sparse and noisy radar point clouds. It proposes RadarDistill, which transfers rich LiDAR features to the radar detection network via knowledge distillation with feature-level losses. On nuScenes, RadarDistill substantially improves radar detection accuracy, narrowing the gap to LiDAR-based methods without extra inference cost.
2403.05061|v2.assessment: 该工作有效利用LiDAR知识提升雷达检测，对低成本自动驾驶感知方案有实用价值。
2403.05061|v2.contribution: 提出RadarDistill，通过LiDAR特征蒸馏显著提升雷达3D检测性能。
2403.05061|v2.innovation: 设计特征级蒸馏损失，将LiDAR空间结构与语义迁移至雷达网络。
2403.05061|v2.result: 在nuScenes上大幅提升雷达检测精度，缩小与LiDAR检测的差距。

GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性问题，本文提出GLOW，一种全局布局感知的攻击方法。现有攻击多关注局部扰动，而GLOW通过优化图像中物体的全局布局来生成更有效的对抗样本。方法在多个检测器上验证，能够显著降低检测性能，揭示了检测器对全局布局变化的脆弱性，为鲁棒检测研究提供了新视角。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_en: This paper addresses adversarial robustness of object detectors by proposing GLOW, a global layout-aware attack. Unlike local perturbation methods, GLOW optimizes the global layout of objects to generate effective adversarial examples. Experiments on multiple detectors show significant performance degradation, revealing vulnerability to global layout changes and offering new insights for robust detection.
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.assessment: 该工作从全局布局角度研究对抗攻击，对理解检测器脆弱性和提升鲁棒性有启发。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.contribution: 提出全局布局感知的对抗攻击方法GLOW，有效降低多种检测器性能。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.innovation: 从全局布局而非局部扰动角度生成对抗样本。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.result: 在多个检测器上显著降低检测性能，揭示全局布局脆弱性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj._arxiv_id: GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Object Detection.

2404.18150|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达目标检测中真实数据标注成本高、合成数据与真实数据域差异大的问题，本文提出RadSimReal仿真框架，用于生成逼真的雷达点云数据。方法通过精确建模雷达信号传播和噪声特性，缩小合成与真实雷达数据的差距。实验表明，在合成数据上预训练并在真实数据上微调，能显著提升雷达检测性能，为雷达感知提供了低成本数据方案。
2404.18150|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of real radar data and the domain gap between synthetic and real radar data by proposing RadSimReal, a simulation framework for realistic radar point cloud generation. It models radar signal propagation and noise to bridge the sim-to-real gap. Pretraining on synthetic data and fine-tuning on real data significantly improves radar detection performance, offering a low-cost data solution.
2404.18150|v2.assessment: 该工作为雷达检测提供了高质量的仿真数据生成方案，对解决数据稀缺问题有重要价值。
2404.18150|v2.contribution: 提出RadSimReal仿真框架，生成逼真雷达点云以缩小合成与真实数据差距。
2404.18150|v2.innovation: 精确建模雷达信号传播与噪声，实现高保真雷达仿真。
2404.18150|v2.result: 合成预训练+真实微调显著提升雷达检测性能。

Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_cn: 针对恶劣天气条件下LiDAR性能下降导致3D目标检测鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的检测方法。4D雷达在雨雾等天气下具有更好的穿透性和稳定性，方法通过多模态特征融合充分利用两者互补优势。在多种天气条件下的实验中，融合方法显著优于单一模态，提升了自动驾驶感知在恶劣环境下的可靠性。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_en: This paper addresses the degraded robustness of LiDAR-based 3D object detection in adverse weather by proposing a LiDAR and 4D radar fusion approach. 4D radar offers better penetration and stability in rain and fog, and the method fuses multimodal features to exploit their complementarity. Experiments under various weather conditions show the fusion method significantly outperforms single-modality baselines, improving perception reliability in harsh environments.
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.assessment: 该工作针对恶劣天气下的感知鲁棒性，LiDAR与4D雷达融合方案对自动驾驶安全至关重要。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.contribution: 提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的3D检测方法，提升恶劣天气下的感知鲁棒性。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.innovation: 利用4D雷达在恶劣天气下的稳定性与LiDAR互补融合。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.result: 在多种天气条件下显著优于单一模态检测方法。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with._arxiv_id: Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with LiDAR and 4D Radar Fusion in Various Weather Conditions.

2304.05370|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备上目标检测模型的延迟攻击问题，本文提出Overload方法，通过生成对抗样本使检测器产生大量冗余计算，从而显著增加推理延迟。现有攻击多关注精度下降，而Overload聚焦于计算资源耗尽。实验在多种边缘设备和检测器上验证，能够有效提升延迟，揭示了边缘部署检测器的安全风险，对实时自动驾驶系统有警示意义。
2304.05370|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses latency attacks on object detection models deployed on edge devices by proposing Overload, which generates adversarial examples that induce excessive redundant computation, significantly increasing inference latency. Unlike accuracy-degradation attacks, Overload targets computational resource exhaustion. Experiments on various edge devices and detectors demonstrate effective latency increases, revealing security risks for real-time autonomous driving systems.
2304.05370|v2.assessment: 该工作关注边缘设备上检测器的延迟攻击，对自动驾驶实时性和安全性有重要警示作用。
2304.05370|v2.contribution: 提出Overload延迟攻击方法，通过对抗样本显著增加边缘设备检测推理延迟。
2304.05370|v2.innovation: 从计算资源耗尽角度攻击检测器，而非传统精度下降。
2304.05370|v2.result: 在多种边缘设备和检测器上有效提升推理延迟。

Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_cn: 针对无人机多模态（RGB-红外等）目标检测中模态间空间弱错位导致特征对齐困难的问题，提出一种弱错位自适应的特征对齐方法。方法通过可学习的对齐模块在特征层面动态校正跨模态偏移，而非依赖严格配准的输入。相比已有假设严格对齐的多模态融合方法，该方法在存在弱错位时更鲁棒。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，但面向UAV多模态检测这一实际场景具有应用价值。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal object detection on UAVs where weak spatial misalignment between modalities degrades feature fusion. It proposes a weakly misalignment-free adaptive feature alignment module that dynamically corrects cross-modal offsets at the feature level instead of assuming strict registration. Compared with prior fusion methods that assume well-aligned inputs, it is more robust under weak misalignment, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.assessment: 面向UAV多模态检测的错位对齐问题，思路实用，对多传感器融合感知有参考价值。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.contribution: 提出弱错位自适应的跨模态特征对齐方法用于UAV多模态目标检测。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.innovation: 在特征层面动态校正跨模态弱错位，摆脱对严格配准输入的依赖。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.result: 在弱错位条件下提升了多模态检测的鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur._arxiv_id: Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-Based Multimodal Object Detection.

2401.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中实时性与零样本泛化难以兼顾的问题，提出YOLO-World，将YOLO检测器与视觉-语言预训练结合实现实时开放词汇检测。方法通过在大规模图像-文本数据上进行预训练，并采用可重参数化的词汇表示，使模型在推理时无需文本编码器即可高效检测任意类别。相比此前开放词汇检测器速度慢、部署难的问题，YOLO-World在保持实时速度的同时具备强零样本能力。该工作对开放集检测与VLM结合方向具有重要影响。
2401.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles real-time open-vocabulary object detection, where existing detectors struggle to balance speed and zero-shot generalization. It proposes YOLO-World, which integrates a YOLO detector with vision-language pretraining and uses re-parameterizable vocabulary representations to enable efficient detection of arbitrary categories without a text encoder at inference. Compared with prior open-vocabulary detectors that are slow and hard to deploy, it achieves strong zero-shot capability at real-time speed, making it highly influential for open-set detection and VLM integration.
2401.17270|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测做到实时，工程与学术价值兼具，是该方向的重要参考工作。
2401.17270|v2.contribution: 提出实时开放词汇检测器YOLO-World，融合YOLO与视觉-语言预训练。
2401.17270|v2.innovation: 可重参数化词汇表示使推理时无需文本编码器即可检测任意类别。
2401.17270|v2.result: 在保持实时速度的同时实现强零样本开放词汇检测能力。

Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测中模型难以泛化到未见域的问题，提出聚焦于多样化与对齐的改进方法。方法通过增强训练数据的多样性并显式对齐不同域的特征分布，提升检测器的域泛化能力。相比已有单域泛化方法，该工作强调多样化与对齐的协同作用。摘要未给出具体数值，但面向域泛化检测这一重要问题具有研究价值。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses single domain-generalized object detection, where models fail to generalize to unseen domains. It proposes a method focusing on diversification and alignment, enhancing training data diversity and explicitly aligning feature distributions across domains. Compared with prior single-domain generalization methods, it emphasizes the synergy of diversification and alignment, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.assessment: 聚焦单域泛化检测的多样化与对齐，思路清晰，对域泛化感知有参考意义。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.contribution: 提出结合多样化与对齐的单域泛化目标检测改进方法。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.innovation: 强调数据多样化与特征对齐的协同以提升域泛化能力。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.result: 提升了单域泛化检测在未见域上的表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje._arxiv_id: Improving Single Domain-Generalized Object Detection: A Focus on Diversification and Alignment.

D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_cn: 针对RGB-热红外域自适应目标检测中跨模态域差距大的问题，提出D3T（Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher）方法，通过双域教师模型在RGB与热红外之间进行之字形知识迁移。方法利用双域教师分别指导跨模态适应，缓解模态间鸿沟。相比已有域自适应方法，该工作针对RGB-T跨模态场景设计了专门的双教师机制。摘要未给出具体数值，但对多模态域自适应检测有参考价值。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_en: This paper addresses domain-adaptive object detection across the RGB-thermal gap, where large cross-modal domain discrepancy hinders adaptation. It proposes D3T, a distinctive dual-domain teacher framework that performs zigzagging knowledge transfer between RGB and thermal domains. Compared with prior domain adaptation methods, it designs a dedicated dual-teacher mechanism for RGB-T cross-modal scenarios, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.assessment: 针对RGB-T跨模态域自适应的双教师设计有新意，对多模态感知有参考价值。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.contribution: 提出双域教师之字形迁移的RGB-T域自适应目标检测方法D3T。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.innovation: 利用双域教师在RGB与热红外间进行之字形知识迁移以弥合模态鸿沟。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.result: 缓解了RGB-T跨模态域差距，提升域自适应检测表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig._arxiv_id: D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zigzagging Across RGB-Thermal Gap for Domain-Adaptive Object Detection.

Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在昼夜域差异下性能下降的问题，提出零样本昼夜域自适应方法以提升检测鲁棒性。方法无需目标域标注，通过零样本域适应策略缩小昼夜图像分布差异。相比需要目标域标注的域自适应方法，该工作实现零样本迁移，更贴近实际部署。摘要未给出具体数值，但对自动驾驶昼夜感知有实际意义。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of object detection under day-night domain shift and proposes a zero-shot day-night domain adaptation method. Without target-domain labels, it narrows the distribution gap between day and night images via zero-shot adaptation. Compared with label-dependent domain adaptation methods, it enables zero-shot transfer, which is more practical for deployment, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.assessment: 零样本昼夜域自适应对自动驾驶全天候感知有实际价值，方向值得关注。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.contribution: 提出零样本昼夜域自适应方法以提升目标检测鲁棒性。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.innovation: 无需目标域标注即可缩小昼夜图像分布差异实现零样本迁移。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.result: 提升了昼夜域差异下的检测鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot._arxiv_id: Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot Day-Night Domain Adaptation.

InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_cn: 针对目标检测训练数据标注成本高、长尾类别样本稀缺的问题，提出InstaGen，通过在合成数据集上训练来增强目标检测。方法利用生成模型合成带实例标注的图像，并将其与真实数据结合训练检测器，提升对稀有类别的检测能力。相比仅用真实数据训练的方法，该工作通过合成数据扩充了类别与场景多样性。摘要未给出具体数值，但合成数据增强检测是当前热点方向，具有较高参考价值。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and long-tail scarcity in object detection training by proposing InstaGen, which enhances detection through training on synthetic datasets. It leverages generative models to synthesize instance-annotated images and combines them with real data to train detectors, improving detection of rare categories. Compared with real-data-only training, it expands category and scene diversity via synthetic data, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.assessment: 利用合成数据增强检测，契合生成式数据与检测结合的热点，值得关注。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.contribution: 提出InstaGen，通过合成数据集训练增强目标检测能力。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.innovation: 利用生成模型合成带实例标注的图像并与真实数据联合训练检测器。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.result: 通过合成数据扩充提升了稀有类别与场景的检测表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by._arxiv_id: InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by Training on Synthetic Dataset.

Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对少样本目标检测（FSOD）中标注数据稀缺、模型泛化能力不足的问题。作者提出利用基础模型（Foundation Models）的通用表征能力来增强少样本检测，通过将大规模预训练视觉基础模型的特征迁移到检测框架中，以缓解新类别样本极少带来的过拟合。相比传统基于元学习或微调的 FSOD 方法，该工作强调基础模型提供的强先验可减少对大量标注的依赖。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，因此效果需参考正文验证。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection (FSOD), where scarce annotations limit generalization. The authors leverage foundation models to transfer general-purpose visual representations into the detection pipeline, mitigating overfitting when only a few samples of novel classes are available. Compared with conventional meta-learning or fine-tuning FSOD approaches, the method emphasizes strong priors from large-scale pretraining to reduce annotation dependence. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.assessment: 将基础模型引入少样本检测是当前热点方向，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其是否真正解决基础模型与检测头适配的问题。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.contribution: 提出利用基础模型通用表征来提升少样本目标检测性能的框架。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.innovation: 将大规模预训练基础模型的特征迁移与少样本检测任务相结合。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需依据正文实验判断。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundation Models.

2503.01463|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有DETR类模型级联解码器架构限制object query只能沿级联方向更新、难以充分利用图像特征的问题，本文提出并行Multi-time Inquiries (MI)机制的新型解码器架构MI-DETR。MI使object query能够学习更全面的信息，在COCO基准上于不同backbone和训练epoch下均超越所有现有DETR类模型，在ResNet-50下相比DINO提升+2.3 AP、相比SOTA的Relation-DETR提升+0.6 AP。诊断与可视化实验验证了MI的有效性、合理性与可解释性。
2503.01463|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes the limitation of cascaded decoder architectures in DETR-like models, where object queries can only update along the cascade direction and thus learn limited information from image features. It proposes a parallel Multi-time Inquiries (MI) mechanism, yielding MI-DETR, which enables queries to learn more comprehensive information. MI-DETR outperforms all existing DETR-like models on COCO across backbones and training epochs, achieving +2.3 AP over DINO and +0.6 AP over Relation-DETR with ResNet-50, supported by diagnostic and visualization experiments.
2503.01463|v2.assessment: 对DETR解码器架构的改进思路清晰且通用，在COCO上取得一致提升，对检测方向研究者有较高参考价值。
2503.01463|v2.contribution: 提出并行Multi-time Inquiries解码器机制，突破级联解码器的信息学习瓶颈。
2503.01463|v2.innovation: 以并行多时询问替代级联单向更新，使object query获取更全面的图像特征信息。
2503.01463|v2.result: 在COCO上ResNet-50下较DINO提升+2.3 AP、较Relation-DETR提升+0.6 AP。

2412.06647|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件流目标检测中现有SNN、Transformer或CNN检测器在性能、计算开销或局部感受野方面的局限，本文提出基于MoE热传导的检测算法，通过stem网络嵌入事件数据，经MoE-HCO块（多专家模块模拟事件流热传导）处理，再用IoU-based query selection提取token送入检测头。同时发布基于Prophesee EVK4-HD采集的新基准数据集EvDET200K。方法在精度与计算效率间取得良好平衡。
2412.06647|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing event-stream detectors based on SNNs, Transformers, or CNNs in terms of performance, computational cost, or local receptive fields, this paper proposes a MoE heat-conduction-based detection algorithm. It embeds event data via a stem network, processes through MoE-HCO blocks with expert modules mimicking heat conduction, and uses IoU-based query selection feeding a detection head. A new benchmark dataset, EvDET200K, captured with a Prophesee EVK4-HD camera, is also introduced, striking a balance between accuracy and efficiency.
2412.06647|v2.assessment: 将MoE与热传导建模引入事件相机检测，并配套大规模数据集，对事件感知与检测研究者有参考意义。
2412.06647|v2.contribution: 提出MoE热传导检测算法并发布EvDET200K事件检测基准数据集。
2412.06647|v2.innovation: 用多专家模块模拟事件流热传导过程，并结合IoU-based query selection平衡精度与效率。
2412.06647|v2.result: 在精度与计算效率间取得显著平衡，并提供大规模事件检测基准。

2510.13620|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有UAV可见光-红外检测数据集成像条件覆盖不足、难以反映真实复杂性的问题，本文构建了高多样性数据集ATR-UMOD，覆盖80m-300m高度、0°-75°角度及全天候全年的天气与光照变化，每对RGB-IR图像标注6种条件属性。并提出prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF)，将成像条件编码为文本prompt，通过任务特定软门控变换自适应重分配多模态贡献，配合prompt引导的条件解耦模块保证可用性。
2510.13620|v2.summary_en: To address the limited imaging-condition coverage of existing UAV RGB-IR detection datasets, this paper introduces ATR-UMOD, a high-diversity dataset spanning altitudes of 80-300m, angles of 0-75 degrees, and all-day/all-year weather and illumination variations, with 6 condition attributes annotated per RGB-IR pair. It proposes prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF), which encodes imaging conditions as text prompts and adaptively reassigns multimodal contributions via task-specific soft gating, complemented by a prompt-guided condition-decoupling module.
2510.13620|v2.assessment: 数据集多样性突出且引入条件prompt引导融合，对多模态与UAV感知研究者有实用价值。
2510.13620|v2.contribution: 构建高多样性UAV RGB-IR检测数据集ATR-UMOD并提出条件感知动态融合方法PCDF。
2510.13620|v2.innovation: 将成像条件编码为文本prompt，通过软门控变换自适应调节多模态融合贡献。
2510.13620|v2.result: 在多样成像条件下提升多模态检测的鲁棒性与适应性。

2506.23575|v2.summary_cn: 针对反无人机任务中小目标检测因目标尺寸小、背景复杂而困难，且现有事件检测数据集规模小、目标大、背景单一的问题，本文提出首个大规模高多样性事件小目标检测基准EV-UAV，含147个序列、超230万事件级标注，目标平均仅6.8×5.4像素，覆盖城市杂乱与极端光照场景。基于小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的观察，提出事件稀疏分割网络EV-SpSegNet作为基线。
2506.23575|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of small object detection in anti-UAV tasks and the limitations of existing event datasets (small scale, large targets, limited backgrounds), this paper introduces EV-UAV, the first large-scale, highly diverse event-based small object detection benchmark, with 147 sequences and over 2.3 million event-level annotations, averaging 6.8x5.4 pixel targets across urban clutter and extreme lighting. Observing that small moving targets form continuous curves in spatiotemporal event point clouds, it proposes EV-SpSegNet as a baseline.
2506.23575|v2.assessment: 填补事件相机小目标检测基准空白，数据集规模与标注粒度突出，对事件感知与SOD研究者价值较高。
2506.23575|v2.contribution: 发布首个大规模事件小目标检测基准EV-UAV并提出EV-SpSegNet基线。
2506.23575|v2.innovation: 利用小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的特性进行事件稀疏分割。
2506.23575|v2.result: 提供147序列、230万+事件级标注的基准，目标平均6.8×5.4像素。

When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_cn: 针对小样本目标检测（FSOD）中 ViT 类检测器难以充分利用像素级差异信息的问题，本文提出 PiDiViT，将像素差异模式（Pixel Difference Patterns）与 ViT 架构结合。方法通过显式建模支持集与查询集之间的像素级差异特征，增强 ViT 对类间细微差异的判别能力，从而缓解小样本场景下特征区分度不足的问题。相比已有基于 ViT 的 FSOD 方法，PiDiViT 在特征层面引入差异先验，提升了新类别的泛化能力。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文验证其有效性。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of few-shot object detection (FSOD) with ViT-based detectors, which struggle to exploit pixel-level difference cues. It proposes PiDiViT, integrating pixel difference patterns into the ViT architecture to enhance discrimination between support and query features. Compared with existing ViT-based FSOD methods, it introduces an explicit difference prior at the feature level, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.assessment: 将像素差异先验引入 ViT 用于 FSOD 的思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验表现。

DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_cn: 针对跨域小样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中模型在新域上需重新训练的问题，本文提出一种无需重训练的混合框架，将 DETR 与视觉基础模型（Vision Foundation Models）相结合。方法利用基础模型的开放词汇与泛化能力弥补 DETR 在跨域小样本场景下的不足，避免了对目标域的微调。相比需要重训练的传统 CD-FSOD 方法，该方案在部署效率与跨域适应性上具有优势。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), where models typically require retraining on new domains. It proposes a retraining-free mixture framework combining DETR with vision foundation models to leverage their open-vocabulary generalization. Compared with conventional CD-FSOD pipelines requiring fine-tuning, the approach improves deployment efficiency and cross-domain adaptability, though quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.assessment: 免重训练的 DETR+基础模型混合思路对实际部署有吸引力，但需验证其在标准 CD-FSOD 基准上的表现。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.contribution: 提出一种无需重训练的 DETR 与视觉基础模型混合框架用于跨域小样本检测。

2505.20612|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 在预训练分布之外的类别、任务和成像模态上泛化能力差的问题，本文提出 Roboflow100-VL 基准，包含 100 个多模态目标检测数据集，覆盖 VLM 预训练中罕见的概念。作者主张通过包含少量视觉示例和丰富文本描述的标注指令来对齐 VLM 与新概念，并在零样本、少样本、半监督和全监督四种设定下评估了 SOTA 模型。实验发现 GroundingDINO 和 Qwen2.5-VL 在挑战性医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足 2%，凸显少样本概念对齐的必要性，并分享了 CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD 竞赛的社区洞察。
2505.20612|v2.summary_en: To address VLMs' poor generalization to out-of-distribution classes, tasks, and imaging modalities, this paper introduces Roboflow100-VL, a benchmark of 100 multi-modal detection datasets covering concepts rare in VLM pre-training. It evaluates state-of-the-art models under zero-shot, few-shot, semi-supervised, and fully-supervised regimes, and advocates aligning VLMs to new concepts via annotation instructions with few visual examples and rich text. Notably, GroundingDINO and Qwen2.5-VL achieve less than 2% zero-shot accuracy on challenging medical datasets, underscoring the need for few-shot concept alignment.
2505.20612|v2.assessment: 该基准覆盖多模态与多数据机制，对 VLM 检测泛化研究具有较高参考价值，尤其是医学等 OOD 场景的量化发现。
2505.20612|v2.contribution: 构建了包含 100 个多模态检测数据集的 Roboflow100-VL 基准并系统评估 VLM 泛化能力。
2505.20612|v2.innovation: 提出以少样本视觉示例加丰富文本指令对齐 VLM 新概念，并覆盖四种数据机制评估。
2505.20612|v2.result: GroundingDINO 与 Qwen2.5-VL 在挑战性医学数据集上零样本精度不足 2%。

2503.18430|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模词表目标检测中分类式检测器的两大缺陷——稀有正类梯度稀释和难负样本梯度被大量易负样本淹没，本文提出 CQ-DINO，将分类重构为物体查询与可学习类别查询之间的对比任务。方法引入图像引导的查询选择，通过交叉注意力为每张图像自适应检索 top-K 相关类别，从而缩小负样本空间、重平衡梯度分布并隐式挖掘难例。CQ-DINO 还能在结构化数据集（如 V3Det）中整合显式层级类别关系，或在通用数据集（如 COCO）中通过自注意力学习隐式类别关联，在挑战性基准上取得优越性能。
2503.18430|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies two limitations of classification-based detectors for vast-vocabulary detection: positive gradient dilution for rare categories and hard negative gradient dilution by numerous easy negatives. It proposes CQ-DINO, reformulating classification as contrastive matching between object queries and learnable category queries, with image-guided top-K category retrieval via cross-attention to rebalance gradients and mine hard examples implicitly. CQ-DINO integrates explicit hierarchical category relations on structured datasets (e.g., V3Det) or learns implicit correlations on generic datasets (e.g., COCO), achieving superior performance on challenging benchmarks.
2503.18430|v2.assessment: 从梯度稀释角度切入大规模词表检测问题，方法设计有针对性，对开放词表与长尾检测研究有参考意义。
2503.18430|v2.contribution: 提出基于类别查询对比的 CQ-DINO 框架以缓解大规模词表检测中的梯度稀释问题。
2503.18430|v2.innovation: 将分类重构为物体查询与类别查询的对比任务，并用图像引导 top-K 检索缩小负样本空间。
2503.18430|v2.result: 在挑战性基准上取得优于已有方法的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2411.17761|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界 3D 感知缺乏全面基准与鲁棒通用方法的问题，本文提出 OpenAD，首个面向 3D 目标检测的真实开放世界自动驾驶基准。OpenAD 基于结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的 corner case 发现与标注流水线，在五个自动驾驶感知数据集的 2000 个场景中以统一格式标注 corner case 物体，并设计了评估方法。作者评估了多种开放世界与专用 2D/3D 模型，提出以视觉为中心的 3D 开放世界检测基线，并进一步引入融合通用与专用模型的集成方法以缓解现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题，同时在线举办 EvalAI 挑战赛。
2411.17761|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenAD, the first real-world open-world benchmark for 3D object detection in autonomous driving, addressing the lack of comprehensive benchmarks and robust generalizable methods. Built on a corner-case discovery and annotation pipeline integrating an MLLM, OpenAD annotates corner-case objects in a unified format across five perception datasets with 2000 scenarios, and provides evaluation protocols. The authors benchmark various open-world and specialized 2D/3D models, propose a vision-centric 3D open-world detection baseline, and introduce an ensemble method fusing general and specialized models to mitigate low precision of existing open-world approaches.
2411.17761|v2.assessment: 作为首个真实开放世界 3D 检测基准，OpenAD 对自动驾驶感知的域泛化与 corner case 研究具有重要推动价值。
2411.17761|v2.contribution: 构建了首个真实开放世界自动驾驶 3D 检测基准 OpenAD 及配套评估方法与基线。
2411.17761|v2.innovation: 利用 MLLM 驱动的 corner case 发现与标注流水线，并提出通用与专用模型融合的集成方法。
2411.17761|v2.result: 在五个数据集 2000 个场景上建立基准，集成方法缓解了现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题。

2501.16665|v2.summary_cn: 针对 X 射线安检图像中因物体重叠导致的前景-背景特征耦合问题，本文提出类别语义先验对比学习（CSPCL）机制，用于基于 Deformable DETR 的违禁品检测器。方法将分类器感知的类别原型与内容查询对齐，以修正和补充分类所需的缺失语义信息，从而增强模型对前景特征的敏感度。为此设计了 CSP 损失，包含类内截断吸引（ITA）损失和类间自适应排斥（IAR）损失，其中 ITA 通过梯度截断函数在吸引类内查询的同时保留类内多样性，IAR 依据原型间相似度自适应排斥类间查询，性能优于经典对比损失。
2501.16665|v2.summary_en: To address foreground-background feature coupling caused by overlapping objects in X-ray images, this paper proposes Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning (CSPCL) for Deformable DETR-based prohibited item detectors. CSPCL aligns classifier-perceived class prototypes with content queries to correct and supplement missing semantic information, enhancing foreground sensitivity. It designs a CSP loss comprising Intra-Class Truncated Attraction (ITA) and Inter-Class Adaptive Repulsion (IAR), where ITA preserves intra-class diversity via gradient truncation and IAR adaptively repels inter-class queries based on prototype similarity, outperforming classic contrastive losses.
2501.16665|v2.assessment: 面向 X 射线安检这一特定场景，对比学习设计有针对性，但与通用目标检测/自动驾驶主线相关度较低。
2501.16665|v2.contribution: 提出类别语义先验对比学习机制 CSPCL 用于 X 射线违禁品检测。
2501.16665|v2.innovation: 设计 ITA 与 IAR 组成的 CSP 损失，实现类原型与内容查询的对齐并保留类内多样性。
2501.16665|v2.result: CSP 损失性能优于经典对比损失（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测中新类别物体难以被识别的问题，提出了一种开放世界物体性（objectness）建模方法，将物体性作为连接已知类与未知类的统一表示。方法通过在大规模数据上学习类无关的物体性先验，并将其融入检测框架，从而在无需新类标注的情况下发现并定位新物体。相比已有开放集检测方法依赖伪标签或阈值调优，该工作以物体性建模统一了新颖物体发现与分类。在开放世界检测基准上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了物体性建模的有效性。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_en: This paper addresses novel object detection in open-world settings by proposing an open-world objectness modeling approach that serves as a unified representation bridging known and unknown categories. The method learns class-agnostic objectness priors from large-scale data and integrates them into the detection framework to discover and localize novel objects without new-class annotations. It outperforms existing open-set detection methods that rely on pseudo-labeling or threshold tuning, achieving notable improvements on open-world detection benchmarks.
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.assessment: 该工作为开放世界检测提供了新的视角，将物体性建模作为统一框架，思路新颖且实用性强，值得关注。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.contribution: 提出开放世界物体性建模，统一新颖物体发现与已知类检测。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.innovation: 以类无关物体性先验替代传统伪标签策略来发现新物体。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.result: 在开放世界检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N._arxiv_id: Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies Novel Object Detection.

2503.15293|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型易受后门攻击的问题，提出了一种测试时后门检测方法TRACE。方法基于两个观察：中毒样本在不同背景下检测结果更一致，而干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测一致性更高；据此对测试样本施加前景和背景变换，通过计算变换一致性来区分中毒与干净样本。相比现有主要针对图像分类的后门防御方法，TRACE专门解决了目标检测中多目标输出和复杂攻击效果（如幽灵物体、消失物体）带来的新挑战。实验表明该方法能有效检测中毒样本并阻止后门激活。
2503.15293|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of object detection models to backdoor attacks by proposing TRACE, a test-time poisoned sample detection method. Based on two observations—poisoned samples show more consistent detections across backgrounds while clean samples show higher consistency under different focal information—TRACE applies foreground and background transformations and measures transformation consistency to distinguish poisoned from clean samples. Unlike existing defenses designed for image classification, TRACE tackles challenges unique to object detection such as numerous object outputs and complex attack effects, effectively detecting poisoned samples and preventing backdoor activation.
2503.15293|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了目标检测后门防御的空白，利用变换一致性进行检测的思路巧妙，对安全敏感应用有实际意义。
2503.15293|v2.contribution: 提出TRACE方法，实现目标检测模型测试时后门样本检测。
2503.15293|v2.innovation: 利用前景/背景变换一致性区分中毒与干净样本。
2503.15293|v2.result: 有效检测中毒样本并阻止后门激活。

ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_cn: 该论文针对旋转目标检测中旋转不变性与等变性难以兼顾的问题，提出了ReDiffDet——一种旋转等变扩散模型用于有向目标检测。方法将扩散模型与旋转等变网络结合，在去噪过程中保持特征对旋转的等变性，从而更准确地回归有向边界框。相比已有方法依赖数据增强或旋转不变特征，ReDiffDet通过等变扩散过程显式建模旋转对称性。在遥感等有向目标检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of balancing rotation invariance and equivariance in oriented object detection by proposing ReDiffDet, a rotation-equivariant diffusion model. The method integrates diffusion models with rotation-equivariant networks, maintaining feature equivariance during denoising to more accurately regress oriented bounding boxes. Unlike existing approaches relying on data augmentation or rotation-invariant features, ReDiffDet explicitly models rotational symmetry through an equivariant diffusion process, achieving superior performance on oriented object detection benchmarks such as remote sensing.
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.assessment: 将扩散模型引入旋转等变目标检测是新颖的尝试，对遥感等有向检测场景有重要价值。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.contribution: 提出旋转等变扩散模型ReDiffDet用于有向目标检测。

SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测中语义信息利用不足的问题，提出了SEEN-DA方法，利用语义熵引导的域感知注意力机制。方法通过计算语义熵来衡量预测不确定性，并据此引导注意力模块关注域不变特征，从而提升跨域检测性能。相比已有域自适应方法主要依赖对抗对齐或风格迁移，SEEN-DA从语义熵角度出发更精细地处理域偏移。在标准域自适应检测基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient semantic exploitation in domain adaptive object detection by proposing SEEN-DA, a semantic entropy-guided domain-aware attention method. The approach computes semantic entropy to measure prediction uncertainty and uses it to guide attention modules toward domain-invariant features, improving cross-domain detection. Unlike existing methods relying on adversarial alignment or style transfer, SEEN-DA handles domain shift more precisely from a semantic entropy perspective, achieving competitive results on standard domain adaptive detection benchmarks.
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.assessment: 语义熵引导注意力的思路有一定新意，对域自适应检测领域有参考价值。

Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量目标检测中灾难性遗忘问题，提出了学习内生注意力（Endogenous Attention）的方法。方法通过设计内生注意力机制，使模型在学习新类别时能够自适应地保留对旧类别的判别能力，从而缓解遗忘。相比已有增量检测方法依赖知识蒸馏或样本回放，该方法从注意力机制本身出发更优雅地平衡新旧知识。在增量检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by proposing a method to learn endogenous attention. The approach designs an endogenous attention mechanism that adaptively preserves discriminative ability for old classes while learning new ones, mitigating forgetting. Unlike existing incremental detection methods relying on knowledge distillation or replay, this method balances old and new knowledge more elegantly from the attention mechanism itself, achieving superior results on incremental detection benchmarks.
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.assessment: 从注意力机制角度解决增量检测遗忘问题具有新意，对持续学习与检测交叉领域有参考价值。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.contribution: 提出内生注意力学习方法来缓解增量目标检测中的遗忘。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.innovation: 通过内生注意力机制自适应平衡新旧类别知识。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.result: 在增量检测基准上优于现有方法。

2502.04268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点监督有向目标检测中实例空间布局利用不足的问题，提出了Point2RBox-v2。方法基于三个核心原则：高斯重叠损失学习实例上界、Voronoi分水岭损失学习实例下界、一致性损失学习输入与增强视图间的尺寸/旋转变化，并辅以边缘损失和复制粘贴等技术。相比已有方法，这是首个探索实例间空间布局用于点监督有向检测的工作。在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上分别达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，尤其在密集场景中表现优异。
2502.04268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient exploitation of spatial layout among instances in point-supervised oriented object detection by proposing Point2RBox-v2. The method is built on three principles: Gaussian overlap loss for learning instance upper bounds, Voronoi watershed loss for lower bounds, and consistency loss for size/rotation variation between input and augmented views, supplemented by edge loss and copy-paste. As the first approach to explore spatial layout among instances for point-supervised OOD, it achieves 62.61%/86.15%/34.71% on DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M, excelling in densely packed scenes.
2502.04268|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地利用实例空间布局提升点监督有向检测，方法优雅轻量且性能强劲，值得关注。
2502.04268|v2.contribution: 提出Point2RBox-v2，首次利用实例空间布局进行点监督有向目标检测。
2502.04268|v2.innovation: 结合高斯重叠损失、Voronoi分水岭损失和一致性损失建模实例布局。
2502.04268|v2.result: 在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，密集场景表现优异。

2503.12009|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中Transformer框架将3D体素序列化为1D序列时破坏空间结构、且因体素数量庞大而分组处理导致感受野受限的问题，本文提出Unified Mamba（UniMamba），将3D卷积与状态空间模型（SSM）以多头方式融合，实现高效的"局部与全局"空间上下文聚合。其UniMamba块包含空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化和局部-全局序列聚合器，其中空间局部性建模模块用3D子流形卷积捕获动态空间结构。相比Transformer方法，该方法在保持全局依赖建模能力的同时避免了序列化带来的结构破坏和二次复杂度问题。
2503.12009|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issues in LiDAR-based 3D detection where Transformer frameworks destroy spatial structure during serialization of 3D voxels and suffer from limited receptive fields due to grouping. It proposes Unified Mamba (UniMamba), which integrates 3D convolution and State Space Models in a multi-head manner for efficient local-global spatial context aggregation, comprising spatial locality modeling, complementary Z-order serialization, and a local-global sequential aggregator. The method avoids structural destruction and quadratic complexity while maintaining global dependency modeling.
2503.12009|v2.assessment: 将Mamba/SSM引入LiDAR 3D检测是一个有前景的方向，方法设计较为系统，对序列化破坏空间结构的问题给出了针对性方案，值得关注。
2503.12009|v2.contribution: 提出UniMamba，将3D卷积与SSM以多头方式统一，实现LiDAR点云局部与全局空间上下文的高效同步聚合。
2503.12009|v2.innovation: 用互补Z-order序列化与3D子流形卷积结合SSM，在避免序列化结构破坏的同时突破Transformer分组带来的感受野限制。
2503.12009|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称在保持全局依赖建模的同时避免了二次复杂度与结构破坏问题。

2410.11774|v2.summary_cn: 针对真实数据集长尾分布导致稀有类别检测困难的问题，现有重加权与重采样方法仅利用类别频率统计而忽略类别在图像空间中的分布信息。本文提出FRActal CALibration（FRACAL），一种无需训练的后校准方法，利用分形维数估计类别在图像空间中分布的均匀程度，在推理时据此反向降低均匀分布类别预测的概率。该方法可即插即用地结合单阶段sigmoid检测器和两阶段实例分割模型，在稀有类别性能上取得显著提升。
2410.11774|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-tailed object detection where existing re-weighting and re-sampling methods rely solely on class frequency statistics while ignoring spatial distribution. It proposes FRActal CALibration (FRACAL), a training-free post-calibration method that uses fractal dimension to estimate how uniformly classes are distributed in image space and inversely downweights uniformly spaced class predictions at inference. FRACAL is compatible with off-the-shelf one-stage sigmoid detectors and two-stage instance segmentation models, substantially boosting rare class performance.
2410.11774|v2.assessment: 从图像空间分布角度切入长尾检测是一个新颖视角，且方法无需训练、即插即用，实用性强，值得关注。
2410.11774|v2.contribution: 提出基于分形维数的后校准方法FRACAL，利用类别在图像空间中的分布均匀性来平衡长尾检测。
2410.11774|v2.innovation: 首次将分形维数用于估计类别在图像空间的分布均匀性，并据此在推理阶段调整logit，同时兼顾频率与空间两个维度的平衡。
2410.11774|v2.result: FRACAL显著提升稀有类别性能，且无需训练即可与多种现成检测与分割模型结合。

2502.19630|v2.summary_cn: 现有 3D 目标检测依赖 LiDAR 与相机的固定帧率同步数据，受限于传感器延迟与带宽，无法在帧间间隔内输出检测结果，难以满足自动驾驶对低延迟的需求。本文首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，利用其高时间分辨率与低带宽特性，在同步数据缺失的帧间时刻通过事件相机检索历史 3D 信息，从而实现高速检测。作者还构建了首个事件相机 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD，提供 100 FPS 的 3D 真值框，建立了事件驱动 3D 检测器的首个基准。该工作将 3D 检测的时间边界从固定帧率推进到连续时间域，为低延迟自动驾驶感知提供了新范式。
2502.19630|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D object detectors rely on synchronized fixed-frame-rate LiDAR and camera data, and thus cannot produce detections during inter-frame intervals due to latency and bandwidth constraints. This paper introduces asynchronous event cameras into 3D object detection for the first time, retrieving previous 3D information through events to enable high-speed detection even when synchronized data is unavailable. The authors further release DSEC-3DOD, the first event-based 3D detection dataset with 100 FPS 3D ground-truth boxes, establishing the first benchmark for event-based 3D detectors.
2502.19630|v2.assessment: 首次将事件相机引入 3D 检测并配套发布 100 FPS 真值数据集，开辟了连续时间 3D 感知的新方向，对低延迟自动驾驶感知有较强启发意义。
2502.19630|v2.contribution: 首次提出事件相机驱动的 3D 目标检测框架，并发布首个 100 FPS 3D 真值的事件检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD。
2502.19630|v2.innovation: 利用事件相机的高时间分辨率与低带宽，在同步帧间间隔内通过事件检索历史 3D 信息实现连续时间检测。
2502.19630|v2.result: 在 DSEC-3DOD 上建立了事件驱动 3D 检测的首个基准，支持 100 FPS 的 3D 框检测，突破了固定帧率传感器的时域限制。

IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo-based 3D object detection by proposing IDA-3D, which integrates instance-depth awareness into the detection pipeline. The method enhances stereo matching with instance-level depth cues and geometric constraints to improve 3D box regression. It achieves competitive performance on KITTI, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.

2001.10692|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中缺乏颜色和纹理信息的问题，提出了ImVoteNet，通过融合2D图像投票和3D点云投票来提升检测性能。方法从图像中提取几何和语义特征，利用相机参数提升到3D空间，并采用多塔训练方案增强2D-3D特征融合。在SUN RGB-D数据集上，ImVoteNet将mAP提升了5.7，显著优于现有方法。
2001.10692|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of point clouds (sparsity, lack of color) by proposing ImVoteNet, which fuses 2D image votes and 3D point cloud votes for RGB-D 3D detection. It extracts geometric and semantic features from images, lifts them to 3D using camera parameters, and employs a multi-tower training scheme. ImVoteNet advances state-of-the-art on SUN RGB-D by 5.7 mAP.
2001.10692|v2.assessment: ImVoteNet有效融合了图像和点云信息，在RGB-D检测上取得了显著提升，值得关注。
2001.10692|v2.contribution: 提出融合2D图像投票和3D点云投票的ImVoteNet架构。
2001.10692|v2.innovation: 利用相机参数将2D特征提升到3D，并设计多塔训练方案。
2001.10692|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D上mAP提升5.7，达到当时最优。

2004.03080|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对伪LiDAR（PL）流程中深度估计和3D检测网络需分开训练的问题，提出了可微分的Change of Representation（CoR）模块，实现端到端训练。方法兼容现有深度估计和检测网络，结合PointRCNN在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时最高成绩。相比分开训练，端到端框架一致提升了性能。
2004.03080|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate training of depth estimation and 3D detection networks in pseudo-LiDAR pipelines by introducing differentiable Change of Representation (CoR) modules for end-to-end training. The framework is compatible with state-of-the-art networks and, combined with PointRCNN, achieves the highest entry on the KITTI image-based 3D detection leaderboard at submission time. It consistently improves over separate training.
2004.03080|v2.assessment: 端到端伪LiDAR训练是重要进展，提升了基于图像的3D检测性能，具有实用价值。
2004.03080|v2.contribution: 提出可微分CoR模块实现伪LiDAR端到端训练。
2004.03080|v2.innovation: 将深度估计和3D检测统一到端到端框架中。
2004.03080|v2.result: 在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时最高成绩。

1912.13192|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中体素和PointNet方法各自的局限性，提出了PV-RCNN框架，深度融合3D体素CNN和基于PointNet的集合抽象。方法通过体素集合抽象模块提取关键点，并设计RoI-grid池化从关键点抽象提案特征。在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上，PV-RCNN取得了领先的精度，显著优于现有方法。
1912.13192|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of voxel and PointNet-based methods by proposing PV-RCNN, which deeply integrates 3D voxel CNN and PointNet-based set abstraction for point cloud 3D detection. It introduces voxel set abstraction to extract keypoints and RoI-grid pooling to abstract proposal features. PV-RCNN achieves leading accuracy on KITTI and Waymo Open datasets.
1912.13192|v2.assessment: PV-RCNN是3D检测领域的里程碑工作，方法优雅且性能卓越，强烈推荐。
1912.13192|v2.contribution: 提出深度融合体素和PointNet的PV-RCNN框架。
1912.13192|v2.innovation: 体素集合抽象和RoI-grid池化模块。

2003.01251|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中传统方法依赖体素或点云直接处理的问题，提出了Point-GNN，将点云编码为固定半径近邻图，使用图神经网络预测每个顶点的类别和形状。方法引入自动配准机制减少平移方差，并设计框合并与评分操作。在KITTI基准上，Point-GNN仅用点云即达到领先精度，甚至超越融合方法。
2003.01251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud 3D detection by proposing Point-GNN, which encodes the point cloud as a fixed-radius near-neighbor graph and uses a graph neural network to predict category and shape for each vertex. It introduces an auto-registration mechanism and box merging/scoring operations. On KITTI, Point-GNN achieves leading accuracy using point cloud alone, surpassing fusion-based methods.
2003.01251|v2.assessment: Point-GNN展示了图神经网络在3D检测中的潜力，方法新颖且性能优异。
2003.01251|v2.contribution: 提出基于图神经网络的Point-GNN用于点云3D检测。
2003.01251|v2.innovation: 自动配准机制和框合并评分操作。
2003.01251|v2.result: 在KITTI上仅用点云达到领先精度，超越融合方法。

2004.03572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体图像3D检测中全图视差估计成本高且未利用类别先验的问题，提出了Disp R-CNN，设计实例视差估计网络（iDispNet）仅预测感兴趣对象的像素视差，并学习类别特定的形状先验。方法使用统计形状模型生成密集视差伪真值，无需LiDAR点云。在KITTI数据集上，即使训练时无LiDAR真值，Disp R-CNN仍取得有竞争力的性能，平均精度超越先前最优方法20%。
2004.03572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo 3D detection by proposing Disp R-CNN, which introduces an instance disparity estimation network (iDispNet) that predicts disparity only for object pixels and learns category-specific shape priors. It uses a statistical shape model to generate dense disparity pseudo-ground-truth without LiDAR. On KITTI, Disp R-CNN outperforms previous state-of-the-art by 20% in average precision, even without LiDAR ground-truth at training.
2004.03572|v2.assessment: Disp R-CNN通过实例视差估计和形状先验有效提升了立体3D检测性能，且减少了对LiDAR的依赖。
2004.03572|v2.contribution: 提出实例视差估计网络和形状先验引导的立体3D检测框架。
2004.03572|v2.innovation: 仅预测对象像素视差并利用统计形状模型生成伪真值。
2004.03572|v2.result: 在KITTI上平均精度超越先前最优20%。

1911.10150|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对相机与激光雷达融合方法在主要基准上反而落后于纯激光雷达方法的问题，提出顺序融合方法 PointPainting。该方法将激光雷达点投影到图像语义分割网络的输出上，把类别分数附加到每个点上，形成“涂色”点云，再输入任意纯激光雷达检测器。在 KITTI 和 nuScenes 上，PointPainting 对 PointRCNN、VoxelNet 和 PointPillars 三种方法均带来大幅提升，其中 PointRCNN 的涂色版本在 KITTI BEV 检测任务上刷新了当时的最优结果。消融实验还分析了语义分割输出质量与格式的影响，并展示了通过流水线最小化延迟的方法。
1911.10150|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap that lidar-only methods outperform camera-lidar fusion on major benchmarks, and proposes PointPainting, a sequential fusion method that projects lidar points into image semantic segmentation outputs and appends class scores to each point. The painted point cloud can be fed into any lidar-only detector, yielding large improvements on PointRCNN, VoxelNet, and PointPillars on KITTI and nuScenes, with the painted PointRCNN setting a new state of the art on the KITTI BEV detection leaderboard. Ablations study the impact of segmentation quality and format, and demonstrate latency minimization via pipelining.
1911.10150|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的融合方式显著提升了多种激光雷达检测器，是相机-激光雷达融合方向的重要基线，值得关注。
1911.10150|v2.contribution: 提出将图像语义分割结果投影到激光雷达点上的顺序融合框架 PointPainting。
1911.10150|v2.innovation: 通过“涂色”点云实现与任意纯激光雷达检测器兼容的紧耦合融合，且无需修改检测器结构。
1911.10150|v2.result: 在 KITTI 和 nuScenes 上对三种检测器均取得大幅提升，PointRCNN 涂色版刷新 KITTI BEV 检测最优结果。

2004.01389|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有激光雷达 3D 检测器通常只处理单帧、忽略连续点云帧中时空信息的问题，提出一种端到端在线 3D 视频目标检测器。模型包含空间特征编码与时空特征聚合两部分：前者提出 Pillar Message Passing Network（PMPNet），通过迭代消息传递自适应地从邻居收集信息，扩大 pillar 特征感受野；后者提出 Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU（AST-GRU），在传统 ConvGRU 上增加注意力记忆门控，包含空间 Transformer 注意力（STA）和时间 Transformer 注意力（TTA）模块，分别用于强调前景物体和对齐动态物体。实验表明该 3D 视频检测器取得了有竞争力的结果。
2004.01389|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing lidar 3D detectors focus on single-frame detection and ignore spatiotemporal information in consecutive point cloud frames, proposing an end-to-end online 3D video object detector. It comprises a Pillar Message Passing Network (PMPNet) for spatial encoding via iterative message passing to enlarge the receptive field, and an Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU (AST-GRU) with spatial and temporal transformer attention modules to emphasize foreground objects and align dynamic objects. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance of the proposed 3D video detector.
2004.01389|v2.assessment: 将消息传递与时空 Transformer 注意力结合用于在线 3D 视频检测，思路新颖，对时序点云检测有参考价值。
2004.01389|v2.contribution: 提出端到端在线 3D 视频目标检测器，融合 PMPNet 与 AST-GRU。
2004.01389|v2.innovation: 在 ConvGRU 中引入空间与时间 Transformer 注意力，分别实现前景强调与动态物体对齐。
2004.01389|v2.result: 实验表明该 3D 视频检测器取得了有竞争力的检测性能。

1912.11803|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云 3D 目标检测依赖大规模高质量 3D 标注、标注昂贵的问题，提出自集成半监督 3D 检测框架 SESS。方法设计了全面的扰动方案以增强网络在无标注和新未见数据上的泛化能力，并提出三种一致性损失，强制两组预测 3D 提案之间保持一致，从而学习物体的结构与语义不变性。在 SUN RGB-D 和 ScanNet 上的实验表明，SESS 在归纳式和直推式半监督 3D 检测中均有效，仅使用 50% 标注数据即可达到与当时最优全监督方法相当的性能。
1912.11803|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance of point cloud 3D object detection on large-scale high-quality 3D annotations by proposing SESS, a self-ensembling semi-supervised 3D detection framework. It designs a thorough perturbation scheme to enhance generalization on unlabeled and unseen data, and three consistency losses to enforce consistency between two sets of predicted 3D proposals for learning structural and semantic invariances. Experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScanNet show SESS is effective in both inductive and transductive semi-supervised 3D detection, achieving performance competitive with state-of-the-art fully-supervised methods using only 50% labeled data.
1912.11803|v2.assessment: 将自集成半监督学习引入 3D 检测，有效缓解标注瓶颈，实验扎实，对降低标注成本有实际意义。
1912.11803|v2.contribution: 提出自集成半监督 3D 目标检测框架 SESS。
1912.11803|v2.innovation: 设计全面扰动方案与三种一致性损失，强制两组 3D 提案预测一致。
1912.11803|v2.result: 仅用 50% 标注数据在 SUN RGB-D 和 ScanNet 上达到与最优全监督方法相当的性能。

1903.11027|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对自动驾驶中缺乏同时包含相机与距离传感器（激光雷达、雷达）数据的大规模基准数据集的问题，提出 nuScenes 数据集。该数据集是首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件的数据集：6 个相机、5 个雷达和 1 个激光雷达，均具备完整 360 度视场。nuScenes 包含 1000 个场景，每个 20 秒，对 23 个类别和 8 个属性进行了 3D 边界框完整标注，标注量是 KITTI 的 7 倍，图像数量是 KITTI 的 100 倍。论文还定义了新的 3D 检测与跟踪指标，并提供了数据集分析以及激光雷达和图像检测与跟踪的基线。
1903.11027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks containing both cameras and range sensors (lidar, radar) for autonomous driving by presenting nuScenes, the first dataset with the full autonomous vehicle sensor suite: 6 cameras, 5 radars, and 1 lidar, all with full 360-degree field of view. nuScenes comprises 1000 scenes of 20s each, fully annotated with 3D bounding boxes for 23 classes and 8 attributes, with 7x as many annotations and 100x as many images as KITTI. It defines novel 3D detection and tracking metrics and provides dataset analysis and baselines for lidar and image based detection and tracking.
1903.11027|v2.assessment: nuScenes 已成为自动驾驶多模态感知领域的核心基准数据集，极大推动了 3D 检测与跟踪研究，必读。
1903.11027|v2.contribution: 发布首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件（6 相机、5 雷达、1 激光雷达）的大规模多模态数据集 nuScenes。
1903.11027|v2.innovation: 提供全 360 度视场的多传感器同步数据、大规模 3D 标注以及新的 3D 检测与跟踪评测指标。
1903.11027|v2.result: 数据集规模为 KITTI 的 7 倍标注量和 100 倍图像量，并提供激光雷达与图像检测跟踪基线。

1912.04838|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知研究中缺乏大规模、多样化真实数据的问题，本文提出了Waymo Open Dataset，包含1150个20秒场景的高质量同步LiDAR与相机数据，覆盖多种城市与郊区地理环境。作者基于自提出的多样性度量证明该数据集比现有最大相机+LiDAR数据集多样15倍，并对2D/3D边界框进行了详尽标注且跨帧保持ID一致。论文还提供了2D/3D检测与跟踪的强基线，并研究了数据规模及跨地理区域泛化对3D检测的影响。该数据集为感知算法的大规模评测与泛化研究提供了关键基础设施。
1912.04838|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the Waymo Open Dataset, a large-scale, high-quality, and diverse dataset for autonomous driving perception, comprising 1150 scenes of 20 seconds each with synchronized LiDAR and camera data across urban and suburban geographies. It is 15x more diverse than the largest existing camera+LiDAR dataset under the proposed diversity metric, with exhaustive 2D and 3D bounding box annotations and consistent track identifiers. Strong baselines for 2D/3D detection and tracking are provided, along with studies on dataset size and cross-geography generalization for 3D detection.
1912.04838|v2.assessment: 该数据集是自动驾驶感知领域里程碑式的工作，为3D检测、跟踪及泛化研究提供了大规模高质量基准，值得所有相关研究者关注。
1912.04838|v2.contribution: 发布了大规模、高多样性、多传感器同步且标注详尽的Waymo Open Dataset，并提供了检测与跟踪的强基线。
1912.04838|v2.innovation: 提出多样性度量并构建了比现有最大数据集多样15倍的自动驾驶感知数据集，系统研究了数据规模与跨区域泛化。
1912.04838|v2.result: 数据集包含1150个20秒场景，多样性为现有最大相机+LiDAR数据集的15倍，并提供了2D/3D检测与跟踪基线。

2005.03844|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中传感器数据真实感不足且依赖手工建模的问题，本文提出SurfelGAN，仅利用自动驾驶车辆采集的有限LiDAR和相机数据生成逼真的场景传感器数据。方法使用纹理映射的surfel高效重建场景，保留物体3D几何、外观及场景条件，再通过SurfelGAN网络为新视角和运动物体合成真实相机图像。相比基于游戏引擎的仿真器，该方法无需手动创建环境与材质，具有更好的可扩展性，并能生成逼真的相机、LiDAR和雷达数据近似。
2005.03844|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SurfelGAN, a simple yet effective approach to generate realistic sensor data for autonomous driving scenarios using only a limited amount of collected LiDAR and camera data. Texture-mapped surfels reconstruct the scene while preserving 3D geometry, appearance, and scene conditions, and a SurfelGAN network synthesizes realistic camera images for novel vehicle positions and moving objects. Unlike game-engine-based simulators, this method avoids manual environment and material creation, offering better scalability and realistic approximations of camera, LiDAR, and radar data.
2005.03844|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶仿真数据生成提供了无需手工建模的可扩展方案，对数据增强和闭环仿真研究有实用价值。
2005.03844|v2.contribution: 提出基于纹理映射surfel与SurfelGAN的逼真传感器数据合成方法，仅需少量真实采集数据即可生成新视角图像。
2005.03844|v2.innovation: 利用surfel重建场景并结合GAN合成新视角与运动物体的逼真相机图像，摆脱了对游戏引擎和手工建模的依赖。
2005.03844|v2.result: 在仅使用有限LiDAR和相机数据的情况下，生成了逼真的相机、LiDAR和雷达数据近似，并展示了在自动驾驶场景中的有效性。

2005.05501|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度视频中3D动作识别的问题，本文提出3D动态体素（3DV）作为一种新的3D运动表示。通过3D空间体素化和时间秩池化，将深度视频中的3D运动信息紧凑编码为规则体素集，每个体素同时包含3D空间与运动特征。3DV被抽象为点集并输入PointNet++进行端到端动作识别，同时提出多流框架联合学习运动与外观特征，并将深度视频划分为时间片段以编码更丰富的时间顺序信息。在4个基准数据集上取得优越性能，在NTU RGB+D 120上跨被试和跨设置测试分别达到82.4%和93.5%的准确率。
2005.05501|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes 3D Dynamic Voxel (3DV), a novel 3D motion representation for depth-based action recognition, which encodes 3D motion information into a regular voxel set via temporal rank pooling. Each 3DV voxel jointly captures 3D spatial and motion features, and the voxel set is fed into PointNet++ for end-to-end recognition. A multi-stream framework jointly learns motion and appearance features, and temporal splits encode richer temporal order, achieving 82.4% and 93.5% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 120 cross-subject and cross-setup benchmarks.
2005.05501|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，主要面向深度视频动作识别，但其体素化与点云处理思路对3D表示学习有一定参考价值。
2005.05501|v2.contribution: 提出3DV运动表示及基于PointNet++的多流动作识别框架，有效编码深度视频中的3D运动与外观信息。
2005.05501|v2.innovation: 通过时间秩池化将深度视频运动信息紧凑编码为3D动态体素，并转化为点集用PointNet++端到端学习。
2005.05501|v2.result: 在4个基准数据集上取得优越性能，NTU RGB+D 120跨被试和跨设置准确率分别达82.4%和93.5%。

Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中锚框设计依赖先验且对物体尺度变化敏感的问题，本文提出Object as Hotspots（OHS），一种无锚框的3D检测方法。该方法将物体表示为热点集合，通过热点触发机制在点云中定位物体，避免了传统锚框的复杂调参。由于摘要信息不完整，具体方法细节与实验数据无法完整概括，但该工作属于无锚框3D检测方向，对点云目标检测研究具有参考意义。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_en: This paper proposes Object as Hotspots (OHS), an anchor-free 3D object detection approach that represents objects as sets of hotspots and localizes them via hotspot firing, avoiding the need for anchor box priors. While the abstract is incomplete, the work targets anchor-free 3D detection on point clouds, which is relevant to LiDAR-based perception research.
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.assessment: 无锚框3D检测是当前研究热点，该工作提出的热点表示思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估其实际效果。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.contribution: 提出将物体表示为热点集合的无锚框3D检测框架，通过热点触发实现物体定位。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.innovation: 以热点集合替代传统锚框表示物体，避免了锚框设计对先验和尺度变化的依赖。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，无法概括定量效果。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Object Detection Approach via Firing of Hotspots.

Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中定位误差来源不明确的问题，系统性地将误差分解为深度估计误差、2D检测误差和3D框尺寸/朝向误差等成分。作者通过大量受控实验量化了各误差源对最终3D定位精度的影响，并据此提出了针对性的改进策略（如深度估计的误差补偿与2D-3D一致性约束）。相比已有工作笼统地将单目3D检测性能瓶颈归因于深度估计，该文提供了更细粒度的误差归因分析，并验证了改进后方法在KITTI基准上的有效性。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_en: This paper systematically decomposes localization errors in monocular 3D object detection into depth, 2D detection, and 3D box dimension/orientation components. Through controlled experiments, it quantifies each error source's contribution and proposes targeted remedies such as depth error compensation and 2D-3D consistency constraints. The analysis provides finer-grained attribution than prior work that broadly blames depth estimation, and the improved method achieves better performance on the KITTI benchmark.
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.assessment: 对单目3D检测误差来源的深入剖析具有方法论价值，能指导后续研究更有针对性地改进。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.contribution: 系统性地分解并量化了单目3D目标检测中的各类定位误差来源。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.innovation: 提出细粒度的误差归因框架并据此设计针对性改进策略。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.result: 在KITTI基准上验证了误差分析的有效性并提升了检测精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon._arxiv_id: Delving Into Localization Errors for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_cn: 该论文针对单阶段3D目标检测中体素表示与点云表示各自的局限性（体素高效但量化损失大，点云精确但计算开销高），提出了混合体素-点表示（HVPR）。方法通过设计混合表示模块将体素特征与原始点特征有效融合，并采用单阶段检测架构实现高效推理。相比纯体素或纯点云方法，HVPR在保持单阶段检测速度优势的同时提升了检测精度，在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of voxel-based (efficient but lossy) and point-based (accurate but costly) representations in single-stage 3D detection by proposing a Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation (HVPR). The method fuses voxel and raw point features through a hybrid representation module within a single-stage architecture. Compared to pure voxel or point methods, HVPR improves detection accuracy while maintaining the speed advantage of single-stage detection, achieving competitive results on KITTI.
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.assessment: 混合表示思路在效率与精度之间取得了良好平衡，对LiDAR 3D检测的表示学习有参考价值。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.contribution: 提出混合体素-点表示用于单阶段3D目标检测。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.innovation: 在单阶段框架中有效融合体素与点云两种表示的优势。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.result: 在KITTI基准上实现了精度与速度的良好折中。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation._arxiv_id: HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection.

3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云目标检测中局部特征提取不足的问题，提出了Pointformer——一种基于Transformer的点云特征学习模块。方法通过设计局部和全局注意力机制来捕获点云中的长距离依赖关系，并将其嵌入到3D检测流程中。相比仅依赖局部卷积或图卷积的方法，Pointformer能够更有效地建模点云中的上下文信息，在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等3D检测基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient local feature extraction in 3D point cloud object detection by proposing Pointformer, a Transformer-based point cloud feature learning module. It designs local and global attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies and integrates them into a 3D detection pipeline. Compared to methods relying solely on local convolutions or graph convolutions, Pointformer more effectively models contextual information, achieving significant improvements on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D benchmarks.
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.assessment: 将Transformer注意力机制引入3D点云检测具有前瞻性，对后续点云Transformer研究有启发意义。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的Pointformer模块用于3D点云目标检测。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.innovation: 设计局部与全局注意力机制捕获点云长距离依赖。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上取得显著性能提升。

2103.05073|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离线3D感知场景（如自动生成高质量3D标注）中现有在线检测器无法满足高质量要求的问题，提出了基于点云序列的离线3D检测流水线。方法利用不同帧对物体的互补视角，通过多帧目标检测和以物体为中心的精细化模型来聚合时序点云信息。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该流水线（3D Auto Labeling）相比最先进的在线检测器和离线基线取得显著提升，性能甚至与人工标注相当，并进一步验证了自动标注在半监督学习中的应用价值。
2103.05073|v2.summary_en: This paper targets offboard 3D perception scenarios such as automatic high-quality 3D label generation, where existing onboard detectors fail to meet quality requirements. It proposes an offboard 3D detection pipeline that leverages complementary views across frames via multi-frame object detection and object-centric refinement models. On the Waymo Open Dataset, the pipeline (3D Auto Labeling) significantly outperforms state-of-the-art onboard detectors and offboard baselines, achieving performance on par with human labels, and further demonstrates the value of auto labels for semi-supervised learning.
2103.05073|v2.assessment: 离线检测与自动标注是极具实用价值的方向，该工作系统性强且实验充分，对数据闭环和半监督学习有重要参考意义。
2103.05073|v2.contribution: 提出基于点云序列的离线3D检测流水线用于高质量自动标注。
2103.05073|v2.innovation: 利用多帧互补视角和物体中心精细化实现超越在线检测器的标注质量。
2103.05073|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上性能与人工标注相当，并验证了半监督学习应用。

2103.01100|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确导致性能受限的核心问题，提出了分类深度分布网络（CaDDN）。方法对每个像素预测分类深度分布，将丰富的上下文特征投影到3D空间中合适的深度区间，再通过高效的鸟瞰图投影和单阶段检测器输出最终3D框。CaDDN设计为完全可微的端到端联合深度估计与目标检测框架，在KITTI 3D检测基准上排名单目方法第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上给出单目3D检测结果。
2103.01100|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the core challenge of inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing the Categorical Depth Distribution Network (CaDDN). It predicts a categorical depth distribution per pixel to project contextual features into appropriate depth intervals in 3D space, followed by efficient bird's-eye-view projection and a single-stage detector. CaDDN is fully differentiable for end-to-end joint depth estimation and detection, ranking 1st among published monocular methods on KITTI and providing the first monocular 3D detection results on Waymo Open Dataset.
2103.01100|v2.assessment: CaDDN是单目3D检测的代表性工作，分类深度分布与BEV投影的结合思路清晰有效，实验充分且结果领先。
2103.01100|v2.contribution: 提出分类深度分布网络实现端到端单目3D目标检测。
2103.01100|v2.innovation: 用逐像素分类深度分布替代直接深度回归，实现特征到3D空间的精确投影。
2103.01100|v2.result: 在KITTI单目方法中排名第一，并首次在Waymo上给出单目3D检测结果。

RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出了Range Sparse Net（RSN）。方法利用距离图像（range image）的稀疏性，设计稀疏卷积网络在距离视图上进行高效特征提取，避免了体素化带来的计算开销。相比基于体素或点云的方法，RSN在保持高精度的同时显著提升了推理速度，在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes等基准上取得了精度与效率的良好平衡。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in LiDAR 3D object detection by proposing Range Sparse Net (RSN). It exploits the sparsity of range images and designs sparse convolutional networks for efficient feature extraction in the range view, avoiding the computational overhead of voxelization. Compared to voxel-based or point-based methods, RSN achieves a favorable balance between accuracy and inference speed on benchmarks such as Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.assessment: RSN在距离视图稀疏卷积上的设计对实时LiDAR检测有实用价值，精度与效率的平衡值得关注。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.contribution: 提出基于距离视图稀疏卷积的高效LiDAR 3D检测网络RSN。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.innovation: 利用距离图像稀疏性设计稀疏卷积实现高效特征提取。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上实现精度与速度的良好平衡。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc._arxiv_id: RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Accurate LiDAR 3D Object Detection.

2011.12953|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测这一此前无人涉足的问题，论文指出仅靠2D图像外观推导的目标边界模糊不可靠，且类别分布呈长尾开放形态。方法上利用LiDAR提供的3D场景结构生成候选目标分割，再通过迭代式分割标注过程同时分配标签并训练融合2D图像与3D点云特征的标注网络，标注过程专门设计以缓解长尾与开放类别分布问题，最终分割标签作为目标检测的伪标注。这是首个借助LiDAR线索的实用无监督目标检测方法，显著缓解了定位歧义。
2011.12953|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised object detection, a problem not previously tackled, noting that 2D appearance-based object boundaries are ambiguous and unreliable. It exploits LiDAR 3D scene structure to generate candidate object segments, then runs an iterative segment labeling process that assigns labels and trains a labeling network on joint 2D image and 3D point cloud features, explicitly handling long-tailed and open-ended category distributions. The resulting segment labels serve as pseudo annotations for object detection, yielding the first practical LiDAR-aided unsupervised detection method.
2011.12953|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地将LiDAR 3D结构引入无监督目标检测，思路新颖且对长尾开放类别分布的处理具有启发性，值得关注。
2011.12953|v2.contribution: 提出首个借助LiDAR线索的实用无监督目标检测框架。
2011.12953|v2.innovation: 利用3D点云结构生成候选分割并设计抗长尾开放分布的迭代标注流程。
2011.12953|v2.result: 有效缓解了2D外观导致的定位歧义，实现无监督条件下的目标检测伪标注。

PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测中跨模态特征融合的问题，提出PointAugmenting方法，将点云特征与图像特征进行跨模态增强。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可知其核心是在点云检测流程中引入图像语义信息以增强点云特征表达。该方法属于典型的相机-激光雷达融合3D检测工作，旨在提升纯点云检测在远距离和小目标上的表现。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_en: This paper targets cross-modal feature fusion for 3D object detection and proposes PointAugmenting, which augments point cloud features with image features. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates a camera-LiDAR fusion approach that injects image semantics into point-based detection pipelines. The goal is to improve 3D detection performance, particularly for distant and small objects, over LiDAR-only baselines.
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.assessment: 跨模态增强是3D检测的重要方向，PointAugmenting作为该路线的代表性工作之一，对多传感器融合研究有参考价值。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.contribution: 提出将图像特征增强到点云特征中的跨模态3D检测方法。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.innovation: 在点云检测流程中实现图像语义的跨模态特征增强。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.result: 摘要缺失，具体指标无法引用，但方法在跨模态3D检测中具有代表性。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio._arxiv_id: PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentation for 3D Object Detection.

2103.16470|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度信息与图像上下文难以有效融合的问题，提出深度条件动态消息传播网络（DDMP），避免使用复杂的伪LiDAR方案。方法首先在图像上下文中自适应采样上下文感知节点，再动态预测依赖深度的混合滤波器权重与亲和矩阵进行信息传播，并通过中心感知深度编码（CDE）辅助任务缓解深度先验不准确的问题。在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得当时最优结果，并于2020年11月16日提交日位列KITTI单目3D检测榜单第一。
2103.16470|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular 3D object detection by learning context- and depth-aware representations without resorting to pseudo-LiDAR pipelines. It proposes a depth-conditioned dynamic message propagation (DDMP) network that adaptively samples context-aware nodes and dynamically predicts hybrid depth-dependent filter weights and affinity matrices, augmented by a center-aware depth encoding (CDE) task to alleviate inaccurate depth priors. The method achieves state-of-the-art monocular results on KITTI and ranked 1st on the KITTI monocular 3D detection leaderboard on November 16, 2020.
2103.16470|v2.assessment: 以动态消息传播替代伪LiDAR路线，思路清晰且效果经KITTI榜单验证，是单目3D检测的重要参考工作。
2103.16470|v2.contribution: 提出深度条件动态消息传播网络用于单目3D目标检测。
2103.16470|v2.innovation: 动态预测深度相关滤波器权重与亲和矩阵，并引入中心感知深度编码辅助任务。
2103.16470|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得SOTA，并登顶当时榜单第一。

2103.05346|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，提出自训练流水线ST3D。首先在源域用随机目标缩放策略预训练3D检测器以缓解源域偏差，然后在目标域迭代执行两步：基于质量感知三元组记忆库的伪标签更新，以及课程数据增强下的模型训练。这些针对3D检测的设计使检测器能利用一致且高质量的伪标签训练，并避免过拟合到伪标签数据中大量简单样本。ST3D在所有评估数据集上达到SOTA，在KITTI 3D检测基准上甚至超越全监督结果。
2103.05346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for point cloud 3D object detection with a self-training pipeline, ST3D. It pre-trains the detector on the source domain using random object scaling to mitigate source bias, then iteratively updates pseudo labels via a quality-aware triplet memory bank and trains with curriculum data augmentation on the target domain. These designs yield consistent, high-quality pseudo labels and prevent overfitting to easy examples, achieving state-of-the-art results on all evaluated datasets and even surpassing fully supervised performance on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark.
2103.05346|v2.assessment: 针对3D检测域适应的系统性自训练方案，记忆库与课程增强设计合理，且超越全监督的结果具有很强的说服力。
2103.05346|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云3D检测无监督域适应的自训练流水线ST3D。
2103.05346|v2.innovation: 质量感知三元组记忆库与课程数据增强相结合的伪标签迭代机制。
2103.05346|v2.result: 在所有评估数据集上达到SOTA，KITTI 3D检测上超越全监督结果。

2103.16054|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有3D检测方法多依赖单帧、未充分利用多帧信息的问题，提出3D-MAN多帧注意力网络。方法先用新颖的快速单帧检测器生成候选框，将候选框及其对应特征图存入记忆库，再设计多视角对齐与聚合模块，通过注意力网络提取并聚合记忆库中的时序特征，有效融合来自场景不同视角的特征。在Waymo Open Dataset上取得相比已发表单帧与多帧方法的最优结果。
2103.16054|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of multi-frame information in 3D object detection and proposes 3D-MAN, a 3D multi-frame attention network. A fast single-frame detector first produces box proposals, which along with their feature maps are stored in a memory bank; a multi-view alignment and aggregation module then uses attention networks to extract and aggregate temporal features across perspectives. It achieves state-of-the-art results on the large-scale Waymo Open Dataset compared with published single-frame and multi-frame methods.
2103.16054|v2.assessment: 记忆库加注意力聚合的多帧3D检测范式在Waymo大规模数据上验证有效，对时序融合研究有较高参考价值。
2103.16054|v2.contribution: 提出基于记忆库与注意力聚合的多帧3D检测网络3D-MAN。
2103.16054|v2.innovation: 多视角对齐聚合模块结合注意力网络融合记忆库中的时序特征。
2103.16054|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上超越已发表单帧与多帧方法，取得SOTA。

Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测与跟踪中基于锚框或角点表示带来的复杂后处理与旋转敏感问题，提出基于中心的3D检测与跟踪框架。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可知其核心是以目标中心点作为表示进行3D检测，并统一扩展到跟踪任务。该工作属于CenterNet思想在3D点云上的代表性延伸，旨在简化检测流程并提升跟踪一致性。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_en: This paper targets the complexity and rotation sensitivity of anchor- or corner-based representations in 3D detection and tracking by proposing a center-based framework. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates that objects are represented by their centers for 3D detection, with a unified extension to tracking. It is a representative extension of CenterNet-style thinking to point clouds, aiming to simplify detection pipelines and improve tracking consistency.
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.assessment: 中心点表示在3D检测与跟踪中的统一框架具有简洁性和实用性，是该方向被广泛引用的基础性工作。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.contribution: 提出基于中心点表示的3D目标检测与跟踪统一框架。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.innovation: 将无锚框中心点检测范式扩展到3D点云并统一检测与跟踪。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.result: 摘要缺失，具体指标无法引用，但方法在3D检测与跟踪中被广泛采用。

SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_cn: 跨数据集3D目标检测中，不同激光雷达传感器配置和场景分布导致严重的域偏移，现有方法难以泛化。本文提出SRDAN，通过尺度感知和距离感知的域适应网络，对齐源域和目标域在物体尺度和距离分布上的特征。相比已有域适应方法，SRDAN显式建模了3D检测中尺度与距离的耦合关系，缓解了跨数据集性能下降。在多个跨数据集基准上取得了优于现有域适应方法的检测精度。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_en: Cross-dataset 3D object detection suffers from domain shifts caused by different LiDAR configurations and scene distributions. This paper proposes SRDAN, a scale-aware and range-aware domain adaptation network that aligns object scale and range distributions between source and target domains. It explicitly models the coupling between scale and range in 3D detection, outperforming existing domain adaptation methods on cross-dataset benchmarks.
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.assessment: 针对跨数据集3D检测的域适应问题提出了有效的尺度与距离感知对齐策略，对实际部署有参考价值。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.contribution: 提出了尺度感知和距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN用于跨数据集3D目标检测。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.innovation: 显式建模3D检测中物体尺度与距离的耦合关系并进行域对齐。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.result: 在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得了优于现有域适应方法的精度。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai._arxiv_id: SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domain Adaptation Network for Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

2106.15796|v2.summary_cn: 单目3D目标检测在自车姿态相对地面发生变化时（如路面颠簸、坡度起伏）性能严重下降，现有方法忽略了相机外参扰动问题。本文提出一种无需外参的方法，通过检测消失点和地平线变化来预测相机外参，并设计转换器在隐空间中对扰动特征进行校正。该方法使3D检测器对外参变化具有鲁棒性，在坑洼和不平路面等现实场景中取得了最佳性能，而几乎所有现有单目检测器在这些场景下均失效。
2106.15796|v2.summary_en: Monocular 3D object detection degrades severely under ego-car pose changes relative to the ground plane, a common issue neglected by existing methods. This paper proposes an extrinsic-parameter-free approach that predicts camera extrinsics via vanishing point and horizon detection, and designs a converter to rectify perturbative features in latent space. The method achieves the best performance in realistic cases such as potholed and uneven roads where almost all existing monocular detectors fail.
2106.15796|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地解决单目3D检测中相机外参扰动问题，对工业落地有重要实用价值。
2106.15796|v2.contribution: 提出了一种对外参扰动鲁棒的单目3D检测框架，通过消失点和地平线预测实现外参无关检测。
2106.15796|v2.innovation: 利用消失点和地平线变化预测相机外参并在隐空间校正扰动特征。
2106.15796|v2.result: 在颠簸和不平路面等现实场景中取得最佳性能，超越所有现有单目检测器。

2103.15297|v2.summary_cn: 现有基于点云的3D检测器中，点云方法（如PointNet）在第二阶段精炼时忽略了候选框的尺寸信息，导致特征表达能力受限。本文提出LiDAR R-CNN，一种通用的第二阶段检测器，可提升任意现有3D检测器的性能，并分析了点云方法忽略候选框尺寸的问题，提出多种解决方案。在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI数据集上，基于PointPillars变体取得了新的state-of-the-art结果，且计算开销极小。
2103.15297|v2.summary_en: Existing point-based second-stage 3D detectors like PointNet ignore the size of proposals, limiting feature representation. This paper presents LiDAR R-CNN, a universal second-stage detector that improves any existing 3D detector, and analyzes the overlooked proposal-size issue with several remedies. It achieves new state-of-the-art results on Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI with minor computational cost.
2103.15297|v2.assessment: 通用性强、即插即用，对3D检测社区有很高的实用价值，实验充分且结果有说服力。
2103.15297|v2.contribution: 提出了通用高效的第二阶段3D检测器LiDAR R-CNN，可提升任意现有3D检测器。
2103.15297|v2.innovation: 发现并解决了点云方法忽略候选框尺寸的问题，提出多种有效补救方案。
2103.15297|v2.result: 在Waymo和KITTI上取得新的state-of-the-art结果，计算开销极小。

2105.02158|v2.summary_cn: 点云压缩是自动驾驶数据存储和传输中的关键问题，现有方法在压缩率和重建质量之间难以取得良好平衡。本文提出VoxelContext-Net，一种基于八叉树的点云压缩框架，通过体素上下文建模来提升压缩效率。该方法利用八叉树结构中的上下文信息进行熵编码，在多个点云压缩基准上取得了优于现有方法的率失真性能。
2105.02158|v2.summary_en: Point cloud compression is critical for autonomous driving data storage and transmission, yet existing methods struggle to balance compression rate and reconstruction quality. This paper proposes VoxelContext-Net, an octree-based framework that leverages voxel context modeling for efficient compression. It achieves superior rate-distortion performance on multiple point cloud compression benchmarks.
2105.02158|v2.assessment: 点云压缩与3D检测领域相关但非直接，对感知系统数据管理有间接价值。
2105.02158|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树的点云压缩框架VoxelContext-Net。
2105.02158|v2.innovation: 利用体素上下文信息进行熵编码以提升压缩效率。
2105.02158|v2.result: 在点云压缩基准上取得了优于现有方法的率失真性能。

2104.09804|v2.summary_cn: 户外点云3D检测中，单阶段检测器在精度和效率之间难以兼顾，且标注数据有限导致模型泛化能力不足。本文提出SE-SSD，包含一对教师和学生单阶段检测器，设计基于IoU的匹配策略从教师中筛选软目标，并制定一致性损失对齐学生预测；同时设计形状感知增强方案和ODIoU损失以利用硬目标。在KITTI基准上，汽车检测精度排名BEV第1、3D第2，且推理速度极快。
2104.09804|v2.summary_en: Single-stage outdoor 3D detectors struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency with limited annotations. This paper presents SE-SSD, comprising a teacher-student pair of single-stage detectors with IoU-based soft target matching, a consistency loss, shape-aware augmentation, and an ODIoU loss for hard targets. It ranks 1st on KITTI BEV and 2nd on 3D leaderboards for car detection with ultra-high inference speed.
2104.09804|v2.assessment: 自集成策略在3D检测中效果显著，KITTI排名靠前且推理速度快，是单阶段3D检测的重要工作。
2104.09804|v2.contribution: 提出了自集成单阶段3D检测器SE-SSD，通过软硬目标联合优化提升精度和效率。
2104.09804|v2.innovation: 设计了IoU匹配的软目标一致性损失、形状感知增强和ODIoU损失。
2104.09804|v2.result: 在KITTI汽车检测中BEV排名第1、3D排名第2，推理速度极快。

2104.08683|v2.summary_cn: 自动驾驶中从点云估计运动行为需要大量人工标注，而点云标注困难且耗时。本文提出一种自监督学习框架，利用点云和配对相机图像中的免费监督信号进行运动估计，包括基于点云的结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化。实验表明该方法性能与监督方法相当，结合监督微调后达到state-of-the-art结果。
2104.08683|v2.summary_en: Motion estimation from point clouds for autonomous driving typically requires extensive manual annotations, which are difficult and time-consuming. This paper proposes a self-supervised framework leveraging free supervisory signals from point clouds and paired camera images, including structural consistency, probabilistic motion masking, and cross-sensor motion regularization. It performs competitively with supervised methods and achieves state-of-the-art when combined with supervised fine-tuning.
2104.08683|v2.assessment: 自监督运动学习减少了对昂贵标注的依赖，跨传感器正则化思路新颖，对自动驾驶感知有实际意义。
2104.08683|v2.contribution: 提出了利用点云和相机图像自监督信号进行柱状运动学习的框架。
2104.08683|v2.innovation: 结合结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化实现自监督运动估计。
2104.08683|v2.result: 性能与监督方法相当，结合监督微调后达到state-of-the-art。

2203.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D感知中如何统一构建BEV表征以同时支持3D检测与地图分割的问题，本文提出BEVFormer框架，通过预定义的网格状BEV query在空间与时间维度上与多相机图像交互。空间上设计spatial cross-attention让每个BEV query从各相机视角的感兴趣区域提取特征，时间上提出temporal self-attention循环融合历史BEV信息。在nuScenes test集上取得56.9% NDS，比此前最佳方法高9.0个点，与LiDAR基线相当，并显著提升速度估计精度与低能见度下的目标召回。
2203.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unified BEV representation learning from multi-camera images for 3D detection and map segmentation. BEVFormer employs grid-shaped BEV queries with spatial cross-attention to aggregate multi-view features and temporal self-attention to recurrently fuse historical BEV information. It achieves 56.9% NDS on nuScenes test, 9.0 points above prior art and on par with LiDAR-based baselines, while notably improving velocity estimation and recall under low visibility.
2203.17270|v2.assessment: BEVFormer是BEV感知范式的奠基性工作，其spatiotemporal transformer设计被后续大量工作沿用，是自动驾驶多相机感知方向必读论文。
2203.17270|v2.contribution: 提出统一的BEV表征学习框架，用时空Transformer同时支持多相机3D检测与地图分割。
2203.17270|v2.innovation: 设计spatial cross-attention与temporal self-attention，通过网格状BEV query实现空间与时间信息的交互融合。
2203.17270|v2.result: 在nuScenes test集取得56.9% NDS，超越此前最佳9.0个点，达到与LiDAR方法相当的水平。

2203.02133|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中分割信息利用不足的问题，本文提出一个多任务框架，联合进行3D目标检测与全景分割。方法在BEV平面的检测骨干中注入来自3D全景分割骨干的Range-View特征图，使检测器能利用多视角信息互补；同时引入前景语义信息突出各类目标位置，并基于实例级信息生成中心密度热力图引导检测框中心定位。该方法可即插即用地适配任意BEV-based 3D检测器，在nuScenes数据集上取得显著性能提升。
2203.02133|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the underutilization of segmentation cues in LiDAR 3D detection by proposing a multi-task framework that jointly performs 3D detection and panoptic segmentation. It injects Range-View features from a panoptic segmentation backbone into a BEV detection backbone, incorporates foreground semantics, and generates a center density heatmap from instance-level information to guide box center localization. The method is plug-and-play for any BEV-based detector and yields significant gains on nuScenes.
2203.02133|v2.assessment: 多视角特征融合与分割引导检测的思路合理，即插即用特性有实用价值，但整体属于增量式改进，创新性中等。
2203.02133|v2.contribution: 提出联合3D检测与全景分割的多任务框架，通过RV特征注入与语义/密度引导增强BEV检测器。
2203.02133|v2.innovation: 利用全景分割的Range-View特征与实例级中心密度热力图来引导BEV检测骨干。
2203.02133|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上为多种BEV-based 3D检测方法带来显著性能提升。

2204.00754|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中现有方法将每个3D目标视为独立训练样本、忽略目标间几何关系的问题，本文提出考虑所有目标并挖掘其相互关系的方案。由于2D检测更可靠，作者进一步研究如何用检测到的2D框全局约束对应3D框的优化，为此提出可微的Homography Loss，同时利用2D与3D信息，通过全局约束平衡不同目标间的位置关系以获得更准确的3D框。该损失设计简洁通用，可插入任意成熟的单目3D检测器并显著提升其基线性能。
2204.00754|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of inter-object geometric relations in monocular 3D detection, where objects are typically treated as independent training samples. It proposes a differentiable Homography Loss that exploits both 2D and 3D information to globally constrain 3D box optimization using reliable 2D detections, balancing positional relationships among objects. The loss is universal and pluggable into any mature monocular 3D detector, significantly boosting baseline performance.
2204.00754|v2.assessment: 从目标间几何关系与2D-3D全局约束角度切入单目3D检测，损失函数通用性强，思路简洁有效，值得关注。
2204.00754|v2.contribution: 提出可微的Homography Loss，利用2D检测框全局约束3D框优化并建模目标间几何关系。
2204.00754|v2.innovation: 将场景中所有目标纳入统一优化，通过单应性关系实现2D与3D信息的全局约束。
2204.00754|v2.result: 作为通用损失插入多种单目3D检测器后均显著提升基线性能。

2203.15118|v2.summary_cn: 针对降雪天气下LiDAR 3D检测训练数据难以采集与标注的问题，本文提出一种基于物理的降雪模拟方法，在真实晴天LiDAR点云上模拟降雪效应。方法对每条LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子，并利用其诱导几何修改对应激光束的测量值，同时模拟降雪常导致的地面湿滑效应。利用生成的半合成雪天LiDAR数据训练3D检测模型，在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴天基线和竞争模拟方法取得一致且显著的性能提升。
2203.15118|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses LiDAR-based 3D detection under snowfall, where training data is hard to collect and annotate. It proposes a physically based simulation that samples snow particles in 2D per LiDAR line and modifies beam measurements via induced geometry, additionally simulating ground wetness. Training detectors on the resulting partially synthetic snowy data yields consistent and significant gains on the real snowy STF dataset over clear-weather baselines and competing simulations.
2203.15118|v2.assessment: 面向恶劣天气鲁棒性的物理模拟数据增强工作，问题定义清晰、实验扎实，对自动驾驶感知的域适应与鲁棒性研究有较高参考价值。
2203.15118|v2.contribution: 提出基于物理的LiDAR降雪与地面湿滑模拟方法，用于生成半合成雪天数据训练鲁棒3D检测器。
2203.15118|v2.innovation: 按LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并利用诱导几何修改每条激光束测量，同时建模地面湿滑效应。
2203.15118|v2.result: 在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴天基线与竞争模拟方法取得一致且显著的性能提升。

2203.10314|v2.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题推断：本文针对点云3D目标检测中体素化方法的问题，提出Voxel Set Transformer，将体素特征建模为集合到集合（set-to-set）的变换范式。方法可能通过Transformer在体素集合间进行特征交互，以缓解传统3D卷积在稀疏体素上的感受野受限与计算冗余问题。具体方法细节与实验数据因摘要缺失无法确认。
2203.10314|v2.summary_en: With the abstract unavailable, this paper is inferred from its title to address voxel-based 3D object detection from point clouds by proposing Voxel Set Transformer, a set-to-set approach. It likely models voxel features via transformer-based set interactions to mitigate limited receptive fields and computational redundancy of 3D convolutions on sparse voxels. Method details and experimental results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
2203.10314|v2.assessment: 将Transformer集合建模引入体素点云检测的思路有潜力，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度，建议查阅原文后再判断。
2203.10314|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Set Transformer，以集合到集合的Transformer范式处理体素化点云用于3D检测。
2203.10314|v2.innovation: 将体素特征建模为集合间交互，替代或增强传统3D卷积的局部感受野。
2203.10314|v2.result: 因摘要缺失，具体性能数据无法确认。

2203.05662|v2.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题推断：本文针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中体素化后点密度分布不均的问题，提出点密度感知的体素方法（Point Density-Aware Voxels）。方法可能根据体素内点密度自适应地调整特征编码或注意力权重，以缓解远处或稀疏区域目标特征不足的问题。具体方法细节与实验数据因摘要缺失无法确认。
2203.05662|v2.summary_en: With the abstract unavailable, this paper is inferred from its title to address non-uniform point density in voxelized LiDAR point clouds for 3D object detection via Point Density-Aware Voxels. It likely adapts feature encoding or attention weights according to per-voxel point density to mitigate insufficient features for distant or sparse objects. Method details and experimental results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
2203.05662|v2.assessment: 点密度感知是LiDAR检测中实际且重要的问题，思路有针对性，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献与实验效果。
2203.05662|v2.contribution: 提出点密度感知的体素特征编码方法，用于LiDAR 3D目标检测。
2203.05662|v2.innovation: 根据体素内点密度自适应调整特征表示，缓解点云密度不均带来的检测困难。
2203.05662|v2.result: 因摘要缺失，具体性能数据无法确认。

Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_cn: 本文针对自动驾驶中多LiDAR传感器布局对3D目标检测性能影响缺乏系统研究的问题，通过在不同车辆位置配置多个LiDAR并采集数据，系统评估了LiDAR放置方案对点云覆盖和检测精度的影响。作者构建了多LiDAR配置的实验框架，对比了不同布局下的检测结果，并分析了遮挡、点云密度等因素的作用。相比已有工作多关注单LiDAR或固定布局，本文首次系统量化了多LiDAR放置对检测性能的影响。实验表明合理的LiDAR布局能显著提升检测精度，为自动驾驶传感器配置提供了指导。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_en: This paper investigates how multi-LiDAR placement affects 3D object detection for autonomous driving. The authors systematically evaluate different LiDAR configurations on a vehicle and analyze their impact on point cloud coverage and detection accuracy. Compared to prior work focusing on single or fixed LiDAR setups, this study provides quantitative guidance for sensor placement, showing that proper layout significantly improves detection performance.
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.assessment: 该工作填补了多LiDAR布局对检测性能影响的空白，对自动驾驶传感器配置有实际指导意义，但方法创新性有限。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.contribution: 系统量化了多LiDAR放置对3D目标检测性能的影响。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.innovation: 首次通过实验框架对比不同LiDAR布局并分析遮挡与点云密度的影响。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.result: 合理的LiDAR布局能显著提升检测精度，为传感器配置提供指导。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR._arxiv_id: Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR Placement on Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

2203.10981|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中依赖外部深度估计器带来额外计算负担且深度先验不准确的问题，本文提出MonoDTR，一种端到端的深度感知Transformer网络。该方法包含深度感知特征增强模块（DFE），通过辅助监督隐式学习深度特征而无需额外计算；以及深度感知Transformer模块（DTR），全局整合上下文与深度特征，并引入深度位置编码（DPE）注入深度位置提示。相比已有方法，该模块可即插即用，在KITTI数据集上超越了此前最优的单目方法。
2203.10981|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the extra computation and inaccurate depth priors in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoDTR, an end-to-end depth-aware transformer network. It introduces a Depth-Aware Feature Enhancement (DFE) module that implicitly learns depth features with auxiliary supervision, and a Depth-Aware Transformer (DTR) module with depth positional encoding (DPE) to integrate context and depth features. Experiments on KITTI show it outperforms previous state-of-the-art monocular methods.
2203.10981|v2.assessment: MonoDTR通过隐式深度特征学习和深度位置编码，在不增加推理负担的前提下提升了单目3D检测性能，方法设计巧妙且实用。
2203.10981|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度感知Transformer网络MonoDTR，无需外部深度估计器。
2203.10981|v2.innovation: DFE模块隐式学习深度特征，DTR模块结合深度位置编码全局整合上下文。
2203.10981|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上超越此前最优的单目3D检测方法。

3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_cn: 本文针对3D目标检测中模型在未见域上泛化能力差的问题，提出3D-VField，一种通过对抗性点云增强来提升域泛化的方法。作者设计了一种可变形点云生成策略，在训练时对点云进行对抗性扰动以模拟不同传感器和场景的分布变化，从而增强检测器的鲁棒性。相比传统数据增强，该方法能更有效地缩小域间差距。实验表明，在多个跨域基准上，3D-VField显著提升了检测器的泛化性能。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_en: This paper tackles poor domain generalization in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-VField, an adversarial point cloud augmentation method. It generates deformable point clouds to simulate distribution shifts across sensors and scenes during training, enhancing detector robustness. Experiments on cross-domain benchmarks show significant improvements in generalization compared to conventional augmentation.
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.assessment: 3D-VField通过对抗性点云增强有效提升了3D检测的跨域泛化能力，思路新颖且实验充分，对实际部署有重要价值。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.contribution: 提出对抗性点云增强方法3D-VField以提升3D检测域泛化。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.innovation: 利用可变形点云生成模拟域偏移，增强检测器鲁棒性。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.result: 在多个跨域基准上显著提升检测器泛化性能。
