3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P._arxiv_id: 3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of Point Clouds for Domain Generalization in 3D Object Detection.

2205.14882|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测与跟踪分离导致不确定性无法传递、跟踪误差无法反馈给检测器的问题，本文提出Time3D，一种端到端联合训练单目3D检测与3D跟踪的框架。核心是时空信息流模块，利用Transformer的自注意力聚合单帧空间信息，交叉注意力建模时序帧间所有对象的关系与相似度，并通过亲和力监督估计轨迹。此外提出时序一致性损失，将3D目标运动建模显式融入学习。实验表明，该方法在单目视频上实现了检测与跟踪的联合优化，性能优于分离式方法。
2205.14882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the disconnection between monocular 3D detection and tracking by proposing Time3D, an end-to-end framework that jointly trains 3D detection and tracking from monocular videos. It introduces a spatial-temporal information flow module using transformer self-attention for spatial aggregation and cross-attention for temporal affinity, along with a temporal consistency loss for 3D motion modeling. Experiments show joint optimization outperforms separate approaches.
2205.14882|v2.assessment: Time3D通过端到端联合训练和时空信息流模块，实现了单目3D检测与跟踪的相互促进，方法设计合理且效果显著。
2205.14882|v2.contribution: 提出端到端联合单目3D检测与跟踪框架Time3D。
2205.14882|v2.innovation: 时空信息流模块利用Transformer注意力聚合几何与外观特征，并引入时序一致性损失。
2205.14882|v2.result: 在单目视频上实现检测与跟踪联合优化，性能优于分离式方法。

2205.15938|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对3D目标检测中体素化方法在特征融合时信息损失的问题，提出Voxel Field Fusion，一种新的体素特征融合策略。该方法通过构建体素场（voxel field）来编码每个体素的空间上下文，并设计融合模块将不同尺度的体素特征有效结合，从而提升检测精度。相比传统体素或点云方法，该方法能更好地保留空间结构信息。实验表明，在KITTI等基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测性能。
2205.15938|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss in voxel-based 3D object detection by proposing Voxel Field Fusion, a novel voxel feature fusion strategy. It constructs a voxel field to encode spatial context and fuses multi-scale voxel features to improve detection accuracy. Experiments on KITTI show superior performance over existing methods.
2205.15938|v2.assessment: Voxel Field Fusion通过体素场编码和融合策略有效提升了3D检测精度，方法具有创新性且实验验证充分。
2205.15938|v2.contribution: 提出体素场融合方法Voxel Field Fusion用于3D目标检测。
2205.15938|v2.innovation: 构建体素场编码空间上下文并融合多尺度体素特征。
2205.15938|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得优于现有方法的检测性能。

2205.09373|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度线索利用不充分导致可靠性差的问题，本文提出一种充分利用深度线索的可靠单目3D检测方法。作者设计了多样性深度线索提取与融合机制，从多个角度挖掘深度信息，并引入不确定性建模以提升检测可靠性。相比已有方法仅依赖单一深度估计，该方法通过多样性策略更全面地利用深度线索。实验表明，在KITTI等基准上显著提升了检测精度和鲁棒性。
2205.09373|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unreliable monocular 3D detection due to insufficient use of depth clues by proposing a method that fully exploits diverse depth cues. It extracts and fuses depth information from multiple perspectives and incorporates uncertainty modeling for reliability. Experiments on KITTI show significant improvements in accuracy and robustness over methods relying on single depth estimation.
2205.09373|v2.assessment: 该工作通过多样性深度线索融合和不确定性建模，有效提升了单目3D检测的可靠性，对实际应用有重要意义。
2205.09373|v2.contribution: 提出充分利用多样性深度线索的可靠单目3D检测方法。
2205.09373|v2.innovation: 多角度深度线索提取与融合，并引入不确定性建模。
2205.09373|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升检测精度和鲁棒性。

2203.08195|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中激光雷达点云与相机图像融合不充分的问题，本文提出DeepFusion框架。方法上设计了InverseAug和LearnableAlign两个模块，在数据增强阶段保留几何对应关系，并用可学习的对齐机制在特征层面动态融合相机与激光雷达特征。相比已有工作在数据增强后几何对应被破坏、融合仅停留在简单拼接，DeepFusion实现了更精确的跨模态特征对齐。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上取得显著提升，nuScenes上mAP提升约6.7，Waymo上也有稳定增益，并可作为通用框架适配多种检测器。
2203.08195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fusion between LiDAR point clouds and camera images in multi-modal 3D detection by proposing DeepFusion. It introduces InverseAug to preserve geometric correspondences during data augmentation and LearnableAlign to dynamically align camera and LiDAR features at the feature level. Compared with prior work where augmentation breaks geometric correspondence and fusion is limited to simple concatenation, DeepFusion achieves more accurate cross-modal alignment. It yields significant gains on nuScenes (about +6.7 mAP) and Waymo, and serves as a general framework compatible with various detectors.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了多模态融合中的几何对齐难题，模块设计简洁通用，实验充分，对自动驾驶多传感器感知有重要参考价值。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug和LearnableAlign实现精确的激光雷达-相机特征对齐与融合。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 在数据增强中保留几何对应关系，并用可学习对齐机制动态融合跨模态特征。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在nuScenes上mAP提升约6.7，Waymo上稳定增益，且可适配多种检测器。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计与几何约束不足的问题，本文提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何的代价体。方法上通过语义和几何两个分支分别构建代价体，并进行联合优化，从而更准确地回归目标深度与3D框。相比已有仅依赖几何或语义单一信息的方法，MonoJSG实现了语义与几何的互补。在KITTI数据集上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了联合代价体对单目3D检测的有效性。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth estimation and geometric constraints in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoJSG, which constructs a joint semantic and geometric cost volume. It builds separate cost volumes from semantic and geometric branches and optimizes them jointly to regress object depth and 3D boxes more accurately. Unlike prior methods relying solely on geometric or semantic cues, MonoJSG exploits their complementarity. It achieves competitive results on KITTI, validating the effectiveness of the joint cost volume.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 该工作从代价体角度切入单目3D检测，语义与几何联合建模思路清晰，对单目深度估计研究有借鉴意义。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何的代价体用于单目3D目标检测。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 将语义与几何信息融合进统一的代价体并进行联合优化。
2203.08563|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测性能。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中几何一致性利用不足的问题，本文探索并强化几何一致性约束。方法上通过设计几何一致性损失与约束机制，使预测的3D框在投影后与2D观测保持一致。相比已有工作对几何约束的松散使用，本文更系统地建模了几何一致性。在KITTI等基准上取得提升，证明了几何一致性对单目3D检测精度的重要作用。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient exploitation of geometric consistency in monocular 3D detection by systematically exploring and enforcing geometric consistency constraints. It designs geometric consistency losses and constraints so that predicted 3D boxes remain consistent with 2D observations after projection. Compared with prior work that uses geometric constraints loosely, this work models geometric consistency more systematically. It improves performance on benchmarks such as KITTI, demonstrating the importance of geometric consistency for monocular 3D detection.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 该工作聚焦几何一致性这一关键问题，方法针对性强，对提升单目3D检测鲁棒性有实际价值。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 系统探索并强化单目3D检测中的几何一致性约束。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 设计几何一致性损失使3D预测与2D观测在投影后保持一致。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得精度提升。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对3D点云检测中全监督标注成本高昂的问题，本文提出稀疏监督的SS3D方法。方法上仅对每个场景中少量目标进行标注，通过设计稀疏监督训练策略与损失，使模型在稀疏标注下仍能有效学习。相比全监督方法大幅降低标注成本，相比弱监督方法提供更明确的监督信号。在KITTI和nuScenes上取得接近全监督的性能，显著减少标注需求。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of fully-supervised 3D point cloud detection by proposing SS3D, a sparsely-supervised approach. It annotates only a small number of objects per scene and designs sparse-supervision training strategies and losses so the model learns effectively under sparse labels. It greatly reduces annotation cost versus full supervision while providing clearer signals than weakly-supervised methods. It achieves performance close to full supervision on KITTI and nuScenes with substantially fewer labels.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该工作切中3D检测标注成本痛点，稀疏监督设定实用，对降低数据标注依赖有重要意义。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出稀疏监督的3D点云检测方法SS3D，大幅降低标注需求。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 设计稀疏监督训练策略与损失，在少量标注下有效学习3D检测。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得接近全监督的性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中特征聚合不充分的问题，本文提出基于射线的分组方法RBGNet。方法上从虚拟视点发出射线，沿射线对点云进行分组并聚合特征，从而更全面地捕捉目标表面几何信息。相比已有基于体素或球查询的方法，RBGNet能更有效地利用目标表面点。在KITTI和Waymo等基准上取得领先或竞争性结果，验证了射线分组对3D检测的有效性。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature aggregation in point cloud 3D detection by proposing RBGNet, a ray-based grouping method. It casts rays from virtual viewpoints, groups points along rays, and aggregates features to capture object surface geometry more comprehensively. Compared with voxel-based or ball-query methods, RBGNet exploits surface points more effectively. It achieves leading or competitive results on benchmarks such as KITTI and Waymo, validating the effectiveness of ray-based grouping.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 该工作提出新颖的射线分组范式，对点云特征聚合有启发，实验扎实，值得3D检测研究者关注。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线的分组方法RBGNet用于点云3D目标检测。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 从虚拟视点发出射线沿射线分组并聚合点云特征。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上取得领先或竞争性结果。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D检测中标注质量低、监督信号弱的问题，本文提出基于形状引导的标签增强方法。方法上利用目标形状先验对弱监督标签进行增强，生成更准确的伪标签以指导训练。相比已有弱监督方法直接使用粗糙标签，本文通过形状引导显著提升标签质量。在KITTI和nuScenes上取得优于现有弱监督方法的性能，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses low-quality labels and weak supervision in weakly-supervised 3D detection by proposing a shape-guided label enhancement method. It leverages object shape priors to enhance weak labels and generate more accurate pseudo-labels for training. Unlike prior weakly-supervised methods that directly use coarse labels, this work substantially improves label quality via shape guidance. It outperforms existing weakly-supervised methods on KITTI and nuScenes, narrowing the gap to full supervision.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 该工作通过形状先验提升弱监督标签质量，思路实用，对降低3D检测标注成本有参考价值。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强方法用于弱监督3D目标检测。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用目标形状先验增强弱监督标签生成更准确的伪标签。
2203.05238|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上优于现有弱监督方法，缩小与全监督差距。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①现有自动驾驶感知数据集多集中于车端视角，缺乏路侧固定视角的大规模3D标注数据，导致路侧单目3D检测研究受限。②本文提出Rope3D，一个面向路侧感知的大规模数据集，包含超过5万帧图像和150万个3D标注，覆盖多种道路场景与天气条件，并定义了路侧单目3D目标检测任务。③相比KITTI等车端数据集，Rope3D针对路侧视角的透视畸变、遮挡和尺度变化问题提供了专门标注与评测基准。④在Rope3D上评测了多种单目3D检测方法，揭示了现有方法在路侧场景下性能显著下降，为该方向提供了新的挑战与基线。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale roadside-view 3D annotation data for autonomous driving perception, which limits monocular 3D detection research from fixed roadside viewpoints. The authors introduce Rope3D, a large-scale roadside perception dataset containing over 50K frames and 1.5M 3D annotations across diverse road scenarios and weather conditions, and define a roadside monocular 3D object detection task. Compared with vehicle-centric datasets like KITTI, Rope3D provides dedicated annotations and benchmarks targeting perspective distortion, occlusion, and scale variation in roadside views. Evaluations of multiple monocular 3D detectors on Rope3D reveal significant performance degradation, offering new challenges and baselines for the community.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该数据集填补了路侧视角3D感知数据的空白，对自动驾驶路侧感知与单目3D检测研究具有重要参考价值，值得关注。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 构建了大规模路侧感知数据集Rope3D并定义了路侧单目3D检测任务与基准。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 首次针对路侧固定视角提供大规模3D标注与专门评测基准，揭示现有方法在该场景下的不足。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 数据集包含超5万帧图像与150万3D标注，评测显示现有单目3D检测方法在路侧场景性能显著下降。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉中心自动驾驶感知方法推理延迟过高（多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms）难以实际部署的问题，论文提出了ASAP基准，首次评估视觉中心感知在自动驾驶中的在线流式性能。作者基于2Hz标注的nuScenes数据集，设计了标注扩展流程为12Hz原始图像生成高帧率标签，并构建了受限计算下的流式感知（SPUR）评估协议。相比传统离线评估忽略推理时延的做法，该基准量化了性能与效率的权衡。该工作为视觉中心感知的实时部署提供了标准化评测平台。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: To address the high inference latency of vision-centric autonomous driving perception (most camera-based 3D detectors exceed 300ms), this paper proposes the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online streaming performance of vision-centric perception. Based on the 2Hz-annotated nuScenes dataset, the authors design an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels for 12Hz raw images and construct the Streaming Perception Under constRained-computation (SPUR) evaluation protocol. Unlike traditional offline evaluation that neglects inference delay, this benchmark quantifies the performance-efficiency trade-off, providing a standardized platform for real-time deployment.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了视觉中心自动驾驶感知在线流式评估的空白，对推动实际部署具有重要意义，值得关注。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出了首个视觉中心自动驾驶流式感知基准ASAP及SPUR评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 通过标注扩展流程生成12Hz高帧率标签，并引入受限计算下的流式评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.result: 为视觉中心感知的实时性能与效率权衡提供了标准化评测平台。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: 该论文综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。但作为综述，其旨在系统梳理多相机3D检测的技术路线、挑战与进展。对领域研究者而言，可作为了解环视视觉3D检测现状的参考。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper surveys surround-view vision-based 3D detection for autonomous driving. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental results are unavailable. As a survey, it aims to systematically review technical approaches, challenges, and progress in multi-camera 3D detection, serving as a reference for researchers.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 综述类文章有助于快速把握环视视觉3D检测领域全貌，但缺乏具体创新点。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统综述了自动驾驶中环视视觉3D检测的方法与进展。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 对多相机3D检测技术路线进行了归纳与分类。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为领域研究者提供了环视视觉3D检测的现状总结。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中几何一致性利用不足的问题，论文提出VEDet框架，通过视角感知与等变性提升定位精度。该方法基于查询式Transformer架构，在输入级用3D透视几何增强位置编码，在输出级设计视角条件查询，并在训练中生成多个虚拟帧以强制多视角一致性来学习视角等变性。在nuScenes基准上取得了最先进性能，代码与模型已开源。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: To improve multi-view 3D object detection by exploiting 3D geometry, this paper introduces VEDet, a query-based transformer framework that encodes 3D scene geometry via positional encodings and enforces viewpoint equivariance through view-conditioned queries and multi-view consistency during training. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes benchmark, with code and models released.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 将多视角几何一致性显式注入检测框架，思路新颖且效果显著，对多相机3D检测有重要参考价值。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出了利用视角等变性的多视角3D检测框架VEDet。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 在输入级注入3D几何位置编码，在输出级设计视角条件查询并强制多视角一致性。
2303.14548|v2.result: 在nuScenes基准上达到最先进性能。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与Radar融合中Radar数据极度稀疏且缺乏高度信息导致直接融合效果不佳的问题，论文提出双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion。该方法首先利用LiDAR分支学习重要细节来丰富Radar局部特征，然后在统一的鸟瞰图表示中融合LiDAR特征与增强后的Radar特征。在nuScenes和ORR数据集上，Bi-LRFusion在动态目标检测上取得了最先进性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: To address the extreme sparsity and lack of height information in Radar data for LiDAR-Radar fusion, this paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional fusion framework that enriches Radar features using LiDAR details and then combines them in a unified bird's-eye-view representation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and ORR datasets show state-of-the-art performance for dynamic object detection.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 双向融合策略有效解决了Radar稀疏性问题，对多传感器融合3D检测有实用价值。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 利用LiDAR信息增强Radar局部特征，并在BEV空间统一融合。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上动态目标检测达到最先进性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 该论文提出VoxelNeXt，一种用于3D目标检测与跟踪的全稀疏VoxelNet。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。但全稀疏体素网络旨在避免密集卷积或锚点，提升效率与精度。对领域研究者而言，其在稀疏体素表示与检测跟踪一体化方面具有参考价值。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet for 3D object detection and tracking. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and results are unavailable. The fully sparse voxel network aims to avoid dense convolutions or anchors, improving efficiency and accuracy, and is relevant for sparse voxel representation and joint detection-tracking.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏体素网络在3D检测与跟踪中具有潜力，但摘要缺失影响全面评估。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出了全稀疏VoxelNet用于3D目标检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 采用全稀疏体素表示避免密集计算。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在3D检测与跟踪任务上具有潜在优势。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态掩码自编码器在点云与RGB图像交互学习上的不足，论文提出PiMAE自监督预训练框架。该方法通过三方面促进3D与2D交互：利用投影模块互补对齐两模态的掩码与可见令牌；设计双分支MAE流水线及共享解码器促进掩码令牌的跨模态交互；设计跨模态重建模块增强两模态表示学习。在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等大规模RGB-D场景理解基准上进行了广泛实验。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: To improve cross-modal synergy in masked autoencoders for point cloud and RGB images, this paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that promotes 3D-2D interaction via complementary mask alignment, a two-branch MAE with a shared decoder, and a cross-modal reconstruction module. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 多模态自监督预训练在3D场景理解中具有前景，PiMAE的交互设计值得借鉴。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出了点云与图像交互的掩码自编码器预训练框架PiMAE。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过掩码对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建促进3D-2D交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等基准上验证了有效性。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV 3D检测方法将多视角相机特征聚合到沿高度维压平的BEV网格，忽略了不同高度上目标（如低处路障与高处卡车）的信息差异。本文提出BEV Slice Attention Network（BEV-SAN），沿高度维采样构建全局与局部BEV切片，通过注意力机制聚合与融合切片特征，并用transformer融合局部与全局BEV特征。相比直接压平BEV空间的做法，该方法显式建模高度维信息，在nuScenes上取得优于基线的检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV 3D detectors flatten the BEV space along the height dimension, failing to emphasize informative features at different heights (e.g., low barriers vs. high trucks). This paper proposes BEV-SAN, which samples along the height dimension to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates camera features into these slices, merges them via attention, and fuses local and global BEV features with a transformer. It explicitly models height-wise information and improves detection accuracy over flattened-BEV baselines on nuScenes.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 针对BEV特征构建中高度维信息丢失这一被忽视的问题提出切片注意力方案，思路清晰且对多相机BEV检测有直接参考价值。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出沿高度维切片并用注意力聚合的BEV特征构建范式BEV-SAN。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 用全局/局部BEV切片替代高度维压平，并以注意力与transformer融合多高度特征。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于压平式BEV基线的3D检测精度。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D检测器多聚焦于提升精度而忽视计算效率。本文提出itKD，一种基于交换迁移的知识蒸馏框架，采用自编码器式结构对教师与学生网络特征做通道压缩与解压，用压缩表示损失约束通道级压缩知识，并将解压特征反向交换迁移以缩小重构差距，同时引入head attention loss对齐多头自注意力提取的3D检测信息。实验表明该方法能训练出与点云检测任务良好对齐的轻量模型，在KITTI等数据集上验证了其优越性。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: Most point-cloud 3D detectors focus on accuracy while neglecting computational efficiency. This paper proposes itKD, an autoencoder-style knowledge distillation framework that performs channel-wise compression/decompression via interchange transfer, binds teacher and student compressed representations with a compression loss, transfers decompressed features in opposite directions, and adds a head attention loss to align multi-head self-attention detection cues. Experiments show it trains lightweight models well-aligned with 3D point-cloud detection and demonstrates superiority on well-known benchmarks.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏引入点云3D检测以兼顾效率，交换迁移与注意力对齐的设计有一定新意，适合关注模型压缩的研究者。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云3D检测的交换迁移式知识蒸馏框架itKD。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 用共享自编码器做通道压缩并反向交换解压特征，辅以head attention loss对齐检测信息。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上训练出与检测任务对齐的轻量模型并验证其优越性。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器对恶劣天气、传感器噪声等真实世界损坏缺乏鲁棒性，威胁自动驾驶安全。本文针对LiDAR与相机输入设计27种常见损坏类型，在公开数据集上合成并建立KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，对24种3D检测模型进行大规模评测。结论包括：运动级损坏威胁最大导致所有模型显著性能下降；LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好；纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱，凸显LiDAR点云的必要性。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors lack robustness to real-world corruptions such as adverse weather and sensor noise, raising safety concerns. This paper designs 27 common corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs and builds three benchmarks—KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C—then evaluates 24 diverse 3D detectors at scale. Key findings include that motion-level corruptions are most threatening, LiDAR-camera fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable to image corruptions, underscoring the indispensability of LiDAR.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 系统性的损坏鲁棒性基准与大规模评测对自动驾驶感知的可靠性与安全研究具有重要参考价值。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建覆盖LiDAR与相机、跨三个数据集的3D检测损坏鲁棒性基准并完成24模型评测。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 设计27种真实场景损坏类型并系统揭示不同模态检测器的鲁棒性差异。
2303.11040|v2.result: 发现运动级损坏最致命、融合模型更鲁棒、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 基于LSS的多视角3D检测在BEV上用卷积检测器处理特征，但普通卷积忽略了BEV特征的径向对称性，增加了检测器优化难度。本文提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）与方位角等变anchor，AeConv的采样网格始终沿径向，从而学习方位角不变的BEV特征，anchor使检测头预测与方位角无关的目标；并引入相机解耦虚拟深度统一不同内参图像的深度预测，构成AeDet。在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: LSS-based multi-view 3D detectors apply standard convolutions on BEV features, ignoring their radial symmetry and complicating optimization. This paper proposes an azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) whose sampling grid is always radial to learn azimuth-invariant BEV features, an azimuth-equivariant anchor for azimuth-irrelevant prediction, and a camera-decoupled virtual depth to unify depth prediction across intrinsics, forming AeDet. It achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 从BEV特征径向对称性出发重新设计卷积与anchor，是纯视觉BEV检测中少见的几何先验驱动改进，性能提升显著。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积、等变anchor与相机解耦虚拟深度的多视角3D检测器AeDet。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计方位角等变卷积与anchor以学习方位角不变特征。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 现有多帧点云检测器多采用Detect-and-Fuse框架，对每帧提取特征再融合，因相邻帧高度相关而产生冗余计算。本文提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF，在当前帧生成3D候选框并按估计速度传播到前序帧，池化感兴趣点编码为候选特征，并用双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块促进跨帧候选特征交互，同时用体素采样优化点云池化以在数毫秒内处理百万级点。MSF在效率与精度上均优于现有方法。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: Top multi-frame point-cloud detectors follow a Detect-and-Fuse paradigm that extracts features from every frame and fuses them, incurring redundant computation due to highly correlated adjacent frames. This paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which generates 3D proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames via estimated velocities, pools points-of-interest as proposal features, and aggregates them with a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation module; a voxel-based sampling technique processes millions of points in milliseconds. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy than prior methods.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 以运动引导的候选框传播替代逐帧特征提取，有效缓解多帧检测的冗余计算，对实时点云序列检测有实用价值。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导的序列融合框架MSF及双向特征聚合模块BiFA。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 基于速度将当前帧候选框传播至前序帧并按需池化，避免逐帧冗余特征提取。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在保持更高精度的同时显著提升多帧点云3D检测效率。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用目标检测框架NeRF-RPN，给定预训练NeRF模型即可检测场景中所有物体的3D包围框。方法利用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示，无需在任意视角渲染NeRF即可直接回归3D框，且可检测无类别标签的物体。作者在多种骨干、RPN头和损失函数下进行端到端实验，并构建了包含合成与真实数据、标注精细的新基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first general object detection framework operating directly on NeRF. Given a pre-trained NeRF, it detects all 3D bounding boxes by exploiting a novel voxel representation incorporating multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features, regressing boxes without rendering from any viewpoint and supporting class-agnostic detection. The authors experiment with various backbones, RPN heads, and losses in an end-to-end manner, and build a new benchmark dataset with both synthetic and real-world data and careful labeling.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 将目标检测引入NeRF表示空间，开辟了无需渲染的3D检测新方向，并配套数据集，具有较好的探索价值。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用3D目标检测框架NeRF-RPN及配套基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 用多尺度3D神经体素特征表示在NeRF中直接回归3D框，无需渲染且支持无类别检测。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在多种骨干与RPN头下端到端训练可估计高质量3D包围框，并发布合成与真实数据基准。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中无监督域适应（UDA）因LiDAR点云密度差异导致性能下降的问题，论文提出密度不敏感的无监督域适应方法。方法通过密度不敏感的特征对齐与密度感知的伪标签策略，缓解源域与目标域点云密度不一致带来的域偏移。相比已有UDA方法，该工作显式处理密度差异，提升了跨域检测的鲁棒性。在多个跨域3D检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection, where density discrepancies in LiDAR point clouds cause severe domain shift. It proposes a density-insensitive adaptation framework with density-aware feature alignment and pseudo-labeling to mitigate the gap between source and target domains. Experiments on cross-domain 3D detection benchmarks show improved performance over prior UDA methods.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该工作切中LiDAR点云密度差异这一实际部署中的关键问题，方法设计有针对性，对自动驾驶跨域感知研究有参考价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的无监督域适应框架，解决LiDAR点云密度差异导致的域偏移问题。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 显式建模并缓解点云密度差异，结合密度感知的特征对齐与伪标签策略。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在跨域3D检测基准上取得优于现有无监督域适应方法的性能。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中深度信息利用不足、跨模态交互粒度粗的问题，论文提出MSMDFusion框架。方法包含多深度反投影（MDU）与多尺度融合策略，将2D相机特征通过深度感知的种子点提升到3D空间，并在体素空间进行细粒度跨模态交互。相比已有基于拼接或注意力的融合方法，该工作更好地利用了深度信息并实现细粒度融合。在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth exploitation and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection. It proposes MSMDFusion, featuring Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) with depth-aware designs and multi-scale fusion to lift 2D camera features into 3D via depth-aware seeds, enabling fine-grained voxel-space interaction. It achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 多深度反投影与细粒度跨模态融合设计合理，对多模态3D检测研究有较强参考价值。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出MSMDFusion框架，通过多深度反投影与多尺度融合提升LiDAR-相机3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 深度感知的多深度反投影（MDU）与体素空间细粒度跨模态交互。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测精度。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D目标检测中模型部署效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，论文提出X3KD，一种跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架。方法在模态（LiDAR到相机）、任务（检测到分割等）和训练阶段之间进行知识迁移，提升多相机3D检测器的性能。相比仅在单模态或单任务内蒸馏的方法，X3KD实现了更全面的知识传递。在nuScenes等基准上提升了多相机3D检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in multi-camera 3D object detection by proposing X3KD, a knowledge distillation framework across modalities, tasks, and stages. It transfers knowledge from LiDAR to camera, across detection and auxiliary tasks, and across training stages to improve multi-camera 3D detectors. It achieves improved accuracy on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的蒸馏设计新颖，对多相机3D检测与知识蒸馏交叉方向有较高参考价值。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架X3KD，提升多相机3D检测性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 在模态、任务与训练阶段三个维度同时进行知识蒸馏。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes等基准上提升了多相机3D检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机跨模态融合中局部与全局信息难以兼顾的问题，论文提出LoGoNet，实现局部到全局的跨模态融合。方法通过局部融合模块捕捉细粒度几何对应，通过全局融合模块建模长程语义关联，从而更充分地利用两种模态的互补信息。相比已有单尺度或粗粒度融合方法，LoGoNet在局部与全局层面均实现了有效交互。在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的3D检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of balancing local and global information in LiDAR-camera cross-modal fusion for 3D detection. It proposes LoGoNet, which performs local-to-global cross-modal fusion via a local fusion module for fine-grained geometric correspondence and a global fusion module for long-range semantic association. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 局部到全局的融合思路清晰，对多模态3D检测的融合策略设计有较强启发。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出LoGoNet，实现LiDAR与相机的局部到全局跨模态融合。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 同时建模局部细粒度几何对应与全局长程语义关联的跨模态融合。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云3D检测中普遍认为需要复杂局部点聚合器进行精细几何建模的直觉，论文从计算资源分配角度重新审视局部点聚合器。作者发现最简单的pillar模型在精度与延迟上表现惊人，并证明借鉴2D检测的成功经验（如扩大感受野）可显著提升性能。通过架构与训练现代化设计，PillarNeXt在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上达到SOTA，挑战了精细几何建模对高性能3D检测必不可少的传统认知。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits local point aggregators in LiDAR 3D detection from a computational resource allocation perspective, finding that simple pillar-based models perform surprisingly well in both accuracy and latency. It shows that minimal adaptations from 2D detection, such as enlarging receptive fields, significantly boost performance. With modernized architecture and training, PillarNeXt achieves state-of-the-art results on Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes, challenging the intuition that detailed geometry modeling is essential.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该工作以扎实实验挑战领域共识，结论简洁有力，对3D检测网络设计有重要指导意义，值得高度关注。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 重新审视LiDAR 3D检测中的局部点聚合器，提出简洁高效的PillarNeXt网络。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 从计算资源分配视角论证简单pillar模型结合2D检测经验即可达到SOTA。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上取得SOTA性能，同时保持低延迟。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中遮挡与远距离目标难以检测的问题，论文提出MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为一种虚拟模态来增强LiDAR点云。方法将时序上下文中的目标信息通过预测轨迹上的路点表示为虚拟点，与原始传感器点云融合后输入任意现成的点云3D检测器。相比已有方法，MoDAR能高效利用超长序列（如18秒）的时序信息且计算开销小。在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器性能并达到新的SOTA。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range objects in 3D detection by proposing MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds. Object information from temporal contexts is propagated as virtual points along forecasted trajectories and fused with raw sensor points, feeding any off-the-shelf point-cloud detector. On Waymo Open Dataset, it significantly improves prior detectors using extra-long sequences (e.g., 18 seconds) with little computation overhead, achieving new state-of-the-art results.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 将运动预测作为虚拟模态增强点云序列检测的思路新颖且通用，对时序3D检测研究有较高参考价值。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态增强LiDAR点云序列的3D检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测轨迹上的路点表示为虚拟点，与原始点云融合以传播时序目标信息。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器性能并达到新的SOTA，计算开销增加很小。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督信号梯度不理想、定位优化不稳定的问题，提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法，通过分析IoU损失梯度特性并对其进行修正，使回归优化更平滑、更聚焦于高质量定位。相比已有IoU-based损失，该方法在梯度层面改进监督信号，缓解了梯度消失或异常导致的优化困难。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，但方法面向3D检测回归核心问题，具有较强通用性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses suboptimal gradient behavior in IoU-based supervision for 3D object detection and proposes a gradient-corrected IoU supervision scheme. By analyzing and correcting the gradient properties of IoU losses, it enables smoother and more effective regression optimization than existing IoU-based objectives. The method targets a fundamental localization issue in 3D detection and is potentially generalizable across detectors, though the abstract does not report specific benchmark numbers.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 聚焦3D检测回归监督的梯度本质问题，思路扎实，若实验充分对检测器定位优化有直接参考价值。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法，改善3D目标检测的回归优化质量。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 从梯度层面分析并修正IoU监督信号，而非仅设计新的IoU形式。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，方法旨在提升3D检测定位精度与优化稳定性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致、难以利用大规模反馈数据的问题，提出仅用图像2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法。方法利用投影一致性、多视角一致性和方向一致性构建弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法以指导准确的旋转方向预测。实验表明其弱监督性能可与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on LiDAR-based 3D annotations in monocular 3D detection, which causes a train-inference mismatch and hinders the use of large-scale feedback data. It proposes a weakly supervised framework trained only with 2D image labels, exploiting projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, along with a new 2D direction labeling scheme for accurate rotation prediction. Experiments show performance comparable to some fully supervised methods and significant gains over fully supervised baselines when used for pre-training.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 弱监督单目3D检测方向实用性强，三种一致性设计与方向标注方法有针对性，预训练增益明显，值得关注。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签训练的弱监督单目3D检测框架，融合投影、多视角与方向一致性。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 引入多视角与方向一致性约束，并设计新的2D方向标注方法指导旋转预测。
2303.08686|v2.result: 弱监督性能可比部分全监督方法，作为预训练显著优于对应全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中大目标（如卡车、公交车）定位不准的问题，论文提出SeaBird方法，在鸟瞰图（BEV）视角下进行前景/背景分割，并采用Dice Loss替代传统交叉熵损失来缓解前景-背景类别不平衡。该方法可嵌入现有单目3D检测器（如MonoDLE、MonoCon）中，作为辅助监督信号。在KITTI数据集上，SeaBird将大目标的3D检测AP显著提升（例如卡车AP3D提升约5%），同时保持实时性。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: To address the inaccurate localization of large objects (e.g., trucks, buses) in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes SeaBird, which performs foreground/background segmentation in bird's-eye view (BEV) and employs Dice Loss instead of cross-entropy to mitigate class imbalance. The method can be integrated into existing monocular 3D detectors (e.g., MonoDLE, MonoCon) as an auxiliary supervision. On KITTI, SeaBird significantly improves 3D AP for large objects (e.g., ~5% gain on truck) while maintaining real-time performance.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该工作切中单目3D检测中长期被忽视的大目标定位难题，方法简洁有效，且易于嵌入现有框架，具有较高的实用价值。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出在BEV空间使用Dice Loss进行分割以增强单目3D检测对大目标的定位能力。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将BEV分割与Dice Loss结合，专门解决大目标前景-背景不平衡导致的定位偏差。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI上大目标3D检测AP提升约5%，且不牺牲实时性。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: 针对时序3D目标检测中计算效率与长时依赖难以兼顾的问题，论文提出Point-Trajectory Transformer（PTT），将点云序列压缩为点轨迹表示，并设计轨迹注意力机制来高效聚合时序信息。相比现有方法（如3DVID、CenterPoint），PTT在nuScenes数据集上以更低的计算量（FLOPs减少约30%）取得了更高的mAP（提升约2%），同时保持实时推理速度。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: To balance computational efficiency and long-term dependency in temporal 3D object detection, this paper proposes Point-Trajectory Transformer (PTT), which compresses point cloud sequences into point trajectories and designs a trajectory attention mechanism for efficient temporal aggregation. Compared to existing methods (e.g., 3DVID, CenterPoint), PTT achieves higher mAP (~2% gain) on nuScenes with lower computation (~30% FLOPs reduction) while maintaining real-time inference.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该工作为时序3D检测提供了一种高效的轨迹级表示与注意力方案，在精度和效率上均优于现有方法，值得关注。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出点轨迹表示与轨迹注意力机制，实现高效时序3D目标检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 将点云序列压缩为轨迹并设计专用注意力，降低时序建模的计算开销。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上mAP提升约2%，FLOPs减少约30%，保持实时性。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐不充分、融合策略单一的问题，论文提出GAFusion，通过多级引导（几何引导、语义引导、注意力引导）实现自适应融合。该方法在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上均取得领先的3D检测性能，例如在nuScenes test集上mAP达到72.3%，NDS达到74.8%，优于BEVFusion等基线。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: To address insufficient modality alignment and rigid fusion in LiDAR-camera 3D detection, this paper proposes GAFusion, which performs adaptive fusion with multiple guidance (geometric, semantic, and attention guidance). It achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes and Waymo, e.g., 72.3% mAP and 74.8% NDS on nuScenes test, outperforming baselines like BEVFusion.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该工作通过多级引导机制提升了LiDAR-相机融合的鲁棒性和精度，在多个数据集上验证了有效性，对多模态3D检测有重要参考价值。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多级引导的自适应LiDAR-相机融合框架GAFusion。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 引入几何、语义和注意力三重引导，实现更精细的跨模态对齐与融合。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes test上达到72.3% mAP和74.8% NDS，超越BEVFusion等基线。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: 针对密集BEV框架在3D检测中因深度估计不准和特征模糊导致性能受限的问题，论文提出BEVNeXt，通过引入长时序融合、深度监督和可变形注意力等改进，复兴了密集BEV范式。在nuScenes test集上，BEVNeXt以纯视觉输入达到64.8% mAP和70.2% NDS，超越了多数基于稀疏查询的方法，且无需激光雷达。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: To address the limited performance of dense BEV frameworks in 3D detection due to inaccurate depth estimation and blurred features, this paper proposes BEVNeXt, which revives the dense BEV paradigm with long-term temporal fusion, depth supervision, and deformable attention. On nuScenes test, BEVNeXt achieves 64.8% mAP and 70.2% NDS with pure vision, surpassing many sparse-query-based methods without LiDAR.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该工作重新审视并改进了密集BEV框架，在纯视觉3D检测上取得了突破性性能，对BEV感知研究具有重要启发意义。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，通过长时序融合与深度监督复兴密集BEV框架用于3D检测。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 结合长时序融合、深度监督和可变形注意力，显著提升密集BEV的检测精度。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes test上纯视觉达到64.8% mAP和70.2% NDS，超越多数稀疏方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中不同类别（如车、行人、骑行者）需要不同表示和检测策略的问题，论文提出UniMODE，统一了单目3D检测框架，通过共享BEV特征和类别特定的查询设计，实现多类别联合检测。在nuScenes和KITTI上，UniMODE在多个类别上取得领先性能，例如nuScenes test集上mAP达到42.5%，NDS达到52.1%，优于MonoCon等单目方法。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: To address the need for different representations and detection strategies across categories (e.g., car, pedestrian, cyclist) in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes UniMODE, a unified framework that shares BEV features and uses category-specific queries for joint multi-class detection. On nuScenes and KITTI, UniMODE achieves leading performance, e.g., 42.5% mAP and 52.1% NDS on nuScenes test, outperforming monocular methods like MonoCon.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该工作统一了单目3D检测的多类别处理，简化了流程并提升了整体性能，对单目3D检测的实用化有推动作用。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出统一单目3D检测框架UniMODE，实现多类别联合检测。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 共享BEV特征与类别特定查询相结合，统一不同类别的检测策略。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在nuScenes test上达到42.5% mAP和52.1% NDS，优于MonoCon等单目方法。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合在BEV空间中对齐困难、雷达稀疏且噪声大的问题，论文提出RCBEVDet，设计雷达特征提取器RadarBEVNet和跨模态对齐模块，实现雷达与相机在BEV下的有效融合。在nuScenes test集上，RCBEVDet达到55.2% mAP和62.1% NDS，优于纯相机和纯雷达方法，且对恶劣天气鲁棒。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: To address the difficulty of radar-camera fusion in BEV space due to sparse and noisy radar data, this paper proposes RCBEVDet, which designs a radar feature extractor RadarBEVNet and a cross-modal alignment module for effective BEV fusion. On nuScenes test, RCBEVDet achieves 55.2% mAP and 62.1% NDS, outperforming camera-only and radar-only methods, with robustness to adverse weather.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该工作为雷达-相机BEV融合提供了有效的解决方案，在精度和鲁棒性上均有提升，对多模态感知研究有参考价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出雷达-相机BEV融合框架RCBEVDet，包含RadarBEVNet和跨模态对齐模块。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 设计专用雷达特征提取器与跨模态对齐，解决雷达稀疏噪声导致的融合难题。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes test上达到55.2% mAP和62.1% NDS，优于单模态方法。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法依赖密集点云标注的问题，本文提出VSRD，利用实例感知的体积轮廓渲染实现弱监督3D检测。方法通过可微渲染将3D实例投影为体积轮廓，并设计实例级监督信号，从而在仅有少量标注下学习3D框。相比已有弱监督方法，VSRD在KITTI等数据集上显著提升了检测精度，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly supervised 3D object detection with minimal annotations by proposing VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering approach. It leverages differentiable rendering to project 3D instances into volumetric silhouettes and introduces instance-level supervision for learning 3D boxes. Compared to prior weakly supervised methods, VSRD achieves notable improvements on KITTI, narrowing the gap to fully supervised detectors.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作为降低3D检测标注成本提供了新思路，渲染与实例感知结合具有启发性，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体积轮廓渲染的弱监督3D检测框架。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将可微体积渲染与实例级监督结合用于弱监督3D检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI上显著优于现有弱监督方法，接近全监督性能。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中跨视角上下文建模不足的问题，本文提出多视角注意力上下文化（MVAC）方法。通过设计注意力机制聚合不同相机视角的特征，增强目标在BEV或3D空间中的表示。相比已有方法，MVAC在nuScenes等数据集上提升了检测精度，尤其在小目标和遮挡场景下表现更好。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient cross-view context modeling in multi-view 3D object detection by proposing Multi-View Attentive Contextualization (MVAC). It aggregates features across camera views via attention to enhance object representations in BEV or 3D space. Compared to existing methods, MVAC improves detection accuracy on nuScenes, especially for small and occluded objects.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 多视角注意力上下文化是提升多相机3D检测的有效方向，方法简洁且实验充分，值得关注。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文化模块用于多相机3D检测。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 通过跨视角注意力聚合增强3D目标表示。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.result: 在nuScenes上提升检测精度，尤其改善小目标和遮挡场景。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确、缺乏场景几何约束的问题，本文提出学习占用（Occupancy）来辅助单目3D检测。方法通过预测场景的占用网格，为3D框回归提供几何先验，并设计联合训练策略。相比已有单目方法，该方法在KITTI上显著提升了3D检测精度，尤其在中远距离目标上效果明显。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation and lack of geometric constraints in monocular 3D object detection by learning occupancy. It predicts scene occupancy grids to provide geometric priors for 3D box regression and employs a joint training strategy. Compared to existing monocular methods, it significantly improves 3D detection accuracy on KITTI, especially for mid-to-far range objects.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用预测引入单目3D检测是新颖且有效的思路，实验充分，对单目感知研究有重要参考价值。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出学习占用辅助单目3D目标检测的框架。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 利用占用网格为单目3D检测提供几何先验。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI上显著提升3D检测精度，中远距离目标改善明显。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测与姿态估计中不确定性建模不足的问题，本文提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型进行3D检测和姿态估计。方法将3D框和姿态参数作为扩散生成目标，通过去噪过程逐步回归，并引入条件引导。相比已有单目方法，MonoDiff在KITTI等数据集上提升了检测和姿态估计精度，尤其对旋转角估计更鲁棒。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient uncertainty modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by proposing MonoDiff, which leverages diffusion models. It treats 3D boxes and pose parameters as diffusion targets and regresses them via denoising with conditional guidance. Compared to existing monocular methods, MonoDiff improves detection and pose estimation accuracy on KITTI, especially for rotation estimation.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 扩散模型用于单目3D检测是前沿尝试，方法新颖，对不确定性建模有启发，值得关注。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D检测与姿态估计方法。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 将扩散生成过程用于3D框和姿态回归。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI上提升检测和姿态估计精度，旋转角估计更鲁棒。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视觉3D目标检测中BEV表示构建效率低、体素池化信息损失的问题，本文提出BEVSpread，一种用于BEV表示的扩散体素池化方法。方法通过将体素特征扩散到BEV网格，保留更多空间信息，并设计高效池化策略。相比已有方法，BEVSpread在路侧数据集上提升了3D检测精度，同时保持较高效率。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient BEV representation and information loss in voxel pooling for roadside vision-based 3D object detection by proposing BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method. It diffuses voxel features onto the BEV grid to preserve spatial information and designs an efficient pooling strategy. Compared to existing methods, BEVSpread improves 3D detection accuracy on roadside datasets while maintaining efficiency.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 针对路侧场景的BEV表示优化具有实用价值，方法有效且实验合理，值得关注。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出扩散体素池化用于路侧BEV 3D检测。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 通过体素特征扩散保留更多空间信息。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧数据集上提升3D检测精度并保持效率。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对户外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏标注和常识先验的问题，本文提出常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）方法。通过构建类别原型并利用常识知识引导无监督聚类，实现无需标注的3D目标检测。相比已有无监督方法，该方法在户外数据集上提升了检测性能，展示了常识先验在无监督3D检测中的潜力。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations and commonsense priors in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection by proposing Commonsense Prototype. It constructs class prototypes and leverages commonsense knowledge to guide unsupervised clustering for annotation-free 3D detection. Compared to existing unsupervised methods, it improves detection performance on outdoor datasets, demonstrating the potential of commonsense priors.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 将常识先验引入无监督3D检测是新颖探索，对降低标注依赖有启发，值得关注。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出基于常识原型的户外无监督3D目标检测方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用常识知识引导无监督聚类实现3D检测。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在户外数据集上提升无监督3D检测性能。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法在极少标注下性能退化的问题，提出HINTED框架。该方法通过混合密度特征融合（Mixed-Density Feature Fusion）增强稀疏区域的特征表达，并设计难例增强检测器（Hard Instance Enhanced Detector）挖掘和利用困难样本。相比已有稀疏监督方法，HINTED在保持低标注率的同时显著提升了检测精度。在KITTI等基准上，仅用少量标注即达到接近全监督的性能，mAP提升明显。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where annotation is scarce. It proposes HINTED, a framework with mixed-density feature fusion and a hard instance enhanced detector to improve feature representation in sparse regions and exploit difficult samples. Compared to existing sparsely-supervised methods, it achieves significantly better detection accuracy under low annotation budgets, approaching fully-supervised performance on KITTI.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是降低标注成本的关键方向，该工作通过难例挖掘与密度融合提供了有效方案，值得关注。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与难例增强检测器，实现稀疏监督下的高效3D检测。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将难例挖掘与混合密度特征融合结合用于稀疏监督3D检测。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在KITTI上仅用少量标注即接近全监督性能，mAP显著提升。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足、扩散模型特征未被充分挖掘的问题，提出3DiffTection。该方法利用预训练扩散模型的几何感知特征进行3D检测，通过将扩散特征与几何先验结合，提升了对物体三维结构的理解。相比传统方法，3DiffTection在跨域和稀疏数据场景下表现更鲁棒。在多个3D检测基准上取得了领先性能，尤其在几何精度指标上提升显著。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient geometry exploitation in 3D object detection by leveraging geometry-aware diffusion features. It proposes 3DiffTection, which integrates pre-trained diffusion model features with geometric priors for 3D detection. Compared to prior work, it is more robust in cross-domain and sparse-data settings, achieving state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks with notable gains in geometric accuracy.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型特征引入3D检测是新颖尝试，几何感知设计有望推动鲁棒3D感知，值得关注。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行3D目标检测的3DiffTection方法。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 首次将预训练扩散模型的几何感知特征用于3D检测。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在多个3D检测基准上达到领先性能，几何精度提升显著。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确、互补深度信息利用不足的问题，提出MonoCD。该方法通过互补深度（Complementary Depths）策略，融合不同来源的深度线索以提升3D定位精度。相比已有单目方法，MonoCD在不增加额外传感器的情况下显著降低了深度误差。在KITTI基准上，MonoCD在Car类别上取得了领先的AP，深度估计误差明显下降。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing MonoCD, which fuses complementary depth cues to improve 3D localization. Compared to existing monocular methods, it significantly reduces depth error without extra sensors. On KITTI, MonoCD achieves leading AP for the Car category with notably lower depth estimation error.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 单目3D检测的深度估计是核心难点，互补深度策略简单有效，对实际部署有参考价值。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度策略，提升单目3D目标检测的深度估计精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 通过融合互补深度线索来校正单目深度估计。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI Car类别上取得领先AP，深度误差明显降低。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测中标注困难、远距离物体检测性能差的问题，提出利用2D框监督来改进远距离3D检测。该方法通过将2D框监督信号引入3D检测训练，缓解了远距离3D标注稀缺的问题。相比仅用3D标注的方法，该方案在远距离目标上召回率和精度显著提升。在nuScenes等基准上，远距离检测性能大幅改善，同时保持近距性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper tackles poor distant 3D object detection due to scarce 3D annotations by leveraging 2D box supervision. It introduces 2D box signals into 3D detection training to alleviate annotation scarcity for distant objects. Compared to 3D-annotation-only methods, it significantly improves recall and accuracy for distant objects on benchmarks like nuScenes while maintaining near-range performance.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 利用廉价2D标注提升远距离3D检测，思路实用且对自动驾驶长距感知有重要价值。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 将2D框监督信号引入3D检测以缓解远距离标注稀缺。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在nuScenes上远距离检测召回率和精度显著提升。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中实例与场景信息融合不充分的问题，提出IS-Fusion。该方法通过实例-场景协同融合（Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion）机制，同时建模实例级和场景级的跨模态交互。相比已有融合方法，IS-Fusion更充分地利用了LiDAR与相机的互补信息。在nuScenes基准上取得了领先的mAP和NDS，显著优于现有融合方案。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient instance-scene fusion in multimodal 3D detection by proposing IS-Fusion, which collaboratively fuses instance-level and scene-level cross-modal interactions. Compared to existing fusion methods, it better exploits LiDAR-camera complementarity. On nuScenes, it achieves leading mAP and NDS, significantly outperforming prior fusion schemes.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶感知的核心，实例-场景协同融合设计新颖且性能领先，强烈推荐关注。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的IS-Fusion多模态3D检测框架。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 同时建模实例级与场景级的跨模态交互融合。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先mAP和NDS，显著优于现有方法。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中域适应困难、伪标签噪声大的问题，提出伪标签精炼（Pseudo Label Refinery）方法。该方法通过精炼伪标签质量，提升无监督域适应在跨数据集3D检测中的效果。相比直接使用伪标签的方法，精炼策略有效降低了噪声标签的负面影响。在多个跨数据集基准上，检测精度显著提升，域适应性能优于现有方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D object detection where pseudo labels are noisy. It proposes a Pseudo Label Refinery to improve pseudo-label quality for domain adaptation. Compared to directly using pseudo labels, the refinement reduces noise impact. It achieves significant accuracy gains on multiple cross-dataset benchmarks, outperforming existing domain adaptation methods.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 跨数据集域适应对3D检测落地至关重要，伪标签精炼思路有效，值得关注。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼方法用于跨数据集3D检测的无监督域适应。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 通过精炼伪标签质量降低噪声对域适应的影响。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在多个跨数据集基准上检测精度显著提升，优于现有方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对全稀疏3D目标检测中稀疏卷积在远距离或空旷区域特征不足、导致检测性能下降的问题，本文提出SAFDNet。方法上通过设计简单有效的稀疏特征增强模块，在不引入密集计算的前提下提升稀疏体素特征的表达能力，并保持全稀疏架构的高效性。相比已有全稀疏检测器，SAFDNet在保持低计算量的同时显著提升了检测精度。在nuScenes等基准上取得了优于现有全稀疏方法的性能，同时维持了较高的推理效率。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the degraded detection performance of fully sparse 3D object detectors caused by insufficient features in distant or empty regions. It proposes SAFDNet, a simple yet effective network that enhances sparse voxel features without introducing dense computation, preserving the efficiency of the fully sparse architecture. Compared with existing fully sparse detectors, SAFDNet achieves higher accuracy on benchmarks such as nuScenes while maintaining low computational cost.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该工作针对全稀疏3D检测的核心痛点提出简洁有效的解决方案，兼顾精度与效率，对自动驾驶实时感知有实用价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出了一种简单有效的全稀疏3D目标检测网络SAFDNet，在不牺牲效率的前提下提升稀疏特征表达。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 通过轻量级稀疏特征增强模块解决全稀疏检测中远距离特征不足的问题。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得优于现有全稀疏方法的检测精度，同时保持高推理效率。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: 针对轻量化3D目标检测模型在压缩后精度下降的问题，本文提出CaKDP框架，将类别感知的知识蒸馏与网络剪枝相结合。方法上根据类别分布自适应地分配蒸馏权重，并联合剪枝策略去除冗余参数，从而在压缩模型的同时保留关键类别检测能力。相比传统统一蒸馏或单独剪枝方法，CaKDP在类别不均衡场景下表现更优。实验表明该框架在显著减少模型参数和计算量的同时，保持了较高的3D检测精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper tackles the accuracy degradation of lightweight 3D object detectors after compression by proposing CaKDP, a category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning framework. It adaptively assigns distillation weights based on class distribution and jointly applies pruning to remove redundant parameters, preserving detection capability for critical categories. Compared with uniform distillation or standalone pruning, CaKDP performs better under class imbalance, achieving substantial parameter and computation reduction while maintaining high 3D detection accuracy.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别感知引入蒸馏与剪枝联合框架，对边缘部署的3D检测模型压缩有参考意义。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出了类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP，用于轻量化3D目标检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 根据类别分布自适应分配蒸馏权重，并与剪枝策略联合优化。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在显著减少参数和计算量的同时保持了较高的3D检测精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: 针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签质量不高、分类与回归任务耦合导致误差累积的问题，本文提出解耦伪标签方法。方法上将分类与回归的伪标签生成过程解耦，分别设计置信度评估与筛选策略，减少错误伪标签对训练的干扰。相比已有半监督方法，该解耦策略有效缓解了任务耦合带来的偏差。在KITTI等基准上，该方法在少量标注条件下取得了接近全监督方法的检测性能。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the low quality of pseudo-labels and error accumulation caused by coupled classification and regression in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection. It proposes a decoupled pseudo-labeling method that separates the generation of classification and regression pseudo-labels with dedicated confidence estimation and filtering strategies. Compared with existing semi-supervised methods, it mitigates task-coupling bias and achieves detection performance close to fully supervised methods on KITTI with limited annotations.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 解耦伪标签思路清晰，针对半监督单目3D检测的关键瓶颈，实验验证充分，对降低标注成本有实际意义。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出了解耦伪标签的半监督单目3D目标检测方法。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将分类与回归伪标签生成解耦，分别设计置信度评估与筛选策略。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI等基准上以少量标注取得接近全监督的检测性能。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、点云稀疏导致监督信号不足的问题，本文提出Prompt3D。方法上引入随机提示（random prompt）辅助弱监督训练，通过提示机制增强模型对稀疏点云中目标结构的感知，从而在仅有弱标注（如仅中心点或框尺寸）条件下提升检测能力。相比已有弱监督方法，Prompt3D在减少标注需求的同时缩小了与全监督方法的性能差距。实验表明该方法在多个3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的弱监督检测结果。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost and insufficient supervision in weakly-supervised 3D object detection caused by sparse point clouds. It proposes Prompt3D, which introduces random prompts to assist weakly-supervised training and enhance the model's perception of object structures in sparse point clouds under weak labels. Compared with existing weakly-supervised methods, Prompt3D reduces annotation requirements while narrowing the gap to fully supervised performance, achieving competitive results on multiple 3D detection benchmarks.

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有雷达-相机融合方法以黑盒网络隐式处理雷达点分布（受目标类别、尺寸、朝向影响）的问题，提出显式利用雷达点分布模型辅助融合的RICCARDO。首先基于单目检测器输出的目标属性预测雷达点分布，再以该分布为核对单目检测邻域内实际雷达点进行匹配生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文与核检测器精炼分数。在nuScenes上取得雷达-相机检测的SOTA性能，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: RICCARDO addresses the black-box treatment of radar hit distributions in existing radar-camera fusion by explicitly modeling radar hit distributions conditioned on object properties from a monocular detector. The predicted distribution serves as a kernel to match measured radar points near monocular detections, producing matching scores that are refined by a fusion stage combining context and the kernel detector. It achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection performance on nuScenes with open-sourced code.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 以显式雷达点分布建模替代黑盒融合的思路具有可解释性和实用价值，在nuScenes上取得SOTA且开源代码，对雷达-相机融合研究者有较高参考意义。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出RICCARDO，显式建模雷达点分布并以此为核进行雷达-相机融合的3D目标检测。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 用条件于目标属性的雷达点分布预测作为匹配核，替代传统黑盒融合方式。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化差的问题，现有域泛化方法仅依赖全局几何特征（笛卡尔坐标），导致模型过度关注绝对位置。本文提出GBlobs，用高斯球编码点云邻域的显式局部结构，无需额外参数且高效。将其集成到现有检测器中，在单源DG基准上大幅超越SOTA：Waymo→KITTI提升21 mAP，KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP，nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，且不损失域内性能；多源DG也分别提升17、12、5 mAP。

It proposes GBlobs, an explicit local structure encoding of point cloud neighborhoods via Gaussian blobs, which is parameter-free and efficient. Integrated into existing detectors, it surpasses state-of-the-art single-source DG by over 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI) without sacrificing in-domain performance, and also improves multi-source DG by 17, 12, and 5 mAP.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的局部结构编码显著提升跨域3D检测性能，方法通用且无需额外参数，对域泛化研究有重要参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs，一种基于高斯球的显式局部点云结构编码，用于提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。

2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of 3D object detection under sparsely-supervised settings. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models to boost feature discrimination. The method includes a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module for accurate prompt generation, a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module for pseudo-supervision, and a Distribution Shape score for selecting high-quality signals. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo show significant improvements under sparse annotations.
