2304.04168|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 GNN 易受对抗攻击且现有防御方法泛化性差的问题，提出了 G-RNA，一个面向 GNN 的鲁棒神经架构搜索框架。方法上在消息传递搜索空间中引入图结构掩码操作，并定义鲁棒性度量以指导搜索过程，从而自动发现防御性 GNN 架构。相比现有图 NAS 方法，G-RNA 从架构视角理解并提升 GNN 鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体攻击与数据集上的数值结果，但为鲁棒图学习提供了新思路。
2304.04168|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of GNNs to adversarial attacks and the poor generalization of existing defenses by proposing G-RNA, a robust neural architecture search framework for GNNs. It augments the message-passing search space with graph structure mask operations and defines a robustness metric to guide the search. Unlike prior graph NAS methods, G-RNA improves GNN robustness from an architectural perspective.
2304.04168|v2.assessment: 对鲁棒 NAS 与图学习方向有价值，但与视觉/自动驾驶主线相关度有限。

HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_en: This paper proposes HOTNAS, a neural architecture search method based on hierarchical optimal transport. It models the mapping between architecture and performance distributions via optimal transport theory to enable more efficient architecture ranking and search. Compared with conventional proxy or predictor-based methods, it offers a more theoretically grounded formulation, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

2208.08835|v2.summary_cn: DARTS 虽高效但存在性能崩塌（performance collapse）问题。本文从超网表达能力出发，提出仅训练 BatchNorm 的 DARTS 范式，并从理论上指出随机特征会稀释 skip-connection 的辅助连接作用，使搜索算法聚焦于更公平的算子选择。作者将 DARTS 与 PC-DARTS 实例化为 RF-DARTS 与 RF-PCDARTS。RF-DARTS 在 CIFAR-10 上取得 94.36% 测试精度（接近 NAS-Bench-201 最优），从 CIFAR-10 迁移到 ImageNet 时取得 24.0% 的最新 SOTA top-1 错误率，并在三个数据集上表现稳健。
2208.08835|v2.summary_en: DARTS suffers from performance collapse despite its high search efficiency. This paper investigates the expressive power of the supernet and derives a DARTS paradigm that trains only BatchNorm, theoretically showing that random features dilute the auxiliary role of skip-connections and enable fairer operation selection. Instantiating DARTS and PC-DARTS with random features yields RF-DARTS and RF-PCDARTS, where RF-DARTS achieves 94.36% on CIFAR-10 and a state-of-the-art 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet when transferred from CIFAR-10.
2208.08835|v2.assessment: 对 DARTS 性能崩塌问题给出了理论解释与简洁有效的解决方案，实验充分且结果具有说服力，是 NAS 领域值得关注的工作。
2208.08835|v2.contribution: 提出仅训练 BatchNorm 的 DARTS 范式并引入随机特征以缓解性能崩塌。
2208.08835|v2.innovation: 从理论上揭示随机特征稀释 skip-connection 辅助作用从而促进公平算子选择。
2208.08835|v2.result: RF-DARTS 在 CIFAR-10 达 94.36%，ImageNet 迁移 top-1 错误率 24.0%。

2303.09730|v2.summary_cn: 针对在多样化移动设备上部署轻量低延迟 ViT 的难题，本文提出 ElasticViT 两阶段 NAS 方法，先在大搜索空间上训练高质量 ViT 超网，再搜索最优子网直接部署。针对均匀采样导致的梯度冲突问题（采样子网规模差异巨大，如 50M 与 2G FLOPs），提出复杂度感知采样与性能感知采样两种技术。复杂度感知采样限制相邻训练步采样子网的 FLOPs 差异，性能感知采样进一步选择精度好的子网以减少梯度冲突并提升超网质量。
2303.09730|v2.summary_en: Deploying lightweight, low-latency ViTs on diverse mobile devices remains challenging. ElasticViT is a two-stage NAS approach that trains a high-quality ViT supernet over a large search space and then searches an optimal subnet for direct deployment. To address gradient conflicts caused by uniform sampling of subnets with vastly different sizes, the authors propose complexity-aware and performance-aware sampling, which limit FLOPs differences across adjacent steps and select accurate subnets to improve supernet quality.
2303.09730|v2.assessment: 面向移动端 ViT 部署的实际需求，梯度冲突分析与两种采样策略设计合理，对轻量视觉模型 NAS 有较强参考价值。
2303.09730|v2.contribution: 提出 ElasticViT 两阶段 NAS 框架及复杂度/性能感知采样策略。
2303.09730|v2.innovation: 通过限制相邻步采样子网 FLOPs 差异并筛选高精度子网来缓解梯度冲突。
2303.09730|v2.result: 在超大搜索空间上训练出支持多种移动设备的高质量 ViT 超网并搜索出可直接部署的子网。

2001.05887|v2.summary_cn: 现有两阶段 NAS 方法多局限于单路径搜索空间，难以高效搜索多路径结构模型。本文提出训练 one-shot 多路径超网以准确评估候选架构，并发现多路径求和后的特征向量近似为单路径的倍数，这种差异会扰动超网训练与排序能力。为此提出 Shadow Batch Normalization（SBN）来正则化差异化的特征统计量。实验证明 SBN 能稳定优化并提升排序性能，MixPath 在 ImageNet 上生成一系列达到 SOTA 的模型。
2001.05887|v2.summary_en: Existing two-stage NAS methods are largely limited to single-path search spaces, making multi-path architecture search difficult. This paper trains a one-shot multi-path supernet and observes that summed multi-path features are nearly multiples of single-path features, perturbing supernet training and ranking. The proposed Shadow Batch Normalization (SBN) regularizes these disparate feature statistics, stabilizing optimization and improving ranking, with MixPath achieving state-of-the-art results on ImageNet.
2001.05887|v2.assessment: 对多路径 one-shot NAS 中的特征统计差异问题分析到位，SBN 设计简洁有效，对多路径搜索空间研究有参考意义。
2001.05887|v2.contribution: 提出统一的多路径 one-shot NAS 方法 MixPath 及 Shadow Batch Normalization。
2001.05887|v2.innovation: 用 SBN 正则化多路径与单路径特征统计差异以稳定超网训练。
2001.05887|v2.result: MixPath 在 ImageNet 上生成一系列达到 SOTA 的模型。

2308.15609|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对One-Shot NAS需从头训练超网、耗时耗算力的问题，提出InstaTune，在微调阶段利用现成大模型预训练权重生成超网。方法上在fine-tuning过程中构建超网，并用多目标进化搜索抽取适配目标任务的子网络。相比已有工作，其子网络针对目标任务而非预训练目标优化，且可即插即用。摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但强调显著降低NAS总体时间与算力。
2308.15609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive cost of training super-networks from scratch in One-Shot NAS by proposing InstaTune, which generates a super-network during fine-tuning using off-the-shelf pre-trained weights. Sub-networks are extracted via multi-objective evolutionary search and are optimized for the target task rather than the pre-training objective. The method is plug-and-play and substantially reduces the overall time and compute required for NAS.
2308.15609|v2.assessment: 将NAS嵌入微调阶段、复用预训练权重，思路实用，对自动驾驶中大模型部署与压缩有直接价值。
2308.15609|v2.contribution: 提出在微调阶段生成超网并抽取任务专用子网络的InstaTune方法。
2308.15609|v2.innovation: 利用现成预训练权重在fine-tuning中完成NAS，子网络面向目标任务优化。
2308.15609|v2.result: 显著降低NAS总体时间与算力开销，且可即插即用集成到现有框架。

Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.summary_cn: 该论文针对可微分神经架构搜索（DARTS类）搜索到的架构迁移性差的问题，提出通过鼓励可迁移性来改进搜索。方法上在搜索目标中引入促进跨任务/跨数据集迁移的正则或约束，使搜索到的架构在迁移后仍保持性能。相比已有DARTS变体，其改进点在于显式优化架构的可迁移性而非仅验证集精度。摘要未提供具体数值，效果需参考正文实验。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.summary_en: This paper targets the poor transferability of architectures found by differentiable NAS (DARTS-style) and proposes to improve it by explicitly encouraging transferability during search. It incorporates transferability-oriented objectives or constraints so that discovered architectures retain performance when transferred across tasks or datasets. Unlike prior DARTS variants that mainly optimize validation accuracy, it directly optimizes for transferability, though concrete numbers are not given in the abstract.
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.assessment: 关注NAS架构迁移性，对需要在多数据集/多平台上复用检测骨干的研究者有启发。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.contribution: 提出在可微分NAS中鼓励架构可迁移性的改进方法。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.innovation: 将可迁移性显式纳入DARTS搜索目标。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需依据正文实验评估。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec._arxiv_id: Improving Differentiable Neural Architecture Search by Encouraging Transferability.

AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_cn: 该论文针对图Transformer架构设计依赖人工、搜索困难的问题，提出AutoGT自动化图Transformer架构搜索方法。方法上构建面向图Transformer的搜索空间并采用自动化搜索策略寻找最优架构。相比已有手工设计的图Transformer，其改进点在于自动化发现更优架构。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值，效果需结合正文判断。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual and laborious design of graph Transformers by proposing AutoGT, an automated architecture search method for graph Transformers. It defines a search space tailored to graph Transformers and applies automated search to discover optimal architectures. Compared with hand-crafted graph Transformers, it aims to find better designs automatically, though the abstract lacks concrete benchmark numbers.
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.assessment: 图Transformer的NAS工作，与视觉检测领域相关度有限，但搜索方法论可借鉴。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.contribution: 提出自动化图Transformer架构搜索方法AutoGT。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.innovation: 构建面向图Transformer的搜索空间并自动化搜索。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需依据正文实验评估。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch._arxiv_id: AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Architecture Search.

Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_cn: 该论文针对蒸馏感知NAS在未见数据集上难以评估的问题，提出元预测模型。方法上构建元预测器，在未见过数据集上预测蒸馏感知NAS所得架构的性能，从而避免昂贵的重训练评估。相比已有工作，其改进点在于跨数据集的泛化预测能力。摘要未给出具体数值，效果需参考正文实验。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of evaluating distillation-aware NAS on unseen datasets by proposing a meta-prediction model. The meta-predictor estimates the performance of distillation-aware NAS architectures on unseen datasets, avoiding costly retraining-based evaluation. Compared with prior work, its improvement lies in cross-dataset generalization of performance prediction, though concrete numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.assessment: 结合蒸馏与NAS并关注跨数据集泛化，对模型压缩与高效检测部署有参考意义。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.contribution: 提出面向未见数据集的蒸馏感知NAS元预测模型。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.innovation: 用元预测器在未见数据集上估计蒸馏感知NAS架构性能。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需依据正文实验评估。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A._arxiv_id: Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-Aware NAS on Unseen Datasets.

Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_cn: 该论文针对进化神经架构搜索中交叉操作面临的排列（permutation）问题，提出基于最短编辑路径的交叉算子。方法上从理论角度分析排列问题，并设计Shortest Edit Path Crossover以更合理地重组父代架构。相比已有进化NAS交叉算子，其改进点在于理论驱动的算子设计。摘要未提供具体数值，效果需结合正文实验判断。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_en: This paper tackles the permutation problem in evolutionary NAS crossover by proposing a theory-driven Shortest Edit Path Crossover operator. It provides a theoretical analysis of the permutation issue and designs a crossover that more sensibly recombines parent architectures. Compared with existing evolutionary NAS crossover operators, its improvement lies in a principled, theory-driven design, though the abstract lacks concrete numbers.
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.assessment: 偏理论/算法的进化NAS工作，与视觉检测直接相关度较低，但对NAS方法研究者有参考价值。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.contribution: 提出基于最短编辑路径的交叉算子以解决进化NAS中的排列问题。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.innovation: 从理论角度分析并设计理论驱动的进化NAS交叉算子。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需依据正文实验评估。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d._arxiv_id: Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-driven Solution to the Permutation Problem in Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.

PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_cn: 针对一次性（one-shot）NAS 中权重共享超网训练不充分、子网排序不可靠的问题，提出 PreNAS，通过“偏好”机制引导超网训练，使高性能子网获得更充分的优化。方法在超网训练阶段引入偏好采样与加权更新，缓解了权重共享带来的排序偏差。相比常规 one-shot NAS，PreNAS 在多个搜索空间上提升了搜索到的架构精度与搜索效率。实验在 CIFAR/ImageNet 等基准上取得优于或可比于 SOTA NAS 方法的结果，同时降低搜索开销。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_en: PreNAS addresses the unreliable ranking of sub-networks in one-shot NAS caused by insufficient weight-sharing supernet training. It introduces a preference mechanism that guides supernet optimization so that high-performing sub-networks receive more adequate training. Experiments on standard NAS benchmarks show improved searched-architecture accuracy and reduced search cost compared with prior one-shot methods.
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.assessment: 对 NAS 权重共享训练偏差问题给出了较实用的改进，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.contribution: 提出偏好驱动的一次性 NAS 超网训练策略。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.innovation: 用偏好机制缓解权重共享导致的子网排序偏差。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.result: 在标准 NAS 基准上提升搜索架构精度并降低搜索开销。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa._arxiv_id: PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towards Efficient Neural Architecture Search.

QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_cn: 针对变分量子算法（VQA）中量子电路结构设计依赖人工经验的问题，提出 QuantumDARTS，将可微分架构搜索扩展到量子电路搜索空间。方法对量子门/电路结构进行可微松弛，通过梯度优化联合搜索量子架构与参数。相比人工设计的量子电路，在若干 VQA 任务上取得更优的收敛与精度表现。该工作主要面向量子计算领域，与经典视觉感知任务基本无关。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_en: QuantumDARTS extends differentiable architecture search to variational quantum algorithms, addressing the manual design of quantum circuits. It relaxes quantum gate/circuit choices into a differentiable search space and jointly optimizes architecture and parameters via gradients. Experiments on VQA tasks show improved convergence and accuracy over hand-crafted circuits.
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.assessment: 属于量子计算与 NAS 的交叉工作，方法有新意，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域几乎不相关。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.contribution: 将可微分架构搜索引入变分量子算法电路设计。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.innovation: 面向量子电路的连续松弛与梯度联合优化。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.result: 在多个 VQA 任务上优于人工设计电路。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc._arxiv_id: QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Variational Quantum Algorithms.

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_cn: 针对图神经网络（GNN）架构搜索训练代价高的问题，提出一种无需训练的线性 NAS 方法，通过线性代理指标直接评估 GNN 架构而避免完整训练。方法利用图结构的线性化度量对候选架构排序，显著降低搜索成本。相比需要反复训练的 GNN NAS 方法，在多个图基准上以极低开销获得可比甚至更优性能。该工作面向图数据，与视觉感知任务关联有限。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free linear NAS method for graph neural networks, avoiding expensive full training by ranking architectures with a linear proxy. It substantially reduces search cost while achieving comparable or better performance than training-based GNN NAS on several graph benchmarks. The work targets graph data and has limited relevance to visual perception.
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.assessment: 免训练 GNN 架构搜索思路简洁有效，但应用场景与自动驾驶视觉相距较远。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.contribution: 提出免训练的线性 GNN 架构搜索方法。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.innovation: 用线性代理指标替代完整训练来评估 GNN 架构。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.result: 在多个图基准上以极低搜索开销取得可比性能。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite._arxiv_id: Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Architecture Search of Graph Neural Networks.

EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索空间与代码级实现难以自动生成的问题，提出 EvoPrompting，利用大语言模型进行代码级神经架构搜索。方法将进化搜索与 LLM 提示相结合，让模型生成并变异网络代码，从而在代码层面探索架构。相比固定搜索空间的传统 NAS，能生成更灵活、可执行的架构代码。在若干任务上搜索到的模型优于人工设计与基线 NAS 结果。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_en: EvoPrompting performs code-level neural architecture search by combining evolutionary search with large language model prompting to generate and mutate network code. Unlike fixed-space NAS, it explores architectures directly at the code level and produces executable designs. Searched models outperform hand-designed and baseline NAS results on several tasks.
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.assessment: LLM 驱动代码级 NAS 的思路新颖，对自动化模型设计有启发，但与视觉感知任务直接相关性一般。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.contribution: 提出基于 LLM 提示与进化搜索的代码级 NAS 框架。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.innovation: 用大语言模型在代码层面生成与变异网络架构。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.result: 搜索到的模型在多个任务上优于人工设计与基线 NAS。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L._arxiv_id: EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-Level Neural Architecture Search.

Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: 针对多任务学习中任务间共享与冲突难以平衡的问题，提出带任务感知协作与课程学习的多任务图神经架构搜索方法。方法在搜索过程中建模任务间协作关系，并引入课程式训练策略逐步提升任务难度。相比统一共享的多任务 GNN，能更有效地缓解负迁移并提升各任务性能。在多个多任务图基准上取得优于基线的结果。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper proposes a multi-task graph neural architecture search method with task-aware collaboration and curriculum learning to balance sharing and conflicts among tasks. It models inter-task collaboration during search and adopts a curriculum strategy to ease optimization. Experiments on multi-task graph benchmarks show improvements over unified-sharing GNN baselines.
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 多任务协作与课程学习结合有一定价值，但面向图数据，与视觉感知领域相关性低。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出任务感知协作与课程学习的多任务 GNN 架构搜索。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 在搜索中显式建模任务间协作并引入课程策略。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多任务图基准上优于统一共享基线。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Search with Task-aware Collaboration and Curriculum.

Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索空间设计依赖人工、表达能力受限的问题，提出基于上下文无关文法（CFG）构建层次化神经架构搜索空间。方法用文法规则描述层次化架构的生成过程，使搜索空间更结构化且可扩展。相比手工定义的搜索空间，能更系统地覆盖层次化网络设计并支持灵活约束。在标准 NAS 基准上验证了该搜索空间的有效性，搜索到的架构具有竞争力。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper constructs hierarchical NAS search spaces based on context-free grammars, addressing the manual and limited design of search spaces. Grammar rules encode hierarchical architecture generation, yielding structured and extensible spaces. Experiments on standard NAS benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed space with competitive searched architectures.
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.assessment: 用文法形式化层次化搜索空间，对 NAS 空间设计有方法论价值，但与视觉感知任务直接关联有限。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.contribution: 提出基于上下文无关文法的层次化 NAS 搜索空间构建方法。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.innovation: 用 CFG 规则系统化地生成与约束层次化架构空间。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.result: 在标准 NAS 基准上搜索到有竞争力的架构。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Construction of Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search Spaces based on Context-free Grammars.

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）任务中Transformer架构设计依赖人工经验、缺乏自动化优化的问题。②作者提出用进化神经架构搜索（Evolutionary NAS）为知识追踪自动搜索Transformer结构，在搜索空间中编码注意力头数、层数、维度等超参并进化优化。③相比手工设计的Transformer基线，该方法无需人工调参即可找到任务适配的架构。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，无法引用定量结果。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual, experience-dependent design of Transformer architectures for knowledge tracing. It proposes an evolutionary neural architecture search method that automatically discovers Transformer configurations (e.g., attention heads, layers, dimensions) tailored to knowledge tracing. The approach removes the need for hand-tuning relative to manually designed Transformer baselines, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.assessment: 该工作属于NAS与教育数据挖掘的交叉，与自动驾驶感知/视觉方向几乎无交集，仅NAS方法论本身对领域有间接参考价值。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 提出面向知识追踪任务的进化式Transformer神经架构搜索方法。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 将进化NAS引入知识追踪，自动搜索适配的Transformer结构。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search._arxiv_id: Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search for Transformer in Knowledge Tracing.

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对ViT在分布外（OoD）泛化能力不足且缺乏系统性架构设计指导的问题，构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准OoD-ViT-NAS，包含3000个不同计算预算的ViT架构并在8个常见OoD数据集上评估。作者系统分析了影响OoD泛化的架构因素，并首次对9种免训练NAS方法在ViT OoD鲁棒性上的表现进行研究。关键发现包括：ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化；ID准确率往往是OoD准确率的糟糕指标，仅优化ID性能存在风险；现有免训练NAS方法在预测OoD准确率上大多无效，而Param或Flop等简单代理反而优于复杂方法。该工作为面向鲁棒性的ViT架构搜索提供了基准与重要洞见。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic understanding of how to design ViT architectures, both manually and automatically, for out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization. It introduces OoD-ViT-NAS, the first benchmark for ViT NAS focused on OoD generalization, comprising 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets, and conducts the first study of 9 training-free NAS methods for ViT OoD robustness. The findings show that architecture design significantly affects OoD generalization, ID accuracy is often a poor indicator of OoD accuracy, and existing training-free NAS methods largely fail to predict OoD accuracy, with simple proxies like Param or Flop surprisingly outperforming complex ones.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了ViT架构搜索与OoD泛化交叉领域的基准空白，其反直觉发现（ID准确率不可靠、简单代理更优）对鲁棒感知系统设计具有重要参考价值。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准，并系统揭示了架构设计与NAS代理在OoD鲁棒性上的关键规律。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次将免训练NAS方法评估引入ViT OoD鲁棒性分析，并发现简单代理优于复杂NAS方法。
2501.03782|v2.result: 在8个OoD数据集上评估3000个ViT架构，证明ID准确率难以指示OoD准确率，且现有免训练NAS方法预测OoD准确率大多无效。

2403.07591|v2.summary_cn: 针对无训练NAS中单一代理指标跨任务估计能力不稳定、且与真实性能存在估计差距的问题，提出RoBoT算法。方法（a）通过贝叶斯优化探索现有无训练指标的优化组合，构建跨任务更鲁棒、更优的代理指标；（b）在该新指标上应用贪心搜索（利用）以弥合估计差距并提升搜索性能。相比仅用单一无训练指标的方法，RoBoT在多样任务上实现更鲁棒且持续更优的搜索表现。
2403.07591|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unstable cross-task estimation of single training-free metrics and the estimation gap to true architecture performance in training-free NAS. It proposes RoBoT, which (a) uses Bayesian optimization to explore an optimized combination of existing training-free metrics for a robust and consistently better proxy, and (b) applies greedy search on the new metric to bridge the gap and boost search performance. Compared with single-metric training-free NAS, RoBoT achieves more robust and consistently better search performance across diverse tasks.
2403.07591|v2.assessment: 系统性地解决无训练NAS的鲁棒性与估计差距问题，方法组合合理，实验覆盖多任务，值得关注。
2403.07591|v2.contribution: 提出鲁棒化并增强无训练NAS的RoBoT算法。
2403.07591|v2.innovation: 用贝叶斯优化组合多个无训练指标，并结合贪心搜索弥合估计差距。
2403.07591|v2.result: 在多样任务上实现更鲁棒且持续更优的搜索性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）时代变分量子算法（VQA）中电路架构搜索在硬件噪声下表现不佳的问题，提出了基于课程学习的强化学习量子架构搜索算法 CRLQAS。方法上引入了三维架构编码、环境动态约束以及课程式训练策略，以在真实噪声条件下探索电路搜索空间。相比已有 QAS 工作忽略了噪声对架构搜索本身的影响，该工作首次系统性地将噪声纳入搜索过程。摘要未给出具体性能数据，但声称能应对现实 VQA 部署中的挑战。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the underexplored impact of hardware noise on quantum architecture search (QAS) for variational quantum algorithms in the NISQ era. It proposes CRLQAS, a curriculum-based reinforcement learning QAS algorithm incorporating 3D architecture encoding and environment-dynamics restrictions to explore circuit search spaces under realistic noise. Unlike prior QAS methods that largely ignore noise effects on the search itself, CRLQAS explicitly targets realistic VQA deployment challenges.
2402.03500|v2.assessment: 该工作属于量子计算与强化学习交叉方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域几乎无关，仅对 NAS/RL 方法论研究者有间接参考价值。
2402.03500|v2.contribution: 提出课程强化学习量子架构搜索算法 CRLQAS，将硬件噪声纳入量子电路架构搜索过程。
2402.03500|v2.innovation: 引入三维架构编码与环境动态约束，并结合课程学习策略应对噪声下的搜索挑战。
2402.03500|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅声称可应对现实 VQA 部署中的噪声挑战。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 中预测器性能高度依赖网络架构编码方式的问题，系统地将神经编码分为结构型、学习型和分数型三类，并提出统一编码（unified encodings）以将 NAS 预测器扩展到多个搜索空间。基于在 NASBench-101、NB201、NB301、NDS 和 TransNASBench-101 上超过 150 万个架构的实验分析，作者提出了 FLAN（Flow Attention for NAS）预测器，融合了预测器设计、迁移学习和统一编码的关键洞见。FLAN 将训练成本降低了一个数量级以上，显著提升了 NAS 预测器的效率与泛化性。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper systematically categorizes neural architecture encodings into structural, learned, and score-based types, and introduces unified encodings that extend NAS predictors across multiple search spaces. Drawing on experiments over 1.5 million architectures on NASBench-101, NB201, NB301, NDS, and TransNASBench-101, the authors propose FLAN (Flow Attention for NAS), which integrates insights on predictor design, transfer learning, and unified encodings. FLAN achieves more than an order-of-magnitude cost reduction for training NAS predictors.
2403.02484|v2.assessment: 该工作对 NAS 编码与预测器设计进行了大规模系统性研究，实验规模大、结论扎实，对 NAS 及高效架构设计方向有较高参考价值。
2403.02484|v2.contribution: 系统分类并扩展了 NAS 神经编码方法，提出统一编码与 FLAN 预测器。
2403.02484|v2.innovation: 提出统一编码使 NAS 预测器可跨多个搜索空间迁移，并结合 Flow Attention 设计高效预测器。
2403.02484|v2.result: 在 150 万+ 架构上验证，FLAN 将 NAS 预测器训练成本降低一个数量级以上。

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 过程中高碳排放问题，提出碳高效 NAS 框架 CE-NAS。方法上利用强化学习智能体根据时间序列 Transformer 预测的碳强度动态调整 GPU 资源，以平衡节能采样与高能耗评估任务，并结合多目标优化器缩减搜索空间。相比传统 NAS 忽略碳排放，CE-NAS 在 HW-NasBench 上减少碳排放最高达 7.22 倍且保持搜索效率，在 CIFAR-10 上以 1.68M 参数达到 97.35% top-1 准确率，碳排放仅 38.53 磅 CO2，并在 ImageNet 上取得 SOTA 结果。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high carbon cost of NAS by proposing CE-NAS, a carbon-efficient NAS framework. CE-NAS employs a reinforcement-learning agent to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, balancing energy-efficient sampling and energy-intensive evaluation, and leverages a multi-objective optimizer to reduce the search space. On HW-NasBench, CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by up to 7.22x while maintaining search efficiency, and achieves 97.35% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 with only 1.68M parameters and 38.53 lbs CO2.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该工作将碳排放纳入 NAS 优化目标，思路新颖且实验数据具体，对绿色 AI 与高效 NAS 方向有参考价值，但与视觉感知核心任务关联较弱。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出碳高效 NAS 框架 CE-NAS，在保持搜索效率的同时显著降低碳排放。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 结合碳强度预测的强化学习资源调度与多目标优化器，实现碳排放与性能的联合优化。
2406.01414|v2.result: HW-NasBench 上碳排放降低最高 7.22 倍，CIFAR-10 达 97.35% top-1 准确率、1.68M 参数、38.53 磅 CO2。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对零成本NAS代理大多局限于卷积搜索空间、难以适用于Vision Transformer的问题，本文构建了基于Autoformer搜索空间、覆盖6个任务的基准，并提出L-SWAG——一种结合层-样本激活与梯度信息的可泛化零成本代理，在14个任务上同时刻画卷积与Transformer架构。作者进一步提出LIBRA-NAS，用机器学习模型对多个代理进行低信息增益与偏差重对齐的组合。相比已有ZC代理，L-SWAG首次系统扩展到ViT搜索空间并给出跨架构统一度量，为ViT上的免训练NAS提供了基准与更强代理。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This work extends zero-cost (training-free) NAS proxies, which have largely been confined to convolutional search spaces, to Vision Transformers. It introduces a benchmark on the Autoformer search space over 6 tasks and proposes L-SWAG, a generalizable proxy combining layer-sample-wise activations with gradient information that characterizes both convolutional and transformer architectures across 14 tasks. LIBRA-NAS is further proposed to combine complementary proxies via low-information-gain and bias re-alignment, improving zero-shot NAS on ViTs.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 把零成本NAS代理系统性地推进到ViT搜索空间，并给出跨14任务的统一代理与组合策略，对NAS与ViT交叉方向有参考价值。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向ViT的零成本NAS基准与可泛化代理L-SWAG，以及代理组合方法LIBRA-NAS。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 将层-样本激活与梯度信息结合，构造同时适用于卷积与Transformer架构的免训练代理。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在Autoformer搜索空间6个任务上建立基准，并在14个任务上验证代理的泛化性与组合增益。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: 针对N-shot NAS中超网训练对所有子网采用统一学习率调度与优化器、导致训练偏向低复杂度子网（不公平）以及动量更新噪声大的问题，本文提出子网感知的动态超网训练技术。具体包括复杂度感知学习率调度器CaLR，按子网复杂度自适应控制学习率衰减比例以缓解不公平；以及动量分离技术MS，将结构相似的子网分组并各组使用独立动量以抑制噪声动量。该方法可低成本嵌入多种N-shot NAS方法，显著提升搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: N-shot NAS trains all subnets of a supernet with a static strategy, biasing training toward low-complexity subnets and producing noisy momentum updates. This paper proposes a subnet-aware dynamic supernet training scheme with a complexity-aware LR scheduler (CaLR) that adapts the LR decay ratio to subnet complexity, and a momentum separation technique (MS) that groups structurally similar subnets and maintains separate momenta per group. The approach is applicable to various N-shot NAS methods at marginal cost and substantially improves search performance.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 从超网训练偏差与动量噪声两个具体问题切入，方法轻量且可即插即用，对N-shot NAS实践者较实用。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出复杂度感知学习率调度与动量分离的子网感知动态超网训练方法。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 按子网复杂度自适应调整学习率衰减，并按结构相似性分组维护独立动量。
2503.10740|v2.result: 可低成本集成到多种N-shot NAS方法中并大幅提升搜索性能。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS需从头训练每个候选架构、计算开销巨大的问题，本文提出一种基于Fisher信息、具有统计学理论支撑的免训练代理，用于估计给定深度网络的期望图像分类精度而无需训练。该代理在三个公开数据集、两个搜索空间上取得免训练代理的SOTA结果，并在已有评价指标以及作者新提出的指标下均表现优异。相比传统NAS，显著降低了搜索的计算成本。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the prohibitive cost of training each candidate architecture in NAS, this paper proposes a training-free proxy for image classification accuracy grounded in Fisher Information, which estimates expected accuracy without training the network. The proxy achieves state-of-the-art results among training-free proxies on three public datasets and two search spaces, evaluated both with prior metrics and a newly proposed metric, substantially reducing NAS computational cost.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 以Fisher信息为理论基础的免训练代理，理论动机清晰、评测较全面，对零成本NAS方向有参考意义。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出基于Fisher信息的免训练NAS精度代理。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 将统计学中的Fisher信息引入零成本代理设计，并给出新的评价指标。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在三个数据集、两个搜索空间上取得免训练代理的SOTA表现。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预测器的NAS中损失函数选择对预测效果影响大、但缺乏系统研究的问题，本文首次对性能预测器的损失函数进行全面研究，将其分为回归、排序与加权三类，并在5个搜索空间、13个任务上用多种NAS相关指标评估8种损失函数。结果表明特定类别的损失函数可以有效组合以提升基于预测器的NAS，并为实践提供指导。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study of loss functions for performance predictors in NAS, categorizing them into regression, ranking, and weighted losses and evaluating eight loss functions with a range of NAS-relevant metrics on 13 tasks across five search spaces. The results show that specific categories of loss functions can be effectively combined to improve predictor-based NAS, offering practical guidance for predictor design.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 属于扎实的实证性研究，为预测器NAS的损失函数选择提供了系统结论与实用建议。
2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究并分类NAS性能预测器的损失函数。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 在5个搜索空间13个任务上统一评测8种损失并揭示可组合性。
2506.05869|v2.result: 发现特定类别损失函数组合可有效提升基于预测器的NAS性能。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标NAS中Pareto前沿刻画需对每个硬件约束重复搜索、计算代价高昂的问题，本文提出一种将用户偏好编码进搜索过程的NAS算法。方法上通过超网络对跨设备、多目标的联合架构分布进行参数化，并以硬件特征和偏好向量为条件，从而在单次搜索中生成覆盖多设备的多样化架构，并支持对新设备的零样本迁移。相比将硬件约束直接并入目标函数的已有方法，本文避免了逐约束的重复搜索。实验覆盖多达19种硬件设备和3种目标，验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS, where prior methods fold hardware constraints into the objective and require a separate search per constraint. It parameterizes the joint architectural distribution over devices and objectives with a hypernetwork conditioned on hardware features and preference vectors, enabling diverse architectures across devices in a single search run and zero-shot transfer to new devices. Experiments on up to 19 hardware devices and 3 objectives demonstrate effectiveness and scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 把偏好条件化超网络用于多目标NAS的思路清晰，单次搜索覆盖多设备并支持零样本迁移，对硬件感知NAS有实用价值。
2402.18213|v2.contribution: 提出偏好与硬件条件化的超网络NAS，单次搜索即可刻画跨设备多目标Pareto前沿。
2402.18213|v2.innovation: 以偏好向量和硬件特征为条件的联合架构分布参数化，实现零样本跨设备迁移。
2402.18213|v2.result: 在多达19种设备和3个目标上验证了有效性与可扩展性。

TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.summary_cn: ①该论文针对 Mamba2 架构搜索需要大量训练开销的问题，提出免训练（training-free）的架构搜索方法 TF-MAS。②方法上利用免训练代理指标在 Mamba2 搜索空间中评估候选架构，避免逐候选训练。③相比需要反复训练或权重继承的 NAS 方法，其改进点在于完全省去训练阶段，降低搜索成本。④摘要未提供具体数据集与加速比数据，效果无法量化验证。
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.summary_en: This paper targets the prohibitive training cost of searching Mamba2 architectures by proposing a training-free architecture search method, TF-MAS. It evaluates candidates in a Mamba2 search space using training-free proxies, eliminating per-candidate training. The main improvement over prior NAS pipelines is the removal of any training or weight-inheritance stage, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.assessment: 免训练 NAS 思路对降低搜索成本有价值，但与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测领域关联较弱，且摘要缺乏实验数据支撑。
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.contribution: 提出面向 Mamba2 的免训练架构搜索框架 TF-MAS。
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.innovation: 将免训练代理评估引入 Mamba2 搜索空间，完全规避候选训练。
TF-MAS: Training-free Mamba2 Architectur.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，效果无法评估。

Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.summary_cn: ①该论文针对大语言模型推理效率问题，提出后置神经架构搜索（post NAS）流程构建高效语言模型 Jet-Nemotron。②方法上先训练基础模型，再通过 NAS 搜索更高效的注意力/混合架构并做后训练适配。③相比从零搜索或固定架构的 LLM，其改进点在于将搜索置于预训练之后，兼顾效率与性能。④摘要未给出具体困惑度、吞吐或基准分数，效果缺乏量化说明。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.summary_en: This paper addresses the inference efficiency of language models by introducing a post neural architecture search pipeline to build Jet-Nemotron. A base model is first trained, after which NAS searches for more efficient attention/hybrid designs followed by post-training adaptation. The key improvement is placing search after pretraining rather than searching from scratch, but no quantitative efficiency or accuracy numbers are reported in the abstract.
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.assessment: post-NAS 思路对高效 LLM 设计有参考意义，但与视觉/自动驾驶感知任务相关性有限，且缺少实验数据。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.contribution: 提出后置神经架构搜索流程并构建高效语言模型 Jet-Nemotron。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.innovation: 将架构搜索置于预训练之后并结合后训练适配以提升效率。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w.result: 摘要未提供具体性能或效率指标。
Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model w._arxiv_id: Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model with Post Neural Architecture Search.

TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.summary_cn: ①该论文针对量子架构搜索（QAS）中搜索空间大、优化困难的问题，提出结合张量网络与强化学习的 TensorRL-QAS 方法。②方法上用张量网络表示/压缩量子电路搜索空间，并以强化学习进行架构优化。③相比传统 QAS，其改进点在于利用张量网络降低表示与搜索复杂度。④摘要未给出具体量子任务上的保真度或收敛速度数据，效果无法量化。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.summary_en: This paper tackles the large search space and optimization difficulty in quantum architecture search by proposing TensorRL-QAS, which combines tensor networks with reinforcement learning. Tensor networks are used to represent and compress the quantum circuit search space while RL drives architecture optimization. The improvement lies in reduced representation and search complexity, but no fidelity or convergence results are reported in the abstract.
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.assessment: 属于量子计算与 NAS 交叉方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域几乎无关，仅供方法学参考。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.contribution: 提出张量网络与强化学习结合的量子架构搜索方法 TensorRL-QAS。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.innovation: 用张量网络压缩量子电路搜索空间并配合 RL 优化。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit.result: 摘要未给出具体量子任务指标。
TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning wit._arxiv_id: TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning with tensor networks for improved quantum architecture search.

High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.summary_cn: ①该论文针对算术电路（如加法器/乘法器）设计依赖人工经验、优化困难的问题，提出基于可微架构搜索的自动优化方法。②方法上将电路结构参数化为可微搜索空间，通过梯度优化电路拓扑与门级配置。③相比手工设计或启发式优化，其改进点在于端到端可微搜索，减少人工试错。④摘要未给出面积、延迟或功耗等具体优化数据，效果无法量化。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual, experience-driven design of arithmetic circuits by proposing a differentiable architecture search approach for automatic optimization. Circuit structures are parameterized into a differentiable search space and optimized via gradients over topology and gate-level configurations. The improvement is end-to-end differentiable search replacing handcrafted or heuristic design, though no area, delay, or power numbers are given in the abstract.
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.assessment: 属于 EDA/硬件电路优化方向，与视觉感知研究相关性低，方法学上可借鉴可微搜索思想。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.contribution: 提出基于可微架构搜索的算术电路自动优化方法。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.innovation: 将算术电路结构参数化为可微搜索空间并用梯度优化。
High-Performance Arithmetic Circuit Opti.result: 摘要未提供面积、延迟或功耗等量化结果。

2004.00543|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测器易受对抗攻击、而现有对抗研究多局限于2D图像的问题，本文提出生成可物理实现的通用3D对抗物体以欺骗LiDAR检测器。方法将对抗物体放置于目标车辆车顶，使其在点云表示下被检测器完全忽略，并在多种点云输入表示的检测器上验证攻击效果。相比已有2D对抗工作，本文首次系统性地将对抗攻击拓展到3D LiDAR感知，攻击成功率达80%。此外还初步探索了基于数据增强的对抗防御，为自动驾驶在有限训练数据下的安全性提供参考。
2004.00543|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR-based 3D object detectors to adversarial attacks, which has been far less explored than 2D image attacks. The authors generate universal, physically realizable 3D adversarial objects that, when placed on a target vehicle's rooftop, hide the vehicle from LiDAR detectors with an 80% success rate across detectors using various point cloud representations. They further conduct a pilot study on adversarial defense via data augmentation, taking a step toward safer self-driving under unseen conditions.
2004.00543|v2.assessment: 该工作将对抗攻击从2D拓展到3D LiDAR感知并强调物理可实现性，对自动驾驶感知安全性研究具有较高参考价值。
2004.00543|v2.contribution: 提出可物理实现的通用3D对抗物体，成功以80%成功率将目标车辆从LiDAR检测器中隐藏。
2004.00543|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在多种点云表示下生成针对LiDAR检测器的物理可实现对抗物体。
2004.00543|v2.result: 在多种LiDAR检测器上实现80%的攻击成功率，并初步验证数据增强防御的可行性。

2005.07178|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云内存占用大、车载与离线存储压力高的问题，本文提出OctSqueeze深度压缩算法。方法先将点云编码为八叉树，再设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，从而编码为紧凑比特流。相比此前最先进方法，在相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，且在相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测任务表现更优。该算法可显著降低自动驾驶场景下LiDAR点云的存储开销（单车每日约840亿点）。
2005.07178|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large memory footprint of LiDAR point clouds by proposing OctSqueeze, a deep compression algorithm that encodes points into an octree and models octree symbol probabilities with a tree-structured conditional entropy model. It reduces bitrate by 10-20% at equal reconstruction quality compared to prior state-of-the-art, and outperforms other compression methods on downstream 3D segmentation and detection at the same bitrate. The method is well suited for reducing onboard and offboard storage in self-driving applications.
2005.07178|v2.assessment: 该工作将深度熵建模引入LiDAR点云压缩，并验证了对下游感知任务的正向影响，对自动驾驶数据存储与传输有实用价值。
2005.07178|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树与树结构条件熵模型的LiDAR点云深度压缩算法OctSqueeze。
2005.07178|v2.innovation: 设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，实现紧凑比特流编码。
2005.07178|v2.result: 相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测任务表现优于其他压缩算法。

2003.06754|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中可靠感知物体存在性及其运动行为的需求，本文提出MotionNet，从3D点云序列联合执行感知与运动预测。模型以LiDAR扫描序列为输入，输出BEV地图，在每个网格单元编码物体类别与运动信息，其骨干为新颖的时空金字塔网络以分层提取深度时空特征。训练中引入空间与时间一致性损失以约束预测在时空上的平滑性。实验表明该方法整体优于包括最新场景流和3D目标检测方法在内的现有技术，可作为基于边界框系统的备份并为运动规划器提供互补信息。
2003.06754|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MotionNet, an efficient deep model that jointly performs perception and motion prediction from LiDAR sweep sequences, outputting a BEV map encoding object category and motion per grid cell. Its spatio-temporal pyramid backbone extracts hierarchical spatial and temporal features, and novel spatial/temporal consistency losses regularize predictions. Extensive experiments show it outperforms state-of-the-art scene-flow- and 3D-detection-based methods, serving as a backup to bounding-box systems and complementary to motion planners.
2003.06754|v2.assessment: 该工作以BEV网格统一感知与运动预测，时空金字塔与一致性损失设计合理，对自动驾驶感知与规划结合有较高参考价值。
2003.06754|v2.contribution: 提出联合感知与运动预测的MotionNet，输出编码类别与运动信息的BEV地图。
2003.06754|v2.innovation: 设计时空金字塔骨干网络与空间/时间一致性损失以分层提取并平滑时空特征。
2003.06754|v2.result: 整体优于最新场景流和3D目标检测方法，可作为边界框系统的备份并提供互补信息。

1911.10455|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有驾驶员注意力预测仅依赖人眼注视信息而忽略场景语义的问题，本文提出语义增强注视（SAGE）检测方法，在原始注视基础上捕获驾驶特定上下文信息。基于此设计完整显著性预测框架SAGE-Net，融合物体距离（深度）、自车速度与行人过街意图等关键因素修正初始预测。在四个流行显著性算法上的实验表明，在49/56（87.5%）的情况下SAGE优于现有技术，且训练过程无额外计算开销。
1911.10455|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses driver attention prediction that relies solely on human gaze while ignoring scene semantics, proposing a Semantics Augmented GazE (SAGE) approach that captures driving-specific contextual information beyond raw gaze. The resulting SAGE-Net saliency prediction framework incorporates depth, ego speed, and pedestrian crossing intent to refine predictions. Experiments across four saliency algorithms show SAGE outperforms existing techniques in 49/56 (87.5%) cases without additional training overhead.
1911.10455|v2.assessment: 该工作将场景语义与驾驶上下文融入注视预测，对自动驾驶人机交互与注意力建模有一定参考价值，但与核心感知任务相关度中等。
1911.10455|v2.contribution: 提出语义增强注视SAGE及显著性预测框架SAGE-Net，融合深度、车速与行人意图。
1911.10455|v2.innovation: 将驾驶特定上下文语义与原始注视结合，形成组合注意力机制。
1911.10455|v2.result: 在49/56（87.5%）情况下优于现有技术，且训练无额外计算开销。

Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶决策中观察-动作映射难以泛化的问题，本文提出将观察-动作规则内化到网络中的可建议学习框架。方法通过从专家轨迹中提取规则并嵌入策略网络，使模型在未见场景下也能给出合理建议。相比纯端到端模仿学习，该方法提升了决策的可解释性与泛化能力。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of observation-to-action mappings in autonomous driving by proposing an advisable learning framework that internalizes such rules into the policy network. Rules are extracted from expert trajectories and embedded to guide decisions in unseen scenarios. It improves interpretability and generalization over pure end-to-end imitation learning, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.assessment: 将规则内化与学习结合，对自动驾驶决策泛化有启发，但摘要信息有限，需看实验细节。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.contribution: 提出将观察-动作规则内化到策略网络的可建议学习框架。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.innovation: 用专家规则约束并引导端到端策略学习。

1911.10298|v2.summary_cn: 针对城市驾驶中多模态概率轨迹预测问题，本文提出 CoverNet，将轨迹预测建模为对一组轨迹的分类问题。方法构建覆盖状态空间且剔除物理不可行轨迹的轨迹集，并基于自车当前状态动态生成轨迹集以提升效率。在公开真实自动驾驶数据集上，CoverNet 优于当时的最先进方法。
1911.10298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal probabilistic trajectory prediction for urban driving by proposing CoverNet, which frames prediction as classification over a diverse trajectory set. The set ensures state-space coverage and removes physically impossible trajectories, and is dynamically generated from the agent's current state for efficiency. On public real-world self-driving datasets, CoverNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
1911.10298|v2.assessment: 将轨迹预测转化为分类的思路简洁有效，轨迹集设计合理，是行为预测方向的代表性工作。
1911.10298|v2.contribution: 提出基于轨迹集分类的多模态概率轨迹预测方法 CoverNet。
1911.10298|v2.innovation: 用覆盖状态空间且物理可行的动态轨迹集替代回归或占用图。
1911.10298|v2.result: 在公开真实自动驾驶数据集上超越当时最先进方法。

RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中深度估计困难与实时性不足的问题，本文提出 RTM3D，从目标关键点出发进行实时单目 3D 检测。方法预测 3D 框的 9 个关键点及其投影关系，结合几何约束恢复目标的三维位置、尺寸与朝向。相比依赖密集深度图或复杂后处理的方法，RTM3D 在保持高精度的同时实现实时推理。摘要未给出具体数值。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of depth estimation and real-time constraints in monocular 3D detection by proposing RTM3D, which detects 3D objects from object keypoints. It predicts nine 3D box keypoints and their projections, using geometric constraints to recover 3D position, dimensions, and orientation. Compared with dense-depth or heavy post-processing methods, RTM3D achieves real-time inference with competitive accuracy, though no specific numbers are given in the abstract.
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.assessment: 关键点驱动的单目 3D 检测思路清晰，兼顾精度与实时性，对自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.contribution: 提出基于目标关键点的实时单目 3D 检测方法 RTM3D。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.innovation: 用 3D 框关键点及几何约束替代密集深度估计。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.result: 在保持高精度的同时实现实时推理。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection._arxiv_id: RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection from Object Keypoints for Autonomous Driving.

Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_cn: 针对点云 3D 检测中体素方法计算开销大、部署困难的问题，本文提出基于 Pillar 的物体检测方法。方法将点云编码为柱状表示，用 2D 卷积网络进行检测，避免昂贵的 3D 卷积。相比体素方案，该方法在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度，适合自动驾驶实时场景。摘要未给出具体数值。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of voxel-based 3D detection by proposing a pillar-based object detection method. Point clouds are encoded into pillars and processed with 2D convolutions, avoiding expensive 3D convolutions. Compared with voxel approaches, it significantly improves inference speed while maintaining accuracy, making it suitable for real-time autonomous driving, though no specific numbers are given.
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.assessment: Pillar 表示是点云检测的重要工程化方向，速度快、易部署，对自动驾驶落地有参考价值。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.contribution: 提出基于 Pillar 表示的高效点云 3D 物体检测方法。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.innovation: 用柱状编码与 2D 卷积替代昂贵的 3D 体素卷积。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.result: 在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度。
