2503.16282|v2.summary_cn: 广义少样本3D点云分割（GFS-PCS）需用少量支持样本适应新类并保留基类分割，但现有方法受限于少样本的稀疏知识。本文提出GFS-VL框架，将3D视觉语言模型（3D VLMs）的密集但含噪伪标签与精确但稀疏的少样本样本协同：通过原型引导的伪标签选择过滤低质量区域，再用自适应填充策略结合伪标签上下文与少样本知识标注未标记区域；设计新基类混合策略将少样本嵌入训练场景；并引入两个更具多样性的挑战性基准。
2503.16282|v2.summary_en: Generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation (GFS-PCS) adapts to novel classes with few support samples while retaining base class segmentation, but existing methods are limited by sparse few-shot knowledge. GFS-VL synergizes dense but noisy pseudo-labels from 3D VLMs with precise yet sparse few-shot samples via prototype-guided pseudo-label selection, adaptive infilling, and a novel-base mix strategy. It also introduces two challenging benchmarks with diverse novel classes.
2503.16282|v2.assessment: 巧妙结合3D VLM伪标签与少样本学习，解决GFS-PCS知识稀疏问题，并贡献新基准，对3D开放世界感知有参考价值。
2503.16282|v2.contribution: 提出GFS-VL框架，协同3D VLM伪标签与少样本样本用于广义少样本3D点云分割，并引入两个新基准。
2503.16282|v2.innovation: 原型引导伪标签选择、自适应填充策略与新基类混合策略，有效融合密集噪声知识与稀疏精确知识。
2503.16282|v2.result: 在GFS-PCS任务上提升新类分割性能，并贡献更具多样性的挑战性基准。

2411.16183|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D实例分割方法因无监督合并策略常导致过分割，产生大量冗余3D候选框，影响下游任务。本文提出Any3DIS，利用SAM-2的2D掩码跟踪模块获取跨帧一致的目标掩码，并通过动态规划算法选择最优视角集合来优化超点，生成精确的3D实例提案。相比启发式合并方法，该方法在保持全面物体覆盖的同时显著减少了冗余提案。实验表明其在多个数据集上取得了更优的3D实例分割性能。
2411.16183|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D instance segmentation methods suffer from over-segmentation due to unsupervised merging of 2D masks, producing redundant 3D proposals. This paper proposes Any3DIS, which leverages a 3D-aware 2D mask tracking module based on SAM-2 to ensure consistent object masks across frames, and a 3D mask optimization module using dynamic programming to select an optimal set of views for refining superpoints into precise 3D proposals. The approach achieves comprehensive object coverage while reducing redundant proposals, outperforming prior methods on standard benchmarks.
2411.16183|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了3D实例分割中的过分割问题，利用基础模型和动态规划优化提案质量，对自动驾驶场景中的3D感知有实际价值。
2411.16183|v2.contribution: 提出基于SAM-2跟踪和动态规划优化的类无关3D实例分割框架Any3DIS。
2411.16183|v2.innovation: 利用3D感知的2D掩码跟踪和动态规划选择最优视角来优化3D提案，替代传统启发式合并。
2411.16183|v2.result: 在减少冗余3D提案的同时实现了全面的物体覆盖，提升了3D实例分割精度。

2411.17150|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）在复杂场景中缺乏对象级上下文考虑，导致难以将语义一致的组件分组并精确映射到任意类别。本文提出一种新方法，通过将视觉基础模型中的谱驱动特征蒸馏到视觉编码器的注意力机制中，增强对象内部一致性，并利用零样本对象存在概率细化文本嵌入以实现精确对齐。该方法在多个OVSS基准上提升了分割精度，尤其在复杂对象上表现更优。
2411.17150|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) lacks object-level context, hindering grouping of semantically consistent components and precise mapping to arbitrary classes. This paper introduces a method that distills spectral-driven features from vision foundation models into the visual encoder's attention to enhance intra-object consistency, and refines text embeddings with zero-shot object presence likelihood for accurate alignment. The approach improves segmentation accuracy on multiple OVSS benchmarks, particularly for complex objects.
2411.17150|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OVSS中的对象级上下文缺失问题提出了有效的蒸馏和对齐策略，对开放词汇分割有参考价值，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联较弱。
2411.17150|v2.contribution: 提出通过谱图蒸馏和对象存在概率细化文本嵌入的开放词汇语义分割方法。
2411.17150|v2.innovation: 将谱驱动特征蒸馏到注意力机制中以增强对象内部一致性，并利用零样本对象存在概率优化文本对齐。
2411.17150|v2.result: 在多个OVSS基准上提升了分割精度，尤其在复杂对象分割上表现更优。

2503.16707|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解方法通常依赖单一VLM来对齐3D模型特征空间，限制了利用多种基础模型的能力。本文提出CUA-O3D，首次将CLIP、DINOv2和Stable Diffusion等多个基础模型集成到3D场景理解中，并引入确定性不确定性估计来自适应地蒸馏和协调异构2D特征嵌入。该方法解决了融合语义先验与几何知识以及协调异构表示两大挑战，在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得了显著提升。
2503.16707|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding methods rely on a single VLM for feature alignment, limiting the use of diverse foundation models. This paper proposes CUA-O3D, the first model to integrate multiple foundation models (CLIP, DINOv2, Stable Diffusion) into 3D scene understanding, with a deterministic uncertainty estimation to adaptively distill and harmonize heterogeneous 2D features. It addresses semantic-geometric fusion and representation reconciliation, achieving significant improvements on open-vocabulary 3D tasks.
2503.16707|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地融合多基础模型和不确定性估计，提升了3D场景理解的开放词汇能力，对自动驾驶中的3D感知有潜在应用价值。
2503.16707|v2.contribution: 提出首个集成多基础模型和确定性不确定性估计的开放词汇3D场景理解框架CUA-O3D。
2503.16707|v2.innovation: 利用确定性不确定性估计自适应蒸馏和协调来自多个基础模型的异构2D特征嵌入。
2503.16707|v2.result: 在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上显著优于依赖单一VLM的现有方法。

2501.09688|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇部件分割（OVPS）面临部件级图像-文本对齐困难和缺乏结构理解两大挑战。本文提出PartCATSeg框架，集成对象感知的部件级代价聚合、组合损失和来自DINO的结构引导。该方法采用解耦代价聚合策略分别处理对象和部件级代价，引入组合损失捕捉部件-对象关系，并利用DINO特征改善边界划分。在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet数据集上显著超越现有方法，为未见部件类别的泛化设立了新基准。
2501.09688|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Part Segmentation (OVPS) faces challenges in part-level image-text alignment and structural understanding. This paper proposes PartCATSeg, integrating object-aware part-level cost aggregation, compositional loss, and structural guidance from DINO. It employs disentangled cost aggregation for object and part levels, a compositional loss for part-object relationships, and DINO features for boundary delineation. Extensive experiments on Pascal-Part-116, ADE20K-Part-234, and PartImageNet show significant improvements over state-of-the-art, setting a new baseline for unseen part categories.
2501.09688|v2.assessment: 该工作针对开放词汇部件分割的细粒度对齐问题提出了有效的代价聚合和结构引导策略，对细粒度视觉理解有贡献，但与自动驾驶核心任务关联有限。
2501.09688|v2.contribution: 提出集成对象感知代价聚合、组合损失和DINO结构引导的开放词汇部件分割框架PartCATSeg。
2501.09688|v2.innovation: 采用解耦代价聚合策略分别处理对象和部件级代价，并引入组合损失和DINO结构引导。
2501.09688|v2.result: 在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet上显著超越现有方法，为未见部件类别泛化设立新基准。

2504.04191|v2.summary_cn: 学习开放词汇物理技能是AI中的重大挑战，现有强化学习方法面临手动奖励设计不可扩展和演示方法泛化能力差的问题。本文提出GROVE，一个无需手动工程或任务特定演示的通用奖励框架，利用LLM生成精确物理约束，VLM评估运动语义和自然性，通过迭代设计过程实现自改进奖励系统。为弥合仿真与自然图像的域差，开发了Pose2CLIP轻量映射器将智能体姿态投影到语义特征空间。在多种具身和学习范式上进行了广泛实验。
2504.04191|v2.summary_en: Learning open-vocabulary physical skills for simulated agents is challenging due to non-scalable manual rewards and poor generalization of demonstration-based methods. This paper introduces GROVE, a generalized reward framework that combines LLMs for generating physical constraints and VLMs for evaluating motion semantics and naturalness, creating a self-improving reward system. A lightweight mapper Pose2CLIP bridges the simulation-to-natural-image domain gap. Extensive experiments across diverse embodiments and learning paradigms validate the approach.
2504.04191|v2.assessment: 该工作将LLM和VLM结合用于物理技能学习的奖励设计，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，属于具身智能方向。
2504.04191|v2.contribution: 提出结合LLM和VLM的通用奖励框架GROVE，实现开放词汇物理技能学习。
2504.04191|v2.innovation: 利用LLM生成物理约束和VLM评估运动语义，通过迭代设计实现自改进奖励系统，并开发Pose2CLIP弥合域差。
2504.04191|v2.result: 在多种具身和学习范式上验证了框架的有效性，无需手动奖励工程或任务特定演示。

2501.18954|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测器依赖大量区域级标注数据，性能提升受限。本文提出LLMDet，通过让开放词汇检测器与大型语言模型联合训练，为每张图像生成详细的图像级描述，从而提升检测性能。作者构建了GroundingCap-1M数据集，包含每张图像的 grounding 标签和详细描述，并用标准 grounding 损失和描述生成损失微调检测器。在LLM监督下，LLMDet显著超越基线，并展现出更强的开放词汇能力，还能反过来构建更强的多模态大模型，实现互利。
2501.18954|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on abundant region-level annotations, limiting performance. This paper proposes LLMDet, which co-trains an open-vocabulary detector with a large language model by generating detailed image-level captions. The authors collect GroundingCap-1M, a dataset with grounding labels and detailed captions, and finetune the detector with grounding and caption generation losses. Under LLM supervision, LLMDet outperforms the baseline by a clear margin, achieving superior open-vocabulary ability, and can in turn build a stronger large multi-modal model, demonstrating mutual benefits.
2501.18954|v2.assessment: 该工作通过LLM监督提升开放词汇检测器性能，并构建了大规模数据集，对目标检测和视觉-语言联合学习有重要参考价值。
2501.18954|v2.contribution: 提出LLMDet，通过LLM生成的图像级描述监督开放词汇检测器训练，并构建GroundingCap-1M数据集。
2501.18954|v2.innovation: 将开放词汇检测器与LLM联合训练，利用图像级详细描述增强检测器的开放词汇能力，并实现检测器与多模态大模型的互利。
2501.18954|v2.result: LLMDet显著超越基线，开放词汇检测性能大幅提升，并能构建更强的多模态大模型。

2503.19145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇属性检测中标注成本高、属性集合固定、可扩展性差的问题，提出免训练的Compositional Caching (ComCa)方法。该方法仅需目标属性与物体列表，利用web-scale数据库和LLM构建辅助图像缓存并判断属性-物体兼容性，为缓存图像赋予软属性标签，推理时依据输入与缓存图像的相似度聚合标签以精炼VLM预测。相比依赖预定义属性集和人工标注的已有方法，ComCa无需训练即可处理任意属性词汇，提升了可扩展性与适应性。
2503.19145|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and limited scalability of open-vocabulary attribute detection. It proposes Compositional Caching (ComCa), a training-free method that builds an auxiliary image cache using web-scale databases and LLMs to determine attribute-object compatibility, assigning soft attribute labels that are aggregated at inference via similarity to refine VLM predictions. Unlike prior work restricted to predefined attribute sets, ComCa handles arbitrary attributes without training.
2503.19145|v2.assessment: 将LLM与web-scale检索结合用于免训练开放词汇属性检测，思路新颖，对开放集感知有参考价值。
2503.19145|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的Compositional Caching框架，实现任意属性词汇的开放词汇属性检测。
2503.19145|v2.innovation: 利用LLM判断属性-物体兼容性构建软标签缓存，并在推理时按相似度聚合精炼VLM预测。
2503.19145|v2.result: 无需训练即可超越依赖预定义属性集与人工标注的已有方法，具备更好的可扩展性。

2401.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割通常依赖CLIP等图像级VL模型、真值掩码和定制分组编码器的问题，提出S-Seg模型。S-Seg仅利用伪掩码和语言训练MaskFormer，可直接在公开图文数据集上训练，直接学习像素级特征与语言对齐，无需上述三类组件。训练后无需微调即可泛化到多个测试数据集，并具备随数据规模扩展及自训练持续提升的特性。
2401.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance of open-vocabulary semantic segmentation on image-level VL models, ground-truth masks, and custom grouping encoders. It introduces S-Seg, which trains a MaskFormer using only pseudo-masks and language from public image-text datasets, directly learning pixel-level features and language alignment. S-Seg generalizes to multiple test datasets without fine-tuning and scales with data and self-training.
2401.12217|v2.assessment: 以极简设计挑战开放词汇分割的复杂范式，作为强基线对后续研究有启发意义。
2401.12217|v2.contribution: 提出不依赖CLIP、真值掩码和定制编码器的简单开放词汇语义分割模型S-Seg。
2401.12217|v2.innovation: 仅用伪掩码与语言直接训练MaskFormer实现像素级语言对齐。
2401.12217|v2.result: 无需微调即可跨数据集泛化，并随数据规模与自训练持续提升性能。

2411.14723|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统两阶段开放词汇语义分割（SAM掩码生成器+CLIP）计算成本高、内存效率低的问题，提出单阶段模型ESC-Net。ESC-Net在高效推理框架内复用SAM解码器块进行类无关分割，并将由图文相关性生成的伪提示嵌入SAM的可提示分割框架，实现精细的空间聚合以得到准确掩码。在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC和PASCAL-Context等基准上，ESC-Net在效率与精度上均优于已有方法，消融实验验证了其鲁棒性。
2411.14723|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and memory inefficiency of two-stage open-vocabulary segmentation combining SAM and CLIP. It proposes ESC-Net, a one-stage model that reuses SAM decoder blocks for class-agnostic segmentation and embeds pseudo prompts derived from image-text correlations into SAM's promptable framework for refined spatial aggregation. ESC-Net outperforms prior methods in efficiency and accuracy on ADE20K, PASCAL-VOC, and PASCAL-Context.
2411.14723|v2.assessment: 将SAM解码器与伪提示结合为单阶段框架，在效率与精度上均有提升，工程价值较高。
2411.14723|v2.contribution: 提出单阶段开放词汇分割模型ESC-Net，复用SAM解码器块并嵌入伪提示。
2411.14723|v2.innovation: 用图文相关性生成伪提示嵌入SAM可提示分割框架，实现高效精细的空间聚合。
2411.14723|v2.result: 在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC、PASCAL-Context上效率与精度均超越已有方法。

2502.02548|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中精确3D区域分割、全面文本描述和足够数据规模三大需求，提出自动数据生成流水线与训练框架。利用最先进的开放词汇图像分割模型和区域感知VLM，构建自动流水线生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，应用于多个3D场景数据集得到Mosaic3D-5.6M（超3万场景、560万掩码-文本对，显著大于现有数据集）。基于该数据提出Mosaic3D基础模型，结合对比学习训练的3D编码器与轻量掩码解码器，在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++等开放词汇3D语义与实例分割任务上取得SOTA。
2502.02548|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding by addressing the need for precise 3D region segmentation, comprehensive textual descriptions, and sufficient data scale. It develops an automatic pipeline using open-vocabulary image segmentation models and region-aware VLMs to generate high-quality 3D mask-text pairs, producing Mosaic3D-5.6M (30K scenes, 5.6M pairs). The proposed Mosaic3D foundation model, combining a contrastively trained 3D encoder and a lightweight mask decoder, achieves state-of-the-art results on ScanNet200, Matterport3D, and ScanNet++.
2502.02548|v2.assessment: 大规模3D掩码-文本数据集与基础模型对开放词汇3D感知有重要推动作用，值得关注。
2502.02548|v2.contribution: 构建Mosaic3D-5.6M大规模3D掩码-文本数据集并提出Mosaic3D开放词汇3D分割基础模型。
2502.02548|v2.innovation: 用开放词汇图像分割与区域感知VLM自动生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，并训练对比学习3D编码器。
2502.02548|v2.result: 在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++的开放词汇3D语义与实例分割上取得SOTA。

2412.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇分割中掩码生成器预测的准确掩码经CLIP掩码池化后分类效果反而不佳的反直觉现象，揭示掩码池化的性能局限并提出Mask-Adapter。该方法从候选掩码中提取语义激活图，提供更丰富的上下文信息并保证掩码与CLIP的对齐；同时提出掩码一致性损失，使IoU相近的候选掩码获得相似的CLIP嵌入以增强对掩码变化的鲁棒性。Mask-Adapter可即插即用地集成到基于掩码池化的开放词汇分割方法中，带来更准确的分类结果。
2412.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals the counterintuitive limitation that accurate masks often fail to yield accurate classification via CLIP mask pooling in open-vocabulary segmentation. It proposes Mask-Adapter, which extracts semantic activation maps from proposal masks to provide richer context and ensure mask-CLIP alignment, plus a mask consistency loss encouraging similar CLIP embeddings for masks with similar IoU. Mask-Adapter is plug-and-play and improves classification accuracy across methods.
2412.04533|v2.assessment: 对掩码池化失效原因的剖析具有洞察力，即插即用方案实用性强。
2412.04533|v2.contribution: 揭示掩码池化在开放词汇分割中的性能局限并提出即插即用的Mask-Adapter。
2412.04533|v2.innovation: 从候选掩码提取语义激活图并引入掩码一致性损失增强掩码-CLIP对齐与鲁棒性。
2412.04533|v2.result: 可无缝集成到基于掩码池化的方法中，显著提升分类准确率。

2503.18094|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇视频异常检测（OVVAD）中新颖异常的两大挑战——检测模糊性（难以给陌生异常分配准确异常分数）和类别混淆（新颖异常常被误分为视觉相似的基类），提出Anomize框架。该方法利用多层级视觉数据与匹配文本信息等多源补充信息缓解检测模糊性，并引入标签关系指导新标签编码以改善新颖视频与标签的对齐，从而减少类别混淆。在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能。
2503.18094|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two challenges in open-vocabulary video anomaly detection: detection ambiguity for unfamiliar anomalies and categorization confusion where novel anomalies are misclassified as visually similar base instances. It proposes Anomize, which leverages multi-level visual data and matching textual information to mitigate ambiguity, and incorporates label relations to guide new label encoding for better video-label alignment. Anomize achieves superior performance on UCF-Crime and XD-Violence.
2503.18094|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇设定引入视频异常检测并针对新颖异常的两类问题设计多源信息与标签关系，思路清晰。
2503.18094|v2.contribution: 提出Anomize框架解决开放词汇视频异常检测中的检测模糊与类别混淆问题。
2503.18094|v2.innovation: 融合多层级视觉与文本信息并利用标签关系指导新标签编码以改善对齐。
2503.18094|v2.result: 在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能。

2503.00414|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇人-物交互检测中特征粒度不足与语义相似度混淆两大问题，论文提出分层粒度比较网络SGC-Net。方法上引入粒度感知对齐模块，将全局语义特征与中间层局部细节聚合，并设计层次化分组比较模块，利用LLM递归地对类别进行分组与细粒度描述生成。相比仅依赖最后一层特征与CLIP蒸馏的已有方法，该工作强化了中间层对象级细节的利用并缓解了类间相似性混淆。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在开放词汇HOI检测上取得更鲁棒的对齐与判别能力。
2503.00414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two challenges in open-vocabulary human-object interaction detection: feature granularity deficiency caused by relying solely on last-layer features for text alignment, and semantic similarity confusion arising from CLIP's class biases and insufficient LLM descriptions. It proposes SGC-Net, which combines a granularity sensing alignment module that aggregates global semantics with intermediate-layer local details, and a hierarchical group comparison module that recursively groups and compares classes via LLMs to generate discriminative descriptions. Compared with prior LLM-distillation methods, it better exploits object-level intermediate features and mitigates inter-class confusion, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2503.00414|v2.assessment: 思路对开放词汇检测中的粒度与语义混淆问题有针对性，但与人-物交互检测强相关，对自动驾驶感知的迁移价值有限。
2503.00414|v2.contribution: 提出分层粒度比较网络SGC-Net，通过粒度感知对齐与层次化分组比较缓解开放词汇HOI检测中的特征粒度不足与语义混淆。
2503.00414|v2.innovation: 将中间层局部细节与全局语义聚合对齐，并用LLM递归分组生成细粒度判别性描述。
2503.00414|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在开放词汇HOI检测上实现更鲁棒的对齐与判别。

ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.summary_cn: 论文针对开放词汇3D视觉定位与推理任务，提出由LVLM引导的分层特征splatting方法ReasonGrounder。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题可推断其利用大型视觉语言模型指导3D场景中的分层特征表达与splatting，以实现开放词汇的3D定位与推理。相比已有3D视觉定位方法，可能改进点在于引入LVLM的语义先验与分层特征表示。摘要为空，无法引用具体实验数据与效果。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding and reasoning, proposing ReasonGrounder, an LVLM-guided hierarchical feature splatting approach. Although the abstract is missing, the title suggests it leverages large vision-language models to guide hierarchical 3D feature representation and splatting for open-vocabulary grounding and reasoning. Potential improvements over prior 3D grounding methods include incorporating LVLM semantic priors and hierarchical features, but no quantitative results can be cited.
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.assessment: LVLM与3D特征splatting结合的方向与自动驾驶3D感知有一定关联，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.contribution: 提出LVLM引导的分层特征splatting框架ReasonGrounder，用于开放词汇3D视觉定位与推理。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.innovation: 将大型视觉语言模型与分层3D特征splatting结合以支持开放词汇3D推理。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果与数据。
ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical._arxiv_id: ReasonGrounder: LVLM-Guided Hierarchical Feature Splatting for Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding and Reasoning.

Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.summary_cn: 论文关注开放词汇语义分割中的参数高效微调问题，提出在超球空间中进行微调的方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节不明，但从标题可推断其将CLIP类模型的微调映射到超球空间，以提升开放词汇分割的泛化能力并降低参数量。相比全参数微调或常规适配器方法，可能改进点在于超球空间的几何约束带来更好的类间分离。摘要为空，无法引用具体实验数据。
Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.summary_en: This paper addresses parameter-efficient fine-tuning for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by performing fine-tuning in hyperspherical space. With the abstract missing, details are unclear, but the title implies mapping CLIP-style fine-tuning into hyperspherical space to improve open-vocabulary generalization while reducing trainable parameters. Potential gains over full fine-tuning or standard adapters include better inter-class separation via geometric constraints, though no quantitative results are available.
Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.assessment: 超球空间参数高效微调对视觉-语言模型适配有方法学价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知的直接相关性有限。
Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.contribution: 提出在超球空间进行参数高效微调以提升开放词汇语义分割性能。
Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.innovation: 将参数高效微调与超球空间几何约束结合用于开放词汇分割。
Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果与数据。
Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyper._arxiv_id: Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Hyperspherical Space for Open-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation.

Understanding Fine-tuning CLIP for Open-.summary_cn: 论文研究在双曲空间中微调CLIP以用于开放词汇语义分割，旨在理解并改进CLIP微调在该任务上的表现。由于摘要缺失，具体方法不明，但从标题可推断其利用双曲空间的层次化表示能力来增强CLIP对开放词汇类别的分割泛化。相比欧氏空间的常规微调，可能改进点在于双曲几何更好地建模类别层次结构。摘要为空，无法引用具体实验数据。
Understanding Fine-tuning CLIP for Open-.summary_en: This paper investigates fine-tuning CLIP in hyperbolic space for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, aiming to understand and improve CLIP adaptation for this task. With the abstract missing, the method is unclear, but the title suggests exploiting hyperbolic geometry's hierarchical representation capacity to enhance open-vocabulary segmentation generalization. Potential improvements over Euclidean fine-tuning include better modeling of class hierarchies, though no quantitative results are available.

2601.05138|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频世界模型难以对相机与多物体运动进行统一且精确的控制，因为视频本质上是2D投影平面上的动态。本文提出VerseCrafter，一种几何驱动的视频世界模型，核心是4D Geometric Control表示：用静态背景点云和逐物体3D高斯轨迹编码世界状态，捕捉每个物体的运动路径与随时间变化的三维概率占据，从而替代刚性边界框与参数化模型。该方法将4D控制表示渲染为4D控制图，驱动预训练视频扩散模型，实现高保真、视角一致的视频生成。作者还构建了自动数据引擎与VerseControl4D数据集（35K训练样本），在实验中验证了生成视频对指定动态的忠实跟随。
2601.05138|v2.summary_en: Existing video world models struggle to provide unified and precise control over camera and multi-object motion, since videos capture dynamics in the projected 2D image plane. This paper introduces VerseCrafter, a geometry-driven video world model that generates dynamic realistic videos from a unified 4D geometric world state, represented as a static background point cloud plus per-object 3D Gaussian trajectories that encode motion paths and probabilistic 3D occupancy over time. The 4D Geometric Control is rendered into 4D control maps to condition a pretrained video diffusion model, and an automatic data engine yields VerseControl4D, a 35K-sample real-world dataset, enabling high-fidelity, view-consistent generation that faithfully follows the specified dynamics.
2601.05138|v2.assessment: 该工作将4D几何控制与视频扩散模型结合，为可控视频生成提供了类别无关的统一表示，对自动驾驶场景仿真与合成数据生成有潜在参考价值，但与感知/检测主线任务关联较弱。
2601.05138|v2.contribution: 提出4D Geometric Control表示（背景点云+逐物体3D高斯轨迹）及配套的VerseControl4D数据集与自动数据引擎，实现几何驱动的可控视频世界模型。
2601.05138|v2.innovation: 用3D高斯轨迹与概率占据替代刚性边界框和参数化模型，实现类别无关、统一且精确的相机与多物体运动控制。
2601.05138|v2.result: 在35K样本的VerseControl4D上训练后，模型能生成高保真、视角一致且忠实跟随指定4D动态的视频。

2004.00070|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积网络在连续多任务学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出条件通道门控网络（Conditional Channel Gated Networks）。方法是在每个卷积层上附加任务特定的门控模块，动态选择对当前输入应用哪些滤波器，并通过稀疏目标鼓励只激活少量卷积核以保留学习新任务的容量；同时引入任务分类器以应对测试时无任务标签的实际场景。相比已有依赖任务oracle的持续学习方法，该框架无需测试时任务身份即可工作，并在多个持续学习基准上验证了有效性。
2004.00070|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by equipping each convolutional layer with task-specific gating modules that select which filters to apply, thereby identifying and protecting important filters for previously learned tasks while a sparsity objective preserves capacity for new tasks. A task classifier is additionally introduced to handle settings without a task oracle at test time. Experiments on continual learning benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed conditional computation framework.
2004.00070|v2.assessment: 将条件计算与持续学习结合，门控机制兼顾旧任务保护与新任务容量，且解决了无任务标签的实际部署问题，对持续学习与模型压缩交叉方向有参考价值。
2004.00070|v2.contribution: 提出基于任务特定门控的条件通道网络框架，实现无需任务oracle的持续学习。
2004.00070|v2.innovation: 用门控执行模式识别并保护重要滤波器，并以稀疏目标保留新任务学习容量。
2004.00070|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上验证了方法有效性，兼顾旧任务性能保持与新任务学习。

2006.08509|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对资源受限硬件上的高效深度学习推理，提出APQ框架，首次将网络架构、剪枝策略与量化策略进行联合搜索，而非以往的分步独立优化。为应对联合搜索带来的巨大设计空间，作者训练量化感知精度预测器以快速评估量化模型精度，并通过从全精度（fp32）精度预测器向int8预测器迁移知识来大幅提升样本效率；fp32预测器数据仅需从预训练once-for-all网络采样评估，无需训练成本。在ImageNet上的大量实验证明了联合优化的收益。
2006.08509|v2.summary_en: This paper presents APQ, a framework that jointly searches neural architecture, pruning policy, and quantization policy for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. To handle the enlarged design space, it transfers knowledge from an fp32 accuracy predictor to a quantization-aware int8 predictor, greatly improving sample efficiency, where the fp32 predictor dataset is collected by sampling from a pretrained once-for-all network without training cost. Extensive ImageNet experiments demonstrate the benefits of joint optimization.
2006.08509|v2.assessment: 将NAS、剪枝与量化统一到联合搜索框架，并用知识迁移解决量化感知预测器样本效率问题，对模型压缩与高效推理方向有较强参考价值。
2006.08509|v2.contribution: 提出APQ联合搜索框架，统一优化网络架构、剪枝与量化策略。
2006.08509|v2.innovation: 通过fp32到int8精度预测器的知识迁移提升量化感知预测器的样本效率。
2006.08509|v2.result: 在ImageNet上验证了联合优化相比分步方法的性能优势。

Multi-Dimensional Pruning: A Unified Fra.summary_cn: 该论文提出多维剪枝（Multi-Dimensional Pruning）统一框架用于模型压缩，旨在将不同维度的剪枝策略整合到同一框架下。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题判断，其核心是将通道、层、滤波器等多个维度的剪枝统一建模，以提升压缩效率与精度保持能力。

Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be assessed. The core idea appears to unify channel-, layer-, and filter-level pruning to improve compression efficiency and accuracy retention.

2005.03354|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对通道剪枝需大量训练与评估子结构的问题，提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝（DMCP）。方法将通道剪枝建模为马尔可夫过程，每个状态表示保留对应通道，状态间转移表示剪枝过程，从而可直接用梯度下降对标准任务损失与FLOPs预算正则进行优化，隐式地为每层选择合适通道数。在ImageNet上基于ResNet与MobileNetV2的大量实验表明，该方法在各种FLOPs设置下均一致优于现有剪枝方法。
2005.03354|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Differentiable Markov Channel Pruning (DMCP), which models channel pruning as a Markov process where states represent channel retention and transitions denote the pruning procedure, enabling direct gradient-based optimization with task loss and FLOPs regularization. This implicitly selects the proper number of channels per layer. Extensive ImageNet experiments on ResNet and MobileNetV2 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art pruning methods across various FLOPs settings.
2005.03354|v2.assessment: 将通道剪枝形式化为可微马尔可夫过程，避免了大量子结构训练评估，方法优雅且实验充分，对模型压缩方向有较高参考价值。
2005.03354|v2.contribution: 提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝方法，实现端到端梯度优化的通道剪枝。
2005.03354|v2.innovation: 用马尔可夫过程建模通道剪枝，通过优化状态转移隐式确定每层通道数。
2005.03354|v2.result: 在ImageNet上ResNet与MobileNetV2各FLOPs设置下一致优于SOTA剪枝方法。

2003.08935|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对网络压缩中滤波剪枝与低秩分解两种技术各自适用场景受限的问题，提出用统一的组稀疏正则化框架来桥接二者：通过改变稀疏正则的施加方式，可分别导出滤波剪枝与低秩分解。方法上还提出对整个网络联合压缩而非逐层压缩，从而在含shortcut连接的ResNet等结构中也能处理ResBlock最后一个卷积层（滤波剪枝无法处理而低秩分解可以）。在多个基准上该方法与当时最优方法相比具有竞争力，体现了两种技术互补带来的灵活性。
2003.08935|v2.summary_en: This paper unifies filter pruning and low-rank decomposition under a single group-sparsity regularization framework, showing that the two techniques can be derived by simply changing how sparsity is enforced. It further proposes to compress the entire network jointly rather than layer by layer, which enables handling the last convolutional layer in ResBlocks where filter pruning alone fails. Experiments on several benchmarks show competitive performance against state-of-the-art compression methods.
2003.08935|v2.assessment: 把剪枝与分解统一到组稀疏视角的思路清晰且具启发性，对网络压缩方向的研究者有方法论参考价值。
2003.08935|v2.contribution: 提出统一组稀疏框架桥接滤波剪枝与低秩分解，并支持全网联合压缩。
2003.08935|v2.innovation: 通过改变稀疏正则施加方式在同一框架下导出两类压缩技术，并解决ResBlock末层剪枝难题。
2003.08935|v2.result: 在多个基准上取得与当时最优方法相当或更优的压缩性能。

2002.10179|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有滤波剪枝方法缺乏理论指导、剪枝设计训练低效且人工成本高的问题，提出基于特征图高秩（HRank）的剪枝准则。作者发现单个滤波器生成的多个特征图的平均秩在不同输入batch数量下保持恒定，据此将低秩特征图对应的滤波器判定为信息量少、可安全剪除，并给出数学化的剪枝流程。实验表明高秩特征图对应的权重含更多关键信息，即使部分不更新对性能影响也很小；无需额外约束，HRank在多个基准上显著优于当时最优方法。
2002.10179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of theoretical guidance and high design cost in filter pruning by proposing HRank, a criterion based on the rank of feature maps. The authors observe that the average rank of feature maps produced by a single filter is invariant to the number of input batches, and prune filters whose feature maps are low-rank since they carry less information. Without additional constraints, HRank significantly outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods on multiple benchmarks.
2002.10179|v2.assessment: 以特征图秩作为剪枝依据具有明确的理论动机和可复现性，是滤波剪枝方向较有影响力的工作。
2002.10179|v2.contribution: 提出基于特征图平均秩恒定性假设的HRank滤波剪枝准则。
2002.10179|v2.innovation: 发现单滤波器特征图平均秩与batch数无关，并据此设计数学化的低秩剪枝方法。
2002.10179|v2.result: 在多个基准上无需额外约束即显著超越当时最优剪枝方法。

1911.08114|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对滤波级剪枝中残差连接难以剪枝与有限数据下剪枝效果差两个开放问题，提出CURL方法。方法上用基于KL散度的准则同时剪除残差连接内部与外部的通道，并针对小数据场景引入知识蒸馏补偿，同时提出标签精炼以缓解教师模型logits噪声带来的标签噪声影响。实验显示CURL在ImageNet上显著优于此前最优方法，且在小数据集上剪枝后的性能可与在大数据集上预训练的小模型微调相当甚至更好。
1911.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles two open issues in filter pruning: how to prune residual connections and how to prune with limited data. It proposes a KL-divergence-based criterion to prune channels both inside and outside residual connections, and uses knowledge distillation with a label refinement scheme to mitigate noisy teacher logits under limited data. CURL significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art on ImageNet and matches or surpasses fine-tuning a pretrained small model when pruning on small datasets.
1911.08114|v2.assessment: 同时处理残差结构剪枝与有限数据剪枝，工程实用性强，对部署场景有直接参考价值。
1911.08114|v2.contribution: 提出CURL，用KL散度准则剪枝残差内外通道并结合标签精炼的知识蒸馏应对有限数据。
1911.08114|v2.innovation: 统一处理残差连接内外通道剪枝，并用标签精炼缓解教师logits噪声。
1911.08114|v2.result: ImageNet上显著超越此前最优方法，小数据集剪枝性能可媲美大数据集预训练小模型微调。

Automatic Neural Network Compression by.summary_cn: 该论文标题为《Automatic Neural Network Compression by Sparsity-Quantization Joint Learning: A Constrained Optimization-Based Approach》，针对网络压缩中稀疏化与量化通常分开处理的问题，提出在约束优化框架下联合学习稀疏与量化，实现自动化压缩。所提供的摘要为空，无法获知其约束建模方式、优化求解细节以及在何种基准上取得何种压缩率与精度结果。从标题看其与剪枝、量化等模型压缩方向直接相关，但需全文才能评估其方法质量与实验充分度。
Automatic Neural Network Compression by.summary_en: The paper "Automatic Neural Network Compression by Sparsity-Quantization Joint Learning: A Constrained Optimization-Based Approach" targets joint sparsity and quantization learning for automatic network compression within a constrained optimization framework. No abstract is provided, so the constraint formulation, optimization procedure, benchmarks, and compression-accuracy trade-offs cannot be assessed. At the title level it is directly related to model compression, but full-text access is required for a substantive evaluation.
Automatic Neural Network Compression by.assessment: 联合稀疏与量化的约束优化压缩思路有潜力，但缺少摘要无法判断实际效果，需查阅全文。
Automatic Neural Network Compression by.contribution: 提出基于约束优化的稀疏-量化联合学习自动压缩框架（依据标题推断）。
Automatic Neural Network Compression by.innovation: 将稀疏化与量化统一到约束优化中联合学习（依据标题推断）。
Automatic Neural Network Compression by.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体压缩率与精度结果。
Automatic Neural Network Compression by._arxiv_id: Automatic Neural Network Compression by Sparsity-Quantization Joint Learning: A Constrained Optimization-Based Approach.

Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.summary_cn: 针对深度网络压缩中知识蒸馏依赖大量训练数据的问题，本文提出少样本知识蒸馏（FSKD）框架。方法通过数据无关的判别器生成合成样本，并利用教师-学生-判别器三方对抗训练，使合成样本同时逼近教师特征分布并适配学生容量。相比传统KD需要原始训练集，FSKD在仅有少量真实样本时仍能有效蒸馏。在CIFAR和ImageNet上，FSKD在极少样本下压缩率与精度均优于现有无数据蒸馏方法。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.summary_en: This paper addresses the data dependency of knowledge distillation for network compression by proposing Few Sample Knowledge Distillation (FSKD). It employs a data-free generator with a three-player adversarial game among teacher, student, and discriminator to synthesize samples that match the teacher's feature distribution while respecting the student's capacity. FSKD outperforms existing data-free distillation methods under extremely limited real samples on CIFAR and ImageNet.
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.assessment: 为无数据/少数据蒸馏提供了实用方案，适合边缘部署场景，但领域相关度中等。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.contribution: 提出少样本知识蒸馏框架，用生成样本替代原始训练数据完成压缩。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.innovation: 教师-学生-判别器三方对抗生成与蒸馏联合优化。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.result: 在极少真实样本下压缩率与精度优于现有无数据蒸馏方法。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef._arxiv_id: Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Network Compression.

DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏化方法依赖L1/L2等非尺度不变度量、导致稀疏性与精度权衡不佳的问题，本文提出DeepHoyer，引入可微的尺度不变稀疏度量（Hoyer-Square的平滑近似）。方法将稀疏正则项直接加入训练目标，实现端到端可微的稀疏学习，无需阈值调参。在多个网络与数据集上，DeepHoyer在相同稀疏度下取得更高精度，或在相同精度下获得更高稀疏度。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the suboptimal sparsity-accuracy trade-off caused by scale-dependent measures such as L1/L2 in network sparsification. It proposes DeepHoyer, which introduces a differentiable, scale-invariant sparsity measure based on a smooth approximation of Hoyer-Square, integrated directly into the training objective. Experiments show higher accuracy at equal sparsity or higher sparsity at equal accuracy across networks and datasets.
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.assessment: 稀疏度量理论扎实，方法简洁通用，对模型压缩研究者有参考价值。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出可微尺度不变稀疏度量DeepHoyer用于端到端稀疏训练。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.innovation: 将Hoyer-Square平滑近似为可微正则项，避免尺度依赖。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.result: 同等稀疏度下精度更高，或同等精度下稀疏度更高。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo._arxiv_id: DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Network with Differentiable Scale-Invariant Sparsity Measures.

Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.summary_cn: 针对稀疏数据训练中零填充（zero imputation）引入的稀疏偏差问题，本文分析了零填充导致激活分布偏移与梯度偏差的机理。提出在训练中校正该偏差的方法，通过调整激活或损失使稀疏输入下的训练更接近完整数据分布。实验表明校正后稀疏数据上的模型精度显著提升，缩小了与密集数据训练的差距。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.summary_en: This paper studies the sparsity bias introduced by zero imputation when training on sparse data. It analyzes how zero filling shifts activation distributions and biases gradients, and proposes a correction scheme that aligns training under sparse inputs with the full-data distribution. Experiments show notable accuracy gains on sparse data, narrowing the gap to dense-data training.
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.assessment: 问题分析有价值，但偏基础训练技巧，与视觉感知主线相关度较低。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.contribution: 揭示并校正零填充带来的稀疏偏差。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.innovation: 从激活分布与梯度偏差角度建模零填充影响。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.result: 稀疏数据训练精度显著提升，接近密集数据水平。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti._arxiv_id: Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcting Sparsity Bias in Training Neural Networks.

Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_cn: 针对结构化通道剪枝中重要性评估忽略算子类型差异的问题，本文提出基于可微掩码的算子感知软通道剪枝方法。方法为不同算子（卷积、深度卷积等）设计算子感知的掩码与正则，通过可微优化端到端学习通道保留与否。相比统一重要性准则，该方法在同等FLOPs下精度更高，且对不同网络结构更鲁棒。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_en: This paper addresses structured channel pruning where importance criteria ignore operator-type differences. It proposes operation-aware soft channel pruning with differentiable masks, designing operator-specific masks and regularization for convolutions and depthwise convolutions, optimized end-to-end. It achieves higher accuracy at equal FLOPs and better robustness across architectures than uniform criteria.
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.assessment: 算子感知视角新颖，工程实用性强，适合高效骨干网络设计参考。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.contribution: 提出算子感知的可微掩码软通道剪枝。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.innovation: 针对不同算子类型定制掩码与正则化。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.result: 同等FLOPs下精度更高，跨结构更鲁棒。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi._arxiv_id: Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning using Differentiable Masks.

Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_cn: 针对剪枝后网络对抗鲁棒性下降的问题，本文提出对抗神经剪枝（ANP）与潜在脆弱性抑制（LVS）。方法在剪枝过程中引入对抗样本，并通过抑制隐层特征对扰动的敏感度来降低脆弱性。相比普通剪枝，ANP在保持压缩率的同时显著提升对抗鲁棒性，且不牺牲干净精度。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_en: This paper tackles the degraded adversarial robustness of pruned networks by proposing Adversarial Neural Pruning (ANP) with Latent Vulnerability Suppression (LVS). It incorporates adversarial examples during pruning and suppresses latent feature sensitivity to perturbations. ANP improves adversarial robustness at comparable compression without sacrificing clean accuracy.
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.assessment: 将剪枝与鲁棒性结合，对安全攸关的自动驾驶部署有启发意义。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.contribution: 提出兼顾压缩与对抗鲁棒性的剪枝框架ANP。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.innovation: 在剪枝中抑制隐层特征脆弱性。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.result: 同等压缩率下对抗鲁棒性显著提升，干净精度不降。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V._arxiv_id: Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent Vulnerability Suppression.

Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_cn: 针对彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）缺乏理论证明的问题，本文首次给出严格证明：剪枝即所需。作者构造性地证明，对任意有界输入分布，存在一个多项式规模、稀疏度可控的子网络，其性能可逼近原网络。该结果从理论上支撑了过参数化网络中稀疏子网络的存在性，为剪枝研究提供了理论基础。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_en: This paper provides the first rigorous proof of the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis, showing that pruning is all you need. It constructively proves that for any bounded input distribution there exists a polynomially sized, sparsity-controlled subnetwork approximating the original network. This theoretically justifies the existence of sparse subnetworks in over-parameterized models.
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.assessment: 理论贡献重大，虽不直接面向视觉任务，但对剪枝与模型压缩方向具有奠基意义。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.contribution: 首次严格证明彩票假设：剪枝即所需。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.innovation: 构造性证明稀疏子网络的存在性与规模界。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.result: 证明存在多项式规模稀疏子网络逼近原网络性能。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P._arxiv_id: Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: Pruning is All You Need.

DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度神经网络参数量大、推理开销高的问题，提出DropNet迭代剪枝方法，通过逐轮移除对损失影响最小的神经元/连接并微调来压缩网络。相比一次性剪枝，迭代式移除配合重训练能更好地保持精度，在MNIST等基准上以显著更少的参数维持了与原网络相当的准确率。方法思路简洁、实现直接，但实验规模偏小，未在大规模检测/自动驾驶模型上验证。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter count and inference cost of deep networks by proposing DropNet, an iterative pruning scheme that progressively removes the least influential neurons/connections followed by fine-tuning. Compared with one-shot pruning, the iterative removal with retraining better preserves accuracy, achieving comparable performance with substantially fewer parameters on benchmarks such as MNIST. The approach is simple and effective, though experiments remain small-scale and are not validated on large detection or autonomous-driving models.
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.assessment: 剪枝方向的基础性工作，思路清晰，但实验规模有限，对检测/自动驾驶大模型的直接参考价值一般。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.contribution: 提出迭代式剪枝框架DropNet，通过多轮移除低贡献单元并微调实现网络压缩。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.innovation: 将剪枝从一次性操作改为迭代渐进过程，缓解精度损失。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.result: 在多个小规模基准上以大幅减少的参数维持了接近原始网络的精度。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex._arxiv_id: DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complexity via Iterative Pruning.

Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_cn: 该论文针对剪枝后子网络性能缺乏理论保证的问题，提出基于贪心前向选择的剪枝方法，从理论上证明存在性能良好的稀疏子网络，并给出可证明的近似保证。方法通过贪心策略逐层/逐单元选择对目标函数贡献最大的子结构，避免了对全部子网络的穷举搜索。相比经验性剪枝，该工作提供了理论支撑，并在实验中验证了贪心选择得到的子网络在相同稀疏度下优于随机与幅度剪枝基线。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of theoretical guarantees for pruned subnetworks by proposing a greedy forward selection pruning method, proving that good subnetworks provably exist and providing approximation guarantees. The method greedily selects the most contributive substructures layer by layer, avoiding exhaustive search over subnetworks. Compared with empirical pruning, it offers theoretical grounding and empirically outperforms random and magnitude-based baselines at matched sparsity.
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.assessment: 为剪枝提供了可证明的理论保证，兼具方法与理论价值，对模型压缩研究者有较强参考意义。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.contribution: 提出贪心前向选择剪枝算法，并证明存在性能有保证的稀疏子网络。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.innovation: 将子网络存在性从经验观察提升为可证明结论，并给出贪心近似算法。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.result: 在相同稀疏度下，所得子网络性能优于随机剪枝与幅度剪枝基线。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning._arxiv_id: Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning via Greedy Forward Selection.

Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_cn: 该论文针对离散数据（图、图像等）上随机平滑鲁棒性证书计算代价高的问题，提出稀疏感知的随机平滑方法，利用离散域的稀疏结构高效计算鲁棒性证书。相比面向连续输入的经典随机平滑，该方法在图与离散图像等场景下显著降低了证书计算开销，同时保持证书有效性。工作偏理论/鲁棒性认证方向，与检测和自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of randomized-smoothing robustness certificates on discrete data (graphs, images) by proposing a sparsity-aware randomized smoothing method that exploits discrete-domain sparsity to compute certificates efficiently. Compared with classical randomized smoothing for continuous inputs, it substantially reduces certification cost on graphs and discrete images while preserving certificate validity. The work is largely theoretical/certification-oriented and only weakly related to detection and autonomous-driving perception.
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.assessment: 鲁棒性认证方向的理论工作，方法有针对性，但与目标检测/自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.contribution: 提出面向离散数据的稀疏感知随机平滑鲁棒性认证方法。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.innovation: 利用离散域的稀疏结构降低随机平滑证书的计算复杂度。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.result: 在图与离散图像等任务上以更低开销获得有效鲁棒性证书。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di._arxiv_id: Efficient Robustness Certificates for Discrete Data: Sparsity-Aware Randomized Smoothing for Graphs, Images and More.

Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_cn: 该论文研究矩阵流（matrix stream）模型下的Schatten范数估计问题，针对数据以流式方式到达、维度极大的场景，提出利用稀疏性绕过维度依赖的算法。相比传统需要存储整个矩阵或依赖维度多项式复杂度的方法，该工作给出与稀疏度相关而非维度相关的空间与时间界。属于理论算法/流式计算方向，与视觉感知和自动驾驶研究基本无关。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_en: This paper studies Schatten norm estimation in the matrix streaming model, where data arrives as a stream and dimensions are huge, proposing algorithms that exploit sparsity to bypass dimension dependence. Compared with methods requiring full matrix storage or dimension-polynomial complexity, it achieves bounds depending on sparsity rather than dimension. The work is theoretical streaming-algorithms research and is essentially unrelated to visual perception or autonomous driving.
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.assessment: 纯理论流式算法工作，与视觉/自动驾驶领域几乎无交集，仅对稀疏计算理论感兴趣的读者有价值。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.contribution: 在矩阵流模型下给出稀疏性驱动的Schatten范数估计算法。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.innovation: 将复杂度从维度依赖转为稀疏度依赖，突破高维流式场景限制。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.result: 获得与稀疏度相关而非维度相关的空间与时间复杂度界。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello._arxiv_id: Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello Sparsity, Goodbye Dimension.

2103.16788|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对有限内存下的类增量学习问题，旨在提升稳定性-可塑性权衡。作者提出两阶段学习框架DER，在每个增量步骤冻结旧表征并用新的可学习特征提取器扩展特征维度，同时通过通道级掩码剪枝策略根据新概念复杂度动态扩展表征，并引入辅助损失鼓励学习多样且具判别性的特征。相比已有增量学习方法，DER能更好地整合新视觉概念并保留旧知识。在三个类增量学习基准上，该方法以较大幅度持续超越其他方法。
2103.16788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class incremental learning under limited memory, aiming to improve the stability-plasticity trade-off. It proposes a two-stage approach, DER, which freezes the previously learned representation and augments it with new feature dimensions from a learnable extractor, while dynamically expanding the representation via a channel-level mask-based pruning strategy and an auxiliary loss for diverse discriminative features. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show consistent and large-margin improvements over prior methods.
2103.16788|v2.assessment: 该工作为增量学习提供了简洁有效的动态扩展表征思路，实验充分且提升显著，对持续学习与视觉感知系统长期部署有参考价值。
2103.16788|v2.contribution: 提出动态可扩展表征的两阶段类增量学习框架DER。
2103.16788|v2.innovation: 利用通道级掩码剪枝按新概念复杂度动态扩展特征维度，并辅以多样性判别损失。
2103.16788|v2.result: 在三个类增量学习基准上以较大幅度持续超越现有方法。

Network Pruning via Performance Maximiza.summary_cn: 该论文关注网络剪枝问题，提出以性能最大化为目标的剪枝方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法细节、与已有工作的对比以及实验数据。仅从标题可推断其试图在剪枝过程中直接优化模型性能而非仅依赖启发式重要性指标。整体信息不足，难以评估其实际效果。
Network Pruning via Performance Maximiza.summary_en: This paper targets network pruning via performance maximization. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method, comparisons, and experimental results cannot be verified. From the title, it likely optimizes model performance directly during pruning rather than relying solely on heuristic importance criteria.
Network Pruning via Performance Maximiza.assessment: 主题与模型压缩相关，但摘要缺失导致无法判断方法质量与实验充分度，需获取全文后再评估。
Network Pruning via Performance Maximiza.contribution: 提出以性能最大化为导向的网络剪枝方法（细节待确认）。
Network Pruning via Performance Maximiza.innovation: 可能将剪枝目标直接与性能优化关联（细节待确认）。
Network Pruning via Performance Maximiza.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。

2011.14563|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对稀疏且分布不均的候选对应点中真假匹配难以区分的问题，研究运动一致性建模以进行对应点剪枝。作者提出Laplacian Motion Coherence Network (LMCNet)，将一致运动拟合表述为对应点图上的平滑函数，并证明可通过图拉普拉斯获得闭式解，从而设计可微分层捕获全局运动一致性，再与局部层提取的局部一致性结合检测内点。在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝任务上，LMCNet优于现有最先进方法。
2011.14563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles correspondence pruning by modeling motion coherence on sparse, unevenly distributed putative correspondences. It proposes LMCNet, which formulates coherent motion fitting as a smooth function on a correspondence graph with a closed-form graph Laplacian solution, enabling a differentiable layer for global coherence that is combined with a local layer. Experiments show superior performance over state of the art in relative camera pose estimation and dynamic-scene correspondence pruning.
2011.14563|v2.assessment: 该工作将图拉普拉斯闭式解引入可微分运动一致性学习，方法优雅，对SLAM、位姿估计等几何视觉任务有参考意义。
2011.14563|v2.contribution: 提出基于图拉普拉斯闭式解的可微分运动一致性网络LMCNet用于对应点剪枝。
2011.14563|v2.innovation: 将一致运动拟合转化为对应点图上的平滑函数并导出闭式可微分实现。
2011.14563|v2.result: 在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上超越现有最先进方法。

Manifold Regularized Dynamic Network Pru.summary_en: This paper studies dynamic network pruning with manifold regularization. Due to the missing abstract, the technical details, differences from existing dynamic pruning methods, and experimental results cannot be verified. The title suggests using manifold constraints on features or parameters to improve pruning stability and generalization.
Manifold Regularized Dynamic Network Pru.assessment: 动态剪枝与流形正则化结合具有一定新意，但摘要缺失使评估受限，需全文确认方法有效性。
Manifold Regularized Dynamic Network Pru.contribution: 提出流形正则化的动态网络剪枝方法（细节待确认）。

Convolutional Neural Network Pruning Wit.summary_cn: 该论文关注卷积神经网络剪枝中的结构冗余问题，提出结构冗余约简方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体冗余度量方式、剪枝流程及实验对比。从标题推测，其可能通过识别并去除卷积结构中的冗余通道或滤波器来压缩模型。整体信息不足，难以判断其相对已有结构化剪枝方法的优势。
Convolutional Neural Network Pruning Wit.summary_en: This paper addresses structural redundancy reduction for convolutional neural network pruning. Due to the missing abstract, the redundancy metric, pruning pipeline, and experimental comparisons cannot be verified. The title suggests removing redundant channels or filters in convolutional structures for model compression.
Convolutional Neural Network Pruning Wit.assessment: 结构化剪枝是模型压缩的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实验充分度。
Convolutional Neural Network Pruning Wit.contribution: 提出面向卷积神经网络的结构冗余约简剪枝方法（细节待确认）。
Convolutional Neural Network Pruning Wit.innovation: 可能从结构冗余角度设计剪枝准则（细节待确认）。

Multi-Decoding Deraining Network and Qua.summary_cn: 该论文研究图像去雨问题，提出多解码去雨网络及基于准稀疏性的训练策略。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其网络结构细节、准稀疏性训练的具体形式以及定量实验结果。从标题推测，其可能通过多个解码分支处理不同尺度或类型的雨痕，并利用准稀疏约束提升去雨效果。整体信息不足，难以评估其相对现有去雨方法的改进。
Multi-Decoding Deraining Network and Qua.summary_en: This paper studies image deraining with a multi-decoding network and quasi-sparsity based training. Due to the missing abstract, the network architecture, quasi-sparsity formulation, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The title suggests multiple decoding branches for rain streak removal with quasi-sparsity constraints.
Multi-Decoding Deraining Network and Qua.assessment: 去雨属于底层视觉任务，与自动驾驶感知有一定关联，但摘要缺失使评估受限，需全文确认效果。
Multi-Decoding Deraining Network and Qua.contribution: 提出多解码去雨网络及准稀疏性训练策略（细节待确认）。
Multi-Decoding Deraining Network and Qua.innovation: 可能将准稀疏性约束引入多解码去雨训练（细节待确认）。
Multi-Decoding Deraining Network and Qua.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。

Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像超分辨率（SR）模型计算量大、难以高效推理的问题，提出在SR网络中引入稀疏化以加速推理。方法上通过分析SR网络中不同层的冗余性，设计稀疏化策略对卷积核或通道进行剪枝，并结合稀疏卷积实现实际加速。相比已有SR压缩工作，其改进在于更细粒度地探索稀疏性对SR重建质量与速度的权衡。实验在多个SR基准和网络上取得加速效果，同时保持可比的PSNR/SSIM，具体数值需参见原文。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of image super-resolution (SR) models by exploring sparsity for efficient inference. It analyzes layer-wise redundancy in SR networks and designs sparsification strategies over kernels/channels, leveraging sparse convolutions for practical speedup. Compared with prior SR compression work, it provides a finer-grained trade-off between reconstruction quality and speed, achieving acceleration on multiple SR benchmarks with comparable PSNR/SSIM.
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.assessment: 对SR加速与稀疏推理有参考价值，但与自动驾驶/3D感知领域关联较弱。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.contribution: 提出面向图像超分辨率的稀疏化推理方案以降低计算量。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.innovation: 针对SR网络结构特点设计细粒度稀疏策略并结合稀疏卷积实现加速。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.result: 在多个SR基准上实现推理加速并保持可比的超分质量。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu._arxiv_id: Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolution for Efficient Inference.

Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中全局稀疏度难以有效分配的问题，提出带全局稀疏约束的网络稀疏化方法。方法通过全局稀疏约束统一控制整体稀疏预算，并在此约束下优化各层/各权重的稀疏分配，从而避免逐层手工设定稀疏率。相比传统逐层剪枝，其改进在于以全局视角实现更优的稀疏-精度权衡。实验在多种网络与数据集上验证了在相同全局稀疏度下精度优于基线方法。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of allocating sparsity across layers in neural network pruning by proposing a global sparsity-constrained sparsification method. It enforces a unified global sparsity budget and optimizes the distribution of sparsity among layers/weights, avoiding manual per-layer sparsity ratios. Experiments across various networks and datasets show improved accuracy over baselines under the same global sparsity.
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.assessment: 全局稀疏约束思路清晰，对模型压缩研究者有参考意义，但与感知任务直接相关性有限。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出带全局稀疏约束的神经网络稀疏化方法。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.innovation: 以全局稀疏预算替代逐层手工稀疏率，实现更优的稀疏分配。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.result: 在相同全局稀疏度下取得优于基线的精度表现。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo._arxiv_id: Effective Sparsification of Neural Networks With Global Sparsity Constraint.

Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端实时超分辨率难以兼顾速度与质量的问题，提出联合神经架构搜索与剪枝搜索的方案。方法将架构搜索与剪枝策略纳入统一搜索空间，自动寻找适合移动端部署的高效SR网络。相比单独使用NAS或剪枝，其改进在于联合优化架构与稀疏结构以适配移动硬件。实验在移动端实现实时超分，并在速度与重建质量上优于已有轻量SR方法。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_en: This paper targets on-mobile real-time super-resolution by jointly searching neural architectures and pruning strategies. It integrates architecture search and pruning into a unified search space to find efficient SR networks suitable for mobile deployment. Compared with using NAS or pruning alone, the joint optimization better adapts to mobile hardware, achieving real-time SR with improved speed-quality trade-offs over prior lightweight methods.
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.assessment: NAS与剪枝联合优化对高效视觉模型部署有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联一般。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.contribution: 提出联合神经架构与剪枝搜索的移动端实时超分方案。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.innovation: 将架构搜索与剪枝搜索统一到同一搜索空间以适配移动端。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.result: 在移动端实现实时超分并在速度-质量权衡上优于已有方法。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso._arxiv_id: Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Resolution with Neural Architecture and Pruning Search.

ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统CNN剪枝中“记忆”（保留重要权重）与“遗忘”（移除冗余权重）耦合导致精度损失的问题，提出ResRep方法将二者解耦。方法通过重参数化将剪枝过程分解为记忆与遗忘两个独立部分，在训练后可将剪枝结构无损融合回原网络。相比已有剪枝方法，其改进在于实现无损剪枝，即剪枝后精度不下降甚至提升。实验在ResNet、MobileNet等网络上验证了无损剪枝效果，显著优于基线。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_en: This paper addresses the coupling of remembering (preserving important weights) and forgetting (removing redundant weights) in CNN pruning, proposing ResRep to decouple them. It reparameterizes pruning into independent remembering and forgetting components that can be losslessly fused back after training. Compared with prior pruning methods, ResRep achieves lossless pruning with no accuracy drop (or even gains), validated on ResNet and MobileNet with clear improvements over baselines.
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.assessment: 无损剪枝思路新颖且实用，对高效模型部署有较高参考价值。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.contribution: 提出解耦记忆与遗忘的无损CNN剪枝方法ResRep。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.innovation: 通过重参数化将剪枝分解为可独立优化的记忆与遗忘部分。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.result: 在多种网络上实现无损剪枝，精度不降甚至提升。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl._arxiv_id: ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupling Remembering and Forgetting.

GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于门控的神经网络剪枝训练不稳定、门控难以收敛到明确0/1状态的问题，提出GDP方法。方法引入可微分极化机制，使门控变量在训练中逐渐极化到0或1，从而稳定剪枝过程并获得更明确的稀疏结构。相比已有门控剪枝方法，其改进在于提升训练稳定性与剪枝决策的确定性。实验在多种网络与数据集上验证了在相同稀疏度下精度优于基线。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_en: This paper tackles the instability of gate-based neural network pruning, where gates struggle to converge to clear 0/1 states. It proposes GDP, which introduces differentiable polarization to drive gates toward binary values, stabilizing pruning and yielding clearer sparse structures. Compared with prior gate-based pruning, GDP improves training stability and pruning determinism, achieving better accuracy under the same sparsity across networks and datasets.
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.assessment: 可微分极化门控对稳定剪枝有方法价值，但与感知任务直接相关性有限。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.contribution: 提出基于可微分极化门控的稳定神经网络剪枝方法GDP。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.innovation: 通过可微分极化机制使门控收敛到明确0/1状态以稳定剪枝。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.result: 在相同稀疏度下取得优于基线的精度并提升训练稳定性。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v._arxiv_id: GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning via Gates with Differentiable Polarization.

Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中如何自动确定各层稀疏结构的问题，提出基于自动图编码器-解码器的剪枝方法。方法将网络结构建模为图，利用图编码器-解码器自动学习并生成剪枝后的子网络结构。相比手工或启发式剪枝，其改进在于以图学习方式自动搜索剪枝结构。实验在多种网络上验证了在压缩率与精度上的有效性。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses automatic determination of layer-wise sparsity structures in neural network pruning by proposing an auto graph encoder-decoder approach. It models the network as a graph and uses a graph encoder-decoder to learn and generate pruned subnetworks. Compared with manual or heuristic pruning, it automates structure search via graph learning, showing effectiveness in compression rate and accuracy across networks.
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.assessment: 图学习驱动的剪枝思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.contribution: 提出基于自动图编码器-解码器的神经网络剪枝方法。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.innovation: 将网络建模为图并用图编码器-解码器自动生成剪枝结构。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.result: 在多种网络上验证了压缩率与精度上的有效性。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne._arxiv_id: Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Network Pruning.

Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对特征匹配中大量外点导致对应关系估计不准确的问题，提出了一种基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝方法。方法通过迭代地学习局部共识并逐步剔除错误匹配，从而在保持内点的同时提升匹配精度。相比已有的一次性剪枝或固定阈值方法，该工作能够自适应地处理不同外点比例的匹配场景。在多个标准匹配基准上取得了优于现有方法的匹配精度和鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of inaccurate correspondence estimation caused by a large number of outliers in feature matching. It proposes a progressive correspondence pruning method based on consensus learning, which iteratively learns local consensus and removes false matches. Compared with existing one-shot pruning or fixed-threshold methods, it adaptively handles varying outlier ratios and achieves superior matching accuracy and robustness on standard benchmarks.
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.assessment: 该工作为特征匹配中的外点剔除提供了有效的渐进式方案，对视觉SLAM和三维重建有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.contribution: 提出基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝框架，有效提升特征匹配的鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.innovation: 将共识学习与渐进式剪枝结合，自适应地迭代剔除错误匹配。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.result: 在多个匹配基准上取得了优于现有方法的匹配精度和鲁棒性。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co._arxiv_id: Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Consensus Learning.

Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（Cryo-ET）体积图像去噪中缺乏干净参考数据的问题，提出了一种仅从单张噪声体积图像进行自监督恢复的方法。方法引入稀疏性约束，利用噪声图像自身的统计特性构建自监督训练信号，无需配对或干净数据。相比已有的监督或需要多帧输入的方法，该工作显著降低了数据获取门槛。在Cryo-ET数据集上取得了有效的去噪和恢复效果。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_en: This paper tackles volumetric image restoration for cryo-electron tomography (Cryo-ET) without clean references. It proposes a self-supervised method that restores a single noisy volume with a sparsity constraint, eliminating the need for paired or clean data. Compared with supervised or multi-frame approaches, it lowers data requirements and achieves effective denoising and restoration on Cryo-ET datasets.
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习应用于生物医学成像领域，方法有创新性，但与自动驾驶感知领域几乎不相关。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.contribution: 提出单噪声体积自监督恢复方法，结合稀疏性约束实现Cryo-ET图像去噪。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.innovation: 利用稀疏性约束从单张噪声体积中构建自监督信号，无需干净参考数据。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.result: 在Cryo-ET数据集上实现了有效的体积图像去噪和恢复。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography Volumetric Image Restoration from Single Noisy Volume with Sparsity Constraint.

Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中计算资源受限的问题，提出了一种在线多粒度蒸馏方法。方法在训练过程中同时从多个粒度（如像素级、特征级、判别器级）进行知识蒸馏，实现在线联合优化生成器和压缩模型。相比已有的离线或单粒度蒸馏方法，该工作能够更充分地传递知识并提升压缩后GAN的生成质量。在多个GAN压缩基准上取得了优于现有方法的FID和压缩比。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_en: This paper addresses GAN compression under limited computational resources by proposing an online multi-granularity distillation method. It simultaneously distills knowledge at multiple granularities (e.g., pixel, feature, and discriminator levels) during training to jointly optimize the generator and compressed model. Compared with offline or single-granularity distillation, it transfers knowledge more effectively and improves the quality of compressed GANs, achieving better FID and compression ratios on benchmarks.
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.assessment: 该工作为GAN压缩提供了有效的多粒度蒸馏方案，对模型轻量化有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.contribution: 提出在线多粒度蒸馏框架，实现GAN的高效压缩。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.innovation: 在训练过程中同时从多个粒度进行在线知识蒸馏，联合优化生成器与压缩模型。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.result: 在多个GAN压缩基准上取得了优于现有方法的FID和压缩比。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo._arxiv_id: Online Multi-Granularity Distillation for GAN Compression.

2102.11535|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中需要大量训练和评估导致资源消耗巨大的问题，提出了无需训练的NAS框架TE-NAS。方法通过分析神经正切核（NTK）的谱和输入空间中线性区域的数量来对架构进行排序，这两个指标分别反映网络的可训练性和表达能力，且无需任何训练和标签即可计算。相比需要训练超网或大量架构评估的现有方法，TE-NAS在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS搜索空间上仅需4个GPU小时即可完成搜索，且找到的架构性能具有竞争力。
2102.11535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy resource consumption in NAS caused by extensive training and architecture evaluation by proposing a training-free framework called TE-NAS. It ranks architectures by analyzing the spectrum of the neural tangent kernel (NTK) and the number of linear regions in the input space, which reflect trainability and expressivity and can be computed without any training or labels. Compared with methods requiring supernet training or intensive evaluations, TE-NAS completes search in four GPU hours on NAS-Bench-201 and DARTS spaces with competitive architecture performance.
2102.11535|v2.assessment: 该工作从理论角度出发实现了无需训练的NAS，大幅降低搜索成本，对自动化模型设计有重要参考价值。
2102.11535|v2.contribution: 提出基于NTK谱和线性区域数的无训练NAS框架TE-NAS，实现高效架构搜索。
2102.11535|v2.innovation: 利用NTK谱和线性区域数量作为无需训练的性能代理指标，并设计基于剪枝的搜索机制。
2102.11535|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS上仅需4个GPU小时完成搜索，找到的架构性能具有竞争力。

2103.09377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对二值神经网络训练困难和彩票假设中寻找高性能子网络代价高的问题，提出了多奖彩票假设（MPT）。该假设证明充分过参数化的随机权重网络包含多个子网络，这些子网络无需进一步训练即可达到与训练后稠密网络相当的精度，且对极端量化（二值权重/激活）具有鲁棒性。方法通过剪枝和量化随机权重网络来直接获得紧凑且高精度的二值网络，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上验证了有效性。
2103.09377|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of training binary neural networks and the high cost of finding high-performing subnetworks in the lottery ticket hypothesis by proposing the Multi-Prize Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (MPT). It proves that a sufficiently over-parameterized randomly weighted network contains subnetworks that achieve accuracy comparable to a trained dense network without further training and are robust to extreme quantization. The proposed algorithm finds MPTs by pruning and quantizing randomly weighted networks, validated on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.
2103.09377|v2.assessment: 该工作为二值神经网络和网络剪枝提供了新的理论视角和实用方法，对模型压缩领域有重要启发。
2103.09377|v2.contribution: 提出多奖彩票假设，证明随机权重网络中存在无需训练且抗量化的高性能子网络。
2103.09377|v2.innovation: 将彩票假设扩展到多奖设定，结合剪枝与量化直接从随机权重网络获得二值网络。
2103.09377|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上验证了无需训练即可获得与稠密网络精度相当的二值子网络。

2009.08576|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对初始化时剪枝方法（如SNIP、GraSP、SynFlow）性能不及训练后剪枝的问题，系统分析了其原因。作者发现，随机打乱这些方法在每层内剪枝的权重或采样新的初始值反而能保持或提升精度，说明这些方法的逐权重剪枝决策可被逐层的剪枝比例选择所替代。这一发现揭示了初始化剪枝启发式方法的内在挑战，表明当前方法可能并未真正捕捉到权重的重要性。
2009.08576|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why pruning-at-initialization methods such as SNIP, GraSP, and SynFlow underperform magnitude pruning after training. The authors show that randomly shuffling the pruned weights within each layer or sampling new initial values preserves or improves accuracy, indicating that per-weight pruning decisions can be replaced by a per-layer choice of pruning fraction. This finding reveals fundamental challenges in initialization-time pruning heuristics and suggests they may not truly capture weight importance.
2009.08576|v2.assessment: 该工作对初始化剪枝方法进行了深入反思和批判性分析，对网络剪枝领域的后续研究有重要指导意义。
2009.08576|v2.contribution: 系统分析并揭示了初始化时剪枝方法性能不佳的原因，指出逐权重剪枝决策可被逐层比例选择替代。
2009.08576|v2.innovation: 通过随机打乱和重采样实验，证明现有初始化剪枝方法的逐权重决策并不比逐层比例选择更有效。
2009.08576|v2.result: 实验表明初始化剪枝方法精度低于训练后幅度剪枝，且其逐权重决策可被更简单的逐层策略替代。

Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对初始化阶段剪枝（Pruning at Initialization, PaI）在极端稀疏度下性能不稳定、对超参敏感的问题，提出了一种鲁棒的初始化剪枝方法。作者通过分析现有基于梯度/幅度的打分准则在初始化时的噪声与尺度偏差，设计了更稳定的重要性度量与剪枝流程，以缓解随机初始化带来的评分不可靠问题。相比已有 PaI 方法（如 SNIP、GraSP），该方法在保持高稀疏率的同时提升了训练后的精度与跨数据集/架构的鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多个基准上优于现有初始化剪枝基线。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability and hyperparameter sensitivity of pruning-at-initialization (PaI) under extreme sparsity. It proposes a robust importance criterion and pruning procedure that mitigates noisy and scale-biased scores caused by random initialization. Compared with prior PaI methods such as SNIP and GraSP, it improves post-training accuracy and cross-dataset/architecture robustness at high sparsity levels, though the abstract does not report specific numbers.
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.assessment: 对关注网络压缩与稀疏训练的研究者有参考价值，但属于通用剪枝方法，与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.contribution: 提出了一种在初始化阶段更鲁棒的剪枝准则与流程，缓解了随机初始化导致的评分不可靠问题。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.innovation: 从初始化噪声与尺度偏差角度重新设计重要性度量，提升了极端稀疏下的稳定性。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.result: 在多个基准上于高稀疏率下优于 SNIP、GraSP 等初始化剪枝基线，精度与鲁棒性均有提升。

2105.03193|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对剪枝后重训练中权重回卷（weight rewinding）与学习率回卷（learning rate rewinding）为何有效这一未解问题展开研究。作者通过大量实验分析发现，学习率回卷成功的关键在于使用了较大的学习率，类似现象也出现在 1-cycle 等含大学习率的调度中。基于此，论文提出在重训练中采用合适的学习率调度，并展示了一个反直觉现象：随机剪枝网络在正确调度下甚至可超过按传统方式微调的方法化剪枝网络。结果强调了学习率调度在剪枝网络重训练中的关键作用。
2105.03193|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why weight rewinding and learning rate rewinding outperform conventional fine-tuning when retraining pruned networks. Through extensive experiments, the authors identify the use of a large learning rate as the key factor behind learning rate rewinding's success, a phenomenon also observed in other schedules involving large learning rates such as 1-cycle. Leveraging an appropriate learning rate schedule, they show the counter-intuitive result that randomly pruned networks can even outperform methodically pruned ones fine-tuned conventionally, highlighting the criticality of the learning rate schedule in retraining.
2105.03193|v2.assessment: 对剪枝与稀疏训练实践有直接指导意义，揭示了重训练调度的关键作用，但属于通用压缩方法，与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2105.03193|v2.contribution: 系统分析了学习率回卷有效的根本原因，并证明合适的学习率调度可显著提升剪枝网络重训练效果。
2105.03193|v2.innovation: 揭示大学习率是学习率回卷成功的关键，并展示随机剪枝在正确调度下可超越方法化剪枝的反直觉现象。
2105.03193|v2.result: 在合适学习率调度下，随机剪枝网络的重训练精度可超过传统微调的方法化剪枝网络。

Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于幅度的剪枝中全局统一稀疏率忽略各层敏感度差异的问题，提出了层自适应稀疏度分配方法。作者从理论上分析了剪枝对网络输出的影响，推导出各层应分配的稀疏度与其参数规模及敏感度相关的准则，从而在总稀疏率约束下实现更合理的逐层稀疏分配。相比全局统一或启发式逐层剪枝，该方法在相同压缩率下取得更高的精度，且计算开销低、易于集成到现有幅度剪枝流程中。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多个网络与数据集上一致优于基线。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of magnitude-based pruning that applies a uniform global sparsity, ignoring layer-wise sensitivity differences. The authors theoretically analyze the effect of pruning on network output and derive a criterion that allocates sparsity to each layer according to its parameter size and sensitivity under a global sparsity constraint. Compared with uniform or heuristic layer-wise pruning, the method achieves higher accuracy at the same compression rate with low computational overhead and easy integration into existing magnitude-pruning pipelines.
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.assessment: 为幅度剪枝提供了有理论依据的逐层稀疏分配方案，实用性强，但属于通用压缩方法，与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.contribution: 提出了一种基于理论分析的层自适应稀疏度分配准则，用于改进基于幅度的剪枝。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.innovation: 从剪枝对网络输出的影响出发推导逐层稀疏度分配，替代全局统一稀疏率。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.result: 在相同压缩率下于多个网络与数据集上一致优于全局统一及启发式逐层剪枝基线。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud._arxiv_id: Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitude-based Pruning.

2210.06707|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模预训练ViT在资源受限设备上计算与内存开销大的问题，本文通过实证分析发现低比特量化自注意力图的信息失真是性能下降的瓶颈。为此提出信息校正模块（IRM）与分布引导蒸馏（DGD）方案，实现全量化低比特ViT。在DeiT和Swin骨干上，Q-ViT显著优于已有量化方法，例如理论上可将ViT-S加速6倍以上并保持精度。
2210.06707|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies information distortion in low-bit quantized self-attention maps as the bottleneck of low-bit ViTs. It proposes an Information Rectification Module (IRM) and a Distribution Guided Distillation (DGD) scheme for fully quantized ViTs. Experiments on DeiT and Swin show substantial gains over prior quantization methods, e.g., theoretically accelerating ViT-S by over 6x.
2210.06707|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了ViT低比特量化的瓶颈并给出有效校正与蒸馏方案，对模型压缩与高效ViT部署有参考价值。
2210.06707|v2.contribution: 提出IRM与DGD实现全量化低比特ViT，缓解自注意力图信息失真。
2210.06707|v2.innovation: 首次定位低比特ViT性能下降源于自注意力图信息失真，并用信息校正与分布引导蒸馏联合解决。
2210.06707|v2.result: 在DeiT/Swin上大幅超越已有量化方法，理论上可加速ViT-S 6倍以上。

2203.09931|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模非结构化3D点云属性（颜色、反射率等）存储开销大的问题，本文提出深度压缩网络3DAC。方法先将属性转换为变换系数，再用深度熵模型结合属性变换与已编码属性信息估计系数概率，最终压缩为属性比特流。在ScanNet与SemanticKITTI上取得更优压缩率与重建质量。
2203.09931|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses attribute compression for large-scale unstructured point clouds. It proposes 3DAC, a deep compression network that converts attributes into transform coefficients and models their probabilities with a deep entropy model. Experiments on ScanNet and SemanticKITTI demonstrate superior compression rates and reconstruction quality.
2203.09931|v2.assessment: 属于点云压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知中的检测/BEV等任务关联较弱，但点云数据表示与压缩对大规模数据管理有间接价值。
2203.09931|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度点云属性压缩网络3DAC。
2203.09931|v2.innovation: 利用属性变换与已编码属性信息构建深度熵模型来估计系数概率。
2203.09931|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI上实现更优压缩率与重建质量。

2204.12684|v2.summary_cn: 现有深度点云压缩方法忽略了局部密度对细节表示的重要性，本文提出一种保持局部密度的自编码器式压缩方法。编码器下采样并学习逐点特征，解码器利用密度嵌入、局部位置嵌入与祖先嵌入上采样，并显式预测上采样因子、方向与尺度，同时设计子点卷积层与自适应尺度上采样块。在SemanticKITTI与ShapeNet上取得最优率失真权衡，并可压缩法向量等逐点属性。
2204.12684|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a density-preserving deep point cloud compression method in an auto-encoder fashion. It encodes local geometry and density via density, local position, and ancestor embeddings, and decodes with explicit upsampling factor prediction plus a sub-point convolution layer. It achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion trade-off on SemanticKITTI and ShapeNet.
2204.12684|v2.assessment: 点云压缩方向，与感知检测任务相关性有限，但密度保持与上采样设计对点云表示学习有借鉴意义。
2204.12684|v2.contribution: 提出保持局部密度的深度点云压缩自编码器。
2204.12684|v2.innovation: 引入密度/局部位置/祖先三种嵌入并显式预测上采样因子与尺度。
2204.12684|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI与ShapeNet上达到最优率失真权衡。

2202.10203|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中任务间参数干扰导致的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出稀疏神经网络SNCL，在所有层神经元激活上施加变分贝叶斯稀疏先验，仅为当前与过去任务激活稀疏神经元，为未来任务保留参数空间。结合全经验回放（FER）与损失感知蓄水池采样维护记忆缓冲区。方法对网络结构与任务边界不敏感，可有效缓解跨任务干扰。
2202.10203|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing SNCL, which imposes variational Bayesian sparsity priors on neuron activations to activate only sparse neurons per task. It combines Full Experience Replay with a loss-aware reservoir-sampling strategy. The method is agnostic to network structures and task boundaries and mitigates cross-task interference.
2202.10203|v2.assessment: 持续学习方法对自动驾驶中不断新增场景/类别的在线学习有潜在价值，稀疏激活思路清晰。
2202.10203|v2.contribution: 提出基于变分贝叶斯稀疏先验与全经验回放的持续学习框架SNCL。
2202.10203|v2.innovation: 通过稀疏神经元激活为未来任务保留容量，并设计损失感知蓄水池采样。
2202.10203|v2.result: 有效缓解跨任务干扰与灾难性遗忘，且不依赖特定网络结构或任务边界。

2110.08232|v2.summary_cn: 针对动态剪枝中连续通道门控需平衡任务损失与稀疏正则、且难以预先估计计算预算的问题，本文提出解耦任务损失与剪枝损失，并支持训练前估计FLOPs缩减。受Hebbian理论启发，基于前一层激活预测当前层top-k滤波器的掩码，将问题建模为自监督二分类，k由热力图质量动态估计。方法简化了超参选择并实现输入自适应的动态剪枝。
2110.08232|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a dynamic pruning approach that decouples task and pruning losses and enables FLOPs reduction estimation before training. Inspired by Hebbian theory, it predicts a mask for top-k filters based on previous-layer activations as a self-supervised binary classification problem, with k dynamically estimated per input. This simplifies hyperparameter selection and achieves input-adaptive pruning.
2110.08232|v2.assessment: 动态剪枝对自动驾驶模型部署效率有实际意义，解耦损失与可预估FLOPs的设计较实用。
2110.08232|v2.contribution: 提出解耦任务与剪枝损失、可预估FLOPs的动态剪枝方法。
2110.08232|v2.innovation: 基于Hebbian思想用自监督掩码预测实现输入自适应top-k滤波器选择。
2110.08232|v2.result: 简化超参选择并支持训练前FLOPs缩减估计，实现动态子网络推理。

2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统剪枝要么在训练后剪枝（推理高效但训练开销大）、要么在初始化时剪枝（省训练成本但性能明显下降）的矛盾，提出一种尽可能早地在训练过程中剪枝的策略。方法先用少量 epoch 的稠密训练快速引导网络结构，通过神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，并引入 Early Pruning Indicator（EPI），基于子网络结构相似度在结构稳定时快速触发剪枝。在 ImageNet 上实验表明 EPI 能快速定位适合剪枝的早期训练阶段，在几乎不损失性能的前提下显著降低训练成本。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning, which is inference-efficient but incurs full training cost, and pruning-at-initialization, which saves training cost but degrades accuracy. It proposes a policy that prunes as early as possible during training by exploiting a few dense warm-up epochs to guide the architecture, continuously ranking neuron importance, and introducing an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) that triggers pruning once the sub-network architecture stabilizes. Experiments on ImageNet show EPI identifies early pruning epochs without hurting performance.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 将剪枝时机作为可学习/可判定的策略问题，EPI 思路对训练加速有实用价值，但实验主要限于 ImageNet 分类，与感知任务关联有限。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出基于子网络结构稳定性的 Early Pruning Indicator，实现训练早期剪枝且不损失性能。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 用子网络架构相似度动态判定剪枝时机，而非固定剪枝点或初始化剪枝。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在 ImageNet 上实现早期剪枝并保持性能，显著降低训练开销。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对标准非结构化剪枝（SP）将滤波器元素置零、从而把滤波器约束在固定子空间并引入强偏置的问题，提出 interspace pruning（IP）。IP 将滤波器表示为自适应滤波器基（FB）的线性组合，在动态 interspace 中表示滤波器，仅将 FB 系数置零，未剪枝系数与基联合训练。论文给出 IP 性能更优的数学论证，并在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上验证 IP 优于 SP，尤其在 ImageNet 剪枝或高稀疏度等困难场景下提升明显，且运行时与参数量开销相同。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the strong bias induced by standard unstructured pruning (SP), which constrains filters to a fixed subspace by zeroing filter elements. It introduces interspace pruning (IP), which represents filters as linear combinations of an adaptive filter basis (FB) and only zeros the FB coefficients while jointly training unpruned coefficients and bases. Mathematical analysis and experiments show IP consistently outperforms SP across state-of-the-art unstructured pruning methods, with the largest gains on ImageNet and at high sparsity, at equal runtime and parameter cost.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 从滤波器参数化角度改进剪枝的通用工具，理论支撑与实验覆盖较扎实，但属于通用剪枝方法，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出基于自适应滤波器基的 interspace pruning 通用框架，可即插即用地增强现有非结构化剪枝方法。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 用动态滤波器基的线性组合替代固定子空间约束，缓解剪枝偏置并提升可训练性。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上均优于 SP，ImageNet 与高稀疏度场景提升尤为显著。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究在无干净训练数据条件下检测被植入 Trojan 后门的 DNN。作者观察到 Trojan 特征在网络剪枝下比良性特征更稳定，据此提出新的检测范式：先定位一个'winning Trojan lottery ticket'子网络，它保留几乎全部 Trojan 信息但在干净输入上仅有随机水平性能，再从该孤立子网络中恢复嵌入的触发器。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 及多种网络架构上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Trojan backdoor detection in DNNs without access to clean training data. Observing that Trojan features are significantly more stable to network pruning than benign features, the authors propose a detection regime that first locates a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket' preserving nearly full Trojan information while achieving only chance-level clean accuracy, then recovers the embedded trigger from this isolated subnetwork. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across various architectures validate the approach.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 将 lottery ticket 假设与后门检测结合的角度新颖，对模型安全与剪枝交叉领域有启发，但与视觉感知任务本身关联不大。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏子网络的 Trojan 检测范式，在无干净数据下定位并恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 发现 Trojan 特征对剪枝的稳定性高于良性特征，并据此构造 winning Trojan lottery ticket。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 多种架构上有效检测 Trojan 网络并恢复触发器。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像复原任务中深度模型计算量大的问题，指出已有 N:M 结构化剪枝未考虑不同层在计算复杂度与性能需求上的差异。作者提出一种新的剪枝方法，为每一层自适应地确定 N:M 结构化稀疏的剪枝比例，从而更好地权衡效率与复原精度。在超分辨率和去模糊任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于已有剪枝方法，并开源了 PyTorch 实现。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of deep models for image restoration, noting that existing N:M structured pruning ignores layer-wise differences in computational complexity and performance requirements. It proposes a pruning method that determines the N:M structured sparsity ratio for each layer adaptively to better trade off efficiency and restoration accuracy. Extensive experiments on super-resolution and deblurring show significant improvements over prior pruning methods.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 面向图像复原的逐层自适应 N:M 剪枝，思路清晰且实验充分，但任务域为底层视觉，与自动驾驶感知的迁移性需进一步验证。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出逐层自适应确定 N:M 结构化稀疏比例的剪枝方法，用于图像复原网络压缩。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 按层分配 N:M 稀疏度以匹配不同层的复杂度与精度需求。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率与去模糊任务上显著优于已有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云 3D 目标检测中点占据固有的稀疏性这一核心挑战，提出 Sparse Window Transformer（SWFormer）。方法将 3D 点转换为稀疏体素与窗口，用 bucketing 方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并通过多尺度特征融合与窗口移位操作在窗口内自注意力之外捕获跨窗口关联；同时提出 voxel diffusion 技术以从稀疏特征中更准确地检测 3D 目标。在 Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集上，车辆与行人 3D 检测取得 73.36 L2 mAPH 的 SOTA 结果，超越所有单阶段与两阶段模型且效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inherent sparsity of point occupancy for 3D object detection by proposing Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer), a scalable and accurate model that converts 3D points into sparse voxels and windows and processes variable-length sparse windows via a bucketing scheme. It captures cross-window correlation through multi-scale feature fusion and window shifting, and introduces a voxel diffusion technique for accurate detection from sparse features. On the Waymo Open Dataset test set it achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH for vehicle and pedestrian detection, outperforming all prior single- and two-stage models while being more efficient.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶点云 3D 检测的高影响力工作，将窗口 Transformer 与稀疏体素结合并在 Waymo 上取得 SOTA，对 BEV/3D 检测方向研究者高度相关。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出稀疏窗口 Transformer 与体素扩散技术，实现高效高精度的点云 3D 目标检测。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 用 bucketing 处理变长稀疏窗口并结合窗口移位与多尺度融合捕获跨窗口关联。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集取得 73.36 L2 mAPH 的 SOTA，超越所有单/两阶段模型且更高效。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究多实例点云配准问题，即估计源点云多个实例在目标点云中的位姿，其难点在于某一实例的内点对应关系会成为其他实例的外点。作者提出 PointCLM 框架，先用对比学习为输入假定对应关系学习分布良好的深度表示，再基于这些表示设计外点剪枝策略与聚类策略，高效剔除外点并将剩余对应关系分配到正确实例。在合成与真实数据集上，该方法大幅超越已有 SOTA。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for all others. It proposes PointCLM, a contrastive learning framework that first learns well-distributed deep representations for putative correspondences, then applies an outlier pruning strategy and a clustering strategy to remove outliers and assign remaining correspondences to correct instances. The method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches by a large margin on both synthetic and real datasets.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 将对比学习引入多实例点云配准并配合外点剪枝与聚类，思路清晰，对 3D 感知中的配准/位姿估计子问题有参考价值。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比学习的多实例点云配准框架 PointCLM，结合外点剪枝与聚类分配实例。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 用对比学习学习对应关系的深度表示，替代耗时的假设采样与空间一致性特征。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上大幅超越已有 SOTA 方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模稀疏点云压缩中熵编码效率不足的问题，本文提出了一种基于八叉树的多级压缩框架。方法上设计了新的熵模型，利用兄弟节点子节点、祖先和邻居的上下文来编码非叶节点的占用信息，并通过体素级几何感知模块局部拟合二次曲面提供几何先验。相比已有基线，该方法在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes数据集上分别实现了11-16%和12-14%的比特率改进，解码阶段采用两步启发式策略提升重建质量。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient compression of large-scale sparse point clouds by proposing an octree-based multi-level framework. It introduces a novel entropy model that exploits sibling, ancestor, and neighbor context to encode occupancy of non-leaf nodes, and a voxel-based geometry-aware module that fits local quadratic surfaces as geometric priors. The method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate improvements on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes, respectively, and uses a two-step heuristic decoding strategy for better reconstruction.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 该工作将几何先验与上下文熵模型结合，在自动驾驶点云压缩上取得了显著比特率提升，对感知数据存储与传输有实用价值。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出了一种融合兄弟上下文与表面先验的八叉树点云压缩框架。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 利用兄弟节点子节点、祖先和邻居上下文构建熵模型，并引入体素级二次曲面拟合提供几何先验。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes上比特率分别改进11-16%和12-14%。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer在人体姿态估计中全局注意力计算开销大的问题，本文提出了Token-Pruned Pose Transformer (PPT)。方法上先定位粗略人体掩码，仅在选定token内进行自注意力，并扩展至多视图姿态估计，提出跨视图的人体区域融合策略。在COCO和MPII上，PPT在保持与先前姿态Transformer方法相当精度的同时减少了计算量；在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上多视图PPT高效融合多视图线索并达到新的最优结果。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: To reduce the computational cost of global attention in vision transformers for human pose estimation, this paper proposes the Token-Pruned Pose Transformer (PPT), which locates a rough human mask and performs self-attention only within selected tokens. It extends PPT to multi-view pose estimation with a human area fusion strategy. Experiments on COCO and MPII show comparable accuracy with reduced computation, and multi-view PPT achieves new state-of-the-art on Human3.6M and Ski-Pose.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: 该工作通过token剪枝有效降低了姿态Transformer的计算量，思路简洁且在多视图融合上有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出了基于token剪枝的姿态Transformer，并扩展至多视图人体姿态估计。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 利用人体掩码进行token选择以降低自注意力计算，并提出跨视图人体区域融合策略。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在COCO和MPII上保持精度并减少计算，在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上取得新的最优结果。

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中灾难性遗忘以及现有方法在稳定性-可塑性权衡或计算存储开销上的不足，本文受梯度提升算法启发，提出了两阶段学习范式FOSTER。方法上先动态扩展新模块以拟合目标模型与原始模型输出之间的残差，再通过有效的蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度，保持单一骨干模型。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000上，该方法在不同设置下均取得了最先进的性能。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning and the limitations of existing methods in the stability-plasticity dilemma or computational overhead, this paper proposes FOSTER, a two-stage learning paradigm inspired by gradient boosting. It first dynamically expands new modules to fit the residuals between the target and the original model's output, then removes redundant parameters and feature dimensions via an effective distillation strategy to maintain a single backbone. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000 show state-of-the-art performance under various settings.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 该工作将梯度提升思想引入类增量学习，通过残差拟合与蒸馏压缩实现高效增量学习，在多个基准上达到SOTA，对持续学习在自动驾驶感知中的应用有参考价值。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出了基于梯度提升启发的两阶段类增量学习范式FOSTER。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 动态扩展模块拟合残差，并结合蒸馏策略压缩冗余以保持单骨干模型。
2204.04662|v2.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000上取得最先进性能。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT训练后量化(PTQ)在低比特下精度严重下降的问题，提出RepQ-ViT框架。该方法将量化与推理过程解耦：量化阶段对post-LayerNorm激活采用通道级量化、对post-Softmax激活采用log√2量化以应对极端分布，推理阶段通过尺度重参数化将复杂量化器简化为硬件友好的层级量化器。相比牺牲量化性能迁就硬件的已有方案，RepQ-ViT同时保证了量化精度与推理效率。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: RepQ-ViT addresses the severe accuracy degradation of post-training quantization for vision transformers in low-bit regimes. It decouples quantization from inference by applying channel-wise quantization to post-LayerNorm activations and log√2 quantization to post-Softmax activations, then reparameterizing the scales into hardware-friendly layer-wise quantizers. Unlike prior methods that sacrifice quantization performance for hardware compatibility, it achieves both accurate quantization and efficient inference.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 量化与推理解耦+尺度重参数化的思路简洁有效，对ViT低比特部署有实用价值，但属于通用模型压缩工作，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出基于量化尺度重参数化的ViT训练后量化框架RepQ-ViT。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 将复杂量化器用于校准、简化量化器用于推理，通过尺度重参数化桥接二者。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低比特ViT量化下显著缓解精度退化，兼顾硬件友好推理。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT计算开销大、现有token剪枝方法因直接丢弃token造成显著信息损失的问题，提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS。TPS先剪枝得到保留与剪除子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配和基于相似度的融合，将被剪token的信息压缩进部分保留token中。相比SOTA方法，TPS在所有剪枝强度下均更优，将DeiT-tiny/small计算预算压缩至35%时，ImageNet分类精度仍比基线高1%-6%。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: To address the information loss caused by discarding tokens in ViT token pruning, this paper proposes a joint Token Pruning and Squeezing module (TPS). TPS first prunes tokens into reserved and pruned subsets, then squeezes the information of pruned tokens into partial reserved tokens via unidirectional nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusing. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all pruning intensities, improving ImageNet accuracy by 1%-6% over baselines when shrinking DeiT-tiny/small budgets to 35%.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 将剪枝与信息压缩结合缓解token丢弃的信息损失，思路清晰且实验充分，对ViT高效部署有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务无直接关联。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS以更高效地压缩ViT。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 通过最近邻匹配与相似度融合将被剪token信息压缩进保留token，而非直接丢弃。
2304.10716|v2.result: 在DeiT-tiny/small压缩至35%预算时，ImageNet精度较基线提升1%-6%。
