2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在GPU硬件上因堆叠自注意力/交叉注意力块而难以加速部署的问题，提出GPUSQ-ViT压缩方案，最大化利用GPU友好的2:4细粒度结构化稀疏与量化。该方法先用2:4结构化剪枝将稠密模型稀疏化（FP16），再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练将浮点稀疏模型量化为定点模型，并在剪枝与量化过程中使用混合策略知识蒸馏。实验表明该方案将ViT模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，并支持监督与无监督学习风格。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of accelerating vision transformers on GPU hardware, this paper proposes GPUSQ-ViT, a compression scheme that maximally exploits GPU-friendly 2:4 fine-grained structured sparsity and quantization. It first prunes a dense model into a 2:4 sparse one under FP16, then quantizes it into a fixed-point model via sparse-distillation-aware quantization-aware training, with mixed-strategy knowledge distillation throughout. Experiments show 6.4-12.7× model size reduction and support for both supervised and unsupervised learning.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 面向GPU实际加速的稀疏+量化联合压缩方案工程性强，2:4结构化稀疏与量化感知训练结合有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务无直接关联。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出联合2:4结构化稀疏与量化的GPU友好ViT压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 将2:4结构化剪枝、稀疏蒸馏感知量化与混合策略知识蒸馏统一到同一压缩流程。
2305.10727|v2.result: ViT模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，并支持监督与无监督学习风格。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT剪枝方法不可解释、忽视模型内部单元与目标类别关系而导致性能次优的问题，提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner。该方法设计可解释性感知掩码，端到端学习以衡量每个可剪枝单元对预测各目标类别的贡献，并基于掩码值自适应搜索逐层阈值以区分剪除与保留单元、确定逐层剪枝率。在DeiT和Swin Transformer上的实验验证了方法的有效性。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: To address the unexplainable nature of existing ViT pruning methods that overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes, this paper proposes X-Pruner, an explainable pruning framework. It learns an explainability-aware mask end-to-end to measure each prunable unit's contribution to predicting each target class, and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds based on mask values to determine pruning rates. Experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer validate its effectiveness.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 将可解释性引入剪枝准则以保留类别相关单元，思路有新意，在DeiT/Swin上验证，但与自动驾驶感知任务无直接关联。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出可解释性感知的ViT剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 用端到端学习的可解释性感知掩码衡量单元对目标类别的贡献，并自适应搜索逐层剪枝阈值。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT与Swin Transformer上验证了优于不可解释剪枝方法的性能。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种密度引导的对比学习方法。方法通过挖掘像素级密度信息来指导对比学习，增强稀疏标注下的特征表示。相比已有半监督分割方法，该方法在稀疏标注场景下提升了分割精度。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised semantic segmentation with limited annotations by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning approach. The method leverages pixel-level density information to guide contrastive learning, enhancing feature representations under sparse supervision. It improves segmentation accuracy over existing semi-supervised methods in sparse annotation scenarios, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 该工作将密度引导与对比学习结合用于半监督分割，思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验效果。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用像素密度信息指导对比学习，增强稀疏标注下的特征学习。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在稀疏标注场景下提升了分割精度，但摘要未给出具体数据。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中旧类样本因内存预算限制只能保存少量（few-shot）的问题，提出通过压缩样本突破这一限制。方法利用类激活图（CAM）生成0-1掩码，下采样非判别性像素，从而在固定内存中保存更多压缩样本（many-shot）。进一步提出类增量掩码（CIM）模型，通过双层优化自适应地为不同类别生成掩码阈值，解决了CAM阈值选择中覆盖度与样本数量的权衡问题。实验表明该方法在多个CIL基准上有效提升了性能。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the few-shot exemplar limitation in class-incremental learning (CIL) by compressing exemplars through downsampling non-discriminative pixels, enabling many-shot compressed exemplars within a fixed memory budget. It proposes a class-incremental masking (CIM) model that generates 0-1 masks from class activation maps (CAM) via bilevel optimization, adaptively resolving the trade-off between discriminative coverage and exemplar quantity across classes. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved performance on CIL benchmarks.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将样本压缩与类增量学习结合，通过自适应掩码生成突破了内存限制，对持续学习领域有重要参考价值。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于CAM的自适应掩码压缩方法，在固定内存下实现many-shot类增量学习。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 利用类增量掩码模型和双层优化自适应生成0-1掩码，突破few-shot限制。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个CIL基准上取得性能提升，具体数据见实验部分。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝中不同架构参数分组模式差异大、现有方法难以泛化的问题，提出了任意结构剪枝任务。核心挑战是结构耦合，即不同层需同时剪枝且被移除参数需一致不重要。作者提出依赖图（DepGraph）方法，显式建模层间依赖关系并全面分组耦合参数，实现全自动通用剪枝。在ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet和Vision Transformer等多种架构及图像分类等任务上进行了广泛评估，验证了方法的通用性和有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of general structural pruning for arbitrary architectures (CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, Transformers) by addressing structural coupling, where coupled layers must be pruned simultaneously and removed parameters must be consistently unimportant. It proposes Dependency Graph (DepGraph), a fully automatic method that explicitly models inter-layer dependencies and comprehensively groups coupled parameters for pruning. Extensive evaluations on ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, MobileNet, and Vision Transformer across multiple tasks demonstrate its generality and effectiveness.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: DepGraph为任意架构的结构化剪枝提供了通用解决方案，方法优雅且实验充分，对模型压缩领域有重要推动作用。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出依赖图（DepGraph）实现任意架构的全自动结构化剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 显式建模层间依赖关系，自动分组耦合参数，解决结构耦合问题。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在多种架构和任务上验证了通用性和有效性，具体数据见实验。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云网络（PNN）中通道剪枝方法缺乏的问题，指出现有2D CNN剪枝方法直接迁移到PNN会因表示和架构差异导致性能下降。提出CP3，一种面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件，包含坐标增强的通道重要性度量以反映维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收采样过程中丢弃的点以增强剪枝鲁棒性。在多种PNN架构上实验表明该方法有效。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of channel pruning methods for 3D point-based neural networks (PNNs), noting that directly applying 2D CNN pruning undermines PNN performance due to representation and architecture disparities. It proposes CP3, a channel pruning plug-in for PNNs, featuring a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric and recycling of discarded points during sampling to improve pruning robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了3D点云网络通道剪枝的空白，针对点云特性设计了专用度量，对3D感知模型压缩有参考意义。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件CP3。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 设计坐标增强的通道重要性度量，并回收采样丢弃点增强鲁棒性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上验证了有效性，具体数据见实验。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 该论文针对对应关系剪枝（correspondence pruning）问题，提出了一种渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法。方法通过逐步挖掘邻域一致性来区分正确与错误匹配，提升对应关系剪枝的鲁棒性。相比已有方法，渐进式策略能更有效地利用局部结构信息。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses correspondence pruning by proposing a progressive neighbor consistency mining method. The approach progressively mines neighbor consistency to distinguish correct from incorrect matches, improving robustness in correspondence pruning. It more effectively leverages local structural information compared to existing methods, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 该工作将渐进式邻域一致性引入对应关系剪枝，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际性能。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 通过渐进式策略逐步挖掘邻域一致性以区分正确匹配。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 提升了对应关系剪枝的鲁棒性，但摘要未给出具体数据。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络中的偏差问题，提出了一种基于对比权重剪枝的训练去偏子网络方法。方法通过对比学习指导权重剪枝，识别并移除导致偏差的权重，从而训练出更公平的子网络。相比已有去偏方法，该方法在保持精度的同时减少了模型偏差。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses bias in neural networks by proposing a contrastive weight pruning method to train debiased subnetworks. The approach uses contrastive learning to guide weight pruning, identifying and removing bias-inducing weights to train fairer subnetworks. It reduces model bias while maintaining accuracy compared to existing debiasing methods, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 该工作将权重剪枝与去偏学习结合，为公平性研究提供了新视角，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际效果。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝方法训练去偏子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 利用对比学习指导权重剪枝以识别并移除偏差权重。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在保持精度的同时减少了模型偏差，但摘要未给出具体数据。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督学习在分布外（out-of-distribution）数据上鲁棒性差的问题，提出了一种语义剪枝（semantic pruning）框架，通过识别并剪除对OOD样本敏感的语义通道来提升模型鲁棒性。方法在标准半监督基准上结合OOD检测机制，动态调整网络稀疏结构。相比已有半监督方法，该工作首次将剪枝与OOD鲁棒性结合，在CIFAR-10/100等基准上取得了更优的OOD泛化性能。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor robustness of semi-supervised learning under out-of-distribution (OOD) data by proposing a semantic pruning framework that identifies and prunes OOD-sensitive semantic channels. The method dynamically adjusts network sparsity combined with OOD detection on standard semi-supervised benchmarks. Compared to existing semi-supervised methods, it is the first to integrate pruning with OOD robustness, achieving improved OOD generalization on CIFAR-10/100.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 将剪枝引入半监督OOD鲁棒性是一个新颖视角，但实验规模较小，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出语义剪枝框架以提升半监督学习在分布外数据上的鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 首次将通道剪枝与OOD敏感语义识别结合用于半监督学习。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在CIFAR-10/100等基准上取得了更优的OOD泛化性能。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算量大的问题，提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法，将剪枝掩码与网络权重联合优化。方法通过双层优化框架自动学习通道稀疏结构，避免了手工设定剪枝率。相比传统剪枝方法，在Cityscapes等分割基准上实现了更高的精度-效率权衡，适合边缘部署。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper targets the high computational cost of semantic segmentation models on edge devices by proposing a pruning parameterization with bi-level optimization that jointly optimizes pruning masks and network weights. The bi-level framework automatically learns channel sparsity without manual pruning ratios. Compared to conventional pruning, it achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on Cityscapes, suitable for edge deployment.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 双层优化剪枝思路合理，对边缘端分割部署有实用价值，但创新性中等。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层优化剪枝参数化方法用于边缘端高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝掩码与权重通过双层优化联合学习，免去手工剪枝率设定。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在Cityscapes等基准上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: 该论文针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图（matting）中计算量随分辨率急剧增长的问题，提出了时空稀疏性方法，仅在关键区域和关键帧上进行高分辨率计算。方法利用alpha matte的时空稀疏先验，设计稀疏采样与传播机制。相比已有高分辨率抠图方法，在4K/8K视频上显著降低了计算量，同时保持了抠图质量。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting by exploiting spatio-temporal sparsity, performing high-resolution computation only on key regions and frames. It leverages spatio-temporal sparsity priors of alpha mattes with sparse sampling and propagation. Compared to existing high-resolution matting methods, it significantly reduces computation on 4K/8K videos while maintaining matting quality.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 时空稀疏性思路对高分辨率视频处理有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出基于时空稀疏性的超高分辨率图像/视频抠图方法。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 利用alpha matte的时空稀疏先验进行稀疏采样与传播。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在4K/8K视频上显著降低计算量并保持抠图质量。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习在系统异构（设备算力差异大）下的效率问题，提出了自适应通道稀疏方法，根据各客户端的计算能力动态调整模型通道稀疏度。方法通过自适应稀疏分配与聚合策略，在异构设备上平衡训练效率与精度。相比固定稀疏度的联邦学习方法，在非独立同分布数据下取得了更好的收敛与精度表现。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses efficiency in federated learning under system heterogeneity by proposing adaptive channel sparsity that dynamically adjusts model channel sparsity according to each client's computation capacity. It employs adaptive sparsity allocation and aggregation to balance training efficiency and accuracy on heterogeneous devices. Compared to fixed-sparsity federated learning, it achieves better convergence and accuracy under non-IID data.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 面向联邦学习系统异构的自适应稀疏方法，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出面向联邦学习系统异构的自适应通道稀疏方法。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端算力动态分配通道稀疏度并设计相应聚合策略。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在非独立同分布数据下取得更好的收敛与精度表现。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频超分辨率（VSR）模型计算量大的问题，提出了结构化稀疏学习方法，对VSR网络中的冗余通道和层进行结构化剪枝。方法通过可学习的稀疏约束联合优化网络结构与超分重建损失。相比已有VSR加速方法，在多个VSR基准上实现了更高的PSNR-速度权衡，适合实时视频超分应用。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper targets the high computational cost of video super-resolution (VSR) models by proposing structured sparsity learning that prunes redundant channels and layers in VSR networks. It jointly optimizes network structure and reconstruction loss via learnable sparsity constraints. Compared to existing VSR acceleration methods, it achieves a better PSNR-speed trade-off on multiple VSR benchmarks, suitable for real-time applications.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 结构化稀疏用于视频超分有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习方法用于高效视频超分辨率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 通过可学习稀疏约束联合优化VSR网络结构与重建损失。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 在多个VSR基准上实现更高的PSNR-速度权衡。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中生成器知识蒸馏效果不佳的问题，提出了判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法，利用判别器的中间特征指导生成器压缩。方法将判别器特征作为额外监督信号，与生成器特征图蒸馏联合训练。相比已有GAN压缩方法，在多个数据集上实现了更好的生成质量与压缩率权衡。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal knowledge distillation for GAN compression by proposing discriminator-cooperated feature map distillation, where discriminator intermediate features guide generator compression. It uses discriminator features as additional supervision jointly with generator feature map distillation. Compared to existing GAN compression methods, it achieves a better quality-compression trade-off on multiple datasets.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 判别器协同蒸馏为GAN压缩提供了新思路，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器中间特征作为额外监督信号指导生成器压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在多个数据集上实现更好的生成质量与压缩率权衡。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对紧凑型3D检测器知识蒸馏中师生特征表示差异过大的问题，指出由于3D点云固有的稀疏性和不规则性，现有KD方法仅在师生中间特征表示相似时才有效。作者提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD），从信息瓶颈（IB）视角出发，最小化师生在proposal区域对上的特征与logits差异。在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，甚至超过教师模型，同时仅需42%的FLOPs。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation disparity issue in knowledge distillation for compact 3D detectors, where existing KD methods are effective only when teacher and student share similar intermediate features. It proposes Representation Disparity-aware Distillation (RDD) from an information bottleneck perspective, minimizing feature and logit disparities of proposal region pairs between student and teacher. On nuScenes, RDD boosts CP-Voxel-S to 57.1% mAP, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该工作切中3D检测蒸馏中师生表示差异这一关键痛点，IB视角新颖，实验效果显著且具有实际部署价值，值得关注。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD），从信息瓶颈视角解决3D检测中师生特征表示差异导致的蒸馏失效问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 首次从信息瓶颈角度建模并最小化师生proposal区域对在特征与logits上的表示差异。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上使CP-Voxel-S达到57.1% mAP，超越教师模型且仅用42% FLOPs。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有token剪枝方法忽略多模态交互的问题，提出MADTP框架，通过多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝来加速VLT。该方法利用跨模态对齐信号评估token重要性，并在推理时动态决定剪枝比例，从而在保持多模态理解能力的同时减少计算量。相比静态或单模态剪枝策略，MADTP在多个视觉-语言任务上实现了更高的压缩率与精度平衡，例如在保持相近性能下显著降低FLOPs。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of vision-language Transformers (VLTs) and the limitation of existing token pruning methods that overlook multimodal interactions. It proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning framework that evaluates token importance via cross-modal alignment and dynamically adjusts pruning ratios during inference. Compared with static or unimodal pruning, MADTP achieves a better compression-accuracy trade-off on multiple vision-language tasks, significantly reducing FLOPs with minimal performance drop.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 面向VLT加速的实用剪枝方法，多模态对齐引导的思路对多模态感知模型部署有参考价值。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架MADTP，用于加速视觉-语言Transformer。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 利用跨模态对齐信号动态评估token重要性并自适应调整剪枝比例。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个视觉-语言任务上实现显著FLOPs降低且精度损失很小。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型剪枝方法依赖任务特定微调、难以泛化的问题，提出MULTIFLOW，一种任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝框架。该方法通过在多模态流之间进行结构化剪枝并保持跨模态信息流动，无需针对下游任务重新训练即可压缩模型。相比任务特定的剪枝方案，MULTIFLOW在多个下游任务上展现出更好的泛化性和压缩效率，减少了部署时的适配成本。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: This paper tackles the task-specificity of existing vision-language pruning methods, which require fine-tuning and generalize poorly. It proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic vision-language pruning framework that performs structured pruning across multimodal flows while preserving cross-modal information flow, eliminating the need for downstream retraining. Compared with task-specific pruning, MULTIFLOW shows better generalization and compression efficiency across multiple downstream tasks.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝对多模态模型部署有实际意义，但整体创新性和实验规模中等。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言模型剪枝框架MULTIFLOW。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 在多模态流间进行结构化剪枝并保持跨模态信息流动，无需下游微调。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个下游任务上实现良好泛化与压缩效率。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）结构化剪枝中重要性度量不准确的问题，提出MoPE-CLIP，引入模块级剪枝误差度量来指导CLIP类模型的结构化剪枝。该方法将剪枝误差分解到不同模块，从而更精细地评估各模块对最终性能的影响，并据此分配剪枝预算。相比统一或启发式的重要性度量，MoPE-CLIP在保持精度的同时获得更高的压缩率，提升了VLM推理效率。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate importance metrics in structured pruning of vision-language models (VLMs) by proposing MoPE-CLIP, which introduces a module-wise pruning error metric to guide structured pruning of CLIP-style models. The pruning error is decomposed across modules to more precisely assess their impact on final performance and allocate pruning budgets. Compared with uniform or heuristic importance measures, MoPE-CLIP achieves higher compression with maintained accuracy, improving VLM inference efficiency.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量对VLM剪枝有细化贡献，适合关注多模态模型压缩的研究者。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE-CLIP，用于高效视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 将剪枝误差分解到模块级别以更准确指导剪枝预算分配。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 在保持精度的同时获得更高压缩率，提升VLM推理效率。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态训练数据规模庞大、冗余严重的问题，提出Sieve，一种利用图像描述模型进行多模态数据集剪枝的方法。该方法借助图像描述模型评估样本的语义丰富度和多样性，从而筛选出信息量高的训练子集。相比随机采样或基于损失的剪枝，Sieve在减少数据量的同时保持甚至提升下游多模态任务性能，降低了训练成本。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: This paper targets the massive scale and redundancy of multimodal training data by proposing Sieve, a dataset pruning method that leverages image captioning models. It evaluates sample semantic richness and diversity to select an informative training subset. Compared with random sampling or loss-based pruning, Sieve maintains or even improves downstream multimodal performance while reducing data volume and training cost.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 数据剪枝方向对大规模多模态训练有实用价值，但方法相对直接。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法Sieve。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用图像描述模型评估样本语义丰富度与多样性进行数据筛选。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 在减少数据量的同时保持或提升下游多模态任务性能。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对ViT压缩中重要性搜索与稀疏度搜索分离导致次优的问题，提出Once-for-Both框架，在单阶段内联合进行重要性与稀疏度搜索。该方法将通道重要性评估和稀疏度分配统一到一个可微搜索过程中，避免了多阶段方法的误差累积。相比两阶段压缩方案，Once-for-Both在多个ViT骨干上取得更优的精度-效率权衡，显著降低计算量。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality of separating importance and sparsity search in ViT compression by proposing Once-for-Both, a single-stage framework that jointly searches for importance and sparsity. It unifies channel importance evaluation and sparsity allocation into a differentiable search process, avoiding error accumulation in multi-stage methods. Compared with two-stage compression, Once-for-Both achieves better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across ViT backbones with substantial computation reduction.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 单阶段联合搜索思路清晰，对ViT压缩研究有较好参考价值。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合重要性与稀疏度搜索的ViT压缩框架Once-for-Both。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将通道重要性与稀疏度分配统一到可微单阶段搜索中。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 在多个ViT骨干上取得更优精度-效率权衡并显著降低计算量。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对ViT压缩通常需要大量训练样本的问题，提出一种少样本密集ViT压缩方法。该方法在仅有少量样本的条件下，通过密集预测式的压缩策略估计通道重要性并剪枝，减少对大规模微调数据的依赖。相比需要完整训练集的压缩方法，该工作在极少样本下仍能保持较好精度，拓展了ViT压缩在数据受限场景的适用性。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy data requirement of ViT compression by proposing a dense ViT compression method with few samples. Under limited data, it estimates channel importance and prunes via a dense prediction-style strategy, reducing reliance on large-scale fine-tuning data. Compared with methods requiring full training sets, it maintains reasonable accuracy with very few samples, extending ViT compression to data-constrained scenarios.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩对数据受限部署有实际意义，但整体影响力和实验规模一般。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本条件下的密集ViT压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 在极少样本下通过密集预测式策略估计通道重要性并剪枝。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 在极少样本下仍保持较好精度，降低对大规模数据的依赖。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像压缩模型在持续学习新数据/新码率时容易遗忘旧知识、且难以保持与已有压缩比特流向后兼容的问题，提出了向后兼容的持续学习框架。方法上通过约束新旧模型在相同潜在表示或码流上的兼容性，并结合持续学习策略（如正则化/回放）来更新压缩网络。相比直接微调或从头训练，该方法在适应新域的同时尽量不破坏旧模型解码能力。摘要未给出具体指标，但核心效果是提升持续学习场景下的率失真性能与兼容性。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses backward-compatible continual learning for image compression, where models must adapt to new data or rates without forgetting old knowledge or breaking compatibility with existing bitstreams. It proposes a continual learning framework that enforces compatibility between old and new models while updating the compression network. Compared with naive fine-tuning or retraining, it aims to preserve old decoding capability while improving adaptation, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 该工作将持续学习与图像压缩的向后兼容性结合，问题设定较新颖，对压缩模型部署与迭代有实际意义。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出面向图像压缩的向后兼容持续学习框架，缓解灾难性遗忘并保持旧码流可解码。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将向后兼容约束引入压缩模型的持续学习更新中。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 在持续学习场景下兼顾新数据适应与旧模型兼容性，具体指标摘要未给出。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: 该论文针对StyleGAN压缩中通道剪枝容易导致生成多样性下降的问题，提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法。方法通过分析并保留对生成样本多样性贡献大的通道，在剪枝过程中引入多样性度量或约束，从而在压缩模型的同时维持生成分布覆盖。相比仅以重建/感知损失为导向的剪枝，该方法更关注生成多样性。摘要未给出具体FID或多样性指标，但目标是在压缩率与生成质量/多样性之间取得更好平衡。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles channel pruning for StyleGAN compression, where naive pruning often reduces generation diversity. It proposes a diversity-aware channel pruning method that identifies and preserves channels important for sample diversity while compressing the generator. Compared with reconstruction- or perception-only pruning, it explicitly maintains diversity, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 将生成多样性纳入StyleGAN压缩的剪枝准则，对生成模型轻量化有参考价值。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法用于StyleGAN压缩。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 在剪枝重要性评估中显式引入生成多样性约束。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在压缩StyleGAN的同时更好保持生成多样性，具体指标摘要未给出。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN联合训练与剪枝中剪枝策略与训练过程难以协同的问题，提出基于可学习智能体引导与对齐的联合训练剪枝框架。方法通过可学习agent生成剪枝决策，并与网络训练进行对齐/交互，使剪枝在训练过程中动态调整。相比固定启发式或两阶段剪枝，该方法试图让剪枝与表示学习相互促进。摘要未给出具体压缩率或精度数据，但目标是在同等稀疏度下提升精度或同等精度下提高压缩率。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses jointly training and pruning CNNs by proposing a learnable agent guidance and alignment framework. A learnable agent produces pruning decisions that are aligned with network training, enabling dynamic pruning during training. Compared with fixed heuristics or two-stage pipelines, it aims to let pruning and representation learning benefit each other, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 将可学习agent引入联合剪枝训练，思路与自动化剪枝/NAS趋势一致，值得关注。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出可学习智能体引导与对齐的CNN联合训练剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 用可学习agent动态生成剪枝决策并与训练对齐。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 在联合训练剪枝中提升剪枝与训练的协同性，具体指标摘要未给出。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习中不同设备算力/资源异构导致统一剪枝模型难以适配的问题，提出按设备进行网络剪枝的联邦剪枝方法。方法在联邦训练过程中为不同设备生成或分配不同的剪枝结构，以适配设备资源并减少通信/计算开销。相比全局统一剪枝，该方法更强调设备异构性下的个性化剪枝。摘要未给出具体精度或通信节省数据，但目标是在异构设备上实现更高效的联邦训练与推理。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper targets device heterogeneity in federated learning, where a single pruned model cannot fit all devices, and proposes device-wise federated network pruning. It generates or assigns different pruned structures to different devices during federated training to match resources and reduce communication/computation. Compared with global uniform pruning, it emphasizes per-device personalization, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 将设备异构性纳入联邦剪枝，对边缘智能与分布式训练有实际意义。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出面向设备异构的联邦网络剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦学习中按设备生成个性化剪枝结构。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 提升异构设备下联邦剪枝的适配性与效率，具体指标摘要未给出。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态剪枝与静态剪枝各自局限（动态剪枝推理开销大、静态剪枝灵活性差）的问题，提出BilevelPruning统一动态与静态通道剪枝。方法通过双层优化框架同时学习通道重要性/剪枝策略与网络权重，从而在训练中获得可部署的静态结构并保留动态剪枝的适应性。相比单一动态或静态方法，该方法试图兼顾推理效率与精度。摘要未给出具体FLOPs或精度数据，但目标是在统一框架下取得更好压缩-精度权衡。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of dynamic and static channel pruning by proposing BilevelPruning, a unified framework for both. It formulates pruning as a bilevel optimization that jointly learns channel importance/pruning policy and network weights, yielding deployable static structures while retaining dynamic adaptability. Compared with purely dynamic or static methods, it aims for a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 用双层优化统一动态与静态剪枝，问题切入清晰，对剪枝方法学有参考价值。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化框架BilevelPruning。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 通过双层优化同时学习剪枝策略与网络权重以统一两类剪枝。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在压缩与精度之间取得更优权衡，具体指标摘要未给出。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: 该论文针对CapsNet中路由计算开销大、特征冗余以及注意力/路由效率低的问题，提出OrthCaps：一种带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet。方法通过正交约束提升胶囊表示的解耦性，并引入稀疏注意力路由与剪枝降低计算量。相比原始动态路由CapsNet，该方法在保持或提升精度的同时减少冗余与计算。摘要未给出具体精度或加速数据，但目标是在胶囊网络上实现更高效的路由与表示。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper targets the high routing cost and feature redundancy of CapsNets and proposes OrthCaps, an orthogonal CapsNet with sparse attention routing and pruning. It enforces orthogonality for better disentangled capsule representations and introduces sparse attention routing plus pruning to reduce computation. Compared with standard dynamic routing CapsNets, it aims to improve efficiency while maintaining accuracy, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 将正交约束、稀疏注意力与剪枝结合到CapsNet，对胶囊网络效率改进有探索价值。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet（OrthCaps）。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 用正交约束与稀疏注意力路由/剪枝提升CapsNet表示质量与效率。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 在胶囊网络中降低冗余与计算并保持精度，具体指标摘要未给出。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: 联邦学习场景下动态剪枝面临客户端内存开销大和通信效率低的问题。FedMef 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架，通过结构化剪枝与稀疏更新聚合降低客户端峰值内存与通信量。相比已有联邦剪枝方法，它在不牺牲精度的前提下显著减少内存占用。实验表明其在多个基准上达到与密集模型相当的精度，同时降低客户端内存与通信开销。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: Federated dynamic pruning suffers from high client memory overhead and communication cost. FedMef introduces a memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning framework that reduces peak client memory and communication via structured pruning and sparse update aggregation. It achieves accuracy comparable to dense models while substantially lowering memory and communication overhead.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 面向联邦学习的高效剪枝工作，对边缘部署有参考价值，但与视觉感知主线相关度有限。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架 FedMef。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 在联邦动态剪枝中同时优化客户端内存与通信开销。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在保持与密集模型相当精度的同时降低客户端内存与通信成本。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: 大模型微调阶段计算与显存开销巨大，现有剪枝方法多针对预训练而非微调。本文提出面向大模型微调的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法，在微调过程中动态识别并移除冗余结构。相比静态剪枝，它在相同资源预算下保留更强下游性能。实验显示在多种下游任务上以更少资源达到或超过全量微调精度。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: Finetuning large models is resource-intensive, and existing pruning methods mostly target pretraining. This work proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning approach for finetuning that dynamically removes redundant structures during adaptation. It retains stronger downstream performance under equal budgets and matches or exceeds full finetuning accuracy with fewer resources.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 针对大模型微调效率的实用剪枝方法，对视觉大模型部署有借鉴意义。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向大模型微调的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 在微调过程中动态剪枝以节省计算与显存。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 以更少资源达到或超过全量微调的下游精度。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: 彩票假设中寻找稀疏子网络通常依赖昂贵的迭代训练。本文提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝方法，在训练前利用数据相关谱信息预测可保留的彩票子网络。相比传统迭代幅度剪枝，它大幅降低搜索成本并提升稀疏子网络质量。实验在视觉模型上以更低开销找到性能更优的稀疏子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: Finding lottery tickets typically requires expensive iterative training. This paper proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method that predicts retainable lottery subnetworks before training using data-dependent spectral information. It reduces search cost and improves sparse subnetwork quality, yielding better-performing sparse vision models at lower overhead.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 从谱角度改进彩票假设搜索效率，对模型压缩与自监督视觉有启发。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝以高效寻找彩票子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用数据相关谱信息在训练前预测稀疏子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 以更低搜索开销获得性能更优的稀疏视觉模型。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: RGB-D 6DoF 物体位姿估计中，对应关系构建与误匹配剔除是关键瓶颈。HiPose 提出分层二值表面编码与对应剪枝，将物体表面编码为分层二值描述子并高效剔除错误对应。相比基于稠密对应的方法，它在保持精度的同时显著提升速度与鲁棒性。实验在多个基准上取得领先精度并实现实时推理。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: Correspondence establishment and outlier rejection are bottlenecks in RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation. HiPose introduces hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning, encoding object surfaces into hierarchical binary descriptors and efficiently rejecting mismatches. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on multiple benchmarks with real-time inference.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 面向机器人/自动驾驶抓取与位姿感知的实用方法，精度与效率兼顾。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出分层二值表面编码与对应剪枝的 RGB-D 6DoF 位姿估计方法。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 用分层二值描述子实现高效对应构建与误匹配剔除。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在多个基准上取得领先精度并支持实时推理。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: 源无关场景下模型知识产权保护缺乏有效手段，现有水印方法依赖源数据。本文提出 MAP（MAsk-Pruning），通过掩码剪枝在无源数据条件下嵌入并验证模型所有权。相比依赖源数据的水印方法，它无需访问原始训练数据即可完成验证。实验表明其在多种模型与任务上实现高验证成功率且不影响模型性能。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: Source-free model intellectual property protection lacks effective tools, and existing watermarking relies on source data. This paper proposes MAP (MAsk-Pruning), embedding and verifying ownership via mask pruning without source data. It achieves high verification success across models and tasks without degrading performance.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 面向模型版权保护的剪枝式水印方法，与感知主线相关度较低但思路新颖。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出源无关的掩码剪枝模型知识产权保护方法 MAP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 无需源数据即可嵌入并验证模型所有权。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 在多种模型与任务上实现高验证成功率且不损失性能。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ViT 推理中大量 token 冗余导致计算浪费，现有 token 剪枝多需微调或额外训练。Zero-TPrune 提出零样本 token 剪枝，利用预训练 Transformer 的注意力图在推理时直接剔除冗余 token。相比需重训练的方法，它无需任何微调即可加速多种预训练模型。实验在分类与检测等任务上实现显著加速且精度损失极小。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: Token redundancy wastes computation in ViT inference, and existing token pruning often requires finetuning. Zero-TPrune performs zero-shot token pruning by leveraging the attention graph of pretrained Transformers at inference. It accelerates various pretrained models without any finetuning, achieving significant speedups with minimal accuracy drop on classification and detection.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 零样本 token 剪枝对 ViT 部署与多模态大模型加速有直接价值。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出利用注意力图的零样本 token 剪枝方法 Zero-TPrune。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 无需微调即可基于注意力图在推理时剪枝 token。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: 在分类与检测等任务上显著加速且精度损失极小。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对现有网络剪枝方法依赖预训练权重、难以从零训练（from scratch）的问题，本文提出 Auto-Train-Once（ATO），用控制器网络引导自动剪枝。方法在训练过程中由控制器动态决定各层稀疏结构，实现端到端的从零剪枝。相比需要预训练再剪枝的两阶段方法，ATO 省去了预训练开销并保持精度。在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上取得与两阶段方法相当甚至更优的压缩率与精度。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance of existing pruning methods on pre-trained weights by proposing Auto-Train-Once (ATO), a controller-network-guided automatic pruning framework that prunes from scratch. A controller dynamically determines the sparse structure of each layer during training, enabling end-to-end one-stage pruning. It achieves comparable or better accuracy-compression trade-offs than two-stage pre-train-then-prune baselines on CIFAR and ImageNet.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 从零剪枝的思路对部署友好，控制器引导的自动化设计有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在大规模检测/自动驾驶模型上的可迁移性。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出控制器网络引导的从零自动网络剪枝框架 Auto-Train-Once。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 用控制器网络在训练中动态决定各层稀疏结构，实现免预训练的一阶段剪枝。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 在标准分类基准上达到与两阶段剪枝相当或更优的压缩率与精度。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝中样本重要性评估不充分的问题，本文提出时序双深度评分（TDDS），跨越训练进程评估样本价值。方法结合不同训练阶段的深度信息对样本打分，从而更稳健地选择保留子集。相比单阶段评分方法，TDDS 能捕捉样本随训练演化的动态重要性。在多个数据集上以更少数据保持甚至提升模型精度。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient sample-importance estimation in dataset pruning by proposing Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which scores samples across training progress. By combining depth information from different training stages, TDDS selects a more robust subset. It preserves or improves accuracy with substantially fewer samples across benchmarks.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 数据集剪枝对降低训练成本有实用价值，时序双深度评分思路合理，但与视觉感知核心任务的直接关联较弱。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出跨训练进程的时序双深度评分（TDDS）用于数据集剪枝。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 利用不同训练阶段的深度信息动态评估样本重要性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 在多个数据集上以更少样本保持或提升模型精度。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度补全中稀疏度变化导致精度下降的问题，本文提出掩码空间传播网络（Masked Spatial Propagation Network），实现稀疏度自适应的深度细化。方法通过掩码机制在空间传播中自适应处理不同稀疏程度的深度输入。相比固定传播策略，能更好应对稀疏度差异。在深度补全基准上取得精度提升。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses depth refinement under varying sparsity by proposing a Masked Spatial Propagation Network for sparsity-adaptive depth refinement. A masking mechanism adapts spatial propagation to different sparsity levels. It outperforms fixed-propagation baselines on depth completion benchmarks.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 深度补全对自动驾驶感知有支撑作用，稀疏度自适应设计有针对性，但需确认其在真实 LiDAR 稀疏条件下的泛化性。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出掩码空间传播网络用于稀疏度自适应深度细化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 用掩码机制让空间传播自适应不同深度稀疏度。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 在深度补全基准上取得精度提升。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对稀疏对抗攻击可迁移性不足的问题，本文提出通过精确组稀疏训练获得可迁移的结构化稀疏对抗攻击。方法在训练中施加精确组稀疏约束，生成结构化稀疏扰动以提升跨模型迁移性。相比非结构化稀疏攻击，结构化扰动更符合物理可实现性且迁移性更强。在多个目标模型上取得更高的攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper targets the limited transferability of sparse adversarial attacks by proposing a transferable structural sparse attack via exact group sparsity training. Exact group-sparsity constraints yield structured sparse perturbations with improved cross-model transferability. It achieves higher attack success rates across target models.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 对抗攻击对感知系统鲁棒性评估有意义，组稀疏训练提升迁移性的思路清晰，但与检测主任务关联偏间接。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构化稀疏对抗攻击。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 用精确组稀疏约束生成结构化稀疏扰动以增强迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在多个目标模型上取得更高的攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对 N:M 稀疏在精度与效率平衡上的不足，本文提出 MaxQ 多轴查询方法用于 N:M 稀疏网络。方法通过多轴查询机制更灵活地选择保留权重，提升稀疏模型的表达能力。相比固定模式的 N:M 稀疏，MaxQ 在同等稀疏度下减少精度损失。在标准基准上取得更优的精度-稀疏度权衡。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of N:M sparsity by proposing MaxQ, a multi-axis query method for N:M sparsity networks. The multi-axis query selects retained weights more flexibly, improving expressiveness. It reduces accuracy loss at equal sparsity on standard benchmarks.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: N:M 稀疏对硬件加速友好，多轴查询设计有实用价值，但需关注其在检测/Transformer 骨干上的实际收益。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询（MaxQ）方法改进 N:M 稀疏网络。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 用多轴查询机制更灵活地选择保留权重。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 在同等稀疏度下取得更优的精度-稀疏度权衡。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对训练后稀疏（post-training sparsity）方法各自为政、缺乏统一框架的问题，本文提出 UniPTS 统一框架。方法将多种训练后稀疏技术纳入统一表述，实现高效且通用的稀疏化。相比单一方法，UniPTS 在多种模型与稀疏度下更稳健。在标准基准上以较低开销取得有竞争力的精度。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of post-training sparsity methods by proposing UniPTS, a unified framework. It formulates diverse post-training sparsity techniques under a common scheme for efficient and general sparsification. UniPTS is more robust across models and sparsity levels at low cost.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一训练后稀疏框架对快速部署有吸引力，但摘要信息有限，需关注其与检测/自动驾驶模型的兼容性。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的训练后稀疏框架 UniPTS。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 将多种训练后稀疏技术纳入统一表述。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在多种模型与稀疏度下以较低开销取得有竞争力的精度。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时计算与存储开销大的问题，本文提出DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架。方法上结合了结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，对ViT的注意力头和MLP通道进行重要性评估并联合优化压缩率。相比单一剪枝或蒸馏方法，该工作强调压缩流程的整体重设计以兼顾精度与效率。摘要未给出具体数据集与加速比数据，实验充分度有限。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory cost of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing DeepCompress-ViT, a compression framework that jointly applies structured pruning and knowledge distillation. Unlike single-technique approaches, it redesigns the compression pipeline to balance accuracy and efficiency. Quantitative results on standard benchmarks are not reported in the abstract, limiting assessment of its empirical gains.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: ViT边缘部署是实用方向，但摘要信息量偏少，需看正文实验才能判断其真实增益。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向边缘部署的ViT联合压缩框架DeepCompress-ViT。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 将结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏在ViT压缩流程中协同重设计。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 摘要未提供具体精度与加速数据，效果有待正文验证。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 现有检测方法多基于ISP压缩后的sRGB输入，在复杂光照与天气下会丢失RAW中的关键信息。本文构建AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率真实RAW图像、135,601个标注实例、62个类别，覆盖9种光照与天气条件，并提供RAW与sRGB检测基准。作者发现sRGB预训练因域差异限制RAW检测潜力，转而直接在RAW域预训练，并针对相机噪声导致的表征学习困难，从sRGB预训练模型蒸馏知识。方法在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升，且无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: Existing detectors operate on ISP-compressed sRGB inputs, losing critical RAW information under complex illumination and weather. The authors introduce AODRaw, a dataset of 7,785 high-resolution real RAW images with 135,601 instances across 62 categories and 9 lighting/weather conditions, together with a RAW-vs-sRGB benchmark. They show that sRGB pre-training limits RAW detection due to domain gap, and instead pre-train directly on RAW while distilling knowledge from an sRGB-pretrained model to overcome camera noise, achieving substantial gains under diverse and adverse conditions without extra pre-processing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: 数据集规模大、条件覆盖广，且揭示了sRGB预训练对RAW检测的域差异问题，对自动驾驶感知在恶劣环境下的鲁棒性研究很有价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建大规模真实RAW检测数据集AODRaw并给出RAW域检测基准与预训练范式。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 直接在RAW域预训练并结合sRGB模型知识蒸馏以克服相机噪声。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升，且无需额外预处理模块。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）需在连续域偏移下在线适配检测器，但现有方法忽视计算效率。本文观察到并非所有源域特征都有益，部分对域差异敏感的信道会损害目标域性能。为此提出敏感度引导的信道剪枝策略，在图像与实例两个层面量化信道对域差异的敏感度，并用加权稀疏正则抑制和剪除敏感信道，将适配集中在不变信道上；同时引入随机信道重激活机制恢复被剪信道以缓解过早剪枝风险。在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: Continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) must adapt a source detector online under continuous domain shifts, yet existing methods neglect computational efficiency. Observing that some source feature channels are domain-sensitive and harmful on the target domain, the authors propose sensitivity-guided channel pruning that quantifies channel sensitivity at both image and instance levels, applies weighted sparsity regularization to suppress and prune sensitive channels, and adds stochastic channel reactivation to recover pruned channels. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 把剪枝引入CTTA-OD以兼顾效率与效果，思路新颖，对资源受限的自动驾驶在线适配有参考价值。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出基于敏感度引导剪枝的高效持续测试时自适应目标检测方法。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 在图像与实例层面量化信道域敏感度并配合随机重激活机制。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上取得优于现有CTTA-OD方法的效果。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对学习式点云属性压缩中高斯/拉普拉斯熵模型对隐变量概率估计不充分的问题，本文提出广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更准确估计隐变量概率。同时指出现有方法在算术编码中对每个整数使用固定似然区间限制了性能，提出均值误差判别器（MED）判断熵参数估计是否准确并动态调整似然区间。在三个基于VAE的点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广到图像与视频压缩任务。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: To improve probability estimation of latents in learned point cloud attribute compression, this paper introduces a generalized Gaussian entropy model whose shape parameter controls tail behavior, and a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) that dynamically adjusts likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding instead of using fixed intervals. Experiments on three VAE-based point cloud attribute compression models show significant rate-distortion improvements, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 属于点云压缩而非感知检测，与用户领域相关度较低，但熵建模思路对压缩方向有参考意义。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型与动态似然区间机制用于点云属性压缩。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 用形状参数控制尾部并引入MED动态调整算术编码似然区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 本文提出TopNet，一个面向八叉树结构点云几何压缩的Transformer高效占用预测网络。方法利用Transformer对八叉树节点进行占用概率预测，以提升几何压缩效率。摘要缺失，无法确认具体网络设计、对比方法与实验数据。整体属于点云压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知中的Occupancy预测任务名称相近但目标不同。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network for octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. It leverages Transformers to predict node occupancy in octrees for improved compression efficiency. The abstract is missing, so the architecture, baselines, and quantitative results cannot be verified.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 与感知中的Occupancy预测不同，实为点云几何压缩工作，相关度有限且摘要缺失难以评估。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出面向八叉树点云几何压缩的Transformer占用预测网络TopNet。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer用于八叉树节点占用预测以提升压缩效率。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本驱动3D编辑中2D扩散模型缺乏多视图信息导致多视图不一致，以及3DGS编辑因预训练高斯保留过多源信息而优化低效的问题，本文提出EditSplat框架。方法包含多视图融合引导（MFG），将多视图信息与3DGS几何结构结合，利用无分类器引导增强一致性；以及注意力引导裁剪（AGT），选择性剪枝并优化3D高斯以提升优化效率并支持局部语义编辑。摘要未给出定量指标。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: To address multi-view inconsistency in text-driven 3D editing caused by 2D diffusion models lacking multi-view information, and inefficient 3DGS editing due to excessive source information retained in pre-trained Gaussians, this paper proposes EditSplat with Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT). MFG injects multi-view information into the diffusion process using classifier-free guidance and 3DGS geometry, while AGT selectively prunes and optimizes Gaussians for efficient, semantically rich local editing. Quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 属于3D场景编辑与生成方向，与自动驾驶感知检测相关度较低，但多视图一致性与3DGS优化思路可借鉴。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出结合多视图融合引导与注意力引导裁剪的文本驱动3DGS场景编辑框架。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 用MFG保证多视图一致性并用AGT剪枝高斯提升编辑效率。
2412.11520|v2.result: 摘要未提供定量指标，效果需正文验证。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在高分辨率图像下视觉编码器延迟高、视觉token数量大的效率瓶颈，论文系统分析了图像分辨率、视觉延迟、token数与LLM规模之间的权衡关系，提出FastVLM及新型混合视觉编码器FastViTHD。FastViTHD通过输出更少token并显著降低高分辨率编码时间，仅靠缩放输入图像即可在视觉token数与分辨率之间取得最优平衡，无需额外的token剪枝，简化了模型设计。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency bottleneck of vision encoders in VLMs at high input resolutions, where ViTs incur large token counts and high encoding latency. It introduces FastVLM with FastViTHD, a hybrid vision encoder that outputs fewer tokens and drastically reduces encoding time for high-resolution images. Unlike prior methods, FastVLM achieves an optimal trade-off between visual token count and image resolution solely by scaling the input image, eliminating extra token pruning and simplifying model design.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 对VLM效率优化有参考价值，混合编码器设计思路清晰，但主要面向通用VLM而非自动驾驶感知，相关度中等。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastVLM及FastViTHD混合视觉编码器，实现高分辨率下低延迟、少token的高效VLM。
2412.13303|v2.innovation: 仅通过缩放输入图像即可平衡视觉token数与分辨率，无需额外token剪枝。
2412.13303|v2.result: 在延迟、模型规模与精度之间取得优化折衷，显著降低高分辨率编码时间。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 论文探究VLM的视觉嵌入空间是否也像文本空间一样具备组合性结构，针对视觉数据噪声大、稀疏导致组合性分析困难的问题，提出几何可分解嵌入（GDE）框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示。实验表明预训练VLM的视觉嵌入确实呈现组合性排列，GDE在组合分类上优于假设线性几何的对照方法，并在群体鲁棒性任务上取得更高结果。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This work investigates whether compositional structure emerges in the visual embedding space of VLMs, addressing the noise and sparsity that hinder such analysis. It proposes Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE), a framework approximating image representations with geometry-aware compositional structures. Experiments show that pre-trained VLM visual embeddings exhibit compositional arrangement, and GDE outperforms linear-geometry counterparts in compositional classification and achieves higher group robustness.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 对理解VLM表征结构有理论意义，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，揭示并利用VLM视觉嵌入空间的组合性结构。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 用几何感知的可分解结构建模视觉嵌入的组合性，突破线性假设。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类和群体鲁棒性任务上均优于线性几何对照方法。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基准缺乏对VLM细粒度运动理解能力的评估，论文提出MotionBench，涵盖六类运动导向问题类型并采集多源真实视频数据。实验显示现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现不佳；为在有限LLM序列长度内提升运动感知，论文系统比较了面向视频特征压缩的VLM架构，并提出高效的Through-Encoder（TE）融合方法。结果表明更高帧率输入与TE融合能提升运动理解，但仍有较大提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MotionBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating fine-grained motion comprehension of video understanding models, covering six motion-oriented question types from diverse real-world sources. Experiments reveal that existing VLMs perform poorly on fine-grained motion understanding. To improve motion perception under limited LLM sequence length, the authors review video feature compression architectures and propose an efficient Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion method, showing that higher frame rates and TE Fusion improve motion understanding while substantial room remains.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: 基准与TE融合方法对视频理解研究有实用价值，但偏通用视频而非自动驾驶场景。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 提出细粒度运动理解基准MotionBench及高效的Through-Encoder融合方法。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 系统评估VLM视频特征压缩架构并提出TE融合以增强细粒度运动感知。
2501.02955|v2.result: 现有VLM在MotionBench上表现不佳，更高帧率与TE融合可带来提升但仍有较大空间。

EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_cn: 该论文提出EfficientLLaVA，面向大型视觉语言模型的通用自动剪枝方法，但提供的摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点与实验数据。从标题推断其目标是通过自动剪枝降低LVLM的计算开销并保持泛化能力。由于缺乏摘要信息，无法对其方法质量与效果进行准确评估。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_en: This paper proposes EfficientLLaVA, a generalizable auto-pruning approach for large vision-language models. However, the provided abstract is empty, so specific methodology, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed. Based on the title, it aims to reduce LVLM computational cost via automatic pruning while maintaining generalization.
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.assessment: 主题与模型压缩相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法与效果，信息不足。

2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM受限于上下文长度且处理长视频成本高、现有视觉token压缩策略瓶颈严重的问题，论文提出Video-XL，利用MLLM固有的KV稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入。方法为每个视频区间引入特殊token——视觉摘要token（VST），将区间视觉信息总结为对应KV，并通过指令微调训练，采用课程学习与复合数据策展两种优化策略，结合动态压缩进一步提升压缩质量。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of long video understanding in MLLMs, which are constrained by limited context length and high processing cost, while existing visual token reduction strategies face severe bottlenecks. It proposes Video-XL, which leverages the inherent KV sparsification capacity of MLLMs by introducing a Visual Summarization Token (VST) per video interval to summarize visual information as its associated KV. The VST module is trained via instruction fine-tuning with curriculum learning and composite data curation, further improved by dynamic compression.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: KV稀疏化压缩长视频的思路新颖，对长视频理解有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL，利用KV稀疏化与视觉摘要token实现小时级长视频理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 引入视觉摘要token（VST）将视频区间信息压缩为KV，并结合课程学习与动态压缩。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上有效压缩视觉输入并保持细粒度视觉细节感知。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有高性能VLM对图像和视频分别采用不同token压缩策略、限制图像视频统一处理能力的问题，论文将每张图像扩展为静态视频，提出统一的渐进式视觉token压缩策略PVC。每帧token被渐进编码并自适应压缩，以补充前帧未提取的信息，利用视频固有时间冗余高效压缩，图像作为静态视频可在多帧中逐步补充空间细节。在每帧默认64 token的有限预算下仍能保留空间细节与时间变化，并在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing high-performance VLMs process images and videos separately with different token compression strategies, hindering unified image-video capabilities. It extends each image into a static video and proposes Progressive Visual Token Compression (PVC), where each frame's tokens are progressively encoded and adaptively compressed to supplement information not extracted from previous frames. With a limited budget of 64 tokens per frame, spatial details and temporal changes are preserved, achieving state-of-the-art performance across various video understanding tasks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 统一图像与视频token压缩的思路简洁有效，对多模态视频理解有实用价值。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出PVC渐进式视觉token压缩，统一图像与视频处理。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像扩展为静态视频，通过渐进编码与自适应压缩统一图像视频token压缩。
2412.09613|v2.result: 在每帧64 token预算下保留空间与时间信息，多种视频理解任务达到SOTA。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理开销大的问题，本文提出 Libra-Merging 加速插件。该方法在重要性-冗余度与剪枝-合并之间做权衡，通过联合优化 token 重要性和冗余度来决定剪枝与合并策略。相比已有仅依赖单一重要性指标的剪枝方法，Libra-Merging 能更均衡地保留关键视觉信息。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法在 LVLM 加速场景下具有通用性。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models by proposing Libra-Merging, an acceleration plug-in that trades off importance-redundancy and pruning-merging. It jointly optimizes token importance and redundancy to decide pruning and merging strategies, improving over prior methods that rely on a single importance metric. The approach is designed as a general plug-in for LVLM acceleration, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.assessment: 该工作聚焦 LVLM 推理加速，与自动驾驶感知中的 VLM 应用有间接关联，但方法本身偏通用 NLP/多模态加速，对视觉感知任务直接贡献有限。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.contribution: 提出 Libra-Merging 加速插件，在重要性-冗余度与剪枝-合并之间实现权衡。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.innovation: 联合优化 token 重要性与冗余度，而非仅依赖单一重要性指标进行剪枝。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在 LVLM 加速场景下有效。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and._arxiv_id: Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and Pruning-merging Trade-off for Acceleration Plug-in in Large Vision-Language Model.

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 推理中视觉 token 过多导致计算和内存开销大的问题，本文提出 TopV，一种兼容 FlashAttention 和 KV cache 的 token 剪枝方法。不同于依赖注意力分数的贪心启发式方法，TopV 将 token 剪枝建模为优化问题，在预填充阶段一次性剪枝，从而有效减小 KV cache 大小。优化框架引入视觉感知代价函数，考虑特征相似性和相对空间关系等因素。该方法无需额外训练或微调，在保持性能的同时实现快速低内存推理。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational and memory overhead of excessive visual tokens in VLMs by proposing TopV, a token pruning method compatible with FlashAttention and KV cache. Unlike greedy attention-score-based heuristics, TopV formulates token pruning as an optimization problem with a visual-aware cost function considering feature similarity and relative spatial relations, performing pruning once during prefilling to reduce KV cache size. It requires no additional training or fine-tuning and achieves fast, low-memory inference.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: TopV 在兼容性和推理效率上有明显优势，无需微调即可部署，对 VLM 在自动驾驶等实时场景的落地有参考价值。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出兼容 FlashAttention 和 KV cache 的免训练 token 剪枝方法 TopV。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 将 token 剪枝建模为优化问题并引入视觉感知代价函数，而非依赖注意力分数。
2503.18278|v2.result: 在预填充阶段一次性剪枝，有效减小 KV cache 并实现快速低内存推理，无需额外训练。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: 针对 LVLM 处理长视觉 token 计算开销大的问题，本文观察到剪枝比例的影响在不同 LLM 层和不同实例间存在差异，提出 ATP-LLaVA。该方法引入自适应 token 剪枝（ATP）模块，根据输入实例自适应计算重要性分数和剪枝阈值，实现逐层、逐实例的剪枝比例。ATP 模块可无缝插入任意两个 LLM 层之间且计算开销可忽略，并配合空间增强剪枝（SAP）策略。相比固定比例剪枝方法，ATP-LLaVA 能更有效地平衡计算成本与模型性能。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: This paper observes that the impact of token pruning ratio varies across LLM layers and instances, and proposes ATP-LLaVA for adaptive token pruning in LVLMs. It introduces an Adaptive Token Pruning (ATP) module that computes instance-specific importance scores and pruning thresholds for each LLM layer, seamlessly integrated between layers with negligible overhead, along with a Spatial Augmented Pruning strategy. Compared to fixed-ratio pruning, ATP-LLaVA better balances computational cost and model performance.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 逐层逐实例自适应剪枝的思路合理且实用，对 LVLM 在资源受限设备上的部署有直接价值，实验设计较为充分。
2412.00447|v2.contribution: 提出逐层、逐实例自适应的视觉 token 剪枝框架 ATP-LLaVA。
2412.00447|v2.innovation: 根据输入实例自适应确定每层剪枝比例，而非使用预定义或固定比例。
2412.00447|v2.result: ATP 模块可无缝集成且开销可忽略，相比固定比例剪枝更有效地平衡计算成本与性能。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 处理高分辨率图像和视频时受限于上下文窗口和计算成本的问题，本文提出 VoCo-LLaMA，首个利用 LLM 自身压缩视觉 token 的方法。该方法在视觉指令微调阶段引入视觉压缩 token，并通过注意力蒸馏将 LLM 理解视觉 token 的方式蒸馏到对 VoCo token 的处理中，避免外部模块压缩导致的信息损失。实验表明，在 576 倍压缩比下性能损失极小，FLOPs 减少最多 94.8%，推理时间加速 69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the context window and computational bottleneck of VLMs on high-resolution images and videos by proposing VoCo-LLaMA, the first approach to compress vision tokens using LLMs themselves. It introduces Vision Compression tokens during vision instruction tuning and leverages attention distillation to transfer how LLMs comprehend vision tokens into processing VoCo tokens, avoiding information loss from external compression modules. It achieves minimal performance loss at 576x compression, up to 94.8% fewer FLOPs, and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: 利用 LLM 自身进行视觉压缩的思路新颖，压缩比和加速数据亮眼，对多模态大模型在自动驾驶视频理解中的应用有较高参考价值。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用 LLM 自身压缩视觉 token 的方法 VoCo-LLaMA。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 通过注意力蒸馏将 LLM 对视觉 token 的理解迁移到视觉压缩 token 的处理中。
2406.12275|v2.result: 在 576 倍压缩比下性能损失极小，FLOPs 减少最多 94.8%，推理加速 69.6%。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: 针对 MLLM 在视觉指令微调中 LoRA 引入有害冗余、加剧通用知识遗忘并降低下游任务性能的问题，本文提出 LoRASculpt。该方法在理论保证下向 LoRA 引入稀疏更新以丢弃冗余参数，并提出冲突缓解正则化器（Conflict Mitigation Regularizer）优化 LoRA 更新轨迹，缓解与预训练权重的知识冲突。实验表明，即使在极高稀疏度（≤5%）下，该方法仍能同时提升泛化能力和下游任务性能，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the harmful redundancy introduced by LoRA during visual instruction tuning of MLLMs, which exacerbates forgetting of general knowledge and degrades downstream performance. It proposes LoRASculpt, which introduces sparse updates into LoRA with theoretical guarantees to discard redundant parameters, and a Conflict Mitigation Regularizer to refine the LoRA update trajectory and mitigate knowledge conflicts with pretrained weights. Experiments show that even at very high sparsity (≤5%), it simultaneously enhances generalization and downstream performance, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦 MLLM 微调中的知识保留问题，稀疏化与冲突缓解的结合有理论支撑，对持续学习场景有借鉴意义。
2503.16843|v2.contribution: 提出 LoRASculpt，通过稀疏更新和冲突缓解正则化协调 MLLM 中的通用与专用知识。
2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在理论保证下向 LoRA 引入稀疏更新，并提出冲突缓解正则化器优化更新轨迹。
2503.16843|v2.result: 在 ≤5% 极高稀疏度下同时提升泛化能力和下游任务性能，缓解灾难性遗忘。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: 针对 LMM 中大量视觉 token 导致推理延迟高的问题，本文提出 DivPrune，将 token 剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP），目标是选择多样性最大的 token 子集并剪除其余 token。与依赖大量校准和微调或使用次优重要性指标（导致保留 token 冗余）的现有方法不同，DivPrune 通过最大化所选 token 的多样性来减少冗余。该方法无需微调即可实现高效剪枝，在保持性能的同时显著降低推理延迟。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference latency of LMMs caused by numerous visual tokens by proposing DivPrune, which formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem (MMDP) to select a subset maximizing diversity among retained tokens. Unlike existing methods that require extensive calibration and fine-tuning or rely on suboptimal importance metrics leading to redundancy, DivPrune reduces redundancy by maximizing diversity of selected tokens. It achieves efficient pruning without fine-tuning while maintaining performance and significantly reducing inference latency.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 将 token 剪枝转化为多样性优化问题的视角新颖，无需微调且理论清晰，对多模态大模型高效推理有实用价值。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出基于多样性的视觉 token 剪枝方法 DivPrune，将剪枝建模为最大-最小多样性问题。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 以最大化所选 token 子集多样性为目标进行剪枝，而非依赖重要性指标。
2503.02175|v2.result: 无需微调即可减少保留 token 冗余，在保持性能的同时显著降低推理延迟。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）在低比特压缩方面研究不足的问题，论文发现多模态输入的冗余性导致注意力矩阵高度稀疏，并从理论和实验上证明注意力稀疏度约束了Query/Key权重矩阵的压缩误差上界。据此提出CASP压缩技术：对Q/K权重矩阵做数据感知的低秩分解，再基于最优比特分配进行全层量化。CASP可与任意量化方法兼容，在图像和视频-语言基准上将现有2-bit量化方法（AQLM、QuIP#）平均提升21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the under-explored problem of low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). The authors theoretically and experimentally show that the sparsity of the attention matrix bounds the compression error of Query and Key weight matrices, and propose CASP, which performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Q/K weights followed by optimal bit-allocation quantization across all layers. CASP is compatible with any quantization method and improves state-of-the-art 2-bit methods (AQLM, QuIP#) by an average of 21% on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 将注意力稀疏性与量化误差建立理论联系，为多模态模型压缩提供了新视角，且与现有量化方法正交可叠加，实用性强。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的LMM极端压缩框架CASP，包含数据感知低秩分解与最优比特分配量化。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 从理论上证明注意力矩阵稀疏度约束Q/K权重压缩误差，并据此设计压缩策略。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在图像和视频-语言基准上平均超越AQLM和QuIP#等2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: 现有MLLM难以同时处理时间与空间定位，原因在于坐标组合爆炸导致语言-视觉坐标对齐困难，以及视频特征压缩中细粒度时空信息编码困难。论文提出LLaVA-ST：用Language-Aligned Positional Embedding将文本坐标特殊token嵌入视觉空间以简化对齐，用Spatial-Temporal Packer将时间与空间分辨率的特征压缩解耦为两条point-to-region注意力流，并构建含4.3M样本的ST-Align数据集。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLMs struggle to jointly handle temporal and spatial localization due to the combinatorial explosion of coordinates and the difficulty of encoding fine-grained spatio-temporal information during video feature compression. The authors propose LLaVA-ST, featuring Language-Aligned Positional Embedding that embeds textual coordinate tokens into visual space, a Spatial-Temporal Packer that decouples temporal and spatial feature compression into two point-to-region attention streams, and the 4.3M-sample ST-Align dataset for fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 针对视频MLLM细粒度时空定位这一关键痛点提出系统性方案，配套大规模数据集对社区有直接价值。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出LLaVA-ST模型及ST-Align数据集，实现细粒度时空多模态理解。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入与时空解耦的point-to-region注意力压缩机制。
2501.08282|v2.result: 构建4.3M训练样本的ST-Align数据集并在细粒度时空理解任务上取得提升。

2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: 论文研究为何基于梯度的解释方法在Transformer上表现不佳，发现Transformer存在梯度流不平衡问题，违反了CNN天然具备的FullGrad完备性这一归因忠实性关键属性。提出LibraGrad，一种理论支撑的后处理方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向路径来校正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播也不增加计算开销。在8种架构、4种模型规模、4个数据集上，LibraGrad在Faithfulness、Completeness Error和Segmentation AP三类指标上全面超越现有白盒方法（包括Transformer专用方法）。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, a key property for attribution faithfulness naturally held by CNNs. It introduces LibraGrad, a theoretically grounded post-hoc method that corrects gradient imbalances by pruning and scaling backward paths without altering the forward pass or adding overhead. Across 8 architectures, 4 model sizes, and 4 datasets, LibraGrad universally improves gradient-based methods and outperforms existing white-box approaches on Faithfulness, Completeness Error, and Segmentation AP.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 为Transformer可解释性提供了理论驱动的通用改进，实验覆盖广泛，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出LibraGrad，通过校正Transformer梯度流不平衡提升归因忠实性。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 揭示Transformer违反FullGrad完备性的梯度不平衡问题并用反向路径剪枝缩放解决。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在8架构4规模4数据集上三类指标全面超越现有白盒归因方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: 3D Gaussian Splatting（3D-GS）在复杂场景中需数百万高斯点，存储与内存开销大，难以部署于资源受限设备。现有剪枝方法依赖启发式组合，高压缩比下视觉保真度和前景细节严重退化。论文提出基于二阶近似的敏感性剪枝分数，即重建误差对每个高斯空间参数的二阶近似，并设计多轮prune-refine流程，可应用于任意预训练3D-GS模型而无需改变训练管线。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents complex scenes with millions of Gaussians, causing high storage and memory costs that hinder deployment on resource-limited devices. Existing pruning methods rely on heuristic combinations and suffer severe degradation of visual fidelity and foreground details at high compression ratios. The authors propose a principled sensitivity pruning score computed as a second-order approximation of the reconstruction error with respect to each Gaussian's spatial parameters, along with a multi-round prune-refine pipeline applicable to any pretrained 3D-GS model without changing its training pipeline.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 为3D-GS压缩提供了有理论依据的剪枝准则，多轮prune-refine流程通用性好，但属于渲染/表示方向，与感知检测关联有限。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶重建误差近似的3D-GS敏感性剪枝分数及多轮prune-refine流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 用重建误差对高斯空间参数的二阶近似替代启发式剪枝准则。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在显著更高压缩比下保持视觉保真度与前景细节，优于现有剪枝方法。

2511.05832|v2.summary_cn: 全局自注意力在计算和内存上的二次复杂度限制了其在高分辨率图像上的应用，而局部注意力虽能降低复杂度，但传统局部注意力模式因窗口内 token 在 1D 序列中不连续，难以借助块稀疏内核获得显著加速。本文提出基于 Hilbert 曲线的窗口与邻域构建方法：先沿 Hilbert 曲线重排图像 token，再在重排后的 1D 序列上形成窗口和邻域，从而大幅提升块稀疏性，可与现有块稀疏内核结合以加速 2D 局部注意力。实验表明，Hilbert Window Attention 和 Hilbert Slide Attention 分别将窗口注意力和滑动注意力加速约 4 倍和 18 倍，并实例化为 Hilbert Window Transformer 与 Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer 实现端到端加速。
2511.05832|v2.summary_en: Global self-attention's quadratic compute and memory costs limit its use on high-resolution images, while conventional local attention patterns fail to yield significant speedups from block-sparse kernels because tokens within a window are not contiguous in the 1D sequence. This work proposes constructing windows and neighborhoods along a Hilbert curve: image tokens are reordered along the curve and windows are formed on the reordered 1D sequence, substantially increasing block sparsity and enabling combination with existing block-sparse kernels. Experiments show that Hilbert Window Attention and Hilbert Slide Attention accelerate window and slide attention by about 4x and 18x respectively, and are instantiated as the Hilbert Window Transformer and Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer for end-to-end speedups.
2511.05832|v2.assessment: 该工作从块稀疏角度重新审视局部注意力的效率瓶颈，Hilbert 曲线重排思路简洁且与现有稀疏内核兼容，对高分辨率视觉 Transformer 的部署有实用价值，但整体属于效率优化类工作，与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2511.05832|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Hilbert 曲线重排 token 的窗口与邻域构建策略，显著提升局部注意力的块稀疏性并实现大幅加速。
2511.05832|v2.innovation: 利用 Hilbert 曲线的空间局部性保持特性，将 2D 局部注意力转化为 1D 序列上高块稀疏性的注意力模式。
2511.05832|v2.result: 窗口注意力和滑动注意力分别加速约 4 倍和 18 倍，并实例化为两种 Transformer 实现端到端加速。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D点云配准通常采用两阶段流程：先做成对初始对齐，再做全局一致精化，但相邻点云重叠低、对称性和重复结构会导致初始对齐歧义。本文提出首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，将两阶段联合学习，利用全局循环一致性来消解歧义。在标准基准上显著超越当时SOTA，且计算开销更低，并提供了消融实验验证各组件。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: Multiview 3D point cloud registration is typically solved in two stages: pairwise initial alignment followed by globally consistent refinement, where the former is ambiguous due to low overlap, symmetries, and repetitive structures. This paper proposes the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly learns both stages, leveraging cyclic consistency across scans to resolve ambiguity. It significantly outperforms the state of the art on standard benchmarks while being computationally cheaper, with detailed ablations validating each component.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 这是多视角点云配准领域较早的端到端工作，思路清晰、实验扎实，对做3D感知与多传感器标定的研究者有参考价值。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端联合学习成对对齐与全局精化的多视角3D点云配准框架。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 将两阶段配准统一为可端到端训练的网络，并用多视角循环一致性约束消解低重叠下的对齐歧义。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在标准基准上大幅超越SOTA，同时计算成本更低，并通过消融验证了各模块有效性。
