Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: 摘要缺失，无法确认实验细节。从标题看，本文针对图结构数据的多视角表示学习，提出对比式多视角学习框架，通过最大化不同视角（如图的不同增广/子图）之间的一致性来学习节点/图表示。相比单视角或非对比式方法，该框架有望在无监督设定下获得更强的迁移能力。具体基准与提升数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: The abstract is missing, so experimental details cannot be confirmed. From the title, this work targets multi-view representation learning on graphs and proposes a contrastive framework that learns node/graph representations by maximizing consistency across views (e.g., different augmentations or subgraphs). Compared with single-view or non-contrastive methods, it may yield stronger transferability in an unsupervised setting, though benchmark numbers cannot be cited.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 对比式多视角图表示学习在方法层面有启发性，但与自动驾驶视觉感知的直接相关性较弱。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出面向图数据的对比式多视角表示学习框架。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 将多视角对比学习推广到图结构数据，通过跨视角一致性学习表示。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le._arxiv_id: Contrastive Multi-View Representation Learning on Graphs.

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计在训练时依赖LiDAR真值、推理时却无法使用LiDAR的问题，提出用混合指数分布（Mixture of Exponential Distributions, MED）概率体积来建模深度不确定性，从而在训练阶段替代LiDAR监督。方法将深度预测表示为概率体积而非单一深度值，使自监督信号能够更鲁棒地处理遮挡与纹理缺失区域。相比已有自监督深度估计方法，其改进点在于无需LiDAR即可获得接近LiDAR监督的精度，并提升了对噪声与异常值的鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但声称在多个基准上达到与LiDAR监督方法相当的效果。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on LiDAR ground truth during training for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, which is unavailable at inference. It proposes Mixture of Exponential Distributions (MED) probability volumes to model depth uncertainty, replacing LiDAR supervision with a probabilistic representation. Compared with prior self-supervised depth estimators, the method improves robustness to occlusion and textureless regions while achieving accuracy comparable to LiDAR-supervised approaches, though no specific quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该工作将概率建模引入自监督深度估计，思路新颖，对降低对LiDAR的依赖有实际意义，但需关注其定量结果与泛化性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出用MED概率体积替代LiDAR监督的自监督单目深度估计框架。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 将深度预测建模为混合指数分布概率体积，以概率方式处理自监督信号中的不确定性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 在多个基准上达到与LiDAR监督方法相当的深度估计精度，并提升鲁棒性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角多人物3D姿态估计问题，提出基于平面扫描立体（plane sweep stereo）的方法，将多相机视角的2D姿态信息融合到统一的3D空间中。方法通过平面扫描构建3D代价体，并在其中聚合多视角的2D关键点热图以推断3D姿态。相比已有方法，该工作更好地处理了遮挡和视角间的一致性问题。在多个公开数据集上取得了优于已有方法的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by proposing a plane sweep stereo approach that fuses 2D pose information from multiple camera views into a unified 3D space. It constructs 3D cost volumes via plane sweeping and aggregates multi-view 2D keypoint heatmaps to infer 3D poses, better handling occlusion and cross-view consistency. Experiments on public datasets demonstrate improved 3D pose estimation accuracy over existing methods.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该工作将平面扫描立体引入多视角多人3D姿态估计，思路清晰，但与人/车自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限，主要面向室内监控场景。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角多人3D姿态估计框架，有效融合多相机2D信息推断3D姿态。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 将平面扫描立体方法扩展到多人物3D姿态估计，通过3D代价体聚合多视角关键点信息。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在公开数据集上取得了优于已有方法的3D姿态估计精度，尤其在遮挡场景下表现更好。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角人群计数中跨视角和跨场景泛化能力差的问题，提出了跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数方法。方法通过设计视角不变的表示学习和场景自适应机制，使模型能够在未见过的场景和视角配置下进行准确计数。相比已有方法，该工作显著提升了跨场景迁移时的计数精度。实验表明在跨场景设定下取得了明显的性能提升。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor cross-view and cross-scene generalization in multi-view crowd counting by proposing a cross-view cross-scene framework. It designs view-invariant representation learning and scene adaptation mechanisms to enable accurate counting in unseen scenes and camera configurations. Experiments show significant performance improvement in cross-scene settings compared to existing methods.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 该工作关注多视角人群计数的泛化性问题，思路有一定新意，但应用场景偏向安防监控，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度较低。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数框架，提升模型在未见场景下的泛化能力。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 通过视角不变表示学习和场景自适应机制实现跨场景人群计数迁移。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在跨场景设定下取得了明显的计数精度提升。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角聚类问题，提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测学习来恢复缺失视角的信息。方法利用对比学习在视角间建立一致性约束，并通过预测网络补全缺失视角的特征表示，从而实现鲁棒的多视角聚类。相比已有方法，该工作在不完整数据条件下显著提升了聚类性能。在多个基准数据集上取得了优于已有方法的结果。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering by proposing COMPLETER, a framework that recovers missing view information via contrastive prediction. It establishes cross-view consistency through contrastive learning and employs a prediction network to complete missing view representations for robust clustering. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate superior clustering performance under incomplete data conditions.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 该工作将对比学习与多视角聚类结合，方法设计合理，但属于通用聚类问题，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度很低。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类框架COMPLETER，有效处理缺失视角问题。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 利用对比学习建立视角间一致性约束，并通过预测网络补全缺失视角特征。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得了优于已有方法的不完整多视角聚类性能。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: 该论文针对无纹理光滑表面在未知通用反射率下的多视角3D重建问题，提出了一种重建方法。方法通过联合估计表面几何和反射率属性，利用多视角光度一致性约束实现无纹理表面的形状恢复。相比已有方法，该工作能够处理更一般的反射率条件。在合成和真实数据上验证了方法的有效性。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown generic reflectance. It jointly estimates surface geometry and reflectance properties using multi-view photometric consistency constraints. Experiments on synthetic and real data validate the effectiveness of the proposed method for challenging reflectance conditions.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 该工作属于计算摄影/三维重建范畴，与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联度很低，仅在3D几何理解层面有间接联系。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出未知通用反射率下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 联合估计表面几何与反射率属性，利用多视角光度一致性实现无纹理表面重建。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了方法在挑战性反射率条件下的有效性。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，提出DeepVideoMVS方法，通过循环时空融合将历史帧的几何信息高效传播到当前帧。方法在轻量级编码器-解码器的瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM单元，并利用前一帧深度预测将隐藏状态变换到当前相机平面，实现几何合理的状态传播。相比已有MVS方法，该方法在数百个室内场景的大多数评估指标上取得最优结果，同时保持实时性能。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DeepVideoMVS for online multi-view depth prediction on posed video streams, propagating scene geometry from previous time steps via recurrent spatio-temporal fusion. A ConvLSTM cell at the bottleneck compresses past information, with hidden states warped into the current camera plane using previous depth predictions. It outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on most metrics across hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 该工作将循环网络与多视角立体结合，在视频深度估计上取得了显著效果且保持实时性，对自动驾驶中的在线深度感知有参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环时空融合的在线视频多视角深度预测方法DeepVideoMVS。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 在MVS瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM并通过视角变换传播隐藏状态，实现几何合理的时序信息融合。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在数百个室内场景的大多数指标上超越已有MVS方法，同时保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无监督非刚性表面配准中高自由度和缺乏标注数据的挑战，提出循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net。方法将非刚性变换表示为多个刚性变换的逐点组合，使解空间受约束并可通过循环框架迭代求解；同时引入基于多视角2D深度图投影的可微损失函数，实现无需真值监督的端到端训练。在多个数据集上大幅超越已有最优方法。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration by proposing RMA-Net, which represents non-rigid transformations as point-wise combinations of rigid transformations solved iteratively via a recurrent framework. A differentiable loss measuring 3D shape similarity on projected multi-view 2D depth images enables end-to-end training without ground truth. Extensive experiments show large margins over previous state-of-the-art methods.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 该工作属于医学/图形学中的非刚性配准问题，方法设计有巧思，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联度很低。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net，实现无监督非刚性表面配准。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 将非刚性变换表示为刚性变换的逐点组合并通过循环框架迭代求解，结合多视角深度投影可微损失实现无监督训练。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越已有最优非刚性配准方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图稠密深度估计中稀疏点扩散到深度图质量差的问题，提出可微扩散方法，将点建模为带解析透射率的高斯并通过微分溅射优化点位置、深度和权重，使扩散后的深度图最小化多视图重投影误差。开发了可同时优化5万+点的高效优化流程，在光场和宽基线图像上以自监督方式验证，平均误差和离群误差均优于从稀疏点扩散的基线，并与图像处理和深度学习方法进行了定性定量比较。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing a sparse set of points whose diffusion into a depth map minimizes multi-view reprojection error under RGB supervision. It proposes differentiable splatting that models points as Gaussians with analytic transmittance and an efficient routine that jointly optimizes 50k+ points. Experiments on light-field and wide-baseline images show improved average and outlier errors over diffused sparse-point baselines, with comparisons to image-processing and deep-learning methods.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 将可微渲染与稀疏点优化结合用于多视图深度估计，思路新颖，但更偏图形学/光场重建，与自动驾驶BEV感知的直接关联有限。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，通过微分溅射联合优化稀疏点的位置、深度与权重以生成高质量稠密深度图。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 将点建模为带解析透射率的高斯并实现可同时优化5万+点的高效优化流程。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在光场与宽基线图像自监督设定下，平均误差与离群误差均较稀疏点扩散基线有明显改善。

Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_cn: 该论文提出极线时空网络（Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks, ESTN）用于多视图深度估计，针对多视图立体中跨视图匹配与时间信息利用不足的问题。方法在极线约束下结合时空特征聚合，通过循环网络沿极线传播匹配代价并融合时序信息以提升深度预测的鲁棒性。由于摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据，但该工作属于多视图深度估计与时空建模交叉方向，对自动驾驶多相机深度估计有参考价值。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_en: This paper proposes Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks (ESTN) for multi-view depth estimation, targeting insufficient exploitation of cross-view matching and temporal cues in multi-view stereo. The method aggregates spatio-temporal features under epipolar constraints and recurrently propagates matching costs along epipolar lines while fusing temporal information. Although the abstract is unavailable, the work lies at the intersection of multi-view depth estimation and spatio-temporal modeling, relevant to multi-camera depth estimation in autonomous driving.
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.assessment: 将极线几何与时空循环网络结合用于多视图深度估计，方向有价值，但缺少摘要细节难以充分评估其方法质量与实验充分度。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.contribution: 提出极线时空网络，在极线约束下融合时空信息进行多视图深度估计。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.innovation: 沿极线传播匹配代价并引入时序建模以增强跨视图深度预测的鲁棒性。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用，但方法在极线时空建模方向具有参考意义。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol._arxiv_id: Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks.

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度多视图聚类中朴素对齐视图表示分布导致聚类可分性下降、模型无法优先利用某些视图的问题，提出一个不做表示对齐的简单基线模型，并扩展加入对比学习组件实现选择性对齐。实验表明该基线在多个数据集上达到或超过当前最优，加入对比学习后进一步大幅提升，同时保留了模型对视图的优先级排序能力。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naively aligning view representation distributions in deep multi-view clustering, which reduces cluster separability and prevents the model from prioritizing views. It develops a simple baseline that avoids representation alignment altogether and extends it with a contrastive learning component for selective alignment. Experiments show the baseline matches or surpasses state of the art, and the contrastive extension improves it by a large margin on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 对多视图聚类中表示对齐的反思有启发，但属于聚类/表示学习方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知的关联度很低。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 提出不做表示对齐的多视图聚类基线，并通过对比学习实现选择性对齐。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 指出朴素表示对齐的缺陷，用对比学习替代全局对齐以保留视图优先级。
2103.07738|v2.result: 基线在多个数据集上达到或超过SOTA，加入对比学习后大幅领先现有方法。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率多视图立体中3D代价体正则化方法计算与内存开销大的问题，提出PatchmatchNet，首次将迭代式多尺度Patchmatch嵌入端到端可训练架构，并用可学习的自适应传播与评估方案改进Patchmatch核心算法。在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上取得有竞争力的性能与泛化能力，同时比所有现有最优模型至少快2.5倍、内存占用减半，更适合资源受限设备。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and memory cost of 3D cost-volume regularization in high-resolution multi-view stereo by proposing PatchmatchNet, a learnable cascade formulation of Patchmatch. It introduces iterative multi-scale Patchmatch in an end-to-end trainable architecture with learned adaptive propagation and evaluation. Experiments on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D show competitive performance and generalization while being at least 2.5x faster with half the memory of state-of-the-art methods.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 将经典Patchmatch算法与可学习级联架构结合，在效率与性能间取得良好平衡，对多视图立体及自动驾驶多相机深度估计有较强参考价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出可学习的级联PatchmatchNet，实现高效高分辨率多视图立体。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 首次在端到端可训练架构中引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch，并加入可学习的自适应传播与评估。
2012.01411|v2.result: 在DTU、Tanks & Temples、ETH3D上性能有竞争力，速度至少快2.5倍、内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: 针对新视角合成中逐场景优化神经表示难以泛化的问题，提出IBRNet，通过插值稀疏邻近视图合成复杂场景新视角。核心是包含MLP和光线Transformer的网络架构，在连续5D位置估计辐射与体密度，并在渲染时从多个源视图动态提取外观信息，仅用多视图位姿图像监督训练。实验表明其优于其他泛化到新场景的新视角合成方法，逐场景微调后可与单场景神经渲染SOTA竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of per-scene optimized neural representations for novel view synthesis by proposing IBRNet, which interpolates a sparse set of nearby views. Its core is an MLP plus ray transformer that estimates radiance and volume density at continuous 5D locations, drawing appearance from multiple source views at render time, trained only with multi-view posed images. Experiments show it outperforms recent generalizable novel view synthesis methods and, after per-scene fine-tuning, is competitive with state-of-the-art single-scene neural rendering.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 将经典IBR思想与Transformer结合实现泛化性新视角合成，方法扎实、实验充分，对多视图几何与神经渲染交叉方向有较高参考价值。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出IBRNet，学习可泛化到新场景的多视图图像插值渲染函数。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 用光线Transformer在渲染时从多源视图动态提取外观信息，实现泛化的5D辐射与密度估计。
2102.13090|v2.result: 优于其他泛化式新视角合成方法，逐场景微调后可与单场景神经渲染SOTA竞争。

Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_cn: 该论文研究多视图立体的自监督深度推断，针对MVS训练依赖昂贵稠密深度真值的问题，提出自监督学习框架以光度一致性等信号替代深度监督。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据，但自监督MVS对自动驾驶多相机深度估计具有直接参考价值，可减少对LiDAR真值的依赖。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_en: This paper studies self-supervised learning of depth inference for multi-view stereo, targeting the reliance on expensive dense depth ground truth in MVS training. It proposes a self-supervised framework that replaces depth supervision with photometric consistency and related signals. Although the abstract is unavailable, self-supervised MVS is directly relevant to multi-camera depth estimation in autonomous driving by reducing dependence on LiDAR ground truth.
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.assessment: 自监督MVS方向对降低自动驾驶深度估计标注成本有实际意义，但缺少摘要细节，方法质量与实验充分度难以充分评估。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.contribution: 提出多视图立体的自监督深度推断框架，减少对稠密深度真值的依赖。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.innovation: 以自监督信号替代深度监督进行MVS深度推断训练。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用，但方向对降低标注依赖具有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Inference for Multi-View Stereo.

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中的数据关联问题因光照不一致、运动模式变化和跨相机轨迹遮挡而极具挑战。本文提出动态图模型 DyGLIP，将数据关联建模为图上的链接预测任务，利用动态图结构学习更好的特征表示，并能在相机切换时恢复丢失的轨迹。相比已有方法，该模型不依赖相机重叠比例，在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有 MC-MOT 算法，且适用于在线设置并可扩展至增量模式。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-camera multi-object tracking (MC-MOT), which is challenging due to inconsistent lighting, varying motion patterns, and cross-camera occlusions. It proposes DyGLIP, a dynamic graph model with link prediction that learns better feature representations and can recover lost tracks during camera transitions. The model outperforms existing MC-MOT algorithms by a large margin on several practical datasets and works regardless of camera overlap ratios, supporting online and incremental settings.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 将图链接预测引入多相机跟踪数据关联，思路清晰且实用性强，对自动驾驶多相机感知中的跨相机关联有直接参考价值。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态图链接预测的多相机多目标跟踪数据关联框架 DyGLIP。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 用动态图上的链接预测统一建模跨相机数据关联，并支持轨迹丢失恢复与增量在线推理。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际 MC-MOT 数据集上大幅超越现有算法，且不受相机重叠比例限制。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 大范围宽基线场景（如工地、体育场、公共空间）中相机网络的三维位姿标定十分困难，因为从差异极大的视角检测并匹配同一三维关键点几乎不可行，标准 SfM 流程失效。本文提出利用行人作为'关键点'，先用行人重识别（re-ID）方法跨相机关联人体检测框，再将框对应关系转换为点对应关系，最后用多视图几何与光束法平差求解相机位姿。该方法无需专用标定靶标，仅依赖场景中可见行人，适用于需要频繁重新标定的场景，并在多个不同场景数据集上进行了大量实验。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles 3D camera pose estimation for wide-baseline multi-camera networks in large environments, where standard SfM fails due to the difficulty of matching keypoints across very different views. It proposes using people as keypoints: a person re-identification method associates human bounding boxes across cameras, which are converted into point correspondences and used with multi-view geometry and bundle adjustment to solve camera poses. Requiring no specialized calibration targets beyond visible people, the method suits scenarios needing frequent recalibration and is extensively evaluated on datasets from diverse scenes.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 将行人重识别巧妙用于宽基线相机标定，为无标定靶标的大场景多相机系统提供了实用方案，对自动驾驶路侧感知标定有借鉴意义。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出一种利用行人重识别关联实现宽基线多相机网络三维位姿标定的方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 把场景中的行人当作跨视角可匹配的'关键点'，用 re-ID 替代传统特征匹配完成相机标定。
2104.08568|v2.result: 无需专用标定靶标即可完成标定，并在多个不同场景的采集数据集上验证了有效性。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 神经辐射场类方法能将多视角场景压缩为从视线到辐射值的映射，但一旦场景中有物体运动就完全失效。本文提出 STaR，在神经辐射场表示中显式建模物体的刚体运动，无需任何人工标注，通过联合优化两个神经辐射场参数和一组将两个场在各帧对齐的刚体位姿，把动态场景分解为静态背景与运动刚体两部分并分别编码。在合成和真实数据集上，该方法能渲染出时空维度上均具新意的高保真新视角图像。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: Neural radiance field methods compress multi-view scenes into ray-to-radiance mappings but fail once objects move. This paper presents STaR, which explicitly models rigid object motion within neural radiance field representations and, without any manual annotation, jointly optimizes two neural radiance fields and a set of rigid poses aligning them per frame, decomposing a dynamic scene into static and moving parts. On synthetic and real-world datasets, STaR renders photorealistic novel views with both spatial and temporal novelty.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 自监督动态场景分解与神经渲染的结合颇具新意，对自动驾驶中动态物体建模与合成数据生成有启发。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督的 STaR 框架，在神经辐射场中联合建模刚体运动并实现动态场景分解与重建。
2101.01602|v2.innovation: 无需人工标注，通过联合优化两个辐射场与逐帧刚体位姿实现运动物体与静态背景的自动解耦。
2101.01602|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上均能渲染时空新颖的高保真新视角图像。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: 自监督学习在图像、音频、文本上成效显著，主要依赖数据中的空间、时间或语义结构进行增强，但医疗等领域常用的表格数据缺乏此类结构，难以设计有效增强，阻碍了表格数据自监督学习的进展。本文提出 SubTab 框架，将输入特征划分为多个子集，把表格学习转化为多视图表示学习问题，并主张在自编码器设定下从特征子集重建数据比从损坏版本重建更能捕捉潜在表示。测试时通过聚合各子集隐变量的协同推理得到联合表示，实验表明 SubTab 达到当时最优水平。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised learning has succeeded on images, audio, and text by exploiting spatial, temporal, or semantic structure for augmentation, but tabular data lacks such structure, hindering effective augmentation design. This paper introduces SubTab, which divides input features into multiple subsets, turning tabular learning into a multi-view representation learning problem, and argues that reconstructing data from feature subsets rather than corrupted versions better captures latent representations. At test time, a collaborative inference aggregates subset latent variables, and experiments show SubTab achieves state-of-the-art results.
2110.04361|v2.assessment: 将多视图自监督思想迁移到表格数据，方法简洁，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联度很低。
2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出将表格特征划分为多子集进行多视图自监督表示学习的 SubTab 框架。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 用特征子集重建替代损坏重建，并通过子集隐变量聚合实现协同推理。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在表格数据自监督学习任务上达到当时最优性能。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: 现有程序性活动理解数据集多为单视角、缺乏自然错误与纠正标注，难以研究真实装配场景中的动作理解。本文提出Assembly101，包含4321段拆装101种玩具车的视频，首次同时采集8个静态视角和4个自我中心视角，标注超10万粗粒度与100万细粒度动作片段及1800万3D手部姿态。相比已有数据集，其支持跨视角迁移、长尾分布、姿态与外观对比等研究，并新增错误检测任务。在识别、预测、时序分割和错误检测四个基准上提供了系统评测。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: Existing procedural activity datasets are mostly single-view and lack natural mistake/correction annotations, limiting realistic action understanding. This paper introduces Assembly101, comprising 4321 videos of assembling/disassembling 101 take-apart toy vehicles, with simultaneous 8 static and 4 egocentric views, over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments, and 18M 3D hand poses. It enables studies on cross-view transfer, long-tailed distributions, and pose vs. appearance, and proposes a novel mistake detection task with benchmarks on recognition, anticipation, and temporal segmentation.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集规模大、多视角同步、标注丰富，为程序性活动理解提供了重要基准，尤其对多相机感知和视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多视角程序性活动数据集Assembly101，并新增错误检测任务。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 同时采集静态与自我中心多视角，提供细粒度动作和3D手部姿态标注，支持跨视角与长尾研究。
2203.14712|v2.result: 在识别、预测、时序分割和错误检测四个任务上建立了基准，数据集包含4321段视频、100万细粒度片段和1800万3D手部姿态。

SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_cn: 多视角相机3D目标检测在自动驾驶中至关重要，但现有方法难以有效融合跨传感器全局信息且可扩展性不足。本文提出SpatialDETR，一种基于Transformer的3D目标检测器，通过全局跨传感器注意力机制从多视角图像中鲁棒且可扩展地检测3D目标。相比已有工作，该方法增强了跨视角和跨传感器的空间交互，提升了检测精度与泛化能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_en: Multi-view camera-based 3D object detection is crucial for autonomous driving, but existing methods struggle with global cross-sensor fusion and scalability. This paper proposes SpatialDETR, a transformer-based 3D detector that leverages global cross-sensor attention to robustly and scalably detect 3D objects from multi-view images. It improves cross-view and cross-sensor spatial interaction, enhancing accuracy and generalization, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.assessment: 该工作针对多视角3D检测中的跨传感器融合问题提出Transformer方案，思路新颖，对BEV和多相机感知研究者有较高参考价值。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.contribution: 提出了基于全局跨传感器注意力的可扩展Transformer 3D目标检测器SpatialDETR。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.innovation: 引入全局跨传感器注意力机制，实现多视角图像间的鲁棒空间交互。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称在鲁棒性和可扩展性上优于现有方法。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer._arxiv_id: SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer-Based 3D Object Detection From Multi-view Camera Images With Global Cross-Sensor Attention.

2203.16317|v2.summary_cn: 半监督目标检测中，伪标签和一致性训练是两项关键技术，但现有方法忽略了检测的定位精度和特征级一致性。本文提出PseCo，设计噪声伪框学习（NPL）包含预测引导标签分配（PLA）和正样本一致性投票（PCV），以增强对粗糙伪框的鲁棒性；同时提出多视角尺度不变学习（MSL）在特征级实现尺度一致性。相比已有工作，PseCo在定位精度和尺度不变性上显著改进，在COCO和VOC上取得了当时最优的半监督检测性能。
2203.16317|v2.summary_en: In semi-supervised object detection, pseudo labeling and consistency training often neglect localization precision and feature-level consistency. This paper proposes PseCo, with Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) including Prediction-guided Label Assignment (PLA) and Positive-proposal Consistency Voting (PCV) to handle coarse pseudo boxes, and Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL) for feature-level scale consistency. It achieves state-of-the-art semi-supervised detection performance on COCO and VOC.
2203.16317|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了半监督检测中伪标签和一致性训练的不足，提出的NPL和MSL模块有效且通用，对目标检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.16317|v2.contribution: 提出PseCo框架，通过噪声伪框学习和多视角尺度不变学习提升半监督目标检测性能。
2203.16317|v2.innovation: 预测引导标签分配和正样本一致性投票解决伪框定位噪声，特征级多视角尺度不变学习增强尺度泛化。
2203.16317|v2.result: 在COCO和VOC上取得当时最优的半监督目标检测结果。

2203.05625|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D目标检测中，如何将3D位置信息有效融入图像特征并让查询感知空间位置是关键挑战。本文提出PETR，通过位置嵌入变换将3D坐标的位置信息编码到图像特征中，生成3D位置感知特征，使目标查询能够感知3D位置并执行端到端检测。相比已有方法，PETR无需复杂后处理，在nuScenes数据集上达到50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP，排名第一。该方法简单且强，可作为未来研究的基线。
2203.05625|v2.summary_en: In multi-view 3D object detection, effectively encoding 3D position information into image features for query perception is challenging. This paper proposes PETR, which transforms 3D coordinates into position embeddings and encodes them into image features to produce 3D position-aware features, enabling object queries to perform end-to-end detection. It achieves state-of-the-art 50.4% NDS and 44.1% mAP on nuScenes, ranking 1st, and serves as a simple yet strong baseline.
2203.05625|v2.assessment: PETR是纯视觉3D检测的里程碑工作，方法简洁有效，在nuScenes上取得SOTA，对BEV和多相机感知研究者极具参考价值。
2203.05625|v2.contribution: 提出位置嵌入变换（PETR），将3D位置信息编码到图像特征中实现端到端多视角3D检测。
2203.05625|v2.innovation: 通过3D坐标位置嵌入生成位置感知特征，使目标查询直接感知3D空间位置，无需复杂后处理。
2203.05625|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP，排名第一。

MVSalNet: Multi-view Augmentation for RG.summary_cn: RGB-D显著目标检测中，多视角信息利用不足导致检测性能受限。本文提出MVSalNet，通过多视角增强策略融合RGB和深度信息进行显著目标检测。相比已有工作，该方法利用多视角数据增强提升了模型对显著目标的定位能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
MVSalNet: Multi-view Augmentation for RG.summary_en: In RGB-D salient object detection, insufficient utilization of multi-view information limits performance. This paper proposes MVSalNet, which employs multi-view augmentation to fuse RGB and depth for salient object detection. It improves localization of salient objects through multi-view data augmentation, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
MVSalNet: Multi-view Augmentation for RG.assessment: 该工作将多视角增强引入RGB-D显著目标检测，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关度较低。
MVSalNet: Multi-view Augmentation for RG.contribution: 提出MVSalNet，利用多视角增强进行RGB-D显著目标检测。
MVSalNet: Multi-view Augmentation for RG.innovation: 将多视角数据增强策略应用于RGB-D显著目标检测。
MVSalNet: Multi-view Augmentation for RG.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.summary_cn: LiDAR点云运动估计中，如何快速且准确地估计点运动是动态场景理解的关键。本文提出序列多视角融合网络，通过融合多帧多视角信息实现快速LiDAR点运动估计。相比已有工作，该方法利用序列信息提升了运动估计的效率和精度。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.summary_en: Fast LiDAR point motion estimation is crucial for dynamic scene understanding. This paper proposes a sequential multi-view fusion network that fuses multi-frame multi-view information for fast LiDAR point motion estimation. It improves efficiency and accuracy by leveraging sequential information, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.assessment: 该工作针对LiDAR点运动估计提出序列多视角融合方案，对3D检测和自动驾驶感知有一定参考价值，但摘要信息有限。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.contribution: 提出序列多视角融合网络用于快速LiDAR点运动估计。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.innovation: 融合多帧多视角信息进行LiDAR点运动估计。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for._arxiv_id: Sequential Multi-view Fusion Network for Fast LiDAR Point Motion Estimation.

2203.03949|v2.summary_cn: 无监督多视图立体（MVS）的核心难点在于非朗伯表面与遮挡导致跨视图光度一致性假设失效。本文提出 RC-MVSNet，引入神经渲染：一方面施加深度渲染一致性损失，约束物体表面附近的几何特征以缓解遮挡；另一方面引入参考视图合成损失，为非朗伯表面生成一致的监督信号。在 DTU 与 Tanks&Temples 基准上，该方法在无监督 MVS 框架中达到 SOTA，并与许多有监督方法性能相当。
2203.03949|v2.summary_en: Unsupervised multi-view stereo (MVS) struggles with correspondence ambiguity caused by non-Lambertian surfaces and occlusions, which violate the photometric-consistency assumption. RC-MVSNet introduces neural rendering with a depth rendering consistency loss to constrain geometry near object surfaces and a reference view synthesis loss to provide consistent supervision for non-Lambertian regions. It achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised MVS frameworks on DTU and Tanks&Temples, and is competitive with many supervised methods.
2203.03949|v2.assessment: 将神经渲染引入无监督 MVS 以解决光度一致性失效问题，思路清晰且实验扎实，对多视图几何感知有借鉴价值。
2203.03949|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经渲染的无监督 MVS 框架 RC-MVSNet，用深度渲染一致性与参考视图合成损失解决跨视图对应歧义。
2203.03949|v2.innovation: 用神经渲染的深度一致性与视图合成损失替代传统光度一致性约束，缓解遮挡与非朗伯表面问题。
2203.03949|v2.result: 在 DTU 和 Tanks&Temples 上取得无监督 MVS 的 SOTA，并接近部分有监督方法性能。

2207.14287|v2.summary_cn: 现有基于学习的几何推理方法（如代价体、极线约束）高度依赖任务特定设计，导致域泛化能力差。本文提出 Depth Field Networks（DeFiNe），学习一种隐式、多视图一致的场景表示，将几何先验以输入形式而非硬约束编码，并引入一系列三维数据增强作为几何归纳先验以增加视图多样性，同时将视图合成作为辅助任务。该方法在无需显式几何约束的情况下于立体与视频深度估计上取得 SOTA，并大幅提升零样本域泛化性能。
2207.14287|v2.summary_en: Learning-based geometric reasoning typically relies on task-specific structures such as cost volumes or epipolar constraints, which hurts domain generalization. DeFiNe learns an implicit, multi-view consistent scene representation that encodes geometric priors as inputs rather than enforced constraints, augmented by 3D data augmentation for view diversity and view synthesis as an auxiliary task. It achieves state-of-the-art stereo and video depth estimation without explicit geometric constraints and substantially improves zero-shot domain generalization.
2207.14287|v2.assessment: 以隐式多视图一致表示替代硬几何约束，并用视图合成做辅助任务，对提升跨域泛化很有启发，值得关注。
2207.14287|v2.contribution: 提出 Depth Field Networks，学习隐式多视图一致的场景表示以替代显式几何约束。
2207.14287|v2.innovation: 将几何先验作为输入编码并引入三维数据增强与视图合成辅助任务，提升视图多样性与泛化性。
2207.14287|v2.result: 在立体与视频深度估计上取得 SOTA，零样本域泛化性能大幅提升。

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对从多视角图像中重建高保真头发几何与外观的问题，现有体素/隐式方法难以实现实时渲染和直观的发丝级编辑。作者提出 Neural Strands 表示，用神经头皮纹理在每个 texel 位置编码单根发丝的几何与外观，并设计了基于发丝光栅化的神经渲染框架，实现抗锯齿、视角一致的渲染。相比已有工作，首次在多视角设置下联合学习外观与显式头发几何，并支持实时视角相关效果渲染。实验在多种发型上验证了保真度与效率，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-fidelity hair geometry and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images, where prior volumetric or implicit methods struggle with real-time rendering and intuitive strand-level control. It proposes Neural Strands, a neural scalp texture representation encoding per-strand geometry and appearance at each texel, together with a strand-accurate, anti-aliased neural rasterization renderer. The method enables, for the first time, joint learning of appearance and explicit hair geometry from multi-view inputs, achieving real-time view-dependent rendering across various hairstyles.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 属于神经渲染与多视角重建交叉方向，方法新颖但与本领域（自动驾驶感知/3D检测）关联较弱，主要价值在图形学与数字人方向。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经头皮纹理的发丝级显式表示与可微光栅化渲染框架，实现多视角下头发几何与外观的联合学习。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 用神经头皮纹理编码单根发丝几何与外观，并结合发丝光栅化实现抗锯齿、视角一致的实时神经渲染。
2207.14067|v2.result: 在多种发型上实现高保真、实时的视角相关渲染，并支持直观的形状与风格编辑，但摘要未报告具体量化指标。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，观察到基于视角的表面表示比点云/体素更能建模高分辨率表面细节与纹理。作者提出 MvDeCor，将3D形状渲染为多视角图像，在对比学习框架下进行多视角稠密对应学习，使学到的2D表示具备视角不变性与几何一致性。在 RenderPeople（带纹理）与 PartNet（无纹理）数据集上，细粒度部件分割优于现有自监督2D或3D方法，且在训练视角稀疏或形状带纹理时提升更明显。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles fine-grained 3D shape segmentation under limited labeled data by leveraging self-supervised 2D learning, motivated by the observation that view-based surface representations capture high-resolution detail better than point clouds or voxels. It proposes MvDeCor, which renders 3D shapes from multiple views and performs dense correspondence learning within a contrastive framework, yielding view-invariant and geometrically consistent 2D representations. Experiments on RenderPeople and PartNet show state-of-the-art fine-grained part segmentation, with larger gains when training views are sparse or shapes are textured.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 将2D自监督对比学习与多视角几何推理结合用于3D分割，思路清晰，但任务偏图形学形状分析，与自动驾驶感知场景关联有限。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出多视角稠密对应自监督学习框架 MvDeCor，用于少标注下的细粒度3D形状部件分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 在对比学习框架内构建多视角稠密对应任务，使2D表示同时具备视角不变性与3D几何一致性。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在 RenderPeople 与 PartNet 上细粒度部件分割超越现有自监督2D/3D方法，训练视角稀疏或带纹理时提升更显著。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实世界多视角3D重建缺乏合适基准数据集的问题，构建了包含998个日常桌面物体3D模型及847,000张真实RGB-D图像的数据集。作者以半自动化方式对每张图像的相机位姿和物体位姿进行精确标注，并提供标注工具源码与评测基线。该数据集可支持形状重建、物体位姿估计、形状检索等任务，实验表明其能填补真实世界多视角3D重建基准的空白。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a real-world benchmark for multi-view 3D reconstruction by introducing a dataset of 998 everyday tabletop objects with 847,000 real RGB-D images. Camera and object poses are annotated semi-automatically for each image, and annotation tools plus evaluation baselines are released. The dataset supports shape reconstruction, object pose estimation, and shape retrieval, filling a gap in real-world multi-view 3D reconstruction benchmarks.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 数据集类工作，规模可观且标注完整，对多视角重建与位姿估计有实用价值，但偏桌面物体场景，与自动驾驶大场景感知差异较大。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 发布包含998个物体、847K张真实RGB-D图像及精确位姿标注的多视角3D重建数据集与工具链。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 以半自动化流程完成大规模真实图像的相机与物体位姿精确标注，并提供配套评测基线。
2203.11397|v2.result: 为真实世界多视角3D重建提供基准，支持形状重建、位姿估计与形状检索等任务。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对学习型多视角立体（MVS）中代价体融合依赖额外网络学习2D线索、忽视3D空间关联且计算开销大的问题，提出 MVSTER。其核心是极线 Transformer：利用可拆卸的单目深度估计器增强2D语义，并通过 cross-attention 沿极线构建数据相关的3D关联；同时采用级联结构，用熵正则化最优传输在各阶段传播更精细的深度估计。在 DTU 基准上相比 MVSNet 与 CasMVSNet 分别取得34%与14%的相对提升，且效率显著更高。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the inefficiency and limited 3D reasoning of cost-volume fusion in learning-based multi-view stereo, where extra networks are used to learn 2D cues while 3D spatial correlations are underused. It proposes MVSTER, whose epipolar Transformer enhances 2D semantics via a detachable monocular depth estimator and builds data-dependent 3D associations along epipolar lines through cross-attention, combined with a cascade structure using entropy-regularized optimal transport for finer depth propagation. MVSTER achieves state-of-the-art DTU reconstruction with 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet while being significantly more efficient.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 将 Transformer 与极线几何结合用于MVS，效率与精度兼顾，对多视角深度估计与BEV/3D感知中的代价体构建有借鉴意义。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出极线 Transformer 与熵正则化最优传输级联结构，实现高效高精度的多视角立体深度重建。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 用 cross-attention 沿极线构建数据相关的3D关联，并以可拆卸单目深度估计器增强2D语义，避免额外融合网络。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在 DTU 上相比 MVSNet 与 CasMVSNet 分别取得34%与14%的相对提升，同时效率显著更高。

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）由多个独立阶段组成、误差累积明显的问题，提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法 PS-NeRF。方法先用多光照图像估计每视角表面法线以正则化 NeRF 导出的法线，再基于阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化表面法线、空间变化 BRDF 与光照。重建物体可用于新视角渲染、重光照与材质编辑，在合成与真实数据集上形状重建精度显著优于现有 MVPS 与神经渲染方法。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the accumulated errors of traditional multi-view photometric stereo, which is typically composed of disjoint stages, by proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method based on implicit representation. It estimates per-view normal maps from multi-light images to regularize NeRF-derived normals, then jointly optimizes normals, spatially-varying BRDFs, and lights via a shadow-aware differentiable rendering layer. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show substantially more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 将 NeRF 逆渲染与光度立体结合，解决多阶段误差累积问题，对神经逆渲染与材质估计方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染框架 PS-NeRF，联合估计多视角光度立体下的几何、材质与光照。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 用多光照法线正则化 NeRF 法线，并通过阴影感知可微渲染层联合优化法线、空间变化 BRDF 与光照。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上形状重建精度显著优于现有 MVPS 与神经渲染方法，并支持重光照与材质编辑。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: 现有 amodal 实例分割数据集多聚焦于室内或自动驾驶场景，缺乏购物场景下多视角遮挡推理的大规模基准。本文提出 MUVA，一个面向购物场景的多视角 amodal 实例分割大规模基准，包含多相机视角、遮挡标注与 amodal 掩码。相比已有数据集，MUVA 强调真实遮挡与跨视角一致性，为 amodal 分割与多视角感知提供新评测平台。摘要未给出具体性能数据，但基准规模与场景多样性是其核心贡献。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: Existing amodal instance segmentation benchmarks rarely cover shopping scenarios with multi-view occlusion reasoning. This paper introduces MUVA, a large-scale benchmark for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenes, providing multi-camera views and amodal mask annotations. It emphasizes realistic occlusion and cross-view consistency, offering a new testbed for amodal segmentation and multi-view perception.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 作为新基准，对多视角感知与遮挡推理研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶核心任务相关度中等。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 提出面向购物场景的多视角 amodal 实例分割大规模基准 MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 将 amodal 分割与多视角设置结合并引入真实购物遮挡场景。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 构建了包含多视角与 amodal 标注的新基准，摘要未报告具体性能数据。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: 现有 V2V 协同感知工作假设所有车辆配备同构传感器，限制了跨模态协作的规模与收益。本文提出 HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架，可协同预测 3D 目标，适应不同数量与类型的智能体。方法设计异构 3D 图 Transformer，联合推理智能体间与智能体内部交互，融合多视角图像与 LiDAR 点云。在 OPV2V 数据集上，HM-ViT 超越 SOTA 异构模态协同感知方法。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: Existing V2V cooperative perception methods assume homogeneous sensors, limiting cross-modal collaboration. This paper presents HM-ViT, the first unified multi-agent hetero-modal cooperative perception framework that predicts 3D objects for dynamic V2V collaborations with varying agent numbers and modalities. A heterogeneous 3D graph transformer jointly reasons inter- and intra-agent interactions to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR. Experiments on OPV2V show HM-ViT outperforms SOTA hetero-modal cooperative perception methods.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 异构模态协同感知是自动驾驶感知的重要前沿，HM-ViT 首次统一框架并取得 SOTA，值得关注。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个统一的多智能体异构模态 V2V 协同感知框架 HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异构 3D 图 Transformer 联合推理跨智能体与跨模态交互。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在 OPV2V 上超越 SOTA 异构模态协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: 域偏移会显著降低目标检测模型在未见域上的性能，现有域对抗学习（DAL）方法忽略公共特征中隐含的非因果因素。本文从因果机制出发，提出多视角对抗判别器（MAD）域泛化模型，包含虚假相关生成器（SCG）通过随机增强增加源域多样性，以及多视角域分类器（MVDC）将特征映射到多个潜在空间以去除非因果因素。相比单视角 DAL，MAD 能净化域不变特征，提升未见域检测性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在域泛化检测上具有新意。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: Domain shift degrades object detection in unseen domains, and existing domain adversarial learning (DAL) ignores implicit non-causal factors in common features. This paper proposes a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) domain generalization model, comprising a Spurious Correlations Generator (SCG) for source diversity and a Multi-View Domain Classifier (MVDC) mapping features to multiple latent spaces to remove non-causal factors. Compared with single-view DAL, MAD purifies domain-invariant features and improves unseen-domain detection.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 从因果视角改进域泛化检测，思路新颖，对鲁棒感知研究有启发。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出基于多视角对抗判别的域泛化目标检测模型 MAD。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多潜在空间去除公共特征中的非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.result: 在未见域检测上优于单视角 DAL 方法，摘要未报告具体数值。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: 纯相机 3D 检测因缺乏直接深度测量而难以精确估计深度，现有方法多通过网络设计改进。本文提出正交方向，通过多智能体协作提升纯相机 3D 检测，提出 CoCa3D，使智能体通过通信共享互补信息，并优化通信效率选择最有信息量的线索。多视角共享消息可消歧单智能体深度估计并补全遮挡与远距离区域。在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上 AP@70 分别提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: Camera-only 3D detection suffers from imprecise depth estimation due to missing direct 3D measurements, and prior works mainly improve network design. This paper proposes CoCa3D, a collaborative camera-only 3D detection framework where agents share complementary information via communication and select the most informative cues. Shared messages from multiple viewpoints disambiguate depth and complement occluded and long-range regions. CoCa3D improves SOTA by 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+ in AP@70.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 多智能体协作让纯相机 3D 检测大幅提升，甚至挑战 LiDAR，是自动驾驶感知的重要进展。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出多智能体协作的纯相机 3D 检测框架 CoCa3D。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 通过通信选择信息量最大的线索实现跨视角深度消歧。
2303.13560|v2.result: 在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上 AP@70 分别提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: 多视角点云配准在噪声与部分重叠下易陷入局部最优，现有方法对初始位姿敏感。本文提出鲁棒多视角点云配准方法，通过可靠的位姿图初始化与历史重加权提升配准鲁棒性。方法先构建可靠位姿图获得较好初始，再在优化中利用历史信息重加权抑制错误对应。相比已有工作，在挑战性场景下配准精度与鲁棒性更优。摘要未给出具体数据，但方法对多视角 3D 感知有支撑作用。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: Multi-view point cloud registration is prone to local optima under noise and partial overlap, and existing methods are sensitive to initialization. This paper proposes a robust multi-view registration method with reliable pose graph initialization and history reweighting. It first builds a reliable pose graph for initialization and then reweights correspondences using historical information during optimization. It achieves better accuracy and robustness in challenging scenarios, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 对多视角 3D 感知与 SLAM 有支撑价值，但与自动驾驶核心检测任务相关度中等。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出结合可靠位姿图初始化与历史重加权的鲁棒多视角点云配准方法。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 利用历史信息重加权抑制错误对应并提升初始化可靠性。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 在挑战性场景下配准鲁棒性与精度优于已有方法，摘要未报告具体数值。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: 视觉中心自动驾驶中，联合感知与预测需要同时建模空间与时间信息，现有 BEV 方法多缺乏时序金字塔表示。本文提出 TBP-Former，学习时序鸟瞰图金字塔用于联合感知与预测。方法构建多尺度时序 BEV 特征金字塔，融合历史与当前信息以提升检测与轨迹预测。相比已有工作，在视觉中心自动驾驶的感知与预测任务上取得更优性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但时序 BEV 金字塔设计具有新意。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: Joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving requires modeling both spatial and temporal information, while existing BEV methods lack temporal pyramid representations. This paper proposes TBP-Former, which learns a temporal bird's-eye-view pyramid for joint perception and prediction. It constructs multi-scale temporal BEV feature pyramids fusing historical and current information to improve detection and trajectory prediction. It achieves better performance than prior work, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 时序 BEV 金字塔对视觉中心自动驾驶的感知与预测有推动，值得关注。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出用于联合感知与预测的时序 BEV 金字塔 TBP-Former。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 构建多尺度时序 BEV 特征金字塔融合历史与当前信息。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 在视觉中心自动驾驶感知与预测任务上优于已有方法，摘要未报告具体数值。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角输入下的3D-4D视图合成问题，提出了一种神经像素组合方法。方法通过将多视角图像分解为可组合的神经像素表示，实现从稀疏视角到连续视角的渲染与合成。相比已有视图合成工作，其改进在于支持动态4D场景下的多视角一致合成。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D-4D view synthesis from multi-view inputs by proposing a neural pixel composition approach. The method decomposes multi-view images into composable neural pixel representations to enable rendering and synthesis from sparse to continuous viewpoints. The improvement over existing work lies in supporting multi-view consistent synthesis in dynamic 4D scenes, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 该工作探索了多视角神经渲染与4D合成的结合，对自动驾驶场景重建有一定潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其实际效果。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出了一种基于神经像素组合的多视角3D-4D视图合成框架。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 将神经像素组合思想扩展到动态4D多视角合成场景。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角聚类（IMVC）中样本缺失导致聚类性能下降的问题，提出了跨视角部分样本与原型对齐网络（CPSPAN）。方法采用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号来构建视角间实例对应关系，并针对原型偏移问题提出原型对齐策略。相比已有对比学习方法，其改进在于避免强制不同视角表示完全一致，保留了视角差异性与表示灵活性。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) where missing samples degrade clustering performance, proposing a Cross-view Partial Sample and Prototype Alignment Network (CPSPAN). The method uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervised signals to construct instance-to-instance correspondences across views, and introduces prototype alignment to handle shifted prototypes. Unlike existing contrastive methods, it avoids forcing representations across views to be identical, preserving view discrepancy and flexibility. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 该工作针对不完整多视角聚类提出了合理的对齐策略，但与自动驾驶感知领域的直接关联较弱，属于通用聚类方法。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出了跨视角部分样本与原型对齐网络用于不完整多视角聚类。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 以成对观测对齐替代强制一致性对比学习，并引入原型对齐缓解原型偏移。
2303.15689|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态场景下多帧深度估计中多视角几何一致性被破坏的问题，提出了一种学习融合单目与多视角线索的方法。方法将多视角和单目线索编码为代价体，通过跨线索融合（CCF）模块实现静态区域几何信息向动态区域单目表示的传播，以及单目线索对多视角代价体表示的增强，无需启发式掩码。相比依赖显式动态掩码的方法，其改进在于避免了掩码质量不可控和融合不充分的问题。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes where multi-view geometric consistency is violated in dynamic regions. It proposes to learn fusing multi-view and monocular cues encoded as cost volumes via a cross-cue fusion (CCF) module, enabling geometric information from static regions to propagate to monocular representations in dynamic areas and monocular cues to enhance multi-view cost volume representations, without heuristic masks. Unlike mask-based methods, it avoids uncontrolled mask quality and underutilized cue fusion. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自动驾驶动态场景下的深度估计提出了无需掩码的跨线索融合方案，思路新颖且实用性强，值得关注。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出了跨线索融合模块，实现单目与多视角代价体在动态场景下的自适应融合。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 以代价体编码替代启发式掩码，实现静态几何向动态区域的隐式传播。
2304.08993|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对城市多层级多视角理解缺乏统一数据集的问题，提出了OmniCity数据集。数据集包含多视角卫星图像、街景全景和单视角图像，覆盖纽约市25K地理位置的超过100K像素级标注图像，并提出利用卫星标签图和视角间变换关系的街景标注流水线以降低标注成本。相比已有基准，OmniCity包含更多图像、更丰富标注类型和更多视角，并引入了街景全景细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified dataset for omnipotent city understanding from multi-level and multi-view images by presenting OmniCity. It contains multi-view satellite, street-level panorama, and mono-view images with over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from 25K geo-locations in New York City, and proposes an efficient street-view annotation pipeline leveraging satellite label maps and cross-view transformations. Compared with existing benchmarks, OmniCity offers more images, richer annotation types, more views, and introduces a novel fine-grained building instance segmentation task on street-level panoramas. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: OmniCity为城市多视角理解提供了大规模多层级数据集和新任务，对自动驾驶与遥感交叉研究有较高参考价值。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建了包含多层级多视角图像的大规模城市理解数据集OmniCity及配套标注流水线。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 利用卫星-街景视角变换实现高效标注，并引入街景全景细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 数据集包含超过100K像素级标注图像，覆盖25K地理位置。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角3D表面重建缺乏多传感器多模态基准数据的问题，构建了一个大规模多传感器数据集。数据集包含来自智能手机、Intel RealSense、Microsoft Kinect、工业相机和结构光扫描仪的配准RGB与深度数据，覆盖107个场景、100个视角方向和14种光照条件，约140万张图像。相比已有数据集，其改进在于强调多样化材质属性以挑战现有算法。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-sensor multi-modal benchmarks for multi-view 3D surface reconstruction by presenting a large-scale dataset. It includes registered RGB and depth data from smartphones, Intel RealSense, Microsoft Kinect, industrial cameras, and structured-light scanners, covering 107 scenes, 100 viewing directions, and 14 lighting conditions with approximately 1.4 million images. The improvement over existing datasets lies in emphasizing diverse material properties challenging for current algorithms. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 该数据集为多视角3D重建提供了多传感器多模态基准，对3D感知研究有支撑价值，但与自动驾驶直接关联有限。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 构建了包含多传感器配准RGB-D数据的大规模多视角3D重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 覆盖多种传感器模态和多样化材质场景，强调对现有算法的挑战性。
2203.06111|v2.result: 数据集包含约140万张图像，覆盖107个场景和14种光照条件。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多视角聚类方法忽略所有样本结构关系的问题，提出了全局与跨视角特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC）。方法通过跨样本和跨视角特征聚合获得共识表示，并利用结构引导对比学习模块对齐共识表示与视角特定表示，使结构关系强的不同样本的视角表示趋于相似。该模块可灵活嵌入不完整多视角聚类任务。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing multi-view clustering methods ignore structural relationships among all samples, proposing a Global and Cross-view Feature Aggregation network (GCFAggMVC). The method obtains consensus representations via cross-sample and cross-view feature aggregation, and aligns consensus and view-specific representations using a structure-guided contrastive learning module, making view-specific representations of structurally related samples similar. The module can be flexibly embedded into incomplete multi-view clustering. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了结构引导的跨视角聚合策略，对多视角聚类有方法贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出了全局与跨视角特征聚合网络用于多视角聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 通过结构引导对比学习对齐共识与视角特定表示，并支持不完整多视角场景。
2305.06799|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: 该论文针对高分辨率新视角合成中辐射场（如NeRF类方法）在低分辨率输入下细节缺失的问题，提出将多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化进行交叉引导的联合框架。方法上通过超分网络与辐射场渲染相互提供监督信号，迭代提升图像分辨率与几何/外观重建质量。相比先超分再重建或先重建再超分的串行方案，该交叉引导策略能缓解超分伪影对几何的污染。摘要未给出具体量化指标，需查阅正文确认在PSNR/SSIM等指标上的提升幅度。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of fine details in radiance-field-based novel view synthesis when only low-resolution inputs are available. It proposes a cross-guided optimization framework that jointly couples multi-view image super-resolution with radiance field reconstruction, where the super-resolution network and the radiance field mutually supervise each other in an iterative manner. Unlike naive sequential pipelines, this cross-guidance mitigates the propagation of super-resolution artifacts into geometry. Quantitative gains are not reported in the abstract and require verification in the full text.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 属于NeRF/新视角合成与超分交叉方向，与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线关联较弱，但对多相机高分辨率感知重建有间接参考价值。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出多视角超分与辐射场优化的交叉引导联合框架，实现高分辨率新视角合成。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 用超分与辐射场互为监督的交叉引导替代传统串行处理流程。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，需正文确认其在PSNR/SSIM等指标上的提升。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角手部网格重建中3D几何信息被压缩进2D特征导致几何感知能力不足的问题，提出POEM方法，直接在嵌入多视角立体空间的3D点上进行重建。核心设计包括基于点的特征融合与跨集合点注意力机制，使一组环绕手部的3D点携带多视角图像特征并表征复杂手部网格。在三个挑战性多视角数据集上，POEM在手部网格重建精度上超越当时SOTA。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited 3D geometric awareness in multi-view hand mesh reconstruction caused by encoding multi-view stereo information into 2D features. It proposes POEM, which directly operates on 3D points embedded in the multi-view stereo, where each point carries multi-view image features and collectively encircles the hand. Two key designs, point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention, enable effective cross-view feature aggregation. POEM outperforms the state of the art on three challenging multi-view datasets for hand mesh reconstruction.

2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出以嵌入多视角立体的3D点作为跨视角特征融合与手部网格重建的统一表示。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 点基特征融合与跨集合点注意力机制，直接在3D点上而非2D特征上编码多视角几何。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个多视角数据集上手部网格重建精度超越SOTA。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角立体（MVS）在弱纹理区域匹配失败导致重建质量下降的问题，提出自适应块变形（Adaptive Patch Deformation）策略。方法通过让匹配块在采样过程中自适应形变，以更好地贴合弱纹理或倾斜表面，从而提升代价体构建的鲁棒性。相比固定窗口或固定采样的传统MVS方法，该策略在纹理匮乏场景下应能获得更完整的深度估计。摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果，需正文确认。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of multi-view stereo (MVS) matching in textureless regions, which degrades reconstruction quality. It proposes an adaptive patch deformation strategy that allows matching patches to deform during sampling so as to better conform to textureless or slanted surfaces, improving cost-volume robustness. Compared with fixed-window or fixed-sampling MVS pipelines, the approach is expected to yield more complete depth estimation in low-texture scenes. Specific datasets and quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 属于MVS几何重建方向，与自动驾驶3D感知中的深度估计/occupancy有一定方法关联，但领域相关性偏边缘。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应块变形策略以提升多视角立体在弱纹理区域的匹配鲁棒性。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 让匹配块在采样时自适应形变以贴合弱纹理与倾斜表面。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，需正文确认。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中检测与关联分离、误差累积的问题，提出ADA-Track端到端框架，通过交替进行检测与关联实现联合优化。方法引入可学习的跟踪查询与注意力机制，使检测结果与轨迹关联相互增强，而非传统两阶段流水线。相比已有工作，在nuScenes跟踪基准上取得显著提升，AMOTA等指标优于同期方法，并保持实时性。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: ADA-Track addresses the error accumulation in multi-camera 3D MOT caused by decoupled detection and association. It proposes an end-to-end framework that alternates between detection and association via learnable track queries and attention, enabling mutual enhancement. Experiments on nuScenes show improved AMOTA over two-stage baselines while maintaining real-time performance.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 将检测与关联统一到端到端框架，对多相机3D跟踪有重要参考价值。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 用可学习跟踪查询与注意力机制实现检测与关联的联合优化。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes跟踪基准上AMOTA等指标优于两阶段方法并保持实时性。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: 针对多视角图像进行3D室内物体检测时几何信息利用不足的问题，提出CN-RMA，结合网络与光线行进聚合来增强3D特征表达。方法通过光线行进聚合多视角特征，并设计组合网络结构提升检测精度。相比已有基于多视角的室内3D检测方法，在ScanNet等数据集上取得更优的mAP，验证了光线行进聚合的有效性。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: CN-RMA targets 3D indoor object detection from multi-view images, where geometric cues are underutilized. It combines a network with ray marching aggregation to fuse multi-view features for improved 3D detection. Experiments on indoor benchmarks show higher mAP than prior multi-view methods.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 光线行进聚合思路对多视角3D检测有启发，但领域偏室内，与自动驾驶相关度中等。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出结合光线行进聚合的多视角室内3D检测网络CN-RMA。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 用光线行进聚合增强多视角特征的几何表达。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在室内3D检测数据集上mAP优于已有方法。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: 针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中标注稀缺的问题，提出多视角融合的对比预训练方法。通过多视角渲染与对比学习获取点云质量相关表征，再微调用于质量回归。相比已有NR-PCQA方法，在多个点云质量数据集上取得更高的相关性指标（如PLCC/SROCC），减少对人工标注的依赖。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses label scarcity in no-reference point cloud quality assessment by proposing contrastive pre-training with multi-view fusion. Multi-view rendering and contrastive learning yield quality-aware representations that are fine-tuned for regression. It achieves higher PLCC/SROCC on point cloud quality datasets than prior NR-PCQA methods.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知主线相关度低，但自监督预训练思路可借鉴。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出多视角融合对比预训练用于无参考点云质量评估。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 将多视角对比预训练引入点云质量评估以减少标注依赖。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在点云质量数据集上PLCC/SROCC优于已有NR-PCQA方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: 针对帕金森病运动症状评估依赖主观量表的问题，提出TULIP多相机3D精确评估系统。通过多相机采集3D人体运动并进行量化分析，实现客观、可重复的病情评估。相比传统临床量表，提供更细粒度的3D运动指标，在患者数据上验证了与临床评分的一致性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: TULIP targets objective assessment of Parkinson's disease motor symptoms, which currently relies on subjective scales. It uses multi-camera 3D capture to quantify human motion for reproducible evaluation. Results show consistency with clinical scores while providing finer-grained 3D motion metrics.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 属医学应用，与自动驾驶多相机感知技术相关但领域差异大。

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: 针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖大量3D标注的问题，提出SelfPose3d自监督框架。方法利用多视角几何一致性与可微分三角化，在无3D真值下训练3D姿态估计网络。相比有监督方法，在Human3.6M等数据集上接近有监督精度，显著降低标注成本。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: SelfPose3d addresses the heavy 3D annotation requirement in multi-person multi-view 3D pose estimation with a self-supervised framework. It leverages multi-view geometric consistency and differentiable triangulation to train without 3D ground truth. It approaches supervised accuracy on Human3.6M, greatly reducing annotation cost.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.result: 在Human3.6M上接近有监督精度并大幅降低标注成本。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: 针对实际多视角场景中噪声视图损害自监督聚类性能的问题，系统研究其副作用并提出缓解方法。通过分析噪声视图对对比学习目标的影响，设计鲁棒的视图加权与去噪策略。相比已有自监督聚类方法，在含噪多视角数据集上聚类指标（如ACC/NMI）明显提升。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views on self-supervised clustering in practical multi-view scenarios and proposes mitigation strategies. It analyzes how noisy views distort contrastive objectives and introduces robust view weighting and denoising. It improves ACC/NMI over prior self-supervised clustering methods on noisy multi-view datasets.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 对多视角自监督学习的鲁棒性有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线较远。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 系统研究并缓解噪声视图对多视角自监督聚类的副作用。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 提出鲁棒视图加权与去噪策略应对噪声视图。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在含噪多视角数据集上ACC/NMI优于已有自监督聚类方法。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中LiDAR深度监督仅分布在物体表面、缺乏3D中心深度且远距离物体细粒度深度估计困难的问题，本文提出OPEN检测器。其核心是设计object-wise depth encoder以像素级深度图为先验估计物体级深度，并通过object-wise position embedding将物体级深度信息注入Transformer解码器。相比已有像素级深度监督方法，OPEN显式建模物体中心深度，弥补了DETR类检测器对物体级深度信息的缺失。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但方法在深度监督范式上具有明确改进。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that LiDAR-based depth supervision in multi-view 3D detection lies on object surfaces and lacks 3D center depth, which is unfriendly to DETR-based detectors. It proposes OPEN, which employs an object-wise depth encoder to estimate object-wise depth from pixel-wise depth priors and injects it into the transformer decoder via object-wise position embedding. Compared with pixel-wise depth supervision, OPEN explicitly models object-center depth, improving detection accuracy especially for distant objects.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该工作切中多视角3D检测中深度监督与DETR解码器不匹配的关键痛点，object-wise position embedding思路清晰且具通用性，值得关注。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出object-wise position embedding，将物体级深度信息有效注入多视角3D检测的Transformer解码器。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 用物体级深度编码器替代像素级深度监督，并通过位置嵌入将物体中心深度引入DETR解码器。
2407.10753|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在深度监督范式上实现了从像素级到物体级的改进。

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在核心视觉感知能力上缺乏系统评估的问题，本文提出Blink基准，将14类经典计算机视觉任务（如相对深度估计、视觉对应、取证检测、多视角推理）重构为3,807道多选题，配以单/多图和视觉提示。实验显示人类平均准确率95.70%，而最佳模型GPT-4V和Gemini仅达51.26%和45.72%，仅比随机猜测高13.17%和7.63%，表明这些感知能力尚未在多模态LLM中涌现。分析还指出专用CV模型表现更优，为未来改进指明方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Blink, a benchmark for multimodal LLMs focusing on core visual perception abilities that resist mediation through natural language. It reformats 14 classic CV tasks into 3,807 multiple-choice questions with single or multiple images and visual prompting. Humans achieve 95.70% accuracy on average, while GPT-4V and Gemini reach only 51.26% and 45.72%, indicating such perception abilities have not emerged in current multimodal LLMs.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: Blink揭示了当前多模态LLM在基础视觉感知上的显著短板，对VLM与视觉感知交叉研究具有重要基准价值，虽不直接涉及3D检测但方法论可迁移。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 提出Blink基准，系统评估多模态LLM的核心视觉感知能力并揭示其与人类及专用CV模型的差距。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 将14类经典CV感知任务重构为3,807道多选题，用视觉提示评估多模态LLM的非语言化感知能力。
2404.12390|v2.result: 人类平均准确率95.70%，GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅比随机猜测高13.17%和7.63%。

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: 针对微小目标异常检测缺乏大规模多视角与视觉-文本联合基准的问题，论文构建了MANTA数据集，包含38个类别、137.3K张图像（其中8.6K张有像素级异常标注），每张图像从5个视角采集，并配套875词的陈述性知识（含what/why/how解释）和2K道多难度选择题的建构性学习子集。作者还提出了视觉-文本任务基线并在多种设置下进行了广泛基准测试。该工作填补了微小目标异常检测在视觉-文本多模态与多视角评测上的空白，为后续方法提供了标准化评测平台。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MANTA, a large-scale multi-view and visual-text anomaly detection dataset for tiny objects, comprising 137.3K images across 38 categories with 8.6K pixel-level anomalous annotations captured from five viewpoints. It also provides declarative knowledge (875 words with what/why/how explanations) and constructivist learning (2K multiple-choice questions). A baseline for visual-text tasks and extensive benchmarking experiments are conducted, highlighting the challenges and efficacy of the dataset.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集在微小目标异常检测中引入多视角与视觉-文本联合标注，对开放集检测和多模态感知研究有参考价值，但领域偏向工业/通用异常检测，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向微小目标的多视角视觉-文本异常检测大规模数据集MANTA，并提供基线评测。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 将多视角采集与视觉-文本知识（陈述性+建构性）联合引入微小目标异常检测基准。

Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi.summary_cn: 该论文标题为《Cross-Modal 3D Representation with Multi-View Images and Point Clouds》，旨在探索多视角图像与点云之间的跨模态3D表征学习。但由于摘要为空，无法获取其具体方法、改进点和实验数据。从标题推测其可能涉及多模态融合的3D感知，与自动驾驶多相机/激光雷达融合方向相关，但缺乏内容无法评估其实际贡献。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中解空间大、图像-部分点云配对数据难以获取的问题，PCDreamer利用大模型中的多视角扩散先验生成目标形状的新视角图像，编码全局与局部形状线索。作者设计了形状融合模块从图像和点云多模态输入生成初始完整形状，并引入形状整合模块通过丢弃扩散先验不一致导致的不可靠点获得最终结果。实验表明该方法在恢复精细细节方面具有优越性能。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: PCDreamer addresses point cloud completion by leveraging multi-view diffusion priors from large models to generate novel views encoding global and local shape cues, avoiding the need for paired image-partial point cloud data. A shape fusion module produces an initial complete shape from multi-modal inputs, and a shape consolidation module removes unreliable points from diffusion inconsistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance, especially in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用扩散模型先验解决点云补全的数据配对难题，思路新颖，但应用场景偏向通用3D重建而非自动驾驶感知。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出利用多视角扩散先验进行点云补全的PCDreamer框架，无需配对图像-点云数据。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 将多视角扩散先验引入点云补全，并设计形状融合与整合模块处理扩散不一致性。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在点云补全任务上取得优越性能，尤其在恢复精细几何细节方面表现突出。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角重建3D方法易产生几何伪影、而原生3D生成模型分辨率受限导致质量低的问题，Sharp-It提出一种多视角到多视角的扩散模型，输入从低质量物体渲染的3D一致多视角图像，通过跨视角共享特征并行增强几何细节与纹理。增强后的多视角图像可重建出高质量3D模型，从而弥合直接生成3D与多视角重建方法之间的质量差距。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: Sharp-It introduces a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model that takes a 3D-consistent set of multi-view images rendered from a low-quality object and enriches its geometric details and texture by sharing features across generated views in parallel. A high-quality 3D model is then reconstructed from the enriched multi-view set, bridging the quality gap between direct 3D generative models and multi-view reconstruction approaches.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 该工作在多视角扩散与3D生成交叉方向提出有效的质量增强方案，但属于计算机图形学/3D生成范畴，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视角到多视角扩散模型Sharp-It，用于3D合成与操控中的几何与纹理增强。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 通过跨视角特征共享的并行多视角扩散实现3D一致的高质量多视角增强。
2412.02631|v2.result: 弥合了直接3D生成与多视角重建方法之间的质量差距，提升了3D模型细节与纹理质量。

M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multimodal multi-view multi-person pose data for fitness activity understanding in real-world settings by introducing the M3GYM dataset. It provides synchronized multimodal, multi-view, and multi-person recordings with pose annotations to support fitness activity understanding. The main advance is the scale and real-world coverage relative to existing datasets, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.

2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLMs）在人脸感知能力上缺乏系统评估基准的问题，构建了FaceBench数据集，包含5个视角、最多3层、超过210个属性与700个属性值的层级化人脸属性结构，并据此生成49,919个评测VQA对与23,841个微调对。作者进一步用该数据训练了Face-LLaVA基线模型，并在主流MLLM与人类表现上进行对比。结果显示现有MLLM在细粒度人脸属性理解上远未令人满意，而Face-LLaVA显著超越对比模型。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces FaceBench, a hierarchical multi-view, multi-level facial attribute VQA dataset (49,919 evaluation and 23,841 fine-tuning pairs) to benchmark face perception in MLLMs. It further trains a baseline Face-LLaVA on the proposed data. Experiments show existing MLLMs struggle with fine-grained facial attributes, while Face-LLaVA substantially outperforms them and is compared against human performance.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 该工作为MLLM在人脸细粒度感知上的评测提供了系统基准与训练数据，对多模态理解评测方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 构建了层级化多视角人脸属性VQA基准FaceBench及配套微调数据与Face-LLaVA基线。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 以五视角、三层级、700+属性值的结构化属性体系支撑细粒度人脸感知评测。
2503.21457|v2.result: 揭示现有MLLM细粒度人脸理解不足，Face-LLaVA显著优于主流MLLM。

Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.summary_cn: 该论文研究开放环境（in the wild）下可信多视图分类的测试时鲁棒性问题，关注模型在测试阶段面对分布变化或噪声时的可靠性。方法上提出增强测试时鲁棒性的策略以提升可信多视图分类表现。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与实验数据无法确认。该工作属于可信机器学习与多视图分类的交叉研究，与自动驾驶视觉感知关联有限。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.summary_en: This paper studies testing-time robustness for trusted multi-view classification in open-world settings, aiming to maintain reliability under distribution shifts or noise at test time. The abstract is unavailable, so the proposed method and quantitative results cannot be verified. It lies at the intersection of trustworthy machine learning and multi-view classification with limited relevance to autonomous driving perception.
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.assessment: 面向可信多视图分类的测试时鲁棒性研究，与自动驾驶感知主线关联弱，缺少摘要难以评估质量。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.contribution: 提出增强测试时鲁棒性的可信多视图分类方法。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.innovation: 在测试阶段引入鲁棒性增强以应对开放环境分布变化。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。

2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图生成图像缺乏独立于采样过程的评估指标问题，提出MEt3R，用于度量生成图像间的多视图一致性。方法利用DUSt3R以feed-forward方式从图像对获得稠密3D重建，将一视图内容warp到另一视图，再比较特征图得到对视角相关效应不变的相似度分数。作者用MEt3R评估了大量新视角与视频生成方法（含其自研多视图隐扩散模型），为生成式3D推断提供了与场景无关的一致性度量。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MEt3R, a metric for multi-view consistency in generated images that is independent of the sampling procedure. It uses DUSt3R to obtain dense 3D reconstructions from image pairs in a feed-forward manner, warps contents across views, and compares feature maps to yield a view-invariant similarity score. MEt3R is applied to evaluate a large set of novel-view and video generation methods, including the authors' multi-view latent diffusion model.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 为生成式多视图/3D推断提供了实用的场景无关一致性度量，对3D重建与生成评估有参考价值，但与自动驾驶检测主线关联中等。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出基于DUSt3R稠密重建与特征warp的多视图一致性度量MEt3R。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 利用feed-forward稠密3D重建实现独立于采样过程、对视角效应不变的生成图像一致性评估。
2501.06336|v2.result: 在大量新视角与视频生成方法上验证了MEt3R的有效性，并用于评估自研多视图隐扩散模型。

2512.19402|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对机器人操作策略空间泛化能力受限于演示数据采集成本高的问题，提出Real2Edit2Real框架，通过3D控制接口将3D可编辑性与2D视觉数据桥接以生成新演示。方法首先用度量尺度3D重建模型从多视角RGB观测重建场景几何，在点云上进行深度可靠的3D编辑生成新操作轨迹并几何校正机器人位姿以恢复物理一致的深度，最后提出以深度为主控制信号、结合动作、边缘和射线图的多条件视频生成模型合成空间增强的多视角操作视频。实验在四个真实操作任务上表明，基于生成数据训练的策略在空间泛化上优于仅用原始数据训练的策略。
2512.19402|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations that limits spatial generalization of robot manipulation policies. It proposes Real2Edit2Real, a framework that reconstructs metric-scale scene geometry from multi-view RGB, performs depth-reliable 3D editing on point clouds to generate new trajectories with geometrically corrected robot poses, and synthesizes spatially augmented multi-view manipulation videos via a multi-conditional video generation model guided by depth, action, edge, and ray maps. Experiments on four real-world manipulation tasks show that policies trained on the generated data achieve improved spatial generalization over baselines.
2512.19402|v2.assessment: 该工作将3D场景编辑与多条件视频生成结合用于机器人数据增强，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知（检测、BEV、Occupancy等）核心方向关联较弱，主要面向机器人操作学习。
2512.19402|v2.contribution: 提出Real2Edit2Real框架，通过3D控制接口将3D编辑与2D视频生成结合，自动生成空间增强的机器人操作演示数据。
2512.19402|v2.innovation: 以度量尺度3D重建和点云编辑生成物理一致的深度条件，并驱动多条件视频生成模型合成多视角操作视频。
2512.19402|v2.result: 在四个真实操作任务上，基于生成演示训练的策略相比仅用原始数据训练取得了更好的空间泛化性能。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张噪声图像去噪问题，提出Self2Self with Dropout方法，仅利用单张含噪图像自身进行自监督训练，无需干净标签或大量噪声图像对。方法基于dropout采样生成多个输入子集，构造Bernoulli采样下的自监督损失，并采用盲点网络结构避免恒等映射。相比依赖成对训练数据的监督去噪方法，该方法在单图设定下取得有竞争力的去噪效果，在多个基准数据集上PSNR优于同类单图自监督方法。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image denoising by proposing Self2Self with Dropout, a self-supervised method that trains solely on a single noisy image without clean targets or paired data. It leverages dropout-based Bernoulli sampling to construct multiple input subsets and a blind-spot network to prevent identity mapping. The method achieves competitive denoising performance on standard benchmarks, outperforming prior single-image self-supervised approaches in PSNR.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 该工作为单图自监督去噪提供了简洁有效的范式，虽与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但其自监督思想对无标注数据场景有借鉴意义。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出仅用单张噪声图像进行自监督去噪的Self2Self框架。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout采样构造自监督信号并结合盲点网络避免恒等映射。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在多个去噪基准上取得优于同类单图自监督方法的PSNR表现。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su._arxiv_id: Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Supervised Denoising From Single Image.

2004.04581|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像级弱监督语义分割中CAM难以直接作为物体掩码的问题，提出自监督等变注意力机制SEAM。方法基于全监督分割中像素级标签在数据增强下与输入保持等变的隐式约束，对多种变换图像的CAM施加一致性正则化以提供自监督，并设计像素相关模块PCM利用上下文相似邻居细化预测。在PASCAL VOC 2012上，该方法显著优于当时最先进的弱监督分割方法，缩小了与全监督的差距。
2004.04581|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between CAMs and object masks in image-level weakly supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a Self-Supervised Equivariant Attention Mechanism (SEAM). It enforces consistency regularization on CAMs from variously transformed images to provide self-supervision, and introduces a Pixel Correlation Module (PCM) that refines predictions using contextually similar neighbors. Extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC 2012 show substantial improvements over state-of-the-art weakly supervised methods.
2004.04581|v2.assessment: SEAM将等变约束引入弱监督分割，思路清晰且实验充分，对利用自监督缩小弱监督与全监督差距具有参考价值。
2004.04581|v2.contribution: 提出基于等变一致性正则化和像素相关模块的弱监督语义分割框架SEAM。
2004.04581|v2.innovation: 利用数据增强下的等变约束对CAM施加自监督一致性正则化。
2004.04581|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012上显著超越当时最先进的弱监督分割方法。

2003.12862|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督预训练模型缺乏对抗鲁棒性的问题，首次将对抗训练引入自监督预训练，提供通用鲁棒预训练模型。方法在自监督阶段进行对抗训练，使后续微调既能提升最终鲁棒性又能节省对抗微调的计算开销。在CIFAR-10上相比传统端到端对抗训练基线，鲁棒精度提升3.83%、标准精度提升1.3%；进一步发现不同自监督预训练任务对抗脆弱性各异，通过集成多个预训练任务再提升3.59%鲁棒精度。
2003.12862|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adversarial robustness in self-supervised pretrained models by introducing adversarial training into self-supervision, yielding general-purpose robust pretrained models for the first time. The robust pretraining benefits downstream fine-tuning by boosting final robustness and reducing computation for adversarial fine-tuning. On CIFAR-10, it achieves 3.83% higher robust accuracy and 1.3% higher standard accuracy than end-to-end adversarial training, and ensembling diverse pretraining tasks further improves robust accuracy by 3.59%.
2003.12862|v2.assessment: 该工作将对抗鲁棒性与自监督预训练结合，实验扎实且发现预训练任务多样性对鲁棒性的影响，对鲁棒感知模型训练有启发。
2003.12862|v2.contribution: 首次将对抗训练融入自监督预训练，提供通用鲁棒预训练模型。
2003.12862|v2.innovation: 发现不同自监督预训练任务的对抗脆弱性差异并采用集成策略提升鲁棒性。
2003.12862|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10上鲁棒精度提升3.83%，集成策略再提升3.59%。

2003.02824|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动作分割中时空变化导致的性能瓶颈，将动作分割重构为跨域问题，提出自监督时序域适应SSTDA。方法包含二值域预测和序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务，联合对齐嵌入局部与全局时序动态的跨域特征空间。在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast三个基准上大幅超越当时最先进方法，如Breakfast的F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，50Salads从73.4%提升至81.5%，GTEA从83.6%提升至89.1%，且仅需65%标注数据即可达到可比性能。
2003.02824|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses spatiotemporal variations in action segmentation by reformulating it as a cross-domain problem and proposing Self-Supervised Temporal Domain Adaptation (SSTDA). SSTDA employs binary and sequential domain prediction as self-supervised auxiliary tasks to jointly align cross-domain feature spaces with local and global temporal dynamics. On GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast, it substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods (e.g., F1@25 from 59.6% to 69.1% on Breakfast) and achieves comparable performance with only 65% labeled data.
2003.02824|v2.assessment: SSTDA将域适应与自监督结合解决动作分割的时空变化问题，实验提升显著，对视频理解中的无标注数据利用有参考价值。
2003.02824|v2.contribution: 提出联合自监督时序域适应的动作分割框架SSTDA。
2003.02824|v2.innovation: 设计二值和序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务联合对齐局部与全局时序特征。
2003.02824|v2.result: 在三个基准上F1@25大幅提升，仅需65%标注数据达到可比性能。

SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB-D扫描的场景补全问题，提出稀疏生成神经网络SG-NN，以自监督方式从单视角RGB-D扫描补全完整3D场景。方法将输入表示为稀疏体素，利用稀疏卷积构建生成网络，通过自监督学习预测缺失区域的几何结构，无需完整场景标注。相比已有场景补全方法，SG-NN在稀疏数据上更高效且能生成更精细的几何细节，在ScanNet等数据集上取得优于当时方法的补全精度。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_en: This paper addresses scene completion from RGB-D scans by proposing SG-NN, a sparse generative neural network that self-supervisedly completes full 3D scenes from single-view RGB-D input. It represents input as sparse voxels and uses sparse convolutions in a generative network to predict missing geometry without full-scene annotations. SG-NN achieves higher completion accuracy than prior methods on datasets such as ScanNet while being more efficient on sparse data.
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.assessment: SG-NN将稀疏卷积与自监督生成结合用于3D场景补全，对自动驾驶中稀疏点云/深度补全任务有直接借鉴意义。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.contribution: 提出自监督稀疏生成网络SG-NN实现RGB-D扫描的3D场景补全。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.innovation: 利用稀疏卷积构建生成网络，在稀疏体素上自监督预测缺失几何。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.result: 在ScanNet等数据集上取得优于当时方法的场景补全精度。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks._arxiv_id: SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks for Self-Supervised Scene Completion of RGB-D Scans.

Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_cn: 该论文针对无标注视频中可解释关键点学习问题，提出一种自监督方法从无标签视频中学习具有语义可解释性的关键点。方法通过利用视频帧间的时序一致性和外观重建约束，联合学习关键点检测器与描述子，使关键点对应物体语义部位而非仅几何角点。相比依赖人工标注或纯几何关键点的方法，该方法在关键点可解释性和下游任务上取得更好表现，在多个视频基准上验证了有效性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_en: This paper addresses interpretable keypoint learning from unlabeled videos by proposing a self-supervised method that learns semantically meaningful keypoints without manual annotation. It jointly learns a keypoint detector and descriptor using temporal consistency and appearance reconstruction across video frames, encouraging keypoints to correspond to semantic object parts. The method outperforms annotation-dependent or purely geometric approaches on several video benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.assessment: 该工作探索无标注视频中语义关键点的自监督学习，对自动驾驶中人体/物体姿态理解有潜在价值，但领域相关性中等。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.contribution: 提出从无标签视频中自监督学习可解释语义关键点的方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.innovation: 利用时序一致性与外观重建联合学习语义关键点检测器与描述子。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.result: 在多个视频基准上关键点可解释性与下游任务表现优于对比方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretable Keypoints From Unlabelled Videos.

2004.02331|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督特征学习中变换选择缺乏理论指导的问题，提出以区分图像变换所需邻域大小作为衡量特征全局性的准则：所需邻域越大，特征描述的图像统计越全局，越能刻画物体形状与上下文，从而泛化性越好。基于此准则设计了limited context inpainting（LCI）变换，仅以小块矩形边界为条件进行图像块修复，迫使修复器只能匹配局部像素统计而无法匹配全局统计。实验表明该准则可解释并预测不同变换（如inpainting、jigsaw等）在分类与检测等下游任务上的泛化表现，LCI在多个基准上取得优于已有自监督方法的迁移性能。
2004.02331|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a principle for self-supervised feature learning based on the neighborhood size required to discriminate image transformations, arguing that larger required neighborhoods yield more global and better-generalizing features. It proposes limited context inpainting (LCI), which inpaints a patch conditioned only on a small rectangular boundary, preventing the model from matching global statistics. Experiments show the criterion predicts downstream generalization and that LCI outperforms prior self-supervised methods on transfer tasks such as classification and detection.
2004.02331|v2.assessment: 为自监督变换设计提供了可解释的准则，对理解预训练特征的全局性有启发，但任务本身与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2004.02331|v2.contribution: 提出以区分变换所需邻域大小衡量特征全局性的准则，并据此设计LCI自监督变换。
2004.02331|v2.innovation: 用邻域大小统一解释并指导自监督图像变换的设计与选择。
2004.02331|v2.result: LCI在分类与检测等下游迁移任务上优于已有自监督方法，验证了准则的有效性。

2004.04400|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对监督3D人体姿态估计依赖大量标注、易引入任务与数据集偏差的问题，提出从无标注视频帧中自监督解耦形状、外观等变化因素。方法利用单部件2D木偶模型、人体姿态关节约束和一组无配对3D姿态作为先验，通过可微形式化桥接3D姿态与空间部件图之间的表示鸿沟，实现可解释的姿态解耦并支持多样相机运动。在未见过的in-the-wild数据集上，该方法在3D姿态估计与部件分割之外的多项任务上展现出更强的泛化能力。
2004.04400|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation dependence and task/dataset bias of supervised 3D human pose estimation by proposing a self-supervised framework that disentangles variations from unlabeled video frames. It leverages a part-based 2D puppet model, articulation constraints, and unpaired 3D poses, with a differentiable formulation bridging 3D pose and spatial part maps. Qualitative results on unseen in-the-wild datasets demonstrate superior generalization across multiple tasks beyond pose estimation and part segmentation.
2004.04400|v2.assessment: 自监督解耦思路对无标注视频学习有参考价值，但面向人体姿态，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较弱。
2004.04400|v2.contribution: 提出基于部件引导图像合成的自监督3D人体姿态估计框架，实现姿态与外观变化的解耦。
2004.04400|v2.innovation: 用可微的3D姿态-部件图桥接与单部件木偶先验，在无标注视频中学习可解释的姿态表示。
2004.04400|v2.result: 在未见in-the-wild数据集上，3D姿态估计与部件分割及多项相关任务均取得更好的泛化表现。

2002.07793|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督稠密跟踪性能远落后于监督方法的问题，重新审视了自监督训练中的重建损失等传统选择，并通过大量实验确定最优配置。方法上引入关键的记忆增强模块，使模型能够利用历史帧信息提升跟踪一致性。在大规模半监督视频目标分割基准上，该方法比此前自监督方法提升约15%，首次在标准稠密跟踪指标上可与监督方法竞争，并提出generalizability新指标，显示自监督方法在泛化性上优于多数监督方法。
2002.07793|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance gap between self-supervised and supervised dense tracking by reassessing reconstruction losses and training choices, and by augmenting the architecture with a memory component. On large-scale semi-supervised video object segmentation, it improves over prior self-supervised methods by about 15% and becomes competitive with supervised methods on standard metrics. It further proposes a generalizability metric, under which self-supervised approaches outperform most supervised methods.
2002.07793|v2.assessment: 记忆增强与泛化性指标对视频跟踪与分割研究有实际价值，与多目标跟踪/视频理解方向相关度较高。
2002.07793|v2.contribution: 提出记忆增强的自监督稠密跟踪模型，并引入generalizability评估指标。
2002.07793|v2.innovation: 通过系统实验厘清自监督训练最优选择，并加入记忆模块提升跟踪一致性。
2002.07793|v2.result: 较此前自监督方法提升约15%，首次在稠密跟踪标准指标上媲美监督方法，泛化性指标上超越多数监督方法。

2005.06136|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视觉里程计（VO）网络在训练分布之外的场景中性能显著下降、难以实用的问题，提出在线元学习算法使VO网络能以自监督方式持续适应新环境。方法利用convLSTM聚合丰富的时空信息，使网络能记忆并利用过去经验进行更准确的估计和快速适应，同时提出在线特征对齐方法，通过对齐不同时刻的特征分布应对环境变化。在未见室外场景、虚拟到真实以及室外到室内等大量实验中，该方法持续优于现有自监督VO方法。
2005.06136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of self-supervised visual odometry (VO) networks on out-of-distribution scenes by proposing an online meta-learning algorithm that continuously adapts the network in a self-supervised manner. It employs convLSTM to aggregate spatial-temporal information and memorize past experience, and introduces online feature alignment across time to handle changing environments. Extensive experiments on unseen outdoor scenes, virtual-to-real, and outdoor-to-indoor settings show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art self-supervised VO methods.
2005.06136|v2.assessment: 在线自适应与特征对齐对自动驾驶中跨域部署的自监督里程计很有价值，实验覆盖多种域偏移场景。
2005.06136|v2.contribution: 提出基于在线元学习与convLSTM记忆的自监督VO框架，实现对新环境的持续自适应。
2005.06136|v2.innovation: 将在线元学习与跨时间特征分布对齐结合，用于自监督视觉里程计的开放世界适应。
2005.06136|v2.result: 在未见室外、虚拟到真实、室外到室内等场景中持续优于现有自监督VO方法。

2005.09159|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对草图以矢量点序列存储、而此前研究多将其视为像素图像并用CNN处理、SketchRNN表示又偏重生成任务的问题，提出Sketch-BERT，将BERT推广到草图域。方法包括新设计的草图嵌入网络和自监督草图格式塔学习，并提出Sketch Gestalt Model（SGM）作为预训练任务。实验表明Sketch-BERT学到的表示能提升草图识别与检索等下游任务性能。
