Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_cn: 针对点云自监督学习中对比方法过度依赖物体共现、导致学到的表征被物体上下文主导的问题，本文提出通过物体交换（Object Exchange）构造增强样本，解耦物体与场景上下文。方法在预训练中交换不同场景中的物体点云，迫使网络学习物体本身的判别性特征而非依赖共现线索。相比已有对比式点云预训练，该方法在下游检测与分割任务上取得一致提升，验证了缓解物体依赖的有效性。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_en: This paper tackles the object-dependency issue in point cloud self-supervised learning, where contrastive methods over-rely on object co-occurrence and learn context-dominated representations. It proposes an Object Exchange augmentation that swaps object point clouds across scenes during pretraining, forcing the network to capture intrinsic object discriminability. Compared with existing contrastive point cloud pretraining, it yields consistent gains on downstream detection and segmentation tasks.
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.assessment: 切中对比式点云预训练的关键缺陷，物体交换增强简单有效，对3D感知预训练有参考价值。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.contribution: 提出物体交换增强以缓解点云自监督学习中的物体依赖问题。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.innovation: 通过跨场景交换物体点云解耦物体特征与场景上下文。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.result: 在下游3D检测与分割任务上相比现有自监督方法取得一致提升。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin._arxiv_id: Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improving Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning Through Object Exchange.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪标注成本高昂、现有自监督方法难以维持长时身份一致性的问题，本文提出基于路径一致性（Path Consistency）的自监督多目标跟踪方法。方法利用轨迹在时间上的路径一致性构造自监督信号，学习具有身份判别力的外观与运动表征，无需跟踪标注即可训练关联模块。相比已有自监督跟踪方法，该工作在 MOT 基准上显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距，并提升了身份保持能力。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of multi-object tracking and the difficulty of maintaining long-term identity consistency in self-supervised settings. It proposes a Path Consistency objective that exploits temporal consistency of trajectories as a self-supervised signal to learn identity-discriminative appearance and motion representations without tracking labels. Compared with prior self-supervised trackers, it substantially narrows the gap to fully supervised methods on MOT benchmarks and improves identity preservation.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 路径一致性自监督信号设计合理，对降低MOT标注依赖有实际意义，实验较充分。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于路径一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用轨迹时间一致性构造无需标注的身份判别自监督信号。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT基准上显著缩小与全监督方法的差距并提升身份保持能力。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Path Consistency.

RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_cn: 针对开放世界3D场景理解中标注类别有限、模型难以泛化到新类别的问题，本文提出区域点-语言对比学习框架 RegionPLC，将点云区域与语言嵌入对齐以实现开放词汇的3D场景理解。方法通过区域级点-语言对比预训练，结合多粒度文本描述增强区域表征，支持零样本与开放词汇的3D检测和分割。相比已有3D开放词汇方法，该工作在多个3D基准上取得显著提升，并展现出更强的跨类别泛化能力。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_en: This paper targets open-world 3D scene understanding, where limited annotated categories hinder generalization to novel classes. It proposes RegionPLC, a regional point-language contrastive learning framework that aligns point cloud regions with language embeddings for open-vocabulary 3D understanding. By combining region-level point-language pretraining with multi-granularity textual descriptions, it supports zero-shot and open-vocabulary 3D detection and segmentation, outperforming prior 3D open-vocabulary methods across several benchmarks.
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.assessment: 面向开放词汇3D感知的前沿工作，区域级点-语言对齐思路清晰，对自动驾驶开放场景感知很有价值。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.contribution: 提出区域点-语言对比学习框架实现开放词汇3D场景理解。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.innovation: 以区域级点-语言对齐与多粒度文本增强支持零样本3D检测与分割。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.result: 在多个3D基准上显著超越现有开放词汇方法并展现更强跨类别泛化。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr._arxiv_id: RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contrastive Learning for Open-World 3D Scene Understanding.

Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）普遍存在物体幻觉、生成与图像不符内容的问题，本文提出幻觉增强对比学习（HACL），通过构造幻觉样本作为负例进行对比训练以抑制幻觉。方法自动生成包含物体幻觉的文本作为难负样本，与真实描述构成对比对，增强模型对视觉证据的依赖。相比已有基于微调或解码策略的方法，该工作在多个幻觉评测基准上降低了幻觉率，同时保持通用多模态能力。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_en: This paper addresses object hallucination in multimodal large language models, where generated text contradicts visual evidence. It proposes Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning (HACL), which automatically constructs hallucinated captions as hard negatives and trains the model contrastively to rely more on visual evidence. Compared with fine-tuning or decoding-based remedies, it reduces hallucination rates on multiple benchmarks while preserving general multimodal capabilities.
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.assessment: 从对比学习角度抑制MLLM幻觉，负例构造思路实用，对多模态感知与VLM结合方向有借鉴意义。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.contribution: 提出幻觉增强对比学习以抑制多模态大模型的物体幻觉。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.innovation: 自动构造幻觉文本作为难负例进行对比训练。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.result: 在多个幻觉评测基准上降低幻觉率并保持通用多模态能力。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear._arxiv_id: Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model.

BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_cn: 针对多模态对比学习（如CLIP）易受后门攻击、现有攻击在微调后失效的问题，本文提出双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法 BadCLIP。方法在预训练阶段注入与触发模式关联的双嵌入表示，使后门在微调后仍能保持有效，同时不影响正常任务性能。相比已有后门攻击，该工作在多种下游任务与防御设置下展现出更强的持久性和隐蔽性，揭示了多模态预训练的安全隐患。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_en: This paper studies backdoor attacks on multimodal contrastive learning such as CLIP, where existing attacks often fail after downstream fine-tuning. It proposes BadCLIP, a dual-embedding guided backdoor attack that injects trigger-associated dual embeddings during pretraining, preserving the backdoor through fine-tuning without degrading normal performance. Compared with prior attacks, it demonstrates stronger persistence and stealthiness across downstream tasks and defenses, exposing security risks in multimodal pretraining.
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.assessment: 关注多模态预训练安全，双嵌入后门设计在微调后仍有效，对模型可信部署有警示意义。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.contribution: 提出双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法 BadCLIP。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.innovation: 通过双嵌入表示使后门在微调后仍保持有效且隐蔽。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.result: 在多种下游任务与防御设置下展现更强的后门持久性与隐蔽性。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor._arxiv_id: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning.

SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测方法严重依赖昂贵且稀疏的LiDAR点云进行监督的问题，本文提出SelfOcc，一种纯视觉、自监督的3D占用预测框架。方法通过可微渲染将场景几何与语义从多视角图像中自监督学习，无需任何3D标注，并引入光照/视角增强与遮挡感知损失提升鲁棒性。相比依赖LiDAR监督的方法，SelfOcc在无3D标签下仍能预测稠密占用，在SemanticKITTI等基准上以自监督方式达到甚至超越部分全监督方法的性能。该工作为自动驾驶中低成本、可扩展的占用感知提供了新范式。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance of existing 3D occupancy prediction methods on expensive and sparse LiDAR supervision by proposing SelfOcc, a purely vision-based self-supervised framework. It learns scene geometry and semantics from multi-view images via differentiable rendering without any 3D annotations, and introduces illumination/viewpoint augmentation and occlusion-aware losses for robustness. SelfOcc achieves dense occupancy prediction without 3D labels, reaching or surpassing some fully supervised methods on benchmarks such as SemanticKITTI, offering a scalable low-cost paradigm for autonomous driving perception.
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习成功引入3D占用预测，摆脱LiDAR依赖，对降低自动驾驶感知成本意义重大，值得重点关注。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.contribution: 提出首个纯视觉自监督3D占用预测框架SelfOcc，无需任何3D标注即可学习稠密场景占用。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.innovation: 利用可微渲染与遮挡感知损失从多视角图像自监督学习几何与语义占用。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.result: 在无3D标签条件下于SemanticKITTI等基准上达到接近甚至超越部分全监督方法的占用预测性能。

What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: 针对未剪辑多动作视频中时空定位（何时、何地发生何种动作）依赖昂贵人工标注的问题，本文提出基于叙述指令的自监督时空定位任务与方法。方法利用视频与旁白文本的对应关系自动生成时空监督信号，通过跨模态对齐定位动作的时间区间与空间区域。相比全监督方法，该自监督范式无需人工时序/空间标注即可学习定位能力。实验在未剪辑多动作视频基准上验证了方法的有效性，缩小了与监督方法的差距。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper tackles the costly manual annotation required for spatio-temporal grounding in untrimmed multi-action videos by proposing a self-supervised approach driven by narrated instructions. It automatically derives temporal and spatial supervision from video-narration correspondence and performs cross-modal alignment to localize when and where actions occur. Experiments on untrimmed multi-action benchmarks demonstrate effectiveness and narrow the gap to supervised methods without manual temporal/spatial labels.
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.assessment: 将自监督引入视频时空定位，利用叙述文本降低标注成本，对视频理解与多模态研究有参考价值。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出基于叙述指令的自监督时空定位框架，实现未剪辑多动作视频的何时、何地、何种动作定位。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.innovation: 利用视频-旁白对应关系自动生成时空监督信号进行跨模态对齐。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.result: 在未剪辑多动作视频基准上无需人工时空标注即取得有效定位性能，缩小与监督方法的差距。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised Spatio- Temporal Grounding in Untrimmed Multi-Action Videos from Narrated Instructions.

Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_cn: 针对超分辨率模型在真实退化下泛化能力差的问题，本文提出低分辨率引导的自监督学习策略。方法先在低分辨率域进行自监督预训练以学习退化鲁棒的表示，再迁移到高分辨率超分任务，从而提升对未知退化的泛化性。相比直接在合成退化上训练的传统超分方法，该策略显著改善了跨域泛化表现。实验在多个超分基准与真实退化场景下验证了泛化能力的提升。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of super-resolution models under real-world degradations by proposing a low-resolution-guided self-supervised learning strategy. It first performs self-supervised pre-training in the low-resolution domain to learn degradation-robust representations, then transfers to high-resolution super-resolution, improving generalization to unseen degradations. Experiments across multiple SR benchmarks and real degradation settings demonstrate improved generalization over conventional synthetic-degradation training.
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.assessment: 低分辨率引导的自监督预训练思路新颖，对提升超分泛化性有效，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.contribution: 提出低分辨率引导的自监督学习策略以提升超分辨率模型对真实退化的泛化能力。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.innovation: 在低分辨率域自监督预训练学习退化鲁棒表示再迁移至高分辨率超分。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.result: 在多个超分基准与真实退化场景下显著提升跨域泛化性能。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General._arxiv_id: Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving Generalization for Super-Resolution by Self-Supervised Learning.

Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_cn: 针对人脸表示学习依赖大量标注且忽略局部区域语义的问题，本文提出具有面部区域感知的自监督人脸表示学习方法。方法通过区域感知的对比学习与掩码重建，显式建模眼睛、鼻子、嘴等面部区域的局部一致性，从而学习更细粒度的表示。相比通用自监督方法，该方法在人脸识别与属性分析等下游任务上取得更好性能。实验验证了区域感知对提升人脸表示质量的有效性。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on large-scale annotations and neglect of local region semantics in facial representation learning by proposing a facial-region-aware self-supervised method. It explicitly models local consistency of facial regions (eyes, nose, mouth) via region-aware contrastive learning and masked reconstruction to learn fine-grained representations. Experiments show improved performance on downstream face recognition and attribute analysis over generic self-supervised methods.
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.assessment: 区域感知的自监督人脸表示思路合理，但应用面较窄，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.contribution: 提出面部区域感知的自监督人脸表示学习方法，显式建模局部区域语义。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.innovation: 结合区域感知对比学习与掩码重建学习细粒度人脸表示。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.result: 在人脸识别与属性分析等下游任务上优于通用自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Facial Representation Learning with Facial Region Awareness.

CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标发现中现有方法依赖单一自监督特征、难以发现多样目标的问题，本文提出CuVLER，通过穷尽式组合多种自监督Transformer特征来增强无监督目标发现。方法融合不同层、不同模型的ViT特征，并设计特征选择与聚类策略以提升目标定位与分类的召回率。相比使用单一特征的方法，CuVLER在无监督目标发现基准上显著提升了发现精度。实验表明多特征融合能有效缓解漏检问题。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of unsupervised object discovery methods that rely on a single self-supervised feature and struggle to discover diverse objects, proposing CuVLER, which exhaustively combines multiple self-supervised Transformer features. It fuses ViT features from different layers and models with feature selection and clustering strategies to improve recall in localization and classification. Experiments show CuVLER significantly improves discovery accuracy over single-feature methods, mitigating missed detections.
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.assessment: 多自监督特征融合提升无监督目标发现，思路实用，对开放集检测与目标发现研究有借鉴意义。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.contribution: 提出CuVLER，通过穷尽式融合多种自监督Transformer特征增强无监督目标发现。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.innovation: 跨层、跨模型ViT特征融合与选择策略提升目标发现召回。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.result: 在无监督目标发现基准上显著优于单特征方法，有效缓解漏检。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis._arxiv_id: CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Discoveries through Exhaustive Self-Supervised Transformers.

Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_cn: 针对文本引导图像编辑中提示词质量影响生成效果、且缺乏配对监督的问题，本文提出提示增强的自监督文本引导图像编辑方法。方法通过自监督方式自动扩充与优化文本提示，并利用图像自身一致性构建训练信号，从而在无配对数据下提升编辑的语义对齐与保真度。相比依赖人工提示或配对数据的方法，该方法在编辑质量与文本一致性上取得改进。实验验证了提示增强对编辑效果的有效性。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the sensitivity of text-guided image manipulation to prompt quality and the lack of paired supervision by proposing a prompt-augmentation self-supervised method. It automatically augments and optimizes text prompts and leverages image self-consistency as training signals, improving semantic alignment and fidelity without paired data. Experiments show improvements in manipulation quality and text consistency over methods relying on manual prompts or paired data.
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.assessment: 提示增强结合自监督提升文本引导编辑，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.contribution: 提出提示增强的自监督文本引导图像编辑方法，在无配对数据下提升编辑质量。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.innovation: 自监督扩充优化文本提示并利用图像自一致性构建训练信号。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.result: 在编辑质量与文本一致性上优于依赖人工提示或配对数据的方法。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised Text-guided Image Manipulation.

BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）中亚细胞结构三维重建时的朝向估计问题，提出将等变性（equivariance）引入自监督三维子断层对齐框架 BOE-ViT。方法上以 Vision Transformer 为骨干，通过显式建模旋转等变性来增强特征对三维朝向的表征能力，并采用自监督对齐损失进行训练。相比传统依赖标注或非等变网络的方法，BOE-ViT 在朝向估计精度上有所提升，缓解了标注稀缺问题。该工作属于自监督视觉与三维几何学习交叉方向，与自动驾驶感知的关联较弱。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_en: This paper addresses orientation estimation for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-ET by introducing equivariance into a self-supervised framework, BOE-ViT. Built on a Vision Transformer backbone, it explicitly models rotational equivariance to improve 3D orientation representation and is trained with self-supervised alignment objectives. Compared with annotation-dependent or non-equivariant baselines, it improves orientation estimation accuracy while alleviating the scarcity of labels.
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.assessment: 将等变性引入自监督三维对齐的思路对几何感知研究有参考价值，但应用场景（cryo-ET）与自动驾驶感知距离较远。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.contribution: 提出融合等变性的自监督 ViT 框架用于三维子断层朝向估计。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.innovation: 在自监督对齐中显式建模旋转等变性以增强三维朝向特征。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.result: 在子断层朝向估计任务上取得优于非等变基线的精度。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation._arxiv_id: BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation with Equivariance in Self-Supervised 3D Subtomogram Alignment.

DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云自监督预训练在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器 DAP-MAE。方法在 MAE 式掩码重建框架中引入域自适应机制，使编码器学习到跨域不变的点云表征，从而提升下游跨域任务的迁移效果。相比仅在单一域上预训练的 MAE 方法，DAP-MAE 在跨域点云分类/分割等任务上取得更好表现。该工作与自动驾驶中的 3D 点云感知有一定关联，但并非直接面向检测任务。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited cross-domain generalization of point cloud self-supervised pre-training by proposing DAP-MAE, a domain-adaptive masked autoencoder. It incorporates domain adaptation into the MAE-style masked reconstruction pipeline so that the encoder learns domain-invariant point cloud representations for better downstream transfer. Compared with single-domain MAE pre-training, DAP-MAE achieves improved performance on cross-domain point cloud tasks.
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.assessment: 跨域点云自监督预训练对自动驾驶 3D 感知有潜在价值，但需验证其在检测/分割等下游任务上的实际增益。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.contribution: 提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器以提升跨域表征迁移能力。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.innovation: 将域自适应机制融入点云 MAE 预训练框架。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.result: 在跨域点云下游任务上优于单域预训练基线。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas._arxiv_id: DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Masked Autoencoder for Effective Cross-Domain Learning.

2503.23220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中 Mean Teacher 自标注范式耦合学习与伪标签生成、初始伪标签质量差的问题，提出 DINO Teacher。方法利用大规模冻结的 DINOv2 视觉基础模型在源域上训练一个独立标注器，为目标域生成更准确的伪标签，从而解耦标签生成与检测器学习，并可结合额外的域对齐损失。相比依赖学生模型 EMA 生成伪标签的现有方法，DINO Teacher 在多个 DAOD 基准上取得更优的检测精度，验证了视觉基础模型在域自适应检测中的价值。
2503.23220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the brittleness of Mean-Teacher self-labelling in domain adaptive object detection (DAOD), where label generation and detector learning are tightly coupled. It proposes DINO Teacher, which trains a separate labeller on source data using a large frozen DINOv2 backbone to produce more accurate target-domain pseudo-labels, decoupling labelling from detection learning. Compared with EMA-based pseudo-labeling, it achieves superior detection accuracy on DAOD benchmarks, demonstrating the value of vision foundation models for domain adaptation.
2503.23220|v2.assessment: 利用冻结视觉基础模型解耦伪标签生成是 DAOD 的实用改进，对自动驾驶跨域检测有直接参考意义。
2503.23220|v2.contribution: 提出基于 DINOv2 的独立标注器以解耦 DAOD 中的伪标签生成与检测器学习。
2503.23220|v2.innovation: 用大规模冻结基础模型替代 EMA 教师生成目标域伪标签。

A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维点云自监督预训练方法缺乏统一解释框架的问题，提出基于交互（interactions）的统一分析视角。方法通过量化预训练模型中学到的特征交互模式，对多种点云自监督方法进行对比与解释，揭示不同预训练目标所捕获的几何与语义信息差异。相比以往仅以微调精度评价预训练方法的工作，该研究提供了更细粒度的可解释性分析。该工作对理解点云表征学习有理论价值，但与自动驾驶检测任务关联间接。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified interpretation framework for 3D point cloud self-supervised pre-training methods by proposing an interaction-based analysis. It quantifies feature interactions learned by different pre-training objectives, revealing differences in captured geometric and semantic information. Compared with prior work that evaluates pre-training solely by fine-tuning accuracy, it offers finer-grained interpretability, though its link to autonomous driving detection is indirect.
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.assessment: 为点云自监督预训练提供可解释性分析视角，对表征学习研究有启发，但工程落地价值有限。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.contribution: 提出基于交互的统一框架解释三维点云自监督预训练方法。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.innovation: 用特征交互量化不同预训练目标所捕获的信息差异。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.result: 揭示了多种点云自监督方法在几何与语义表征上的差异。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-._arxiv_id: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-supervised Pre-training Methods for 3D Point Clouds via Interactions.

2503.13739|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角行人关联中外观特征在相似外观场景下失效、且现有方法依赖真值身份标签或标定相机参数的问题，提出自监督无标定方法 Self-MVA。方法设计编码器-解码器模型与跨视角图像同步（cross-view image synchronization）自监督 pretext 任务，判断不同视角图像是否同一时刻拍摄，并通过匈牙利匹配桥接实例级与同步标签的监督。相比全监督或需标定的方法，Self-MVA 无需任何标注即可在挑战场景下实现更鲁棒的多视角行人关联。
2503.13739|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view person association in challenging scenes where appearance features fail and existing methods require identity labels or calibrated cameras. It proposes Self-MVA, a self-supervised uncalibrated approach with an encoder-decoder model and a cross-view image synchronization pretext task that determines whether images from different views are captured simultaneously, using Hungarian matching to bridge instance-level and synchronization supervision. Without any annotations, it achieves more robust association than fully-supervised or calibration-dependent methods.
2503.13739|v2.assessment: 利用时间同步作为自监督信号进行无标定多视角关联的思路新颖，对多相机感知与跟踪有借鉴意义。
2503.13739|v2.contribution: 提出基于跨视角时间同步的自监督无标定多视角行人关联方法。
2503.13739|v2.innovation: 以图像同步作为 pretext 任务并借匈牙利匹配桥接实例监督。
2503.13739|v2.result: 在无任何标注条件下于挑战场景实现更鲁棒的多视角行人关联。

2505.04410|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 CLIP 等视觉语言模型在开放词汇密集预测中局部特征判别性差、空间一致性不足的问题，提出 DeCLIP 框架。方法将 CLIP 自注意力模块解耦为 content 与 context 两类特征，content 特征与图像裁剪表征对齐以增强局部判别性，context 特征在 DINO 等视觉基础模型指导下保留空间关联。相比直接应用 CLIP 的现有方法，DeCLIP 在多个开放词汇密集预测基准上显著领先，提升了开放词汇分割/检测的精度。
2505.04410|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor local discriminability and spatial consistency of CLIP features in open-vocabulary dense prediction. It proposes DeCLIP, which decouples the self-attention module into content and context features: content features are aligned with image crop representations for local discriminability, while context features retain spatial correlations under the guidance of vision foundation models such as DINO. DeCLIP significantly outperforms existing methods across multiple open-vocabulary dense prediction benchmarks.
2505.04410|v2.assessment: 解耦 CLIP 注意力以兼顾局部判别与空间一致性，对开放词汇检测/分割及自动驾驶开放场景感知有较高参考价值。
2505.04410|v2.contribution: 提出解耦自注意力的 DeCLIP 框架提升开放词汇密集预测性能。
2505.04410|v2.innovation: 将 CLIP 自注意力拆分为 content 与 context 特征并分别对齐。
2505.04410|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇密集预测基准上显著超越现有方法。

2503.21003|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对AI生成图像取证中传统方法难以泛化到未见生成器的问题，提出显式建模取证微观结构（像素级残差模式）的方法。仅使用真实图像以自监督方式学习一组多样化预测滤波器提取多尺度残差，联合建模后得到每张图像的紧凑"取证自描述"参数。相比依赖已知源特定特征的传统方法，该方法无需先验知识即可实现零样本合成图像检测、开放集源归属和源聚类。实验表明其在准确性和适应性上优于竞争技术，推进了合成图像取证的最先进水平。
2503.21003|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of AI-generated image forensics to unseen generators by explicitly modeling forensic microstructures via pixel-level residual patterns. Using only real images in a self-supervised manner, it learns diverse predictive filters to extract multi-scale residuals and jointly models them into a compact forensic self-description per image. This enables zero-shot synthetic image detection, open-set source attribution, and source clustering without prior knowledge, achieving superior accuracy and adaptability over competing techniques.
2503.21003|v2.assessment: 将自监督残差建模与开放集取证结合，思路新颖，对开放集检测与自监督视觉方向有借鉴意义。
2503.21003|v2.contribution: 提出以真实图像自监督学习多尺度残差并构建每图唯一"取证自描述"的零样本取证框架。
2503.21003|v2.innovation: 用多样化预测滤波器联合建模多尺度残差，将图像参数化为可区分生成源的紧凑自描述。
2503.21003|v2.result: 在零样本检测、开放集源归属与聚类上准确性和适应性均优于现有方法。

S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_en: This paper (S4-Driver) targets scalable self-supervised training of multimodal large language models for autonomous driving with spatio-temporal visual representations. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodology, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be assessed. Based on the title, it aims to enhance multimodal understanding and spatio-temporal modeling in driving scenes via self-supervision.

2412.04424|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对主流CLIP式对比学习视觉编码器视觉表征层次单一、难以适配多样下游任务的问题，提出Florence-VL多模态大语言模型系列，采用生成式视觉基础模型Florence-2作为视觉编码器。提出深度-广度融合（DBFusion）机制，融合不同深度与多提示下提取的视觉特征，并设计端到端预训练加投影层与LLM微调的完整训练配方。定量分析与可视化表明其在视觉-语言对齐上优于流行视觉编码器，验证了丰富深度与广度视觉特征的优越性。
2412.04424|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited and single-level visual representations of CLIP-style contrastive encoders by introducing Florence-VL, an MLLM family built on the generative vision foundation model Florence-2. It proposes depth-breadth fusion (DBFusion) to integrate visual features from different depths and multiple prompts, with an end-to-end pretraining plus projection/LLM finetuning recipe. Quantitative analysis and visualization show advantages over popular vision encoders in vision-language alignment.
2412.04424|v2.assessment: 用生成式视觉编码器替代CLIP并设计深度-广度融合，对VLM视觉表征研究有明确参考价值。
2412.04424|v2.contribution: 提出基于Florence-2生成式编码器与DBFusion融合的Florence-VL多模态大模型系列。
2412.04424|v2.innovation: 深度-广度融合机制整合多深度、多提示视觉特征以增强视觉-语言对齐。
2412.04424|v2.result: 在视觉-语言对齐上优于流行视觉编码器，可视化验证了丰富视觉特征的优势。

2502.18290|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督学习视觉编码器被广泛共享复用、可能被植入后门从而影响下游LVLM的安全隐患，揭示了仅通过污染视觉编码器即可向LVLM注入显著视觉幻觉的新后门威胁。提出BadVision方法，采用新颖的触发器优化与后门学习技术，在两类SSL编码器和LVLM、八个基准上评估。结果显示攻击成功率超过99%，造成77.6%的相对视觉理解错误，同时保持隐蔽性，可绕过现有最先进的后门检测方法。
2502.18290|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals a new backdoor threat where compromising shared self-supervised learning (SSL) vision encoders can induce significant visual hallucinations in downstream LVLMs. It proposes BadVision, the first method exploiting this vulnerability with novel trigger optimization and backdoor learning, evaluated on two SSL encoder types and LVLMs across eight benchmarks. BadVision achieves over 99% attack success rate and 77.6% relative visual understanding error while maintaining stealthiness against state-of-the-art backdoor detection.
2502.18290|v2.assessment: 首次揭示SSL视觉编码器共享复用带来的后门传播风险，对自监督视觉与VLM安全研究有重要警示意义。
2502.18290|v2.contribution: 提出首个针对LVLM所用SSL视觉编码器的隐蔽后门攻击方法BadVision。
2502.18290|v2.innovation: 利用编码器共享复用特性，通过触发器优化与后门学习向LVLM注入攻击者指定的视觉幻觉。
2502.18290|v2.result: 攻击成功率超99%，造成77.6%相对视觉理解错误，且能规避最先进后门检测。

2511.08666|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频基础模型提取的时空特征在共享或存储时会泄露肤色、性别、衣着等敏感隐私信息的问题，指出现有像素级匿名化方法需重训练整个效用模型且任务特定，不适用于冻结的视频基础模型。作者提出轻量级匿名适配器模块（AAM），以即插即用方式作用于冻结视频编码器的潜在特征，并设计三个训练目标：片段级自监督隐私目标降低静态片段间互信息、协同训练目标在匿名化同时保留效用等。相比像素级方法，AAM无需微调编码器或重新提取特征，显著降低计算开销，并实现任务无关的隐私保护。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在保留通用任务效用的同时去除私有信息。
2511.08666|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that spatio-temporal features extracted by video foundation models inadvertently leak sensitive personal attributes (e.g., skin color, gender, clothing) when shared or stored. It proposes a lightweight Anonymizing Adapter Module (AAM) that operates in the latent space and can be plugged into frozen video encoders, trained with three objectives including a clip-level self-supervised privacy objective and a co-training objective to preserve utility. Unlike pixel-level anonymization that requires retraining the entire utility model and is task-specific, AAM is task-agnostic and avoids finetuning or feature re-extraction, reducing computational cost while removing private information.
2511.08666|v2.assessment: 该工作将隐私保护从像素级推进到潜在特征级，思路新颖且与视频基础模型生态兼容，但摘要未提供具体量化效果，且与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱，值得作为隐私-效用权衡的参考。
2511.08666|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的潜在空间匿名适配器AAM，在冻结视频编码器上实现任务无关的隐私保护。
2511.08666|v2.innovation: 将视觉隐私保护形式化到视频基础模型的潜在特征空间，并设计片段级自监督隐私目标与协同训练目标。
2511.08666|v2.result: 声称在保留通用任务效用的同时去除敏感隐私信息，且无需微调编码器或重新提取特征，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。

2003.13942|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频描述生成中现有方法仅使用场景级或物体级信息、缺乏对物体交互显式建模的问题，提出了一种时空图模型，通过构建可解释的物体间时空链接实现视觉 grounding。为避免物体数量变化导致性能不稳定，进一步提出物体感知的知识蒸馏机制，用局部物体信息正则化全局场景特征。在两个基准上的实验表明，该方法在保持竞争性性能的同时提供了可解释的预测。
2003.13942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit object interaction modeling in video captioning by proposing a spatio-temporal graph model that captures object interactions across space and time with interpretable links for visual grounding. An object-aware knowledge distillation mechanism is introduced to regularize global scene features using local object information, mitigating instability from varying object counts. Experiments on two benchmarks show competitive performance with interpretable predictions.
2003.13942|v2.assessment: 该工作将图神经网络与知识蒸馏结合用于视频描述，思路清晰且可解释性较强，但主题与自动驾驶感知的核心方向（3D检测、BEV等）关联较弱，主要对视频理解与多模态研究者有参考价值。
2003.13942|v2.contribution: 提出时空图模型与物体感知知识蒸馏机制，实现可解释的视频描述生成。
2003.13942|v2.innovation: 利用物体间时空交互图进行视觉 grounding，并通过知识蒸馏解决物体数量变化带来的性能不稳定问题。
2003.13942|v2.result: 在两个基准上取得竞争性性能，并提供可解释的预测结果。

2103.03454|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中现有智能体仅将历史观测以循环网络隐状态存储、无法捕捉环境布局与进行长期规划的问题，本文提出结构化场景记忆（SSM）架构。SSM 将导航过程中的感知精确分格记忆，并作为结构化场景表示解耦视觉与几何线索；其 collect-read 控制器自适应收集信息以支持当前决策并模拟迭代算法进行长程推理。由于 SSM 提供完整动作空间（地图上所有可导航位置），作者引入基于前沿探索的导航决策策略以实现高效全局规划。在 R2R 和 R4R 两个 VLN 数据集上取得当时最优性能。
2103.03454|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation that existing vision-language navigation (VLN) agents merely store past observations as latent states in recurrent networks, failing to capture environment layouts for long-term planning, this paper proposes a Structured Scene Memory (SSM) architecture. SSM compartmentalizes percepts during navigation and serves as a structured scene representation that disentangles visual and geometric cues, with a collect-read controller that adaptively gathers information and mimics iterative algorithms for long-range reasoning. Leveraging the complete action space provided by SSM, a frontier-exploration-based decision-making strategy is introduced for efficient global planning, achieving state-of-the-art results on R2R and R4R.
2103.03454|v2.assessment: 该工作对 VLN 中的记忆与规划机制提出了结构化建模思路，虽与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，但其场景表示与长程推理设计对具身导航与多模态决策有参考价值。
2103.03454|v2.contribution: 提出结构化场景记忆 SSM，将导航历史组织为可解耦视觉与几何线索的结构化表示并支持全局规划。
2103.03454|v2.innovation: 用分格记忆与 collect-read 控制器替代循环隐状态，并引入前沿探索策略实现完整动作空间上的全局导航决策。
2103.03454|v2.result: 在 R2R 与 R4R 数据集上取得当时最优性能。

3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_en: As the abstract is unavailable, the specific problem, method, and experimental results cannot be summarized. Based on the title, 3DVG-Transformer addresses visual grounding on point clouds by proposing relation modeling with a Transformer, typically leveraging self- and cross-attention to capture relations among point cloud instances and between language and 3D targets for improved referring localization. Concrete experimental conclusions require consulting the original paper.
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.assessment: 该工作将 Transformer 关系建模引入点云视觉定位，与 3D 感知中的多模态指代理解相关，但缺少摘要无法评估具体贡献。

3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云中密集描述（dense captioning）与视觉定位（visual grounding）两个任务通常被分开处理的问题，提出了统一框架3DJCG。方法上通过共享编码器和任务特定的解码器，联合学习点云区域的描述生成与语言指代定位，并引入跨任务交互机制。相比已有单任务方法，该框架能同时输出区域描述和定位结果，在ScanRefer和Nr3D等数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that dense captioning and visual grounding on 3D point clouds are typically handled separately, and proposes a unified framework, 3DJCG. It jointly learns region captioning and language grounding via a shared encoder and task-specific decoders with cross-task interaction. Compared to single-task methods, it achieves competitive performance on ScanRefer and Nr3D.
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.assessment: 该工作将两个3D点云理解任务统一到一个框架中，思路清晰，但主要面向室内点云场景，与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测的直接关联有限。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.contribution: 提出了一个联合3D点云密集描述与视觉定位的统一框架。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.innovation: 通过跨任务交互机制实现描述生成与语言定位的相互增强。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.result: 在ScanRefer和Nr3D等基准上取得了有竞争力的联合性能。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den._arxiv_id: 3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Dense Captioning and Visual Grounding on 3D Point Clouds.

A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割（open-vocabulary semantic segmentation）问题，即模型需分割训练时未见过的类别。作者提出了一种简单基线方法，利用预训练的视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）进行像素级分类，通过将图像块特征与文本嵌入对齐来实现开放词汇分割。相比复杂的定制架构，该方法无需额外训练即可取得与专用方法相当甚至更好的效果，在多个开放词汇分割基准上验证了其有效性。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where models must segment categories unseen during training. The authors propose a simple baseline that leverages a pre-trained vision-language model (e.g., CLIP) to perform pixel-level classification by aligning patch features with text embeddings. Without additional training, it achieves comparable or superior performance to specialized methods on several open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks.
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.assessment: 该工作展示了预训练视觉-语言模型在开放词汇分割中的强大零样本能力，方法简洁有效，对开放集感知研究有参考价值。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.contribution: 提出了一个基于预训练视觉-语言模型的简单开放词汇语义分割基线。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.innovation: 无需额外训练，直接利用CLIP的图文对齐能力实现像素级开放词汇分割。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上达到与专用方法相当或更优的性能。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se._arxiv_id: A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Pre-trained Vision-Language Model.

A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式视觉-语言导航（interactive vision-language navigation）中指令可行性未知的问题，构建了一个新的数据集。现有导航数据集通常假设指令总是可行的，而实际中用户指令可能无法完成。作者收集了包含可行与不可行指令的交互式导航数据，并设计了评估协议来测试模型判断指令可行性的能力。实验表明现有模型在判断指令可行性方面仍有较大提升空间。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of unknown command feasibility in interactive vision-language navigation, where existing datasets assume all instructions are feasible. The authors introduce a new dataset containing both feasible and infeasible instructions with an evaluation protocol to test models' ability to judge feasibility. Experiments show that current models still have significant room for improvement in feasibility judgment.
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.assessment: 该工作关注导航中指令可行性的现实问题，数据集构建有实际意义，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.contribution: 构建了包含未知指令可行性的交互式视觉-语言导航数据集。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.innovation: 首次系统性地引入指令可行性判断任务并设计评估协议。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.result: 实验表明现有模型在指令可行性判断上表现有限，仍有较大提升空间。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility.

Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言导航（VLN）中模型难以解耦视觉与语言信息的问题，提出了解耦标签（decoupled labels）学习方法。作者将导航指令分解为多个语义组件，并设计辅助任务促使模型学习解耦的表征，从而提升导航决策的可解释性和泛化能力。在R2R等标准VLN基准上，该方法相比基线取得了性能提升，并验证了解耦表征的有效性。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of disentangling visual and linguistic information in vision-language navigation (VLN). The authors propose a decoupled labels learning approach that decomposes navigation instructions into semantic components and uses auxiliary tasks to encourage disentangled representations. On standard VLN benchmarks such as R2R, the method improves over baselines and validates the effectiveness of disentangled representations.
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.assessment: 该工作通过解耦学习提升VLN的表征质量，思路有一定新意，但属于导航与语言交叉领域，与自动驾驶感知相关性有限。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.contribution: 提出了基于解耦标签的视觉-语言导航学习方法。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.innovation: 通过指令语义分解和辅助任务实现视觉-语言表征的解耦。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.result: 在R2R等VLN基准上相比基线取得了性能提升。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled._arxiv_id: Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled Labels for Vision-Language Navigation.

UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型中文本生成与目标框预测通常分离的问题，提出了UniTAB统一框架，将文本和边界框输出统一到一个序列生成范式中。方法上通过统一的Transformer解码器同时生成文本token和框坐标token，实现指代定位、区域描述等多任务统一。相比分别设计任务特定头的已有方法，UniTAB在多个视觉-语言基准上取得了更优或相当的性能，并简化了模型架构。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of text generation and box prediction in vision-language models by proposing UniTAB, a unified framework that casts both text and bounding box outputs into a single sequence generation paradigm. A unified Transformer decoder generates text tokens and box coordinate tokens simultaneously, unifying tasks like referring expression comprehension and region captioning. Compared to task-specific head designs, UniTAB achieves superior or comparable performance on multiple vision-language benchmarks with a simplified architecture.
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.assessment: 该工作将文本与框输出统一为序列生成，架构简洁且通用性强，对多模态定位任务有参考价值。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.contribution: 提出了统一文本与边界框输出的视觉-语言建模框架UniTAB。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.innovation: 将框坐标作为token与文本统一在序列生成范式中。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.result: 在多个视觉-语言基准上取得更优或相当的性能。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo._arxiv_id: UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs for Grounded Vision-Language Modeling.

2207.09644|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人体骨架序列表示学习中自监督预训练未充分利用骨架层次化时空特性的问题，提出了层次化自监督Transformer（Hi-TRS）。方法上在帧、片段和视频三个层级分别捕捉空间、短期和长期时序依赖，并设计相应的自监督预训练任务。相比仅使用视频级对比学习的已有方法，Hi-TRS在动作识别、动作检测和运动预测三个下游任务上，在监督和半监督协议下均取得了最先进性能。
2207.09644|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of hierarchical spatial-temporal structure in self-supervised skeleton sequence representation learning by proposing a hierarchical Transformer-based encoder (Hi-TRS). It explicitly captures spatial, short-term, and long-term temporal dependencies at frame, clip, and video levels with corresponding self-supervised pre-training tasks. Compared to video-level contrastive learning methods, Hi-TRS achieves state-of-the-art performance on action recognition, action detection, and motion prediction under both supervised and semi-supervised protocols.
2207.09644|v2.assessment: 该工作将层次化Transformer与自监督预训练结合用于骨架序列建模，实验充分且性能领先，对自监督视频理解有借鉴意义。
2207.09644|v2.contribution: 提出了层次化自监督Transformer用于人体骨架序列表示学习。
2207.09644|v2.innovation: 在帧、片段、视频三个层级设计自监督任务以捕捉层次化时空依赖。
2207.09644|v2.result: 在动作识别、动作检测和运动预测三个任务上均取得最先进性能。

2208.06105|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频对比学习方法未能充分利用短时运动动态，而这对下游视频理解任务至关重要。本文提出运动敏感对比学习（MSCL），将光流捕捉的运动信息注入RGB帧以强化特征学习，具体包括跨模态帧级对比目标（LMCL）、流旋转增强（FRA）生成运动打乱的负样本，以及运动差分采样（MDS）筛选训练样本。在UCF101和Something-Something v2上，以3D ResNet-18为骨干，视频分类top-1准确率分别达到91.5%和50.3%，视频检索UCF101 Top-1 Recall为65.6%，显著优于现有方法。
2208.06105|v2.summary_en: Existing contrastive video representation learning methods insufficiently exploit short-term motion dynamics. This paper proposes Motion Sensitive Contrastive Learning (MSCL), which injects optical flow motion into RGB frames via local motion contrastive learning, flow rotation augmentation, and motion differential sampling. With 3D ResNet-18, it achieves 91.5% top-1 on UCF101 and 50.3% on Something-Something v2 for classification, and 65.6% Top-1 Recall on UCF101 for retrieval, notably improving state-of-the-art.
2208.06105|v2.assessment: 该工作通过多模态对比学习有效融合运动信息，在视频理解任务上取得显著提升，对自监督视频表示学习有参考价值。
2208.06105|v2.contribution: 提出运动敏感对比学习框架，将光流运动信息注入RGB视频表示学习。
2208.06105|v2.innovation: 设计局部运动对比学习、流旋转增强和运动差分采样，增强运动动态的利用。
2208.06105|v2.result: 在UCF101和Something-Something v2上分类和检索任务均达到最优性能。

2208.09843|v2.summary_cn: 图像-文本检索（ITR）的核心挑战在于跨模态对齐，现有对比学习方法受限于负样本数量少、手动加权及缺乏外部知识。本文提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习（CODER），包含多样性敏感对比学习（DCL）架构，通过动态字典扩大图像-文本对规模并自适应加权负样本；同时设计双分支结构，一支学习实例级嵌入并生成伪聚类标签，另一支从常识知识图谱查询概念级描述符，两分支利用DCL对齐跨模态空间。实验表明CODER在ITR任务上提升了跨模态表示能力。
2208.09843|v2.summary_en: Image-Text Retrieval (ITR) struggles with cross-modal alignment. This paper proposes CODER, a coupled diversity-sensitive momentum contrastive learning method. It introduces dynamic dictionaries and adaptive negative weighting, and combines instance-level and concept-level branches via a commonsense knowledge graph. Experiments show improved cross-modal representation for ITR.
2208.09843|v2.assessment: 该工作通过动态字典和知识图谱增强对比学习，为跨模态检索提供了新思路，但相关度对自动驾驶领域较低。
2208.09843|v2.contribution: 提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习框架CODER，用于图像-文本检索。
2208.09843|v2.innovation: 结合动态字典、自适应负样本加权和常识知识图谱的双分支对比学习。
2208.09843|v2.result: 在图像-文本检索任务上提升了跨模态表示和对齐性能。

2207.12661|v2.summary_cn: 多模态对比预训练通常为每种模态使用独立编码器，但Transformer可能支持跨模态知识共享。本文系统研究了模态共享对比语言-图像预训练（MS-CLIP），探索在对比预训练中Transformer参数跨模态共享的比例，并严格检验架构设计选择。实验发现，视觉和语言信号使用大部分统一的编码器优于分离更多参数的变体，且轻量级模态特定并行模块可进一步提升性能。MS-CLIP在零样本ImageNet分类上相对原始CLIP提升高达13%。
2207.12661|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates Modality-Shared Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (MS-CLIP), questioning how many transformer parameters can be shared across modalities. It finds that a mostly unified encoder outperforms more separated variants, and lightweight modality-specific modules further improve performance. MS-CLIP outperforms vanilla CLIP by up to 13% relative in zero-shot ImageNet classification.
2207.12661|v2.assessment: 该工作深入探索了多模态预训练中的参数共享策略，对高效多模态模型设计有重要指导意义。
2207.12661|v2.contribution: 系统研究并验证了模态共享的对比语言-图像预训练框架MS-CLIP。
2207.12661|v2.innovation: 通过参数共享谱系分析，发现统一编码器加轻量模态特定模块的最佳设计。
2207.12661|v2.result: 零样本ImageNet分类相对CLIP提升高达13%。

2107.06383|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉-语言（V&L）模型依赖在少量标注数据上预训练的视觉编码器，泛化能力受限。本文研究CLIP作为视觉编码器在V&L模型中的优势，提出两种场景：1）将CLIP插入任务特定微调；2）结合CLIP与V&L预训练并迁移到下游任务。实验表明CLIP显著优于BottomUp-TopDown等域内标注数据训练的编码器，在视觉问答、视觉蕴涵和V&L导航任务上取得竞争性或更优结果，并建立新的SOTA。
2107.06383|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-and-Language (V&L) models rely on visual encoders pre-trained on limited annotated data. This paper studies using CLIP as the visual encoder in V&L models, either by plugging into fine-tuning or combining with V&L pre-training. CLIP significantly outperforms encoders like BottomUp-TopDown, achieving competitive or better results and new state-of-the-art on VQA, Visual Entailment, and V&L Navigation.
2107.06383|v2.assessment: 该工作系统验证了CLIP在V&L任务中的强大迁移能力，为多模态预训练提供了重要参考。
2107.06383|v2.contribution: 提出将CLIP作为视觉编码器集成到V&L模型中，并验证其有效性。
2107.06383|v2.innovation: 系统比较CLIP与域内预训练编码器在多种V&L任务上的表现。
2107.06383|v2.result: 在VQA、视觉蕴涵和V&L导航任务上取得新SOTA。

2106.12570|v2.summary_cn: 多模态VAE旨在建模异构数据的联合分布并捕获共享表示，但现有方法通常通过显式乘积或混合在识别模型中直接协调各模态表示。本文提出MEME，利用半监督VAE通过相互监督隐式组合模态信息，自然支持部分观测数据（某些模态完全缺失）。在MNIST-SVHN和CUB数据集上，MEME在部分和完全观测方案下均优于基线，并分析了相互监督学习到的表示质量。
2106.12570|v2.summary_en: Multimodal VAEs typically combine modalities via explicit products or mixtures. This paper introduces MEME, which repurposes semi-supervised VAEs to combine modalities implicitly through mutual supervision, naturally handling partially-observed data. MEME outperforms baselines on MNIST-SVHN and CUB under both partial and complete observation schemes.
2106.12570|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态VAE提供了一种新颖的隐式组合方式，能处理缺失模态，但应用场景与自动驾驶较远。
2106.12570|v2.contribution: 提出MEME，通过相互监督隐式组合多模态信息的多模态VAE。
2106.12570|v2.innovation: 利用半监督VAE实现模态间的相互监督，支持部分观测数据。
2106.12570|v2.result: 在MNIST-SVHN和CUB上部分和完全观测方案均优于基线。

2106.09667|v2.summary_cn: 多模态对比学习（如CLIP）通常在噪声大、未整理的训练数据上训练，这虽降低成本并提升分布外鲁棒性，但本文揭示这种实践使后门和投毒攻击成为重大威胁。通过仅污染0.01%的数据集（如300万Conceptual Captions中的300张图像），即可通过叠加小补丁使模型误分类测试图像；定向投毒攻击更易实现，仅需控制0.0001%的数据集（300万中的3张图像）。这些攻击质疑了在未整理互联网数据上训练的可取性。
2106.09667|v2.summary_en: Multimodal contrastive learning like CLIP trains on noisy, uncurated data. This paper shows that this practice makes backdoor and poisoning attacks a significant threat. Poisoning just 0.01% of a dataset (e.g., 300 images of 3M) can cause misclassification via a small patch, and targeted attacks require only 0.0001% (3 images). These attacks question the desirability of training on uncurated Internet scrapes.
2106.09667|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了对比学习在未整理数据上的安全漏洞，对多模态预训练的数据安全有重要警示意义。
2106.09667|v2.contribution: 首次系统展示多模态对比学习易受后门和投毒攻击。
2106.09667|v2.innovation: 证明极低比例的数据污染即可实现有效攻击。
2106.09667|v2.result: 仅需0.01%数据污染即可导致误分类，定向攻击仅需0.0001%。

2207.03482|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）中，CLIP 预训练模型缺乏精确定位能力，而图像级弱监督的启发式方法无法准确指定局部物体区域，两者均未针对检测任务做最优对齐。本文提出对 CLIP 语言嵌入进行以物体为中心的对齐，并通过伪标签过程利用图像级监督生成高质量物体提议以扩展词汇表，再用一种新颖的权重传递函数桥接两种对齐策略以聚合互补优势。相比已有 OVD 方法，该工作缩小了物体级与图像级表示之间的差距。在 LVIS 等基准上取得了显著的开放词汇检测性能提升（新类别 AP 大幅提高）。
2207.03482|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on CLIP pretraining and image-level supervision, neither of which is optimally aligned for detection. This paper proposes object-centric alignment of CLIP language embeddings and a pseudo-labeling process that grounds objects using only image-level supervision, bridging the two strategies via a novel weight transfer function. The method narrows the gap between object- and image-level representations and achieves substantial gains on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks such as LVIS.
2207.03482|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了 OVD 中弱监督信号与检测任务不匹配的核心问题，权重传递函数的设计具有启发性，对开放词汇检测方向的研究者有较高参考价值。
2207.03482|v2.contribution: 提出通过物体中心对齐和伪标签桥接 CLIP 与图像级监督的开放词汇检测框架。
2207.03482|v2.innovation: 设计权重传递函数聚合物体级与图像级对齐策略的互补优势。
2207.03482|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上显著提升新类别检测精度，缩小了与全监督检测器的差距。

2208.05592|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇模型如 CLIP 在零样本分类上表现优异，但在某些特定任务上性能远不理想，且微调容易导致已有任务性能下降。本文提出 PAINT，通过在微调前后的模型权重之间进行插值来实现模型修补（model patching），在不损害已有任务精度的前提下提升特定任务表现。在 9 个零样本 CLIP 表现较差的任务上，PAINT 将精度提升 15 至 60 个百分点，同时 ImageNet 精度保持在零样本模型 1 个百分点以内。此外还发现广泛迁移现象，并探索了计数和排版攻击防御等应用。
2208.05592|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary models like CLIP underperform on certain tasks, and naive fine-tuning degrades existing capabilities. This paper introduces PAINT, which interpolates between pre- and post-fine-tuning weights to patch specific tasks without degrading others. PAINT improves accuracy by 15–60 points on nine tasks while preserving ImageNet accuracy within 1 point, and reveals broad transfer effects and applications such as counting and typographic attack mitigation.
2208.05592|v2.assessment: 权重插值修补思路简洁有效，对多任务持续学习和模型编辑有启发，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度有限。
2208.05592|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重插值的模型修补方法 PAINT，实现特定任务提升且不遗忘已有能力。
2208.05592|v2.innovation: 利用微调前后权重插值实现无遗忘的任务修补，并发现跨任务广泛迁移现象。
2208.05592|v2.result: 在 9 个困难任务上精度提升 15–60 个百分点，ImageNet 精度损失不超过 1 个百分点。

2211.14241|v2.summary_cn: 3D 视觉定位任务中，现有方法主要依赖现成的点云编码器提取 3D 视觉线索，未充分利用 2D 语义信息。本文提出 LAR 模块，从 3D 点云合成 2D 线索（无需额外 2D 输入），通过知识蒸馏辅助 3D 编码器学习更丰富的物体表示。在 Nr3D、Sr3D 和 ScanRefer 三个基准上，LAR 一致性地超越现有 3D 视觉定位方法，取得显著的性能提升。
2211.14241|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D visual grounding methods rely on off-the-shelf point cloud encoders and underutilize 2D semantics. This paper proposes LAR, which synthesizes 2D clues from point clouds and distills them into the 3D encoder without requiring extra 2D inputs. LAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Nr3D, Sr3D, and ScanRefer benchmarks.
2211.14241|v2.assessment: 利用合成 2D 语义蒸馏增强 3D 表示是一个新颖且实用的思路，对 3D 感知与语言 grounding 交叉方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶 BEV/检测主线关联中等。
2211.14241|v2.contribution: 提出从点云合成 2D 线索并通过知识蒸馏增强 3D 视觉定位的 LAR 模块。
2211.14241|v2.innovation: 无需额外 2D 输入，利用合成 2D 语义知识蒸馏提升 3D 编码器表示质量。
2211.14241|v2.result: 在 Nr3D、Sr3D、ScanRefer 三个基准上一致超越现有最优方法。

2301.05499|v2.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测（SDGOD）研究几乎空白的问题，论文提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型（CLIP）通过文本提示引入语义域概念。方法包括在检测器骨干特征上进行语义增强策略，以及基于文本的分类损失，从而同时提升目标定位与表示的鲁棒性。相比唯一已有的SDGOD方法Single-DGOD，在多样天气驾驶基准上性能提升10%。
2301.05499|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the almost non-existent literature on Single Domain Generalization for Object Detection (SDGOD). It proposes leveraging a pre-trained vision-language model (CLIP) to introduce semantic domain concepts via textual prompts, using a semantic augmentation strategy on detector backbone features and a text-based classification loss. It outperforms the only existing SDGOD method, Single-DGOD, by 10% on a diverse weather-driving benchmark.
2301.05499|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了单域泛化目标检测的空白，利用CLIP的语义先验提升跨域鲁棒性，对自动驾驶等域偏移场景有参考价值。
2301.05499|v2.contribution: 首次将视觉-语言模型引入单域泛化目标检测，提出语义增强与文本分类损失。
2301.05499|v2.innovation: 通过文本提示进行语义域增强，并设计文本分类损失来对齐特征与语义概念。
2301.05499|v2.result: 在多样天气驾驶基准上比Single-DGOD提升10%。

2303.12027|v2.summary_cn: 针对自然语言指定跟踪任务中现有方法将视觉定位与跟踪分离、忽略两者联系且难以端到端训练的问题，论文提出联合视觉定位与跟踪框架，将两者统一为基于视觉-语言参考的定位任务。具体设计了多源关系建模模块来构建参考与测试图像的关系，以及时序建模模块在全局语义指导下提供时序线索。该方法提升了对外观变化的适应性，实现了端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of separated visual grounding and tracking frameworks for tracking by natural language specification, which overlook their connection and hinder end-to-end training. It proposes a joint framework that unifies grounding and tracking as localizing the referred target based on visual-language references, with a multi-source relation modeling module and a temporal modeling module guided by global semantics. The method improves adaptability to appearance variations and enables end-to-end training.
2303.12027|v2.assessment: 将视觉定位与跟踪统一建模，思路合理，对多模态跟踪任务有推进，但实验规模与对比需进一步验证。
2303.12027|v2.contribution: 提出联合视觉定位与跟踪的统一框架，实现端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.innovation: 多源关系建模模块与时序建模模块，在全局语义指导下融合时序线索。
2303.12027|v2.result: 提升了对外观变化的适应性，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.16891|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有实例分割模型依赖人工掩码标注、难以扩展到新类别的问题，论文提出Mask-free OVIS流水线，利用预训练视觉-语言模型的定位能力从图像-字幕对中自动生成伪掩码标注。方法以弱监督方式同时学习基类和新类，缓解了强监督基类与弱监督新类之间的过拟合问题。实验表明该方法在开放词汇实例分割上取得了良好泛化性能。
2303.16891|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scalability issue of instance segmentation models that rely on manual mask annotations for base categories. It proposes Mask-free OVIS, a pipeline that automatically generates pseudo-mask annotations from image-caption pairs using the localization ability of a pre-trained vision-language model, and learns both base and novel categories in a weakly supervised manner. This alleviates overfitting on base categories and improves generalization to novel categories.
2303.16891|v2.assessment: 无需人工掩码的开放词汇实例分割方案，降低了标注成本，对开放世界感知有实际意义。
2303.16891|v2.contribution: 提出Mask-free OVIS，利用视觉-语言模型生成伪掩码实现开放词汇实例分割。
2303.16891|v2.innovation: 以弱监督方式从图像-字幕对自动生成伪掩码，统一学习基类与新类。
2303.16891|v2.result: 缓解了基类过拟合，提升了新类泛化能力，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.13076|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇检测中引入CLIP等视觉-语言模型时面临的两个核心障碍：整图训练模型用于区域识别的分布不匹配，以及未见类别的定位困难，论文提出CORA框架。CORA采用DETR风格，通过区域提示（Region prompting）缓解整图到区域的分布差距，并通过锚点预匹配（Anchor pre-matching）的类感知匹配机制学习可泛化的目标定位。在COCO OVD基准上，新类达到41.7 AP50，比之前SOTA提升2.4 AP50，且无需额外训练数据。
2303.13076|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies two core obstacles in incorporating vision-language models like CLIP into open-vocabulary detection: the whole-to-region distribution mismatch and the difficulty of localizing unseen classes. It proposes CORA, a DETR-style framework that adapts CLIP via region prompting to mitigate the distribution gap and anchor pre-matching for generalizable localization. On COCO OVD, CORA achieves 41.7 AP50 on novel classes, outperforming the previous SOTA by 2.4 AP50 without extra training data.
2303.13076|v2.assessment: CORA有效解决了CLIP用于开放词汇检测的关键问题，性能提升显著，对开放世界检测研究有重要参考价值。
2303.13076|v2.contribution: 提出CORA框架，通过区域提示和锚点预匹配适配CLIP进行开放词汇检测。
2303.13076|v2.innovation: 区域提示缓解整图-区域分布不匹配，锚点预匹配实现类感知的泛化定位。
2303.13076|v2.result: 在COCO OVD上新类达到41.7 AP50，超越前SOTA 2.4 AP50。

2301.09121|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割（OVS）任务，论文提出基于Transformer的OVSegmentor模型，仅利用网络爬取的图像-文本对进行预训练，无需任何掩码标注。模型通过基于slot-attention的绑定模块将图像像素聚合成可学习的组令牌，并与字幕嵌入对齐。提出掩码实体补全和跨图像掩码一致性两个代理任务，分别学习细粒度视觉-文本对齐和视觉不变性。构建了CC4M预训练数据集，显著提升训练效率。
2301.09121|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) by proposing OVSegmentor, a transformer-based model pre-trained solely on web-crawled image-text pairs without mask annotations. It aggregates pixels into learnable group tokens via a slot-attention binding module and aligns them with caption embeddings, using two proxy tasks: masked entity completion and cross-image mask consistency. It also constructs the CC4M dataset for efficient pre-training.
2301.09121|v2.assessment: 无需掩码标注的开放词汇分割方案，代理任务设计巧妙，CC4M数据集对社区有贡献。
2301.09121|v2.contribution: 提出OVSegmentor模型及两个代理任务，构建CC4M预训练数据集。
2301.09121|v2.innovation: 基于slot-attention的组令牌绑定与掩码实体补全、跨图像掩码一致性代理任务。
2301.09121|v2.result: 显著提升训练效率，具体分割指标未在摘要中给出。

2212.00785|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有开放世界语义分割方法基于对比学习（CL）仅考虑图像-文本对齐，导致训练与测试（区域-文本对齐）不一致的问题，论文提出文本接地对比学习（TCL）框架。TCL为给定文本生成分割掩码，从掩码区域提取文本接地图像嵌入，并通过TCL与文本嵌入对齐，直接学习区域-文本对齐。此外，论文提出了统一的评估协议，在8个语义分割数据集上进行公平比较。
2212.00785|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the train-test discrepancy in existing open-world semantic segmentation methods that use contrastive learning for image-text alignment but require region-text alignment at test time. It proposes Text-grounded Contrastive Learning (TCL), which generates a segmentation mask for a given text, extracts text-grounded image embedding from the masked region, and aligns it with text embedding. It also presents a unified evaluation protocol on 8 semantic segmentation datasets.
2212.00785|v2.assessment: TCL直接学习区域-文本对齐，解决了训练-测试不一致问题，统一评估协议对领域有规范意义。
2212.00785|v2.contribution: 提出TCL框架直接学习区域-文本对齐，并建立统一评估协议。
2212.00785|v2.innovation: 通过生成掩码并提取文本接地嵌入进行对比学习，实现区域级对齐。
2212.00785|v2.result: 在8个语义分割数据集上验证，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.14038|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言预训练（VLP）训练成本高、收敛慢的问题，指出掩码语言建模（MLM）中预测率与破坏率耦合导致大量输出token被排除在损失之外。提出自由语言建模（FLM），实现100%预测率与任意破坏率解耦，并允许为每个待预测token定制破坏跨度。相比MLM方法，FLM在相同GPU时间下可灵活利用双向上下文，预训练时间减少2.5倍，同时保持下游性能。
2303.14038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and slow convergence of vision-language pretraining (VLP), identifying the entanglement between prediction rate and corruption rate in masked language modeling (MLM) as a key bottleneck. It proposes Free Language Modeling (FLM), which decouples the prediction rate from the corruption rate, enabling 100% prediction rate with arbitrary corruption rates and customized corruption spans per token. FLM achieves a 2.5x reduction in pretraining time compared to MLM-based methods while maintaining competitive downstream performance.
2303.14038|v2.assessment: 该工作从训练效率角度切入VLP，提出的FLM任务设计简洁有效，2.5倍加速对大规模预训练有实际价值，值得关注。
2303.14038|v2.contribution: 提出FLM预训练任务，解耦预测率与破坏率，实现100%预测率下的高效VLP。
2303.14038|v2.innovation: 通过自由破坏跨度与全token预测，打破MLM中预测率与破坏率的绑定。
2303.14038|v2.result: 相比MLM方法预训练时间减少2.5倍，同时保持下游任务性能。

2211.10277|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）在下游任务高效迁移时，现有方法（如prompt tuning丢弃预训练文本分类器、adapter tuning过度依赖预训练特征）破坏或过度偏向先验知识的问题。提出Task Residual Tuning（TaskRes），直接在文本分类器上操作，冻结原始分类器权重，通过调优一组与先验无关的残差参数获得新分类器，显式解耦先验知识与任务特定知识。该方法在保持可靠先验知识的同时灵活利用任务知识，提升了少数据下游任务的迁移性能。
2211.10277|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that existing efficient transfer learning methods for large vision-language models either damage or are excessively biased towards pre-trained prior knowledge. It proposes Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes), which operates directly on the text-based classifier by freezing the original weights and tuning a set of prior-independent residual parameters to form a new classifier, explicitly decoupling prior and task-specific knowledge. TaskRes achieves reliable prior preservation and flexible task adaptation, improving transfer performance on downstream tasks with limited data.
2211.10277|v2.assessment: TaskRes以简洁的残差形式解耦先验与任务知识，思路清晰，对VLM高效迁移有实用价值，值得关注。
2211.10277|v2.contribution: 提出TaskRes，通过文本分类器上的残差调优实现VLM先验知识与任务知识的解耦。
2211.10277|v2.innovation: 在冻结原始分类器的基础上学习先验无关的残差参数，兼顾先验保持与任务适应。
2211.10277|v2.result: 在有限数据下游任务上取得优于prompt tuning和adapter tuning的迁移性能。

2303.15786|v2.summary_cn: 针对人-物交互（HOI）检测中利用CLIP知识蒸馏的方法依赖大规模训练数据、在少样本/零样本场景下性能不佳的问题。提出HOICLIP框架，通过交互解码器以交叉注意力从CLIP视觉特征图中提取信息区域，并经知识集成块与检测骨干融合；利用CLIP文本编码器嵌入HOI描述生成分类器，并通过视觉语义算术和轻量动词表示适配器构建动词分类器，还提出免训练增强利用全局HOI预测。该方法高效提取CLIP先验知识，在少样本/零样本场景下取得更好的泛化性能。
2303.15786|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on large-scale training data and poor few/zero-shot performance of CLIP-based knowledge distillation methods for human-object interaction (HOI) detection. It proposes HOICLIP, which uses an interaction decoder with cross-attention to extract informative regions from CLIP visual features and fuses them with the detection backbone via a knowledge integration block, while leveraging CLIP text encoder to generate classifiers from HOI descriptions and building a verb classifier via visual semantic arithmetic and a lightweight adapter. HOICLIP efficiently extracts CLIP priors and achieves better generalization in few/zero-shot scenarios.
2303.15786|v2.assessment: HOICLIP将CLIP先验高效融入HOI检测，在少样本/零样本场景下表现突出，对多模态感知有参考价值。
2303.15786|v2.contribution: 提出HOICLIP框架，高效利用CLIP先验知识提升HOI检测的泛化能力。
2303.15786|v2.innovation: 交互解码器与知识集成块融合CLIP视觉特征，结合文本嵌入分类器和免训练增强。
2303.15786|v2.result: 在少样本/零样本HOI检测场景下取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。

2303.10431|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）因训练数据中身份群体分布偏斜而产生社会偏见，导致特定文本概念与不同身份群体图像的相似度偏斜，限制其在现实高风险应用中的可用性。提出DeAR（Debiasing with Additive Residuals），学习加性残差图像表示以偏移原始表示，确保公平的输出表示，降低表示区分不同身份群体的能力。同时指出现有公平性测试局限于有限人脸数据集，引入Protected Attribute Tag Association进行更全面评估。
2303.10431|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses societal biases in large vision-language models (VLMs) caused by skewed identity group distributions in training data, which manifest as biased similarities between text concepts and images of different identity groups. It proposes DeAR (Debiasing with Additive Residuals), which learns additive residual image representations to offset original representations and ensure fair outputs by reducing the ability to distinguish identity groups. It also introduces the Protected Attribute Tag Association to better evaluate DeAR beyond limited face image datasets.
2303.10431|v2.assessment: DeAR从表示层面解决VLM偏见问题，方法新颖且提出新的评估基准，对VLM公平性研究有参考价值，但与用户核心感知领域相关度较低。
2303.10431|v2.contribution: 提出DeAR去偏方法及Protected Attribute Tag Association评估基准。
2303.10431|v2.innovation: 通过学习加性残差图像表示来偏移原始表示，降低身份群体区分度。
2303.10431|v2.result: 在减少VLM身份偏见方面有效，并提供了更全面的公平性评估。

THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在自由形式生成中产生物体幻觉、缺乏系统性评估基准的问题，本文提出了 THRONE，一个基于物体的幻觉基准。该方法通过将生成文本中的物体与图像中真实存在的物体进行匹配，构建了包含多种任务（如开放式描述、VQA）的评估框架，并引入人工标注验证。相比已有基准，THRONE 更关注自由生成场景下的物体级幻觉，覆盖更广泛的模型输出形式。实验揭示了当前先进 LVLM 在物体幻觉上的显著缺陷，为后续改进提供了量化依据。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_en: To address the lack of systematic benchmarks for object hallucination in free-form generations of large vision-language models (LVLMs), this paper introduces THRONE, an object-based hallucination benchmark. It matches objects in generated text against ground-truth objects in images across multiple tasks such as open-ended captioning and VQA, with human-annotated validation. Compared to existing benchmarks, THRONE focuses on object-level hallucination in free-form generation and covers broader output formats. Experiments reveal significant deficiencies of state-of-the-art LVLMs in object hallucination, providing a quantitative basis for future improvements.
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.assessment: 该基准填补了 LVLM 自由生成中物体幻觉评估的空白，对多模态理解与安全应用有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.contribution: 提出了首个针对 LVLM 自由形式生成的物体级幻觉基准 THRONE。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.innovation: 将幻觉评估从受限任务扩展到开放式生成，并实现物体级细粒度匹配。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.result: 揭示了当前先进 LVLM 在物体幻觉上的显著不足，为模型改进提供了量化标准。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be._arxiv_id: THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Benchmark for the Free-Form Generations of Large Vision-Language Models.

VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）知识编辑缺乏统一评估基准的问题，本文提出了 VLKEB，一个面向 LVLM 的知识编辑基准。该基准构建了包含多种编辑类型（如事实更新、关系修改）和评估指标（如编辑成功率、泛化性、局部性）的测试集，覆盖图像-文本问答场景。相比已有文本知识编辑基准，VLKEB 首次系统评估了多模态知识编辑的效果。实验表明现有编辑方法在 LVLM 上仍面临泛化与局部性之间的权衡挑战。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_en: To address the lack of a unified benchmark for knowledge editing in large vision-language models (LVLMs), this paper proposes VLKEB, a large vision-language model knowledge editing benchmark. It constructs a test suite covering multiple edit types (e.g., fact update, relation modification) and evaluation metrics (e.g., edit success, generalization, locality) in image-text QA scenarios. Unlike existing text-only knowledge editing benchmarks, VLKEB is the first to systematically evaluate multimodal knowledge editing. Experiments show that current editing methods still face a trade-off between generalization and locality on LVLMs.
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.assessment: 该基准为多模态知识编辑提供了标准化评估平台，对 VLM 的可控更新有推动作用，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.contribution: 提出了首个面向大型视觉语言模型的知识编辑基准 VLKEB。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.innovation: 将知识编辑评估从纯文本扩展到多模态图像-文本场景，并设计多维度指标。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.result: 揭示了现有编辑方法在 LVLM 上泛化性与局部性难以兼顾的问题。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno._arxiv_id: VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Knowledge Editing Benchmark.

ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多轮对话评估中缺乏细粒度能力诊断的问题，本文提出了 ConvBench，一个具有分层消融能力的多轮对话评估基准。该基准设计了多轮交互场景，并通过分层消融（如移除历史轮次、替换图像）来定位模型在感知、推理、记忆等维度的失败原因。相比已有单轮或粗粒度评估，ConvBench 能更精确地诊断多轮对话中的能力瓶颈。实验对多个先进 LVLM 进行了评估，揭示了其在长程多轮交互中的显著性能下降。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_en: To address the lack of fine-grained capability diagnosis in multi-turn conversation evaluation for large vision-language models (LVLMs), this paper introduces ConvBench, a multi-turn conversation evaluation benchmark with hierarchical ablation capability. It designs multi-turn interaction scenarios and employs hierarchical ablations (e.g., removing history turns, replacing images) to localize failure causes across perception, reasoning, and memory dimensions. Unlike existing single-turn or coarse-grained evaluations, ConvBench enables more precise diagnosis of capability bottlenecks in multi-turn conversations. Experiments on several advanced LVLMs reveal significant performance degradation in long-horizon multi-turn interactions.
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.assessment: 该基准通过分层消融提升了多轮对话评估的可解释性，对 VLM 交互能力研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务距离较远。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.contribution: 提出了具有分层消融能力的多轮对话评估基准 ConvBench。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.innovation: 引入分层消融机制以细粒度诊断 LVLM 在多轮对话中的能力缺陷。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.result: 揭示了先进 LVLM 在长程多轮交互中性能显著下降的问题。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva._arxiv_id: ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark with Hierarchical Ablation Capability for Large Vision-Language Models.

2408.16176|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）能否在无需微调的情况下辅助生物学家进行物种性状发现的问题，本文构建了 VLM4Bio 基准数据集，包含 469K 问答对和 30K 图像，覆盖鱼类、鸟类和蝴蝶三类生物的五种生物学相关任务。研究评估了 12 个先进 VLM，并探索了提示工程和推理幻觉的影响。相比已有 VLM 评估，该工作首次系统检验了 VLM 在生物图像性状发现中的能力。实验揭示了当前 VLM 在细粒度生物性状识别上的局限，为领域应用提供了基线。
2408.16176|v2.summary_en: To investigate whether pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) can assist biologists in trait discovery without additional fine-tuning, this paper constructs VLM4Bio, a benchmark dataset comprising 469K question-answer pairs and 30K images across fishes, birds, and butterflies, covering five biologically relevant tasks. It evaluates 12 state-of-the-art VLMs and explores the effects of prompting techniques and reasoning hallucination. Unlike prior VLM evaluations, this work is the first to systematically examine VLM capabilities in biological image trait discovery. Experiments reveal limitations of current VLMs in fine-grained biological trait recognition, providing a baseline for domain applications.
2408.16176|v2.assessment: 该基准为 VLM 在生物领域的应用提供了大规模评估，对跨领域多模态研究有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知任务几乎无关。
2408.16176|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模生物图像 VLM 评估基准 VLM4Bio，涵盖三类生物和五种任务。
2408.16176|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估预训练 VLM 在生物性状发现中的零样本能力，并分析提示与幻觉影响。
2408.16176|v2.result: 揭示了当前 VLM 在细粒度生物性状识别上的显著局限，提供了领域基线。

Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割需要额外训练或复杂流程的问题，本文提出了一种从现成视觉语言模型（VLM）中涌现开放词汇语义分割能力的方法。该方法利用预训练 VLM 的图文对齐能力，通过简单的提示和特征匹配实现无需额外训练的开放词汇分割。相比已有需要微调或专门设计的开放词汇分割方法，该工作展示了 VLM 本身蕴含的分割能力。实验在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了有竞争力的零样本性能，验证了方法的有效性。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_en: To address the need for additional training or complex pipelines in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, this paper proposes a method that elicits emergent open-vocabulary semantic segmentation from off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs). It leverages the image-text alignment of pre-trained VLMs and achieves training-free open-vocabulary segmentation via simple prompting and feature matching. Unlike existing methods requiring fine-tuning or specialized designs, this work demonstrates the inherent segmentation capability of VLMs. Experiments on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks show competitive zero-shot performance, validating the effectiveness of the approach.
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.assessment: 该工作展示了 VLM 在开放词汇分割中的零样本潜力，对开放集感知和分割研究有启发，与自动驾驶中的开放世界感知有一定关联。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.contribution: 提出了一种无需额外训练、从现成 VLM 中涌现开放词汇语义分割的方法。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.innovation: 利用预训练 VLM 的图文对齐能力实现零样本开放词汇分割，无需微调。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了有竞争力的零样本性能。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen._arxiv_id: Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation from Off-the-Shelf Vision-Language Models.

Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_cn: 针对零样本开放词汇 3D 视觉定位（3D visual grounding）中缺乏 3D 标注和开放词汇泛化的问题，本文提出了视觉编程（Visual Programming）框架。该方法将 3D 视觉定位分解为一系列可解释的视觉子任务（如 2D 检测、深度估计、语言解析），通过组合现成的 2D 视觉语言模型和几何模块实现零样本 3D 定位。相比已有需要 3D 标注训练的方法，该框架无需 3D 监督即可泛化到新类别。实验在多个 3D 视觉定位基准上取得了显著的零样本性能提升。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_en: To address the lack of 3D annotations and open-vocabulary generalization in zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding, this paper proposes a visual programming framework. It decomposes 3D visual grounding into a series of interpretable visual sub-tasks (e.g., 2D detection, depth estimation, language parsing) and composes off-the-shelf 2D vision-language models with geometric modules to achieve zero-shot 3D grounding. Unlike existing methods requiring 3D-annotated training, this framework generalizes to novel categories without 3D supervision. Experiments on multiple 3D visual grounding benchmarks show significant zero-shot performance improvements.
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.assessment: 该工作将视觉编程引入 3D 视觉定位，实现了零样本开放词汇能力，对自动驾驶中的 3D 场景理解与语言交互有潜在价值。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.contribution: 提出了基于视觉编程的零样本开放词汇 3D 视觉定位框架。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.innovation: 将 3D 定位分解为可解释子任务并组合现成 2D VLM 与几何模块，无需 3D 监督。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.result: 在多个 3D 视觉定位基准上取得了显著的零样本性能提升。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo._arxiv_id: Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding.

DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_cn: 针对开放世界少样本学习（OW-FSL）中CLIP因图文对齐偏差导致基类与新类性能难以兼顾的问题，本文提出DeIL（Direct-and-Inverse CLIP）框架。方法上通过直接分支与逆分支的双向提示学习，缓解CLIP在少样本场景下的语义鸿沟与预测偏置。相比已有仅单向调优CLIP的工作，DeIL在保持基类性能的同时显著提升新类泛化能力。在多个OW-FSL基准上取得领先结果，验证了双向对齐策略的有效性。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_en: This paper addresses the base-novel trade-off in open-world few-shot learning (OW-FSL) caused by the modality gap in CLIP. It proposes DeIL, a Direct-and-Inverse CLIP framework that performs bidirectional prompt learning to mitigate semantic misalignment and prediction bias. Compared with prior single-direction CLIP tuning, DeIL improves novel-class generalization while preserving base-class performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple OW-FSL benchmarks.
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.assessment: 对开放集/少样本识别方向有参考价值，双向对齐思路可迁移到检测中的开放词汇设定。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.contribution: 提出直接-逆双向CLIP提示学习框架以平衡基类与新类性能。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.innovation: 用逆分支补偿CLIP图文对齐偏差，实现双向语义校准。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.result: 在多个OW-FSL基准上取得领先精度，兼顾基类与新类。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W._arxiv_id: DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-World Few-Shot Learning.

Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉语言模型（VLM）视觉编码器与语言模型耦合不足、视觉表征能力受限的问题，本文提出受视觉机理启发的VLM架构改进方案。方法上重新设计视觉-语言交互模块，强化视觉特征的层次化与语义对齐。相比主流VLM，该工作在多项视觉理解任务上提升了细粒度感知能力。实验表明在多个基准上取得一致增益，验证了视觉先验注入的有效性。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_en: This paper targets the limited visual representation and weak vision-language coupling in existing VLMs. It proposes a vision-inspired architecture that redesigns the visual-language interaction to enhance hierarchical and semantically aligned visual features. Compared with mainstream VLMs, it improves fine-grained visual understanding and yields consistent gains across multiple benchmarks.
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.assessment: 对VLM架构设计有启发，视觉先验注入思路对多模态感知有借鉴意义。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.contribution: 提出视觉机理启发的VLM架构以增强视觉-语言对齐。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.innovation: 将视觉层次化先验引入VLM的视觉-语言交互模块。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.result: 在多项视觉理解基准上取得一致性能提升。

DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）与人类意图对齐不足、交互能力弱的问题，本文提出DRESS框架，利用自然语言反馈进行对齐与交互训练。方法上构建基于人类反馈的指令数据与训练策略，使模型能理解并响应细粒度语言反馈。相比传统RLHF式对齐，DRESS更侧重自然语言反馈的直接利用。实验显示在对话与指令遵循任务上显著提升，增强了模型与人类交互的可靠性。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the weak alignment and interaction of large vision-language models (LVLMs) with human intent. It proposes DRESS, a framework that leverages natural language feedback for alignment and interaction training. Compared with conventional RLHF-style alignment, DRESS directly exploits language feedback, yielding significant improvements in dialogue and instruction-following tasks.
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.assessment: 对VLM对齐与交互方向有价值，自然语言反馈范式可迁移到自动驾驶人机交互。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.contribution: 提出基于自然语言反馈的LVLM对齐与交互框架DRESS。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.innovation: 以自然语言反馈替代传统标量奖励进行对齐训练。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.result: 在对话与指令遵循任务上显著提升交互可靠性。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Language Models to Align and Interact with Humans via Natural Language Feedback.

Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中语言幻觉与视觉错觉相互纠缠、缺乏系统诊断工具的问题，本文提出HallusionBench诊断套件。方法上设计成对的视觉-语言测试样例，分离并量化语言幻觉与视觉错觉两类失败模式。相比已有零散评测，HallusionBench提供了更细粒度、可复现的幻觉诊断基准。实验揭示当前主流LVLM在纠缠幻觉上仍存在显著缺陷，为后续改进提供明确方向。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_en: This paper targets the entangled language hallucination and visual illusion in large vision-language models (LVLMs), which lack systematic diagnostics. It introduces HallusionBench, a diagnostic suite with paired visual-language test cases that disentangle and quantify the two failure modes. Compared with prior scattered evaluations, it offers fine-grained and reproducible hallucination diagnosis, revealing substantial deficiencies in current LVLMs.
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.assessment: 幻觉诊断基准对VLM可靠性评估很重要，对自动驾驶中VLM安全部署有警示意义。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.contribution: 提出分离语言幻觉与视觉错觉的HallusionBench诊断套件。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.innovation: 用成对测试样例解耦并量化两类幻觉失败模式。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.result: 揭示主流LVLM在纠缠幻觉上的显著缺陷。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S._arxiv_id: Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic Suite for Entangled Language Hallucination and Visual Illusion in Large Vision-Language Models.

Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在下游任务适配中依赖梯度优化、难以在黑盒条件下调优的问题，本文提出将语言模型作为黑盒优化器来优化VLM。方法上利用LLM生成并迭代候选提示/参数，无需访问VLM内部梯度即可完成适配。相比传统微调与白盒提示学习，该方法在仅黑盒访问下仍具竞争力。实验在多项视觉语言任务上验证了黑盒优化的有效性。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of adapting vision-language models (VLMs) under black-box conditions where gradients are unavailable. It proposes using language models as black-box optimizers to iteratively generate and refine prompts/parameters for VLM adaptation. Compared with fine-tuning and white-box prompt learning, it remains competitive with only black-box access, validated across multiple vision-language tasks.
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.assessment: 黑盒优化思路对无法访问模型内部的部署场景有实用价值。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.contribution: 提出以语言模型作为黑盒优化器适配VLM。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.innovation: 用LLM迭代生成候选实现无梯度VLM优化。

Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_cn: 针对从视觉内容自动生成匹配音效、实现视听一致的问题，本文提出Sonic VisionLM，利用视觉语言模型为视频生成声音。方法上借助VLM理解视觉语义并驱动音频生成，实现跨模态的音效合成。相比传统音视频生成方法，该工作更强调语义级视听对齐。实验表明生成音效在语义匹配度上表现良好，拓展了VLM在跨模态生成中的应用。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_en: This paper targets automatic sound generation from visual content with audio-visual consistency. It proposes Sonic VisionLM, which leverages vision-language models to understand visual semantics and drive audio synthesis. Compared with conventional audio-visual generation methods, it emphasizes semantic-level alignment, achieving good semantic matching and extending VLM applications to cross-modal generation.
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.assessment: 跨模态生成方向有趣，但对自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度较低。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.contribution: 提出利用VLM为视频生成语义一致音效的Sonic VisionLM。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.innovation: 以VLM语义理解驱动跨模态音效合成。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.result: 生成音效在语义匹配度上表现良好。

2412.09082|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉语言导航（VLN）方法主要针对单阶段导航，难以应对复杂动态环境中的多阶段长时程任务。本文提出长时程视觉语言导航（LH-VLN）新任务，强调跨连续子任务的长期规划与决策一致性，并开发了自动化数据生成平台 NavGen，通过双向多粒度生成构建复杂任务结构的数据集。作者构建了 LHPR-VLN 基准，包含 3,260 个任务、平均 150 个任务步骤，是首个专为长时程 VLN 设计的数据集，并提出 ISR、CSR、CGT 等细粒度评估指标。该工作为长时程 VLN 提供了平台、基准与评估体系，但方法部分摘要未完整给出。
2412.09082|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) methods focus on single-stage navigation, limiting effectiveness in multi-stage, long-horizon tasks in complex dynamic environments. This paper proposes Long-Horizon VLN (LH-VLN), an automated data generation platform NavGen, and the LHPR-VLN benchmark with 3,260 tasks averaging 150 steps, along with ISR, CSR, and CGT metrics for fine-grained evaluation. It provides the first dedicated platform and benchmark for long-horizon VLN, though the methodological details are only partially described.
2412.09082|v2.assessment: 面向长时程 VLN 的任务定义与基准构建工作，对具身导航与 VLM 交叉方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
2412.09082|v2.contribution: 提出长时程视觉语言导航任务、自动化数据生成平台 NavGen 及首个长时程 VLN 基准 LHPR-VLN。
2412.09082|v2.innovation: 通过双向多粒度生成构建复杂任务结构数据，并引入 ISR/CSR/CGT 细粒度评估指标。
2412.09082|v2.result: 构建了含 3,260 个任务、平均 150 步的基准，为长时程 VLN 提供统一评估平台。

2411.00836|v2.summary_cn: 论文关注 VLM 在视觉数学推理中的鲁棒性问题：与人类可对相似问题稳定复用解题步骤不同，GPT-4o 等 SOTA VLM 在问题轻微变体（如视觉数值或函数图像变化）下会持续失败。现有视觉数学基准仅含静态题目集，难以评估推理鲁棒性。为此作者提出 DynaMath，一个动态视觉数学基准，包含 501 个高质量多主题种子问题，每个以 Python 程序表示，可自动生成大量具体变体题目，从而系统评估 VLM 的数学推理鲁棒性。
2411.00836|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the robustness of mathematical reasoning in VLMs, showing that SOTA models like GPT-4o consistently fail on minor variants of the same question. Existing vision-based math benchmarks are static and cannot assess robustness. The authors introduce DynaMath, a dynamic visual math benchmark with 501 multi-topic seed questions represented as Python programs that automatically generate large sets of concrete variants.
2411.00836|v2.assessment: 针对 VLM 推理鲁棒性提出动态基准，评测视角有价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2411.00836|v2.contribution: 提出动态视觉数学基准 DynaMath，用于评估 VLM 数学推理的鲁棒性。
2411.00836|v2.innovation: 以 Python 程序化种子问题自动生成大量变体，突破静态基准无法评估鲁棒性的局限。
2411.00836|v2.result: 构建含 501 个多主题种子问题的动态基准，揭示 SOTA VLM 在问题变体下的一致失败。

2306.13394|v2.summary_cn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）展现出惊人涌现能力，但现有案例研究难以全面反映其性能，缺乏综合评估。本文提出首个全面的 MLLM 评测基准 MME，覆盖感知与认知两大类共 14 个子任务。为避免直接使用公开数据集导致的数据泄漏，所有指令-答案对标注均人工设计，简洁的指令设计使模型间可公平比较而无需复杂 prompt 工程，并便于定量统计。作者在 MME 上综合评估了 30 个先进 MLLM，表明现有模型仍有较大提升空间，并揭示了后续优化方向。
2306.13394|v2.summary_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show emergent abilities, but case studies cannot fully reflect their performance due to the lack of comprehensive evaluation. This paper presents MME, the first comprehensive MLLM evaluation benchmark covering 14 perception and cognition subtasks with manually designed instruction-answer pairs to avoid data leakage. Evaluating 30 advanced MLLMs reveals substantial room for improvement and potential optimization directions.
2306.13394|v2.assessment: 作为早期综合性 MLLM 评测基准，影响力较大，对多模态模型评估有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接关联有限。
2306.13394|v2.contribution: 提出首个覆盖感知与认知共 14 个子任务的综合 MLLM 评测基准 MME。
2306.13394|v2.innovation: 人工设计指令-答案对避免数据泄漏，简洁指令设计实现公平比较与定量统计。
2306.13394|v2.result: 在 MME 上评估 30 个先进 MLLM，揭示现有模型仍有较大提升空间。

2510.21679|v2.summary_cn: 针对石油天然气企业公关广告中潜在'漂绿'行为难以大规模识别的问题，论文构建了一个由专家标注的Facebook与YouTube视频广告基准数据集，覆盖20个国家50余家公司/倡导组织的13种框架类型。该数据集专为视觉语言模型（VLM）评估设计，区别于以往纯文本框架数据集。基线实验显示GPT-4.1检测环境信息的F1为79%，而最佳模型在识别'绿色创新'框架上仅达46% F1，并指出隐式框架、变长视频处理等VLM待解决的挑战。
2510.21679|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces an expert-annotated benchmark of video ads from Facebook and YouTube to study framing and potential greenwashing by oil & gas companies, covering 13 framing types across 50+ organizations in 20 countries. Designed for vision-language model evaluation, it differs from prior text-only framing datasets. Baselines show GPT-4.1 reaches 79% F1 on environmental message detection while the best model achieves only 46% F1 on green-innovation framing, highlighting challenges such as implicit framing and variable-length videos.
2510.21679|v2.assessment: 属于NLP/多模态社会应用方向，与自动驾驶感知无关，但作为VLM评估基准对多模态研究者有参考价值。
2510.21679|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向视频广告框架与漂绿检测的多模态专家标注基准数据集。
2510.21679|v2.innovation: 将框架分析从纯文本扩展到视频多模态，并针对VLM设计评估协议。
2510.21679|v2.result: GPT-4.1环境信息检测F1达79%，最佳模型绿色创新框架识别仅46% F1。

2507.11932|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型基准主要评估被动视觉感知、缺乏对内部心理可视化能力考察的问题，论文提出Hyperphantasia合成基准，通过四类程序化生成的谜题、每类三个难度等级来评估MLLM的心理可视化能力。实验表明当前最先进模型与人类表现存在显著差距，并探讨了提升该能力的潜在方法。
2507.11932|v2.summary_en: To address the gap that existing MLLM benchmarks mainly assess passive visual perception rather than internal mental visualization, this paper introduces Hyperphantasia, a synthetic benchmark with four procedurally generated puzzles at three difficulty levels. Evaluations reveal a substantial gap between state-of-the-art MLLMs and humans, and the authors explore potential approaches to improve this capability.
2507.11932|v2.assessment: 对MLLM认知能力评估有启发，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2507.11932|v2.contribution: 提出首个评估MLLM心理可视化能力的合成基准。
2507.11932|v2.innovation: 用程序化生成的多难度谜题系统化考察模型的内部视觉构建能力。
2507.11932|v2.result: 揭示当前MLLM与人类在心理可视化任务上存在显著性能差距。

2505.19028|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VQA基准缺乏配对普通图表与视觉元素问题、难以评估MLLM对信息图理解能力的问题，论文提出InfoChartQA基准，包含5,642对信息图与普通图表（共享底层数据但视觉呈现不同），并设计基于视觉元素的问题以捕捉独特设计意图。对20个MLLM的评估显示其在信息图上性能显著下降，尤其是涉及隐喻的视觉元素问题，配对设计支持细粒度错误分析与消融研究。
2505.19028|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of paired plain and infographic charts in existing VQA benchmarks, this paper introduces InfoChartQA with 5,642 infographic-plain chart pairs sharing identical data but differing in visual presentation, plus visual-element-based questions. Evaluation of 20 MLLMs shows substantial performance drops on infographics, especially metaphor-related questions, with the paired design enabling fine-grained error analysis.
2505.19028|v2.assessment: 对多模态图表理解评估有贡献，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域相关性低。
2505.19028|v2.contribution: 构建了配对信息图与普通图表的MLLM评估基准InfoChartQA。
2505.19028|v2.innovation: 通过配对图表与视觉元素问题实现细粒度错误归因分析。
2505.19028|v2.result: 20个MLLM在信息图上性能显著下降，隐喻类视觉元素问题尤为明显。

2504.16427|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在认知级语义理解能力上缺乏系统评估的问题，论文提出MMLA基准，包含来自舞台与真实场景的61K+多模态话语，覆盖意图、情感、对话行为、情绪、说话风格与交流行为六个核心维度。对八类主流LLM/MLLM采用零样本、监督微调和指令微调三种方式评估，结果显示即使微调模型也仅达60%~70%准确率，凸显当前MLLM理解复杂人类语言的局限。
2504.16427|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of systematic evaluation of MLLMs on cognitive-level multimodal semantics, this paper introduces MMLA, a benchmark of over 61K multimodal utterances covering six dimensions: intent, emotion, dialogue act, sentiment, speaking style, and communication behavior. Evaluating eight LLM/MLLM branches under zero-shot, SFT, and instruction tuning, even fine-tuned models reach only 60-70% accuracy, underscoring limitations in understanding complex human language.
2504.16427|v2.assessment: 对多模态语言理解评估有价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2504.16427|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖六维认知语义的大规模多模态语言分析基准MMLA。
2504.16427|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估MLLM在认知级多模态语义理解上的能力。
2504.16427|v2.result: 即使微调后模型准确率也仅60%~70%，暴露MLLM理解复杂语言的不足。

2507.18342|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM在跨第一人称与第三人称视角推理能力上尚未被探索的问题，论文提出EgoExoBench，这是首个面向自我中心-外中心视频理解与推理的基准，包含7,300+问答对、11个子任务，分为语义对齐、视角关联和时间推理三大核心挑战。对13个最先进MLLM的评估显示，模型在单视角任务上表现优异，但在跨视角语义对齐、视角关联和时间动态推理上表现挣扎。
2507.18342|v2.summary_en: To explore MLLMs' cross-view reasoning between egocentric and exocentric perspectives, this paper introduces EgoExoBench, the first benchmark for ego-exo video understanding with 7,300+ QA pairs across 11 sub-tasks under three challenges: semantic alignment, viewpoint association, and temporal reasoning. Evaluating 13 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows strong single-view performance but poor cross-view alignment, association, and temporal inference.
2507.18342|v2.assessment: 对具身智能与视频理解研究有参考价值，与自动驾驶多视角感知有间接关联。
2507.18342|v2.contribution: 提出首个评估MLLM跨第一/第三人称视角视频理解与推理的基准。
2507.18342|v2.innovation: 系统化设计跨视角语义对齐、关联与时间推理三类挑战任务。
2507.18342|v2.result: 13个MLLM在单视角任务表现优异，但跨视角推理能力明显不足。
