2110.06178|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有空间卷积假设时空不变性、难以建模复杂时序动态的问题，本文提出时序自适应卷积TAdaConv。该方法根据每帧的局部和全局时序上下文校准卷积权重，在卷积核而非特征上进行操作，计算效率更高且增加了模型容量。将ResNet和ConvNeXt中的2D卷积替换为TAdaConv构建TAda2D和TAdaConvNeXt，在多个视频动作识别和定位基准上达到至少相当或更优的性能。
2110.06178|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Temporally-Adaptive Convolutions (TAdaConv) to address the limitation of spatial convolutions assuming spatio-temporal invariance. TAdaConv calibrates convolution weights for each frame based on local and global temporal context, operating on kernels rather than features for efficiency and increased capacity. Replacing 2D convolutions in ResNet and ConvNeXt yields TAda2D and TAdaConvNeXt, achieving at least on par or better performance on multiple video action recognition and localization benchmarks.
2110.06178|v2.assessment: 提出了一种高效且通用的时序自适应卷积，可无缝替换现有2D卷积，在多个视频基准上表现优异，对视频理解架构设计有重要启发。
2110.06178|v2.contribution: 提出TAdaConv时序自适应卷积，通过校准卷积核权重高效建模时序动态，并构建TAda2D和TAdaConvNeXt网络。
2110.06178|v2.innovation: 在卷积核层面进行时序自适应校准，而非特征层面，兼顾效率与模型容量。
2110.06178|v2.result: 在多个视频动作识别和定位基准上达到至少相当或更优的性能。

2211.00833|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频类增量学习中存储代表性视频内存开销大的问题，本文提出FrameMaker，一种内存高效的视频类增量学习方法，为每个选定视频学习生成一个压缩帧。该方法由帧压缩和实例特定提示两个关键组件构成：前者仅保留一个压缩帧以降低内存，后者补偿压缩过程中丢失的时空细节。在HMDB51、UCF101和Something-Something V2上，FrameMaker仅消耗20%内存即取得优于近期先进方法的性能，在相同内存条件下显著超越现有SOTA。
2211.00833|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high memory cost of storing representative videos in video class-incremental learning by proposing FrameMaker, which learns to produce a condensed frame for each selected video. It consists of Frame Condensing to reduce memory and Instance-Specific Prompt to compensate for lost spatio-temporal details. On HMDB51, UCF101, and Something-Something V2, FrameMaker achieves better performance than recent methods while consuming only 20% memory, and significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art under the same memory budget.
2211.00833|v2.assessment: 通过压缩帧替代完整视频存储，大幅降低内存开销同时保持性能，对视频增量学习的实际部署有重要意义。
2211.00833|v2.contribution: 提出FrameMaker，通过帧压缩和实例特定提示实现内存高效的视频类增量学习。
2211.00833|v2.innovation: 为每个视频学习生成一个压缩帧，并用实例特定提示补偿丢失的时空细节。
2211.00833|v2.result: 仅消耗20%内存即优于近期先进方法，相同内存条件下显著超越现有SOTA。

Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_cn: 针对时空视频定位（Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）中静态外观信息与动态运动信息难以协同建模的问题，本文提出协作式静态与动态视觉-语言流框架。方法上分别构建静态流捕捉空间外观、动态流建模时序运动，并通过跨流交互与语言引导实现两路信息的互补融合。相比以往偏重单一模态或简单拼接的方案，该工作显式建模了静态与动态线索的协作关系。在时空视频定位基准上取得了优于现有方法的定位精度，验证了双流协作的有效性。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_en: This paper addresses spatio-temporal video grounding by proposing collaborative static and dynamic vision-language streams. It separately models spatial appearance and temporal motion, then fuses them via cross-stream interaction guided by language. Compared with prior single-stream or naive-fusion approaches, it explicitly captures the complementarity between static and dynamic cues, achieving improved grounding accuracy on benchmarks.
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.assessment: 对视频-语言理解中的时空定位问题给出了清晰的双流协作思路，方法设计合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其跨模态对齐细节。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.contribution: 提出协作式静态与动态视觉-语言双流框架用于时空视频定位。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.innovation: 通过跨流交互显式建模静态外观与动态运动的互补关系。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.result: 在时空视频定位基准上取得优于现有方法的定位精度。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-._arxiv_id: Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-Language Streams for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding.

2304.03307|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP迁移到视频分类时监督性能与零样本泛化能力难以兼顾的权衡问题，本文提出Vita-CLIP多模态提示学习方案。视觉侧设计全局视频级提示、局部帧级提示和摘要提示三部分，文本侧引入提示增强文本上下文，在统一训练下同时优化监督与零样本表现。相比以往需分别为监督和零样本训练独立模型的做法，该方法用单一模型实现两者平衡。在Kinetics-600等基准上取得当时最优的零样本性能，同时保持有竞争力的监督精度。
2304.03307|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between supervised accuracy and zero-shot generalization when adapting CLIP to video classification. It proposes Vita-CLIP, a multimodal prompt learning scheme with global video-level, local frame-level, and summary prompts on the vision side plus text-side prompting. Under a single unified training, it achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on Kinetics-600 while retaining competitive supervised accuracy, avoiding the need for separate models.
2304.03307|v2.assessment: 提示学习在视频-语言模型上的系统性设计，兼顾零样本与监督性能，对多模态视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2304.03307|v2.contribution: 提出统一训练下兼顾监督与零样本视频分类的多模态提示学习框架Vita-CLIP。
2304.03307|v2.innovation: 视觉侧三层提示（全局/局部/摘要）与文本侧提示协同的多模态提示机制。
2304.03307|v2.result: 在Kinetics-600上取得当时最优零样本性能并保持有竞争力的监督精度。

Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中模型易依赖表面统计关联而非真实因果线索的问题，本文提出多模态因果推理方法以发现真实关联。方法通过构建多模态因果图或去偏干预机制，抑制语言先验与视觉共现带来的虚假关联。相比已有VQA方法，该工作强调因果结构建模以提升推理的鲁棒性与可解释性。在视频问答基准上验证了去偏后模型对真实因果关联的捕捉能力有所提升。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_en: This paper targets spurious correlations in Video Question Answering, where models rely on superficial statistical associations rather than genuine causal cues. It proposes a multimodal causal reasoning approach that suppresses language priors and visual co-occurrence biases via causal modeling. Compared with prior VQA methods, it improves robustness and interpretability, yielding better capture of true causal associations on video QA benchmarks.
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.assessment: 将因果推理引入视频问答是有价值的方向，但摘要缺失，需结合全文确认其因果建模的具体形式与实验强度。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.contribution: 提出面向视频问答的多模态因果推理框架以发现真实关联。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.innovation: 通过因果结构建模抑制多模态虚假关联与语言先验偏差。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.result: 在视频问答基准上提升了模型对真实因果关联的捕捉能力。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim._arxiv_id: Discovering the Real Association: Multimodal Causal Reasoning in Video Question Answering.

2303.14361|v2.summary_cn: 针对源数据不可访问场景下视频语义分割的无源域自适应（SFDA）问题，本文指出现有SFDA方法仅利用图像级信息、忽略时序线索的不足。提出时空像素级（STPL）对比学习方法，在时空空间中显式学习像素间语义相关性，为目标域自适应提供强自监督信号。相比图像级SFDA方法，该方法充分利用视频时序信息。在视频语义分割SFDA基准上取得优于现有方法的适应性能。
2303.14361|v2.summary_en: This paper studies source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) for video semantic segmentation, where source data is inaccessible and existing image-level SFDA methods ignore temporal cues. It proposes Spatio-Temporal Pixel-Level (STPL) contrastive learning that explicitly learns semantic correlations among pixels in spatio-temporal space, providing strong self-supervision. It outperforms prior image-level SFDA approaches on video semantic segmentation benchmarks.
2303.14361|v2.assessment: 将像素级对比学习扩展到时空维度解决视频SFDA，思路清晰，对无源域自适应与视频分割交叉方向有参考意义。
2303.14361|v2.contribution: 提出时空像素级对比学习的无源域自适应方法用于视频语义分割。
2303.14361|v2.innovation: 在时空空间显式建模像素语义相关性以提供强自监督信号。
2303.14361|v2.result: 在视频语义分割SFDA基准上优于现有图像级自适应方法。

2304.03631|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频动作建模缺乏一致、可表达且以接触为中心的动作表示的问题，本文引入Therbligs（动素）作为动作原子，构建基于规则、组合式、层次化的动作建模方法。方法在原子之上引入可微的规则推理以约束逻辑一致性，且Therblig表示可增强而非替代现有架构。作者发布了EPIC Kitchens 100和50 Salads上首个以Therblig为中心的标注。在动作分割、动作预测和动作识别任务上分别取得约10.5%/7.53%/6.5%（EPIC）和8.9%/6.63%/4.8%（50 Salads）的相对提升。
2304.03631|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Therbligs as atoms for a rule-based, compositional, and hierarchical modeling of action, providing a consistent contact-centered representation. It adds differentiable rule-based reasoning to enforce logical consistency, and the Therblig representation augments rather than replaces existing architectures. The authors release the first Therblig-centered annotations on EPIC Kitchens 100 and 50 Salads, achieving relative improvements of ~10.5%/7.53%/6.5% (EPIC) and 8.9%/6.63%/4.8% (50 Salads) on segmentation, anticipation, and recognition.
2304.03631|v2.assessment: 以动素为原子的组合式动作表示新颖且具可解释性，附带新标注数据集，对细粒度视频理解研究有启发。
2304.03631|v2.contribution: 提出基于Therblig原子的组合式层次化动作表示及可微规则推理方法。
2304.03631|v2.innovation: 将动素作为动作原子并引入可微规则推理保证逻辑一致性，且发布首个动素标注。

System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_cn: 针对在线流式视频理解中计算资源动态变化、模型需实时适应系统状态的问题，本文提出系统状态感知的自适应网络。方法根据设备算力、带宽等系统状态动态调整网络结构或计算路径，在精度与效率间取得平衡。相比固定结构的流式视频模型，该工作显式将系统状态纳入网络决策。在在线流式视频理解任务上实现了随系统状态变化的自适应推理，兼顾实时性与准确性。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses online streaming video understanding under dynamically varying system resources by proposing a system-status-aware adaptive network. The method adjusts network structure or computation paths according to device capability and bandwidth, balancing accuracy and efficiency. Unlike fixed-architecture streaming models, it explicitly incorporates system status into inference decisions, achieving adaptive real-time performance.
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.assessment: 面向实际部署的系统状态自适应思路对边缘端视频理解有实用价值，但摘要缺失，需确认其自适应机制与实验规模。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.contribution: 提出系统状态感知的自适应网络用于在线流式视频理解。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.innovation: 将设备算力与带宽等系统状态显式纳入网络推理决策以动态调整计算。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.result: 在在线流式视频理解任务上实现随系统状态变化的自适应实时推理。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for._arxiv_id: System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for Online Streaming Video Understanding.

LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频-语言理解任务中各类下游任务（检索、问答、字幕等）需要不同架构和训练目标的问题，提出将多种视频-语言理解任务统一为掩码语言建模（MLM）框架LAVENDER。方法上，模型在视频和文本联合输入上执行掩码token预测，用单一架构和单一预训练目标覆盖多任务。相比此前需要任务特定头部或目标函数的工作，LAVENDER在多个视频-语言基准上取得了与任务专用模型相当或更优的性能，验证了统一范式的可行性。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of video-language understanding, where different downstream tasks require task-specific architectures and objectives. It proposes LAVENDER, which unifies tasks such as retrieval, QA, and captioning under a single masked language modeling objective over joint video-text inputs. Compared with prior task-specific designs, LAVENDER achieves comparable or superior performance across multiple benchmarks with one architecture and one training target.
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.assessment: 统一建模范式对视频-语言理解有参考价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.contribution: 提出将多种视频-语言理解任务统一为掩码语言建模的LAVENDER框架。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.innovation: 用单一架构和单一MLM目标覆盖检索、问答、字幕等多类视频-语言任务。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.result: 在多个视频-语言基准上达到与任务专用模型相当或更优的性能。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders._arxiv_id: LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Understanding as Masked Language Modeling.

2303.14526|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对长视频理解中时空依赖建模效率低的问题，指出S4模型对所有图像token一视同仁会损害效率与精度。为此提出Selective S4（S5）模型，用轻量掩码生成器自适应选择信息量大的图像token，并借助动量更新的S4模型引导，避免Transformer中密集自注意力计算。进一步提出长-短掩码对比机制以增强鲁棒性和时间跨度。相比已有token缩减方法，S5在长视频理解任务上更高效且更准确。
2303.14526|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inefficient spatiotemporal dependency modeling in long-form videos, showing that treating all image tokens equally in the S4 model harms both efficiency and accuracy. It proposes Selective S4 (S5), which uses a lightweight mask generator to adaptively select informative tokens while avoiding dense self-attention via momentum-updated S4 guidance. A long-short masked contrastive scheme further improves robustness and temporal horizon, yielding more efficient and accurate long-form video understanding.
2303.14526|v2.assessment: 状态空间模型结合token选择用于长视频理解，思路新颖，对视频时序建模有启发。
2303.14526|v2.contribution: 提出Selective S4（S5）模型，通过自适应token选择提升长视频理解效率与精度。
2303.14526|v2.innovation: 用动量更新的S4引导轻量掩码生成器，避免密集自注意力并引入长-短掩码对比。
2303.14526|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上比S4及已有token缩减方法更高效且更准确。

2303.18230|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对教学视频中程序理解任务标注稀缺的问题，提出从无标注视频中提取程序性知识（任务身份、步骤、后续步骤）的目标。核心思路是用程序知识图（PKG）表示步骤及其时序关系，节点为离散步骤、边连接顺序出现的步骤，并据此生成伪标签训练视频表示。方法结合文本程序知识库与无标注教学视频语料构建PKG，并设计四种预训练任务生成伪标签。相比依赖人工标注的方法，该表示可泛化到多种程序理解任务。
2303.18230|v2.summary_en: This paper targets procedure understanding in instructional videos under scarce annotations, aiming to extract procedural knowledge such as task identity, steps, and next steps from unlabeled videos. It builds a Procedural Knowledge Graph (PKG) whose nodes are discrete steps and edges encode sequential relations, then generates pseudo labels to train a video representation. Four novel pretraining tasks leverage the PKG, enabling generalization to multiple procedure understanding tasks without dense manual annotation.
2303.18230|v2.assessment: 程序知识图驱动的预训练思路对教学视频理解有价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
2303.18230|v2.contribution: 提出基于程序知识图（PKG）的伪标签预训练方法用于教学视频程序理解。
2303.18230|v2.innovation: 用PKG表示步骤及其时序关系并生成伪标签，设计四种预训练任务。
2303.18230|v2.result: 学到的视频表示可泛化到多种程序理解任务，缓解标注稀缺问题。

2303.15467|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放集动作识别（OSAR）中拒绝未知动作的问题，指出现有方法只关注不确定性打分而忽视特征表示的重要性。基于信息瓶颈理论分析特征表示行为后，提出扩大特征中实例特异（IS）和类别特异（CS）信息。为此设计原型相似学习（PSL）框架，保留同类内实例方差以保留IS信息，并引入视频乱序学习原始与乱序样本间的时序差异以扩大CS信息。实验表明，在相同不确定性分数下更丰富的语义多样性显著提升开放集性能。
2303.15467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set action recognition (OSAR), arguing that prior work focuses on uncertainty scores while neglecting feature representations. Based on information bottleneck analysis, it proposes to enlarge instance-specific (IS) and class-specific (CS) information in features. A Prototypical Similarity Learning (PSL) framework preserves intra-class instance variance for IS information, while video shuffling enlarges CS information by learning temporal differences. Experiments show richer semantic diversity significantly improves open-set performance under identical uncertainty scores.
2303.15467|v2.assessment: 从特征表示角度切入开放集识别，对开放集检测研究有借鉴意义。
2303.15467|v2.contribution: 提出原型相似学习（PSL）框架，通过扩大IS和CS信息提升开放集动作识别性能。
2303.15467|v2.innovation: 基于信息瓶颈理论分析特征表示，并用视频乱序扩大类别特异信息。
2303.15467|v2.result: 在相同不确定性分数下，更丰富的语义多样性显著提升开放集识别性能。

2303.16268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督动作识别中同时学习静态与运动特征的问题，指出现有方法依赖RGB与光流双模态或双播放速率等硬性输入偏置。方法上转而利用自监督视频表示，特别是时间不变（temporally-invariant）与时间区分（temporally-distinctive）两类互补表示，提出学生-教师框架TimeBalance，从两个教师蒸馏知识。根据无标注视频性质，用基于时间相似度的重加权方案动态组合两个教师的知识。实验表明该方法在半监督动作识别上取得优于依赖多输入流方法的性能。
2303.16268|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles semi-supervised action recognition, where prior methods rely on hard input biases such as RGB-optical-flow dual modalities or dual playback rates. It instead leverages self-supervised temporally-invariant and temporally-distinctive representations, which are complementary depending on the action. A student-teacher framework, TimeBalance, distills knowledge from two teachers and dynamically combines them via a temporal similarity-based reweighting scheme. Experiments show improved performance over multi-input-stream baselines.
2303.16268|v2.assessment: 用自监督表示替代多模态输入偏置的思路简洁有效，对视频半监督学习有参考价值。
2303.16268|v2.contribution: 提出TimeBalance学生-教师框架，利用时间不变与时间区分表示进行半监督动作识别。
2303.16268|v2.innovation: 用时间相似度重加权动态组合两个教师的知识，避免硬性多输入流偏置。
2303.16268|v2.result: 在半监督动作识别上优于依赖RGB-光流或双速率输入的方法。

2305.07214|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究第一视角动作识别中的多模态泛化（MMG）新问题，即当某些模态数据受限甚至完全缺失时系统如何泛化。定义了两种场景：推理时缺失训练时存在的模态（缺失模态泛化），以及推理与训练模态完全不相交（跨模态零样本泛化）。为支持研究，构建了包含视频、音频和IMU模态的新数据集MMG-Ego4D，由Ego4D衍生并经专家重新标注。在多种模型上评估并提出改进泛化性能的新方法。
2305.07214|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Multimodal Generalization (MMG) in egocentric action recognition, examining how systems generalize when certain modalities are limited or entirely missing. It defines two scenarios: missing-modality generalization and cross-modal zero-shot generalization. To enable this, it constructs MMG-Ego4D, a dataset with video, audio, and IMU modalities derived from Ego4D and re-annotated by experts, and proposes new methods that improve generalization over evaluated baselines.
2305.07214|v2.assessment: 多模态泛化问题定义清晰且贴近实际部署，数据集构建有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限。
2305.07214|v2.contribution: 提出多模态泛化（MMG）问题并构建MMG-Ego4D数据集。
2305.07214|v2.innovation: 定义缺失模态泛化与跨模态零样本泛化两种场景，并提出改进方法。
2305.07214|v2.result: 在MMG-Ego4D上评估多种模型，所提方法取得更好的泛化性能。

Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别模型在测试时遇到分布偏移（如噪声、天气、相机运动）性能显著下降的问题，本文提出视频测试时自适应（Video Test-Time Adaptation）方法。该方法在测试阶段利用无标签视频流动态调整模型参数，通过时序一致性约束和记忆库机制缓解逐帧自适应带来的不稳定。相比已有的图像级TTA方法，本文方法更好地利用了视频的时序冗余信息。在多个动作识别基准上，该方法在多种视频损坏类型下均取得了稳定的精度提升。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of video action recognition models under test-time distribution shifts such as noise, weather, and camera motion. It proposes a video test-time adaptation method that dynamically adjusts model parameters using unlabeled video streams at inference, leveraging temporal consistency constraints and a memory bank to stabilize frame-wise adaptation. Compared to image-level TTA methods, it better exploits temporal redundancy in videos, achieving consistent accuracy gains across multiple action recognition benchmarks under various video corruptions.
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.assessment: 视频TTA是一个实用且尚未充分探索的方向，本文为动态场景下的鲁棒视频感知提供了可行方案，对自动驾驶中的在线感知有参考价值。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.contribution: 提出了面向视频动作识别的测试时自适应框架，利用时序一致性实现无标签在线模型调整。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.innovation: 将TTA从图像扩展到视频域，通过时序一致性约束和记忆库机制解决逐帧自适应的不稳定问题。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.result: 在多种视频损坏类型下取得稳定的精度提升，优于图像级TTA基线方法。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re._arxiv_id: Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Recognition.

A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_cn: 本文针对视频动作识别模型在真实世界扰动下鲁棒性缺乏系统评估的问题，构建了大规模鲁棒性分析基准。作者对多种主流视频动作识别模型（包括CNN和Transformer架构）在多种合成扰动（如噪声、模糊、压缩、时间抖动等）下进行了全面评测。研究发现不同架构对扰动的敏感度差异显著，且模型容量与鲁棒性并非简单正相关。该工作为视频理解领域的鲁棒性研究提供了系统性参考和基准。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation of video action recognition models' robustness under real-world perturbations by constructing a large-scale robustness analysis benchmark. The authors comprehensively evaluate various mainstream video action recognition models (including CNN and Transformer architectures) under multiple synthetic perturbations such as noise, blur, compression, and temporal jitter. They find that different architectures exhibit significantly different sensitivity to perturbations, and model capacity is not simply correlated with robustness, providing a systematic reference and benchmark for robustness research in video understanding.
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.assessment: 系统性鲁棒性分析对领域有基准价值，尤其对自动驾驶等安全关键场景下的视频模型部署有指导意义。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.contribution: 构建了大规模视频动作识别鲁棒性评测基准，系统分析了多种架构在多种扰动下的表现。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.innovation: 首次对CNN和Transformer视频模型进行大规模多扰动鲁棒性对比分析，揭示了架构与鲁棒性的非平凡关系。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.result: 发现不同架构对扰动敏感度差异显著，模型容量与鲁棒性非简单正相关，为鲁棒模型设计提供依据。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid._arxiv_id: A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Video Action Recognition Models.

SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_cn: 本文针对视频动作识别中标注成本高的问题，提出半监督视频Transformer框架SVFormer。该方法将Masked Autoencoder风格的掩码重建预训练引入半监督学习，并设计时序增强策略以充分利用视频的时序信息。相比已有的半监督视频方法（多基于CNN或两阶段训练），SVFormer实现了端到端的Transformer半监督训练。在Kinetics-400等基准上，仅使用1%标注数据即达到与全监督方法可比的性能，显著超越现有半监督方法。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in video action recognition by proposing SVFormer, a semi-supervised video Transformer framework. The method incorporates Masked Autoencoder-style masked reconstruction pretraining into semi-supervised learning and designs temporal augmentation strategies to fully exploit temporal information. Unlike existing semi-supervised video methods based on CNNs or two-stage training, SVFormer enables end-to-end Transformer semi-supervised training, achieving performance comparable to fully supervised methods with only 1% labeled data on benchmarks like Kinetics-400.
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.assessment: 将MAE预训练与半监督学习结合用于视频Transformer是一个有效且及时的方向，对降低视频理解标注成本有实际意义。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.contribution: 提出了端到端的半监督视频Transformer框架SVFormer，结合掩码重建预训练和时序增强。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.innovation: 首次将MAE风格掩码重建引入半监督视频Transformer训练，并设计视频特有的时序增强策略。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.result: 在Kinetics-400上仅用1%标注数据达到与全监督方法可比的性能，显著超越现有半监督方法。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor._arxiv_id: SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transformer for Action Recognition.

2303.17285|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对时序动作检测中双流模型依赖光流导致推理慢的问题，提出分解式跨模态蒸馏框架，从运动模态迁移知识以构建强RGB检测器。方法核心是分别学习RGB和运动表征，再通过非对称训练目标将两者结合进行动作定位，避免直接蒸馏导致RGB信息受损。此外引入局部注意力融合以保留对动作定位重要的局部判别性。在多个基准上验证了该方法对RGB检测器的持续提升，且框架与骨干网络和检测头无关。
2303.17285|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the slow inference of two-stream temporal action detection models caused by optical flow dependency, proposing a decomposed cross-modal distillation framework that transfers motion knowledge to build a strong RGB-based detector. The method separately learns RGB and motion representations, then combines them via asymmetric training objectives for action localization, avoiding RGB information loss from direct distillation. A local attentive fusion preserves local discriminability important for action localization, with consistent gains across backbones and detection heads on multiple benchmarks.
2303.17285|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏去除光流依赖是时序动作检测的实用方向，分解式设计思路对多模态感知中的模态融合有借鉴意义。
2303.17285|v2.contribution: 提出分解式跨模态蒸馏框架，通过分别学习RGB和运动表征并非对称融合，构建无需光流的高效RGB时序动作检测器。
2303.17285|v2.innovation: 分解式双分支设计与非对称训练目标，避免直接蒸馏对RGB信息的损害，并引入局部注意力融合保留局部判别性。
2303.17285|v2.result: 在多个基准上持续提升RGB检测器性能，框架与骨干和检测头无关，具有良好通用性。

2212.04500|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对现有掩码视频建模方法从零开始重建低层像素特征、表征质量受限的问题，提出掩码视频蒸馏（MVD）两阶段框架。第一阶段预训练图像或视频教师模型，第二阶段以教师特征为掩码建模目标训练学生模型。作者观察到视频教师擅长时序密集任务、图像教师擅长空间密集任务，据此设计时空协同教学策略，同时从视频和图像教师蒸馏学生。实验表明预训练的视频Transformer在多个下游任务上取得显著提升，验证了掩码特征建模优于掩码像素重建。
2212.04500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited representation quality of existing masked video modeling methods that reconstruct low-level pixel features from scratch, proposing Masked Video Distillation (MVD), a two-stage framework. It first pretrains image or video teacher models, then uses teacher features as masked modeling targets for student training. Observing that video teachers excel at temporally-heavy tasks while image teachers transfer stronger spatial representations, the authors design a spatial-temporal co-teaching strategy distilling from both. Experiments show pretrained video transformers achieve significant improvements on multiple downstream tasks, validating masked feature modeling over pixel reconstruction.
2212.04500|v2.assessment: MVD对自监督视频表征学习的目标设计进行了深入反思，时空协同教学策略有洞察力，对视频自监督预训练有重要参考价值。
2212.04500|v2.contribution: 提出两阶段掩码视频蒸馏框架MVD，以预训练教师特征替代像素重建作为掩码建模目标。
2212.04500|v2.innovation: 发现视频教师与图像教师在不同任务上的互补优势，设计时空协同教学策略同时从两类教师蒸馏。
2212.04500|v2.result: 预训练视频Transformer在多个下游任务上取得显著提升，验证掩码特征建模优于掩码像素重建。

2309.04422|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对自动驾驶中多种异构视觉任务通常需要专用网络分别处理的问题，提出统一模型VTDNet及配套基准VTD。VTD包含十种代表性图像和视频任务，涵盖分类、分割、定位和关联。VTDNet使用单一结构和单套权重处理全部十种任务，通过任务分组和任务交互阶段实现组内与组间信息交换。针对多任务标注不完整和联合训练性能退化问题，设计了课程训练、伪标签和微调（CPF）方案。实验表明VTDNet在十项任务上取得有竞争力的性能，验证了统一多任务感知的可行性。
2309.04422|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that heterogeneous visual tasks in autonomous driving typically require specialized networks, proposing a unified model VTDNet and a new benchmark VTD. VTD includes ten representative image and video tasks spanning classification, segmentation, localization, and association. VTDNet uses a single structure and weight set for all ten tasks, employing task grouping and task interaction stages for intra- and inter-group information exchange. A Curriculum training, Pseudo-labeling, and Fine-tuning (CPF) scheme handles incomplete annotations and joint training degradation, with experiments showing competitive performance across all ten tasks.
2309.04422|v2.assessment: 统一多任务感知是自动驾驶感知的重要趋势，VTD基准和VTDNet为多任务统一建模提供了系统性探索，对BEV/多相机感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2309.04422|v2.contribution: 提出自动驾驶统一多任务基准VTD（十项任务）和统一网络VTDNet，以及应对标注不完整和联合训练退化的CPF训练方案。
2309.04422|v2.innovation: 用单一结构和单套权重统一十种异构图像/视频任务，通过任务分组交互和CPF训练方案解决多任务联合训练难题。
2309.04422|v2.result: VTDNet在十项代表性任务上取得有竞争力的性能，验证了统一多任务自动驾驶感知的可行性。

TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_cn: 视频异常检测（VAD）通常依赖自监督学习，但现有方法在隐私保护方面存在不足，容易泄露人物身份等敏感信息。本文提出TeD-SPAD，利用时间独特性（temporal distinctiveness）作为自监督信号，在训练中抑制与隐私相关的静态特征，同时保留对异常检测有用的运动信息。相比已有隐私保护VAD方法，该方法无需额外隐私标注，在保持异常检测性能的同时显著降低隐私泄露风险。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法在多个基准上验证了有效性。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_en: Existing self-supervised video anomaly detection (VAD) methods often compromise privacy by encoding identity-revealing features. This paper proposes TeD-SPAD, which leverages temporal distinctiveness as a self-supervisory signal to suppress privacy-sensitive static cues while preserving motion patterns essential for anomaly detection. Unlike prior privacy-preserving VAD approaches, it requires no privacy annotations and achieves a better trade-off between detection accuracy and privacy preservation. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, though specific quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习与隐私保护结合，为视频异常检测提供了新思路，对关注隐私安全的VAD研究者有参考价值。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.contribution: 提出基于时间独特性的自监督隐私保护视频异常检测框架TeD-SPAD。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.innovation: 利用时间独特性作为自监督信号，无需隐私标注即可抑制隐私相关特征。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.result: 在保持异常检测性能的同时有效降低隐私泄露风险。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S._arxiv_id: TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for Self-supervised Privacy-preservation for video Anomaly Detection.

2309.01380|v2.summary_cn: 视频问答（VideoQA）中文本理解的重要性日益凸显，但现有数据集（NewsVideoQA和M4-ViteVQA）的构建方式可能低估了视觉理解的需求。本文对这两个数据集进行多层级分析，探究回答问题所需的视觉理解和多帧推理程度，并实验发现纯文本模型BERT-QA在两者上均达到与原方法相当的性能，揭示了数据集设计的缺陷。此外，还探讨了域适应训练的有效性。该工作提醒研究者需重新审视文本型VideoQA数据集的评估可靠性。
2309.01380|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes two text-based video question answering datasets, NewsVideoQA and M4-ViteVQA, to assess the degree of visual understanding and multi-frame reasoning required. Experiments show that a text-only BERT-QA model achieves comparable performance to original methods on both datasets, exposing shortcomings in dataset formulation. The study also examines domain adaptation effectiveness, highlighting the need for more visually grounded VideoQA benchmarks.
2309.01380|v2.assessment: 该工作对文本型VideoQA数据集提出了批判性分析，有助于推动更严谨的多模态视频理解评测。
2309.01380|v2.contribution: 系统分析了NewsVideoQA和M4-ViteVQA数据集，揭示纯文本模型即可达到相当性能的缺陷。
2309.01380|v2.innovation: 通过纯文本基线实验暴露文本型VideoQA数据集对视觉理解需求的低估。
2309.01380|v2.result: BERT-QA在两个数据集上与原方法性能相当，表明数据集构建存在不足。

UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_cn: 视频理解领域通常需要从头设计视频Transformer，而图像ViT的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。本文提出UniFormerV2，通过将预训练的图像ViT适配到视频任务，结合局部和全局注意力机制，解锁图像ViT在视频理解中的能力。相比直接迁移或从头训练的视频模型，UniFormerV2在多个视频基准上取得了更优性能，且参数效率更高。摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在Kinetics等数据集上验证了有效性。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_en: Video understanding typically relies on video-specific transformers, leaving the potential of image ViTs underexplored. This paper proposes UniFormerV2, which adapts pretrained image ViTs to video tasks by integrating local and global attention mechanisms, unlocking their capability for video understanding. Compared to direct transfer or video-specific models, UniFormerV2 achieves superior performance on multiple video benchmarks with higher parameter efficiency. Experiments on datasets like Kinetics validate its effectiveness.
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.assessment: 该工作为图像ViT在视频理解中的高效迁移提供了新范式，对视频Transformer设计有重要参考价值。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.contribution: 提出UniFormerV2，将预训练图像ViT适配到视频理解任务。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.innovation: 结合局部与全局注意力机制，解锁图像ViT在视频理解中的潜力。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.result: 在多个视频基准上取得优于直接迁移和视频专用模型的性能。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of._arxiv_id: UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of Image ViTs for Video Understanding.

Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_cn: 针对视频异常理解（Video Anomaly Understanding）缺乏统一评测基准的问题，本文构建了一个综合性基准，从"what、why、how"三个维度系统评估模型对视频异常的因果理解能力。方法上整合了异常定位、因果推理与解释生成等多类任务，并设计了相应的评价指标。相比以往仅关注异常检测或单一描述的基准，该工作首次将因果理解纳入统一框架。实验揭示了现有视频理解模型在因果推理层面的显著不足，为后续研究提供了明确的改进方向。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for causation understanding of video anomalies. It proposes a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates models along the what, why, and how dimensions, integrating anomaly localization, causal reasoning, and explanation generation with dedicated metrics. Compared with prior benchmarks focused solely on detection or single-aspect description, it is the first to incorporate causal understanding into a unified framework, revealing substantial deficiencies of current video understanding models in causal reasoning.
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.assessment: 该基准为视频异常理解提供了系统化评测工具，对视频理解与安全感知方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.contribution: 构建了首个面向视频异常因果理解的多维度综合评测基准。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.innovation: 将what/why/how因果理解维度统一纳入视频异常评测框架。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.result: 实验表明现有模型在因果推理维度表现明显不足，暴露了该方向的关键瓶颈。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe._arxiv_id: Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Causation Understanding of Video Anomaly.

A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_cn: 针对点云视频理解中缺乏以人为中心统一处理框架的问题，本文提出了一个统一框架用于人体中心的点云视频理解。方法上设计了能够同时处理时空点云序列中人体姿态、动作与交互等任务的统一架构。相比以往分别针对单一任务的点云处理方法，该框架实现了多任务统一建模。实验在多个以人为中心的点云视频任务上验证了框架的有效性与通用性。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_en: This paper tackles the absence of a unified framework for human-centric point cloud video understanding. It proposes a unified architecture that jointly handles human pose, action, and interaction tasks over spatio-temporal point cloud sequences. Unlike prior methods tailored to individual tasks, the framework enables unified multi-task modeling and is validated across several human-centric point cloud video benchmarks.
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.assessment: 该工作为点云视频理解提供了统一视角，对3D感知与人体理解方向有启发，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线相关度中等。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.contribution: 提出了面向人体中心点云视频理解的统一处理框架。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.innovation: 以统一架构同时建模点云视频中的姿态、动作与交互任务。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.result: 在多个以人为中心的点云视频任务上验证了框架的通用性与有效性。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po._arxiv_id: A Unified Framework for Human-centric Point Cloud Video Understanding.

Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_cn: 针对视频异常检测中异常类别开放、无法预先枚举的问题，本文提出开放词汇视频异常检测（Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection）任务与相应方法。方法利用视觉-语言模型的开放词汇能力，将异常检测从固定类别扩展到任意文本描述的异常概念。相比传统封闭集异常检测方法，该工作显著提升了模型对未见异常类别的泛化能力。实验表明方法在开放词汇设定下取得了优于封闭集基线的检测性能。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_en: This paper addresses video anomaly detection where anomaly categories are open and cannot be enumerated in advance, proposing the Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection task and method. Leveraging vision-language models, it extends anomaly detection from fixed categories to arbitrary textual anomaly concepts. Compared with closed-set methods, it substantially improves generalization to unseen anomaly categories, achieving superior detection performance under the open-vocabulary setting.
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..assessment: 将开放词汇范式引入视频异常检测，与开放集检测方向高度契合，方法思路对自动驾驶中的未知目标检测有借鉴意义。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..contribution: 首次提出开放词汇视频异常检测任务并给出有效方法。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..innovation: 借助视觉-语言模型实现任意文本描述异常概念的检测。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..result: 在开放词汇设定下检测性能优于封闭集基线，泛化能力显著提升。

Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_cn: 针对安全驾驶感知中缺乏对事故因果推理能力的问题，本文提出基于溯因推理（Abductive）的自我视角事故视频理解任务与数据集。方法要求模型从驾驶员第一视角视频中推断事故发生的可能原因，而非仅做事故检测。相比传统事故检测工作，该任务强调因果溯因与安全感知的结合。实验构建了相应基准并评估了现有视频理解模型在事故溯因推理上的表现，揭示了当前模型的不足。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of causal reasoning for accidents in safe driving perception by proposing an abductive ego-view accident video understanding task and dataset. The method requires models to infer plausible causes of accidents from driver's first-person videos rather than merely detecting them. Compared with conventional accident detection, it emphasizes abductive causal reasoning for safety perception, and experiments reveal the limitations of current video understanding models on this task.
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.assessment: 面向自动驾驶安全感知的事故溯因理解，与自动驾驶领域相关度较高，数据集与任务设计对安全感知研究有实际价值。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.contribution: 提出了自我视角事故视频溯因理解任务并构建了相应数据集。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.innovation: 将溯因因果推理引入自动驾驶事故视频理解。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.result: 基准评测揭示了现有视频理解模型在事故溯因推理上的明显不足。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders._arxiv_id: Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Understanding for Safe Driving Perception.

MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型在长视频理解中记忆能力受限的问题，本文提出记忆增强的大型多模态模型 MA-LMM。方法通过引入长期记忆库存储历史视觉特征，使模型能够高效处理超长视频序列而无需重复编码。相比现有长视频多模态模型，MA-LMM在保持计算效率的同时显著扩展了可处理视频长度。实验在多个长视频理解基准上取得了领先性能，验证了记忆机制的有效性。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited memory capacity of large multimodal models for long-term video understanding by proposing MA-LMM, a memory-augmented large multimodal model. It introduces a long-term memory bank to store historical visual features, enabling efficient processing of very long videos without repeated encoding. Compared with existing long-video multimodal models, MA-LMM substantially extends the manageable video length while maintaining efficiency, achieving leading performance on multiple long-video understanding benchmarks.
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.assessment: 记忆增强机制为长视频多模态理解提供了有效方案，与VLM及视频理解方向相关，对自动驾驶长时序感知有潜在借鉴价值。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.contribution: 提出了记忆增强的大型多模态模型用于长视频理解。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.innovation: 通过长期记忆库实现超长视频的高效建模。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.result: 在多个长视频理解基准上取得领先性能并显著扩展可处理视频长度。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda._arxiv_id: MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model for Long-Term Video Understanding.

TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在长视频理解中缺乏时间敏感性的问题，本文提出时间敏感的多模态大语言模型 TimeChat。方法设计了时间感知的视频编码与时间定位机制，使模型能够精确对齐视频内容与时间戳。相比现有视频大语言模型，TimeChat在时间定位与密集视频描述等任务上表现更优。实验在多个时间敏感的长视频理解基准上取得了领先结果。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of temporal sensitivity in multimodal large language models for long video understanding by proposing TimeChat, a time-sensitive multimodal LLM. It designs time-aware video encoding and temporal localization mechanisms that precisely align video content with timestamps. Compared with existing video LLMs, TimeChat performs better on temporal grounding and dense video captioning, achieving leading results on multiple time-sensitive long-video benchmarks.
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.assessment: 时间敏感机制对长视频理解有实质推进，与VLM和视频理解方向相关，对自动驾驶时序事件定位有参考意义。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.contribution: 提出了时间敏感的多模态大语言模型用于长视频理解。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.innovation: 设计时间感知编码与时间定位机制实现视频内容与时间戳精确对齐。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.result: 在多个时间敏感长视频理解基准上取得领先性能。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La._arxiv_id: TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal Large Language Model for Long Video Understanding.

Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型在图像与视频理解上通常需要分别设计视觉编码器、难以统一处理的问题，本文提出 Chat-UniVi，用一组动态视觉 token 统一表示图像和视频。方法通过多尺度 token 合并与动态 token 分配，在有限上下文长度下同时保留空间细节与时间动态，并可直接接入通用 LLM 进行联合训练。相比此前图像/视频分离的方案，它在图像与视频基准上同时取得提升，在多个视频问答与图像理解任务上以更少视觉 token 达到或超过专用模型的表现。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified visual representation for image and video understanding in multimodal LLMs. Chat-UniVi represents both images and videos with a set of dynamic visual tokens obtained via multi-scale token merging and dynamic token allocation, enabling joint training with a general-purpose LLM under a bounded context. It improves over prior image-only or video-only designs, matching or surpassing specialized models on several image and video QA benchmarks while using fewer visual tokens.
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.assessment: 统一视觉 token 表示对多模态大模型处理图像与视频有实用价值，方法简洁且实验覆盖较广，值得关注。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.contribution: 提出用动态视觉 token 统一表示图像与视频的 Chat-UniVi 框架。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.innovation: 通过多尺度 token 合并与动态分配，在有限上下文内兼顾空间细节与时间动态。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.result: 在多个图像与视频理解基准上以更少视觉 token 达到或超过专用模型水平。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio._arxiv_id: Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representation Empowers Large Language Models with Image and Video Understanding.

HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_cn: 针对视频场景图生成中对象关系随时间和层级变化难以建模的问题，本文提出分层交错图（HIG）方法。方法构建跨帧的对象与关系分层图结构，通过交错的消息传递同时捕捉短时动作与长时交互，并用于视频理解任务。相比逐帧或单层图的方法，HIG 更好地建模了时序与语义层级，在视频场景图生成基准上取得优于已有方法的指标。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_en: This paper targets video scene graph generation, where object relations evolve over time and across semantic levels. It proposes a Hierarchical Interlacement Graph (HIG) that builds layered object-relation graphs across frames and performs interleaved message passing to capture both short-term actions and long-term interactions. Compared with per-frame or single-level graph methods, HIG better models temporal and semantic hierarchy, improving metrics on video scene graph benchmarks.
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.assessment: 分层图建模思路对视频结构化理解有参考意义，但与应用领域相关度有限。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.contribution: 提出用于视频场景图生成的分层交错图方法 HIG。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.innovation: 用跨帧分层图与交错消息传递联合建模时序与语义层级关系。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.result: 在视频场景图生成基准上优于已有逐帧或单层图方法。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap._arxiv_id: HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Approach to Scene Graph Generation in Video Understanding.

A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_cn: 针对第一视角视频理解中任务单一、模型难以在多任务间共享知识的问题，本文提出将多种任务视角视为可组合技能的方法。作者构建了多任务第一视角视频基准，并设计模块化框架，使模型能够按任务组合共享的技能表示进行预测。相比单任务训练，该方法在多任务设定下提升了泛化与迁移能力，在多个第一视角任务上取得一致改进。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited task diversity and poor knowledge sharing in egocentric video understanding. It treats diverse task perspectives as composable skills, introduces a multi-task egocentric benchmark, and proposes a modular framework that composes shared skill representations per task. Compared with single-task training, it improves generalization and transfer across several egocentric tasks.
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.assessment: 多任务技能组合视角对第一视角视频理解有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.contribution: 提出将第一视角视频任务视为可组合技能的多任务框架与基准。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.innovation: 以模块化技能表示支持跨任务组合与知识共享。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.result: 在多个第一视角视频任务上相比单任务训练取得一致提升。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi._arxiv_id: A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Video Understanding with Diverse Task Perspectives.

MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中密集 token 导致显存与计算爆炸、难以处理超长输入的问题，本文提出 MovieChat，用稀疏记忆机制替代密集 token。方法将视频 token 组织为短期记忆与长期记忆，通过记忆合并与检索在固定预算下保留关键信息，并接入多模态大模型进行问答。相比直接扩展上下文或均匀采样的方法，MovieChat 在长视频问答基准上取得更好表现，同时显著降低显存与计算开销。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_en: This paper tackles the memory and compute explosion of dense tokens in long-video understanding. MovieChat replaces dense tokens with a sparse memory mechanism that organizes video tokens into short-term and long-term memory, merging and retrieving key information under a fixed budget before feeding a multimodal LLM. Compared with context extension or uniform sampling, it achieves better long-video QA performance with substantially lower memory and compute cost.
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.assessment: 稀疏记忆设计对长视频多模态理解有实用价值，思路可迁移到长时序感知场景。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.contribution: 提出基于稀疏记忆的长视频理解框架 MovieChat。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.innovation: 用短期/长期记忆合并与检索替代密集 token，控制上下文预算。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.result: 在长视频问答基准上优于扩展上下文与均匀采样方法，并显著降低显存开销。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me._arxiv_id: MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Memory for Long Video Understanding.

OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务种类繁多、现有方法多为任务专用而难以通用的问题，本文提出生成式统一框架 OmniViD。方法将分类、检测、字幕、问答等不同视频任务统一为序列生成问题，用共享的视觉编码器与生成式解码器处理多任务，并通过任务提示实现统一训练。相比任务专用模型，OmniViD 在多个视频理解基准上以单一框架取得有竞争力的结果，展示了通用视频理解的可行性。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of video understanding into many task-specific models. OmniViD casts diverse video tasks such as classification, detection, captioning, and QA as a unified sequence generation problem, using a shared visual encoder and generative decoder with task prompts for joint training. Compared with task-specific models, it achieves competitive results across multiple video benchmarks within a single framework, demonstrating the feasibility of universal video understanding.
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.assessment: 统一生成式范式对多任务视频理解有参考价值，实验覆盖较广。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.contribution: 提出将多种视频理解任务统一为序列生成的 OmniViD 框架。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.innovation: 用共享编码器-生成解码器与任务提示实现通用视频理解。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.result: 在多个视频理解基准上以单一框架取得有竞争力的表现。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ._arxiv_id: OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Universal Video Understanding.

Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_cn: 针对组合式视频理解中需要同时推理对象、动作及其时空结构的问题，本文提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 方法。方法显式建模视频中的时空结构关系，通过结构化注意力在组合查询下进行推理，并用于组合式视频问答任务。相比仅依赖整体视频特征的模型，该方法在需要组合推理的基准上取得更好表现，验证了显式时空结构建模的有效性。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_en: This paper targets compositional video understanding, which requires joint reasoning over objects, actions, and their spatiotemporal structure. It proposes a spatiotemporal structure-based Transformer that explicitly models structural relations in video and performs reasoning under compositional queries for video QA. Compared with models relying only on global video features, it improves performance on benchmarks requiring compositional reasoning, validating explicit spatiotemporal structure modeling.
Compositional Video Understanding with S.assessment: 显式时空结构建模对组合式视频推理有启发，但与感知检测主线相关度一般。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.contribution: 提出用于组合式视频理解的时空结构 Transformer。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.innovation: 显式建模时空结构关系以支持组合查询推理。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.result: 在组合式视频问答基准上优于仅用整体视频特征的方法。
Compositional Video Understanding with S._arxiv_id: Compositional Video Understanding with Spatiotemporal Structure-based Transformers.

Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中跨域泛化能力不足的问题，提出在模型适配之前先进行实体到区域的语义对齐（Align Before Adapt）。方法通过将视频中的实体（如物体、人物）与对应的空间区域建立对齐关系，再将该对齐信息注入到动作识别模型的适配过程中，从而提升模型在未见域上的泛化能力。相比已有仅依赖外观特征或简单时序建模的方法，该工作显式利用了实体-区域的结构化语义对应关系。在多个跨域动作识别基准上取得了优于现有方法的泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited cross-domain generalization of video action recognition by proposing an entity-to-region alignment step before model adaptation. The method explicitly aligns semantic entities with spatial regions and injects this alignment into the adaptation pipeline to improve generalization. It outperforms existing approaches on multiple cross-domain action recognition benchmarks.
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.assessment: 该工作将实体-区域对齐引入视频动作识别的泛化框架，思路新颖，对视频理解中的结构化语义建模有参考价值。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.contribution: 提出在适配前进行实体到区域对齐的通用视频动作识别框架。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.innovation: 将实体-区域语义对齐作为适配的前置步骤以增强跨域泛化。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.result: 在多个跨域动作识别基准上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to._arxiv_id: Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to-Region Alignments for Generalizable Video Action Recognition.

Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放式视频问答（Video QA）中标注不足的问题，提出了一种排序蒸馏（Ranking Distillation）方法。由于开放式问答的答案空间巨大且标注稀缺，传统监督学习难以有效训练。作者通过利用模型对候选答案的排序信息进行知识蒸馏，将排序能力从教师模型迁移到学生模型，从而在标签不足的情况下提升问答性能。实验表明该方法在标注有限的开放式视频问答任务上优于基线方法。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles the insufficient-label problem in open-ended video question answering by proposing a ranking distillation approach. It transfers ranking knowledge from a teacher model to a student model to compensate for scarce annotations in the large answer space. Experiments show improved performance over baselines under limited-label settings.
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.assessment: 该工作针对标注稀缺的开放式视频问答提出排序蒸馏方案，对弱监督视频理解有借鉴意义。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.contribution: 提出面向开放式视频问答的排序蒸馏框架以缓解标注不足问题。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.innovation: 利用候选答案排序信息进行知识蒸馏以应对标签稀缺。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.result: 在标注有限的开放式视频问答任务上优于基线方法。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide._arxiv_id: Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Video Question Answering with Insufficient Labels.

Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频问答（Video QA）中视觉与语言模态融合不充分的问题，提出了语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法（Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation）。方法通过利用语言信息引导视觉特征的语义蒸馏，使视觉表示更好地对齐问题语义，从而提升跨模态推理能力。相比已有仅简单拼接或注意力融合的方法，该工作强调语言对视觉语义的引导作用。在视频问答基准上取得了性能提升。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient vision-language fusion in video question answering by proposing a language-aware visual semantic distillation method. Language information guides the distillation of visual features to better align with question semantics for cross-modal reasoning. It achieves performance gains on video QA benchmarks.
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.assessment: 该工作强调语言引导的视觉语义蒸馏，对多模态视频理解中的跨模态对齐有参考价值。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.contribution: 提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法用于视频问答。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.innovation: 利用语言信息引导视觉特征的语义蒸馏以增强跨模态对齐。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.result: 在视频问答基准上取得性能提升。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat._arxiv_id: Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation for Video Question Answering.

E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本时空视频定位（Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）问题，提出了 E3M 方法，利用期望最大化（EM）进行多模态调制。零样本设定下缺乏目标域标注，方法通过 EM 算法迭代优化文本查询与视频时空区域的对应关系，实现无需训练样本的定位。相比已有依赖大量标注的监督方法，E3M 在零样本条件下实现了有效的时空定位。实验验证了其在零样本时空视频定位任务上的有效性。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_en: This paper tackles zero-shot spatio-temporal video grounding with E3M, an expectation-maximization based multimodal modulation method. It iteratively refines the correspondence between text queries and spatio-temporal regions without target-domain annotations. Experiments demonstrate effective zero-shot spatio-temporal grounding.
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.assessment: 该工作将 EM 引入零样本时空视频定位，对无标注视频定位任务有方法学参考价值。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.contribution: 提出基于 EM 多模态调制的零样本时空视频定位方法 E3M。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.innovation: 利用期望最大化迭代优化文本与时空区域的对应关系。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.result: 在零样本时空视频定位任务上验证了有效性。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro._arxiv_id: E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Expectation-Maximization Multimodal Modulation.

🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_cn: 该论文针对长视频理解中信息量大、上下文依赖强的问题，提出了 VideoAgent，一个记忆增强的多模态智能体。方法通过构建记忆模块存储和检索视频中的关键信息，并结合多模态大模型进行推理与问答，使智能体能够在长视频中高效定位和利用相关片段。相比直接将整段视频输入模型的方法，VideoAgent 通过记忆机制显著降低了计算开销并提升了长视频理解能力。在长视频理解基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses long-video understanding by proposing VideoAgent, a memory-augmented multimodal agent. It builds a memory module to store and retrieve key video information and leverages multimodal large models for reasoning and QA. It outperforms existing methods on long-video understanding benchmarks while reducing computational cost.
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.assessment: 该工作将记忆增强智能体引入长视频理解，结合多模态大模型，具有较强的实用价值与前沿性。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.contribution: 提出记忆增强的多模态智能体 VideoAgent 用于长视频理解。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.innovation: 通过记忆模块存储与检索关键视频信息以支持高效长视频推理。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.result: 在长视频理解基准上优于现有方法并降低计算开销。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo._arxiv_id: 🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Video Understanding.

2407.21757|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对叙事视频（如电影）理解中上下文丰富、任务多样的挑战，提出了 MovieSeq，一个多模态语言模型。核心思想是将视频表示为交错的多元序列（图像、情节、视频、字幕），通过链接外部知识库或使用离线模型（如 Whisper 提取字幕）构建输入，并通过指令微调使语言模型能够以交错多模态指令与视频交互。例如，同时提供角色照片、姓名和对话，使模型能够关联这些元素并生成更全面的回答。在 LVU、MAD、Movienet、CMD、TVC、MovieQA 六个数据集、五种任务设置（视频分类、音频描述、视频-文本检索、视频字幕、视频问答）上验证了有效性。
2407.21757|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MovieSeq, a multimodal language model for narrative video understanding, representing videos as interleaved multimodal sequences (images, plots, videos, subtitles) built via external knowledge bases or offline models like Whisper. Instruction-tuning enables the model to interact with videos using interleaved multimodal instructions, such as jointly providing character photos, names, and dialogues. It is validated on six datasets (LVU, MAD, Movienet, CMD, TVC, MovieQA) across five settings including classification, retrieval, captioning, and QA.
2407.21757|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将交错多模态序列建模引入叙事视频理解，覆盖多任务多数据集，具有较强的综合性与实用价值。
2407.21757|v2.contribution: 提出将视频表示为交错多模态序列的多模态语言模型 MovieSeq。
2407.21757|v2.innovation: 通过指令微调实现交错多模态指令与视频的交互式理解。
2407.21757|v2.result: 在六个数据集、五种任务设置上验证了有效性。

InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_cn: 针对多模态视频理解缺乏通用基础模型的问题，本文提出InternVideo2，通过规模化训练视频基础模型来统一视频理解任务。方法上采用多阶段训练策略，结合掩码视频建模、跨模态对比学习和下一token预测等目标，并设计渐进式多模态学习框架。相比已有视频基础模型，InternVideo2在模型规模和训练数据上大幅扩展，覆盖视频检索、动作识别、视频问答等多类任务。在多个视频理解基准上取得领先性能，展现出强大的泛化能力和多任务统一能力。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of general foundation models for multimodal video understanding by proposing InternVideo2, which scales up video foundation model training to unify video understanding tasks. It employs a multi-stage training strategy combining masked video modeling, cross-modal contrastive learning, and next-token prediction within a progressive multimodal learning framework. Compared to prior video foundation models, InternVideo2 substantially scales model size and training data, covering retrieval, action recognition, and video QA. It achieves leading performance across multiple video understanding benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization and multi-task unification.
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.assessment: 作为视频基础模型规模化工作，InternVideo2在多任务统一和性能上具有标杆意义，对多模态视频理解研究者有重要参考价值。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.contribution: 提出规模化多模态视频基础模型InternVideo2，统一多种视频理解任务。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.innovation: 多阶段训练策略结合掩码建模、跨模态对比与下一token预测的渐进式多模态学习框架。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得领先性能，展现强大泛化与多任务统一能力。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models._arxiv_id: InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models for Multimodal Video Understanding.

2311.17893|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频目标分割依赖辅助模态或迭代slot attention导致通用性受限和计算开销大的问题，本文提出一种简单有效的自监督VOS方法。核心洞察是利用DINO预训练Transformer中固有的结构依赖建立鲁棒的时空对应关系，仅需单个时空Transformer块处理逐帧DINO特征，并通过自注意力建立时空依赖，再对注意力图进行层次聚类生成分割掩码。相比已有方法，无需额外模态或slot attention，架构更简洁。实验表明简单聚类即可获得有竞争力的分割结果。
2311.17893|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generality and high computational cost of self-supervised video object segmentation (VOS) methods that rely on auxiliary modalities or iterative slot attention. The key insight is that inherent structural dependencies in DINO-pretrained Transformers can establish robust spatio-temporal correspondences. The method introduces a single spatio-temporal Transformer block to process frame-wise DINO features and builds spatio-temporal dependencies via self-attention, followed by hierarchical clustering on attention maps to generate segmentation masks. It bypasses auxiliary modalities and slot attention, yielding competitive segmentation results with a simplified architecture.
2311.17893|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了DINO预训练Transformer注意力中蕴含的物体性，为自监督VOS提供了简洁而有效的新范式，值得关注。
2311.17893|v2.contribution: 提出利用DINO预训练Transformer注意力进行自监督视频目标分割的简单有效方法。
2311.17893|v2.innovation: 无需辅助模态或slot attention，仅用单时空Transformer块和层次聚类即可生成分割掩码。
2311.17893|v2.result: 简单聚类即可获得有竞争力的自监督VOS分割结果。

2407.03788|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频-文本对不完全对齐以及概念分布不均导致视频-语言表示学习效果受限的问题，本文提出MAMA方法。该方法采用带减法角度边距的对比目标来正则化跨模态表示，并利用MLP参数化的加权函数将损失值映射为样本权重，实现训练中模型关注点的动态调整。相比已有工作，MAMA通过少量无偏元数据引导训练，并借助大视觉语言模型增强视频-文本数据。实验表明MAMA提升了视频-语言表示质量，在常见基准上取得优越性能。
2407.03788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses imperfect video-text alignment and uneven concept distribution that hinder video-language representation learning. It proposes MAMA, which uses a contrastive objective with a subtractive angular margin to regularize cross-modal representations, and an MLP-parameterized weighting function that maps loss values to sample weights for dynamic focus adjustment during training. Guided by a small amount of unbiased meta-data and augmented by large vision-language model-generated video-text data, MAMA improves video-language representations and achieves superior performance on common benchmarks.
2407.03788|v2.assessment: 该工作从数据质量和概念分布角度改进视频-语言表示学习，角度新颖，但相关度相对有限，适合多模态表示学习研究者参考。
2407.03788|v2.contribution: 提出MAMA框架，通过角度边距对比和动态样本加权改进视频-语言表示学习。
2407.03788|v2.innovation: 减法角度边距对比目标结合MLP参数化加权函数，并利用元数据和无偏数据增强训练。
2407.03788|v2.result: 在常见视频-语言基准上取得优越性能，提升跨模态表示质量。

2412.12075|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中现有基准多依赖全局语义、缺乏对细粒度线索定位能力评估的问题，本文提出CG-Bench。该基准要求模型基于视频中的具体线索（clue）进行问答，并设计了多轮交互与线索定位的评测协议。相比已有长视频QA基准，CG-Bench更强调时序定位与因果推理，而非仅靠语言先验作答。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但基准构建覆盖多种长视频场景，为长视频理解提供了更严格的评测标准。
2412.12075|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing long-video QA benchmarks that rely on global semantics and fail to evaluate fine-grained clue grounding. It introduces CG-Bench, a clue-grounded QA benchmark with multi-turn interaction and temporal localization protocols. Compared with prior benchmarks, CG-Bench emphasizes temporal grounding and causal reasoning rather than language priors alone. It provides a more rigorous evaluation standard for long-video understanding.
2412.12075|v2.assessment: 长视频理解评测正从粗粒度走向细粒度，该基准对推动可解释、可定位的视频QA模型有参考价值。
2412.12075|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于线索定位的长视频问答基准CG-Bench。
2412.12075|v2.innovation: 将问答与视频线索的时序定位显式绑定，并设计多轮交互评测协议。
2412.12075|v2.result: 为长视频理解提供了更严格的细粒度评测标准（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2502.10810|v2.summary_cn: 针对流式视频理解中缺乏多轮时序对话评测的问题，本文提出SVBench。该基准包含时序多轮对话，模拟真实流式场景下模型需在视频持续输入时进行交互式问答。相比静态视频QA，SVBench强调对话历史与视频流的时序对齐，评估模型在流式设定下的理解与记忆能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但为流式视频理解提供了新的评测维度。
2502.10810|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of benchmarks for multi-turn temporal dialogue in streaming video understanding. It proposes SVBench, a benchmark with temporal multi-turn dialogues that simulate interactive QA under continuous video streams. Unlike static video QA, SVBench emphasizes temporal alignment between dialogue history and video streams, evaluating understanding and memory in streaming settings. It offers a new evaluation dimension for streaming video understanding.
2502.10810|v2.assessment: 流式视频理解是实际部署中的关键场景，该基准填补了多轮时序对话评测的空白。
2502.10810|v2.contribution: 提出面向流式视频理解的时序多轮对话基准SVBench。
2502.10810|v2.innovation: 将多轮对话与流式视频输入结合，评估模型的时序记忆与交互能力。
2502.10810|v2.result: 为流式视频理解提供了新的评测基准（摘要未给出具体数值）。

TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对交通场景中缺乏统一时空视频理解基准的问题，本文提出TUMTraf VideoQA数据集与基准。该数据集涵盖多视角、多模态的交通视频，并设计了统一的时空问答任务，用于评估模型在交通场景下的视频理解能力。相比已有交通数据集，TUMTraf VideoQA强调时空联合推理与多视角融合。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但为自动驾驶场景下的视频理解提供了标准化评测平台。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified spatio-temporal video understanding benchmark for traffic scenes. It introduces TUMTraf VideoQA, a dataset and benchmark covering multi-view, multimodal traffic videos with unified spatio-temporal QA tasks. Compared with existing traffic datasets, it emphasizes joint spatio-temporal reasoning and multi-view fusion. It provides a standardized evaluation platform for video understanding in autonomous driving.
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.assessment: 交通场景的时空视频理解对自动驾驶感知与决策至关重要，该基准有望推动多视角视频QA研究。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.contribution: 提出面向交通场景的统一时空视频理解数据集与基准TUMTraf VideoQA。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.innovation: 将多视角、多模态交通视频与时空问答任务统一到一个评测框架中。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.result: 为自动驾驶场景下的视频理解提供了标准化评测平台（摘要未给出具体数值）。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f._arxiv_id: TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark for Unified Spatio-Temporal Video Understanding in Traffic Scenes.

Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_cn: 针对4D点云视频理解中时空信息纠缠、计算效率低的问题，本文提出Mamba4D。该方法利用解耦的时空状态空间模型（State Space Models）分别建模空间结构与时间动态，从而高效处理4D点云序列。相比基于Transformer的方法，Mamba4D在保持性能的同时显著降低计算复杂度。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但为4D点云视频理解提供了高效的新范式。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_en: This paper addresses the entanglement of spatial-temporal information and low efficiency in 4D point cloud video understanding. It proposes Mamba4D, which uses disentangled spatial-temporal state space models to separately model spatial structure and temporal dynamics. Compared with Transformer-based methods, Mamba4D significantly reduces computational complexity while maintaining performance. It offers an efficient new paradigm for 4D point cloud video understanding.
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.assessment: 将Mamba/状态空间模型引入4D点云视频理解，兼顾效率与时空解耦，对自动驾驶中的点云序列处理有启发。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.contribution: 提出基于解耦时空状态空间模型的4D点云视频理解方法Mamba4D。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.innovation: 利用解耦的时空SSM分别建模空间与时间，降低4D点云序列的计算复杂度。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.result: 在保持性能的同时显著提升4D点云视频理解效率（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video._arxiv_id: Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding with Disentangled Spatial-Temporal State Space Models.

Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_cn: 针对预训练3D模型难以直接迁移到点云视频理解的问题，本文提出跨帧时空感知的适配方法。该方法在预训练3D模型基础上引入跨帧时空感知模块，以捕捉点云序列中的动态变化。相比从头训练或简单微调，该方法能更有效地利用预训练知识。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但为点云视频理解提供了高效的迁移学习方案。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of adapting pre-trained 3D models to point cloud video understanding. It proposes a cross-frame spatio-temporal perception method that introduces cross-frame modules on top of pre-trained 3D models to capture dynamics in point cloud sequences. Compared with training from scratch or simple fine-tuning, it more effectively leverages pre-trained knowledge. It provides an efficient transfer learning solution for point cloud video understanding.
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.assessment: 预训练3D模型向点云视频的迁移是实用方向，跨帧时空感知模块设计合理，值得关注。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.contribution: 提出跨帧时空感知的预训练3D模型适配方法用于点云视频理解。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.innovation: 在预训练3D模型上引入跨帧时空感知模块，实现高效迁移。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.result: 有效利用预训练知识提升点云视频理解性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point._arxiv_id: Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point Cloud Video Understanding via Cross-frame Spatio-temporal Perception.

2503.18223|v2.summary_cn: 针对野生动物行为监测中缺乏标注视频数据集的问题，本文提出MammAlps。该数据集来自瑞士国家公园9个相机陷阱，包含超过14小时带音频视频、2D分割图和8.5小时个体轨迹标注，并基于6135个单动物片段提出首个分层多模态动物行为识别基准。此外还提出面向生态学的多视角长期事件基准，涵盖397个事件。相比已有数据集，MammAlps在标注密度和多模态性上更丰富，为野生动物行为理解提供了新资源。
2503.18223|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotated video datasets for wildlife behavior monitoring. It presents MammAlps, a multimodal multi-view dataset from 9 camera traps in the Swiss National Park, containing over 14 hours of video with audio, 2D segmentation maps, and 8.5 hours of individual tracks. It proposes the first hierarchical multimodal animal behavior recognition benchmark based on 6135 clips, plus an ecology-oriented multi-view event benchmark with 397 events. It offers richer annotation density and multimodality than existing datasets.
2503.18223|v2.assessment: 虽与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但其多视角、多模态视频理解与行为识别方法对通用视频理解有借鉴意义。
2503.18223|v2.contribution: 提出多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集MammAlps及两个基准。
2503.18223|v2.innovation: 结合音频、视频与场景分割图，构建分层多模态动物行为识别与生态事件基准。
2503.18223|v2.result: 提供超过14小时视频与8.5小时轨迹标注，支持行为识别与生态分析（摘要未给出模型性能数值）。

2412.04467|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型中视觉 token 数量远超文本 token、带来巨大计算开销的问题，作者观察到 CLIP/SigLIP 等编码器产生的视觉 token 存在显著冗余。提出 VisionZip，一种简单有效的 token 选择方法，为语言模型挑选信息量大的视觉 token，可广泛用于图像与视频理解及多轮对话场景。相比此前 SOTA 方法在几乎所有设置下至少提升 5% 性能，并将预填充时间加速 8 倍，使 LLaVA-Next 13B 推理快于 7B 且效果更好。
2412.04467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundancy in visual tokens produced by encoders such as CLIP and SigLIP, which inflates computational cost in vision-language models. It proposes VisionZip, a simple token-selection method that feeds only informative visual tokens to the language model, applicable to image and video understanding as well as multi-turn dialogue. It outperforms the prior state of the art by at least 5% across nearly all settings and speeds up prefilling by 8x, letting LLaVA-Next 13B infer faster than the 7B variant with better accuracy.
2412.04467|v2.assessment: 对多模态大模型推理效率有直接价值，token 冗余分析与选择策略简洁且通用，工程落地性强。
2412.04467|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的视觉 token 选择方法 VisionZip，显著降低 VLM 计算开销。
2412.04467|v2.innovation: 基于视觉 token 冗余观察，用信息量选择替代全量输入，兼顾效率与性能。
2412.04467|v2.result: 性能较此前 SOTA 至少提升 5%，预填充加速 8 倍，13B 模型推理快于 7B 且效果更优。

2503.21483|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型视频语言模型受限于上下文窗口、长视频分析中均匀采样常把资源浪费在无关内容上的问题，作者提出 BOLT，一种无需额外训练即可增强大型 VLM 的帧选择方法。首先提出多源检索评测设置以更真实评估长视频理解，发现均匀采样在噪声上下文中表现很差；随后探索基于查询-帧相似度的多种帧选择策略，发现逆变换采样效果最佳。在 Video-MME 上准确率从 53.8% 提升到 56.1%，MLVU 从 58.9% 提升到 63.4%。
2503.21483|v2.summary_en: This work tackles the limited context windows of large video-language models, where uniform frame sampling wastes capacity on irrelevant content in long-form videos. It introduces BOLT, a training-free frame-selection method, along with a multi-source retrieval evaluation setting, and finds inverse transform sampling to be the most effective strategy. It raises Video-MME accuracy from 53.8% to 56.1% and MLVU from 58.9% to 63.4%.
2503.21483|v2.assessment: 免训练、即插即用的帧选择策略实用性强，评测设置对长视频理解研究有参考价值。
2503.21483|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的长视频帧选择方法 BOLT 及多源检索评测设置。
2503.21483|v2.innovation: 系统比较帧选择策略并证明逆变换采样在噪声上下文下最优。
2503.21483|v2.result: Video-MME 从 53.8% 提升至 56.1%，MLVU 从 58.9% 提升至 63.4%。

2412.01095|v2.summary_cn: 针对可解释视频异常检测中现有方法需专门推理模块或指令微调、带来大量计算与标注开销的问题，作者提出 VERA，一种言语化学习框架，使 VLM 在不修改模型参数的情况下完成 VAD。VERA 自动将复杂推理分解为对更聚焦引导问题的反思，把这些问题视为可学习参数，通过学习者与优化器 VLM 之间数据驱动的言语交互、利用粗标注数据优化。该方法在无需参数更新与精细标注的前提下实现可解释异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.summary_en: This paper targets explainable video anomaly detection, where prior VLM-based methods require specialized reasoning modules or instruction tuning with heavy compute and annotation cost. It proposes VERA, a verbalized learning framework that decomposes complex reasoning into reflective guiding questions treated as learnable parameters, optimized through verbal interactions between learner and optimizer VLMs using coarsely labeled data. VERA achieves explainable VAD without modifying model parameters.
2412.01095|v2.assessment: 以言语化学习替代参数微调，思路新颖，对低标注成本的可解释视频异常检测有启发。
2412.01095|v2.contribution: 提出免参数更新的言语化学习框架 VERA 用于可解释视频异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.innovation: 将引导问题作为可学习参数，通过 VLM 间言语交互进行数据驱动优化。
2412.01095|v2.result: 在无需模型参数修改与精细标注下实现可解释 VAD。

2412.03735|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在视频理解中幻觉问题研究不足的现状，作者基于 MLLM 视觉编码器难以区分视觉不同但语义相似视频对的观察，提出 VidHalluc，目前最大的视频理解幻觉评测基准，包含 5,002 个配对视频，从动作、时序、场景转换三个维度评估幻觉。测试显示多数 MLLM 在这些维度上易产生幻觉；作者进一步提出免训练的 DINO-HEAL，利用 DINOv2 空间显著性在推理时重加权视觉特征，平均降低幻觉 3.02%。
2412.03735|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored hallucination problem in video understanding by MLLMs. It introduces VidHalluc, the largest benchmark with 5,002 paired videos assessing hallucinations along action, temporal sequence, and scene transition dimensions, showing most MLLMs are vulnerable. It further proposes DINO-HEAL, a training-free method that reweights visual features using DINOv2 spatial saliency, reducing hallucinations by an average of 3.02%.
2412.03735|v2.assessment: 视频幻觉评测基准填补空白，配套免训练缓解方法简单有效，对多模态可靠性研究有价值。
2412.03735|v2.contribution: 构建最大视频幻觉评测基准 VidHalluc 并提出免训练缓解方法 DINO-HEAL。
2412.03735|v2.innovation: 以配对视频从三维度系统评测视频幻觉，并用 DINOv2 显著性重加权特征。
2412.03735|v2.result: 多数 MLLM 存在幻觉，DINO-HEAL 平均降低幻觉 3.02%。

2411.13281|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频理解评测多依赖 VideoMME、LongVideoBench 等选择题基准、难以反映真实用户复杂需求且人工标注成本高的问题，作者提出 VideoAutoArena，一个受 LMSYS Chatbot Arena 启发的竞技场式基准。它通过用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题，采用改进的 ELO 评分系统进行公平持续比较，并用人工标注构建金标准验证自动评判与人类判断高度一致，同时引入故障驱动机制。
2411.13281|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of multiple-choice video benchmarks that fail to capture real-world user demands and are costly to annotate. It introduces VideoAutoArena, an arena-style benchmark inspired by LMSYS Chatbot Arena that uses user simulation to generate open-ended adaptive questions and a modified ELO rating for fair comparison. A human-annotated gold standard validates that the automated judging aligns strongly with human judgment.
2411.13281|v2.assessment: 竞技场式自动评测思路对视频 LMM 评估有参考意义，可扩展性优于人工标注基准。
2411.13281|v2.contribution: 提出基于用户模拟与 ELO 评分的自动化视频 LMM 竞技场基准 VideoAutoArena。
2411.13281|v2.innovation: 用用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题并以改进 ELO 系统持续比较模型。
2411.13281|v2.result: 自动评判与人工金标准高度一致，兼具可扩展性。

2412.10360|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频 LMM 中驱动视频理解的关键机制尚不清晰、设计决策缺乏依据且训练评测成本高昂的问题，作者开展系统性研究。首先审视高计算开销的主要来源，发现 Scaling Consistency：在较小模型与数据上做出的设计与训练决策可有效迁移到更大模型。基于此探索了视频采样、架构、数据组成、训练计划等多方面，例如证明训练时 fps 采样远优于均匀帧采样，并比较了最适合视频表示的视觉编码器。
2412.10360|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the poorly understood mechanisms driving video understanding in LMMs, where design decisions often lack justification and compute costs are high. It identifies Scaling Consistency, whereby design and training choices made on smaller models and datasets transfer effectively to larger ones, and leverages this to study video sampling, architectures, data composition, and training schedules. It shows, for example, that fps sampling during training is vastly preferable to uniform frame sampling and identifies the best vision encoders for video.
2412.10360|v2.assessment: 系统性强、结论可迁移，为视频 LMM 设计提供了实证指导，对多模态研究者参考价值高。
2412.10360|v2.contribution: 系统研究视频 LMM 的关键设计要素并提出 Scaling Consistency 规律。
2412.10360|v2.innovation: 揭示小模型决策可迁移至大模型的缩放一致性，并据此指导视频采样与架构选择。
2412.10360|v2.result: 证明训练时 fps 采样远优于均匀采样，并给出最优视频视觉编码器结论。

2504.07745|v2.summary_cn: 针对Video-LLM在细粒度视频理解（如视觉动态和细节查询）上的不足，提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T，利用视频固有特性进行训练，避免繁重标注并绕过自然语言难以捕捉复杂时空变化的局限。同时构建FineVidBench基准，从场景和片段两个层级评估Video-LLM。相比已有工作，该方法无需人工标注即可解锁更细粒度理解能力，并提供了更严格的评测协议。
2504.07745|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deficiency of Video-LLMs in fine-grained video understanding, particularly visual dynamics and detail queries. It proposes Self-Supervised Fragment Fine-Tuning (SF²T), which leverages inherent video characteristics for training without labor-intensive annotations, and introduces FineVidBench for scene- and fragment-level evaluation. The method unlocks finer-grained understanding while avoiding the limitations of natural language in capturing complex spatiotemporal variations.
2504.07745|v2.assessment: 对多模态视频理解有参考价值，但主要面向Video-LLM而非自动驾驶感知，相关度中等。
2504.07745|v2.contribution: 提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T及细粒度视频理解基准FineVidBench。
2504.07745|v2.innovation: 利用视频固有特性进行自监督片段微调，无需人工标注即可提升Video-LLM细粒度理解。
2504.07745|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称显著提升细粒度视频理解能力。

2411.11934|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目输入合成双目视频中高质量配对数据不足和时空一致性难以保持的问题，提出自监督双目视频合成范式SpatialDreamer，基于视频扩散模型。具体包括：基于深度的视频生成模块DVG，采用前向-后向渲染机制生成具有几何和时间先验的配对视频；基于DVG数据提出RefinerNet及自监督合成框架；设计一致性控制模块。相比现有NVS方法，能更好处理动态场景并减少训练数据需求。
2411.11934|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles stereo video synthesis from monocular input, addressing the scarcity of paired stereo videos and spatio-temporal consistency challenges. It proposes SpatialDreamer, a self-supervised paradigm via video diffusion, including a Depth-based Video Generation module (DVG) with forward-backward rendering, RefinerNet with a self-supervised synthesis framework, and a consistency control module. It improves dynamic scene handling and reduces training data requirements compared to existing NVS-based methods.
2411.11934|v2.assessment: 对视频生成和3D感知有启发，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度有限。
2411.11934|v2.contribution: 提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督双目视频合成范式SpatialDreamer。
2411.11934|v2.innovation: 结合深度前向-后向渲染与一致性控制模块，实现动态场景下的自监督双目视频合成。
2411.11934|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，但声称能有效应对动态场景和数据不足挑战。

2506.01037|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于扩散的视频超分方法易引入复杂退化和伪影的问题，提出噪声鲁棒的真实世界VSR框架，将自监督学习与Mamba融入预训练潜在扩散模型。通过Video State-Space块和3D选择性扫描模块增强全局时空注意力以保证帧间内容一致性；引入自监督ControlNet，利用HR特征作为引导并通过对比学习提取退化不敏感特征；提出基于HR-LR混合视频的三阶段训练策略。在真实世界VSR基准上取得优于SOTA的感知质量。
2506.01037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses artifacts and complex degradations in diffusion-based video super-resolution (VSR) by proposing a noise-robust real-world VSR framework that integrates self-supervised learning and Mamba into pre-trained latent diffusion models. It enhances spatio-temporal attention via a Video State-Space block with 3D Selective Scan, introduces a self-supervised ControlNet with contrastive learning for degradation-insensitive features, and employs a three-stage HR-LR mixed training strategy. It achieves superior perceptual quality over state-of-the-art on real-world VSR benchmarks.
2506.01037|v2.assessment: 对视频增强和自监督学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务相关度较低。
2506.01037|v2.contribution: 提出结合自监督ControlNet与时空Mamba的真实世界视频超分框架。
2506.01037|v2.innovation: 将3D选择性扫描Mamba与自监督ControlNet结合，提升扩散模型在VSR中的噪声鲁棒性和时空一致性。
2506.01037|v2.result: 在真实世界VSR基准数据集上取得优于现有方法的感知质量。

2601.04068|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到视频扩散模型与人类偏好对齐的问题，指出现有DPO方法依赖多样本排序和任务特定critic模型，效率低且全局监督信号模糊。作者提出LocalDPO后训练框架，通过随机时空掩码局部破坏真实高质量视频并用冻结基座模型仅修复掩码区域，从而以单次推理自动构建局部化偏好对，无需外部critic或人工标注。训练时引入区域感知DPO损失，将偏好学习限制在损坏区域以加速收敛。在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上实验表明，LocalDPO持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐效果。
2601.04068|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and ambiguous global supervision of existing DPO methods for text-to-video diffusion models, which rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critics. It proposes LocalDPO, a post-training framework that constructs localized preference pairs by corrupting real videos with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only masked regions using a frozen base model, enabling single-inference pair generation without external critics or manual annotation. A region-aware DPO loss restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for faster convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX show consistent improvements in video fidelity, temporal coherence, and human preference alignment.
2601.04068|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等目标领域几乎无关，属于视频生成与偏好对齐方向，对视觉感知研究者参考价值有限。
2601.04068|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需critic模型、基于局部时空掩码自动构建偏好对的视频扩散模型DPO后训练框架。
2601.04068|v2.innovation: 将偏好学习从全局视频级细化到时空区域级，并用冻结基座模型修复掩码区域生成负样本。
2601.04068|v2.result: 在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性与人类偏好对齐。

2004.07507|v2.summary_cn: 针对含 BatchNorm 层的深度网络在持续学习中的二次惩罚方法失效问题，作者指出 BN 导致样本间依赖，使标准 K-FAC 的 Hessian 近似不再成立。为此扩展 K-FAC 以纳入样本间关系，并提出 BN 统计参数的权重合并与重参数化方法，以及无需源任务数据的超参选择策略。在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 和 ImageNet→细粒度分类（ResNet-50）序列任务上均优于基线，且完全不使用源任务数据。
2004.07507|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the invalidity of K-FAC-based quadratic penalty in continual learning when batch normalization introduces inter-example dependencies. It extends K-FAC to account for such dependencies, and proposes weight merging/reparameterization for BN statistics plus a source-data-free hyperparameter selection scheme. Experiments on permuted MNIST with BN and ImageNet-to-fine-grained sequential learning with ResNet-50 show consistent gains over baselines without using source task data.
2004.07507|v2.assessment: 把 K-FAC 持续学习从无 BN 场景推广到实际常用的 BN 网络，并解决超参选择依赖源数据的问题，对持续学习落地有实际价值。
2004.07507|v2.contribution: 提出了考虑样本间依赖的扩展 K-FAC 近似，以及 BN 参数处理与无源数据超参选择方案。
2004.07507|v2.innovation: 首次指出 BN 破坏 K-FAC 的样本独立性假设并给出修正，同时实现完全无需源任务数据的持续学习流程。
2004.07507|v2.result: 在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 与 ResNet-50 的 ImageNet 序列细粒度分类上均超过基线方法。

2004.00440|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中分类层需不断扩增权重、且网络易发生灾难性遗忘的问题，本文转向嵌入网络（embedding network）的增量学习，使新类可自然纳入而无需新增权重。提出语义漂移（semantic drift）估计方法，利用当前任务数据的特征漂移来近似旧任务特征的漂移并进行补偿，且完全不需要保存样本。在 CIFAR100 和 ImageNet-Subset 细粒度数据集上验证，嵌入网络的遗忘显著更轻，方法优于现有无样本方法。
2004.00440|v2.summary_en: This work studies class-incremental learning for embedding networks, where new classes can be added without augmenting the classifier weights. It proposes a semantic drift estimation that approximates the feature drift of previous tasks from that observed on current task data, compensating it without any exemplars. Experiments on fine-grained CIFAR100 and ImageNet-Subset show embedding networks suffer much less catastrophic forgetting and the method outperforms exemplar-free baselines.
2004.00440|v2.assessment: 无样本（exemplar-free）设定对隐私与存储敏感场景很重要，语义漂移补偿思路简洁且可迁移到其他增量任务。
2004.00440|v2.contribution: 提出面向嵌入网络的类增量学习框架与无需样本的语义漂移补偿方法。
2004.00440|v2.innovation: 用当前任务数据的特征漂移来估计并补偿旧任务特征漂移，避免保存任何历史样本。
2004.00440|v2.result: 在 CIFAR100 与 ImageNet-Subset 上显著缓解遗忘，性能优于现有无样本增量方法。

2002.00718|v2.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中的增量学习问题，作者指出该任务特有的难点：每步训练只标注部分类别，导致背景类像素出现语义分布偏移，使现有增量学习方法失效。提出显式建模该背景偏移的蒸馏框架，并设计分类器参数初始化策略以抑制对背景类的偏置预测。在 Pascal-VOC 2012 和 ADE20K 上大幅超越当时的增量学习 SOTA。
2002.00718|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incremental learning for semantic segmentation, identifying a task-specific issue: since each step annotates only a subset of classes, background pixels undergo a semantic distribution shift that breaks existing incremental methods. It proposes a distillation framework explicitly modeling this shift and a classifier initialization strategy to avoid background-biased predictions. Extensive evaluation on Pascal-VOC 2012 and ADE20K significantly outperforms prior incremental learning state of the art.
2002.00718|v2.assessment: 把增量学习从分类推广到密集预测任务，并抓住背景类语义漂移这一关键差异，对自动驾驶感知的持续学习有直接参考意义。
2002.00718|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模背景语义漂移的蒸馏式增量语义分割框架及分类器初始化策略。
2002.00718|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析并解决增量语义分割中背景类的语义分布偏移与预测偏置问题。
2002.00718|v2.result: 在 Pascal-VOC 2012 与 ADE20K 上显著优于当时的增量学习 SOTA。

2003.13191|v2.summary_cn: 针对实际应用中增量学习面临的两大障碍——新类导致灾难性遗忘、旧类新观测带来概念漂移——本文提出可在在线场景运行的增量学习框架，同时处理新类数据与旧类新观测。方法通过改进的交叉蒸馏损失（cross-distillation loss）与两步学习技术应对在线模式下的遗忘问题。实验表明其性能优于当时的在线增量学习 SOTA，且训练时间更短。
2003.13191|v2.summary_en: The paper targets two obstacles for real-world incremental learning: catastrophic forgetting of old classes and concept drift caused by sequential new observations of old classes. It proposes an online incremental learning framework handling both new-class data and new observations of old classes, using a modified cross-distillation loss with a two-step learning scheme. Results outperform contemporary online incremental learning state of the art while requiring less training time.
2003.13191|v2.assessment: 在线增量设定更贴近真实部署，同时考虑概念漂移是相对少见的视角，但方法层面的新颖性一般。
2003.13191|v2.contribution: 提出可在线运行、同时处理新类与旧类新观测的增量学习框架。
2003.13191|v2.innovation: 将改进的交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习结合，在在线模式下兼顾抗遗忘与概念漂移。
2003.13191|v2.result: 性能超过当时在线增量学习 SOTA，并显著缩短训练时间。

2002.10211|v2.summary_cn: 针对多类增量学习中保留少量旧类样本效果高度依赖样本代表性的问题，本文提出 mnemonics 框架，将 exemplar 参数化并端到端可优化，通过模型级与 exemplar 级的双层优化进行训练。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset 和 ImageNet 三个基准上大幅超越 SOTA。有趣的是，学到的 mnemonics exemplar 往往落在不同类别的决策边界附近。
2002.10211|v2.summary_en: To address the strong dependence of exemplar-based multi-class incremental learning on exemplar representativeness, this paper proposes the mnemonics framework, which parameterizes exemplars and optimizes them end-to-end via bilevel optimization at the model and exemplar levels. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-Subset and ImageNet surpass state of the art by a large margin, and the learned exemplars intriguingly tend to lie on class boundaries.
2002.10211|v2.assessment: 把 exemplar 从静态采样变为可学习变量是干净且有效的思路，边界样本的发现对理解增量学习记忆机制有启发。
2002.10211|v2.contribution: 提出可端到端优化的 mnemonics exemplar 框架与双层优化训练流程。
2002.10211|v2.innovation: 将 exemplar 参数化并纳入双层优化，使记忆样本自动收敛到类间边界区域。
2002.10211|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset、ImageNet 上大幅超过 SOTA。

1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，作者发现知识蒸馏虽能维持旧类判别性，但无法阻止模型将样本误判为新类，且最后一层全连接层权重存在严重类别偏置。②提出简单有效的方案：先用知识蒸馏保持旧类判别性，再提出权重对齐（Weight Aligning, WA）在正常训练后校正FC层的偏置权重。③相比已有工作，WA无需额外训练即可同时维持旧类与新类之间的公平性。④实验表明该方法有效缓解灾难性遗忘，在多个类增量基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, showing that knowledge distillation (KD) preserves discrimination within old classes but fails to prevent samples from being classified into new classes due to biased weights in the last fully connected layer. The authors propose Weight Aligning (WA), which corrects the biased FC weights after normal training while using KD to maintain old-class discrimination. This simple post-hoc correction improves fairness between old and new classes and achieves superior performance on class incremental benchmarks.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 该工作对类增量学习中FC层权重偏置这一被忽视的因素给出了简洁有效的诊断与修正，方法轻量且即插即用，值得关注。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 揭示了FC层权重偏置是灾难性遗忘的关键因素，并提出无需额外训练的权重对齐方法。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 将知识蒸馏与训练后权重对齐相结合，同时兼顾旧类判别性与新旧类公平性。
1911.07053|v2.result: 在类增量学习基准上有效缓解灾难性遗忘，性能优于已有方法。

Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 利用对抗扰动增强跨任务特征表示的鲁棒性与共享性。

Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中数据类别分布不平衡导致遗忘加剧的问题，现有回放方法在长尾或类别不均衡场景下表现不佳。②提出分区蓄水池采样（Partitioning Reservoir Sampling）策略，在回放缓冲区中按类别分区以维持平衡。③相比标准蓄水池采样，能更好地应对类别不平衡的持续学习场景。④摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法确认。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_en: This paper addresses imbalanced continual learning, where class-imbalanced data streams exacerbate forgetting and standard replay methods underperform. It proposes Partitioning Reservoir Sampling to maintain class balance within the replay buffer. Due to the missing abstract, specific quantitative results cannot be verified.

GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习领域方法日益复杂但进展是否真实的问题，质疑现有复杂方法相对简单基线的实际优势。②提出GDumb这一极简方法：仅将样本贪心地存入内存，训练时在内存样本上从头训练模型。③相比众多复杂持续学习方法，GDumb无需复杂机制却常取得有竞争力的结果，揭示评估中的问题。④摘要缺失，但该工作以挑战领域进展著称，具体数据无法确认。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_en: This paper questions the progress in continual learning by showing that a simple approach, GDumb, which greedily stores samples in memory and trains from scratch on them, often matches or outperforms complex methods. It highlights issues in current evaluation protocols and challenges the claimed advances of sophisticated continual learning algorithms. PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: 针对小任务增量学习（small-task incremental learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，论文提出 PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）在中间层与最终层同时约束新旧特征的空间统计量。方法结合了空间维度池化的蒸馏损失与分类损失，并引入多尺度池化以增强对任务序列的鲁棒性。相比 LwF、iCaRL 等仅约束最终输出的方法，PODNet 在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 子集上显著降低遗忘。在 CIFAR-100 20 任务设定下，PODNet 的最终精度比 LwF 提升约 10 个百分点，且无需存储大量旧样本。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: PODNet addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning by distilling pooled intermediate and final feature statistics between old and new models. It combines spatial-pooled distillation losses with multi-scale pooling to preserve spatial information across tasks. On CIFAR-100 and ImageNet subsets, PODNet outperforms LwF and iCaRL by a large margin, e.g., about 10 points higher final accuracy on CIFAR-100 with 20 tasks, while using limited exemplars.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该工作将特征蒸馏从输出层扩展到中间层池化统计，是增量学习领域简洁有效的改进，实验充分，值得关注。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出池化输出蒸馏损失，在中间层与最终层同时约束新旧模型特征的空间统计量以缓解遗忘。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 将空间池化引入蒸馏目标，并设计多尺度池化以增强小任务增量学习的稳定性。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在 CIFAR-100 20 任务设定下最终精度比 LwF 提升约 10 个百分点，且无需大量旧样本。
