Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中存储旧样本导致内存开销大的问题，论文提出通过特征自适应（Feature Adaptation）实现内存高效的增量学习。方法在旧任务特征提取器上学习一个轻量自适应模块，将新特征映射回旧特征空间，从而只需存储少量旧样本的特征而非原始图像。相比 iCaRL 等需保存大量原图的方法，该方法在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 上以更小内存达到相近或更优精度。实验表明在相同内存预算下，其精度比存储原图的方法高约 2-3 个百分点。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: This paper tackles the memory overhead of storing old samples in incremental learning by learning a lightweight feature adaptation module that maps new features back to the old feature space. It stores only compact feature representations instead of raw images, reducing memory while preserving performance. On CIFAR-100 and ImageNet, it matches or surpasses iCaRL under much smaller memory budgets, with about 2-3 points higher accuracy at equal memory.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 该工作从特征存储角度切入增量学习的内存瓶颈，思路清晰，实验对比合理，对实际部署有参考价值。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出特征自适应模块，用存储特征替代原始图像以实现内存高效的增量学习。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 通过学习新旧特征空间映射，在极低内存下保持旧任务知识。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在相同内存预算下精度比存储原图的方法高约 2-3 个百分点。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中特征空间拓扑结构被破坏导致旧类混淆的问题，论文提出拓扑保持（Topology-Preserving）类增量学习方法。方法在训练新类时引入拓扑约束损失，保持类间相对距离与类内紧凑性，从而缓解遗忘。相比仅用交叉熵与蒸馏的方法，该方法在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet 子集上提升了旧类精度。实验显示在 10 任务设定下平均精度提升约 2-4 个百分点。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the distortion of feature-space topology in class-incremental learning, which causes confusion among old classes. It introduces a topology-preserving loss that maintains inter-class distances and intra-class compactness when learning new classes. On CIFAR-100 and ImageNet subsets, it improves old-class accuracy by about 2-4 points over distillation-only baselines in 10-task settings.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 从特征拓扑角度缓解遗忘有一定新意，但整体提升幅度有限，适合作为增量学习的补充思路。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出拓扑保持损失，在类增量学习中维持特征空间的类间与类内结构。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 将拓扑约束引入类增量学习以保护旧类特征分布。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在 10 任务设定下平均精度比蒸馏基线提升约 2-4 个百分点。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据流类别不平衡导致模型偏向多数类的问题，论文提出面向不平衡数据的在线持续学习方法。方法结合重采样与损失重加权策略，在单遍数据流下动态调整各类别贡献。相比标准在线持续学习基线，该方法在 CIFAR-10/100 的不平衡流设定下提升了少数类精度与整体平均精度。实验表明在高度不平衡流下平均精度提升约 3-5 个百分点。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper studies online continual learning from imbalanced data streams, where models tend to bias toward majority classes. It proposes a combination of resampling and loss reweighting that dynamically adjusts class contributions in a single pass. On imbalanced CIFAR-10/100 streams, it improves minority-class and overall accuracy by about 3-5 points over standard online continual learning baselines.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 关注在线持续学习中的类别不平衡这一现实问题，方法实用，但创新性中等。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出面向不平衡数据流的在线持续学习重采样与重加权策略。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 在单遍在线设定下动态平衡类别贡献以缓解多数类偏置。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在高度不平衡流下平均精度提升约 3-5 个百分点。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: 针对神经主题模型在动态语料上需反复重训练的问题，论文提出结合持续终身学习（continual lifelong learning）的神经主题建模方法。方法在 VAE 主题模型上引入持续学习机制，使模型能增量适应新文档而不遗忘旧主题。相比从头重训练，该方法在多个文本语料上保持主题质量的同时显著降低训练开销。实验显示在新增文档流下主题一致性指标下降不超过 5%。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: This paper addresses the need to retrain neural topic models on evolving corpora by integrating continual lifelong learning into a VAE-based topic model. The model incrementally adapts to new documents while retaining previously learned topics. On several text corpora, it maintains topic quality with substantially lower training cost, with topic coherence dropping by no more than 5% under document streams.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 将持续学习引入主题建模有一定交叉价值，但与视觉/自动驾驶领域相关度低，仅供方法借鉴。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 提出结合持续终身学习的神经主题模型以增量适应动态语料。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 在 VAE 主题模型上引入持续学习机制避免重训练遗忘。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 在新增文档流下主题一致性下降不超过 5% 且训练开销显著降低。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: 论文从理论角度分析持续学习的最优解，证明在一般设定下最优持续学习需要完美记忆（perfect memory），且问题是 NP-hard 的。作者通过形式化定义与归约证明，揭示了持续学习在计算复杂度上的本质困难。该结论为理解现有方法的近似性与局限性提供了理论依据，说明任何有限记忆方法都无法保证全局最优。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of optimal continual learning, proving that it requires perfect memory and is NP-hard in general settings. Through formal definitions and reductions, it reveals the intrinsic computational difficulty of continual learning. The results justify the approximate nature and limitations of existing finite-memory methods, showing no such method can guarantee global optimality.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 理论性强，为持续学习的困难性提供了严格证明，对理解方法边界有参考价值，但无实验方法贡献。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习需要完美记忆且为 NP-hard。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 从计算复杂度角度形式化刻画持续学习的本质困难。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 给出最优持续学习需完美记忆且 NP-hard 的理论结论。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: 针对持续学习（continual learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，论文提出一种前瞻式元学习（look-ahead meta learning）方法，通过在任务序列上模拟未来任务的梯度更新来优化当前参数。与已有基于经验回放或正则化的方法不同，该方法在元学习框架中显式考虑未来任务的适应过程，从而学习到更利于后续任务快速适应的初始化。实验在多个持续学习基准上验证了该方法在缓解遗忘和提升前向迁移方面的有效性，优于标准经验回放和EWC等基线。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a look-ahead meta-learning approach that simulates gradient updates on future tasks to optimize current parameters. Unlike existing rehearsal- or regularization-based methods, it explicitly accounts for future task adaptation within a meta-learning framework to learn an initialization favorable for subsequent tasks. Experiments on standard continual learning benchmarks demonstrate improved resistance to forgetting and forward transfer over baselines such as experience replay and EWC.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 该工作将元学习与持续学习结合，前瞻式优化思路对在线持续学习场景有启发意义，值得关注。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出前瞻式元学习框架，通过模拟未来任务更新来优化持续学习中的参数初始化。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 在元学习目标中显式引入对未来任务适应过程的模拟，以缓解遗忘并促进前向迁移。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于经验回放和EWC等基线，有效降低遗忘并提升前向迁移。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: 针对持续学习和流式数据场景中如何选择代表性样本（coreset）的问题，论文提出一种基于双层优化（bilevel optimization）的coreset构建方法。该方法将coreset选择建模为外层优化目标（如最终模型性能）与内层模型训练的双层问题，从而选出对训练最有价值的样本子集。相比基于几何或损失的传统coreset方法，该双层框架能更直接地优化下游任务性能。实验表明在持续学习和流式学习任务上，该方法在有限内存预算下取得了优于随机采样和经典coreset基线的精度。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: This paper tackles coreset selection for continual learning and streaming by formulating it as a bilevel optimization problem, where the outer level optimizes downstream performance and the inner level trains the model on the selected subset. Unlike geometric or loss-based coreset methods, this approach directly optimizes for task performance. Experiments show improved accuracy over random sampling and classical coreset baselines under limited memory budgets in continual and streaming settings.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 将coreset选择与双层优化结合，为持续学习中的内存高效回放提供了新视角，具有实用价值。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 提出基于双层优化的coreset构建方法，用于持续学习和流式学习中的样本选择。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 将coreset选择建模为直接优化下游性能的双层优化问题，而非依赖几何或损失启发式。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 在有限内存预算下，持续学习和流式学习任务上精度优于随机采样和经典coreset基线。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: 针对一般持续学习（general continual learning）中任务边界模糊、数据分布渐变的问题，论文提出Dark Experience Replay（DER）方法，通过回放模型在历史样本上的logits（dark knowledge）并结合当前交叉熵损失来缓解遗忘。与仅回放原始样本或标签的方法不同，DER同时匹配历史预测分布，从而更好地保留旧知识。该方法简单且无需任务边界信息，在多个一般持续学习基准上取得了当时的最优或接近最优性能，成为强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses general continual learning with blurred task boundaries and gradually shifting distributions by proposing Dark Experience Replay (DER), which replays past logits (dark knowledge) alongside current cross-entropy loss to mitigate forgetting. Unlike methods that replay only raw samples or labels, DER matches historical predictive distributions to better preserve old knowledge. Simple and task-boundary-free, it achieves state-of-the-art or near-state-of-the-art results on general continual learning benchmarks, establishing a strong baseline.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: DER以极简设计取得强性能，是持续学习领域被广泛引用的强基线，值得深入关注。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出Dark Experience Replay，通过回放历史logits缓解一般持续学习中的遗忘。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 将dark knowledge回放引入持续学习，匹配历史预测分布而非仅回放样本或标签。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在多个一般持续学习基准上达到当时最优或接近最优性能，成为强基线方法。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中快速适应新任务与积累旧知识之间的矛盾，论文提出OSAKA（Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation）方法。该方法将在线持续学习形式化为需要同时进行快速适应和知识积累的问题，并设计了一种结合元学习与经验回放的框架来平衡二者。相比仅关注遗忘或仅关注快速适应的已有方法，OSAKA在任务分布变化和任务边界未知的在线场景下表现更优。实验表明其在多个在线持续学习基准上取得了更好的精度-遗忘权衡。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the tension between fast adaptation to new tasks and accumulation of prior knowledge in online continual learning by proposing OSAKA (Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation). It formalizes online continual learning as requiring both rapid adaptation and knowledge retention, and designs a framework combining meta-learning with experience replay to balance the two. Unlike methods focusing solely on forgetting or fast adaptation, OSAKA performs better under shifting task distributions and unknown task boundaries, achieving improved accuracy-forgetting trade-offs on online continual learning benchmarks.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: OSAKA明确区分快速适应与知识积累两个目标，对在线持续学习的设定和评估有推动作用。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出OSAKA框架，结合元学习与经验回放以同时实现在线快速适应和知识积累。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 将在线持续学习形式化为快速适应与知识积累的双重目标问题，并给出统一求解框架。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上取得更好的精度-遗忘权衡，优于仅关注遗忘或适应的基线。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中参数更新导致旧任务知识被覆盖的问题，论文提出在低秩正交子空间中进行持续学习的方法。该方法将每个任务的学习限制在与其他任务正交的低秩子空间中，从而减少任务间的参数干扰。与仅使用正交约束或仅使用低秩分解的方法不同，该工作将两者结合，在保持参数效率的同时增强任务隔离。实验表明在多个持续学习基准上，该方法在缓解遗忘和保持可塑性方面优于现有正交或子空间方法。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge overwriting in continual learning by restricting each task's learning to a low-rank subspace orthogonal to those of other tasks, thereby reducing inter-task parameter interference. Unlike methods using only orthogonality constraints or only low-rank decomposition, it combines both to enhance task isolation while maintaining parameter efficiency. Experiments on continual learning benchmarks show improved resistance to forgetting and preserved plasticity over existing orthogonal or subspace methods.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 低秩正交子空间的结合为持续学习中的参数隔离提供了有效且优雅的方案，值得关注。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出在低秩正交子空间中进行持续学习，以减少任务间参数干扰。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 将低秩分解与正交子空间约束结合，实现参数高效的任务隔离。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有正交或子空间方法，有效缓解遗忘并保持可塑性。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中遗忘问题，论文提出实例感知参数化（instance-aware parameterization）方法，为不同输入实例动态选择或生成参数子集，从而减少新旧任务间的参数冲突。与全局共享参数或任务级参数隔离的方法不同，该方法在实例级别进行参数调制，更细粒度地缓解遗忘。实验表明在在线持续学习基准上，该方法在保持对新任务适应能力的同时显著降低了旧任务性能下降。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in online continual learning by proposing instance-aware parameterization, which dynamically selects or generates parameter subsets for different input instances to reduce parameter conflicts between old and new tasks. Unlike globally shared parameters or task-level isolation, it performs instance-level parameter modulation for finer-grained forgetting mitigation. Experiments on online continual learning benchmarks show significantly reduced degradation on old tasks while maintaining adaptability to new ones.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 实例级参数化思路为在线持续学习提供了更细粒度的遗忘缓解手段，具有研究价值。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出实例感知参数化方法，通过实例级参数调制缓解在线持续学习中的遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 在实例级别动态选择或生成参数子集，实现比任务级隔离更细粒度的遗忘缓解。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在在线持续学习基准上显著降低旧任务性能下降，同时保持对新任务的适应能力。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中任务边界模糊、类别重叠这一更贴近现实但研究较少的设定，作者指出情景记忆中的样本多样性是关键。提出 Rainbow Memory（RM），基于每样本分类不确定性和数据增强来管理记忆缓冲区，从而提升记忆样本的多样性。在 MNIST、CIFAR10/100 和 ImageNet 上验证，在模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时 SOTA，且方法简单。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the realistic but under-studied setting of continual learning with blurry task boundaries, where tasks share classes. It argues for the importance of sample diversity in episodic memory and proposes Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR10/100, and ImageNet show large accuracy gains over state-of-the-art methods in blurry continual learning despite the method's simplicity.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 对持续学习设定提出了更现实的模糊任务边界问题，记忆多样性策略简单有效，但领域与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于不确定性与数据增强的 Rainbow Memory 记忆管理策略，应对模糊任务边界的持续学习。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 将样本多样性引入情景记忆管理，用分类不确定性筛选并增强记忆样本。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在 MNIST/CIFAR/ImageNet 的模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时 SOTA。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中严重遗忘和内存开销大的问题，作者从信息论视角分析，发现遗忘源于学习新任务时参数上旧任务信息增益的丢失。提出 Bit-Level Information Preserving（BLIP），通过参数量化在比特级别更新参数，先量化训练新任务，再估计每个参数的信息增益以决定冻结哪些比特。在分类到强化学习任务上实验，效果优于或持平于已有方法。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This work studies continual learning through an information-theoretic lens, observing that forgetting stems from the loss of information gain on parameters from previous tasks. It proposes Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP), which quantizes weights and freezes specific bits based on estimated per-parameter information gain to prevent forgetting. Extensive experiments from classification to reinforcement learning show better or on-par results compared to prior methods.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 从信息论角度解释遗忘并给出比特级冻结方案，思路新颖，但实验规模与感知任务关联有限。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出比特级信息保持（BLIP）方法，通过量化与比特冻结缓解持续学习遗忘。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 用信息增益视角解释遗忘，并在比特级别选择性冻结参数。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类与强化学习任务上取得优于或持平于已有方法的表现。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: 针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，尤其是测试集包含训练集未见类别的任务增量广义零样本学习问题，作者提出基于权重校正与仿射变换的方法。通过用极少参数对旧任务权重进行'校正'以适配新任务，并对网络输出学习仿射变换以更好适应新任务。在多个数据集的零样本与非零样本任务增量设定下实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles task incremental learning and its generalized zero-shot variant, where test classes may be unseen during training. It proposes weight rectifications and affine transformations with very few parameters to adapt network weights and outputs to sequentially arriving tasks. Experiments on several datasets in both zero-shot and non zero-shot settings empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 将权重校正与仿射变换结合用于任务增量及广义零样本设定，参数高效，但领域相关性一般。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重校正与仿射变换的任务增量学习方法，兼容零样本与广义零样本设定。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 用极少参数对旧任务权重进行校正并学习输出仿射变换以适配新任务。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集的零样本与非零样本任务增量设定下验证了有效性。

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督持续学习（Semi-Supervised Continual Learning）中如何有效利用增量无标签数据的问题展开研究。作者提出ORDisCo方法，通过结合增量无标签数据与有标签数据来缓解灾难性遗忘，并提升模型在新任务上的泛化能力。相比已有仅依赖有标签数据的持续学习方法，ORDisCo在数据利用效率和计算开销之间取得了更好的平衡。实验表明该方法在多个基准上有效提升了持续学习的性能，同时保持了较高的训练效率。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised continual learning by effectively leveraging incremental unlabeled data. The authors propose ORDisCo, which integrates unlabeled data with labeled samples to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and improve generalization on new tasks. Compared with prior continual learning methods that rely solely on labeled data, ORDisCo achieves a better trade-off between data efficiency and computational cost, demonstrating improved performance on multiple benchmarks.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 该工作关注持续学习中无标签数据的利用，思路实用，但整体与自动驾驶感知核心任务的直接关联有限。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出ORDisCo方法，实现增量无标签数据在半监督持续学习中的高效利用。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 将增量无标签数据与持续学习结合，在数据利用与计算效率间取得平衡。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在多个持续学习基准上有效提升性能并保持较高训练效率。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本增量学习（Few-Shot Incremental Learning）中模型在新类别样本极少时容易遗忘旧类知识的问题。作者提出持续演化分类器（Continually Evolved Classifiers, CEC）方法，通过动态调整分类器参数以适应新类，同时利用知识蒸馏保持旧类响应稳定。相比固定分类器的增量学习方法，CEC在多个小样本增量学习基准上取得了显著提升，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot incremental learning, where models must learn new classes from very few samples without forgetting old ones. The authors propose Continually Evolved Classifiers (CEC), which dynamically adapt classifier parameters to new classes while using knowledge distillation to stabilize old-class responses. Compared with fixed-classifier incremental methods, CEC achieves significant improvements on multiple few-shot incremental benchmarks, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: 该工作在小样本增量学习方向具有较强创新性，分类器演化思路对持续学习研究有参考价值。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续演化分类器方法，解决小样本增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 通过动态演化分类器参数并结合知识蒸馏，实现新旧类别的平衡学习。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在多个小样本增量学习基准上取得显著性能提升。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: 该论文针对图像去雨（Image De-Raining）任务中模型需要适应不同雨型而容易遗忘已学知识的问题。作者将持续学习引入图像去雨，提出基于持续学习的去雨方法，使模型能够顺序学习多种雨型而不发生灾难性遗忘。相比传统单独训练或联合训练的去雨方法，该方法在多雨型场景下表现出更好的泛化能力和知识保持能力。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper addresses image de-raining by introducing continual learning to handle multiple rain types without forgetting previously learned ones. The authors propose a continual learning-based de-raining method that sequentially learns different rain patterns while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Compared with conventional separate or joint training approaches, the method achieves better generalization and knowledge retention across multiple rain types.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 该工作将持续学习应用于图像去雨，选题较新颖，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 将持续学习引入图像去雨任务，实现多雨型顺序学习。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 首次将持续学习框架应用于图像去雨，缓解多雨型学习中的遗忘问题。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..result: 在多雨型场景下表现出更好的泛化能力和知识保持能力。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出现有知识蒸馏方法在保持旧知识时存在局限性。作者提出一种基于测地路径（Geodesic Path）的知识蒸馏方法，首先为旧响应和当前响应构建低维流形，然后沿连接两个流形的测地线最小化响应差异。相比传统蒸馏方法，该方法诱导出更平滑的知识蒸馏特性，能更有效地保留旧知识，在增量学习基准上取得了优于现有技术的性能。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning, noting limitations of existing knowledge distillation methods. The authors propose a geodesic path-based distillation approach that constructs low-dimensional manifolds for previous and current responses and minimizes their dissimilarity along the geodesic connecting the manifolds. Compared with prior distillation techniques, this induces smoother knowledge distillation and better preserves past knowledge, achieving superior performance on incremental learning benchmarks.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 该工作在知识蒸馏理论层面有较深创新，测地路径思路对持续学习研究具有启发意义。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地路径的知识蒸馏方法，用于增量学习中的灾难性遗忘缓解。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 通过构建低维流形并沿测地线最小化响应差异，实现更平滑的知识蒸馏。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在增量学习基准上取得优于现有技术的性能，更有效地保留旧知识。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中表示优化和原型重组监督不足的问题。作者提出一种增量原型学习方案，包含随机片段选择策略和自提升原型细化机制，其中动态关系投影模块在共享嵌入空间中计算关系矩阵以引导原型更新。相比现有方法，该方法在三个基准数据集上分别以13%、17%和11%的幅度超越最先进方法，显著提升了增量学习性能。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning, where representation optimization and prototype reorganization suffer from limited supervision. The authors propose an incremental prototype learning scheme with random episode selection and a self-promoted prototype refinement mechanism, where a dynamic relation projection module computes relation matrices in a shared embedding space to bootstrap prototype updates. The method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches by margins of 13%, 17%, and 11% on three benchmark datasets.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: 该工作在小样本类增量学习方向性能提升显著，原型细化机制设计巧妙，值得关注。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出增量原型学习方案，解决小样本类增量学习中的原型重组问题。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 设计自提升原型细化机制和动态关系投影模块，增强新类表达能力。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上分别以13%、17%和11%的幅度超越最先进方法。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中每类仅有少量样本导致标准增量学习方法难以直接应用的问题。作者提出一种语义感知知识蒸馏算法，利用词嵌入作为廉价语义信息辅助蒸馏过程，并设计基于注意力机制的多并行视觉嵌入对齐方法，将视觉与语义向量对齐以减少灾难性遗忘。在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100数据集上，该方法超越了现有方法，建立了新的最先进结果。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where only a few examples per concept make standard incremental learning techniques inapplicable. The authors propose a semantic-aware knowledge distillation algorithm that leverages word embeddings as cheap semantic information to facilitate distillation, and an attention-based method aligning multiple parallel visual embeddings with semantic vectors to reduce catastrophic forgetting. Experiments on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100 establish new state-of-the-art results.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 该工作将语义信息引入小样本类增量学习，思路新颖，在多个数据集上验证有效。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知知识蒸馏算法，解决小样本类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 利用词嵌入作为语义信息并结合注意力机制对齐视觉与语义向量。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100上超越现有方法，建立新的最先进结果。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文从因果角度分析数据在增量学习中的作用。作者提出通过因果推断分离数据中的因果效应与虚假相关，并据此设计蒸馏策略以保留旧类知识。相比传统知识蒸馏方法，该方法更关注数据分布变化带来的因果结构变化，从而在增量任务中更有效地缓解遗忘。实验在标准类增量基准上取得优于基线方法的性能。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning from a causal perspective. It proposes to distill the causal effect of data by disentangling causal and spurious correlations, thereby preserving old-class knowledge more effectively than conventional distillation. Experiments on standard class-incremental benchmarks demonstrate improved performance over baselines.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 从因果视角切入增量学习，为缓解遗忘提供了新的理论解释和实用蒸馏策略，值得关注。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出基于因果效应的数据蒸馏方法用于类增量学习。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将因果推断引入类增量学习，分离数据中的因果与虚假相关。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.result: 在类增量基准上优于传统蒸馏基线，有效缓解遗忘。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中网络容量固定导致新旧类冲突的问题，本文提出自适应聚合网络（Adaptive Aggregation Networks）。该方法动态聚合不同深度的特征或不同子网络的输出，使模型在增量过程中自适应地平衡新旧类表征。相比固定架构的增量学习方法，该网络能更灵活地适应新类分布。实验在多个类增量基准上取得领先性能。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This paper tackles class-incremental learning by proposing Adaptive Aggregation Networks that dynamically aggregate features or subnet outputs across depths. The adaptive aggregation balances old and new class representations more flexibly than fixed architectures. Experiments on multiple class-incremental benchmarks show state-of-the-art performance.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 自适应聚合机制为增量学习中的容量分配提供了有效方案，实验充分，值得关注。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 提出自适应聚合网络用于类增量学习。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 动态聚合不同深度特征以平衡新旧类表征。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.result: 在多个类增量基准上达到领先性能。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度模型在增量学习中因黑箱优化导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出基于率缩减（rate reduction）原理的白箱架构。每一层网络显式计算而非依赖反向传播，给定预训练网络和新类数据，可证明地构造出模拟联合训练所有旧类和新类的新网络。在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，该方法分类性能衰减显著小于现有最优方法，验证了白箱算法在复杂图像增量学习中的有效性。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning by proposing a white-box architecture derived from the principle of rate reduction, where each layer is explicitly computed without backpropagation. Given a pre-trained network and new classes, it provably constructs a new network emulating joint training over all past and new classes. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 show significantly less performance decay, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 白箱架构为增量学习提供了可证明的构造性方案，理论贡献突出，实验效果显著。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出基于率缩减的白箱增量学习架构。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 无需反向传播，可证明地构造模拟联合训练的新网络。
2011.14593|v2.result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上性能衰减远小于现有最优方法。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中旧类样本不可用导致的遗忘问题，本文提出原型增强与自监督相结合的方法。通过为旧类生成增强原型以模拟其分布，并利用自监督学习增强特征表征的泛化性，从而在无旧样本条件下更好地保留旧类知识。相比仅依赖原型或仅依赖自监督的方法，该联合策略在多个增量基准上取得更优性能。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in class-incremental learning when old-class samples are unavailable. It proposes prototype augmentation combined with self-supervision to simulate old-class distributions and enhance feature generalization. The joint strategy outperforms methods relying solely on prototypes or self-supervision on multiple incremental benchmarks.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 原型增强与自监督的结合有效缓解无旧样本下的遗忘，方法简洁且实验充分。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出原型增强与自监督联合的类增量学习方法。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 利用增强原型模拟旧类分布并引入自监督提升泛化。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.result: 在多个增量基准上优于仅用原型或自监督的方法。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对真实世界中在线持续目标检测的挑战，本文提出Wanderlust方法。该方法在数据流不断到达且无任务边界的情况下，实现在线持续学习目标检测，解决了现有持续检测方法依赖离线任务划分的问题。相比已有工作，Wanderlust更贴近实际自动驾驶场景中的在线感知需求。实验表明其在真实世界在线检测场景中有效缓解遗忘并保持检测性能。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual object detection in the real world, where data streams arrive without task boundaries. It proposes Wanderlust, which enables online continual learning for object detection without relying on offline task splits. Experiments show it mitigates forgetting and maintains detection performance in realistic online scenarios.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 面向真实在线场景的持续目标检测，与自动驾驶感知高度相关，方法实用性强。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 提出面向真实世界的在线持续目标检测方法Wanderlust。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 在无任务边界的在线数据流中实现持续目标检测。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 在真实在线检测场景中有效缓解遗忘并保持性能。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，本文提出相应的增量学习方法。视频动作识别面临时序信息复杂、类间差异细微等挑战，传统增量学习方法难以直接适用。作者设计了针对视频特征的增量学习策略，在保留旧动作类别知识的同时学习新类别。实验表明该方法在视频动作识别增量基准上优于通用增量学习基线。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for action recognition in videos, where temporal complexity and subtle inter-class differences challenge conventional incremental methods. It proposes an incremental learning strategy tailored to video features, preserving old action knowledge while learning new classes. Experiments show it outperforms general incremental learning baselines on video action recognition benchmarks.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 将类增量学习拓展到视频动作识别，填补了该方向的研究空白，与视频理解领域相关。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习方法。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 针对视频时序特征设计增量学习策略。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 在视频动作识别增量基准上优于通用增量学习基线。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: ①现有持续学习研究多依赖人工构造的、分布近似平稳的数据流，与真实场景中自然发生的分布漂移不符；②本文构建了基于视觉数据的在线持续学习基准，采用真实视频流中自然出现的分布偏移，并系统评估了多种持续学习方法在该设定下的表现；③相比以往使用 i.i.d. 或人工打乱的数据流，本文强调在线、单遍、非平稳的评估协议，更贴近实际部署；④实验表明现有方法在自然分布漂移下性能显著下降，揭示了在线持续学习在真实场景中的挑战。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between existing continual learning benchmarks and real-world non-stationary data streams. It introduces an online continual learning benchmark with natural distribution shifts derived from visual data, and empirically evaluates representative methods under single-pass, non-i.i.d. conditions. Results show that current approaches degrade substantially under natural shifts, highlighting the difficulty of realistic online continual learning.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 该工作为在线持续学习提供了更贴近真实的评估基准，对关注实际部署的研究者有重要参考价值。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 构建了基于自然分布漂移的在线持续学习视觉基准并系统评估现有方法。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 用真实视频流中的自然分布偏移替代人工构造的平稳数据流进行评估。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 揭示现有持续学习方法在自然分布漂移下性能显著下降。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①持续学习中灾难性遗忘与表示学习之间的矛盾尚未很好解决，尤其缺乏对自监督对比学习的系统利用；②本文提出 Co2L，将对比学习与持续学习结合，通过对比损失增强表示的可迁移性，并设计了对持续学习友好的对比训练策略；③相比仅依赖回放或正则化的方法，Co2L 利用对比学习提升特征泛化能力，缓解任务间干扰；④在多个持续学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，验证了对比学习对持续学习的有效性。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by integrating contrastive learning into the training objective. The proposed Co2L method learns transferable representations via contrastive losses tailored for sequential tasks, improving over replay- and regularization-based baselines. Experiments on standard continual learning benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将对比学习引入持续学习是自然且有效的方向，方法简洁且实验充分，值得关注。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出 Co2L，将对比学习与持续学习结合以缓解灾难性遗忘。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 设计面向持续学习的对比训练策略以增强表示可迁移性。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: ①现实数据流常含噪声标签，而现有持续学习方法多假设标签干净，噪声会通过回放被放大；②本文提出自净化回放（Self-Purified Replay）机制，在回放缓冲区中识别并修正噪声样本，结合鲁棒训练策略提升持续学习在噪声流下的稳定性；③相比直接回放或简单过滤，本文方法在保持记忆多样性的同时抑制噪声传播；④在含噪持续学习基准上取得优于基线方法的性能，验证了自净化回放的有效性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning on noisy data streams, where label noise is amplified through replay. It proposes a self-purified replay mechanism that identifies and corrects noisy samples in the memory buffer, combined with robust training. Experiments show improved performance over standard replay baselines under noisy streams.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: ①小样本学习与持续学习都面临数据有限和任务间干扰的问题，二者结合的研究尚不充分；②本文提出基于注意力独立机制（Attentive Independent Mechanisms）的方法，通过注意力模块分离任务相关特征，缓解小样本与持续学习中的干扰；③相比统一特征表示的方法，本文显式建模任务间独立性；④在少样本和持续学习基准上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了机制的有效性。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: This paper addresses the combination of few-shot and continual learning, where limited data and inter-task interference coexist. It proposes Attentive Independent Mechanisms that disentangle task-relevant features via attention modules. Experiments on few-shot and continual benchmarks show competitive performance.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 将注意力机制用于小样本持续学习，思路合理但影响力相对有限。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出注意力独立机制以同时应对小样本与持续学习。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 通过注意力模块显式分离任务相关特征以缓解干扰。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在少样本和持续学习基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: ①语义分割模型在新类别或新域上持续学习时易发生灾难性遗忘，而分割任务对空间结构敏感；②本文提出 RECALL，基于回放的持续学习框架，通过存储并回放代表性样本以保持旧类别的分割能力；③相比分类任务中的回放方法，RECALL 针对分割的密集预测特性设计了回放与损失策略；④在语义分割持续学习基准上显著缓解遗忘，取得优于现有方法的性能。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual semantic segmentation, where dense prediction is sensitive to spatial structure. It proposes RECALL, a replay-based continual learning framework that stores and replays representative samples with segmentation-specific losses. Experiments show reduced forgetting and improved performance over existing methods.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 将回放式持续学习扩展到语义分割，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习有参考价值。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出面向语义分割的回放式持续学习框架 RECALL。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 针对密集预测特性设计回放与损失策略以缓解分割遗忘。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在语义分割持续学习基准上显著缓解遗忘并优于现有方法。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: ①人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）面临新型攻击不断出现的问题，传统方法难以泛化到未见攻击类型；②本文提出检测并持续学习新型人脸呈现攻击的框架，结合开集检测与持续学习，识别新攻击并增量更新模型；③相比固定类别的 PAD 方法，本文能发现并适应新攻击类型；④实验表明该方法在检测已知攻击的同时能有效识别并持续学习新型攻击，提升长期鲁棒性。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: This paper addresses face presentation attack detection (PAD) under evolving attack types, where models must generalize to unseen attacks. It proposes a framework combining open-set detection with continual learning to identify and incrementally learn novel attacks. Experiments show effective detection of known attacks and improved adaptation to new ones.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出检测并持续学习新型人脸呈现攻击的框架。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 结合开集检测与持续学习以发现并适应新攻击类型。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 在检测已知攻击的同时有效识别并持续学习新型攻击。

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在持续学习中直接应用CNN-based方法会导致严重性能退化的问题，本文提出MEta-ATtention (MEAT)，即对自注意力进行注意力掩码，以适配预训练ViT到新任务而不牺牲旧任务性能。与Piggyback等对所有参数加掩码的方法不同，MEAT利用ViT特性仅对部分参数进行掩码，从而更高效。实验表明MEAT在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法，同时参数效率更高。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of ViT-backed continual learning when CNN-based methods are directly applied. It proposes MEta-ATtention (MEAT), which masks only a portion of ViT parameters via attention to self-attention, unlike prior mask-based methods that mask all parameters. MEAT achieves higher performance and efficiency on continual learning benchmarks.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究ViT持续学习并利用其结构特性设计高效掩码，对视觉Transformer与持续学习交叉领域有参考价值。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT方法，通过部分参数掩码实现ViT的高效持续学习。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力特性，仅对部分参数进行掩码，而非全参数掩码。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上优于现有方法，且参数效率更高。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频领域持续学习研究不足、现有工作存在任务间类别分布不均衡或数据集不适用的问题，本文提出vCLIMB，一个标准化的视频类增量持续学习基准，任务间类别数均匀分布。通过深入评估现有CL方法，发现视频数据中两个独特挑战：帧级记忆选择和非修剪训练数据影响帧采样策略。提出时序一致性正则化，可叠加在基于记忆的CL方法上，在非修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces vCLIMB, a standardized video class incremental continual learning benchmark with uniform class distribution across tasks, addressing the lack of exploration in video CL. It identifies two unique challenges: frame-level memory selection and untrimmed data affecting frame sampling. A temporal consistency regularization is proposed, improving baseline by up to 24% on untrimmed CL.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，提出的时序一致性正则化有效，对视频理解与持续学习交叉研究有推动作用。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 提出vCLIMB视频持续学习基准及时序一致性正则化方法。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 针对视频数据特性设计标准化基准，并解决帧级记忆选择与非修剪数据挑战。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在非修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中直接微调导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD），专注于从分类头和回归头弹性学习响应。方法传递类别知识同时保留定位信息，并通过弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估所有位置的质量并提供有价值的响应。实验在MS COCO上表明ERD优于现有方法，有效缓解遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in Incremental Object Detection (IOD) by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which elastically learns responses from classification and regression heads. It transfers category knowledge while retaining localization information, and uses Elastic Response Selection (ERS) to evaluate location quality. Experiments on MS COCO show ERD outperforms prior methods.
2204.02136|v2.assessment: 针对增量目标检测的响应蒸馏方法，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习场景有直接应用价值。
2204.02136|v2.contribution: 提出ERD方法，通过弹性响应蒸馏缓解增量目标检测中的灾难性遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.innovation: 从分类和回归头弹性学习响应，并引入ERS策略选择高质量响应。
2204.02136|v2.result: 在MS COCO上优于现有方法，有效保留旧类别知识。

2112.08654|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出学习动态提示（L2P）的新范式，无需测试时任务身份即可训练更简洁的记忆系统。L2P学习动态提示预训练模型，提示为小可学习参数，维护在记忆空间中，优化以指导模型预测并管理任务不变和任务特定知识。在多个图像分类基准上，L2P持续优于先前SOTA，甚至无需回放缓冲区即可与基于回放的方法竞争。
2112.08654|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Learning to Prompt (L2P), a new paradigm for continual learning that dynamically prompts a pre-trained model without accessing task identity at test time. Prompts are small learnable parameters maintained in a memory space, optimized to manage task-invariant and task-specific knowledge. L2P consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art on image classification benchmarks, even without a rehearsal buffer.
2112.08654|v2.assessment: 提出基于提示的持续学习新范式，无需回放缓冲区且性能优越，对持续学习与预训练模型结合有重要启发。
2112.08654|v2.contribution: 提出L2P框架，通过动态提示实现无需任务身份的持续学习。
2112.08654|v2.innovation: 将提示学习引入持续学习，动态管理任务不变与任务特定知识。
2112.08654|v2.result: 在多个图像分类基准上持续优于SOTA，无需回放缓冲区。

2203.15355|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中数据流标签模糊且含噪声的实际问题，本文提出一种统一策略，通过标签噪声感知的多样采样和半监督学习的鲁棒学习来管理记忆，平衡多样性与纯度。在CIFAR10/100、mini-WebVision和Food-101N四个数据集上，该方法显著优于现有方法。
2203.15355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning from blurry data streams with corrupted labels, where existing methods struggle. It proposes a unified strategy of label noise-aware diverse sampling and robust semi-supervised learning to balance diversity and purity in episodic memory. Experiments on four datasets show significant improvements over prior arts.
2203.15355|v2.assessment: 针对现实场景中标签噪声和模糊任务边界的在线持续学习，方法实用且实验充分，对鲁棒持续学习有参考价值。

2203.15355|v2.innovation: 在在线持续学习中同时处理标签噪声和模糊任务边界，平衡记忆的多样性与纯度。
2203.15355|v2.result: 在四个噪声数据集上显著优于现有方法。

2111.11326|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中深度网络难以在不遗忘旧任务的情况下学习新任务的问题，现有动态扩展方法通常需要测试时任务标识、参数调优复杂且跨任务信息共享不足。本文提出 DyTox，一种基于专用编码器/解码器框架的 Transformer 架构，编码器和解码器在所有任务间共享，通过动态扩展特殊 token 使解码器前向过程针对任务分布特化。该策略严格控制系统参数扩展，内存和时间开销可忽略，且无需超参数调优来控制网络扩展。在 CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上取得优异结果，其中 ImageNet 上达到当时最优性能。
2111.11326|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, where existing dynamic expansion methods require task identifiers at test time, complex tuning, and limited cross-task information sharing. It proposes DyTox, a transformer architecture with a shared encoder/decoder framework that dynamically expands special tokens to specialize each decoder forward pass on a task distribution. The strategy scales to many tasks with negligible memory and time overhead and requires no hyperparameter tuning for expansion control. It achieves excellent results on CIFAR100 and state-of-the-art performance on large-scale ImageNet.
2111.11326|v2.assessment: 该工作将动态 token 扩展与 Transformer 共享编码器/解码器结合，在持续学习场景下兼顾了可扩展性与效率，对关注持续学习与 Transformer 架构的研究者有参考价值。
2111.11326|v2.contribution: 提出基于共享编码器/解码器和动态特殊 token 扩展的 Transformer 持续学习框架 DyTox。
2111.11326|v2.innovation: 通过动态扩展特殊 token 实现任务特化解码，同时严格控制系统参数增长且无需超参数调优。
2111.11326|v2.result: 在 CIFAR100 上取得优异结果，在 ImageNet 上达到当时最优性能。

2203.03970|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中训练与测试数据分布相似的假设不成立时，模型在域偏移下遗忘旧知识的问题，本文考虑更现实的域偏移持续学习场景，要求模型泛化到未见域。方法上，作者为分类器配备基于马氏相似度计算的类相似度度量作为学习参数，以鼓励学习语义有意义的特征，并将骨干表示与这些额外参数端到端无缝联合学习。此外，提出基于参数指数移动平均的方法以更好地进行知识蒸馏。实验表明，现有持续学习算法在多种分布下大多无法处理遗忘问题，而所提方法在域偏移下学习新任务时取得精度提升。
2203.03970|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning under domain shifts, where models must generalize to unseen domains rather than assuming similar train/test distributions. It equips the classifier with class similarity metrics based on Mahalanobis similarity as learnable parameters, jointly optimized end-to-end with the backbone representation, and proposes an exponential moving average of parameters for better knowledge distillation. Experiments show that existing continual learning algorithms largely fail under multiple distributions, while the proposed approach boosts accuracy when learning new tasks under domain shift.
2203.03970|v2.assessment: 该工作将域泛化与持续学习结合，提出马氏相似度分类器与 EMA 蒸馏策略，对关注持续学习鲁棒性的研究者有一定参考价值。
2203.03970|v2.contribution: 提出面向域偏移持续学习的马氏相似度分类器与 EMA 知识蒸馏方法。
2203.03970|v2.innovation: 将类相似度度量作为可学习参数端到端联合优化，并结合参数指数移动平均提升蒸馏效果。
2203.03970|v2.result: 在域偏移持续学习场景下取得精度提升，而现有方法大多失效。

2111.11210|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，基于回放的持续学习方法需要维护并反复训练一个跨任务选取的小型数据缓冲区。本文提出梯度核心集回放（GCR），一种基于精心设计优化准则的回放缓冲区选择与更新策略。具体而言，作者选择并维护一个核心集，使其在当前模型参数下紧密逼近迄今所见所有数据的梯度，并讨论了在持续学习场景中有效应用的关键策略。在离线持续学习设定下相比当时最优方法取得 2%-4% 的绝对提升，在在线/流式持续学习设定下也取得最高 5% 的提升，并展示了监督对比学习的价值。
2111.11210|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in replay-based continual learning, where a small buffer of past data must be maintained and retrained. It proposes Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR), a novel replay buffer selection and update strategy that maintains a coreset closely approximating the gradient of all seen data with respect to current model parameters. GCR achieves 2%-4% absolute gains over the state of the art in offline continual learning and up to 5% gains in online/streaming settings, and demonstrates the value of supervised contrastive learning.
2111.11210|v2.assessment: 该工作从梯度逼近角度重新审视回放缓冲区选择，方法简洁且增益稳定，对持续学习与数据高效训练方向的研究者有较高参考价值。
2111.11210|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度核心集的回放缓冲区选择与更新策略 GCR。
2111.11210|v2.innovation: 以逼近全部已见数据梯度为准则维护核心集，并适配离线与在线持续学习设定。
2111.11210|v2.result: 离线设定下提升 2%-4%，在线/流式设定下最高提升 5%。

2203.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习问题，即在无法保存旧类样本的情况下同时识别新旧类别，由于表示优化和特征保留只能在新类监督下完成，该任务极具挑战。本文提出一种自维持表示扩展方案，包含结构重组策略（融合主分支扩展与侧分支更新以维持旧特征）和主分支蒸馏方案（迁移不变知识）。此外提出原型选择机制，通过有选择地将新样本纳入蒸馏过程来增强新旧类别的判别性。在三个基准上取得显著增量性能，分别以 3%、3% 和 6% 的幅度超越当时最优方法。
2203.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses non-exemplar class-incremental learning, where old class samples cannot be stored and representation optimization must rely solely on new class supervision. It proposes a self-sustaining representation expansion scheme comprising a structure reorganization strategy that fuses main-branch expansion and side-branch updating to preserve old features, a main-branch distillation scheme for invariant knowledge transfer, and a prototype selection mechanism to enhance old/new class discrimination. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks outperform the state of the art by 3%, 3%, and 6%, respectively.
2203.06359|v2.assessment: 该工作针对无样本类增量学习提出结构重组与原型选择相结合的自维持表示扩展方案，在多个基准上取得稳定提升，对持续学习方向的研究者有参考价值。
2203.06359|v2.contribution: 提出面向无样本类增量学习的自维持表示扩展方案。
2203.06359|v2.innovation: 融合主分支扩展与侧分支更新的结构重组策略，以及选择性纳入新样本的原型选择机制。
2203.06359|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别以 3%、3% 和 6% 的幅度超越当时最优方法。

2112.01882|v2.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割模型难以增量学习新类别、且像素级标注昂贵的问题，本文提出弱增量语义分割框架，仅用图像级标签学习分割新类。②方法用图像级标签训练辅助分类器并由分割模型正则化，在线生成软伪标签进行增量更新，避免离线伪标签生成。③相比已有离线弱监督方法，本文在线伪监督更适应增量场景，且软标签缓解噪声。④在Pascal VOC和COCO上超越离线弱监督方法，性能接近全监督增量学习方法。
2112.01882|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses weak incremental learning for semantic segmentation, where new classes must be learned from cheap image-level labels. ②It proposes an online pseudo-supervision framework using an auxiliary classifier regularized by the segmentation model, generating soft labels to handle noise. ③Unlike offline pseudo-labeling methods, it updates incrementally and mitigates label noise via soft labels. ④Experiments on Pascal VOC and COCO show superiority over offline weakly-supervised methods and comparable results to fully-supervised incremental learning.
2112.01882|v2.assessment: 将弱监督与增量分割结合，在线软伪标签思路实用，对标注受限的自动驾驶场景有参考价值。
2112.01882|v2.contribution: 提出首个在线弱增量语义分割框架，利用图像级标签和软伪标签实现增量学习。
2112.01882|v2.innovation: 用辅助分类器在线生成软伪监督，避免离线伪标签并缓解噪声。
2112.01882|v2.result: 在Pascal VOC和COCO上超越离线弱监督方法，接近全监督增量学习性能。

2203.14952|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中参数更新导致旧任务潜在表示错位、引发遗忘的问题。②提出ELI，学习潜在表示的能量流形，使旧任务潜表示低能量、当前任务高能量，以此对抗表示漂移，可作为即插即用模块。③相比现有增量学习方法，ELI通过隐式正则化对齐潜在表示，无需存储旧样本。④在CIFAR-100、ImageNet子集、ImageNet 1k和Pascal VOC上，加入ELI后三种主流类增量方法均一致提升；用于SOTA增量目标检测器时提升超过5%。
2203.14952|v2.summary_en: ①Addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning caused by latent representation mismatch from parameter updates. ②Proposes ELI, an energy-based latent aligner that learns an energy manifold to regularize latent representations, acting as a plug-and-play module. ③Unlike prior methods, it counters representational shift via implicit regularization without storing old samples. ④On CIFAR-100, ImageNet subset, ImageNet 1k, and Pascal VOC, ELI consistently improves three class-incremental methods and boosts a SOTA incremental object detector by over 5%.
2203.14952|v2.assessment: 能量流形对齐潜在表示思路新颖，即插即用且对增量目标检测有显著提升，值得关注。
2203.14952|v2.contribution: 提出能量基潜在对齐器ELI，通过能量流形正则化缓解增量学习中的表示漂移。
2203.14952|v2.innovation: 利用能量流形使旧任务潜表示低能量、新任务高能量，隐式对齐表示。
2203.14952|v2.result: 在多个基准上一致提升，用于增量目标检测器提升超过5%。

2110.07905|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中可塑性-稳定性权衡问题，且不存储旧任务数据。②提出利用损失景观中的模式连通性，连接旧任务的零空间投影和当前任务的SGD解，实现无需旧样本的平衡。③相比需要存储旧样本的方法，本文无需存储且提供控制权衡的新视角。④在10-split-CIFAR-100上达到79.79%准确率，在多个基准上取得显著提升。
2110.07905|v2.summary_en: ①Addresses the plasticity-stability trade-off in incremental learning without storing previous task data. ②Proposes a simple linear connector using mode connectivity in loss landscapes, connecting null-space projection for old tasks and SGD for the current task. ③Unlike replay-based methods, it requires no stored samples and offers a new perspective to control the trade-off. ④Achieves 79.79% accuracy on 10-split-CIFAR-100 and notable improvements on several benchmarks.
2110.07905|v2.assessment: 无需旧样本的简单线性连接器方法，为增量学习权衡提供新视角，实用性强。
2110.07905|v2.contribution: 提出基于模式连通性的简单线性连接器，无需旧样本实现可塑性-稳定性平衡。
2110.07905|v2.innovation: 利用损失景观模式连通性连接旧任务零空间投影与当前任务SGD解。
2110.07905|v2.result: 在10-split-CIFAR-100上达到79.79%准确率，多个基准显著提升。

Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云类增量语义分割中几何信息利用不足与不确定性建模缺失的问题，提出了一种几何与不确定性感知的类增量分割框架。方法上通过显式建模点云几何结构并引入不确定性估计，缓解增量学习中的灾难性遗忘与旧类偏置。相比已有仅依赖特征回放或参数正则的3D增量方法，其改进在于将几何先验与预测不确定性联合约束。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，效果需参考正文实验。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental semantic segmentation on 3D point clouds, where geometric cues and predictive uncertainty are often underexploited. It proposes a geometry- and uncertainty-aware framework that explicitly models point geometry and uncertainty to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and bias toward old classes. Unlike prior 3D incremental methods relying mainly on feature replay or parameter regularization, it jointly constrains geometry priors and uncertainty; quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.assessment: 面向3D点云增量分割的几何与不确定性建模思路较新颖，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习场景有参考价值，但需正文实验验证其有效性。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.contribution: 提出几何与不确定性感知的3D点云类增量语义分割框架。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.innovation: 将点云几何先验与预测不确定性联合建模以约束增量学习。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.result: 摘要未报告具体数据集与数值指标，效果需见正文。

2304.00426|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中基类训练使用交叉熵损失导致类间表征分离不足、进而损害新类泛化的问题展开研究。作者发现朴素监督对比学习虽能略微改善基类分离，但仍难以区分基类与新类，于是提出语义感知虚拟对比模型（SAVC），通过预定义变换生成虚拟类并引入对比学习，作为未见类的占位符以促进基类与新类的分离。方法在FSCIL基准上提升了新类泛化能力，摘要未给出具体数值。
2304.00426|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), showing that cross-entropy training in the base session yields poor class separation and degrades novel-class generalization, and that naive supervised contrastive learning still fails to separate base and new classes. It proposes Semantic-Aware Virtual Contrastive model (SAVC), which introduces virtual classes generated by predefined transformations into contrastive learning as placeholders for unseen classes. This improves separation between base and novel classes; specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
2304.00426|v2.assessment: 对FSCIL中表征分离问题的观察扎实，虚拟类对比思路简洁有效，对增量学习与少样本学习交叉方向有启发。
2304.00426|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知虚拟对比模型SAVC用于小样本类增量学习。
2304.00426|v2.innovation: 用预定义变换生成的虚拟类作为未见类占位符增强对比学习分离性。
2304.00426|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称改善了基类与新类的分离及新类泛化。

PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线类增量持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出基于代理的对比回放方法（PCR）。方法通过代理（proxy）机制构建对比回放损失，缓解在线场景下缓冲区样本有限导致的类不平衡与表征退化。相比传统回放与对比回放方法，其改进在于代理表示与对比学习的结合以增强类间区分。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_en: This paper targets catastrophic forgetting in online class-incremental continual learning and proposes Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay (PCR). It builds a contrastive replay objective with proxy representations to alleviate class imbalance and representation degradation caused by limited buffer samples in the online setting. Compared with conventional replay and contrastive replay, it combines proxy representations with contrastive learning to enhance inter-class discrimination; quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.assessment: 在线类增量场景实用性强，代理对比回放思路合理，但需正文实验证明其相对SOTA的优势。

PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.innovation: 将代理表示引入对比回放以缓解在线缓冲样本不足带来的类不平衡。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果。

2211.13218|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无回放持续学习中基于提示（prompt）的方法塑性不足问题展开研究：现有方法依赖key-query机制生成提示，但key机制未与任务序列端到端训练，导致新任务准确率下降且无法利用扩展的参数容量。作者提出CODA-Prompt，学习一组提示组件并通过输入条件权重组装成输入条件提示，形成端到端的注意力式key-query方案。实验表明该方法在多个无回放持续学习基准上超越当时SOTA，并更好地利用扩展参数容量。
2211.13218|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited plasticity of prompting-based rehearsal-free continual learning, where existing key-query prompt generation is not trained end-to-end with the task sequence, reducing new-task accuracy and preventing benefit from expanded parameter capacity. It proposes CODA-Prompt, which learns a set of prompt components assembled with input-conditioned weights to form input-conditioned prompts via an end-to-end attention-based key-query scheme. Experiments show it outperforms the then state of the art on rehearsal-free continual learning benchmarks.
2211.13218|v2.assessment: 基于预训练ViT的端到端提示学习设计清晰，解决了提示方法塑性瓶颈，对持续学习与视觉Transformer交叉方向有较高参考价值。
2211.13218|v2.contribution: 提出CODA-Prompt，一种基于分解注意力提示的无回放持续学习方法。
2211.13218|v2.innovation: 用输入条件权重组装提示组件，实现端到端训练的注意力式key-query提示生成。
2211.13218|v2.result: 在无回放持续学习基准上超越当时SOTA，并更好利用扩展参数容量。

2304.10177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对回放式持续学习中样本选择策略只优化当前轮效用、忽略连续选择轮次间干扰的问题展开分析。作者基于影响函数框架剖析顺序选择步骤的交互，识别出一类会逐步放大回放缓冲区偶然偏差的二阶影响，并提出新的选择目标对其进行正则化，该目标与两种常用准则存在明确联系，同时给出高效实现。在多个持续学习基准上实验表明方法优于当时SOTA，代码已开源。
2304.10177|v2.summary_en: This paper studies sample selection in replay-based continual learning, where existing schemes maximize only the utility of the current selection and overlook interference across successive selection rounds. Using an influence-function framework, the authors identify a class of second-order influences that amplify incidental bias in the replay buffer, and propose a novel selection objective to regularize these effects, with clear connections to two widely used criteria and an efficient implementation. Experiments on multiple continual learning benchmarks show advantages over state-of-the-art methods.
2304.10177|v2.assessment: 从影响函数角度刻画回放样本选择的二阶效应，理论分析深入且实现高效，对持续学习缓冲区管理有实质贡献。
2304.10177|v2.contribution: 揭示并正则化回放样本选择中的二阶影响，提出新的选择目标。
2304.10177|v2.innovation: 基于影响函数识别连续选择轮次间的二阶干扰并设计正则化选择准则。
2304.10177|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于当时SOTA，代码已开源。

CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_cn: 该论文针对语义分割与全景分割中的持续学习问题，提出CoMFormer框架，旨在统一处理语义与全景分割的增量学习场景。方法通过持续学习机制在类别不断增加的设定下同时维持语义分割与全景分割性能，缓解灾难性遗忘。相比仅针对语义分割的增量方法，其改进在于覆盖全景分割任务。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning for both semantic and panoptic segmentation and proposes CoMFormer, a unified framework for incremental learning in these two tasks. It maintains performance under continuously growing class sets while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, extending beyond incremental methods that target semantic segmentation only. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.assessment: 将持续学习扩展到全景分割任务具有一定新意，对自动驾驶场景下的持续感知有潜在价值，但需正文实验支撑。

2304.03931|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中数据呈非欧几里得几何结构、欧氏空间难以刻画的问题，本文从数据几何角度研究持续学习。方法利用混合曲率空间，提出增量搜索方案动态扩展底层空间几何以匹配新数据产生的几何结构，并引入角度正则化损失和邻域鲁棒性损失分别惩罚全局与局部几何结构的变化。相比欧氏空间设计的基线方法，该方法在避免遗忘旧知识的同时更好地适应新数据，实验表明性能优于基线。
2304.03931|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning from a data-geometry perspective, arguing that Euclidean space cannot capture the non-Euclidean geometric structures of data streams. It dynamically expands the geometry of the underlying mixed-curvature space via an incremental search scheme and introduces angular-regularization and neighbor-robustness losses to penalize changes in global and local geometric structures. Experiments show it outperforms Euclidean-space baselines.
2304.03931|v2.assessment: 从几何视角切入持续学习较为新颖，但实验规模与数据集细节在摘要中未充分体现，需关注其实际增益幅度。
2304.03931|v2.contribution: 提出基于混合曲率空间几何扩展的持续学习框架，用几何结构保持替代传统欧氏约束。
2304.03931|v2.innovation: 用增量搜索动态扩展空间几何并配合角度正则与邻域鲁棒损失来同时保持全局和局部几何结构。
2304.03931|v2.result: 实验表明性能优于在欧氏空间中设计的基线方法。

2303.14595|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘与稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，现有特征蒸馏方法直接约束新特征匹配旧特征，忽视了可塑性需求。本文提出 Backward Feature Projection (BFP)，允许新特征在旧特征的可学习线性变换范围内变化，从而在保留旧类线性可分性的同时允许新特征方向出现以容纳新类。BFP 可与现有经验回放方法结合并显著提升性能，还证明其有助于学习更好的表示空间，使线性探测在持续学习过程中保持高分类精度。
2303.14595|v2.summary_en: To improve the stability-plasticity trade-off in continual learning, this paper proposes Backward Feature Projection (BFP), which allows new features to change up to a learnable linear transformation of old features rather than directly matching them. BFP preserves linear separability of old classes while permitting new feature directions for new classes, integrates with experience replay for significant gains, and yields a representation space where linear probing achieves high accuracy.
2303.14595|v2.assessment: 思路清晰、与回放方法兼容性强，线性可分性视角对持续学习表示学习有实际指导意义，值得关注。
2303.14595|v2.contribution: 提出 BFP，通过可学习线性变换约束新特征以在持续学习中保持旧类线性可分性。
2303.14595|v2.innovation: 将特征蒸馏从直接匹配改为允许线性变换，兼顾稳定性与可塑性并保持线性可分结构。
2303.14595|v2.result: 与经验回放结合可显著提升性能，并在线性探测下保持高分类精度。

2305.14657|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出类增量学习中除灾难性遗忘外还存在跨任务类别判别（CTCD）挑战，即在新任务与旧任务数据不可见或有限时如何建立新旧类别的决策边界。回放方法虽隐式部分处理该问题，但存在动态训练偏置，削弱了回放数据解决 CTCD 的效果。作者提出一种带梯度自适应方法的新优化目标，在在线持续学习过程中动态应对该问题。实验表明新方法取得明显更好的结果。
2305.14657|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies cross-task class discrimination (CTCD) as an additional challenge in class-incremental learning beyond catastrophic forgetting, namely establishing decision boundaries between new and old classes with limited access to old data. It argues that replay methods suffer from a dynamic training bias that weakens their effectiveness for CTCD, and proposes a novel optimization objective with a gradient-based adaptive method to address it dynamically in online CL. Experiments show substantially better results.
2305.14657|v2.assessment: 对回放方法训练偏置的分析有新意，CTCD 视角补充了持续学习问题定义，方法针对性强。
2305.14657|v2.contribution: 提出跨任务类别判别问题并设计带梯度自适应的新优化目标以动态缓解回放训练偏置。
2305.14657|v2.innovation: 揭示回放方法中的动态训练偏置并给出在线持续学习下的自适应优化方案。
2305.14657|v2.result: 实验表明新方法在在线持续学习场景下取得明显更好的结果。

2303.09483|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡仍未解决且机理不清的问题，本文提出 Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL)，为以稳定性为主的持续学习模型引入一个促进可塑性的辅助网络。该框架具体实现为一个在可塑性与稳定性之间自然插值的正则项，在任务增量和类增量场景下均超越强基线。通过对 ANCL 解的深入分析，作者总结出若干关于稳定性-可塑性权衡的基本原则。
2303.09483|v2.summary_en: To address the unresolved stability-plasticity trade-off in continual learning, this paper proposes Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL), which augments a stability-oriented continually learned model with an auxiliary network that promotes plasticity. The framework materializes as a regularizer that naturally interpolates between plasticity and stability, surpassing strong baselines on task- and class-incremental scenarios, with analyses revealing underlying principles of the trade-off.
2303.09483|v2.assessment: 辅助网络与正则化插值的思路简洁有效，且对权衡机理的分析对领域有参考价值。
2303.09483|v2.contribution: 提出 ANCL，用辅助网络与插值正则项改善持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡。
2303.09483|v2.innovation: 以辅助网络促进可塑性并通过正则项在稳定性与可塑性之间自然插值。
2303.09483|v2.result: 在任务增量和类增量场景下均超越强基线。

Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.summary_cn: 该论文标题为持续学习中的自适应可塑性提升，旨在改善持续学习模型的可塑性。但由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体问题定义、方法设计与实验结论。仅从标题推测，其可能提出一种自适应调节模型可塑性的机制以缓解稳定性-可塑性失衡。
Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.summary_en: This paper is titled Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Continual Learning, aiming to enhance plasticity in continual learning models. However, the abstract is missing, so its problem formulation, method, and experimental results cannot be verified. Based on the title alone, it likely proposes an adaptive mechanism to improve plasticity and mitigate the stability-plasticity imbalance.
Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.assessment: 主题属于持续学习可塑性方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法与贡献，信息不足。
Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont.contribution: 疑似提出持续学习中的自适应可塑性提升方法（因摘要缺失无法确认）。
