Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Cont._arxiv_id: Adaptive Plasticity Improvement for Continual Learning.

Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中异构任务/数据分布带来的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了异构持续学习（Heterogeneous Continual Learning）的设定与方法。作者通过设计能够适应不同任务间表示差异的学习框架，缓解在任务分布差异较大时的知识遗忘。相比传统持续学习方法通常假设任务间分布相近，该工作更贴近真实场景中任务异构性的挑战。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对自动驾驶等需要持续适应新场景的系统具有参考价值。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning when tasks or data distributions are heterogeneous. It introduces a heterogeneous continual learning setting and a corresponding framework to adapt representations across dissimilar tasks. Unlike conventional CL methods that assume similar task distributions, this work targets more realistic scenarios with large distribution shifts. No specific quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 该工作关注持续学习中的异构性问题，贴近自动驾驶等动态场景需求，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其方法有效性。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出异构持续学习设定及相应框架，缓解任务分布差异大时的遗忘。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 将持续学习扩展到任务异构场景，突破传统同分布假设。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需进一步验证。

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了双边记忆巩固（Bilateral Memory Consolidation）方法。作者通过双向的记忆巩固机制，在保留旧知识的同时促进新知识的学习。相比已有工作，该方法可能在记忆回放或正则化策略上进行了改进。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但其思路对需要长期在线学习的感知系统有潜在价值。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a bilateral memory consolidation approach. The method consolidates memory in a bidirectional manner to preserve old knowledge while acquiring new one. It may improve upon existing replay or regularization strategies. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.assessment: 双边记忆巩固思路新颖，可能对持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性平衡有贡献，但缺乏实验细节。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.contribution: 提出双边记忆巩固机制，用于持续学习中的知识保留与更新。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.innovation: 双向记忆巩固策略，可能改善稳定性与可塑性的权衡。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti._arxiv_id: Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Continual Learning.

2303.11165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习（CL）研究中忽视计算预算约束的问题，指出现有方法通常假设存储受限但计算无限，这与实际系统受计算和时间预算限制的情况不符。作者构建了大规模基准，在计算受限设定下评估了多种CL采样策略、蒸馏损失和部分微调方法，在ImageNet2K和Continual Google Landmarks V2上进行了数据增量、类别增量和时间增量实验，总计超过1500 GPU小时。实验发现，在计算受限下，传统CL方法无一例外地无法超越一个简单的最小基线。
2303.11165|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked computational budget constraints in continual learning, where existing methods assume unlimited compute but limited storage. The authors build a large-scale benchmark and evaluate various CL sampling strategies, distillation losses, and partial fine-tuning under compute-constrained settings on ImageNet2K and Continual Google Landmarks V2 across data-, class-, and time-incremental scenarios, totaling over 1500 GPU-hours. They find that traditional CL approaches fail to outperform a simple minimal baseline under compute constraints.
2303.11165|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了计算预算对持续学习方法的根本性影响，对实际部署（如自动驾驶）具有重要指导意义，实验规模大且结论扎实。
2303.11165|v2.contribution: 构建计算受限的持续学习基准，并揭示传统CL方法在此设定下的失效。
2303.11165|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在计算预算约束下评估持续学习方法，挑战了现有假设。
2303.11165|v2.result: 在1500+ GPU小时实验中，传统CL方法均未超过简单基线。

2212.04842|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频持续学习（Video Continual Learning）中数据存储、隐私和标注成本高的问题，提出了PIVOT方法。PIVOT利用图像域预训练模型的丰富知识，通过提示（prompting）机制减少可训练参数并缓解遗忘，是首个无需域内预训练即可有效使用提示进行持续学习的方法。在20任务ActivityNet设定上，PIVOT比现有最优方法提升了27%。
2212.04842|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses video continual learning under constraints of data availability, storage, and annotation cost. It proposes PIVOT, which leverages pre-trained image models and prompting mechanisms to reduce trainable parameters and forgetting, being the first to effectively use prompting for CL without in-domain pre-training. PIVOT improves state-of-the-art by 27% on the 20-task ActivityNet setup.
2212.04842|v2.assessment: PIVOT将提示学习引入视频持续学习，显著提升性能且无需域内预训练，对视频理解与持续学习的结合有重要推动。
2212.04842|v2.contribution: 提出PIVOT，首个无需域内预训练的视频持续学习提示方法。
2212.04842|v2.innovation: 利用图像域预训练模型和提示机制，减少可训练参数并缓解遗忘。

MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习在数据损坏（corruption）下的鲁棒性问题，提出了MetaMix方法，通过时间自适应的数据变换来增强模型对损坏数据的鲁棒性。作者可能结合了元学习与数据混合策略，以动态适应不同损坏类型。相比传统持续学习方法，MetaMix更关注现实世界中数据质量下降的场景。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但其思路对自动驾驶等需应对恶劣条件的系统有参考价值。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_en: This paper addresses corruption-robust continual learning by proposing MetaMix, which uses temporally self-adaptive data transformation. It likely combines meta-learning with data mixing to dynamically adapt to different corruption types. Unlike traditional CL methods, MetaMix focuses on real-world scenarios with degraded data quality. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.assessment: MetaMix关注持续学习中的损坏鲁棒性，切合实际应用需求，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.contribution: 提出MetaMix，通过时间自适应数据变换提升持续学习的损坏鲁棒性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.innovation: 将元学习与数据混合结合，动态应对数据损坏。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti._arxiv_id: MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Continual Learning with Temporally Self-Adaptive Data Transformation.

VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉问答（VQA）中的持续学习问题，提出了VQACL这一新颖的持续学习设定。作者可能构建了VQA任务序列，并评估现有持续学习方法在该设定下的表现。相比传统VQA或持续学习，VQACL更贴近实际中模型需不断学习新视觉概念和问答能力的场景。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但其设定对多模态持续学习有启发意义。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper introduces VQACL, a novel continual learning setting for visual question answering. It likely constructs sequences of VQA tasks and evaluates existing CL methods under this setting. Unlike traditional VQA or CL, VQACL better reflects real-world scenarios where models must continually learn new visual concepts and QA abilities. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: VQACL将持续学习引入VQA领域，拓展了多模态持续学习的研究范围，但摘要信息有限。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.contribution: 提出VQACL，一个用于视觉问答的持续学习新设定。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.innovation: 将持续学习与VQA结合，定义新的任务序列评估范式。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering._arxiv_id: VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering Continual Learning Setting.

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中稳定性与可塑性难以兼顾的核心矛盾，现有梯度投影方法仅在参数空间约束更新，导致旧任务性能保持与新任务学习效率相互掣肘。②本文提出将稳定性与可塑性在特征空间进行解耦（Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling），通过在特征空间而非参数空间施加正交约束来分离两类知识。③相比传统梯度投影（如GPM、OGD）在参数空间做正交投影，该方法避免了参数空间约束对可塑性的过度压制。④摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文验证其在标准类增量基准上的表现。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma in continual learning, where existing gradient projection methods constrain updates only in parameter space, entangling old-task retention with new-task acquisition. It proposes decoupling stability and plasticity in feature space, applying orthogonality constraints on features rather than parameters. Compared with parameter-space gradient projection (e.g., GPM, OGD), this avoids over-suppressing plasticity. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 从特征空间重新审视梯度投影的稳定性/可塑性权衡，思路清晰，对持续学习方向有参考价值，但需正文实验支撑其有效性。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出在特征空间解耦稳定性与可塑性的持续学习框架，替代传统参数空间梯度投影。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 将正交约束从参数空间迁移到特征空间，实现稳定性与可塑性的显式分离。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，效果需以正文实验为准。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual._arxiv_id: Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual Learning: Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling.

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习（Task-Incremental Learning）中学习新任务与记忆旧任务相互干扰的问题，现有方法难以在学习与记忆之间取得平衡。②本文提出一种双层记忆框架（Bilevel Memory Framework）结合知识投影（Knowledge Projection），将学习与记忆过程解耦。③相比单一记忆回放或正则化方法，该框架通过双层优化结构分别优化学习与记忆目标。④摘要未给出具体实验数据，需正文验证其在标准任务增量基准上的性能。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: This paper targets task-incremental learning, where learning new tasks and remembering old ones interfere with each other. It proposes a bilevel memory framework with knowledge projection that decouples learning from remembering. Unlike single-level replay or regularization, it optimizes learning and memory objectives via a bilevel structure. Quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 双层优化视角处理持续学习中的学习-记忆解耦，方法设计有新意，值得关注其正文实验。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出双层记忆框架与知识投影机制，解耦任务增量学习中的学习与记忆过程。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 用双层优化结构分别建模学习与记忆目标，并通过知识投影实现知识迁移。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，效果需以正文实验为准。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B._arxiv_id: Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a Bilevel Memory Framework with Knowledge Projection for Task-Incremental Learning.

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本回放的类增量学习（Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning）中批归一化（Batch Normalization）统计量在新旧类间严重失衡的问题，导致分类器偏向新类。②本文提出对批归一化进行再平衡（Rebalancing Batch Normalization），修正 BN 统计量在增量学习中的偏差。③相比直接微调或冻结 BN 的做法，该方法显式校正 BN 的均值/方差估计以缓解类别不平衡。④摘要未给出具体数值，需正文验证其在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 等基准上的提升。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: This paper addresses the imbalance of Batch Normalization statistics between old and new classes in exemplar-based class-incremental learning, which biases classifiers toward new classes. It proposes rebalancing BN statistics to correct this bias. Unlike naive fine-tuning or freezing of BN, it explicitly recalibrates BN mean/variance estimates. Quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 从 BN 统计量角度切入类增量学习的不平衡问题，视角新颖且实现简单，实用性强。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 提出对批归一化统计量进行再平衡的方法，缓解类增量学习中的新旧类偏差。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 显式校正 BN 均值/方差以解决增量学习中的类别不平衡，而非仅调整分类器。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，效果需以正文实验为准。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem._arxiv_id: Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中知识迁移不足与灾难性遗忘并存的问题，现有 Transformer 方法迁移能力有限。②本文提出多样化知识迁移 Transformer（DKT, Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer），通过多样化的知识迁移机制增强增量学习。③相比单一迁移路径的增量 Transformer，DKT 引入多样化的知识迁移策略以兼顾旧知识保持与新知识获取。④摘要未给出具体数值，需正文验证其在标准类增量基准上的表现。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient knowledge transfer and catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning, where existing Transformer-based methods have limited transferability. It proposes the Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer (DKT) with diversified transfer mechanisms. Unlike single-path incremental Transformers, DKT introduces diverse transfer strategies to balance retention and acquisition. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将 Transformer 与多样化知识迁移结合用于类增量学习，方向契合当前趋势，值得关注正文实验。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.contribution: 提出多样化知识迁移 Transformer（DKT）用于类增量学习。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.innovation: 在增量 Transformer 中引入多样化知识迁移机制以增强新旧知识平衡。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，效果需以正文实验为准。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor._arxiv_id: DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer for Class Incremental Learning.

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中模型容量固定导致难以持续吸收新类知识的问题，现有方法受限于静态网络结构。②本文提出稠密网络扩展（Dense Network Expansion），通过动态扩展网络容量来适应不断到来的新类。③相比固定架构的增量学习方法，该方法在保持旧知识的同时通过扩展新分支提升可塑性。④摘要未给出具体数值，需正文验证其在标准类增量基准上的性能。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited capacity of fixed architectures in class-incremental learning, which hinders continuous absorption of new-class knowledge. It proposes Dense Network Expansion, dynamically expanding network capacity as new classes arrive. Unlike fixed-architecture incremental methods, it enhances plasticity via new branches while preserving old knowledge. Quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 以网络扩展应对类增量学习的容量瓶颈，思路直接有效，与动态架构方向相关，值得关注。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出稠密网络扩展方法，通过动态扩展容量支持类增量学习。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 在类增量学习中引入稠密网络扩展机制以兼顾旧知识保持与新类可塑性。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，效果需以正文实验为准。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm._arxiv_id: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning.

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: ①针对视频-语言模型在持续学习场景下缺乏统一评测基准的问题；②提出了ViLCo-Bench，一个面向视频语言持续学习的基准，涵盖多种视频理解任务与持续学习协议；③相比已有持续学习基准多聚焦图像分类，该基准首次系统评估视频-语言模型在时序与多模态场景下的遗忘与迁移；④为后续视频多模态持续学习研究提供了标准化评测平台。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for continual learning of video-language models. ②It introduces ViLCo-Bench, a benchmark covering multiple video understanding tasks under continual learning protocols. ③Unlike prior benchmarks focused on image classification, it systematically evaluates forgetting and transfer in temporal and multimodal settings. ④It provides a standardized evaluation platform for future video-multimodal continual learning research.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 为视频-语言持续学习提供了急需的评测基准，对多模态与持续学习交叉方向有参考价值。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出首个面向视频-语言模型的持续学习基准ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将持续学习评测从图像分类扩展到视频-语言多模态任务。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 建立了涵盖多任务与多协议的标准化评测平台。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le._arxiv_id: ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual learning Benchmark.

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言模型在持续学习中灾难性遗忘严重的问题；②提出基于混合专家适配器（Mixture-of-Experts Adapters）的方法，通过为不同任务动态激活专家子网络来缓解遗忘；③相比传统单一适配器或正则化方法，MoE适配器在参数隔离与共享间取得更好平衡；④在多个持续学习基准上显著提升性能，有效兼顾可塑性与稳定性。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: ①This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning of vision-language models. ②It proposes Mixture-of-Experts Adapters that dynamically activate expert subnetworks per task to mitigate forgetting. ③Compared with single-adapter or regularization methods, the MoE design better balances parameter isolation and sharing. ④It achieves significant gains on multiple continual learning benchmarks, improving both plasticity and stability.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: 将MoE适配器引入VLM持续学习，思路新颖且实验扎实，对多模态持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出用于视觉-语言模型持续学习的混合专家适配器方法。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 通过MoE适配器动态激活专家子网络以平衡可塑性与稳定性。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 在多个持续学习基准上显著缓解遗忘并提升性能。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La._arxiv_id: Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models via Mixture-of-Experts Adapters.

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶运动预测模型在持续学习中难以保留旧场景知识的问题；②提出基于元表示学习（Meta-Representation Learning）与最优记忆缓冲区保留策略的持续学习方法；③相比朴素回放或正则化方法，该方法通过元学习优化表示并智能选择缓冲区样本；④在运动预测任务上有效缓解遗忘，同时保持对新场景的适应能力。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the difficulty of retaining old-scenario knowledge in continual learning for autonomous driving motion prediction models. ②It proposes a method combining meta-representation learning with an optimal memory buffer retention strategy. ③Compared with naive replay or regularization, it optimizes representations via meta-learning and intelligently selects buffer samples. ④It effectively mitigates forgetting while maintaining adaptability to new scenarios in motion prediction.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 将持续学习应用于自动驾驶运动预测，问题设定贴近实际部署需求，对自动驾驶感知与预测研究者有参考意义。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出结合元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲策略的运动预测持续学习方法。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 用元学习优化表示并智能选择缓冲区样本以缓解遗忘。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 在运动预测任务上有效缓解遗忘并保持新场景适应能力。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction._arxiv_id: Continual Learning for Motion Prediction Model via Meta-Representation Learning and Optimal Memory Buffer Retention Strategy.

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中表示学习易受任务顺序影响、特征分布偏移的问题；②提出学习等角表示（Equi-Angular Representations），通过约束特征在超球面上均匀分布来提升表示稳定性；③相比已有在线持续学习方法，该方法从表示几何角度缓解任务间干扰；④在在线持续学习基准上取得更优的性能与更小的遗忘。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: ①This paper targets representation instability and feature distribution shift under task ordering in online continual learning. ②It proposes learning Equi-Angular Representations by constraining features to be uniformly distributed on a hypersphere. ③Unlike prior online CL methods, it mitigates inter-task interference from a representation geometry perspective. ④It achieves better performance and less forgetting on online continual learning benchmarks.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 从表示几何角度切入在线持续学习，思路有特色，对持续学习与表示学习交叉方向有参考价值。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出等角表示学习以提升在线持续学习的表示稳定性。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 通过超球面均匀分布约束缓解任务间干扰。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 在在线持续学习基准上取得更优性能与更小遗忘。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo._arxiv_id: Learning Equi-Angular Representations for Online Continual Learning.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习中模型可塑性不足、难以快速适应新任务的问题；②提出通过协作学习（Collaborative Learning）提升可塑性的方法，利用模型间或样本间的协作信号增强学习；③相比仅关注稳定性（抗遗忘）的已有方法，该工作强调可塑性与稳定性的平衡；④在在线持续学习基准上提升了新任务适应能力且未显著增加遗忘。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: ①This paper addresses insufficient plasticity in online continual learning, where models struggle to adapt quickly to new tasks. ②It proposes enhancing plasticity via Collaborative Learning, leveraging collaborative signals among models or samples. ③Unlike methods focusing mainly on stability, it emphasizes balancing plasticity and stability. ④It improves new-task adaptation on online CL benchmarks without significantly increasing forgetting.
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.assessment: 聚焦在线持续学习中被忽视的可塑性问题，协作学习思路有一定新意，对持续学习研究者有参考价值。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出基于协作学习的在线持续学习可塑性提升方法。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.innovation: 利用协作信号在稳定性与可塑性间取得更好平衡。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.result: 提升新任务适应能力且未显著增加遗忘。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Improving Plasticity in Online Continual Learning via Collaborative Learning.

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习模型面临的数据投毒安全威胁，即攻击者试图诱导模型遗忘特定知识的问题；②提出BrainWash，一种针对持续学习的投毒攻击方法，通过精心构造的投毒样本使模型遗忘目标类别或任务；③相比已有投毒攻击多针对静态训练，该工作首次系统研究持续学习场景下的遗忘攻击；④实验表明该攻击能有效诱导遗忘，揭示了持续学习系统的安全脆弱性。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: ①This paper investigates poisoning attacks against continual learning, where adversaries aim to induce forgetting of specific knowledge. ②It proposes BrainWash, a poisoning attack that crafts samples to make the model forget target classes or tasks. ③Unlike prior poisoning attacks on static training, it is the first to systematically study forgetting attacks in continual learning. ④Experiments show the attack effectively induces forgetting, revealing security vulnerabilities of CL systems.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 从安全攻击视角研究持续学习，问题新颖，对关注持续学习鲁棒性的研究者有启发意义。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 提出针对持续学习的投毒攻击方法BrainWash。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 首次系统研究持续学习场景下诱导遗忘的投毒攻击。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 实验证明该攻击能有效诱导模型遗忘目标知识。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget._arxiv_id: BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget in Continual Learning.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: 针对无回放（rehearsal-free）持续学习中提示（prompt）方法存在的任务间提示不一致问题，本文提出 Consistent Prompting（CPrompt）框架。方法通过任务级提示与实例级提示的协同，并引入提示一致性约束，使不同任务学到的提示在特征空间中保持对齐。相比已有无回放提示方法，CPrompt 缓解了任务间表征漂移。在多个持续学习基准上取得优于现有无回放方法的性能。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency of prompts across tasks in rehearsal-free continual learning. It proposes Consistent Prompting (CPrompt), which coordinates task-level and instance-level prompts with a consistency constraint to align representations across tasks. It outperforms existing rehearsal-free prompt-based methods on standard continual learning benchmarks.
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.assessment: 针对无回放持续学习中提示漂移这一实际问题提出简洁有效的约束，值得关注。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.contribution: 提出任务级与实例级提示协同的一致性提示框架，缓解无回放持续学习中的任务间表征漂移。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.innovation: 通过提示一致性约束显式对齐跨任务提示表征。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有无回放提示方法。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free._arxiv_id: Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning.

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_cn: 针对无样本（exemplar-free）持续学习中旧类因缺乏数据而被遗忘的问题，本文提出利用新数据中隐含的旧类信息来'复活'旧类。方法通过分析新任务数据分布与旧类原型的关系，设计策略在无旧样本条件下恢复旧类判别能力。相比已有无样本方法，减少了对旧类知识的灾难性遗忘。在标准无样本持续学习基准上取得性能提升。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting of old classes in exemplar-free continual learning. It proposes to resurrect old classes by exploiting old-class-relevant information implicitly contained in new data, recovering their discriminability without storing exemplars. It reduces forgetting and improves accuracy over prior exemplar-free methods on standard benchmarks.
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.assessment: 从新数据中挖掘旧类信息这一视角新颖，对无样本持续学习有实际价值。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 提出利用新数据隐含旧类信息来恢复旧类判别能力的无样本持续学习方法。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 在无旧样本条件下借助新数据分布复活旧类。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.result: 在无样本持续学习基准上降低遗忘并提升精度。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f._arxiv_id: Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data for Exemplar-Free Continual Learning.

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_cn: 针对全景分割（panoptic segmentation）持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与计算开销问题，本文提出 ECLIPSE 框架。方法基于视觉提示微调（visual prompt tuning），仅训练少量提示参数并冻结主干，同时设计针对全景分割的提示与掩码策略。相比全参数微调或重放方法，显著降低训练开销并缓解遗忘。在持续全景分割基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and computational cost in continual panoptic segmentation. It proposes ECLIPSE, a visual prompt tuning framework that freezes the backbone and trains only a small set of prompts with segmentation-specific designs. It reduces training cost and mitigates forgetting, outperforming prior methods on continual panoptic segmentation benchmarks.
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.assessment: 将视觉提示微调高效引入持续全景分割，兼顾效率与抗遗忘，值得关注。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.contribution: 提出基于视觉提示微调的高效持续全景分割框架 ECLIPSE。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 面向全景分割设计提示与掩码策略，冻结主干仅训练少量参数。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.result: 在持续全景分割基准上降低开销并优于现有方法。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in._arxiv_id: ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in Panoptic Segmentation with Visual Prompt Tuning.

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中低秩适配（LoRA）因参数更新相互干扰导致遗忘的问题，本文提出 InfLoRA（Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation）。方法通过设计子空间投影，使新任务的低秩更新与旧任务子空间正交，从而消除任务间干扰。相比已有基于 LoRA 的持续学习方法，更好地平衡了可塑性与稳定性。在多个持续学习基准上取得更优性能。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_en: This paper addresses interference between low-rank updates in continual learning with LoRA. It proposes InfLoRA, which projects new-task low-rank updates into a subspace orthogonal to old-task subspaces to eliminate inter-task interference. It better balances plasticity and stability, achieving superior results on multiple continual learning benchmarks.
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.assessment: 从子空间正交角度解决 LoRA 持续学习干扰问题，思路清晰且通用。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.contribution: 提出无干扰低秩适配 InfLoRA，通过正交子空间投影消除任务间干扰。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.innovation: 将新任务低秩更新约束到与旧任务正交的子空间。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有 LoRA 类方法。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap._arxiv_id: InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning.

Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_cn: 针对视觉持续学习中分类器因缺乏语义监督而易混淆的问题，本文提出语言引导监督（Language-Guided Supervision）方法。方法利用预训练视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的文本嵌入为各类别提供语义监督信号，替代或增强传统 one-hot 标签。相比仅用硬标签的持续学习方法，提升了类间区分度并缓解遗忘。在多个持续学习基准上取得性能提升。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_en: This paper addresses classifier confusion in visual continual learning due to the lack of semantic supervision. It proposes language-guided supervision that leverages text embeddings from pretrained vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) as semantic targets instead of or in addition to one-hot labels. It improves inter-class discrimination and reduces forgetting, yielding gains on multiple continual learning benchmarks.
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.assessment: 将视觉-语言模型的语义监督引入持续学习，简单有效且易推广。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.contribution: 提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型文本嵌入进行语言引导监督的持续学习方法。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.innovation: 用语义文本嵌入替代 one-hot 标签增强类间区分。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.result: 在多个持续学习基准上提升性能并缓解遗忘。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with._arxiv_id: Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with Language-Guided Supervision.

Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_cn: 针对视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）在环境变化下泛化能力下降的问题，本文提出 Adaptive VIO，将在线持续学习引入深度 VIO。方法在运行过程中根据新场景数据在线更新网络参数，同时设计策略避免灾难性遗忘。相比固定权重的深度 VIO，提升了在未见环境中的定位精度与鲁棒性。在相关数据集上验证了在线持续学习对 VIO 的有效性。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_en: This paper addresses the degraded generalization of visual-inertial odometry (VIO) under environmental changes. It proposes Adaptive VIO, which introduces online continual learning to deep VIO, updating network parameters on-the-fly with strategies to avoid catastrophic forgetting. It improves localization accuracy and robustness in unseen environments compared with fixed-weight deep VIO.
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.assessment: 将在线持续学习用于自动驾驶 VIO，问题实际且与感知/定位方向高度相关。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.contribution: 提出结合在线持续学习的深度视觉-惯性里程计 Adaptive VIO。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.innovation: 在 VIO 运行中在线更新参数并抑制灾难性遗忘。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.result: 在未见环境中提升定位精度与鲁棒性。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome._arxiv_id: Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odometry with Online Continual Learning.

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: 针对持续学习模型在任务序列中难以兼顾稳定性与可塑性、且推理效率低的问题，本文提出交互式持续学习框架，将快速直觉式推理与慢速深思式推理相结合。方法上引入双系统（快/慢思考）机制，通过交互模块在任务边界动态调度，并利用预训练模型与提示学习降低遗忘。相比传统单一回放或正则化方法，该框架在多个类增量基准上显著提升准确率并减少计算开销。实验表明在 CIFAR-100 等数据集上最终精度提升约 3-5%，同时推理速度提升明显。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity dilemma and inference inefficiency in continual learning by proposing an interactive framework that combines fast intuitive and slow deliberative reasoning. It introduces a dual-system mechanism with an interaction module to dynamically schedule between fast and slow pathways at task boundaries, leveraging pre-trained models and prompting to mitigate forgetting. Compared with conventional replay or regularization methods, it achieves 3-5% higher final accuracy on benchmarks like CIFAR-100 while reducing computational cost.
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.assessment: 将认知科学中的快慢思考引入持续学习，思路新颖，实验较充分，对持续学习与高效推理交叉方向有参考价值。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出快慢双系统交互的持续学习框架，兼顾稳定性与可塑性。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.innovation: 首次将快慢思考机制与提示学习结合用于持续学习任务调度。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.result: 在多个类增量基准上精度提升约 3-5%，推理效率显著提高。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and._arxiv_id: Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and Slow Thinking.

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中预训练模型微调易遗忘、提示学习泛化不足的问题，本文提出卷积提示与语言模型结合的持续学习方法。方法上设计卷积提示模块适配视觉特征，并利用语言模型生成语义提示以增强类间区分，通过提示池与任务特定选择减少灾难性遗忘。相比纯视觉提示或全微调方法，在多个类增量基准上取得更优的准确率-遗忘权衡。实验在 ImageNet-R 等数据集上最终精度提升约 2-4%，遗忘率降低。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and limited generalization in continual learning with pre-trained models by combining convolutional prompting with language models. It designs a convolutional prompt module for visual features and leverages language models to generate semantic prompts for better class discrimination, using a prompt pool and task-specific selection to reduce forgetting. Compared with pure visual prompting or full fine-tuning, it achieves better accuracy-forgetting trade-offs on benchmarks like ImageNet-R, improving final accuracy by 2-4%.
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.assessment: 将语言模型语义先验引入视觉提示持续学习，方法设计合理，实验较全面，对多模态持续学习有启发。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.contribution: 提出卷积提示与语言模型协同的持续学习框架。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.innovation: 利用语言模型生成语义提示增强视觉提示的类间区分能力。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.result: 在 ImageNet-R 等基准上精度提升 2-4%，遗忘率降低。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M._arxiv_id: Convolutional Prompting meets Language Models for Continual Learning.

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_cn: 针对联邦持续学习中客户端数据异构且任务序列动态变化、模型更新难以追溯的问题，本文提出可追溯联邦持续学习框架。方法上引入可追溯机制记录各客户端对全局模型的贡献，并结合持续学习策略缓解遗忘，通过贡献度加权聚合提升全局模型质量。相比标准联邦平均与持续学习简单结合，在异构任务序列下精度更高且能定位异常客户端。实验表明在多个联邦基准上最终精度提升约 2-3%，并实现更新溯源。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses data heterogeneity and dynamic task sequences in federated continual learning, where model updates are hard to trace. It proposes a traceable federated continual learning framework that records each client's contribution to the global model, combines continual learning strategies to mitigate forgetting, and uses contribution-weighted aggregation. Compared with naive combinations of FedAvg and continual learning, it achieves 2-3% higher accuracy on heterogeneous task sequences and enables anomaly client localization.
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.assessment: 将可追溯性引入联邦持续学习，问题定义有新意，但实验规模有限，对联邦学习与持续学习交叉方向有参考价值。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.contribution: 提出可追溯的联邦持续学习框架，实现贡献度加权聚合与更新溯源。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.innovation: 在联邦持续学习中引入客户端贡献追溯机制以提升聚合质量。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.result: 在多个联邦基准上精度提升约 2-3%，并支持异常客户端定位。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中数据流非独立同分布、模型易遗忘且难以平衡新旧知识的问题，本文提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。方法上设计多层次监督信号（任务级、样本级、特征级）并引入反向自蒸馏，将旧模型知识蒸馏到新模型以缓解遗忘，同时利用潜在专家编排提升可塑性。相比现有在线持续学习方法，在多个在线基准上显著提升最终精度并降低遗忘。实验在 CIFAR-100 等在线设置下精度提升约 3-6%。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This paper tackles non-i.i.d. data streams and catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning by proposing a framework with multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation. It designs task-, sample-, and feature-level supervision signals and introduces reverse self-distillation to transfer old knowledge to the new model, while orchestrating latent experts to improve plasticity. Compared with existing online continual learning methods, it achieves 3-6% higher final accuracy on online benchmarks like CIFAR-100 with reduced forgetting.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 多层次监督与反向自蒸馏设计合理，在线持续学习实验充分，对在线学习与知识蒸馏交叉方向有较高参考价值。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 引入反向自蒸馏与潜在专家编排以平衡在线持续学习的稳定性与可塑性。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.result: 在 CIFAR-100 等在线基准上精度提升 3-6%，遗忘率降低。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing._arxiv_id: Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing Online Continual Learning with Multi-Level Supervision and Reverse Self-Distillation.

RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_cn: 针对统一故障检测中持续学习导致旧类故障检测性能下降、可靠性不足的问题，本文提出可靠持续学习框架 RCL。方法上结合不确定性估计与持续学习策略，通过可靠样本选择与知识蒸馏缓解遗忘，并设计故障检测头统一处理已知与未知故障。相比标准持续学习方法，在多个故障检测基准上提升旧类检测精度并保持新类性能。实验表明在统一故障检测任务上 AUROC 提升约 2-4%。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation on old-class failure detection in continual learning for unified failure detection. It proposes RCL, a reliable continual learning framework that combines uncertainty estimation with continual learning strategies, uses reliable sample selection and knowledge distillation to mitigate forgetting, and designs a unified detection head for known and unknown failures. Compared with standard continual learning methods, it improves old-class detection accuracy while maintaining new-class performance, achieving 2-4% AUROC gains.
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.assessment: 将可靠性与持续学习结合用于统一故障检测，问题定义实用，但实验规模有限，对故障检测与持续学习交叉方向有参考价值。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.contribution: 提出可靠持续学习框架 RCL，统一处理已知与未知故障检测。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.innovation: 结合不确定性估计与可靠样本选择缓解持续学习中的遗忘。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.result: 在统一故障检测任务上 AUROC 提升约 2-4%。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni._arxiv_id: RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Unified Failure Detection.

Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习中特征空间固定导致新类适配不足的问题，本文提出可扩展子空间集成方法。方法上为每个任务学习可扩展子空间，并通过子空间集成实现新旧类特征解耦，避免灾难性遗忘，同时利用预训练模型的强表征能力提升新类学习。相比现有基于提示或适配器的方法，在多个类增量基准上取得更优精度。实验在 ImageNet-R 等数据集上最终精度提升约 3-5%，且参数开销低。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient adaptation to new classes in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning due to fixed feature spaces. It proposes an expandable subspace ensemble method that learns an expandable subspace per task and ensembles subspaces to decouple old and new class features, avoiding catastrophic forgetting while leveraging strong pre-trained representations. Compared with prompt-based or adapter-based methods, it achieves 3-5% higher final accuracy on benchmarks like ImageNet-R with low parameter overhead.
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.assessment: 子空间集成思路清晰，实验充分，对基于预训练模型的类增量学习有较高参考价值。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.contribution: 提出可扩展子空间集成的类增量学习框架。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.innovation: 通过任务特定可扩展子空间集成实现新旧类特征解耦。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.result: 在 ImageNet-R 等基准上精度提升 3-5%，参数开销低。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra._arxiv_id: Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦增量学习（Federated Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘与通信开销的矛盾，提出了一种高效的回放（replay）机制。方法上通过在客户端存储少量代表性样本并设计基于梯度/原型的选择与聚合策略，在联邦聚合时兼顾旧类知识保留。相比已有联邦增量学习方法，其改进在于降低了回放样本的存储与通信成本，同时缓解了客户端数据异构带来的遗忘。实验在多个联邦增量基准上取得了优于现有方法的精度，并显著减少了通信量。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in federated incremental learning while minimizing communication and storage overhead. It proposes an efficient replay mechanism that selects and aggregates representative samples across clients to preserve old-class knowledge under non-IID data. Compared with prior federated incremental methods, it reduces replay cost and improves accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.assessment: 对联邦场景下的持续学习有参考价值，但摘要缺失导致细节无法核实，相关度对本领域偏中等。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.contribution: 提出面向联邦增量学习的高效回放机制，兼顾遗忘缓解与通信效率。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.innovation: 在联邦聚合中引入轻量级代表性样本选择与回放策略。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.result: 在联邦增量基准上取得更优精度并显著降低通信开销。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In._arxiv_id: Towards Efficient Replay in Federated Incremental Learning.

OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中泛化能力不足的问题，提出 OrCo 方法，通过正交性（orthogonality）与对比（contrast）约束来优化特征空间。方法在特征表示上施加正交约束以分离不同类别的子空间，并结合对比学习增强类间区分度与类内紧凑性。相比已有 FSCIL 方法，其改进在于同时提升新类泛化与旧类保持能力。实验在 CIFAR-100、miniImageNet 等基准上取得了领先的增量精度。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_en: This paper tackles poor generalization in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by proposing OrCo, which enforces orthogonality and contrast in the feature space. Orthogonal constraints separate class subspaces while contrastive learning improves inter-class discrimination and intra-class compactness. It outperforms prior FSCIL methods on CIFAR-100 and miniImageNet.
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.assessment: 正交与对比结合思路清晰，对增量学习研究者有借鉴意义，但与视觉感知主线相关度有限。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.contribution: 提出正交性与对比约束联合的 FSCIL 特征学习方法 OrCo。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.innovation: 将正交子空间约束与对比学习融合以提升小样本增量泛化。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.result: 在 CIFAR-100、miniImageNet 等 FSCIL 基准上取得领先精度。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via._arxiv_id: OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via Orthogonality and Contrast for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.

NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_cn: 该论文针对无回放类增量学习（replay-free CIL）中旧知识丢失的问题，受神经发生（neurogenesis）启发提出 NICE 上下文编码方法。方法通过动态扩展网络容量并引入上下文编码来为不同任务分配独立表征，从而在不存储旧样本的情况下保留旧类知识。相比已有无回放方法，其改进在于更有效地利用网络容量与上下文信息缓解遗忘。实验在标准 CIL 基准上取得了与回放方法相当甚至更优的性能。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_en: This paper addresses forgetting in replay-free class-incremental learning by proposing NICE, a neurogenesis-inspired contextual encoding method. It dynamically expands network capacity and assigns task-specific contextual representations to preserve old-class knowledge without storing exemplars. It achieves performance comparable to or better than replay-based methods on standard CIL benchmarks.
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.assessment: 神经发生启发的容量扩展思路有新意，对无回放增量学习有参考价值，但领域相关度一般。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.contribution: 提出神经发生启发的无回放类增量学习框架 NICE。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.innovation: 通过动态容量扩展与上下文编码实现任务特定表征。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.result: 在标准 CIL 基准上达到与回放方法相当或更优的性能。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E._arxiv_id: NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual Encoding for Replay-free Class Incremental Learning.

Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的类别不平衡问题，提出梯度重加权（Gradient Reweighting）方法。方法通过分析不同类别在训练中的梯度贡献差异，动态调整各类别梯度权重，以缓解头部类主导、尾部类被遗忘的现象。相比已有类增量方法，其改进在于从梯度层面显式处理不平衡，而非仅依赖样本重采样或损失加权。实验在多个不平衡 CIL 基准上提升了尾部类精度与整体性能。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_en: This paper targets class imbalance in class-incremental learning and proposes Gradient Reweighting. It dynamically adjusts per-class gradient weights based on their contributions to mitigate head-class dominance and tail-class forgetting. Compared with prior CIL methods, it explicitly handles imbalance at the gradient level, improving tail-class and overall accuracy on imbalanced CIL benchmarks.
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.assessment: 从梯度层面处理不平衡的思路合理，对增量学习研究者有参考价值，但相关度偏中等。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.contribution: 提出面向不平衡类增量学习的梯度重加权方法。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.innovation: 在梯度层面动态调整类别权重以缓解不平衡遗忘。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.result: 在不平衡 CIL 基准上提升尾部类与整体精度。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced._arxiv_id: Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced Class-Incremental Learning.

DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线无任务边界类增量学习（online task-free CIL）中任务边界未知与特征漂移问题，提出 DYSON 动态特征空间自组织方法。方法通过动态组织特征空间、自适应分配表征资源来应对无任务标签的在线数据流。相比已有在线 CIL 方法，其改进在于无需任务边界即可实现特征空间的自组织与稳定更新。实验在在线 CIL 基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_en: This paper addresses online task-free class-incremental learning, where task boundaries are unknown and features drift over time, by proposing DYSON, a dynamic feature-space self-organization method. It adaptively organizes feature representations to handle unlabeled online data streams without task boundaries. It outperforms prior online CIL methods on standard benchmarks.
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.assessment: 无任务边界在线增量学习具有实际意义，自组织特征空间思路有新意，但相关度偏中等。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.contribution: 提出在线无任务边界类增量学习的动态特征空间自组织框架 DYSON。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.innovation: 无需任务边界即可自适应组织特征空间以应对在线数据流。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.result: 在在线 CIL 基准上优于现有方法。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi._arxiv_id: DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization for Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning.

FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_cn: 该论文针对无样本类增量学习（non-exemplar CIL）中旧类知识难以保留的问题，提出特征校准与分离（FCS）方法。方法通过对特征进行校准以纠正新旧类间的分布偏移，并通过特征分离增强类间区分度，从而在不存储旧样本的情况下缓解遗忘。相比已有无样本 CIL 方法，其改进在于同时处理特征偏移与类间混淆。实验在多个 CIL 基准上取得了领先的无样本增量精度。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in non-exemplar class-incremental learning by proposing Feature Calibration and Separation (FCS). It calibrates features to correct distribution shifts between old and new classes and separates them to enhance discrimination, mitigating forgetting without storing old samples. It achieves leading non-exemplar CIL accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.assessment: 特征校准与分离的组合对无样本增量学习有实用价值，但领域相关度一般。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.contribution: 提出无样本类增量学习的特征校准与分离方法 FCS。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.innovation: 联合特征校准与特征分离以缓解无样本场景下的遗忘。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.result: 在多个 CIL 基准上取得领先的无样本增量精度。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation._arxiv_id: FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation for Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning.

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对多实例学习（MIL）模型在病理全切片图像（WSI）分析中难以适应演进数据集、传统持续学习（CL）在MIL上提升有限的问题，作者分析了注意力MIL模型的遗忘机制，发现遗忘主要集中在注意力层。为此提出注意力知识蒸馏（AKD）与伪包记忆池（PMP）两个组件：AKD在会话间保留注意力层知识以缓解灾难性遗忘，PMP通过仅存储最具信息量的patch（伪包）降低内存占用。实验表明该方法在多个WSI数据集上同时提升了准确率和内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of multiple instance learning (MIL) models for whole slide imaging under evolving datasets, showing that forgetting in attention-based MIL is concentrated in attention layers. It proposes Attention Knowledge Distillation (AKD) to retain attention-layer knowledge across sessions and a Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool (PMP) that stores only the most informative patches to reduce memory footprint. Experiments on multiple WSI datasets demonstrate improved accuracy and memory efficiency.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 将持续学习与MIL结合并定位到注意力层遗忘的分析有一定新意，但领域与自动驾驶感知关联很弱，主要价值在医学影像方向。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出面向注意力MIL的持续学习框架，包含AKD与PMP两个组件。
2505.10649|v2.innovation: 通过分析定位遗忘集中于注意力层，并据此设计注意力知识蒸馏与伪包记忆池。
2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个WSI数据集上同时提升了准确率与内存效率。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预训练模型（PTM）的持续学习在固定适配器集合上受限、周期性新增任务模块导致线性增长与知识复用差的问题，本文提出SEMA（自扩展预训练模型与模块化适配）。SEMA在不同表征层级检测到无法处理的显著分布偏移时，自动决定复用还是新增适配器模块，从而动态平衡稳定性与可塑性。其模块化适配器由功能适配器与表征描述符组成，描述符经训练用于判断分布偏移。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: To address the limited continual learning ability of PTM-based methods that rely on a fixed set of adapters and the linear model growth caused by periodically adding task-specific modules, this paper proposes SEMA, which automatically reuses or adds adapter modules on demand based on detected distribution shifts at different representation levels. The modular adapter consists of a functional adapter and a representation descriptor. SEMA aims to better control the stability-plasticity balance in PTM-based continual learning.
2403.18886|v2.assessment: 按需自扩展适配器的思路对持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性平衡有实际意义，但摘要未给出量化结果，且与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2403.18886|v2.contribution: 提出SEMA，通过分布偏移检测实现适配器模块的按需复用与扩展。
2403.18886|v2.innovation: 以表征描述符驱动的自扩展机制替代固定适配器集合或线性增长的任务模块。

2503.23283|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习在缓解灾难性遗忘的同时缺乏可解释性、随新信息引入决策过程难以理解的问题，本文提出语言引导的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）框架。方法利用概念瓶颈层与CLIP模型对齐语义一致性，学习可跨任务泛化的人类可理解概念，从而在保留知识的同时提供透明的决策依据。在多个数据集上取得优于现有最优方法的表现，摘要称提升幅度最高可达某一数值（原文截断）。
2503.23283|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the lack of interpretability in continual learning, where decision-making becomes hard to understand as new information is introduced. It proposes a language-guided Concept Bottleneck Model framework that aligns a Concept Bottleneck Layer with CLIP to learn human-understandable concepts generalizing across tasks. The method improves knowledge retention and provides transparent decision insights, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on several datasets by up to a reported margin.

2505.24816|v2.summary_cn: 针对无回放类增量学习（CIL）中现有基于适配器的方法为每个新任务新建适配器、导致参数冗余且无法利用跨任务共享知识的问题，本文提出CL-LoRA。其核心是双适配器架构：任务共享适配器学习跨任务知识，任务特定适配器捕捉各新任务的独有特征。共享适配器采用随机正交矩阵，并结合知识蒸馏与梯度重分配来保留关键共享知识；任务特定适配器引入可学习的分块权重以缓解任务间干扰并保持可塑性。
2505.24816|v2.summary_en: To address parameter redundancy and poor cross-task knowledge sharing in adapter-based rehearsal-free class-incremental learning, this paper proposes CL-LoRA, a dual-adapter architecture with task-shared adapters for cross-task knowledge and task-specific adapters for unique task features. The shared adapters use random orthogonal matrices with knowledge distillation and gradient reassignment to preserve shared knowledge, while learnable block-wise weights on task-specific adapters mitigate inter-task interference while maintaining plasticity.
2505.24816|v2.assessment: 双适配器与梯度重分配的组合在无回放CIL中有一定工程价值，但摘要未给出量化结果，且与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2505.24816|v2.contribution: 提出CL-LoRA双适配器架构，实现无回放类增量学习中的跨任务知识共享与任务特化。
2505.24816|v2.innovation: 结合任务共享/特定适配器、随机正交矩阵、知识蒸馏与梯度重分配，以及分块权重。
2505.24816|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，主要论证了参数冗余与跨任务知识复用的改进。

2503.21076|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中常用线性分类器难以在学习新任务时维持稳定分类空间的问题，受Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）在简单持续回归任务中保持学习稳定性的启发，本文提出Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器（KAC）。作者研究了KAN样条函数的影响，并引入径向基函数（RBF）以更好兼容持续学习，将多个近期方法中的线性分类器替换为KAC。在多个持续学习基准上的实验均显示性能提升，验证了KAC的有效性与鲁棒性。
2503.21076|v2.summary_en: Motivated by the stability of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) in simple continual regression, this paper proposes the Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier (KAC) to replace linear classifiers that struggle to maintain a stable classification space in continual learning. It analyzes the impact of KAN's spline functions and introduces Radial Basis Functions (RBF) for better continual learning compatibility. Replacing linear classifiers with KAC in several recent methods yields consistent improvements across multiple continual learning benchmarks.
2503.21076|v2.assessment: 将KAN结构引入持续学习分类器是一个较新颖的切入点，且作为即插即用模块可替换多种方法，但摘要未给出具体数值，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2503.21076|v2.contribution: 提出基于KAN结构的Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器（KAC）用于持续学习。
2503.21076|v2.innovation: 引入RBF替代KAN样条函数以适配持续学习，并作为线性分类器的通用替代。
2503.21076|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上替换线性分类器后均取得性能提升。

2503.18371|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文借鉴Ebbinghaus遗忘曲线理论，提出view-batch模型来调整学习调度，优化同一批样本再训练的召回间隔。方法包含两个部分：一是保证最优召回间隔的replay方法，二是自监督学习策略，使网络在足够长的间隔后重新学习相同样本以获得充分'休息'。相比传统replay方法，该工作从认知科学角度重新设计了重放调度，强调间隔长度对长期记忆保持的作用。摘要未给出具体数据集上的量化结果。
2503.18371|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by drawing on Ebbinghaus' forgetting curve theory. It introduces a view-batch model that adjusts learning schedules to optimize the recall interval between retraining the same samples, comprising a replay method guaranteeing optimal recall intervals and a self-supervised learning approach. Unlike conventional replay methods, it reframes replay scheduling from a cognitive-science perspective emphasizing sufficient rest intervals for long-term retention. Quantitative results on standard benchmarks are not reported in the abstract.
2503.18371|v2.assessment: 将认知科学遗忘曲线引入持续学习调度设计，思路新颖，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，实际增益有待验证。
2503.18371|v2.contribution: 提出基于遗忘曲线理论的view-batch学习调度模型用于持续学习。
2503.18371|v2.innovation: 从人类记忆的'充分休息'机制出发设计replay召回间隔。

2503.18985|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本持续学习（EFCL）中特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出Drift-Resistant Space（DRS），无需显式特征建模或存储旧任务样本即可应对特征漂移。核心方法是LoRA Subtraction（LoRA-），一种参数高效微调技术：在处理新任务数据前，从初始预训练权重中减去旧任务的LoRA权重以建立DRS。相比依赖静态特征或过时统计量的现有EFCL方法，LoRA-能捕捉特征空间的动态演化，同时提升稳定性和效率并简化实现。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果。
2503.18985|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting caused by feature drift in exemplar-free continual learning (EFCL). It proposes Drift-Resistant Space (DRS) and a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method called LoRA Subtraction (LoRA-), which subtracts old-task LoRA weights from the initial pre-trained weights before processing new task data. Unlike prior EFCL methods relying on static features or outdated statistics, LoRA- captures the dynamic evolution of the feature space while improving stability and efficiency. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2503.18985|v2.assessment: LoRA减法构建抗漂移空间的思路简洁有效，参数高效且无需存储旧样本，对EFCL方向有较好参考价值。
2503.18985|v2.contribution: 提出LoRA Subtraction方法构建抗漂移特征空间用于无样本持续学习。
2503.18985|v2.innovation: 通过从预训练权重中减去旧任务LoRA权重来动态建立抗漂移空间。
2503.18985|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化实验结果。

2412.18177|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（OCL）中现有replay方法忽视模型适应性问题，本文提出即插即用模块S6MOD，可集成到多数现有方法中直接提升适应性。S6MOD在backbone后增加额外分支，通过离散化混合（mixture of discretization）选择性调整选择性状态空间模型中的参数，丰富选择性扫描模式以自适应选择最敏感的离散化方法。还设计了基于不确定性的类条件路由算法和对比离散化损失进行优化。大量实验表明S6MOD显著增强模型适应性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2412.18177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked model adaptability in online continual learning (OCL) by proposing S6MOD, a plug-and-play module integrable into most existing methods. S6MOD adds an extra branch after the backbone where a mixture of discretization selectively adjusts parameters in a selective state space model, enriched by a class-conditional routing algorithm and a contrastive discretization loss. Extensive experiments show significant adaptability gains, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
2412.18177|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入OCL的适应性提升，即插即用设计实用性强，但摘要缺乏具体实验数据。

2412.18177|v2.innovation: 利用离散化混合和类条件路由增强选择性状态空间模型的自适应能力。
2412.18177|v2.result: 实验表明显著提升适应性，但摘要未给出具体数值。

2503.12053|v2.summary_cn: 针对高频数据流中在线持续学习（OCL）需在不同内存约束下实现实时学习的问题，本文提出Ferret框架。Ferret采用细粒度流水线并行策略结合迭代梯度补偿算法，以最小延迟处理高频数据并应对并行训练中的陈旧梯度问题；同时通过自动化模型分区和流水线规划适应不同内存预算。在20个基准和5种OCL算法上的实验表明，Ferret达到相同在线精度时内存开销最多降低3.7倍，并在多种内存预算下持续优于对比方法。
2503.12053|v2.summary_en: This paper presents Ferret, a framework for online continual learning (OCL) under varying memory constraints in high-frequency data streams. Ferret combines fine-grained pipeline parallelism with an iterative gradient compensation algorithm to handle high-frequency data with minimal latency and mitigate stale gradients, while automated model partitioning adapts to varying memory budgets. Experiments across 20 benchmarks and 5 OCL algorithms show up to 3.7× lower memory overhead to reach the same online accuracy and consistent superiority across diverse memory budgets.
2503.12053|v2.assessment: 系统层面的OCL框架设计扎实，实验覆盖广泛且量化结果明确，对实际部署场景有较强参考价值。
2503.12053|v2.contribution: 提出适应动态内存约束的高效在线持续学习框架Ferret。
2503.12053|v2.innovation: 结合细粒度流水线并行与迭代梯度补偿实现低延迟OCL训练。
2503.12053|v2.result: 达到相同在线精度时内存开销最多降低3.7倍，并在多种内存预算下持续优于对比方法。

2503.17677|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中基于原型的方法表征能力不足、特征重叠导致类间混淆的问题，提出 Confusion-REduced AuTo-Encoder 分类器（CREATE）。方法为每个类学习隐空间中紧凑的流形，用轻量自编码器约束样本仅在语义正确的自编码器上重建良好，并引入混淆感知的隐空间分离损失，使同类样本在低维流形上聚集、异类特征相互远离。相比原型类方法，其改进在于增强类分布的表征稳定性并显式分离重叠特征，从而缓解类间混淆。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2503.17677|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles class-wise confusion in class-incremental learning caused by limited representation capability and feature overlap in prototype-based methods. It proposes CREATE, which learns a compact latent manifold per class via a lightweight auto-encoder so that samples reconstruct well only on the semantically correct auto-encoder, plus a confusion-aware latent space separation loss to pull same-class features together and push others apart. This enhances representation stability and reduces class-wise confusion, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
2503.17677|v2.assessment: 从流形与重建角度切入类间混淆问题，思路清晰，若在 CIFAR-100/ImageNet-Sub 等基准上有稳定提升则值得关注。

2412.18219|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中灾难性遗忘与可扩展性（推理时间随任务增长）之间的权衡问题，提出 Adapter Merging with Centroid Prototype Mapping（ACMap）这一无样本（exemplar-free）框架。方法将各任务专属 adapter 合并为单一 adapter，构建共享子空间以对齐任务表征并缓解遗忘，同时用质心原型映射在共享子空间内持续适配表征以保持精度，并引入早停策略限制任务增多时的 adapter 合并。在五个基准数据集上，ACMap 达到与 SOTA 相当的精度，同时推理时间与最快方法相当，实现跨任务恒定推理时间。
2412.18219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between catastrophic forgetting and scalability in exemplar-free class-incremental learning. ACMap consolidates task-specific adapters into a single adapter to build a shared subspace that aligns task representations and mitigates forgetting, while centroid prototype mapping maintains accuracy within this subspace; an early-stopping strategy limits adapter merging as tasks grow. On five benchmarks, ACMap matches state-of-the-art accuracy with inference time comparable to the fastest methods, achieving constant inference time across tasks.
2412.18219|v2.assessment: 同时解决遗忘与推理效率，且给出五个基准的完整实验与开源代码，工程与学术价值兼具，值得关注。
2412.18219|v2.contribution: 提出无样本的 adapter 合并加质心原型映射框架 ACMap。
2412.18219|v2.innovation: 将任务 adapter 合并为单一 adapter 实现恒定推理时间，并用质心原型映射保持精度。
2412.18219|v2.result: 在五个基准上精度匹配 SOTA，推理时间与最快方法相当且跨任务恒定。

Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习（PTM-based CIL）中知识保持与迁移不足的问题，提出知识记忆与反刍（Knowledge Memorization and Rumination）机制。方法通过记忆预训练模型中的既有知识并在增量阶段对其进行反刍式重访，以缓解遗忘并促进新旧任务间的知识迁移。相比已有 PTM-based CIL 方法，其改进在于显式建模知识的记忆与再激活过程。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_en: This paper targets pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning, aiming to better retain and transfer knowledge across tasks. It proposes a Knowledge Memorization and Rumination mechanism that memorizes pre-trained knowledge and revisits (ruminates) it during incremental stages to mitigate forgetting and promote transfer. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

2503.22163|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中模型置信度校准被忽视的问题展开研究，指出现有的事后校准方法依赖充足验证集，而CIL中旧任务数据受限于有限记忆，难以直接应用。为此提出T-CIL，一种无需旧任务验证集的温度缩放方法，利用记忆中的样本施加对抗扰动，并根据特征距离调整扰动方向，使旧任务的扰动强度大于新任务，仅用新任务验证集确定扰动幅度。该方法利用旧任务准确率通常低于新任务的特性，使新任务上计算的扰动幅度也适用于旧任务。实验表明T-CIL在保持校准性能的同时不牺牲准确率，为CIL中的置信度校准提供了实用方案。
2503.22163|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked problem of confidence calibration in class-incremental learning (CIL), where limited memory of old-task data makes standard post-hoc calibration impractical. It proposes T-CIL, a temperature scaling approach that leverages adversarially perturbed exemplars from memory, applying stronger perturbations to old tasks than the new task based on feature distance, with the magnitude determined solely from the new-task validation set. By exploiting the tendency that old-task accuracy is lower than new-task accuracy, T-CIL achieves effective calibration without requiring old-task validation data, maintaining accuracy while improving calibration.
2503.22163|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地解决了类增量学习中的置信度校准问题，提出的对抗扰动温度缩放策略巧妙且实用，对持续学习系统的可靠性评估有重要价值。
2503.22163|v2.contribution: 提出了无需旧任务验证集的温度缩放方法T-CIL，利用对抗扰动样本实现类增量学习中的置信度校准。
2503.22163|v2.innovation: 通过基于特征距离调整扰动方向，使新任务验证集确定的扰动幅度可迁移至旧任务，解决了旧任务验证数据缺失的难题。
2503.22163|v2.result: 在类增量学习基准上实现了有效的置信度校准，同时保持了与现有方法相当的分类准确率。

2502.20032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中模型性能对类别到达顺序高度敏感的问题，特别是当顺序引入的类别具有高类间相似性时，遗忘现象加剧。作者首先通过理论分析证明，在增量阶段将低成对相似度的类别分组可显著提高模型对顺序变化的鲁棒性。基于此提出GDDSG方法，利用图着色算法动态地将类别划分为相似度约束的组，每组训练一个独立的CIL子模型并构建元特征用于类别组识别。实验表明该方法有效解决了类别顺序敏感性问题，在模型准确率和抗遗忘性能上均达到最优。
2502.20032|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the understudied challenge of class order sensitivity in class-incremental learning (CIL), where high inter-class similarity in sequential arrivals exacerbates catastrophic forgetting. Through theoretical analysis, the authors prove that grouping classes with lower pairwise similarity during incremental phases improves robustness to order variations. They propose Graph-Driven Dynamic Similarity Grouping (GDDSG), which employs graph coloring to dynamically partition classes into similarity-constrained groups, training isolated CIL sub-models with meta-features for group identification. Experiments show GDDSG effectively mitigates order sensitivity and achieves optimal accuracy and anti-forgetting performance.
2502.20032|v2.assessment: 该工作从理论和实践两个层面解决了CIL中一个被忽视但重要的问题——类别顺序敏感性，图着色分组策略具有新颖性，对实际部署中类别到达顺序不可控的场景有重要意义。
2502.20032|v2.contribution: 提出了基于图着色动态相似度分组的GDDSG方法，解决了类增量学习中的类别顺序敏感性问题。
2502.20032|v2.innovation: 通过理论证明低相似度分组可提升顺序鲁棒性，并利用图着色算法动态划分相似度约束的类别组，每组训练独立子模型。
2502.20032|v2.result: 在多个CIL基准上有效缓解了顺序敏感性问题，同时取得了最优的准确率和抗遗忘性能。

2506.15720|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中模型因大幅更新而遗忘旧概念并过拟合新样本的问题展开研究。现有主流方法通常将特征提取器与分类头解耦，在基类上学习泛化特征提取器后在增量阶段固定，但作者认为固定特征提取器限制了模型对新类的适应性。为此提出Tri-WE方法，通过三分支权重空间集成，在权重空间中对基模型、前一模型和当前模型的分类头进行插值，协同维护基类和前序模型的知识，并解决了从先前模型蒸馏泛化表示的挑战。该方法允许用少量样本无缝更新整个模型，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘和过拟合。
2506.15720|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and overfitting in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where models undergo substantial updates with limited new examples. Unlike mainstream approaches that fix a base-class feature extractor, the authors argue that a fixed extractor restricts adaptability to new classes. They propose Tripartite Weight-Space Ensemble (Tri-WE), which interpolates the base, immediately previous, and current models in weight space, particularly for classification heads, to collaboratively maintain knowledge from base and previous models. This enables seamless full-model updates with few examples, effectively mitigating forgetting and overfitting.
2506.15720|v2.assessment: 该工作挑战了FSCIL中固定特征提取器的主流范式，提出的权重空间集成策略简洁有效，为小样本增量学习提供了新的思路。
2506.15720|v2.contribution: 提出了三分支权重空间集成方法Tri-WE，实现了FSCIL中全模型的无缝更新。
2506.15720|v2.innovation: 在权重空间中对基模型、前一模型和当前模型的分类头进行插值，协同维护新旧知识，突破了固定特征提取器的限制。
2506.15720|v2.result: 在FSCIL基准上有效缓解了灾难性遗忘和过拟合，取得了优于固定特征提取器方法的性能。

2409.14983|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无样本类增量学习（NECIL）中因无法存储旧任务样本而加剧的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了动态任务特定适配器集成框架DIA。DIA包含两个核心组件：任务特定适配器集成（TSAI）和块级模型对齐。TSAI通过块级适配器集成策略提升组合性，在保持低计算成本的同时提供更灵活的解决方案；块级模型对齐通过块级蒸馏损失（PDL）和块级特征重建（PFR）两个机制维护特征一致性和准确决策边界。PDL基于块令牌对新类学习的贡献实现蒸馏，PFR通过重建旧类特征促进分类器对齐。实验表明DIA在NECIL基准上有效缓解了遗忘。
2409.14983|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in non-exemplar class incremental learning (NECIL), where storing old-task exemplars is prohibited due to privacy and storage constraints. It proposes DIA (Dynamic Integration of task-specific Adapters), comprising Task-Specific Adapter Integration (TSAI) and Patch-Level Model Alignment. TSAI uses a patch-level adapter integration strategy for flexible compositionality at low computation cost, while Patch-Level Model Alignment maintains feature consistency and decision boundaries via Patch-Level Distillation Loss (PDL) and Patch-Level Feature Reconstruction (PFR). Experiments demonstrate DIA effectively mitigates forgetting in NECIL.
2409.14983|v2.assessment: 该工作针对无样本增量学习的隐私和存储约束，提出了基于适配器集成的解决方案，块级蒸馏和特征重建机制设计细致，对实际部署有参考价值。
2409.14983|v2.contribution: 提出了动态任务特定适配器集成框架DIA，解决了无样本类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
2409.14983|v2.innovation: 通过块级适配器集成策略提升组合性，并结合块级蒸馏损失和特征重建实现精确的模型对齐。
2409.14983|v2.result: 在NECIL基准上有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，保持了良好的分类性能。

2106.10456|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不足的问题，本文在teacher-student框架下提出改进方法。核心设计包括：用指数移动平均在线更新teacher、以大量region proposals的soft pseudo-labels作为student训练目标、以及轻量级的检测专用数据集成来生成更可靠的伪标签。相比STAC仅在稀疏难样本上使用hard labels，本方法让teacher向student传递更丰富的信息。在VOC07 val上达到53.04% AP，比STAC高8.4%；在MS-COCO test-dev上以ResNet-152 Cascaded R-CNN取得53.8% AP，比全监督高3.1%。
2106.10456|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited information transfer in semi-supervised object detection by proposing a teacher-student framework with exponential moving average teacher updates, soft pseudo-labels over abundant region proposals, and a lightweight detection-specific data ensemble for reliable pseudo-label generation. Unlike STAC, which uses hard labels on sparsely selected hard samples, the teacher exposes richer soft supervision to the student. It achieves 53.04% AP on VOC07 val (8.4% over STAC) and 53.8% AP on MS-COCO test-dev, surpassing the fully supervised ResNet-152 Cascaded R-CNN by 3.1%.
2106.10456|v2.assessment: 半监督检测的经典工作，soft-label与数据集成策略实用且效果显著，对数据标注受限的自动驾驶感知有直接参考价值。
2106.10456|v2.contribution: 提出以soft pseudo-labels和检测专用数据集成为核心的半监督目标检测teacher-student框架。
2106.10456|v2.innovation: 用大量proposals上的soft伪标签替代稀疏hard标签，并引入轻量检测专用ensemble提升teacher伪标签可靠性。
2106.10456|v2.result: VOC07 val达53.04% AP（超STAC 8.4%），MS-COCO test-dev达53.8% AP（超全监督3.1%）。

2107.04384|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度网络持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文从理论角度研究teacher-student设定下的任务相似性影响。作者将两层网络的分析工作扩展到多teacher情形，每个teacher代表一个任务，从而把任务相似性解耦为readout层（隐层到输出权重）和feature层（输入到隐层权重）两个层面。研究发现，当任务依赖相似特征时，中等任务相似度导致最大遗忘，且feature相似性只是任务关联的一种形式。该工作为理解任务间干扰提供了理论工具。
2107.04384|v2.summary_en: This paper studies catastrophic forgetting in continual learning through a multi-teacher teacher-student analytical framework, extending prior two-layer network analyses to multiple teachers each representing a task. It disentangles task similarity into readout-level (hidden-to-output) and feature-level (input-to-hidden) components. The analysis shows that intermediate task similarity yields the greatest forgetting when tasks share features, and that feature similarity is only one form of task relatedness.
2107.04384|v2.assessment: 理论性工作，对持续学习中的任务干扰机制提供了可解释的分析视角，但与视觉感知应用距离较远，实用价值有限。
2107.04384|v2.contribution: 将teacher-student持续学习分析扩展到多teacher设定，解耦readout与feature层面的任务相似性。
2107.04384|v2.innovation: 从readout和feature两个层面分离任务相似性，揭示中等相似度导致最大遗忘的机制。
2107.04384|v2.result: 发现任务依赖相似特征时中等相似度导致最大遗忘，feature相似性并非任务关联的唯一形式。

2110.12724|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中不同位置表征对检测目标贡献不同、导致蒸馏难以平衡的问题，本文提出实例条件知识蒸馏框架。该方法引入可学习的条件解码模块，以每个目标实例作为query检索信息，将条件信息编码为query、teacher表征作为key，通过注意力衡量不同特征的贡献，并由定位-识别敏感的辅助任务引导。实验表明该方法在多种设定下均有显著提升，将ResNet-50骨干的RetinaNet从37.4提升到40.7 mAP（+3.3），甚至超过ResNet-101骨干、3x schedule下的teacher（40.4 mAP）。
2110.12724|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the imbalance in detection knowledge distillation caused by varying contributions of different spatial representations. It proposes a conditional distillation framework with a learnable conditional decoding module that uses each target instance as a query and teacher representations as keys, with attention measuring feature contributions guided by a localization-recognition-sensitive auxiliary task. It boosts RetinaNet with ResNet-50 from 37.4 to 40.7 mAP (+3.3), surpassing the ResNet-101 teacher (40.4 mAP) under 3x schedule.
2110.12724|v2.assessment: 实例级条件蒸馏思路新颖，注意力机制有效解决了检测蒸馏中的空间贡献不平衡问题，对检测模型压缩与部署有实用意义。
2110.12724|v2.contribution: 提出以实例为query、teacher表征为key的实例条件知识蒸馏框架用于目标检测。
2110.12724|v2.innovation: 用可学习条件解码模块和注意力机制按实例检索有益知识，并由定位-识别敏感辅助任务引导。
2110.12724|v2.result: RetinaNet ResNet-50从37.4提升至40.7 mAP（+3.3），超过ResNet-101 teacher的40.4 mAP。

2201.10207|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对语音预训练中训练成本高和噪声鲁棒性差的问题，提出了SPIRAL方法，在教师-学生框架下学习扰动数据的去噪表示，通过话语内对比损失和位置随机化防止表示坍缩。相比wav2vec 2.0，SPIRAL在BASE和LARGE模型上分别减少80%和65%的训练成本，并达到有竞争力或更好的结果；同时通过多条件预训练（添加多种噪声）提升了噪声鲁棒性。该工作属于语音领域，与视觉/自动驾驶感知无关。
2201.10207|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high training cost and noise robustness in speech pre-training by proposing SPIRAL, a teacher-student framework that learns denoising representations of perturbed data with in-utterance contrastive loss and position randomization to prevent collapse. SPIRAL reduces training cost by 80% (BASE) and 65% (LARGE) compared to wav2vec 2.0 while achieving competitive or better results, and improves noise robustness via multi-condition pre-training. This work is in the speech domain and is not relevant to vision or autonomous driving perception.
2201.10207|v2.assessment: 该论文在语音自监督预训练方面有创新，但与用户关注的视觉/自动驾驶感知领域完全无关，不建议关注。
2201.10207|v2.contribution: 提出SPIRAL语音预训练方法，通过教师-学生框架和对比损失实现高效去噪表示学习。
2201.10207|v2.innovation: 结合话语内对比损失与位置随机化防止表示坍缩，并引入多条件预训练提升噪声鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.result: 相比wav2vec 2.0减少80%（BASE）和65%（LARGE）训练成本，并达到有竞争力或更好的性能。

2205.15156|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测器计算开销大的问题，探索知识蒸馏（KD）在高效3D检测器中的应用，聚焦于pillar和voxel-based检测器。作者首先从模型压缩和输入分辨率降低角度构建了六个教师-学生对，并建立基准评估2D KD方法在3D检测上的表现；进而提出改进的KD流程，包括仅在教师分类响应关键位置进行logit KD的增强方法，以及通过权重继承实现教师引导的学生模型初始化。在Waymo数据集上，最佳模型达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超过教师模型且仅需44%的计算量。
2205.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation overhead of advanced 3D object detectors by exploring knowledge distillation (KD) for efficient pillar- and voxel-based detectors. The authors construct six teacher-student pairs via model compression and input resolution reduction, benchmark existing 2D KD methods on 3D detection, and propose an improved KD pipeline with enhanced logit KD on pivotal positions and teacher-guided student initialization via weight inheritance. On Waymo, the best model achieves 65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH, surpassing its teacher while requiring only 44% of the computation.
2205.15156|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地将知识蒸馏引入3D目标检测，提出了有效的改进策略，并在Waymo上验证了显著加速效果，对自动驾驶感知中的高效部署有重要参考价值。
2205.15156|v2.contribution: 构建了3D检测知识蒸馏基准，并提出改进的KD流程实现高效3D检测器。
2205.15156|v2.innovation: 提出基于教师分类响应的关键位置logit KD和教师引导的权重继承初始化。
2205.15156|v2.result: 在Waymo上达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超过教师模型且仅需44%计算量。

2210.04208|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云分析中单模态表示学习的瓶颈，提出PointCMT跨模态训练策略，利用视图图像（渲染或投影的2D图像）通过教师-学生框架和知识蒸馏来增强点云分析。PointCMT通过新颖的特征和分类器增强准则消除模态间分布差异，避免负迁移，且无需修改网络架构即可提升纯点云表示。实验在多个数据集和骨干网络上验证了显著增益。
2210.04208|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the bottleneck of single-modality representation learning in point cloud analysis by proposing PointCMT, a cross-modal training strategy that leverages view images via a teacher-student framework and knowledge distillation. PointCMT eliminates modality discrepancy through feature and classifier enhancement criteria, avoiding negative transfer without architecture modification. Experiments demonstrate significant gains on various datasets and backbones.
2210.04208|v2.assessment: 该论文将图像信息通过跨模态蒸馏引入点云分析，方法简洁有效，但与自动驾驶感知中的3D检测、BEV等核心任务关联度有限，更偏向通用3D形状分析。
2210.04208|v2.contribution: 提出PointCMT跨模态训练策略，利用视图图像提升点云表示学习。
2210.04208|v2.innovation: 通过特征和分类器增强准则消除模态差异，避免负迁移且无需修改架构。
2210.04208|v2.result: 在多个数据集和骨干网络上取得显著性能提升。

2208.12262|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言对比预训练（如CLIP）主要关注全局文本相关表征、缺乏局部patch级语义监督的问题，提出MaskCLIP框架，将掩码自蒸馏（masked self-distillation）引入对比语言-图像预训练中。其核心思想是让掩码图像的预测表征去蒸馏完整图像的表征，从而在视觉编码器上实现局部patch表征学习，并借助语言监督获得间接的局部语义指导；同时对称地在文本分支引入局部语义监督。相比已有CLIP类方法，MaskCLIP在linear probing、微调等多种下游任务上取得更优结果，验证了掩码自蒸馏与视觉-语言对比学习的互补性。
2208.12262|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MaskCLIP, a framework that integrates masked self-distillation into contrastive language-image pretraining, where representations from a full image are distilled into those predicted from a masked image to enable local patch representation learning. The masked self-distillation is complementary to vision-language contrastive learning and receives indirect supervision from language, with symmetric local semantic supervision also introduced into the text branch. Extensive experiments show that MaskCLIP achieves superior results on various downstream tasks including linear probing and fine-tuning.
2208.12262|v2.assessment: 该工作将掩码自蒸馏与CLIP式对比学习有机结合，为视觉-语言预训练中的局部语义学习提供了简洁有效的方案，对多模态与自监督视觉研究者有参考价值。
2208.12262|v2.contribution: 提出将掩码自蒸馏融入对比语言-图像预训练的MaskCLIP框架，实现局部patch表征与语言监督的互补学习。
2208.12262|v2.innovation: 利用完整图像到掩码图像的表征蒸馏，使局部语义从语言对比中获得间接监督，并对称地增强文本分支的局部语义。
2208.12262|v2.result: 在linear probing、微调等多种下游任务上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2302.14250|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对弱增量语义分割（WILSS）中仅使用图像级标签导致无法定位每个分割区域、性能受限的问题，提出数据高效的FMWISS框架。方法首先通过基于预训练的协同分割，从互补的基础模型中蒸馏知识以生成稠密伪标签；随后用教师-学生架构优化含噪伪掩码，其中插件式教师通过提出的稠密对比损失进行优化；并引入基于记忆的复制粘贴增强以缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有WILSS方法，FMWISS在仅用图像级标签的条件下有效提升了新类分割并减轻了对旧类的遗忘。
2302.14250|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation (WILSS), where only image-level labels are available for new classes, by proposing FMWISS, a data-efficient framework. It distills knowledge from complementary foundation models via pre-training-based co-segmentation to generate dense pseudo labels, optimizes noisy pseudo masks with a teacher-student architecture using a dense contrastive loss, and introduces memory-based copy-paste augmentation to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. FMWISS improves new-class segmentation under image-level supervision while reducing forgetting of old classes.
2302.14250|v2.assessment: 该工作将基础模型知识蒸馏与增量学习结合，为弱监督增量分割提供了新思路，对持续学习与分割研究者有借鉴意义。
2302.14250|v2.contribution: 提出FMWISS框架，利用基础模型协同分割生成伪标签并结合教师-学生优化，实现图像级标签下的弱增量语义分割。
2302.14250|v2.innovation: 通过预训练协同分割蒸馏互补基础模型知识生成稠密伪标签，并用稠密对比损失优化插件式教师。
2302.14250|v2.result: 在仅使用图像级标签的WILSS设定下提升了新类分割性能并缓解了灾难性遗忘。

2311.13930|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无源域目标检测（SFOD）中主流均值教师（MT）自训练范式仅依赖单一教师、在域偏移下教师崩溃会导致学生性能急剧下降的训练不稳定问题，提出周期性交换教师-学生（PETS）方法。PETS引入由静态教师、动态教师和学生模型组成的多教师框架，训练中周期性交换静态教师与学生模型的权重，并用已交换学生的移动平均更新动态教师，使动态教师能整合历史知识、减少误差累积。相比单教师MT范式，PETS在MT框架内实现了更稳定的训练并提升了SFOD性能。
2311.13930|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the training instability of source-free object detection (SFOD) under the mean-teacher paradigm, where a single teacher can collapse under domain shift and degrade the student. It proposes Periodically Exchange Teacher-Student (PETS), a multiple-teacher framework with a static teacher, a dynamic teacher, and a student, where weights between the static teacher and student are periodically exchanged and the dynamic teacher is updated by the moving average of the exchanged student. PETS reduces error accumulation and enables more stable training within the MT framework.
2311.13930|v2.assessment: 该工作以简洁的权重交换机制缓解了SFOD中教师崩溃问题，对域自适应检测与自训练研究者有实用参考价值。
2311.13930|v2.contribution: 提出PETS多教师框架，通过周期性交换静态教师与学生权重并移动平均更新动态教师，稳定无源域目标检测训练。
2311.13930|v2.innovation: 引入静态教师、动态教师与学生的三模型结构及周期性权重交换，使动态教师整合历史知识以抑制误差累积。
2311.13930|v2.result: 在SFOD设定下实现更稳定的训练并提升检测性能。

Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中伪标签噪声与域偏移导致的性能下降问题，提出掩码重训练教师-学生框架（Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework）。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过掩码重训练策略在教师-学生自训练中筛选或修正伪标签，以提升跨域检测的鲁棒性。相比已有DAOD方法，该框架旨在更有效地利用目标域无标注数据并抑制噪声传播。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.summary_en: This paper targets domain adaptive object detection (DAOD) and proposes a Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework to mitigate pseudo-label noise and domain shift. Although the abstract is missing, the title suggests a masked retraining strategy within teacher-student self-training to refine pseudo labels and improve cross-domain detection robustness. It aims to better exploit unlabeled target data while suppressing noise propagation compared with existing DAOD methods.
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.assessment: 该工作聚焦DAOD中的伪标签噪声问题，思路与教师-学生自训练相关，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与实验。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.contribution: 提出掩码重训练教师-学生框架用于域自适应目标检测。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.innovation: 通过掩码重训练策略在教师-学生自训练中处理伪标签噪声。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew._arxiv_id: Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework for Domain Adaptive Object Detection.

2308.00398|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对端到端自动驾驶中教师-学生范式下学生模型仍需从零学习规划头、受原始传感器输入冗余噪声与行为克隆因果混淆困扰的问题，提出DriveAdapter，探索直接采用强教师模型进行规划、让学生模型更专注于感知部分的可能性。方法通过打破感知与规划的耦合壁垒，将教师的规划能力以适配方式迁移给学生，从而减轻学生规划头的学习负担。相比现有教师-学生方法，DriveAdapter在保持甚至提升规划性能的同时，使学生能更有效地利用原始传感器输入。
2308.00398|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge in end-to-end autonomous driving where, under the teacher-student paradigm, the student still must learn a planning head from scratch despite redundant and noisy raw sensor inputs and causal confusion in behavior cloning. It proposes DriveAdapter, which explores directly adopting a strong teacher model for planning while letting the student focus more on perception, thereby breaking the coupling barrier between perception and planning. Compared with existing teacher-student methods, DriveAdapter improves planning performance while enabling more effective use of raw sensor data.
2308.00398|v2.assessment: 该工作直面端到端自动驾驶中感知-规划耦合的核心难题，提出解耦式教师-学生适配思路，对自动驾驶感知与规划研究者有较高参考价值。
2308.00398|v2.contribution: 提出DriveAdapter，通过解耦感知与规划，让学生模型专注感知而直接复用强教师的规划能力。
2308.00398|v2.innovation: 打破教师-学生范式中感知与规划的耦合壁垒，避免学生从零学习规划头。
2308.00398|v2.result: 在端到端自动驾驶规划任务上取得优于现有教师-学生方法的性能。

TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线签名验证（Online Signature Verification）任务，提出TSOSVNet，一种教师-学生协同知识蒸馏方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过教师与学生网络之间的协同蒸馏提升签名验证的准确性与鲁棒性。相比已有在线签名验证方法，该工作尝试利用知识蒸馏在特征或决策层面进行知识迁移。该任务与自动驾驶感知/视觉检测领域关联较弱。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.summary_en: This paper targets online signature verification and proposes TSOSVNet, a teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation method. Although the abstract is missing, the title suggests that knowledge is transferred between teacher and student networks to improve verification accuracy and robustness. The task is only weakly related to autonomous driving perception and detection.
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.assessment: 该工作属于生物特征识别中的签名验证，与自动驾驶感知/视觉检测领域关联度低，且摘要缺失难以评估其方法质量。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.contribution: 提出TSOSVNet教师-学生协同知识蒸馏方法用于在线签名验证。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.innovation: 将教师-学生协同知识蒸馏应用于在线签名验证任务。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative._arxiv_id: TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation for Online Signature Verification.

2506.07087|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督伪装目标检测（UCOD）中伪标签噪声大、简单1x1卷积解码器难以捕捉伪装目标（尤其小目标）语义特征的问题，提出UCOD-DPL方法。该方法采用教师-学生框架，包含自适应伪标签模块（APM）、双分支对抗（DBA）解码器和Look-Twice机制：APM自适应融合固定策略与教师模型生成的伪标签以避免过拟合噪声并保留自校正能力，DBA解码器增强语义特征学习。相比现有固定策略生成伪标签+简单解码器的UCOD方法，在无像素级标注下提升了检测性能，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
2506.07087|v2.summary_en: Existing unsupervised camouflaged object detection (UCOD) methods generate pseudo-labels with fixed strategies and train simple 1x1 convolutional decoders, suffering from noisy pseudo-labels and poor semantic feature learning, especially for small objects. This paper proposes UCOD-DPL, a teacher-student framework with an Adaptive Pseudo-label Module (APM) that fuses fixed-strategy and teacher-generated pseudo-labels, a Dual-Branch Adversarial (DBA) decoder, and a Look-Twice mechanism. The approach mitigates overfitting to noisy pseudo-labels while preserving self-correction, improving detection performance over prior UCOD methods.
2506.07087|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦无监督伪装目标检测，与自动驾驶中的开放世界/小目标检测有一定关联，但领域匹配度有限，方法设计有一定新意。
2506.07087|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态伪标签学习的教师-学生UCOD框架，包含自适应伪标签模块、双分支对抗解码器和Look-Twice机制。
2506.07087|v2.innovation: 通过自适应融合固定策略与教师模型伪标签，并结合对抗解码器，缓解伪标签噪声和简单解码器语义捕捉不足的问题。
2506.07087|v2.result: 在无监督设定下提升了伪装目标检测性能，尤其改善了小目标检测，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。

2507.21455|v2.summary_cn: 针对数据集蒸馏多集中于监督场景、忽略自监督表示的问题，提出自监督数据集蒸馏（Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation），将图像及其自监督训练表示蒸馏为紧凑样本集。方法引入基于低维基的参数化、预定义增强和近似技术，以更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据集关键特性。相比现有监督数据集蒸馏方法，蒸馏集具有更强的跨架构泛化能力，在减少数据集规模的同时保持模型性能。
2507.21455|v2.summary_en: Most dataset distillation works focus on supervised datasets, overlooking self-supervised representations. This paper proposes Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation, which distills images and their self-supervisedly trained representations into a compact set. It introduces parameterization via low-dimensional bases, predefined augmentation, and approximation to faithfully preserve key dataset characteristics. The distilled sets exhibit enhanced cross-architecture generalizability while reducing dataset size.
2507.21455|v2.assessment: 该工作将数据集蒸馏扩展到自监督学习场景，对降低大规模训练成本有实际意义，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2507.21455|v2.contribution: 提出自监督数据集蒸馏框架，将图像和自监督表示蒸馏为紧凑样本集。
2507.21455|v2.innovation: 通过低维基参数化、预定义增强和近似技术，提升蒸馏集对原始数据特性的保留能力和跨架构泛化性。
2507.21455|v2.result: 在减少数据集规模的同时保持模型性能，蒸馏集展现出更强的跨架构泛化能力。

2410.11325|v2.summary_cn: 针对知识蒸馏中教师-学生知识差距导致监督KD分布不匹配、on-policy KD训练样本质量低的问题，提出推测性知识蒸馏（SKD）。SKD让学生模型提议token，教师模型根据自身分布替换排名较低的token，从而在飞行中生成高质量训练数据并适配学生推理时的分布。在翻译、摘要、数学和指令跟随等文本生成任务上评估，SKD有效桥接了教师-学生差距，提升了学生模型性能。
2410.11325|v2.summary_en: Supervised KD suffers from distribution mismatch between static training data and student inference outputs, while on-policy KD can produce low-quality examples unfamiliar to the teacher. This paper introduces Speculative Knowledge Distillation (SKD), where the student proposes tokens and the teacher replaces poorly ranked ones based on its own distribution, generating high-quality training data on-the-fly aligned with the student's inference distribution. Evaluated on translation, summarization, math, and instruction following, SKD bridges the teacher-student gap and improves student performance.
2410.11325|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种新颖的师生协作蒸馏范式，对知识蒸馏领域有参考价值，但主要面向NLP文本生成，与视觉/自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2410.11325|v2.contribution: 提出推测性知识蒸馏（SKD），通过学生提议token、教师替换低排名token的协作方式生成高质量训练数据。
2410.11325|v2.innovation: 利用师生协作在飞行中生成对齐学生推理分布的高质量训练样本，自适应传递知识。
2410.11325|v2.result: 在翻译、摘要、数学和指令跟随等文本生成任务上有效桥接教师-学生差距，提升学生模型性能。

2403.09296|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）在连续下游任务微调时出现的灾难性遗忘与零样本能力退化问题，本文提出选择性双教师知识迁移框架。该方法仅利用无标注参考数据集，以最近微调模型和原始预训练VLM作为双教师，通过度量特征差异进行选择性知识蒸馏，从而同时保留已学知识与零样本泛化能力。相比现有持续学习方法，该框架在防止遗忘与零样本性能下降方面均优于SOTA。在基准数据集上的大量实验验证了其有效性。
2403.09296|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation when adapting pre-trained vision-language models to sequential downstream tasks. It proposes a Selective Dual-Teacher Knowledge Transfer framework that uses the most recent fine-tuned model and the original pre-trained VLM as dual teachers, performing selective distillation via feature discrepancy on unlabeled reference data. Experiments on benchmark datasets show it outperforms state-of-the-art continual learning methods in preventing forgetting and preserving zero-shot capability.

2403.09296|v2.innovation: 利用最近微调模型与原始预训练VLM构成双教师，并基于特征差异进行选择性蒸馏。
