2407.14007|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态3D点云预训练方法忽视样本间复杂结构关系、限制多模态学习潜力的问题，本文提出多模态关系蒸馏（MRD）三模态预训练框架。该方法将大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）蒸馏到3D骨干网络，同时捕获模态内关系与跨模态关系，生成更具判别力的3D形状表示。在零样本分类与跨模态检索任务上取得显著提升，达到新的SOTA。
2407.14007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of intricate structural relations among samples in multi-modal 3D point cloud pre-training. It proposes Multi-modal Relation Distillation (MRD), a tri-modal framework that distills large vision-language models into 3D backbones while capturing both intra-modal and cross-modal relations. It achieves new state-of-the-art performance on zero-shot classification and cross-modality retrieval tasks.
2407.14007|v2.assessment: 将关系蒸馏引入三模态3D预训练，强调样本间结构关系，对3D表示学习与多模态研究者有较高参考价值。
2407.14007|v2.contribution: 提出三模态关系蒸馏框架MRD，将VLM知识蒸馏到3D骨干以学习判别性形状表示。
2407.14007|v2.innovation: 同时建模模态内与跨模态样本关系进行蒸馏，突破以往仅对齐异构特征的局限。
2407.14007|v2.result: 在零样本分类与跨模态检索任务上取得显著提升，达到新的SOTA。

2407.13362|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中3D-文本配对数据稀缺、现有蒸馏方法忽视3D几何先验的问题，本文提出几何引导自蒸馏（GGSD）方法。该方法先设计几何引导蒸馏模块从2D预训练模型蒸馏知识，再利用3D几何先验缓解2D模型固有噪声并增强表示学习；由于3D表示优势，蒸馏后的3D学生模型性能可超越2D教师，进而通过自蒸馏进一步利用3D表示优势。实验表明GGSD在开放词汇3D场景理解上取得优异性能。
2407.13362|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of 3D-text paired data in open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding, where existing distillation methods ignore 3D geometric priors. It proposes Geometry Guided Self-Distillation (GGSD), which first distills knowledge from 2D models with a geometry-guided module, then leverages 3D geometric priors to suppress 2D noise and enhance representation learning. The distilled 3D student can surpass the 2D teacher, motivating further self-distillation, yielding strong open-vocabulary 3D understanding performance.
2407.13362|v2.assessment: 将几何先验与自蒸馏结合用于开放词汇3D理解，思路新颖，对3D场景理解与BEV方向研究者有较高参考价值。
2407.13362|v2.contribution: 提出几何引导自蒸馏框架GGSD，从2D模型学习优越的3D表示用于开放词汇3D场景理解。
2407.13362|v2.innovation: 利用3D几何先验抑制2D教师噪声，并通过自蒸馏使3D学生超越2D教师。
2407.13362|v2.result: 在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得优异性能，蒸馏后3D学生显著超越2D教师。

2404.12386|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界实体分割（如SAM）依赖昂贵专家标注的问题，本文提出自监督开放世界层次实体分割方法SOHES，无需人工标注。该方法分三阶段：自探索（基于自监督表示通过视觉特征聚类生成大量高质量伪标签）、自指导（用伪标签训练分割模型）、自纠正（通过师生互学习修正伪标签噪声），并能同时分割实体及其组成部分，实现层次化理解。仅用原始图像训练即达到自监督开放世界分割的领先性能。
2404.12386|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on costly expert annotations in open-world entity segmentation (e.g., SAM) by proposing Self-supervised Open-world Hierarchical Entity Segmentation (SOHES), which requires no human annotations. SOHES operates in three phases—self-exploration, self-instruction, and self-correction—generating pseudo-labels via visual feature clustering, training a segmentation model, and rectifying label noise through teacher-student mutual learning, while also capturing hierarchical entity parts. Using only raw images, it achieves unprecedented self-supervised open-world segmentation performance.
2404.12386|v2.assessment: 以自监督方式实现开放世界层次实体分割，摆脱人工标注依赖，对自监督与开放集分割研究者有较高价值。
2404.12386|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的三阶段自监督开放世界层次实体分割框架SOHES。
2404.12386|v2.innovation: 通过自探索-自指导-自纠正流程结合师生互学习，实现层次化实体与部件分割。
2404.12386|v2.result: 仅用原始图像训练即达到自监督开放世界分割的领先性能。

2306.15876|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督表征学习中对比学习（CL）擅长全局判别性但局部注意力不足、掩码图像建模（MIM）局部多样性好但判别性弱的问题，试图融合二者优势。②提出 Hybrid Distillation 策略，同时使用监督/CL 教师和 MIM 教师联合指导学生模型：模仿 MIM 教师的 token 关系以缓解注意力坍缩，并蒸馏监督/CL 教师的特征图以增强判别性。③相比此前非对称设计的特征蒸馏与掩码特征重建方法，该方法避免了因非对称设计导致的判别能力受损。④摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在判别性与多样性之间取得了更好的平衡。
2306.15876|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between Contrastive Learning (CL), which excels at global discrimination, and Masked Image Modeling (MIM), which provides local diversity, in self-supervised representation learning. It proposes Hybrid Distillation, which jointly leverages a supervised/CL teacher and an MIM teacher to guide the student by imitating the MIM teacher's token relations to alleviate attention collapse and distilling the supervised/CL teacher's feature maps to preserve discrimination. Unlike prior asymmetric feature distillation and masked feature reconstruction methods that compromise discrimination, this approach better balances discrimination and diversity, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2306.15876|v2.assessment: 该工作对自监督预训练中判别性与多样性的权衡提出了简洁有效的蒸馏融合思路，对表征学习研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2306.15876|v2.contribution: 提出 Hybrid Distillation 策略，用监督/CL 教师与 MIM 教师联合指导学生模型以同时获得判别性与多样性。
2306.15876|v2.innovation: 通过模仿 MIM 教师的 token 关系缓解注意力坍缩，并蒸馏监督/CL 教师特征图增强判别性，避免非对称设计的缺陷。
2306.15876|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称在判别性与多样性之间取得更好平衡。

2011.11858|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法大多依赖目标类别的先验知识，难以泛化到未见类别，而通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）研究严重缺乏公开基准。本文构建了首个公开GMOT数据集GMOT-40，包含10个类别共40个精细标注序列，并采用两种跟踪协议评估算法不同特性。作者还设计了一系列GMOT基线算法，并对主流MOT方法（经必要修改）与所提基线进行了全面评测。该工作填补了GMOT领域基准缺失的空白，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。
2011.11858|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods largely rely on prior knowledge of target categories and generalize poorly to unseen categories, while Generic Multiple Object Tracking (GMOT) remains under-explored. This paper constructs GMOT-40, the first public GMOT benchmark with 40 carefully annotated sequences across 10 categories and two tracking protocols. It further designs baseline GMOT algorithms and conducts a thorough evaluation of popular MOT methods with necessary modifications, providing a standardized platform for future GMOT research.
2011.11858|v2.assessment: 作为首个GMOT公开基准，该工作对推动通用目标跟踪研究具有基础性意义，数据集与评测协议设计较为规范。
2011.11858|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的通用多目标跟踪基准GMOT-40，并提供了系统的基线算法与评测结果。
2011.11858|v2.innovation: 首次针对GMOT任务构建多类别、双协议的公开数据集，并设计专用基线算法填补方法空白。
2011.11858|v2.result: 发布了包含10类40个序列的GMOT-40基准，并对主流MOT方法与所提基线进行了全面评测。

2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中，现有方法多独立建模每个目标，缺乏联合利用场景中所有目标更新记忆的能力，在相似外观目标共存时易出错。本文提出一种新颖的多轨迹池化模块，以极小空间开销在记忆更新时同时考虑所有轨迹，并设计了适配该模块的在线难例跟踪片段生成训练策略。二者结合形成了强判别性外观模型，使贪婪数据关联即可实现在线跟踪。实验在公开MOT数据集上取得了实时、最先进的性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT approaches typically model each target in isolation, lacking the ability to jointly leverage all targets in the scene for memory updating, which is problematic with similar-looking objects. This paper proposes a novel multi-track pooling module that simultaneously considers all tracks during memory updating with only small spatial overhead, along with an online hard tracking episode generation training strategy. The combination yields a strong discriminative appearance model enabling greedy data association for online tracking, achieving real-time state-of-the-art performance on public MOT datasets.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 多轨迹池化与在线难例训练策略设计巧妙，在保持实时性的同时显著提升判别能力，对MOT数据关联研究有较强参考价值。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块与在线难例跟踪片段训练策略，构建强判别性外观模型实现实时在线MOT。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 通过多轨迹池化在记忆更新时联合考虑所有目标，并以在线难例片段训练增强外观判别力。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公开MOT数据集上取得实时、最先进的跟踪性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: RGB-D视频序列中的多目标跟踪面临视角变化、运动与遮挡的挑战。本文观察到完整物体几何有助于跟踪，提出联合推断物体完整几何与跟踪刚体运动目标的方法：从RGB-D帧中检测物体，学习预测其完整几何及到规范空间的稠密对应映射，从而推导每帧6DoF位姿与帧间对应关系。通过幻觉物体未见区域获得额外对应，即使外观剧烈变化也能鲁棒跟踪。在合成与真实RGB-D数据上均达到动态目标跟踪的最先进性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking from RGB-D sequences is challenging due to changing viewpoints, motion, and occlusions. This paper proposes to jointly infer complete object geometry and track rigidly moving objects, learning to predict full geometry and dense correspondence into a canonical space from RGB-D frames, enabling 6DoF pose derivation and robust frame-to-frame tracking. By hallucinating unseen object regions, it obtains additional correspondences for robust tracking under strong appearance changes, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world RGB-D data.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 将物体几何补全与跟踪联合建模的思路新颖，对遮挡和外观变化鲁棒，对3D场景理解与跟踪研究有较高参考价值。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合推断物体完整几何与6DoF位姿的RGB-D多目标跟踪框架。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 通过幻觉物体未见区域获取额外对应关系，实现外观剧变下的鲁棒跟踪。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成与真实RGB-D数据上均取得动态目标跟踪的最先进性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: MOT中数据关联问题难以端到端求解。本文提出一种基于候选框的可学习框架，将MOT建模为亲和图上的候选生成、候选评分与轨迹推断范式，类似两阶段检测器Faster RCNN。候选生成采用迭代图聚类降低计算成本并保持质量；候选评分部署可训练图卷积网络学习结构模式并排序；轨迹推断采用简单去重叠策略满足无检测被分配给多条轨迹的约束。实验表明该方法在MOTA和IDF1上均有明显提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: Data association in MOT is difficult to solve end-to-end. This paper proposes a proposal-based learnable framework modeling MOT as proposal generation, proposal scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, analogous to the two-stage Faster RCNN. It uses iterative graph clustering for efficient proposal generation, a trainable GCN for scoring structural patterns, and a de-overlapping strategy for trajectory inference. Experiments show clear improvements in both MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 将MOT类比两阶段检测器并引入GCN评分候选，框架设计系统且数据驱动，对端到端MOT研究有较好启发。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于候选框的MOT可学习框架，统一候选生成、GCN评分与轨迹推断。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 借鉴Faster RCNN范式，用迭代图聚类生成候选并用GCN学习候选结构模式进行评分。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1指标上均取得明显性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 现有在线MOT方法通常将位置预测与身份嵌入学习作为两个独立任务处理，难以相互增益。本文提出统一模型，通过时序感知目标注意力与干扰物注意力以及身份感知记忆聚合模型，将位置预测与嵌入关联协同起来：注意力使预测更聚焦目标、更少受干扰，从而提取更可靠嵌入；可靠嵌入又通过记忆聚合增强身份感知，强化注意力并抑制漂移。该协同机制带来对遮挡的强鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: Existing online MOT methods typically treat position prediction and identity embedding learning as two separate tasks with little mutual benefit. This paper proposes a unified model that synergizes the two via temporal-aware target and distractor attention plus an identity-aware memory aggregation model. The attention makes prediction focus more on targets and less on distractors, yielding more reliable embeddings for association, which in turn enhance identity-awareness through memory aggregation, strengthening attention and suppressing drifts, leading to strong robustness to occlusions.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 将位置预测与嵌入关联通过注意力与记忆聚合协同建模，思路统一且针对遮挡问题有效，对在线MOT研究有参考价值。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出位置预测与嵌入关联协同的统一在线MOT模型。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 通过时序感知目标/干扰物注意力与身份感知记忆聚合实现两任务的相互增强。
2104.00380|v2.result: 协同机制显著提升了对遮挡的鲁棒性，改善了在线跟踪性能。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中数据关联问题，指出现有方法忽视轨迹片段与帧内检测间的上下文、端到端关联未利用优化分配优势、以及图优化方法训练与推理不一致三个问题。提出可学习图匹配方法，将轨迹片段与检测的关系建模为无向图，把关联转化为轨迹图与检测图之间的图匹配，并实现端到端优化。相比已有工作，该方法融合了深度特征学习与图划分优化，缓解了训练推理不一致。在MOT基准上取得了优于传统图优化和纯端到端关联方法的效果。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multiple object tracking, identifying three issues: neglect of context among tracklets and detections, underuse of optimization-based assignment in end-to-end methods, and train-inference inconsistency in graph-based optimization. It proposes a learnable graph matching method that models tracklet-detection relationships as an undirected graph and casts association as graph matching between tracklet and detection graphs, enabling end-to-end optimization. The method integrates deep feature learning with graph partitioning, achieving improved performance over traditional graph optimization and purely end-to-end association baselines on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 将图匹配与深度特征学习统一到端到端框架，对多目标跟踪的数据关联有实质推进，值得关注。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出可学习图匹配框架，将轨迹与检测关联建模为端到端可优化的图匹配问题。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 融合图划分优化与深度特征学习，解决训练与推理不一致问题。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上优于传统图优化和纯端到端关联方法。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中密集相似度学习问题，提出准密集相似度学习方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，该方法通过准密集采样学习目标间的相似度，以提升数据关联的鲁棒性。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This paper addresses dense similarity learning for multiple object tracking by proposing a quasi-dense similarity learning approach. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable. The method likely learns similarities between objects via quasi-dense sampling to improve data association robustness.
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 准密集相似度学习思路对MOT关联有参考价值，但摘要缺失难以全面评估。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出准密集相似度学习方法用于多目标跟踪。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 以准密集采样方式学习目标间相似度。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法具体说明。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult._arxiv_id: Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Multiple Object Tracking.

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中长期遮挡导致轨迹断裂的问题，指出现有联合检测跟踪方法忽视长期运动信息。提出概率自回归运动模型，通过学习自然轨迹片段的潜在分布来直接度量轨迹提议的似然，从而既能将新检测分配给已有轨迹，也能在目标长时间丢失时通过采样轨迹进行修复填补检测空缺。在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20等多个基准上大多数标准指标超越当时最优方法。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long occlusions in multiple object tracking, where existing joint detection and tracking methods ignore long-term motion information. It introduces a probabilistic autoregressive motion model that scores tracklet proposals by directly measuring their likelihood, learned from the underlying distribution of natural tracklets. This enables both assigning new detections to existing tracklets and inpainting tracklets lost for long durations by sampling to fill detection gaps. It outperforms the state of the art on most standard MOT metrics across MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 用概率自回归模型建模轨迹分布并实现轨迹修复，对长遮挡场景有实际价值。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率自回归运动模型，通过轨迹似然评分与采样修复处理长期遮挡。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 将轨迹修复（inpainting）引入MOT，通过采样填补检测空缺。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在MOT16/17/20上大多数标准指标超越当时最优方法。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线多目标跟踪，提出基于区域的孪生多目标跟踪网络SiamMOT。SiamMOT包含运动模型，估计实例在两帧间的位移以关联检测结果，并给出隐式与显式两种运动建模变体以探究运动建模对跟踪能力的影响。在MOT17、TAO-person、Caltech Roadside Pedestrians三个数据集上验证了运动建模的重要性，性能大幅超越当时最优方法，并在HiEve数据集上超越ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge冠军。在单张现代GPU上720P视频可达17 FPS。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper focuses on online multi-object tracking and introduces SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese MOT network with a motion model that estimates instance movement between frames for association. Two variants, implicit and explicit motion modeling, are presented to study the impact of motion modeling. Extensive experiments on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech Roadside Pedestrians show the importance of motion modeling and substantial gains over the state of the art, also outperforming the ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge winners on HiEve. SiamMOT runs at 17 FPS for 720P videos on a single modern GPU.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: 系统探究运动建模对MOT的影响，性能与效率兼顾，工程价值高。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出带运动模型的区域孪生多目标跟踪网络SiamMOT。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 对比隐式与显式运动建模，明确运动建模对MOT的重要性。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在MOT17等数据集大幅超越SOTA，HiEve上超越挑战赛冠军，720P下17 FPS。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉目标跟踪中连续帧间丰富时序上下文被忽视的问题，提出用Transformer架构桥接各视频帧并挖掘时序上下文。不同于NLP中的经典用法，将编码器与解码器分离为两个并行分支并嵌入类孪生跟踪流程：编码器通过注意力增强目标模板以生成高质量跟踪模型，解码器将历史模板的跟踪线索传播到当前帧以辅助目标搜索。框架简洁且端到端训练，简单孪生匹配即可超越当时最优跟踪器，与判别式跟踪流程结合后在主流基准上创下多项新SOTA。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked rich temporal context across successive frames in visual object tracking by exploiting a transformer architecture. Unlike classic NLP usage, the encoder and decoder are separated into two parallel branches within Siamese-like tracking pipelines: the encoder reinforces target templates via attention for high-quality tracking models, while the decoder propagates tracking cues from previous templates to the current frame for object search. The framework is neat and trained end-to-end; a simple Siamese matching approach outperforms top trackers, and combined with discriminative tracking it sets several new state-of-the-art records on prevalent benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 将Transformer时序建模引入跟踪，设计简洁且效果显著，对跟踪领域有启发。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的时序上下文建模框架用于鲁棒视觉跟踪。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 将Transformer编解码器分离为并行分支嵌入孪生跟踪流程。
2103.11681|v2.result: 简单孪生匹配即超越当时最优，结合判别式流程创多项SOTA。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离线训练孪生跟踪器因固定首帧模板信息挖掘殆尽而难以应对目标外观变化的问题，以及现有模板更新机制依赖耗时数值优化和复杂手工策略的缺陷，提出基于时空记忆网络的无模板跟踪框架STMTrack。引入新颖记忆机制存储目标历史信息，引导跟踪器聚焦当前帧最具信息量的区域；记忆网络的像素级相似度计算使跟踪器能生成更精确的边界框。在OTB等大规模挑战性基准上与众多竞争跟踪器对比，取得优异效果。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of offline-trained Siamese trackers to target appearance changes due to exhausted fixed first-frame template information, and the reliance of existing template-update mechanisms on time-consuming numerical optimization and complex hand-designed strategies. It proposes STMTrack, a template-free tracking framework built on a space-time memory network that stores historical target information to guide the tracker toward the most informative regions in the current frame. Pixel-level similarity computation in the memory network yields more accurate bounding boxes. Extensive experiments on challenging large-scale benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 无模板时空记忆机制有效利用历史信息，避免复杂模板更新，实用性强。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空记忆网络的无模板视觉跟踪框架STMTrack。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 用记忆机制存储目标历史信息并做像素级相似度计算生成精确边界框。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在OTB等大规模基准上取得优于众多竞争跟踪器的效果。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: 该论文针对多人物关节式3D姿态跟踪问题，提出TesseTrack端到端可学习方法。方法通过时空体素特征聚合与可微关节姿态回归，将检测、关联与姿态估计统一到单一网络中联合优化。相比传统分阶段流水线方法，避免了误差累积并提升了时序一致性。在多个多人姿态跟踪基准上取得优于分阶段方法的精度，具体数据摘要未给出。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking and proposes TesseTrack, an end-to-end learnable approach. It unifies detection, association, and pose estimation via spatio-temporal volumetric feature aggregation and differentiable articulated pose regression. Compared with staged pipelines, it avoids error accumulation and improves temporal consistency, achieving superior accuracy on multi-person pose tracking benchmarks.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 将多人关节姿态跟踪统一为端到端可学习框架，思路清晰，但与人车自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出端到端可学习的多人关节式3D姿态跟踪框架TesseTrack。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 用时空体素特征聚合与可微姿态回归替代分阶段流水线。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在多人姿态跟踪基准上优于分阶段方法，提升时序一致性。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云中刚性与关节式物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题，提出CAPTRA方法。方法利用类别级规范空间表示与点云配准，在时序上跟踪物体6D姿态及关节状态，无需实例级CAD模型。相比实例级跟踪方法，具备跨实例泛化能力。在类别级刚性与关节物体跟踪基准上取得领先精度，具体数值摘要未给出。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds and proposes CAPTRA. It leverages category-level canonical representations and point cloud registration to track 6D poses and articulation states over time without instance-specific CAD models. It generalizes across instances and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on category-level rigid and articulated object tracking benchmarks.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 类别级点云姿态跟踪对机器人操作与自动驾驶场景理解有参考价值，方法设计合理。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出无需实例CAD模型的类别级刚性与关节物体点云姿态跟踪方法CAPTRA。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 结合类别级规范空间表示与点云配准实现跨实例姿态跟踪。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在类别级刚性与关节物体跟踪基准上取得领先精度。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云单目标跟踪中特征判别性不足的问题，提出Box-Aware Feature Enhancement方法。方法利用目标3D边界框先验引导特征提取与聚合，增强前景目标与背景的区分度，并设计框感知的跟踪头进行目标定位。相比仅依赖点云外观特征的跟踪方法，显著提升了对相似干扰物的鲁棒性。在KITTI与nuScenes等点云跟踪基准上取得领先性能，具体数值摘要未给出。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature discriminability in point cloud single object tracking and proposes a Box-Aware Feature Enhancement method. It exploits 3D bounding box priors to guide feature extraction and aggregation, enhancing foreground-background separation, and employs a box-aware tracking head for localization. It improves robustness to distractors over appearance-only trackers and achieves leading performance on point cloud tracking benchmarks such as KITTI and nuScenes.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 利用3D框先验增强点云跟踪特征，思路实用，对自动驾驶点云跟踪有直接参考价值。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出框感知特征增强的点云单目标跟踪方法。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 用3D边界框先验引导特征提取与聚合以增强判别性。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 在KITTI与nuScenes等点云跟踪基准上取得领先性能。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪标注成本高的问题，提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法。方法对同一视频施加不同数据增强或采样，强制模型在不同输入视图下产生一致的跟踪关联，从而无需人工标注即可学习跟踪表示。相比依赖伪标签或合成数据的自监督方法，避免了噪声标签影响。在MOT基准上接近全监督方法性能，具体数值摘要未给出。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of multi-object tracking and proposes a self-supervised MOT method based on cross-input consistency. By enforcing consistent tracking associations across differently augmented or sampled views of the same video, it learns tracking representations without manual labels. It avoids noisy pseudo-labels of prior self-supervised approaches and approaches fully supervised performance on MOT benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 自监督多目标跟踪思路新颖，跨输入一致性约束设计巧妙，对降低标注依赖有重要意义。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 用不同增强视图间的一致性约束替代伪标签进行自监督学习。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT基准上接近全监督方法性能。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 针对RGBD视频中3D目标跟踪缺乏统一基准的问题，论文构建了一个通用的3D跟踪基准数据集，并提出一个基线方法。方法利用RGBD数据中的深度信息进行3D空间中的目标关联与跟踪。相比已有仅基于RGB或点云的跟踪工作，该基准覆盖更通用的场景并提供了标准化评测协议。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但基准的建立有望推动RGBD 3D跟踪研究。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for generic 3D tracking in RGBD videos by constructing a benchmark dataset and proposing a baseline method. The method leverages depth information from RGBD data for 3D object association and tracking. Compared to existing RGB-only or point-cloud-only tracking works, the benchmark covers more generic scenarios and provides standardized evaluation protocols. The abstract does not report specific experimental numbers, but the benchmark is expected to advance RGBD 3D tracking research.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该工作填补了RGBD视频3D跟踪基准的空白，对推动通用3D跟踪研究有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其数据规模和基线性能。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 构建了RGBD视频通用3D跟踪基准并提出基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 首次针对RGBD视频提供通用3D跟踪基准与标准化评测。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，基准有望促进RGBD 3D跟踪研究。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框被丢弃导致漏检和轨迹碎片化的问题，论文提出ByteTrack，一种简单有效的关联方法，关联几乎所有检测框而非仅高分框。通过利用低分框与轨迹的相似性恢复真实目标并过滤背景，方法可即插即用地提升9种SOTA跟踪器1-10个IDF1点。在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，单V100 GPU上30 FPS，并在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: To address the issue of discarding low-score detection boxes in multi-object tracking, which causes missed objects and fragmented trajectories, this paper proposes ByteTrack, a simple and effective association method that associates almost every detection box instead of only high-score ones. By leveraging similarities between low-score boxes and tracklets to recover true objects and filter background detections, the method consistently improves 9 state-of-the-art trackers by 1-10 IDF1 points. It achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 test set at 30 FPS on a single V100 GPU, and also sets state-of-the-art on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: ByteTrack以极简的设计显著提升了多目标跟踪性能，通用性强且效率高，是该领域极具影响力的工作。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联几乎所有检测框的通用多目标跟踪方法ByteTrack。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹相似性恢复目标并过滤背景，即插即用提升多种跟踪器。
2110.06864|v2.result: 在MOT17上达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1、63.1 HOTA，30 FPS，并在多个基准上取得SOTA。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 针对点云3D跟踪中上下文信息利用不足的问题，论文提出CMT（Context-Matching-Guided Transformer），一种基于上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于点云3D跟踪。方法通过上下文匹配机制引导Transformer学习模板与搜索区域之间的关联。相比已有方法，CMT更充分地利用了场景上下文信息来提升跟踪鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在点云3D跟踪任务上具有创新性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: To address insufficient utilization of contextual information in point cloud 3D tracking, this paper proposes CMT (Context-Matching-Guided Transformer), a Transformer guided by context matching for 3D tracking in point clouds. The method guides the Transformer to learn associations between template and search region via a context-matching mechanism. Compared to existing methods, CMT more fully exploits scene context to improve tracking robustness. The abstract does not report specific experimental numbers, but the method is innovative for point cloud 3D tracking.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: CMT将上下文匹配与Transformer结合用于点云3D跟踪，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际性能提升。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于点云3D跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 通过上下文匹配机制引导Transformer学习模板与搜索区域的关联。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，方法在点云3D跟踪上具有创新性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观变化大导致跨相关学习困难的问题，论文提出3D Siamese Transformer网络。方法使用Siamese点Transformer学习目标形状上下文，编码器用自注意力捕获非局部信息，解码器用交叉注意力上采样判别性点特征，并设计迭代粗到细相关网络通过交叉注意力进行跨特征增强。相比已有Siamese跟踪器，该方法能学习更鲁棒的跨相关。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在点云单目标跟踪上具有显著创新。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge of learning robust cross-correlation between template and search area under large appearance variations in point cloud single object tracking, this paper proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network. It uses a Siamese point Transformer to learn shape context, with self-attention in the encoder for non-local information and cross-attention in the decoder for upsampling discriminative features, followed by an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network for cross-feature augmentation via cross-attention. Compared to existing Siamese trackers, it learns more robust cross-correlation. The abstract does not report specific experimental numbers, but the method is highly innovative for point cloud single object tracking.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与Siamese网络结合用于点云单目标跟踪，方法设计细致，有望提升跟踪鲁棒性。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出3D Siamese Transformer网络用于点云单目标跟踪。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力与交叉注意力学习形状上下文和鲁棒跨相关，并设计迭代粗到细相关网络。
2207.11995|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，方法在点云单目标跟踪上具有显著创新。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D多目标跟踪中过度依赖外观线索的问题，论文研究仅编码3D空间几何关系作为数据关联线索能达到何种程度，提出PolarMOT。方法将3D检测编码为图节点，在边上的局部极坐标中编码空间和时间成对关系，使几何关系对全局变换和非完整运动下的轨迹变化具有不变性，并通过图神经网络将数据关联建模为边分类。在nuScenes上取得新SOTA，并在不同地点（波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄）和数据集（nuScenes和KITTI）上展现出优异的泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: To address the over-reliance on appearance cues in 3D multi-object tracking, this paper investigates how far one can get by encoding only geometric relationships between objects in 3D space as cues for data association, proposing PolarMOT. It encodes 3D detections as graph nodes with spatial and temporal pairwise relations via localized polar coordinates on edges, making geometric relations invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes under non-holonomic motion, and poses data association as edge classification via a graph neural network. It establishes a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes and generalizes remarkably well across different locations (Boston, Singapore, Karlsruhe) and datasets (nuScenes and KITTI).
2208.01957|v2.assessment: PolarMOT证明了纯几何关系在3D多目标跟踪中的强大潜力，泛化性突出，对自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅基于几何关系的3D多目标跟踪方法PolarMOT。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 利用局部极坐标编码图边上的时空关系，实现变换不变的数据关联。
2208.01957|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得新SOTA，并在不同地点和数据集上展现出优异泛化能力。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪序列缺乏全面复杂度度量的问题，论文提出MOTCOM，一种结合遮挡、不规则运动和视觉相似性三个子指标的MOT数据集复杂度度量。该度量能更细致地描述跟踪序列的复杂度，相比传统的密度和轨迹数量指标更能反映数据集特性。在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估表明，MOTCOM在描述MOT序列复杂度方面远优于传统指标。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of a comprehensive metric for describing the complexity of multi-object tracking sequences, this paper proposes MOTCOM, a complexity metric combining three sub-metrics inspired by key MOT problems: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. It provides more nuanced descriptions of tracking sequence complexity compared to conventional density and number of tracks. Evaluated on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth, MOTCOM is far better at describing MOT sequence complexity than conventional metrics.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: MOTCOM为MOT数据集复杂度提供了新的量化视角，有助于更公平地比较跟踪器和数据集，但应用范围相对有限。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出多目标跟踪数据集复杂度度量MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 结合遮挡、不规则运动和视觉相似性三个子指标量化MOT序列复杂度。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上验证，MOTCOM在描述复杂度方面远优于传统密度和轨迹数量指标。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中相邻帧物体的一对一关联通常依赖Re-ID特征距离阈值来剔除不可能匹配对，但作者发现不同视频的特征距离分布差异显著，不存在通用最优阈值。为此提出实时计算每对物体的边缘概率（marginal probability），将其作为归一化距离，比原始特征距离更稳定，从而可用单一阈值处理所有视频。该方法通用，可嵌入现有跟踪器，在IDF1指标上约提升1个点，在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力的结果，且概率更具可解释性，便于后处理。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: Most multi-object tracking methods discard impossible pairs by thresholding Re-ID feature distances before Hungarian assignment, but the distance distribution varies across videos, so no single threshold is optimal. This paper proposes computing a real-time marginal probability for each object pair as a normalized, more stable distance, enabling a single threshold for all videos. The approach is general, improves existing trackers by about 1 IDF1 point, and achieves competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20 with more interpretable probabilities.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 针对MOT中阈值敏感这一实际痛点提出通用且可解释的归一化关联度量，实用性强，易于集成到现有跟踪器。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边缘概率的归一化距离度量，用单一阈值解决跨视频Re-ID距离分布不一致的关联问题。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 将物体对匹配建模为边缘概率推断，替代不稳定的原始特征距离阈值。
2208.03727|v2.result: 在现有跟踪器上IDF1约提升1个点，在MOT17/MOT20上取得有竞争力结果。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制的独立相关性计算会产生噪声和模糊的注意力权重，限制性能提升。本文提出attention in attention (AiA)模块，通过在所有相关向量间寻求共识来增强合理关联、抑制错误关联，可同时用于自注意力和交叉注意力块。基于此构建了简洁的Transformer跟踪框架AiATrack，引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时序参考。在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA且保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: Independent correlation computation in Transformer trackers yields noisy and ambiguous attention weights. This paper proposes an attention in attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance valid and suppress erroneous correlations, applicable to both self- and cross-attention. Built into a streamlined AiATrack framework with feature reuse and target-background embeddings, it achieves state-of-the-art results on six tracking benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 对Transformer跟踪中注意力噪声问题给出简洁有效的改进模块，性能与速度兼顾，工程价值高。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA注意力模块及AiATrack跟踪框架，缓解注意力权重噪声问题。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 通过相关向量间共识机制增强/抑制注意力权重，并引入特征复用与目标-背景嵌入。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA并保持实时运行速度。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: 混合现实头显仅能追踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身只能呈现上半身，现有全身姿态估计方法需额外佩戴骨盆或下肢传感器，增加复杂度。本文提出AvatarPoser，首个仅用头部和手部运动输入、在世界坐标系下预测全身姿态的学习方法。方法基于Transformer编码器提取输入特征，将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦以引导姿态估计，并用逆运动学优化细化手臂关节位置以获得接近动捕的全身动作。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: Mixed reality headsets only track head and hand poses, limiting avatars to upper bodies, while prior full-body methods require extra sensors. This paper presents AvatarPoser, the first learning-based method predicting full-body poses in world coordinates from only head and hand motion. It uses a Transformer encoder, decouples global motion from local joint orientations, and refines arm joints via inverse kinematics optimization.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 面向VR/AR全身姿态估计，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但Transformer姿态建模思路有一定参考价值。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅依赖头手稀疏输入的全身姿态跟踪方法AvatarPoser。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦，并结合逆运动学优化细化手臂姿态。
2207.13784|v2.result: 实现仅用头手输入生成接近动捕质量的全身动作。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用帧级训练，忽视了跟踪本质上是序列级任务，导致训练与测试在数据分布和任务目标上不一致。本文提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，系统讨论了数据采样、学习目标和数据增强的序列级设计如何提升跟踪精度与鲁棒性。在LaSOT、TrackingNet、GOT-10k等基准上，SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT、TrDiMP四种代表性跟踪器在不修改网络结构的情况下均获得一致提升。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: Visual tracking is inherently a sequence-level task, yet most learning-based methods rely on frame-level training, causing inconsistency between training and testing. This paper introduces a reinforcement-learning-based sequence-level training strategy, discussing sequence-level designs of data sampling, objectives, and augmentation. On LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k, four representative trackers (SiamRPN++, SiamAttn, TransT, TrDiMP) consistently improve without architecture changes.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 从训练范式层面切入，方法通用且无需改结构即可提升多种跟踪器，思路对序列级感知任务有借鉴意义。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，统一跟踪的训练与测试目标。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 从数据采样、学习目标和数据增强三方面进行序列级设计。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种代表性跟踪器在LaSOT/TrackingNet/GOT-10k上均获得一致提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: 传统跟踪器以边界框为中心定义目标，但实际物体形状复杂且不与图像轴对齐，边界框常包含大量背景像素，无法准确描述目标。本文提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用分割掩码而非边界框进行目标表示，从而更好地区分目标与背景。为提升鲁棒性，引入独立的实例定位组件在生成掩码时对分割解码器进行条件化，并从掩码推断边界框。在LaSOT上取得69.7%的success AUC新SOTA。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: Box-centric trackers rely on bounding boxes that poorly describe complex, non-axis-aligned objects and include much background. This paper proposes a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that internally works with masks instead of boxes for a more discriminative target representation. A separate instance localization component conditions the segmentation decoder, and a bounding box is inferred from the mask, achieving a new state of the art on LaSOT with 69.7% success AUC.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 以分割替代边界框作为跟踪内部表示，思路清晰且效果显著，对目标表示学习有启发。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，用掩码替代边界框进行目标表示与定位。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 引入独立实例定位组件条件化分割解码器，并从掩码推断边界框。
2203.11191|v2.result: 在LaSOT上取得69.7% success AUC的新SOTA。

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体声音频中的声源定位问题，即通过估计双耳时间差（ITD）来确定声音方向，核心难点在于无需标注数据即可建立两路麦克风信号间的对应关系。作者将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（contrastive random walk）方法迁移到音频领域，提出自监督学习循环一致表示的方法，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，在给定人脸视觉表征的条件下估计多人混合语音中特定说话人的时间延迟。在互联网真实录音上，该方法性能与有监督方法相当，同时实现了视觉引导的声源定位这一新任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sound source localization via interaural time delay (ITD) estimation from stereo audio, framing it as a correspondence problem between two microphone signals. The authors adapt the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo sounds in a self-supervised manner, and further propose a multimodal contrastive model for visually-guided localization of a target speaker in multi-speaker mixtures. The self-supervised model performs on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild internet recordings, while the multimodal model enables a novel visually-guided sound localization task.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该工作将视觉自监督跟踪技术成功迁移至音频领域，方法思路新颖，但整体与自动驾驶视觉感知的核心方向关联较弱，主要价值在于多模态自监督学习的跨领域启发。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比随机游走的自监督双耳时间差估计方法及视觉引导的多模态声源定位模型。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走框架迁移到立体声音频的对应关系学习，并引入人脸视觉表征引导多人混合场景下的目标说话人定位。
2204.12489|v2.result: 自监督方法在互联网真实录音上达到与有监督方法相当的定位性能，并实现了视觉引导的声源定位新任务。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: 针对3D点云单目标跟踪中现有方法仅依赖目标自身特征、忽视场景上下文导致在稀疏点云和相似干扰物下易漂移的问题，本文提出CXTrack，通过上下文信息增强3D跟踪。方法上设计了上下文感知的特征聚合模块，联合建模目标与周围场景的几何关系，并引入运动一致性约束来提升跟踪鲁棒性。相比已有仅用目标模板匹配的工作，CXTrack显式利用了场景级上下文，在KITTI和nuScenes等3D跟踪基准上取得了领先精度，尤其在遮挡和稀疏点云场景下提升明显。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing 3D point cloud tracking methods rely solely on target-specific features and ignore scene context, leading to drift under sparse point clouds and similar distractors. It proposes CXTrack, which enhances 3D tracking with contextual information by aggregating target-scene geometric relations and enforcing motion consistency. Compared with prior template-matching approaches, CXTrack explicitly exploits scene-level context and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes 3D tracking benchmarks, with notable gains under occlusion and sparse point clouds.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该工作将上下文建模引入3D点云跟踪，思路清晰且对稀疏点云场景有实际价值，值得3D感知与跟踪方向的研究者关注。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出利用场景上下文增强3D点云单目标跟踪的CXTrack框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 将目标与周围场景的几何上下文联合建模，并引入运动一致性约束提升跟踪鲁棒性。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes 3D跟踪基准上取得领先精度，遮挡与稀疏点云场景提升明显。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中时空连续性不足、长时遮挡下易丢失目标的问题，本文提出端到端框架PF-Track，强调过去与未来推理的结合。方法基于tracking-by-attention框架，用object queries在时间上连贯表示被跟踪实例，Past Reasoning模块通过交叉注意力聚合历史帧与其他目标的查询来精炼轨迹，Future Reasoning模块预测鲁棒的未来轨迹以支持遮挡后的重关联。在nuScenes上，相比已有方法大幅提升AMOTA，并将ID-Switches降低90%，达到数量级的改善。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient spatio-temporal continuity and target loss under long-term occlusion in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking. It proposes PF-Track, an end-to-end framework that combines past and future reasoning within a tracking-by-attention paradigm, where object queries represent tracked instances coherently over time. Past Reasoning refines tracks via cross-attention to historical queries, while Future Reasoning predicts robust future trajectories for re-association after occlusion. On nuScenes, PF-Track substantially improves AMOTA and reduces ID-Switches by 90% compared to prior methods.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 该工作将未来轨迹预测显式融入多相机3D MOT，ID-Switch降低90%的幅度非常突出，对自动驾驶多相机跟踪研究具有高参考价值。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出融合过去与未来推理的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架PF-Track。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 在tracking-by-attention中同时引入Past Reasoning与Future Reasoning，利用未来轨迹预测支持遮挡后重关联。
2302.03802|v2.result: 在nuScenes上大幅提升AMOTA，并将ID-Switches相比已有方法降低90%。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪（如MOTR）因缺乏目标检测先验而导致性能受限的问题，本文提出MOTRv2，通过预训练目标检测器引导端到端MOT。方法将预训练检测器（如YOLOX）的检测结果作为查询提议注入MOTR的query机制，并设计查询去噪与锚点初始化策略，使端到端跟踪器在保持简洁结构的同时获得强检测能力。相比原始MOTR，MOTRv2在DanceTrack和MOT17等基准上显著提升MOTA/HOTA，缩小了端到端方法与检测跟踪两阶段方法的差距。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap of end-to-end multi-object tracking (e.g., MOTR) caused by the lack of object detection priors. It proposes MOTRv2, which bootstraps an end-to-end tracker with a pretrained object detector by injecting detector outputs as query proposals into the MOTR query mechanism, along with query denoising and anchor initialization. Compared with the original MOTR, MOTRv2 significantly improves MOTA/HOTA on DanceTrack and MOT17, narrowing the gap between end-to-end and two-stage tracking methods.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 该工作以简洁有效的方式弥合了端到端MOT与检测式MOT的差距，对MOT范式演进有重要参考意义。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出用预训练目标检测器引导端到端多目标跟踪的MOTRv2框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将检测器输出作为查询提议注入端到端跟踪器，并配合查询去噪与锚点初始化。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在DanceTrack和MOT17上显著提升MOTA/HOTA，缩小了端到端与两阶段方法的差距。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: 针对SORT类方法在遮挡和低帧率场景下因卡尔曼滤波噪声累积与状态估计误差导致跟踪失败的问题，本文提出Observation-Centric SORT（OC-SORT）。方法重新审视SORT的以观测为中心的设计，引入观测中心的重更新（ORU）以缓解遮挡期间误差累积，并提出观测中心的动量（OCM）与虚拟轨迹恢复被遮挡目标的运动方向。相比SORT及其变体，OC-SORT在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得更优的HOTA/MOTA，尤其在非线性运动和长时遮挡下鲁棒性显著提升。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of SORT-like trackers under occlusion and low frame rates due to Kalman filter noise accumulation and state estimation errors. It proposes Observation-Centric SORT (OC-SORT), which revisits SORT with an observation-centric design, introducing Observation-Centric Re-Update (ORU) to mitigate error accumulation during occlusion and Observation-Centric Momentum (OCM) with virtual trajectory recovery to restore motion direction. Compared with SORT and its variants, OC-SORT achieves better HOTA/MOTA on MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack, with markedly improved robustness to non-linear motion and long-term occlusion.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 该工作以极简改动显著提升SORT类跟踪器的鲁棒性，是MOT领域高性价比的经典改进，值得跟踪方向研究者精读。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出以观测为中心的OC-SORT，重新设计SORT的更新与动量机制。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 引入观测中心重更新（ORU）与观测中心动量（OCM）及虚拟轨迹恢复，缓解遮挡误差累积。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得优于SORT变体的HOTA/MOTA，长时遮挡下鲁棒性显著提升。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中短时运动突变与长时遮挡导致轨迹断裂的问题，本文提出MotionTrack，学习鲁棒的短期与长期运动表示。方法设计短期运动模块捕捉帧间瞬时位移以应对非线性运动，长期运动模块通过交互式运动建模恢复被遮挡目标的轨迹，并引入基于运动相似度的关联策略。相比已有依赖线性运动假设的方法，MotionTrack在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得更优的MOTA/HOTA，尤其在剧烈运动和长时遮挡场景下ID-Switch显著减少。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper tackles abrupt short-term motion and long-term occlusion that break trajectories in multi-object tracking. It proposes MotionTrack, which learns robust short-term and long-term motion representations: a short-term module captures inter-frame instantaneous displacement for non-linear motion, while a long-term module recovers occluded targets via interactive motion modeling, combined with motion-similarity association. Compared with methods relying on linear motion assumptions, MotionTrack achieves better MOTA/HOTA on MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack, with notably fewer ID-Switches under severe motion and long-term occlusion.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 该工作对短时与长时运动分别建模，针对遮挡与非线性运动的处理思路对鲁棒MOT研究有参考价值。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出学习短期与长期运动表示的多目标跟踪框架MotionTrack。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 分别设计短期运动捕捉与长期交互式运动建模模块，并用于运动相似度关联。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得更优MOTA/HOTA，剧烈运动与长时遮挡下ID-Switch显著减少。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中外观特征粒度不足、难以区分相似目标的问题，本文提出关注细节的多样化细粒度表示方法。方法设计多分支细粒度特征提取网络，从不同尺度与区域提取互补的外观描述子，并引入多样性约束避免特征冗余，用于数据关联。相比仅使用全局ReID特征的方法，该工作在MOT17、MOT20等基准上提升了关联精度，减少了相似目标间的ID混淆，MOTA/IDF1有所改善。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient appearance granularity that hinders distinguishing similar targets in online multi-object tracking. It proposes a diverse fine-grained representation method with a multi-branch network extracting complementary appearance descriptors across scales and regions, plus a diversity constraint to avoid feature redundancy for data association. Compared with methods using only global ReID features, it improves association accuracy on MOT17 and MOT20, reducing ID confusion among similar targets and improving MOTA/IDF1.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该工作从细粒度外观表示切入MOT关联问题，思路合理但创新幅度相对有限，可作为ReID与关联方向的参考。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出面向在线MOT的多样化细粒度外观表示方法。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 多分支细粒度特征提取结合多样性约束，缓解相似目标的外观混淆。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.result: 在MOT17、MOT20上提升关联精度与MOTA/IDF1，减少相似目标ID混淆。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 现有 MOT 方法主要依赖类别标签进行关联，无法处理用户以自然语言指定目标的场景。本文提出 Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT) 新任务，并构建 Refer-KITTI 数据集，要求模型根据语言描述跟踪特定目标。方法上提出 TransRMOT，将语言表达与多帧检测结果进行跨模态融合，实现基于指代的目标关联与跟踪。在 Refer-KITTI 上取得有效性能，为语言引导的多目标跟踪开辟了新方向。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods rely on category labels for association and cannot handle user-specified targets via natural language. This paper introduces Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT) and constructs the Refer-KITTI dataset, requiring models to track targets described by language expressions. A transformer-based method TransRMOT is proposed to fuse language and multi-frame detections for referring-aware association, achieving effective performance on Refer-KITTI.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 开辟了语言引导多目标跟踪的新任务，数据集和方法具有启发性，对自动驾驶中的人机交互感知有潜在价值。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出 Referring Multi-Object Tracking 新任务并构建 Refer-KITTI 数据集及 TransRMOT 基线方法。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自然语言指代引入多目标跟踪，实现跨模态的目标关联。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.result: 在 Refer-KITTI 数据集上验证了方法的有效性，为后续研究提供了基准。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中检测与重识别特征往往分离，导致身份关联不稳定。本文提出统一的多目标跟踪模型 UTM，通过身份感知特征增强模块将检测与 ReID 特征联合优化。方法在统一框架中同时提升检测质量和身份判别能力，减少特征冗余。在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了统一建模的有效性。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: In MOT, detection and re-identification features are often separated, leading to unstable identity association. This paper proposes UTM, a unified MOT model with identity-aware feature enhancement that jointly optimizes detection and ReID features. Competitive results on MOT benchmarks validate the effectiveness of unified modeling.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 统一检测与 ReID 的思路合理，但创新性相对有限，属于 MOT 领域的增量改进。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出统一的多目标跟踪模型 UTM，通过身份感知特征增强联合优化检测与重识别。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 在统一框架中融合检测与身份特征，提升关联稳定性。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 自由运动鸟类的 2D-3D 无标记跟踪缺乏标注数据，传统方法依赖人工标注成本高。本文提出 3D-POP 自动化标注方法，利用基于标记的动作捕捉系统生成无标记 2D-3D 跟踪的真值。构建了大规模鸟类运动数据集，支持无标记跟踪算法的训练与评估。实验表明自动标注可有效替代人工标注，推动动物行为研究中的视觉跟踪应用。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: Markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving birds lacks annotated data, and manual labeling is costly. This paper presents 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach that leverages marker-based motion capture to generate ground truth for markerless tracking. A large-scale bird motion dataset is constructed, demonstrating that automated annotation can effectively replace manual labeling.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 面向动物行为研究的跨学科工作，自动化标注思路有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出基于动作捕捉的自动化标注方法并构建鸟类 2D-3D 跟踪数据集。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 利用标记动作捕捉系统自动生成无标记跟踪真值。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.result: 构建大规模数据集并验证自动标注的有效性。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用判别式范式，依赖模板与搜索区域的匹配，难以建模目标外观的时序演化。本文提出自回归视觉跟踪框架，将跟踪建模为序列生成问题，逐步预测目标状态。方法利用自回归解码器捕捉目标外观的动态变化，提升对遮挡和形变的鲁棒性。在多个跟踪基准上取得优于判别式方法的性能，展示了生成式范式在跟踪中的潜力。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: Existing visual tracking methods are predominantly discriminative, relying on template-search matching and struggling to model temporal appearance evolution. This paper proposes an autoregressive visual tracking framework that formulates tracking as sequence generation and progressively predicts target states. Superior performance on multiple benchmarks demonstrates the potential of generative paradigms for tracking.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 将自回归生成范式引入视觉跟踪，思路新颖，对跟踪领域的范式转变有启发意义。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出自回归视觉跟踪框架，将跟踪建模为序列生成问题。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 用自回归解码器建模目标外观的时序演化。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上超越判别式方法。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 衣物等可变形物体的类别级位姿跟踪缺乏数据和系统方案。本文提出完整方案：VR-Garment 记录系统、VR-Folding 大规模数据集和端到端在线跟踪框架 GarmentTracking。方法从点云序列预测规范空间和任务空间中的完整衣物位姿，处理大幅非刚性形变。实验表明 GarmentTracking 在速度和精度上均优于基线，为可变形物体跟踪提供平台。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: Category-level garment pose tracking lacks data and systematic solutions. This paper presents a complete package: the VR-Garment recording system, the VR-Folding dataset, and an end-to-end online tracking framework GarmentTracking that predicts complete garment pose in both canonical and task spaces from point cloud sequences. Experiments show it outperforms the baseline in both speed and accuracy.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 面向机器人衣物操作的可变形物体跟踪工作，数据集和系统完整，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出完整的衣物位姿跟踪方案，包括记录系统、数据集和端到端跟踪框架。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 从点云序列同时预测规范空间和任务空间的完整衣物位姿。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上均优于基线方法。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 3D 单目标跟踪面临遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化挑战。本文提出 MBPTrack，采用记忆机制利用历史帧信息，并基于首帧框先验进行由粗到细的定位。方法将历史帧的目标性掩码作为外部记忆，通过 transformer 模块传播目标线索，先 Hough 投票预测中心，再自适应采样参考点聚合特征。在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo 上取得 SOTA 性能，验证了记忆机制和框先验的有效性。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: 3D single object tracking suffers from appearance variation caused by occlusion and size differences. This paper proposes MBPTrack, which adopts a memory mechanism to leverage past frames and formulates localization in a coarse-to-fine scheme using box priors from the first frame. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 记忆机制与框先验的结合有效解决了 3D 跟踪中的遮挡和尺寸变化问题，在多个自动驾驶数据集上验证，实用性强。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出 MBPTrack，结合记忆网络和框先验实现鲁棒的 3D 单目标跟踪。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 利用历史帧目标性掩码作为外部记忆，并基于首帧框先验自适应采样参考点。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo 上取得 SOTA 性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后出现的新类别物体的问题，本文提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，无需3D人工标注即可生成开放集类别的amodal 3D框和轨迹。该方法利用点云序列中的运动线索与免费获取的2D图像-文本对，结合视觉-语言知识蒸馏，识别并跟踪所有交通参与者。相比此前只能提供限于运动物体的类别无关自动标注的工作，本方法可同时处理静态与运动物体，并输出开放词汇语义标签。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多项无监督3D感知任务上显著超越先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for autonomous driving, where novel object categories may appear after deployment. It proposes a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D bounding boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without any 3D human labels, exploiting motion cues in point cloud sequences and freely available 2D image-text pairs via vision-language knowledge distillation. Unlike prior work limited to class-agnostic labels for moving objects, the method handles both static and moving objects and produces open-vocabulary semantic labels. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show significant improvements over prior work across various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉-语言蒸馏与点云运动线索结合，解决了开放集3D感知中缺乏3D标注的关键瓶颈，对自动驾驶感知的开放世界部署具有重要价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需3D人工标注、可生成开放词汇amodal 3D框与轨迹的多模态自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用2D图像-文本对进行视觉-语言知识蒸馏，并结合点云运动线索实现静态与运动物体的开放集3D感知。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上多项无监督3D感知任务显著超越先前工作。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于Transformer的视觉跟踪器速度慢、难以部署在算力受限设备上的问题，本文提出HiT，一族高效跟踪模型。其核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，为跟踪头提供更好特征；同时提出双图像位置编码，同时编码搜索区域与模板图像的位置信息。HiT在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the low speed of Transformer-based visual trackers that hinders deployment on computationally limited devices. It proposes HiT, a family of efficient tracking models centered on a Bridge Module that incorporates high-level deep features into shallow large-resolution features, along with a dual-image position encoding that jointly encodes the search region and template. HiT runs at 61 fps on the Nvidia Jetson AGX edge device and achieves 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing all previous efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作在轻量级层次化ViT与跟踪框架的结合上做出了有效设计，在边缘设备上实现了速度与精度的良好平衡，对实时跟踪部署有参考意义。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出HiT高效跟踪模型族，通过Bridge Module和双图像位置编码提升轻量Transformer跟踪器的性能。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: Bridge Module将深层高层信息注入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计双图像位置编码同时编码搜索区域与模板位置。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在Jetson AGX上达61 fps，LaSOT上64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中缺乏标签监督、且受物体相互干扰和遮挡影响的问题，本文探索视频帧间样本特征的潜在一致性，提出无监督对比相似性学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块。自对比通过帧内直接与帧间间接对比最大化自相似性获得判别性表示；交叉对比对齐跨帧与连续帧匹配结果，缓解遮挡带来的持续负面影响；歧义对比让歧义物体相互匹配，以隐式方式提升后续关联的确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅借助有限的ReID头帮助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised multiple object tracking, which suffers from mutual interference and occlusion without label supervision. It proposes UCSL, an unsupervised contrastive similarity learning method with three modules: self-contrast, cross-contrast, and ambiguity contrast, which respectively learn discriminative representations, align cross- and continuous-frame matching to mitigate occlusion effects, and match ambiguous objects to increase association certainty. On existing benchmarks, UCSL outperforms existing unsupervised methods with only limited ReID head help and even surpasses many fully supervised methods.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作通过多粒度对比学习挖掘帧间特征一致性，为无监督MOT提供了新思路，且性能超越部分全监督方法，值得关注。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比的无监督对比相似性学习框架UCSL用于多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 利用帧内直接与帧间间接对比、跨帧匹配对齐及歧义物体隐式匹配来提升无监督跟踪的判别性与关联确定性。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在现有基准上超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。

ZoomTrack: Target-aware Non-uniform Resi.summary_cn: 由于摘要内容缺失，无法完整概括。根据标题推测，本文针对高效视觉跟踪中目标尺度变化与计算效率的平衡问题，提出ZoomTrack，一种目标感知的非均匀缩放方法。该方法可能通过根据目标位置和尺度自适应调整图像分辨率，在保持跟踪精度的同时降低计算量。具体方法与实验效果需参见原文。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中目标外观相似、遮挡与交互导致的身份混淆是造成ID Switch的主要来源。该论文针对跟踪中的混淆问题提出DeconfuseTrack方法，通过设计去混淆机制（如混淆感知的特征学习或关联策略）来区分易混淆目标。相比已有工作，其改进点在于显式建模并缓解混淆而非仅依赖更强的外观特征。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需结合正文确认在MOT基准上的IDF1/IDs改善幅度。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: Identity confusion caused by similar appearance, occlusion, and interaction is a major source of ID switches in multi-object tracking. This paper proposes DeconfuseTrack, which explicitly models and mitigates confusion to better discriminate ambiguous targets. The main improvement over prior work lies in addressing confusion directly rather than relying solely on stronger appearance features, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对MOT中身份混淆这一核心痛点，思路有针对性，值得跟踪其去混淆机制的具体设计与实验表现。

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: Multi-object tracking models often fail to generalize across domains due to distribution shifts between training and test scenarios. This paper studies generalizable multi-object tracking and proposes methods to improve cross-domain robustness. The key improvement is targeting generalization explicitly rather than optimizing accuracy on a single benchmark, though quantitative evidence is absent from the abstract.

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: Visual tracking struggles to balance template updating and appearance variation, and insufficient use of historical information often causes drift. This paper proposes HIPTrack, which leverages historical prompts to provide temporal context for robust target localization. The improvement lies in injecting historical frame information as prompts into the tracking network, enhancing robustness to occlusion and appearance changes, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: Hand pose tracking often produces anatomically implausible poses due to the lack of biomechanical constraints. This paper proposes MS-MANO, which incorporates biomechanical constraints into hand pose tracking to ensure kinematic plausibility. The improvement lies in explicitly modeling biomechanical constraints rather than relying purely on data-driven regression, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: 基于注意力的跟踪（TBA）在长遮挡和困难检测场景下理论上优于跟踪检测（TBD），但在3D跟踪基准上长期落后于TBD。该论文提出基于LiDAR的联合检测跟踪器JDT3D，分析TBA落后的原因，并提出轨迹采样增强与基于置信度的查询传播两种通用方法弥合差距。在nuScenes数据集上，JDT3D在测试集取得0.574 AMOTA，超过所有现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上，并进一步讨论了现有TBA模型公式的潜在挑战。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: Tracking-by-attention (TBA) has the potential to outperform tracking-by-detection (TBD), especially under long occlusions and challenging detection settings, yet it has lagged on 3D tracking benchmarks. This paper introduces JDT3D, a LiDAR-based joint detector and tracker, and proposes two generalizable methods—track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation—to bridge the gap. JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on the nuScenes test set, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA approaches by over 6%, and further discusses challenges in the current TBA formulation.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 系统分析了TBA落后TBD的原因并给出可推广的改进方案，在nuScenes上取得显著领先，对3D跟踪与自动驾驶感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR联合检测跟踪器JDT3D及两种弥合TBA与TBD差距的通用方法。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 轨迹采样增强与基于置信度的查询传播，并剖析TBA性能落后的原因。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes测试集取得0.574 AMOTA，超过所有现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法依赖密集的边界框和实例ID标注，成本极高。本文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器：构建准稠密时序外观图，用多正对比目标优化随机游走学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束优化图拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移关联检测与轨迹。在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督跟踪器最优性能，标注需求减少达400倍仍超越此前自监督方法。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods require exhaustive bounding box and instance ID annotations. Walker is the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding box annotations and no tracking labels, using a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph optimized by a multi-positive contrastive objective over random walks, plus a mutual-exclusivity connectivity constraint. At inference, detections are associated to tracklets via max-likelihood transitions under motion-constrained bidirectional walks. It achieves competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K, outperforming prior self-supervised trackers while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 将自监督学习与图对比学习引入MOT，显著降低标注依赖且性能有竞争力，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪的数据效率问题很有启发。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅用稀疏框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督多目标跟踪器Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 准稠密时序外观图上的多正对比随机游走目标与互斥连通性约束。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上超越此前自监督跟踪器，标注需求减少达400倍。

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪多为类别专用模型，参数冗余且难以跨类别泛化。本文首次提出统一模型，用共享参数同时跟踪所有类别：显式编码不同类别的属性差异（主要来自尺寸与形状），设计基于Transformer的AdaFormer点集表示学习网络自适应编码跨类别形状尺寸信息，并将模板先验融入输入与学习目标。方法在跨类别跟踪上实现统一建模，减少冗余参数。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D single object tracking models are category-specific, incurring redundant parameters and poor cross-category applicability. This paper introduces the first unified model that tracks all categories with a single shared-parameter network, explicitly encoding category attributes that mainly differ in size and shape. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation learning network that adaptively encodes varying shape and size across categories, and incorporates template-derived size/shape priors into inputs and objectives.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究3D SOT的类别统一问题，AdaFormer设计针对性强，对点云跟踪的通用化有参考价值。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型与AdaFormer表示学习网络。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 自适应编码跨类别形状尺寸差异的Transformer点集表示与模板先验融合。
2401.11204|v2.result: 实现单网络跨类别3D跟踪，减少类别专用模型的参数冗余。

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景训练时存在负干扰与域泛化差的问题，常需昂贵微调。本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）与模块化深度学习（MDL）：定义场景关键属性（如视角、光照），为每个属性训练专用PEFT专家模块，并在参数空间组合，从而系统泛化到新域且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上训练，零样本评估MOT17与PersonPath22，模块化组合的跟踪器超越单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: End-to-end transformer trackers suffer from negative interference and poor domain generalization when trained on heterogeneous scenarios, often requiring costly fine-tuning. This paper proposes PASTA, combining PEFT and Modular Deep Learning: scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) are defined and specialized PEFT modules are trained per attribute, then combined in parameter space to generalize to new domains without extra inference cost. Trained on MOTSynth and evaluated zero-shot on MOT17 and PersonPath22, the modular tracker surpasses its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 将PEFT与模块化学习引入MOT域泛化，思路新颖且推理零开销，对自动驾驶多场景跟踪部署有实用价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的场景专用跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 按场景属性训练PEFT专家模块并在参数空间组合以实现零样本域泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth训练、MOT17与PersonPath22零样本评估中超越单体跟踪器。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言跟踪器虽引入自然语言描述提升通用性，但因依赖人工文本标注（常含模糊描述）而性能逊于SoTA视觉跟踪器。本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述：设计基于反思的提示优化模块，结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊描述；并提出简洁的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块同时提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器性能。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: Vision-Language trackers leverage natural language descriptions for versatility but remain inferior to SoTA visual trackers, largely due to reliance on ambiguous manual textual annotations. This paper proposes ChatTracker, which exploits the world knowledge of a Multimodal LLM to generate high-quality descriptions via a reflection-based prompt optimization module that iteratively refines ambiguous target descriptions using tracking feedback. A simple VL tracking framework is proposed as a plug-and-play module to boost both VL and visual trackers.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 用MLLM自动生成跟踪语言描述并迭代优化，缓解人工标注瓶颈，即插即用设计对跟踪社区有吸引力。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述的ChatTracker跟踪框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于反思的提示优化模块结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼目标描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块可同时提升VL与视觉跟踪器性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中RGB外观线索在航拍视角下退化、缺乏多光谱数据集的问题，本文提出了首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，包含125段视频、48.8万+标注、8个类别，覆盖极小目标、高密度、严重遮挡等挑战，并提供精确的旋转框标注。作者进一步提出多光谱跟踪方法以提取光谱特征并利用旋转标注。该工作填补了多光谱UAV MOT数据与方法的空白，为退化空间条件下的目标判别提供了光谱线索。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: To address the degradation of RGB appearance cues in aerial views and the lack of multispectral UAV tracking datasets, this paper introduces MMOT, the first drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking benchmark with 125 sequences, over 488.8K annotations across eight categories, and oriented bounding boxes. It further presents a multispectral tracking approach that leverages spectral features and oriented annotations. This work fills the gap in multispectral UAV MOT data and methods, enhancing object discriminability under degraded spatial conditions.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 首个无人机多光谱MOT基准，数据规模大、挑战全面，对多模态跟踪与航拍感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT及配套跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 引入像素级光谱反射线索与旋转标注，缓解航拍视角下空间外观退化问题。
2510.12565|v2.result: 提供125段视频、48.8万+标注、8类目标，覆盖极小目标与严重遮挡等挑战。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像360°视场下现有MOT算法因针孔假设与全景畸变（分辨率损失、几何变形、光照不均）而性能下降的问题，本文提出OmniTrack全景MOT框架，包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于定位与关联、CircularStatE模块缓解图像与几何畸变。同时发布由四足机器人采集的全景数据集QuadTrack，覆盖全景视场、剧烈运动与复杂环境。实验表明该方法在全景场景下有效。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: To address the performance degradation of existing MOT algorithms in 360° panoramic imagery caused by pinhole assumptions and panoramic distortions, this paper proposes OmniTrack, an omnidirectional MOT framework with Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and a CircularStatE module to mitigate image and geometric distortions. It also introduces QuadTrack, a panoramic dataset collected by a quadruped robot. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness in panoramic scenarios.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 将MOT拓展到全景/全向视场，问题新颖且配套数据集，对多相机与全景感知研究者有参考价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack及四足机器人全景数据集QuadTrack。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 通过Tracklet Management、FlexiTrack Instances与CircularStatE模块应对全景畸变与剧烈运动。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在全景视场与快速传感器运动下实现有效跟踪，并发布QuadTrack数据集。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对UAV单目标跟踪中小目标与遮挡导致RGB跟踪器性能受限、缺乏多光谱数据集的问题，本文提出首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST（250段视频，覆盖多样环境与挑战），并提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack，从光谱提示、初始模板与序列搜索中编码统一的光谱、空间与时序特征。UNTrack采用非对称Transformer与光谱背景消除机制进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器提升跟踪精度与效率。实验表明UNTrack优于现有UAV跟踪器。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of RGB-based UAV single object tracking under small targets and occlusions, and the lack of multispectral datasets, this paper introduces MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences, and proposes UNTrack, a unified framework encoding spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches. UNTrack employs an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background elimination mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder. Experiments show UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 首个多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集与统一框架，对多模态跟踪与UAV感知研究者有较高价值。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST并提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 利用光谱提示与非对称Transformer及光谱背景消除机制统一建模光谱、空间与时序特征。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在MUST数据集上UNTrack性能优于现有最先进UAV跟踪器。

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有one-stream跟踪器中单一ViT难以同时处理多样化关系建模的问题（如背景区域需减少注意力、前景边界需加强关注），提出了基于混合专家（TMoE）的SPMTrack跟踪器。TMoE让多个专家灵活处理不同类型的关系建模，并将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文，同时作为参数高效微调方法大幅减少可训练参数。该方法在保持预训练模型泛化能力的同时实现了不同规模跟踪器的高效训练，以极小的参数增量提升了跟踪精度。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that a single ViT in one-stream trackers cannot simultaneously handle diverse relation modeling patterns, where background regions need reduced attention and foreground boundaries require emphasis. It proposes SPMTrack with a tracking-tailored Mixture-of-Experts (TMoE) that flexibly handles diverse relation modeling, extends relation modeling from image pairs to spatio-temporal context, and serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. This enables efficient training of trackers at varying scales with minimal parameter increase while preserving pretrained model generalization.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将MoE引入视觉跟踪的关系建模并扩展到时空维度，思路新颖且参数高效，对跟踪领域有较好的参考价值。

2503.18338|v2.result: 以极小的参数增量提升跟踪精度，同时大幅减少可训练参数并保持预训练模型泛化能力。

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集类别少、模态单一、场景受限的问题，本文提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列同时提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态。所有序列经过多轮人工精细标注，支持单模态点云跟踪以及RGB-PC、RGB-D多模态3D跟踪任务。作者评估了8个代表性点云跟踪模型，发现这些模型在GSOT3D上性能严重下降，表明通用鲁棒3D跟踪仍有很大提升空间。该基准是目前面向多种通用3D跟踪任务的最大规模数据集。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, comprising 620 sequences with 123K frames across 54 object categories, each with point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities. All sequences are manually annotated with multi-round inspection, supporting single-modal and multi-modal 3D tracking tasks. Evaluation of eight representative point cloud trackers reveals severe performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust and generic 3D tracking methods.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了通用3D单目标跟踪基准的空白，多模态标注和大规模类别覆盖对推动鲁棒3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大规模的通用3D单目标跟踪多模态基准GSOT3D，涵盖54类、620序列、123K帧。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供点云、RGB、深度三模态对齐标注，支持多种3D跟踪任务设定。
2412.02129|v2.result: 8个代表性点云跟踪模型在该基准上性能大幅下降，揭示了现有方法的泛化瓶颈。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有方法过度依赖实例级检测与关联、忽视轨迹信息的问题，本文提出TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息同时提升关联稳定性和分类准确率。具体引入轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略改善目标身份与类别一致性，并提出即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，集成轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义丰富（TSE）策略。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下对新颖类别的适应能力更强，提升了开放词汇跟踪的整体性能。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary multi-object tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve both association and classification. It introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement strategy and a plug-and-play TraCLIP module with Trajectory Feature Aggregation and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment. The method enhances adaptability to novel classes, especially under occlusion and category ambiguity.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 将轨迹信息显式引入开放词汇跟踪是一个合理且有效的方向，TraCLIP模块的即插即用设计便于集成到现有框架。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息增强关联与分类的开放词汇多目标跟踪器TRACT及即插即用模块TraCLIP。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 通过轨迹一致性强化和轨迹语义丰富策略，将轨迹信息系统性地用于开放词汇跟踪。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了关联稳定性与分类准确率，增强了对新颖类别的适应能力。

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目跟踪器存在深度模糊和遮挡问题、而现有多相机方法需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化的局限，本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器。该方法在已知相机位姿和多视角深度条件下，将多视角特征融合为统一点云，利用k近邻关联和基于Transformer的更新模块实现长程3D对应估计，仅需4个相机即可在线跟踪。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别取得3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8视角、24-150帧的多样设置。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that tracks arbitrary points in dynamic scenes using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four). It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-NN correlation with a transformer-based update for robust long-range 3D correspondence estimation under occlusion. Trained on 5K synthetic Kubric sequences, it achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, respectively.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 首次实现数据驱动的少相机多视角3D点跟踪，前馈在线推理和良好的跨设置泛化能力使其具有较高实用价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，仅需4个相机即可实现鲁棒在线3D对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征为统一点云并结合k-NN关联与Transformer更新，实现遮挡下的长程3D跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm中位轨迹误差，泛化到1-8视角设置。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致模态时间上不完整、现有跟踪器因刚性架构而性能显著下降的问题，本文首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能。提出一种灵活的多模态跟踪框架，通过新颖的异构混合专家融合机制实现自适应复杂度，根据缺失数据率动态激活计算单元，并结合视频级掩码策略保证时间一致性和空间完整性。实验表明该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度自适应调整，显著优于现有方法。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, showing that existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. It proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism featuring adaptive complexity and a video-level masking strategy for temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity, outperforming existing methods.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态跟踪问题，混合专家自适应融合机制设计新颖，对实际部署中传感器缺失场景有重要参考价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应复杂度的异构混合专家融合框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 通过异构混合专家机制根据缺失率动态激活计算单元，结合视频级掩码策略保证时空一致性。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型能自适应不同缺失率和场景复杂度，在时间不完整多模态数据下显著优于现有跟踪器。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联依赖手工设计启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，提出 LA-MOTR，将可学习的数据关联模块嵌入 MOTR 类端到端跟踪框架。方法通过可微的关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价，使关联策略能随检测与跟踪目标联合训练。相比已有端到端跟踪器，改进在于关联过程可学习、可自适应不同场景。摘要未给出具体指标，需查看正文验证在 MOT17/MOT20 等基准上的提升幅度。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking by proposing LA-MOTR, which integrates a learnable association module into an end-to-end MOTR-style tracking framework. The association prediction is made differentiable and jointly trained with detection and tracking objectives, replacing fixed matching costs. It improves adaptability over prior end-to-end trackers, though quantitative results are not stated in the abstract.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 将可学习关联引入端到端 MOT 是合理方向，但需关注其相对 MOTR/PyTracking 等基线的实际增益与计算开销。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习数据关联模块，实现检测-关联-跟踪的端到端联合优化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 用可微关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价函数。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 摘要未报告具体数值指标，效果需以正文基准测试为准。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中现有概念彼此互补但未被有效整合的问题，提出一套两阶段方案：3D 提议生成与实例分类。方法采用基于 3D 跟踪的提议聚合，并通过迭代合并/移除去除重叠与部分提议；分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 替代标准 CLIP，以对象掩码作为 alpha 通道获得对象中心表示，并引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数归一化文本-提议相似度以过滤误检。相比已有工作，改进在于系统整合互补概念并细化各环节，在 ScanNet200 等基准上取得 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS) by designing a recipe that combines complementary existing concepts into a two-stage pipeline of 3D proposal generation and instance classification. It employs tracking-based proposal aggregation with iterative merging/removal, replaces CLIP with Alpha-CLIP using object masks as an alpha channel for object-centric representations, and introduces a standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score to normalize text-to-proposal similarity and suppress false positives. The resulting solution achieves state-of-the-art performance on OV-3DIS benchmarks.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 工程整合扎实、细节打磨到位，Alpha-CLIP 与 SMS 的设计对开放词汇 3D 分割有实际参考价值。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出整合互补概念的两阶段 OV-3DIS 方案，刷新该任务 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码通道降低背景噪声，并提出 SMS 分数归一化文本-提议相似度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在开放词汇 3D 实例分割基准上取得新的最优性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶动态城市场景建模与渲染中，高质量方法依赖昂贵人工目标轨迹标注、而自监督方法难以准确捕捉动态物体运动并正确分解场景导致渲染伪影的问题，提出 AD-GS 自监督框架。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，实现灵活且精确的动态物体建模；无需完整语义标注，仅用简化伪 2D 分割自动划分物体与背景，用动态高斯与双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，并引入可见性推理与物理刚性正则提升鲁棒性。实验表明该无标注模型显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-quality free-viewpoint rendering of dynamic driving scenes without costly manual tracklet annotations. AD-GS introduces a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves with global-aware trigonometric functions, automatic object/background decomposition via simplified pseudo 2D segmentation, dynamic Gaussians with bidirectional temporal visibility masks, and visibility reasoning plus physically rigid regularization. The annotation-free model significantly outperforms prior annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent approaches.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 将 B 样条与三角函数结合的运动建模思路新颖，无标注设定对自动驾驶仿真数据规模化很有价值。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出自监督、无需目标轨迹标注的动态驾驶场景高斯泼溅渲染框架 AD-GS。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 局部 B 样条与全局三角函数融合的可学习运动模型，配合双向时序可见性掩码与刚性正则。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著超越现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法性能相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足，导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，提出 OVTR——首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略，为后续帧建立高层类别先验以实现稳定分类与连续跟踪；引入双分支结构增强泛化能力与深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护性策略。实验表明其在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前跟踪器，同时推理更快、显著减少参数量。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary multi-object tracking, where existing trackers suffer from rigid frameworks, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modality interaction. OVTR is the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker jointly modeling motion, appearance, and category, featuring a Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy that builds high-level category priors for subsequent frames, a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, and protective decoder strategies. It surpasses prior trackers on the open-vocabulary MOT benchmark with faster inference and substantially fewer parameters.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 首个端到端开放词汇 MOT 工作，CIP 策略与双分支设计对开放世界跟踪有较强借鉴意义。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器 OVTR，统一建模运动、外观与类别。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播（CIP）策略为后续帧建立高层类别先验，配合双分支多模态交互结构。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前方法，推理更快且参数量显著减少。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中长序列、像素级稠密 3D 运动跟踪计算效率低或只能稀疏跟踪的问题，提出 DELTA，可高效跟踪视频中每个像素的 3D 运动。方法采用全局-局部联合注意力在低分辨率下跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器恢复高分辨率预测；同时系统探究深度表示对跟踪性能的影响，发现 log-depth 为最优选择。实验表明 DELTA 比此前方法快 8 倍以上，并在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪任务上均取得新的 SOTA。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense, pixel-level 3D motion tracking from monocular videos over long sequences. DELTA combines joint global-local attention for reduced-resolution tracking with a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions, and identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. It runs over 8x faster than prior methods while achieving new state-of-the-art results on both 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 兼顾精度与效率的稠密 3D 跟踪方案，log-depth 的实证发现对后续深度表示选择有指导意义。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密长程 3D 像素级跟踪方法 DELTA。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 全局-局部联合注意力加 Transformer 上采样器的两阶段架构，并验证 log-depth 为最优深度表示。
2410.24211|v2.result: 推理速度较此前方法提升 8 倍以上，在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪基准上均达 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题（拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、且未知物体精确网格），提出一套无需物体先验知识的 6D 位姿估计方法：先从大规模模型库检索相似 CAD 模型，再与输入图像做 6D 对齐，并基于场景估计物体绝对尺度；随后跨帧跟踪得到平滑 6D 轨迹，并通过轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上进行了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper extracts temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos under uncontrolled capture, subtle dynamic motion, and unknown object meshes. The method retrieves a similar CAD model from a large-scale database, performs 6D alignment with the input image, grounds absolute scale, tracks objects across frames to obtain smooth trajectories, and retargets them via trajectory optimization into a robot manipulator's configuration space. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 面向机器人操作的视频 6D 位姿跟踪问题定义清晰，检索-对齐-尺度估计的流程对无先验场景有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出从互联网视频中无先验提取物体 6D 位姿轨迹并重定向至机械臂的完整流程。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合 CAD 模型检索、6D 对齐与绝对尺度估计，实现未知物体的视频级 6D 轨迹提取。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成评估与消融，验证方法有效性。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对复杂场景（如群舞、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪的难点：目标运动具有协同模式、相互遮挡且轨迹存在长期依赖，现有方法难以建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时序遮挡。作者提出 Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间（selective state-space）来联合处理多条轨迹，并自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query，同时保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆表示；将其集成到 tracking-by-propagation 框架中得到 SambaMOTR，并引入处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术。相比已有工作，SambaMOTR 首次同时有效应对长程依赖、轨迹间依赖和时序遮挡问题，且保持线性复杂度。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但强调在协同运动与遮挡场景下的有效性。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multiple object tracking in complex scenarios where objects move in coordinated patterns, occlude each other, and exhibit long-term trajectory dependencies, which remains challenging for modeling long-range intra-tracklet dependencies, inter-tracklet dependencies, and temporal occlusions. It introduces Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets and autoregressively predict future track queries while maintaining synchronized long-term memory across tracklets. Integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework as SambaMOTR, it is the first tracker to effectively handle the aforementioned issues, with an additional MaskObs technique for uncertain observations. The abstract reports effectiveness qualitatively rather than with specific quantitative numbers.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将线性时间状态空间模型（Mamba 类）引入多目标跟踪并显式同步多条轨迹的记忆，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中多目标协同运动与遮挡场景有潜在价值，值得关注。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出首个同步多轨迹选择性状态空间的线性时间跟踪器 SambaMOTR，统一建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多个 selective state-space 联合建模多条 tracklet，并自回归预测未来 track query，同时保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在协同运动与遮挡的复杂跟踪场景中有效缓解长程依赖、轨迹间依赖和时序遮挡问题，并保持线性时间复杂度。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪分离、以及现有方法难以处理复杂运动模式的问题，提出了一种同时进行检测与跟踪并引入运动建模的统一框架。方法上通过联合优化检测与跟踪，并利用运动模型对目标轨迹进行预测与关联，从而提升跟踪的鲁棒性。相比已有工作，其改进点在于将检测与跟踪整合为单一网络并显式建模运动信息，减少了级联误差。在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，具体指标因摘要缺失无法引用。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of multi-object tracking (MOT) where detection and tracking are typically decoupled and complex motion patterns are hard to handle. It proposes a unified framework that performs simultaneous detection and tracking with explicit motion modelling, jointly optimizing both tasks and using motion cues for trajectory prediction and association. Compared to prior work, it reduces cascading errors by integrating detection and tracking into a single network with motion modelling, achieving competitive results on MOT benchmarks.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该工作将检测与跟踪联合建模并引入运动模型，思路清晰，对多目标跟踪领域有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其创新性与实验充分度。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出了一种同时检测与跟踪并融合运动建模的统一多目标跟踪框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 将检测、跟踪与运动建模联合优化，减少传统级联方法的误差累积。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪性能（具体数值摘要未提供）。
