Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）系统在对抗攻击下的安全性问题，指出仅欺骗检测器不足以完全破坏跟踪，但结合跟踪逻辑的攻击可造成更严重失效。方法上提出了一种针对 MOT 的对抗攻击策略，通过同时干扰检测与跟踪关联过程来生成有效攻击。相比已有仅攻击检测的工作，其改进点在于揭示了跟踪模块的脆弱性并设计了联合攻击。实验表明该攻击能显著降低 MOT 性能，具体指标因摘要缺失无法引用。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper investigates the security of multi-object tracking (MOT) systems under adversarial attacks, arguing that fooling detection alone is insufficient but attacking tracking logic can cause severe failures. It proposes an adversarial attack strategy against MOT that jointly perturbs detection and tracking association. Compared to prior detection-only attacks, it reveals the vulnerability of tracking modules and designs a joint attack, significantly degrading MOT performance in experiments.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该工作从对抗攻击角度审视 MOT 系统的鲁棒性，选题新颖，对自动驾驶感知安全有警示意义，但摘要信息有限，需关注其攻击的实用性与防御启示。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出了一种针对多目标跟踪系统的联合对抗攻击方法，揭示跟踪模块的脆弱性。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 首次强调仅攻击检测不足，需同时攻击跟踪关联过程才能有效破坏 MOT。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 实验表明该攻击能显著降低多目标跟踪性能（具体数值摘要未提供）。

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中的数据关联问题，将其建模为带约束的优化问题，提出了 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型。方法上通过将轨迹关联转化为整数线性规划，并利用 lifted 结构处理多帧间的路径约束，从而获得全局最优或近似最优的关联解。相比已有基于图或网络流的方法，其改进点在于更灵活地处理长时关联与遮挡。在 MOT 基准上验证了有效性，具体指标因摘要缺失无法引用。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses the data association problem in multi-object tracking (MOT) by formulating it as a constrained optimization problem and proposing the Lifted Disjoint Paths model. It transforms trajectory association into integer linear programming with lifted structures to handle multi-frame path constraints, yielding globally or near-optimally consistent associations. Compared to graph-based or network-flow methods, it more flexibly handles long-term association and occlusion, with effectiveness validated on MOT benchmarks.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该工作从组合优化角度为 MOT 数据关联提供了新视角，理论性较强，对跟踪领域研究者有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其计算效率与可扩展性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出了 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型用于多目标跟踪中的数据关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 将轨迹关联建模为带 lifted 结构的整数线性规划，提升长时关联与遮挡处理能力。

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏局部归纳偏置、局部细节建模不足的问题，本文提出Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制将局部表示与ViT的全局注意力信息结合。方法在ViT结构中引入局部特征融合模块，使模型同时具备全局建模与局部细节感知能力。相比纯ViT，该设计在保持全局注意力的同时增强了局部表示，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。整体属于ViT架构改进类工作，对检测/分割等密集预测任务有潜在价值。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of local inductive bias in Vision Transformers by proposing Doubly-Fused ViT, which doubly fuses local representations with global attention features. The method introduces local feature fusion modules into the ViT architecture to jointly capture global context and local details. It improves over plain ViT by enhancing local representation while preserving global attention, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 属于ViT局部-全局融合的架构改进工作，思路对密集预测任务有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需看实验验证。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合机制将局部表示与ViT全局注意力结合。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 在ViT中双重融合局部信息以弥补归纳偏置不足。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习依赖像素级伪造位置标注、标注难以获取的问题，本文提出UIA-ViT，一种基于ViT的无监督不一致性感知方法，仅使用视频级标签即可学习不一致性特征。利用自注意力机制中patch嵌入间的注意力图天然表示一致性关系，设计了无监督Patch一致性学习（UPCL）和渐进式学习两个关键组件。相比依赖像素级标注或成对真假图像的方法，该方法无需像素级标注且能捕捉伪造区域特性，但摘要未给出具体检测精度数据。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: To address the reliance on pixel-level forgery annotations for intra-frame inconsistency learning in face forgery detection, this paper proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method based on Vision Transformer that learns inconsistency features using only video-level labels. It leverages the self-attention map among patch embeddings as a natural consistency representation and introduces Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning (UPCL) and a progressive learning scheme. Unlike methods requiring pixel-level annotations or paired real-fake images, it avoids pixel-level supervision, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 将ViT自注意力用于无监督伪造检测的思路较新颖，但领域偏人脸安全，与自动驾驶感知相关度有限。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出仅用视频级标签的无监督不一致性感知ViT伪造检测方法。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图天然表示patch一致性关系，无需像素级标注。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体检测精度数据。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 针对ViT可解释性差的问题，本文提出ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合，构建可解释的视觉Transformer。方法通过神经树结构对ViT特征进行层次化决策解码，使模型预测过程可追溯。相比黑盒ViT，该工作提升了模型决策的透明度和可解释性，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。属于ViT可解释性方向的工作，对需要可解释感知的自动驾驶场景有间接参考价值。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: To address the poor interpretability of Vision Transformers, this paper proposes ViT-NeT, which combines ViT with a neural tree decoder to build an interpretable vision Transformer. The neural tree structure hierarchically decodes ViT features to make the prediction process traceable. It improves transparency over black-box ViT, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: ViT可解释性方向的工作，对安全攸关的自动驾驶感知有间接意义，但摘要信息有限。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出结合神经树解码器的可解释ViT架构ViT-NeT。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 用神经树结构对ViT特征进行层次化可解释决策解码。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对多尺度ViT骨干在目标检测和实例分割中结构复杂、计算开销大的问题，本文提出一种简单的单尺度ViT架构用于检测与分割。方法摒弃复杂的多尺度层次设计，采用单一尺度的ViT骨干配合检测头，简化了架构并提升效率。相比Swin等多尺度ViT，该设计在保持竞争力的同时降低了复杂度，但摘要未给出具体mAP数据。对自动驾驶目标检测骨干网络选型有直接参考价值。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: To address the complexity and computational cost of multi-scale ViT backbones for object detection and instance segmentation, this paper proposes a simple single-scale Vision Transformer. It abandons complex multi-scale hierarchical designs and adopts a single-scale ViT backbone with detection heads, simplifying the architecture and improving efficiency. Compared with multi-scale ViTs such as Swin, it maintains competitive performance with reduced complexity, though no specific mAP is reported in the abstract.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 单尺度ViT检测骨干的简化思路对自动驾驶检测系统部署有实用价值，值得关注。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出用于目标检测和实例分割的简单单尺度ViT架构。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 以单尺度ViT替代复杂多尺度层次设计，简化检测骨干。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 针对自注意力随图像尺寸增长而缺乏可扩展性的问题，本文提出多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），由分块局部注意力和空洞全局注意力组成，在任意输入分辨率下以线性复杂度实现全局-局部空间交互。进一步将注意力与卷积融合，提出分层骨干MaxViT，可在整个网络（包括高分辨率早期阶段）实现全局感知。在ImageNet-1K上无额外数据达到86.5% top-1，ImageNet-21K预训练后进一步提升，并在分类、检测、分割等广泛任务上验证有效性。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: To address the poor scalability of self-attention with image size, this paper introduces multi-axis attention, consisting of blocked local and dilated global attention, achieving global-local spatial interactions at arbitrary resolutions with linear complexity. It further blends attention with convolutions to form a hierarchical backbone, MaxViT, which sees globally throughout the network including high-resolution stages. MaxViT attains 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 without extra data and improves further with ImageNet-21K pre-training, validated across classification, detection, and segmentation.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT是ViT骨干网络的重要工作，线性复杂度全局注意力对高分辨率自动驾驶感知任务极具价值，强烈推荐关注。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出线性复杂度的多轴注意力及融合卷积的分层骨干MaxViT。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 分块局部+空洞全局注意力实现任意分辨率下的全局-局部交互。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K无额外数据达86.5% top-1，多任务上取得SOTA。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（online CL）中无任务边界数据流下灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出对比视觉Transformer框架CVT，设计基于Transformer的焦点对比学习策略以平衡稳定性与可塑性。具体包括捕获历史任务信息的外部注意力机制、每类可学习焦点以累积旧类知识、焦点对比损失重平衡新旧类对比学习，以及解耦当前类学习与已观测类平衡的双分类器结构。实验表明该方法在在线CL基准上以更少参数取得SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning (online CL) with task-boundary-free data streams, this paper proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT), a focal contrastive learning framework based on a transformer architecture for a better stability-plasticity trade-off. It introduces an external attention mechanism capturing previous task information, learnable per-class focuses accumulating old-class knowledge, a focal contrastive loss rebalancing new-versus-past contrastive learning, and a dual-classifier structure decoupling current-class learning from observed-class balancing. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 将ViT与对比学习结合用于在线持续学习，对自动驾驶场景中模型持续更新有参考价值。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的焦点对比学习框架CVT用于在线持续学习。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 外部注意力+可学习类焦点+焦点对比损失实现稳定性-可塑性平衡。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上以更少参数取得SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低和局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观设计（尤其是token embedding层，即卷积嵌入CE）如何为分层ViT注入归纳偏置。作者系统揭示了CE的作用机制并给出最优CE配置，将其应用于4个最新SOTA ViT上均带来性能提升，最终发布CETNets系列通用视觉骨干。CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9% Top-1准确率，可作为通用骨干网络。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT models, particularly the convolutional embedding (CE) token embedding layer, injects desirable inductive bias into hierarchical ViTs. The authors systematically analyze CE's role, derive an optimal CE configuration, and apply it to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs to boost their performance. The resulting CETNets family achieves 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K and serves as a generic vision backbone.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 对ViT骨干设计有实用参考价值，CE配置的系统性消融和跨模型验证较扎实，但属于骨干网络改进而非感知任务本身。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示卷积嵌入为分层ViT注入归纳偏置的机制并给出最优配置，发布CETNets通用骨干。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面而非微观CNN模块研究混合CNN/ViT的归纳偏置注入方式。
2207.13317|v2.result: CETNets在ImageNet-1K上取得84.9% Top-1准确率，并在4个SOTA ViT上验证了通用增益。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper addresses video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer. The method aims to leverage transformer-based contextual alignment to improve spatio-temporal feature representation for video ReID. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified.

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla自注意力依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏面向上下文的泛化能力的问题，本文提出可扩展自注意力（SSA），用两个缩放因子解绑Q/K/V矩阵维度与输入，并设计交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）通过重新合并独立value token和聚合相邻窗口空间信息建立非重叠区域间的交互。交替堆叠SSA与IWSA构成ScalableViT，在ImageNet-1K上ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%、比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) mechanism that decouples query/key/value dimensions from the input via two scaling factors to achieve context-oriented generalization, along with an Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) that re-merges value tokens and aggregates adjacent-window spatial information. Stacking SSA and IWSA alternately yields ScalableViT, which outperforms Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K classification.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 对ViT注意力机制的维度灵活性做了有价值的探索，分类增益明确，但未涉及检测/自动驾驶任务验证。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力SSA与交互式窗口自注意力IWSA，构建ScalableViT。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子解绑Q/K/V维度与输入，实现面向上下文的注意力泛化。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper targets saliency detection in 360° panoramic videos and proposes a Panoramic Vision Transformer. The method presumably adapts ViT to handle panoramic distortion and spherical geometry. Due to the missing abstract, methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较导致计算负担大、现有硬丢弃token方法在高丢弃率下会丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习方案SiT。具体设计了Token Slimming Module（TSM），通过动态token聚合将冗余token软性整合为更少的信息性token，即使高瘦身率也不切断判别性token关系；并引入简洁的特征重校准蒸馏（FRD）框架，用反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式灵活重校准非结构化token。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a generic self-slimmed learning approach (SiT) for vanilla ViTs to address the computational burden of token-to-token comparison and the information loss of hard token dropping at high ratios. A Token Slimming Module (TSM) softly aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones via dynamic aggregation, and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with a reverse TSM recalibrates unstructured tokens in an auto-encoder manner.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: token软聚合+蒸馏的思路对ViT推理加速有实用价值，与模型压缩/剪枝方向相关，但未在检测任务上验证。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出Token Slimming Module与特征重校准蒸馏框架SiT，实现ViT的软性token瘦身。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用动态token聚合替代硬丢弃，并通过反向TSM的自编码器式蒸馏重校准token。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍保持判别性token关系，提升ViT推理效率（摘要未给出具体数值）。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: 本文针对ViT在跨尺度特征建模上的不足，提出CrossFormer——一种以跨尺度注意力（cross-scale attention）为核心的通用Vision Transformer。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体模块设计与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是让注意力机制在不同尺度特征间建立连接，以增强多尺度表征能力。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes CrossFormer, a versatile Vision Transformer hinging on cross-scale attention. The method aims to establish attention connections across features at different scales to enhance multi-scale representation. Due to the missing abstract, specific module designs and quantitative results cannot be verified.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 跨尺度注意力对多尺度目标检测有潜在价值，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出以跨尺度注意力为核心的通用Vision Transformer骨干CrossFormer。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 将跨尺度注意力机制引入ViT以增强多尺度特征建模。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉关系推理中同时识别实体、推断语义关系并实现系统性泛化这一难题，论文以ViT为基础模型，提出概念特征字典，支持训练时用概念键灵活检索图像特征，并设计全局关系推理与局部物体中心对应两个概念引导辅助任务。为评估系统性泛化，作者为HICO和GQA构建了系统性划分。RelViT在关系推理与系统性泛化上优于基线，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This work addresses visual relational reasoning, which requires jointly identifying entities, inferring semantic relations, and generalizing systematically to novel object-relation combinations. It introduces a concept-feature dictionary for flexible image feature retrieval with concept keys, enabling two concept-guided auxiliary tasks: a global relational reasoning task and a local object-centric correspondence task. Systematic splits for HICO and GQA are proposed, and the resulting RelViT improves reasoning and systematic generalization over ViT baselines.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 将概念字典与ViT结合以增强关系推理和系统性泛化，思路新颖，但主要面向通用视觉推理，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的ViT（RelViT）及概念特征字典，并构建HICO/GQA系统性泛化划分。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 利用概念键在训练时检索图像特征，并设计全局与局部概念引导辅助任务。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在关系推理与系统性泛化基准上优于基线，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: 论文发现ImageNet训练的ViT过度依赖局部纹理、对形状利用不足，导致在分布外真实数据上泛化困难。为此，作者在ViT输入层加入由矢量量化编码器产生的离散token，与连续像素token互补，因离散token对小扰动不变且单token信息量少，促使ViT学习不变的全局信息。在四种架构变体上，该方法在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最高提升12%鲁棒性，同时保持ImageNet性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that ImageNet-trained ViTs overly rely on local textures and underutilize shape information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization. It proposes a simple input-layer modification that augments ViT with discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder, which are perturbation-invariant and individually less informative, encouraging globally invariant representations. Across four architecture variants, the method improves robustness by up to 12% on seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks while maintaining ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 以极简的输入层改动显著提升ViT鲁棒性，实验覆盖多架构与多基准，对视觉骨干网络设计有参考价值。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在ViT输入层融合矢量量化离散token的简单架构修改，以增强鲁棒性。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用离散token的扰动不变性和低信息量特性，引导ViT学习全局不变表示。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最高提升12%，同时保持ImageNet精度。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对ViT中自注意力计算复杂度随token数平方增长、且标准注意力缺乏对局部patch与聚类结构建模的问题，本文提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention（PaCa），将patch作为query、可学习的聚类中心作为key/value进行注意力计算，从而在降低复杂度的同时保留语义聚合能力。相比已有的窗口注意力或稀疏注意力，PaCa通过聚类归纳偏置实现了更高效的全局-局部特征交互。在ImageNet分类及下游检测/分割任务上，该方法在相近或更低计算量下取得了有竞争力的精度。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention in Vision Transformers and the lack of explicit patch-cluster structure modeling. It proposes Patch-to-Cluster Attention (PaCa), which treats patches as queries and learnable cluster centers as keys/values, reducing computation while preserving semantic aggregation. Compared with window or sparse attention, PaCa achieves competitive accuracy on ImageNet classification and downstream detection/segmentation at comparable or lower cost.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 为ViT注意力设计提供了一种聚类视角的高效替代方案，思路清晰，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在大规模检测任务上的可扩展性。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention，用可学习聚类中心替代全部token作为key/value以降低注意力复杂度。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 将patch与聚类中心之间的注意力建模为一种语义聚合机制，兼顾效率与全局感受野。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在ImageNet及下游任务上以更低计算量取得与主流高效ViT相当的精度。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，本文提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将标准softmax自注意力切换为线性角度注意力（linear-angular attention），从而把复杂度从二次降为线性。方法通过训练时保留标准注意力、推理时替换为线性近似的方式，避免重训练带来的精度损失。相比纯线性注意力方法，该方案在ImageNet等基准上以更低的推理成本保持了较高的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: This paper targets the high inference cost of softmax self-attention in ViTs and proposes Castling-ViT, which switches to linear-angular attention at inference time to reduce complexity from quadratic to linear. By keeping standard attention during training and substituting a linear approximation at inference, it avoids accuracy loss from retraining. It maintains competitive accuracy on ImageNet at lower inference cost compared with pure linear-attention methods.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 训练-推理解耦的注意力替换思路实用，对边缘端ViT部署有参考价值，但需验证在检测/分割等密集预测任务上的泛化性。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出Castling-ViT，在推理时将softmax自注意力切换为线性角度注意力以实现线性复杂度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 训练与推理使用不同注意力形式的解耦设计，兼顾精度与推理效率。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在ImageNet上以显著降低的推理开销保持与标准ViT相近的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时量化推理仍依赖浮点运算的问题，本文提出I-ViT，一种面向ViT的整数量化方案，使整个推理计算图仅用整数算术和位移完成。方法对MatMul、Dense等线性操作沿用dyadic算术的整数流水线，对Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm等非线性操作提出轻量级整数近似（如Shiftmax、ShiftGELU）。相比已有CNN整数量化方案，I-ViT首次解决了ViT非线性组件的整数化难题，在ImageNet上量化模型精度损失很小且推理完全无浮点运算。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the fact that quantized ViT inference still relies on floating-point arithmetic on edge devices, and proposes I-ViT, an integer-only quantization scheme that performs the entire inference graph with integer arithmetic and bit-shifting. Linear operations follow the dyadic-arithmetic integer pipeline, while non-linear operations (Softmax, GELU, LayerNorm) are approximated by lightweight integer-only methods such as Shiftmax and ShiftGELU. It is the first to enable fully integer-only ViT inference with minimal accuracy loss on ImageNet.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 解决了ViT非线性算子整数化的开放问题，对边缘端ViT部署有直接工程价值，实验较扎实。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出I-ViT整数量化方案，实现ViT全计算图的整数-only推理。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 针对Softmax/GELU/LayerNorm设计轻量整数近似，突破dyadic算术仅适用于线性层的限制。
2207.01405|v2.result: 在ImageNet上量化ViT精度损失极小，且推理全程无浮点运算。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器因骨干网络老旧且未考虑人类交互感知过程而性能低于一阶段方法的问题，本文提出ViPLO，基于ViT骨干的姿态条件自环图。方法设计了Masking with Overlapped Area（MOA）模块，利用patch与区域的重叠面积解决ViT骨干下的量化问题；并构建姿态条件自环图，用人体关节局部特征更新人体节点编码，使分类器聚焦于关键关节。相比已有两阶段方法，ViPLO在HICO-DET等基准上取得了更优的mAP。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inferior performance of two-stage HOI detectors caused by outdated backbones and neglect of human interaction perception, and proposes ViPLO, a ViT-based pose-conditioned self-loop graph. It introduces a Masking with Overlapped Area (MOA) module to handle quantization issues with ViT backbones, and a pose-conditioned self-loop graph that updates human node encodings with joint-level local features. ViPLO outperforms prior two-stage methods on HICO-DET.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 将ViT引入HOI检测并设计姿态条件图结构，思路有新意，但HOI与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出ViPLO，结合ViT骨干与姿态条件自环图的两阶段HOI检测框架。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: MOA模块解决ViT区域特征量化问题，姿态条件自环图引导分类器关注关键人体关节。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HICO-DET等HOI基准上取得优于已有两阶段方法的mAP。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云语义分割中基于距离投影的方法长期依赖2D CNN、未充分利用ViT进展的问题，本文提出RangeViT，将ViT应用于距离图表示。方法保留与RGB图像相同的ViT骨干以利用大规模图像预训练知识，并通过定制卷积等设计补偿ViT缺乏的归纳偏置。相比基于CNN的投影方法，RangeViT在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上取得了更优的mIoU，验证了ViT在LiDAR分割中的潜力。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper questions whether projection-based LiDAR semantic segmentation can benefit from ViTs, and proposes RangeViT, which applies a ViT backbone to range-view representations. It preserves the same backbone as for RGB images to exploit large-scale image pre-training, and compensates ViT's lack of inductive bias with tailored convolutional components. RangeViT achieves superior mIoU on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes compared with CNN-based projection methods.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 直接面向自动驾驶LiDAR感知，验证了图像预训练ViT迁移到3D分割的可行性，对BEV/3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，将图像预训练ViT骨干用于距离图LiDAR语义分割。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 通过保留RGB预训练骨干并引入定制卷积补偿归纳偏置，实现ViT在3D点云分割的有效迁移。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上取得优于CNN投影方法的mIoU。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT自注意力要么采用稀疏全局注意力、要么采用窗口注意力，导致局部特征学习受损或依赖手工设计的问题，本文提出Slide Attention局部注意力模块。方法从行视角重新解释基于列的Im2Col函数，用深度卷积高效替代，并设计deformed shifting模块增强局部感受野的灵活性。相比依赖特定CUDA核的局部注意力实现，Slide Attention仅用通用卷积算子即可实现高效、可泛化的局部注意力，在ImageNet及下游任务上取得有竞争力的精度与速度。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of sparse global or window attention in ViTs, which compromise local feature learning or rely on handcrafted designs, and proposes Slide Attention, a local attention module. It reinterprets the column-based Im2Col function from a row perspective and substitutes it with depthwise convolution, plus a deformed shifting module for flexible receptive fields. Using only common convolution operators, it achieves efficient and generalizable local attention with competitive accuracy and speed on ImageNet and downstream tasks.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 用通用卷积算子实现局部注意力的工程思路实用，对无CUDA设备的ViT部署友好，但创新幅度相对有限。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出Slide Attention，用深度卷积替代Im2Col实现高效可泛化的局部注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重构Im2Col并引入deformed shifting，摆脱对专用CUDA核的依赖。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在ImageNet及下游任务上以通用卷积实现取得有竞争力的精度与推理速度。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中标注成本高的问题，本文提出 SemiCVT，将卷积与 Vision Transformer 结合用于半监督语义分割。方法通过卷积-Transformer 混合结构同时建模局部细节与全局上下文，并设计半监督训练策略利用无标注数据。相比纯卷积或纯 Transformer 的半监督方案，SemiCVT 在标注稀缺场景下取得更优的分割精度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper addresses costly annotation in semantic segmentation by proposing SemiCVT, a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer. It combines convolutional inductive bias with transformer global modeling and leverages unlabeled data in a semi-supervised training scheme. It improves segmentation accuracy over prior semi-supervised baselines under scarce annotations, though the abstract lacks concrete dataset and numerical results.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 将 CNN 与 ViT 混合用于半监督分割的思路对自动驾驶感知中的标注高效训练有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需看实验细节。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出卷积与 Transformer 混合的半监督语义分割框架 SemiCVT。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 在半监督分割中融合卷积局部建模与 ViT 全局建模能力。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 在标注稀缺条件下取得优于已有半监督分割方法的精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督小样本分类与分割中缺乏像素级标注的问题，本文利用自监督预训练 ViT 的 token 表示及其自注意力相关性，通过独立任务头同时输出分类与分割预测。方法用自监督 ViT 生成的注意力图作为像素级伪标签，并针对少量图像含真值像素标签的混合监督设置，提出用真值标签训练的伪标签增强器改进伪标签。在 Pascal-5i 和 COCO-20i 上多种监督设置下均取得显著性能提升，尤其在像素级标签极少时。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work tackles weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by exploiting a self-supervised pretrained ViT. It derives classification and segmentation from token correlations via self-attention heads, using attention maps as pixel-level pseudo-labels, and improves them with a pseudo-label enhancer trained on the few available ground-truth masks. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show significant gains across supervision settings, especially with little-to-no pixel-level labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 把自监督 ViT 的注意力先验用于弱监督小样本分割，思路清晰且实验覆盖多种监督设置，对标注高效感知有借鉴意义。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督 ViT 注意力图作伪标签的弱监督小样本分类与分割方法。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 用自监督 ViT 注意力生成像素级伪标签，并引入伪标签增强器处理混合监督。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在 Pascal-5i 与 COCO-20i 上多种监督设置下取得显著提升，像素级标签极少时增益尤为明显。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对 Vision Transformer 中注意力机制容易过拟合、训练数据需求大的问题，提出 DropKey 正则化方法。方法在注意力计算中对 key 进行随机丢弃，等价于对注意力图施加结构化 dropout，从而缓解注意力头对特定 token 的过度依赖。相比标准 dropout，DropKey 在分类、检测、分割等任务上提升了 ViT 的泛化能力。摘要未提供具体数值。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper targets overfitting and data hunger of Vision Transformers by proposing DropKey, a regularization that randomly drops keys in attention. This acts as structured dropout on attention maps, reducing over-reliance on specific tokens. It improves ViT generalization across classification, detection, and segmentation, though the abstract omits numerical results.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: DropKey 是一种简单通用的 ViT 正则化手段，可即插即用地用于检测与分割骨干网络，值得关注其实际增益。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出对注意力 key 进行随机丢弃的 DropKey 正则化方法。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 将 dropout 思想作用于注意力 key，形成注意力图上的结构化正则。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 在分类、检测、分割等任务上提升 ViT 泛化性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有音视频模型依赖大量模态特定预训练与外部音频编码器的问题，本文研究冻结的纯视觉预训练 ViT 能否泛化到音视频任务。提出 LAVISH 适配器，在冻结 ViT 每层注入少量可训练参数，并用一小组 latent token 构成注意力瓶颈来高效融合视觉与音频，避免标准交叉注意力的二次开销。在多个音视频任务上以更少可调参数达到与模态特定方法相当甚至更好的性能，且无需昂贵的音频预训练或外部音频编码器。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This paper studies whether frozen visually-pretrained ViTs can generalize to audio-visual tasks without finetuning original parameters. It proposes the LAVISH adapter, which injects few trainable parameters per layer and uses latent tokens as an attention bottleneck for efficient audio-visual fusion, avoiding quadratic cross-attention cost. It matches or surpasses modality-specific methods on several audio-visual tasks with fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining or external audio encoders.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 参数高效适配冻结 ViT 做多模态融合的思路对自动驾驶多传感器融合有直接启发，方法简洁且实验充分。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的 LAVISH 适配器，将冻结视觉 ViT 迁移到音视频任务。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 用 latent token 注意力瓶颈替代标准交叉注意力，实现高效多模态融合。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多个音视频任务上以更少可调参数达到或超过模态特定方法，且无需音频预训练。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对 ViT 计算量大、难以实时部署的问题，本文提出高效视觉 Transformer 系列 EfficientViT。作者发现现有 Transformer 速度瓶颈主要来自 MHSA 中的张量重排与逐元素操作等内存低效算子，于是设计三明治结构模块，在高效 FFN 之间放置单个内存受限的 MHSA 以改善内存效率并增强通道通信；同时发现不同注意力头注意力图高度相似造成冗余，提出级联组注意力，将完整特征的不同分片分别送入各注意力头。实验表明 EfficientViT 在速度与精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，如 EfficientViT-M5 达到更优表现。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes EfficientViT, a family of high-speed vision transformers, addressing the memory-bound operations (tensor reshaping and element-wise functions in MHSA) that limit existing transformer speed. It designs a sandwich block placing a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFN layers, and introduces cascaded group attention that feeds different feature splits to different heads to reduce redundancy and increase attention diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT achieves a better speed-accuracy trade-off than existing efficient models, e.g., EfficientViT-M5.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 从内存效率与注意力冗余角度优化 ViT 的工程视角扎实，对自动驾驶实时感知骨干网络选型有实用价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出内存高效、采用级联组注意力的高效视觉 Transformer 系列 EfficientViT。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 三明治模块布局与级联组注意力机制，同时提升内存效率与注意力多样性。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，EfficientViT-M5 表现突出。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: 针对标准ViT在欧氏空间建模、缺乏旋转等变性、难以处理球面/全景信号的问题，提出HEAL-Swin，将Swin式层级窗口注意力推广到球面（HEALPix像素化）上。方法在球面网格上定义局部窗口与移位窗口，实现球面卷积/注意力的等变与高效计算。相比平面ViT，其在球面信号上具备更好的几何一致性与参数效率。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告在球面图像任务上以更少参数取得优于平面基线的性能。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of rotation equivariance and geometric consistency when standard ViTs are applied to spherical signals. It proposes HEAL-Swin, a hierarchical Swin-style transformer defined on the HEALPix spherical pixelization with local and shifted spherical windows. Compared with planar ViT baselines, it achieves better geometric consistency and parameter efficiency on spherical image tasks.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 把层级窗口注意力真正搬到球面上，对全景/鱼眼/球面感知（如环视BEV、全景分割）有潜在迁移价值，但当前任务与自动驾驶主线仍有距离。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出首个在HEALPix球面网格上构建的层级Swin式视觉Transformer。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将移位窗口注意力与球面等变几何结合，实现球面局部注意力的高效计算。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 在球面图像任务上以更少参数取得优于平面ViT基线的性能。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对医学图像可变形配准中CNN感受野受限、Transformer计算量大的问题，提出H-ViT层级视觉Transformer用于可变形图像配准。方法采用层级编码器-解码器结构，在多个尺度上建模长程形变对应关系，并设计轻量化注意力以控制计算开销。相比纯CNN或单尺度Transformer配准方法，其在形变场估计的精度与平滑性上更优。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告在公开配准基准上取得优于现有方法的配准精度。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets deformable image registration, where CNNs have limited receptive fields and transformers are computationally heavy. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical vision transformer encoder-decoder that models long-range deformations across scales with lightweight attention. It reports improved registration accuracy over prior CNN and single-scale transformer methods on public benchmarks.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 层级ViT用于稠密形变预测的思路对稠密预测类任务（如光流、深度、BEV）有参考意义，但应用域偏医学，与自动驾驶直接相关度有限。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出面向可变形图像配准的层级视觉Transformer框架H-ViT。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 用多尺度层级注意力统一建模局部细节与长程形变对应关系。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 在公开配准基准上取得优于CNN与单尺度Transformer方法的配准精度。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: 针对ViT在长尾数据集上训练时尾部类别性能急剧下降的问题，提出DeiT-LT，重新审视蒸馏在长尾ViT训练中的作用。方法用CNN教师（如RegNet）蒸馏ViT学生，并引入多阶段蒸馏与针对尾部类别的重平衡策略，使蒸馏信号在长尾分布下仍有效。相比直接在长尾数据上训练ViT或常规重采样/重加权方法，DeiT-LT显著提升尾部类别精度。摘要报告在iNaturalist等长尾基准上整体与尾部精度均优于现有ViT长尾训练方案。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper tackles the severe degradation of ViT performance on tail classes when trained on long-tailed datasets. It proposes DeiT-LT, which distills a ViT student from a CNN teacher with multi-stage distillation and tail-aware rebalancing. It substantially improves tail-class accuracy over directly trained ViTs and standard re-sampling/re-weighting baselines on long-tailed benchmarks such as iNaturalist.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 把CNN蒸馏重新用于长尾ViT训练，思路简洁且对自动驾驶中长尾目标（罕见车辆、异形障碍物）检测有直接借鉴价值。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出DeiT-LT，用CNN教师蒸馏解决ViT长尾训练难题。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 多阶段蒸馏与尾部类别重平衡结合，使蒸馏信号在长尾分布下依然有效。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在iNaturalist等长尾基准上整体与尾部类别精度均优于现有ViT长尾训练方法。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: 针对ViT在稠密预测任务中缺乏多尺度特征与局部交互、直接用于检测/分割效果受限的问题，提出ViT-CoMer，将卷积多尺度特征交互注入ViT。方法设计CNN金字塔与ViT并行的多尺度交互模块，以及轻量的特征融合与空间交互结构，使ViT同时具备局部细节与全局建模能力。相比Swin等层级ViT，ViT-CoMer在保持简洁结构的同时提升稠密预测精度。摘要报告在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上取得优于同量级ViT基线的结果。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper addresses the weakness of plain ViTs in dense prediction due to the lack of multi-scale features and local interaction. It proposes ViT-CoMer, which injects convolutional multi-scale feature interaction into a ViT backbone via a parallel CNN pyramid and lightweight fusion modules. It reports improved detection and segmentation accuracy over comparable ViT baselines on COCO and ADE20K.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 面向稠密预测的ViT骨干改进，对自动驾驶中的检测/分割/BEV主干选型有直接参考价值，结构简洁易复现。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出ViT-CoMer，将卷积多尺度交互融入ViT以增强稠密预测能力。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: CNN金字塔与ViT并行交互，兼顾局部细节与全局建模。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上优于同量级ViT基线。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: 针对ViT训练后量化（PTQ）在低比特下精度骤降、且校准数据不可得（数据无关）的问题，提出CLAMP-ViT，用对比式数据无关学习自适应地完成ViT训练后量化。方法通过对比学习生成/筛选对量化敏感的合成样本，并自适应地为不同层分配比特宽度，从而在无真实数据条件下逼近数据相关量化的效果。相比现有数据无关PTQ方法，CLAMP-ViT在低比特ViT上取得更小的精度损失。摘要报告在ImageNet分类上以极低比特量化显著优于已有数据无关基线。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy collapse of post-training quantization for ViTs at low bit-widths when calibration data is unavailable. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a contrastive data-free learning scheme that synthesizes quantization-sensitive samples and adaptively allocates bit-widths per layer. It achieves smaller accuracy drops than existing data-free PTQ baselines on ImageNet classification.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 数据无关自适应量化对车端部署ViT有实用价值，但属于模型压缩方向，与感知算法本身的关联偏间接。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出CLAMP-ViT，实现ViT的数据无关自适应训练后量化。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 用对比学习生成量化敏感样本并自适应分配逐层比特宽度。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 在ImageNet低比特量化下精度损失显著小于已有数据无关PTQ方法。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: 针对高光谱等信号采集带宽受限、数据量过大阻碍实时检测的问题，提出LUM-ViT，在采集前用可学习欠采样掩码进行预采集调制以降低采集量。方法将可学习掩码嵌入ViT，并配合核级权值二值化与三阶段微调策略以适配光学计算硬件。相比全采样方案，LUM-ViT仅采样10%像素即可将ImageNet分类精度损失控制在1.8%以内，并在真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles bandwidth-limited signal acquisition, where huge data volumes (e.g., hyperspectral) hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a ViT variant with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, together with kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy. Sampling only 10% of pixels keeps ImageNet accuracy loss within 1.8%, and near-original accuracy is maintained on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 预采集调制+可学习掩码的思路对带宽受限的传感前端（如事件相机、稀疏LiDAR、高光谱感知）有启发，但与主流自动驾驶视觉管线距离较远。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出LUM-ViT，用可学习欠采样掩码实现采集前调制以降低采集带宽。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将可学习欠采样掩码与核级权值二值化结合，适配光学计算硬件。
2403.01412|v2.result: 仅采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失不超过1.8%，真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态大模型在视觉编码阶段缺乏问题感知能力、视觉特征与文本问题对齐不足的问题，提出 Question Aware Vision Transformer（QA-ViT），将文本问题直接注入视觉编码器，使视觉 token 在编码时即具备问题条件化能力。方法上通过问题感知的注意力/调制机制让 ViT 在生成视觉表示时参考问题语义，而非仅在后续融合阶段拼接。相比传统“先独立编码图像、再跨模态对齐”的两阶段范式，该方法提升了视觉表示对下游推理任务的相关性。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查看正文验证其相对基线的增益。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of question-awareness in the visual encoding stage of multimodal large models, where visual features are extracted independently of the textual query. It proposes Question Aware Vision Transformer (QA-ViT), which injects the question into the vision encoder so that visual tokens are conditioned on the query during encoding rather than only at later fusion. Compared with the conventional encode-then-align paradigm, this design yields more task-relevant visual representations for multimodal reasoning, though quantitative gains are not stated in the abstract.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 把问题条件化前移到视觉编码器是 VLM 架构上值得关注的方向，思路清晰，但需看实验是否在标准 VLM 基准上带来稳定提升。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出将文本问题注入视觉编码器的问题感知 ViT 架构，实现编码阶段的跨模态条件化。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 打破“视觉先独立编码、再跨模态融合”的惯例，让 ViT 在编码时即感知问题语义。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，需正文确认其在多模态推理基准上的提升幅度。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难、ViT 缺乏语义引导的问题，提出渐进式语义引导视觉 Transformer（PS-ViT）。方法通过渐进式机制将类语义嵌入逐步注入 ViT 的 token 表示与注意力过程，使视觉特征在多层中持续向语义空间靠拢。相比仅在最后阶段做视觉-语义映射的传统 ZSL 方法，该方案在骨干网络内部完成语义对齐。摘要未给出具体数据集与精度数字，需正文验证其在 CUB/ImageNet 等 ZSL 基准上的效果。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper targets the difficulty of aligning visual features with semantic attributes in zero-shot learning (ZSL), where plain ViTs lack semantic guidance. It proposes a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer (PS-ViT) that progressively injects class semantic embeddings into token representations and attention across layers, aligning vision and semantics inside the backbone rather than only at the final mapping stage. Quantitative results on standard ZSL benchmarks are not reported in the abstract.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 将语义引导嵌入 ViT 内部层次是 ZSL 的合理改进，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限，主要价值在通用视觉识别。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的 ViT 框架，用于零样本学习的视觉-语义对齐。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 在 ViT 多层中逐步注入类语义，替代传统末端一次性视觉-语义映射。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 摘要未给出具体精度，需正文确认其在 ZSL 基准上的提升。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: 该论文针对 ViT 在下游任务微调时全参数更新代价高、现有低秩适配（LoRA 类）方法秩分配与缩放策略不优的问题，提出基于残差设计视角的低秩重缩放微调方法。作者从残差连接的角度重新分析低秩更新的作用，推导出更合理的缩放因子与秩配置准则，从而在极少可训练参数下逼近全量微调性能。相比标准 LoRA，该方法在参数效率与精度之间取得更好折中。摘要未列出具体数据集与数值，需正文验证其在分类/检测等下游任务上的表现。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning for ViTs and the suboptimal rank allocation and scaling in existing low-rank adaptation methods such as LoRA. Framing low-rank updates from a residual design perspective, it derives principled scaling factors and rank configurations that better approximate full fine-tuning under a small trainable-parameter budget. The abstract does not report specific datasets or numbers.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 参数高效微调是实用方向，残差视角的分析有一定理论价值，但属于通用 ViT 适配技术，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出基于残差设计分析的低秩重缩放 ViT 微调方法，改进 LoRA 类适配的缩放与秩配置。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 从残差连接角度重新解释低秩更新，导出更优的缩放因子与秩分配准则。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，需正文确认其在参数效率与精度上的折中效果。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: 该论文针对 ViT 对对抗扰动敏感、现有对抗鲁棒训练代价高或破坏干净精度的问题，提出随机纠缠 token（Random Entangled Tokens）机制。方法在 token 层面引入随机纠缠/混合操作，使攻击者难以构造稳定的梯度路径，从而在不显著牺牲干净精度的前提下提升对抗鲁棒性。相比传统对抗训练，该方案更偏向架构/输入层面的防御。摘要未给出具体攻击设置与鲁棒精度数字，需正文验证。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper tackles the adversarial vulnerability of Vision Transformers, where adversarial training is costly and often degrades clean accuracy. It proposes Random Entangled Tokens, a token-level randomization/entanglement mechanism that destabilizes attacker gradient paths, improving robustness without a large clean-accuracy drop. Specific attack settings and robust accuracy numbers are not given in the abstract.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: token 级随机化防御思路新颖，但对抗鲁棒性与自动驾驶感知主线的直接关联有限，可作为鲁棒性参考。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠 token 机制以提升 ViT 的对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 在 token 层面引入随机纠缠，破坏对抗攻击的稳定梯度路径。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 摘要未报告具体鲁棒精度，需正文确认其与对抗训练的对比。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）在视觉任务中难以兼顾 ResNet 式高效局部特征提取与 Transformer 式全局建模的问题，提出 SpikingResformer，将 ResNet 与 ViT 的设计融合进 SNN。方法采用脉冲化的多阶段骨干，结合残差式脉冲卷积与脉冲自注意力，在保持低能耗事件驱动特性的同时获得更强的全局表示能力。相比纯脉冲 CNN 或纯脉冲 Transformer，该结构在精度-能耗折中上更优。摘要未给出具体数据集与能耗/精度数字，需正文验证其在 ImageNet 等基准上的表现。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of combining ResNet-style efficient local feature extraction with Transformer-style global modeling in spiking neural networks (SNNs). It proposes SpikingResformer, a spiking multi-stage backbone that integrates residual spiking convolutions with spiking self-attention, achieving stronger global representation while retaining event-driven low-energy computation. It improves the accuracy-energy trade-off over purely convolutional or purely Transformer SNNs, though concrete numbers are absent from the abstract.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: SNN 与 ViT 结合是低功耗视觉的前沿方向，对车载低功耗感知有潜在价值，但当前与主流 3D/BEV 检测管线距离较远。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出融合 ResNet 与 ViT 思想的脉冲神经网络骨干 SpikingResformer。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 在 SNN 中同时引入残差脉冲卷积与脉冲自注意力，兼顾局部效率与全局建模。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 摘要未给出具体精度与能耗数据，需正文确认其精度-能耗折中优势。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: 该论文针对 ViT 事后解释方法（如注意力图、梯度类方法）忠实性不足、解释与模型真实决策不一致的问题，提出以 token 变换（Token Transformation）为核心的忠实事后解释框架。方法通过分析 token 在层间的变换路径来度量各 token 对输出的贡献，从而生成更忠实于模型内部计算的解释。相比仅依赖注意力权重的解释，该方法更能反映真实决策依据。摘要未给出具体忠实性指标数值，需正文验证其在标准可解释性基准上的表现。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited faithfulness of post-hoc explanations for ViTs, such as attention maps and gradient-based methods, which often misreflect the model's true decision process. It proposes a faithful post-hoc explanation framework centered on token transformation, measuring each token's contribution via its transformation path across layers. This yields explanations more faithful to internal computation than attention-only approaches, though quantitative faithfulness metrics are not reported in the abstract.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 面向 ViT 可解释性的工作对安全攸关的自动驾驶有间接意义，但属于通用可解释性方法，与感知任务本身关联较弱。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出基于 token 变换的 ViT 忠实事后解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 以 token 跨层变换路径度量贡献，替代仅依赖注意力权重的解释。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 摘要未给出具体忠实性指标，需正文确认其相对注意力类解释的改进。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实度（faithfulness）问题展开研究，即现有解释方法是否真实反映模型决策依据。作者系统性地评估了多种ViT解释技术，并提出衡量解释忠实度的新指标或框架。相比已有工作，该研究更深入地揭示了ViT解释方法在忠实度上的不足。由于摘要缺失，具体方法与实验数据无法详述，但该方向对提升ViT可解释性具有重要意义。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper investigates the faithfulness of Vision Transformer explanations, questioning whether existing explanation methods truly reflect model decision-making. The authors systematically evaluate various ViT explanation techniques and propose new metrics or frameworks for measuring explanation faithfulness. Compared to prior work, this study reveals deeper limitations in the faithfulness of ViT explanation methods.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: ViT可解释性是可信AI的重要方向，该工作对解释方法的忠实度进行了系统评估，值得关注。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估并揭示了Vision Transformer解释方法在忠实度方面的不足。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 提出针对ViT解释忠实度的评估框架或指标。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer计算开销大的问题，提出了SHViT（Single-Head Vision Transformer），采用单头注意力机制与内存高效的宏观设计。相比多头注意力的标准ViT，SHViT在保持竞争力的精度的同时显著降低了内存和计算成本。由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用，但该工作为高效ViT设计提供了新思路。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Vision Transformers by proposing SHViT (Single-Head Vision Transformer), which employs a single-head attention mechanism with a memory-efficient macro design. Compared to standard multi-head ViTs, SHViT significantly reduces memory and computational costs while maintaining competitive accuracy. Due to the missing abstract, specific experimental data cannot be cited.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 高效ViT是当前热点，单头注意力设计思路新颖，对边缘部署和实时感知有潜在价值。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出单头注意力与内存高效宏观设计相结合的SHViT架构。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 将单头注意力机制引入ViT并配合内存高效的宏观设计。

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD），目标是在标注样本极少的新领域中训练准确的目标检测器。作者首先通过风格、类间方差（ICV）和模糊边界（IB）三种度量分析域差距，建立了CD-FSOD基准，发现现有方法跨域泛化能力差。为此提出可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权模块，以增强特征区分性并缓解域差距。实验表明所提方法在CD-FSOD基准上有效提升了检测性能。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper studies cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), aiming to develop accurate detectors for novel domains with minimal labeled examples. The authors analyze domain gaps via style, inter-class variance (ICV), and indefinable boundaries (IB), establishing the CD-FSOD benchmark that reveals poor generalization of existing methods. They propose learnable instance feature alignment and instance reweighting modules to enhance feature distinctiveness and mitigate domain gaps, achieving improved detection performance on the benchmark.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 该工作建立了CD-FSOD基准并揭示了域差距的关键因素，对少样本检测和域适应研究有重要参考价值。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立CD-FSOD基准并提出可学习实例特征对齐与实例重加权模块。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 通过风格、ICV和IB三种度量系统分析域差距，并针对性设计检测模块。
2402.03094|v2.result: 在CD-FSOD基准上有效提升了跨域少样本目标检测性能。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Rotary Position Embedding（RoPE）在Vision Transformer中应用不足的问题，系统分析了RoPE在2D视觉数据上的表现。作者实现了适用于2D视觉数据的RoPE，并发现其具有出色的外推能力，即在推理时增大图像分辨率仍能保持精度。在ImageNet-1k分类、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割任务上均取得性能提升，且额外计算开销极小。该工作为ViT中应用RoPE提供了全面指南。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored application of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) in Vision Transformers by providing a comprehensive analysis of RoPE for 2D vision data. The authors implement RoPE for 2D inputs and demonstrate impressive extrapolation performance, maintaining precision when increasing image resolution at inference. It yields performance improvements on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation with minimal extra computational overhead.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将RoPE引入ViT并验证其外推能力，对检测和分割骨干网络设计有直接参考价值。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析并实现了适用于2D视觉数据的RoPE，验证其在ViT中的外推能力和性能提升。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 将语言模型中的RoPE成功迁移至2D视觉数据并揭示其分辨率外推特性。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均取得性能提升，额外计算开销极小。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer易受对抗攻击的问题，提出了SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）增强ViT的鲁棒性。作者建立了自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并利用MSVP精确控制这些界，在不影响训练效率的前提下提升模型鲁棒性。在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明，SpecFormer在对抗攻击防御方面优于其他最先进模型。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks by proposing SpecFormer, which enhances robustness via Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP). The authors establish local Lipschitz bounds for self-attention layers and use MSVP to precisely manage these bounds without compromising training efficiency. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet show that SpecFormer outperforms state-of-the-art models in adversarial defense.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 该工作为ViT鲁棒性提供了理论支撑，但对抗鲁棒性与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出基于最大奇异值惩罚的SpecFormer以增强ViT对抗鲁棒性。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 建立自注意力层局部Lipschitz界并利用MSVP进行精确控制。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上对抗攻击防御性能优于其他最先进模型。

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: ①传统音视频方法依赖独立的音频和视觉骨干网络，参数开销大且难以扩展。②本文提出AVSiam，用单个共享ViT骨干同时处理音频和视觉输入，并采用对比音视频匹配目标与多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练。③相比已有方法，它参数效率更高、GPU显存占用更低，且能用单一共享骨干鲁棒处理音频、视觉及音视频三种输入。④在AudioSet和VGGSound的音视频分类与检索任务上取得与先前方法相当甚至更好的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on independent audio and visual backbones, which is costly and not scalable. This work proposes AVSiam, an audio-visual siamese network that uses a single shared ViT backbone with a contrastive matching objective and multi-ratio random masking for efficient pretraining. It achieves competitive or better results than prior methods on AudioSet and VGGSound for audio-visual classification and retrieval while improving parameter efficiency.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了共享ViT骨干在音视频预训练中的可扩展性，对多模态Transformer设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出用单一共享ViT骨干进行可扩展音视频预训练的AVSiam框架。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 多比例随机掩码配合对比匹配目标，使共享骨干能统一处理音频、视觉及音视频输入。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound的分类与检索任务上达到与独立骨干方法相当或更优的性能。

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在超低比特后训练量化(PTQ)下精度显著下降的问题，现有基于重建的PTQ方法在ViT上因输出重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活量化困难而失效。本文提出APHQ-ViT，通过改进的平均扰动Hessian(APH)损失进行重要性估计，并设计MLP重建(MR)方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并在小型无标签校准集上用APH损失重建。实验表明该方法在极低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，缓解了ViT量化精度损失。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization, where existing reconstruction-based PTQ methods fail due to inaccurate output importance estimation and difficulty in quantizing post-GELU activations. The authors propose APHQ-ViT, which introduces an improved Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs via APH loss on a small unlabeled calibration set. Extensive experiments show that APHQ-ViT with linear quantization substantially outperforms prior PTQ methods on ViTs.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT量化部署的实际痛点提出了有效的PTQ方案，对边缘端视觉模型部署有参考价值，但领域相关性偏模型压缩而非感知任务本身。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出基于平均扰动Hessian的PTQ方法APHQ-ViT，解决了ViT在超低比特量化下的精度下降问题。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 改进的平均扰动Hessian损失与将GELU替换为ReLU的MLP重建策略。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在极低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，有效缓解ViT量化精度损失。
