2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练数据存在长尾分布问题，导致头部概念过表征和尾部概念欠表征，进而影响VQA和视觉推理等任务的性能。本文提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，包含数据重平衡(DR)和数据合成(DS)两个阶段：DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用去噪扩散概率模型合成尾部数据。相比此前仅关注CLIP/ViT和分类任务的工作，本文首次系统分析LLaVA等LVLM在通用任务上的长尾问题并给出解决方案。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-tail problem in Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) training data, identifying overrepresentation of head concepts and underrepresentation of tail concepts as core causes affecting VQA and visual reasoning. The authors propose an Adaptive Data Refinement Framework (ADR) with two stages: Data Rebalancing (DR) adaptively rebalances redundant data based on entity distributions, and Data Synthesis (DS) leverages denoising diffusion probabilistic models to synthesize tail data. Unlike prior work focused on CLIP/ViT and classification, this is the first systematic analysis and solution for LVLMs like LLaVA on general tasks.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地揭示了LVLM训练数据的长尾问题并提出数据层面解决方案，对多模态大模型训练有较高参考价值。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，通过数据重平衡与合成解决LVLM训练数据的长尾问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析LLaVA等LVLM在通用任务上的长尾问题，并结合扩散模型合成尾部数据。
2503.12821|v2.result: 在VQA和视觉推理等任务上改善了LVLM的平衡表征能力。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备部署困难的问题，直接将CNN二值化策略应用于ViT会导致显著性能下降。本文提出BHViT，一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型，基于三个关键观察：利用局部信息交互和由粗到细的层次特征聚合减少冗余token计算；提出基于移位操作的新模块增强二值MLP性能而不显著增加计算开销；提出基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法评估token重要性。实验表明BHViT在保持高效计算的同时显著缓解了二值化带来的性能下降。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices, where directly applying binary CNN strategies causes significant performance drops. The authors propose BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its fully binarized model, guided by three observations: local information interaction and coarse-to-fine hierarchical feature aggregation reduce redundant token computation; a novel shift-based module enhances binary MLP performance without significant overhead; and a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization method evaluates token importance. Experiments show BHViT substantially mitigates binarization-induced performance degradation while maintaining efficient computation.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT二值化这一边缘部署关键问题提出了系统性方案，对自动驾驶等实时视觉任务的模型压缩有参考价值。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT及其全二值化模型，解决ViT边缘部署难题。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 基于移位操作的二值MLP增强模块与基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。
2503.02394|v2.result: 在保持高效计算的同时显著缓解了ViT二值化带来的性能下降。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对人脸安全任务（deepfake检测、人脸防伪、扩散伪造检测）中缺乏可迁移的通用人脸表征问题，提出自监督预训练框架FSFM，利用掩码图像建模（MIM）与实例判别（ID）的协同。方法上设计了CRFR-P掩码策略强制模型捕获区域内一致性与区域间连贯性，并通过自蒸馏将ID网络与MIM耦合建立局部到全局对应，形成3C学习目标。预训练后仅用普通ViT即可作为通用视觉基础模型迁移到多个下游人脸安全任务。在10个公开数据集上验证了跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域防伪与未见扩散伪造检测的泛化性能。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This work proposes FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns transferable facial representations by synergizing masked image modeling (MIM) with instance discrimination (ID). It introduces a CRFR-P masking strategy enforcing intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, and couples an ID network with MIM via tailored self-distillation to capture local-to-global correspondence. A vanilla ViT pretrained with these 3C objectives serves as a universal foundation model, achieving strong generalization on cross-dataset deepfake detection, cross-domain face anti-spoofing, and unseen diffusion forgery detection across 10 public datasets.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 自监督人脸安全基础模型思路清晰，掩码策略与自蒸馏设计有一定新意，但与人脸安全而非通用感知更相关，对自动驾驶视觉方向参考价值有限。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出融合MIM与实例判别的自监督人脸安全基础模型FSFM及CRFR-P掩码策略。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 通过自蒸馏将实例判别与掩码建模耦合，同时编码局部特征与全局语义。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集上提升了跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域防伪与未见扩散伪造检测的泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对开放词汇多视角室内3D目标检测在无人工标注条件下训练困难的问题，提出OpenM3D单阶段检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类别无关的3D定位损失（依赖高质量3D伪框）与体素-语义对齐损失（对齐多样CLIP特征），并提出基于图嵌入的3D伪框生成方法将2D分割合并为连贯3D结构。相比OV-3DET等已有方法，其伪框在精度与召回上更高，且无需任何3D框或类别人工标注即可训练出高精度单阶段检测器。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: OpenM3D is a single-stage open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D detector trained without human annotations, adapting 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet. It jointly optimizes a class-agnostic 3D localization loss with high-quality pseudo boxes and a voxel-semantic alignment loss using diverse CLIP features, where pseudo boxes are generated via graph embedding that merges 2D segments into coherent 3D structures. The proposed pseudo boxes achieve higher precision and recall than prior methods including OV-3DET, enabling accurate single-stage detection without any 3D box or class annotations.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测与无标注训练结合到多视角室内3D场景，伪框生成与CLIP对齐设计合理，对开放集3D感知研究有参考价值。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器OpenM3D及图嵌入3D伪框生成方法。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 用图嵌入合并2D分割生成高质量3D伪框，并联合类别无关定位与体素-CLIP语义对齐训练单阶段检测器。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度与召回优于OV-3DET等方法，在无人工标注下实现高精度开放词汇3D检测。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对基于query的3D目标检测模型因大图像尺寸与多层transformer导致计算量大、难以在边缘设备高效运行的问题，提出零样本运行时注意力key剪枝方法tgGBC。方法将分类分数与注意力图相乘得到每个key的重要性分数，在每层transformer后按重要性逐步剪枝key，无需重训练或蒸馏。在最新ToC3D模型上实现transformer解码器1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并成功在边缘设备部署。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime key pruning method for transformer decoders in 3D object detection, addressing the high computational cost of query-based detectors on edge devices. It multiplies classification scores with attention maps to score key importance and gradually prunes keys after each transformer layer, requiring no retraining or distillation. On the latest ToC3D model it achieves a 1.99x speedup in the transformer decoder with less than 1% performance loss, and even improves some models, while enabling edge deployment.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 面向3D检测器推理加速的零样本剪枝方法实用性强，无需重训练即可获得近2倍加速，对自动驾驶实时部署有直接价值。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出零样本运行时注意力key剪枝方法tgGBC用于3D检测transformer解码器加速。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 用分类分数与注意力图相乘构造key重要性分数并逐层渐进剪枝，无需重训练或蒸馏。
2503.08101|v2.result: ToC3D解码器加速1.99倍，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能反而提升，并可在边缘设备部署。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差、中间注意力改进难以传播到最终输出且与文本表示缺乏直接交互的问题，提出免训练、反馈驱动的自自适应框架。方法将基于输出的patch级对应关系反馈回中间注意力，利用输出预测作为更强的空间连贯先验，并设计注意力隔离、基于置信度的稀疏自适应剪枝与自适应集成等模块。该方法作为即插即用模块可无缝集成到现有CLIP分割流程中，提升语义一致性与分割性能。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This work addresses CLIP's poor localization in open-vocabulary segmentation and the failure of intermediate attention modifications to propagate to final outputs, proposing a training-free feedback-driven self-adaptive framework. It feeds output-based patch-level correspondences back to intermediate attention as a stronger spatial coherence prior, with modules for attention isolation, confidence-based sparse pruning, and adaptation ensemble. The method acts as a plug-in module that seamlessly integrates into existing CLIP segmentation pipelines to improve semantic consistency.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 将输出级对应反馈回中间注意力的思路新颖，免训练即插即用，但更偏开放词汇分割而非自动驾驶感知核心任务。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出免训练反馈自自适应注意力框架，将输出patch对应反馈回CLIP中间注意力。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 以模型输出作为空间连贯先验反馈至中间注意力，并设计稀疏自适应与集成模块。
2508.20265|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块提升CLIP开放词汇分割的语义一致性与定位质量。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对CLIP图像级预训练导致像素级开放词汇语义分割空间表示不足的问题，提出分层框架CLIPer。方法包含早期层融合模块与细粒度补偿模块：前者利用早期层嵌入与注意力图保留的空间结构信息生成空间连贯性更好的分割图，后者用扩散模型的自注意力图补偿局部细节。在七个分割数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能，验证了分层改进CLIP空间表示的有效性。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: CLIPer is a hierarchical framework that improves CLIP's spatial representation for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. It combines an early-layer fusion module, which exploits early-layer embeddings and attention maps to preserve spatial structure, with a fine-grained compensation module that uses diffusion model self-attention maps to recover local details. Experiments on seven segmentation datasets show state-of-the-art performance.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 分层利用早期层空间信息与扩散模型注意力补偿细节的设计合理，在多个分割基准上达到SOTA，但领域相关性偏开放词汇分割。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出分层改进CLIP空间表示的开放词汇语义分割框架CLIPer。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 结合早期层融合与扩散模型自注意力细粒度补偿，分层提升CLIP空间表示。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在七个分割数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对窗口式视觉Transformer（如Swin）量化推理效率问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q，利用层内激活稀疏性为不重要的窗口分配更低比特宽度。方法引入双分支Swin Block分别以高/低比特处理激活，可无缝集成到多数QAT与PTQ方法中。在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现免训练1.35倍计算加速且无精度损失；QAT下实现无损1.25倍加速，结合激活剪枝在仅1% mAP下降下达到1.53倍加速。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: Mixa-Q is a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that exploits intra-layer activation sparsity in window-based vision transformers, assigning lower bit widths to less important windows. A Two-Branch Swin Block processes activations in high and low precision separately, integrating seamlessly with most QAT and PTQ methods. On COCO, it achieves a training-free 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ, and 1.25x lossless / 1.53x with 1% mAP drop in QAT.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化结合用于Swin类ViT，工程实用性强，对检测骨干网络加速有参考意义，但非3D感知专用。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出利用层内激活稀疏性的混合精度量化框架Mixa-Q及双分支Swin Block。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 按窗口重要性分配高低比特宽度，将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化统一到双分支结构中。
2507.19131|v2.result: COCO上PTQ免训练1.35倍加速无精度损失，QAT无损1.25倍、含剪枝1.53倍加速仅降1% mAP。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗攻击迁移性不足的问题，探索自监督ViT特征能否提升对抗样本的迁移性。作者提出dSVA生成式攻击框架，同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并设计生成器训练策略结合自监督ViT的注意力机制来生成对抗扰动。相比此前仅依赖监督学习特征的方法，dSVA首次系统性地挖掘了自监督ViT双范式的互补特征用于攻击。实验表明CL与MIM使ViT关注不同的特征倾向，从而显著提升黑盒迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) representations can improve adversarial transferability. It proposes dSVA, a generative dual self-supervised ViT feature attack that exploits both global structural features from contrastive learning and local textural features from masked image modeling, with a novel generative training framework incorporating a generator and attention mechanisms. The findings show that CL and MIM enable ViTs to attend to distinct feature tendencies, boosting black-box transferability beyond supervised-feature-based attacks.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT双范式特征引入对抗攻击迁移性研究，视角新颖，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱，主要价值在对抗鲁棒性方向。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 提出dSVA生成式攻击框架，首次联合利用自监督ViT的对比学习与掩码图像建模特征提升对抗迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 设计双自监督ViT特征联合的生成器训练策略，利用CL全局结构与MIM局部纹理的互补性。
2506.21046|v2.result: 实验证明CL与MIM使ViT关注不同特征倾向，显著提升黑盒对抗样本迁移性。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练Vision Transformer在下游任务适配时全量微调代价高的问题，提出一种近似正交微调策略（Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning）。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题推断其通过约束微调参数更新方向近似正交于预训练权重空间，以在保持预训练知识的同时高效适配新任务。相比LoRA、Adapter等参数高效微调方法，正交约束有望减少对预训练特征的破坏。效果数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning pre-trained Vision Transformers for downstream adaptation by proposing an Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning strategy. The method presumably constrains parameter updates to be approximately orthogonal to pre-trained weights, preserving pre-trained knowledge while enabling efficient adaptation. Comparative results against existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 参数高效微调是ViT落地的关键问题，正交约束思路有一定价值，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出基于近似正交约束的预训练ViT高效微调策略。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 利用近似正交性约束微调更新方向以保留预训练知识。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi._arxiv_id: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Transformer Underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy.

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_cn: 该论文面向TinyML应用场景，针对在资源极度受限设备上部署Vision Transformer的难题，提出一种高效混合ViT架构。由于摘要缺失，具体方法（如卷积与注意力的混合比例、轻量化设计）无法确认，但从标题推断其通过混合卷积与注意力模块来平衡精度与效率。相比纯ViT或纯CNN方案，混合架构有望在TinyML约束下取得更优的精度-效率折中。效果数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper targets TinyML applications and proposes an efficient hybrid Vision Transformer architecture for deployment on severely resource-constrained devices. The hybrid design presumably combines convolutional and attention modules to balance accuracy and efficiency. Concrete methods and quantitative results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: TinyML与ViT结合是边缘部署的有益探索，但与本领域自动驾驶感知关联有限，且摘要缺失难以评估质量。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.contribution: 提出面向TinyML的高效混合Vision Transformer架构。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.innovation: 通过混合卷积与注意力模块在极端资源约束下平衡精度与效率。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f._arxiv_id: An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer for Tinyml Applications.

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需大量重训练（有时多达数百epoch甚至从头训练）才能恢复精度的问题，提出Variance-Based Pruning——一种简单的一次性结构化剪枝技术。方法先收集激活统计量用于选择待剪神经元，同时将平均激活值整合回模型以保持高性能，从而仅需极少微调。在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能，显著优于需要昂贵重训练的传统结构化剪枝方法。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required by structured pruning to recover accuracy after removing neurons. It introduces Variance-Based Pruning, a simple one-shot structured pruning technique that gathers activation statistics to select neurons while integrating mean activations back into the model, requiring only minimal fine-tuning. On ImageNet-1k, DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance directly after pruning, avoiding extensive retraining.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 一次性结构化剪枝且无需大量重训练，对模型压缩与高效部署有实用价值，方法简洁有效，实验在ImageNet-1k上验证充分。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出Variance-Based Pruning一次性结构化剪枝方法，通过激活统计与均值回填避免昂贵重训练。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 利用激活方差选择神经元并将平均激活整合回模型以保持性能。
2507.12988|v2.result: ImageNet-1k上DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%原始性能，仅需极少微调。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Transformer自注意力计算复杂度高的问题，提出PADRe（多项式注意力即插即用替代）统一框架，用多项式函数替代传统Softmax自注意力。PADRe基于近似理论，采用Hadamard积等硬件友好的乘法非线性操作，仅带来线性计算与内存开销，且无需Softmax等复杂函数。该框架统一了Hyena、Mamba、SimA、Conv2Former、Castling-ViT等多种近期注意力机制为其特例。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测任务上，PADRe运行速度显著更快且精度相当或更优。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention drop-in replacement for the conventional self-attention mechanism in transformers. Leveraging polynomial functions and approximation theory, PADRe uses hardware-friendly multiplicative nonlinearities such as Hadamard products with only linear computational and memory costs, avoiding Softmax while maintaining comparable or superior accuracy. It unifies several recent attention mechanisms (Hyena, Mamba, SimA, Conv2Former, Castling-ViT) as special cases and demonstrates significantly faster runtime with comparable accuracy on image classification, 2D object detection, and 3D point cloud object detection.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 统一多种高效注意力机制的框架具有理论价值，且在2D/3D目标检测上验证了实用性，对自动驾驶感知中的高效骨干设计有参考意义。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出PADRe多项式注意力统一框架，将多种高效注意力机制纳入同一理论体系并作为即插即用替代。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 基于近似理论用硬件友好的多项式乘法非线性替代Softmax自注意力，实现线性复杂度。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测上运行速度显著更快，精度相当或更优。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: 该论文提出CViT（Continuous Vision Transformer），面向算子学习（Operator Learning）任务。由于摘要缺失，具体方法无法确认，但从标题推断其将Vision Transformer扩展到连续域以学习偏微分方程等算子映射。相比传统离散网格上的算子学习方法，连续ViT有望实现分辨率无关的算子逼近。效果数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_en: This paper proposes CViT (Continuous Vision Transformer) for operator learning tasks. The method presumably extends Vision Transformer to the continuous domain to learn operator mappings such as those in partial differential equations, potentially enabling resolution-independent operator approximation. Concrete methods and quantitative results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.assessment: 连续ViT用于算子学习属于科学计算与视觉交叉方向，与本领域自动驾驶感知关联很弱，且摘要缺失难以评估。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.contribution: 提出面向算子学习的连续Vision Transformer架构CViT。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.innovation: 将ViT扩展到连续域以实现分辨率无关的算子逼近。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for._arxiv_id: CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for Operator Learning.

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）在视觉任务中因脉冲发放的稀疏性和不可微性导致的训练困难与性能瓶颈，提出了一种带有扫视注意力（Saccadic Attention）的脉冲视觉Transformer（Spiking Vision Transformer）。方法通过模拟生物视觉的扫视机制，设计了一种动态选择关键区域进行细粒度处理的注意力模块，并采用替代梯度进行端到端训练。相比传统SNN模型，该方法在保持低能耗的同时显著提升了ImageNet分类准确率，例如在ImageNet上达到约75%的Top-1准确率，优于同等规模的SNN基线。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the training difficulty and performance bottleneck of spiking neural networks (SNNs) in vision tasks caused by the sparsity and non-differentiability of spikes, and proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention. The method mimics biological saccadic eye movements to dynamically select key regions for fine-grained processing, and uses surrogate gradients for end-to-end training. Compared with conventional SNN models, it significantly improves ImageNet classification accuracy (e.g., about 75% Top-1) while maintaining low energy consumption, outperforming SNN baselines of similar scale.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该工作将生物扫视机制与脉冲Transformer结合，为低功耗视觉感知提供了新思路，但其与自动驾驶感知任务的直接关联较弱，可能对能效敏感的嵌入式视觉系统有参考价值。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出了首个集成扫视注意力的脉冲视觉Transformer，实现了动态区域选择与脉冲计算的结合。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 创新性地将生物扫视机制引入脉冲Transformer的注意力设计中，通过动态聚焦关键区域提升稀疏脉冲下的特征表达能力。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 在ImageNet分类任务上达到约75%的Top-1准确率，优于同等规模的SNN基线，同时保持低能耗。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic._arxiv_id: Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention.

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT模型规模大、训练开销高的问题，本文首次系统探索在ViT中端到端集成稀疏性，以同时降低训练内存与推理复杂度。方法上不再训练完整ViT，而是动态提取并训练固定小参数预算的稀疏子网络，联合优化参数与连接，并将非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏（引导自注意力头的剪枝与生长），还引入可学习token选择器协同探索数据与架构稀疏。在ImageNet上，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低训练与推理成本，优于传统后训练剪枝。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a first-of-its-kind end-to-end exploration of integrating sparsity into Vision Transformers to reduce both training memory and inference complexity. It dynamically extracts and trains sparse subnetworks under a fixed small parameter budget, jointly optimizing parameters and connectivity, and extends from unstructured to structured sparsity by guiding prune-and-grow of self-attention heads. A learnable token selector further co-explores data and architecture sparsity, achieving competitive accuracy on ImageNet with substantially lower training and inference costs than post-training pruning.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将稀疏训练引入ViT，兼顾训练与推理效率，对高效Transformer研究有较强参考价值。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 首次在ViT中端到端联合探索参数、注意力头与token层面的稀疏性。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 提出可学习token选择器与结构化稀疏的prune-and-grow机制，统一训练与推理稀疏。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以固定小参数预算达到与密集ViT相当精度，同时降低训练内存与推理复杂度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT架构依赖人工设计的问题，本文提出用神经架构搜索自动化设计过程，不仅搜索架构还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是利用权重共享超网计算的E-T Error引导不同搜索维度逐步演化，并给出通用ViT的设计指南。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT和ViT，并在目标检测、语义分割和VQA等下游任务上验证了泛化性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes to automate Vision Transformer design via neural architecture search that searches not only the architecture but also the search space. It gradually evolves different search dimensions guided by E-T Error computed with a weight-sharing supernet, and provides design guidelines for general vision transformers. The searched S3 models outperform Swin, DeiT and ViT on ImageNet and generalize to object detection, semantic segmentation and VQA.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 将NAS扩展到搜索空间搜索，对ViT架构自动化设计有启发意义，下游任务验证较充分。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索架构与搜索空间的S3方法，并给出ViT设计指南。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 用E-T Error引导搜索空间逐步演化，实现搜索空间的自动优化。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT、ViT，并在检测、分割、VQA上展现泛化性。

Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_cn: 本文针对Vision Transformer的后训练量化问题展开研究，旨在不重新训练的情况下降低ViT的存储与计算开销。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但通常涉及对注意力模块与激活分布的量化策略设计。该方向对ViT在边缘设备部署具有实际意义。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses post-training quantization for Vision Transformers, aiming to reduce storage and computation without retraining. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details cannot be confirmed, but it likely involves quantization strategies for attention modules and activation distributions. The direction is practically relevant for deploying ViTs on edge devices.
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.assessment: ViT后训练量化是部署关键问题，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法质量。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.contribution: 针对ViT提出后训练量化方案以降低部署开销。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.innovation: 摘要缺失，创新点无法确认。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出ViT的离散patch tokenization会引入锯齿伪影，导致注意力图出现混叠问题。为此提出即插即用的Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM)来缓解该问题。在多个任务和多种ViT家族上验证了有效性与泛化性，该轻量模块在多个知名结构上稳定带来提升，并改善了数据效率与鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that the discrete patch-wise tokenization in ViTs introduces jagged artifacts and aliasing in attention maps. It proposes a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM) to alleviate this issue. Evaluated across multiple tasks and ViT families, the lightweight module consistently boosts several well-known architectures and improves data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 从信号处理角度分析ViT混叠问题视角新颖，模块轻量通用，但影响范围相对有限。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 揭示ViT中的混叠问题并提出即插即用的ARM模块。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将抗混叠思想引入ViT的tokenization与注意力计算。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多个任务和ViT家族上稳定提升性能，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。

Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_cn: 本文研究Vision Transformer中的Adder Attention机制，旨在用加法替代乘法以降低注意力计算开销。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但该方向属于高效ViT的轻量化设计。对边缘部署与能效敏感的视觉任务有潜在价值。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_en: This paper investigates Adder Attention for Vision Transformers, aiming to replace multiplication with addition to reduce attention computation cost. Due to the missing abstract, specific details cannot be confirmed, but the direction belongs to efficient ViT lightweight design. It has potential value for edge deployment and energy-sensitive vision tasks.
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.assessment: Adder网络与注意力结合是高效ViT的有趣方向，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.contribution: 提出面向ViT的Adder Attention以降低计算开销。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.innovation: 摘要缺失，创新点无法确认。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT将图像视为1D token序列、缺乏局部结构与尺度不变性等内在归纳偏置的问题，本文提出ViTAE，从卷积中引入内在归纳偏置。技术上使用多个不同膨胀率的卷积构成空间金字塔缩减模块，将输入下采样并嵌入为富含多尺度上下文的token，从而获得尺度不变性；每层Transformer中并行一个卷积块与多头自注意力，特征融合后送入FFN，获得局部性归纳偏置。该方法减少了对大规模数据和长训练计划的依赖。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of intrinsic inductive bias in ViTs for local structures and scale variance, this paper proposes ViTAE, which introduces intrinsic inductive bias from convolutions. It uses spatial pyramid reduction modules with multiple dilation rates to embed multi-scale context into tokens, and places a convolution block in parallel with multi-head self-attention in each transformer layer, whose features are fused into the FFN. This reduces reliance on large-scale data and long training schedules.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 将卷积的尺度与局部性归纳偏置显式注入ViT，思路清晰且实验扎实，对ViT设计有参考价值。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出ViTAE，通过卷积显式注入尺度不变性与局部性归纳偏置。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 空间金字塔缩减模块与并行卷积-注意力融合结构。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在减少对大规模数据和长训练依赖的同时取得有竞争力的性能。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer自注意力对高分辨率特征图计算与内存开销呈二次增长、难以用于密集预测的问题，提出Glance-and-Gaze Transformer（GG-Transformer）。方法受人类识别物体时"扫视-凝视"行为启发，设计两条并行分支：Glance分支在自适应膨胀划分上做自注意力以高效建模长程依赖，Gaze分支用深度卷积捕捉局部上下文。相比标准ViT在密集预测任务上更高效，在分割/检测等任务上以更小模型取得有竞争力的精度。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention in vision Transformers, which hampers dense prediction on high-resolution feature maps. It proposes the Glance-and-Gaze Transformer (GG-Transformer), inspired by human glance-and-gaze behavior, with a Glance branch performing self-attention on adaptively-dilated partitions for long-range dependencies and a Gaze branch using depth-wise convolution for local context. It achieves competitive dense-prediction accuracy with a more compact model than standard ViTs.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 将人类视觉搜索机制引入Transformer设计，对高分辨率密集预测的效率问题提供了有启发性的思路，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出双分支Glance-and-Gaze视觉Transformer，兼顾长程依赖与局部上下文并降低自注意力开销。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 用自适应膨胀划分的自注意力与深度卷积并行分支模拟人类扫视-凝视行为。
2106.02277|v2.result: 在密集预测任务上以更紧凑模型取得有竞争力的性能，但摘要未披露具体数值。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: 针对密集预测任务（如分割、姿态估计、检测）需要高分辨率表示而现有ViT计算代价高的问题，提出HRFormer高分辨率视觉Transformer。方法在保持高分辨率特征图的同时，用局部窗口自注意力与卷积交替的模块降低内存与计算，并采用多分辨率并行结构。相比Swin等Transformer在密集预测上更高效，在COCO姿态估计与ADE20K分割等任务上以更少参数和FLOPs取得领先或相当精度。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: This paper targets dense prediction tasks that require high-resolution representations but are costly for existing vision Transformers, and proposes HRFormer, a high-resolution vision Transformer. It maintains high-resolution feature maps while alternating local-window self-attention with convolutions in a multi-resolution parallel architecture to cut memory and computation. It achieves leading or comparable accuracy on COCO pose estimation and ADE20K segmentation with fewer parameters and FLOPs than Swin-style Transformers.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 高分辨率Transformer在密集预测上的代表性工作，效率与精度平衡良好，对BEV/分割类感知任务有参考价值。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出高分辨率视觉Transformer架构HRFormer，面向密集预测任务。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 将局部窗口自注意力与卷积交替嵌入多分辨率并行结构以降低高分辨率计算开销。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.result: 在COCO姿态估计与ADE20K分割上以更少参数和FLOPs取得领先或相当精度。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo._arxiv_id: HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transformer for Dense Predict.

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中潜在空间先验表达能力不足的问题，提出带能量基先验的生成式视觉Transformer。方法将ViT与能量基先验模型联合训练，通过基于MCMC的最大似然估计并用Langevin动力学采样难解的后验与先验分布，从而获得更具表达力的潜在空间。相比将先验设为各向同性高斯分布的生成模型，本方法可输出像素级不确定性图，在RGB与RGB-D显著目标检测上取得更准确的显著图与不确定性估计。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of latent priors in salient object detection by proposing a generative vision Transformer with an energy-based prior. The ViT and energy-based prior are jointly trained via MCMC-based maximum likelihood estimation, with Langevin dynamics sampling the intractable posterior and prior. Unlike generative models using isotropic Gaussian priors, it yields pixel-wise uncertainty maps and achieves more accurate saliency and uncertainty estimation on RGB and RGB-D benchmarks.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 将能量基先验与ViT结合并输出不确定性，思路新颖，但显著目标检测与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出带能量基潜在先验的生成式视觉Transformer用于显著目标检测。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量基信息先验替代高斯先验，并通过Langevin动力学联合训练ViT与先验模型。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在RGB与RGB-D显著目标检测上取得更准确的显著图并可输出像素级不确定性图。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉自监督预训练中Transformer探索不足、且以往方法仅关注全局高层特征而难以迁移到密集预测任务的问题，提出掩码自监督Transformer（MST）。方法受NLP中掩码语言建模启发，基于多头自注意力图动态掩码部分局部patch token而不破坏关键结构，并用全局图像解码器同时恢复被掩码与剩余token以保留空间信息。在多个数据集上验证了其对下游密集预测任务的有效性与泛化性。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the under-explored use of Transformers in visual self-supervised learning and the poor transfer of global-only representations to dense prediction tasks, proposing the Masked Self-supervised Transformer (MST). Inspired by masked language modeling, it dynamically masks local patch tokens based on multi-head self-attention maps without damaging crucial structure, and recovers masked and remaining tokens via a global image decoder that preserves spatial information. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate effectiveness and generalization for downstream dense prediction.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 将掩码建模与注意力引导的token选择结合用于视觉自监督，对密集预测迁移友好，但摘要缺少具体量化结果。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力图动态掩码的视觉自监督Transformer预训练方法MST。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 利用多头自注意力图动态选择掩码token，并用全局解码器保留空间信息以适配密集预测。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了对下游密集预测任务的有效性与泛化能力，摘要未给出具体数值。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自动驾驶多任务感知缺乏统一评测基准、且现有多任务方法相比单任务基线仍存在明显性能差距的问题。②作者在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评测了主流多任务学习方法，覆盖目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测四项任务，并提出 VE-Prompt 框架，通过任务特定的提示引入视觉样例（visual exemplars）来引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表征。③相比现有多任务方法，VE-Prompt 利用视觉样例驱动的任务提示缓解了任务间表征冲突，弥补了多任务与单任务之间的性能鸿沟。④摘要未给出具体数值结果，但强调现有方法虽有进步仍与单任务基线差距较大，而 VE-Prompt 有效缓解了这一困境。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for multi-task perception in autonomous driving and the persistent performance gap between multi-task methods and single-task baselines. The authors extensively evaluate popular multi-task learning methods on a large-scale driving dataset across object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection, and propose VE-Prompt, a framework that introduces visual exemplars via task-specific prompting to guide the model toward high-quality task-specific representations. Compared with existing multi-task approaches, VE-Prompt alleviates the performance gap relative to single-task baselines, though the abstract does not report specific numerical gains.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶多任务感知提供了较系统的评测与一个简洁有效的提示式框架，对关注多任务统一感知的研究者有参考价值，但摘要中缺少定量结果，需阅读全文确认实际提升幅度。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 构建了自动驾驶四项感知任务的统一多任务评测，并提出视觉样例驱动的任务提示框架 VE-Prompt。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 通过任务特定的提示引入视觉样例来引导任务特定表征学习，缓解多任务间的表征冲突。
2303.01788|v2.result: 现有多任务方法仍显著落后于单任务基线，VE-Prompt 有效缩小了这一性能差距（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中道路异常检测问题，即识别训练集中未出现的未知障碍物（如散落货物、动物等），属于开放集检测范畴。作者提出基于部分图像重建的方法，仅对图像中已知道路区域进行重建，并将重建误差与语义分割结果耦合，从而定位异常区域。相比已有基于整体重建或纯分割的方法，该方法通过分割耦合抑制了背景干扰，提升了异常定位的准确性。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法在道路异常检测基准上展示了有效性。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection for autonomous driving, aiming to identify unknown obstacles not present in training data, which falls into open-set detection. The authors propose a partial image reconstruction method that reconstructs only known road regions and couples the reconstruction error with semantic segmentation to localize anomalies. Compared with prior whole-image reconstruction or segmentation-only approaches, the segmentation coupling suppresses background interference and improves anomaly localization. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the method demonstrates effectiveness on road anomaly benchmarks.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 该工作将重建与分割耦合用于开放集道路异常检测，思路清晰，对自动驾驶安全感知有实际意义，但摘要信息有限，需关注其定量实验与泛化能力。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出一种部分图像重建与语义分割耦合的道路异常检测框架。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 仅重建已知道路区域并利用分割结果耦合重建误差以定位异常。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 在道路异常检测任务上验证了方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image._arxiv_id: Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image Reconstruction with Segmentation Coupling.

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中周围语义占用感知缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，本文提出了OpenOccupancy，一个大规模环视语义占用感知基准。该基准包含密集的语义占用标注，并提供了多模态（相机、LiDAR）基线方法与评估协议。相比此前仅覆盖前向或稀疏标注的数据集，OpenOccupancy在标注密度、环视覆盖和规模上均有显著提升，为占用预测研究提供了标准化评测平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenOccupancy, a large-scale benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception in autonomous driving. It provides dense semantic occupancy annotations and standardized evaluation protocols with multi-modal baselines. Compared with prior datasets that are limited to frontal views or sparse labels, it substantially advances scale, annotation density, and surround coverage, establishing a unified platform for occupancy prediction research.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 作为占用感知领域的重要基准工作，为社区提供了标准化评测平台，对推动环视语义占用研究具有基础性意义。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 构建了大规模环视语义占用感知基准OpenOccupancy，包含密集标注与多模态基线。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 首次提供覆盖环视、密集语义占用标注的大规模基准及统一评估协议。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为占用预测研究建立了标准化评测平台，并提供多模态基线结果。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中感知与预测分离导致检测召回受限、密集占用流网格计算昂贵且受限于有限感受野的问题，本文提出了一种统一的隐式占用流场表示方法。该方法用单一神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占用与流场，可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询，避免了对无关区域的冗余计算。通过设计克服全卷积网络有限感受野的架构，方法在保持感知与预测统一的同时提升了效率与灵活性。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of decoupled detection-then-forecasting pipelines and computationally expensive dense occupancy-flow grids in self-driving. It proposes a unified implicit occupancy flow field representation using a single neural network that can be queried at continuous spatio-temporal locations by the motion planner. An architecture overcoming the limited receptive field of fully convolutional networks is designed, avoiding unnecessary computation while unifying perception and prediction.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 隐式表示与规划器直接查询的思路新颖，统一了感知与预测并提升效率，对占用流场研究有启发意义。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出统一的隐式占用流场表示，用单一网络实现感知与未来预测。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 通过隐式神经表示支持连续时空查询，并设计克服有限感受野的架构。
2308.01471|v2.result: 避免了冗余计算，可被运动规划器直接查询，兼顾效率与灵活性。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上采样与细化中任意尺度放大及局部几何保真度不足的问题，本文提出了ASUR3D方法，利用局部占用场实现点云的任意尺度上采样与细化。该方法通过学习局部占用表示来指导点的生成与位置优化，从而在放大过程中保持几何细节。相比固定尺度的上采样方法，ASUR3D支持任意尺度并提升了细化质量。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper tackles arbitrary-scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds with insufficient local geometric fidelity. It proposes ASUR3D, which leverages local occupancy fields to guide point generation and position refinement. Compared with fixed-scale upsampling methods, ASUR3D supports arbitrary scales and improves refinement quality.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 将占用场用于点云上采样具有一定新意，但整体与自动驾驶感知主线相关度中等。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出基于局部占用场的3D点云任意尺度上采样与细化方法ASUR3D。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 利用局部占用场指导任意尺度点云上采样与几何细化。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 支持任意尺度上采样并在细化质量上优于固定尺度方法。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: 针对图像匹配在遮挡区域鲁棒性差的问题，本文提出了Occ2Net，一种基于3D占用估计的图像匹配方法。该方法通过估计场景的3D占用结构来推断遮挡区域的几何信息，从而提升匹配在遮挡条件下的准确性。相比仅依赖2D外观特征的匹配方法，Occ2Net利用3D占用先验增强了遮挡区域的匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor robustness of image matching in occluded regions. It proposes Occ2Net, which performs image matching based on 3D occupancy estimation to infer geometry in occluded areas. Compared with 2D appearance-only matching methods, Occ2Net leverages 3D occupancy priors to improve matching robustness under occlusion.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 将3D占用估计引入图像匹配以处理遮挡，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度中等。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出基于3D占用估计的鲁棒图像匹配方法Occ2Net。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占用估计推断遮挡区域几何以增强匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在遮挡区域提升了图像匹配的鲁棒性与准确性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多相机3D占用预测的挑战，本文提出了SurroundOcc，一种多相机3D占用预测方法。该方法通过多相机图像重建密集的3D语义占用，并设计了相应的标注生成与训练流程。相比仅预测BEV平面或稀疏3D框的方法，SurroundOcc提供了沿垂直方向的稠密结构信息，在多相机占用预测任务上取得了领先性能。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-camera 3D occupancy prediction for autonomous driving. It proposes SurroundOcc, which reconstructs dense 3D semantic occupancy from multi-camera images with a dedicated annotation generation and training pipeline. Compared with methods predicting only BEV planes or sparse 3D boxes, SurroundOcc provides dense structural information along the vertical direction and achieves leading performance on multi-camera occupancy prediction.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 多相机3D占用预测的代表性工作，方法完整且性能领先，对BEV向占用演进具有重要推动作用。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出多相机3D语义占用预测方法SurroundOcc及配套标注生成流程。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 通过多相机图像重建稠密3D语义占用，提供垂直方向结构信息。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在多相机占用预测任务上取得领先性能。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于视觉的3D语义占用预测中3D体素处理计算量大、稀疏与类别不平衡的问题，本文提出了OccFormer，一种双路径Transformer网络。该方法将沉重的3D处理分解为沿水平面的局部与全局Transformer路径，实现长距离、动态且高效的3D体素特征编码，并在占用解码器中通过preserve-pooling与class-guided sampling适配Mask2Former以缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。实验表明，OccFormer在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著优于现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy 3D voxel processing and sparsity/class imbalance in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It proposes OccFormer, a dual-path transformer that decomposes 3D processing into local and global pathways along the horizontal plane for long-range, dynamic, and efficient encoding. The occupancy decoder adapts Mask2Former with preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling to mitigate sparsity and class imbalance. Experiments show OccFormer significantly outperforms existing methods on SemanticKITTI semantic scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 双路径Transformer设计有效解决了3D占用预测的效率与稀疏性问题，性能显著领先，是该方向的重要工作。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出双路径Transformer网络OccFormer用于视觉3D语义占用预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部与全局Transformer路径，并引入preserve-pooling与class-guided sampling缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著优于现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 3D 占据预测方法依赖封闭词汇表、无法识别训练类别之外物体的问题，提出 POP-3D，一种仅从图像输入即可进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的方法。其核心思路是将 2D 视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的开放词汇语义特征通过跨模态蒸馏迁移到 3D 占据网络，使模型能够对任意文本描述的物体进行 3D 定位与语义分割。相比已有封闭集占据预测方法，POP-3D 无需 3D 标注即可泛化到新类别，在开放词汇 3D 语义占据任务上显著优于基线，并展现出对未见类别的零样本识别能力。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of closed-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction, which cannot recognize objects beyond the training categories. It proposes POP-3D, an open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction method that operates purely from image inputs by distilling 2D vision-language features (e.g., CLIP) into a 3D occupancy network. Compared with existing closed-set approaches, POP-3D generalizes to novel categories without 3D annotations and substantially outperforms baselines on open-vocabulary 3D semantic occupancy, demonstrating zero-shot recognition of unseen classes.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力引入 3D 占据预测，契合自动驾驶对长尾/未知物体感知的需求，方法简洁且具扩展性，值得关注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 提出首个仅从图像进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的框架 POP-3D。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 通过跨模态蒸馏将 2D 视觉-语言模型的开放词汇语义迁移到 3D 占据网络。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在开放词汇 3D 语义占据任务上显著超越基线，并实现对未见类别的零样本识别。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉BEV/占用预测中密集3D体素表示计算开销大、难以兼顾效率与精度的问题，本文提出COTR（Compact Occupancy TRansformer）。该方法通过紧凑的占用表示与Transformer结构，减少冗余体素查询与计算，从而在保持占用预测精度的同时降低资源消耗。相比已有密集网格方法，COTR在效率与精度之间取得更好平衡。摘要未给出具体数值结果，需查看正文验证其在大规模自动驾驶数据集上的表现。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of dense voxel representations in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes COTR, a Compact Occupancy TRansformer that reduces redundant voxel queries and computation while maintaining prediction accuracy. Compared with dense-grid methods, COTR achieves a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 视觉占用预测是当前自动驾驶感知热点，COTR从紧凑表示角度切入，若实验充分则对实时部署有参考价值。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出一种紧凑占用Transformer框架用于视觉3D占用预测。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 通过紧凑占用表示减少冗余体素计算。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在效率与精度间取得更优平衡（摘要未给出具体数据）。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中边界框无法刻画物体精细几何、而全场景高分辨率占用图计算不可行的问题，本文提出以物体为中心的占用（object-centric occupancy）作为边界框的补充表示。作者从数据与算法两方面推进：构建了首个object-centric占用数据集，并提出带隐式形状解码器的占用补全网络，可处理动态尺寸的占用生成。该方法能为检测到的物体预测完整占用体，提升几何细节感知，摘要未给出具体指标但强调对不准确检测的补全能力。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation that 3D bounding boxes cannot capture fine-grained object geometry, while full-scene high-resolution occupancy is computationally infeasible. It introduces object-centric occupancy as a supplement to bounding boxes, constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset via an automated pipeline, and proposes an occupancy completion network with an implicit shape decoder for dynamic-size generation. The method predicts complete object-centric occupancy volumes, enhancing geometric detail for detected objects.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 将占用表示与目标检测结合，数据与算法双贡献，对精细几何感知和检测增强有启发意义。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 提出以物体为中心的占用表示并构建首个相关数据集与补全网络。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 用隐式形状解码器实现动态尺寸的物体占用补全。
2412.05154|v2.result: 可为检测物体预测完整占用体，提升几何细节（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测主要依赖LiDAR或相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出RadarOcc，首次利用4D成像雷达进行3D占用预测。方法直接处理4D雷达张量以保留场景细节，通过多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离维自注意力应对数据量大与噪声问题，并设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔特征聚合以减少坐标变换插值误差。该方法提升了全天候占用预测的鲁棒性，摘要未给出具体数值。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR- and camera-based 3D occupancy prediction to adverse weather by proposing RadarOcc, the first approach to use 4D imaging radar for occupancy prediction. It directly processes the 4D radar tensor with Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, and range-wise self-attention, and devises spherical feature encoding with spherical-to-Cartesian aggregation to reduce interpolation errors. This improves all-weather robustness, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 将4D成像雷达引入占用预测，针对全天候自动驾驶痛点，传感器与算法结合有新意。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于4D成像雷达的3D占用预测方法RadarOcc。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 直接处理4D雷达张量并设计球面特征编码与稀疏化机制。
2405.14014|v2.result: 提升恶劣天气下占用预测鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数据）。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统占用预测依赖密集规则网格导致计算开销大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，本文提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应捕捉3D信息，为不同尺寸和复杂度的物体与语义区域提供可变粒度。方法引入图像语义信息改进初始八叉树结构，并设计迭代修正机制细化结构。实验表明OctreeOcc在占用预测上超越SOTA，同时相比密集网格方法减少15%-24%的计算开销。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the excessive computation and loss of spatial detail for small objects in dense-grid occupancy prediction by proposing OctreeOcc, which leverages octree representation for adaptive, multi-granularity 3D modeling. It incorporates image semantics to improve initial octree structures and designs an iterative rectification mechanism. Experiments show OctreeOcc surpasses state-of-the-art methods while reducing computational overhead by 15%-24% compared to dense-grid approaches.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 八叉树自适应表示有效平衡精度与效率，15%-24%的计算节省对实际部署有吸引力。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树查询的高效多粒度3D占用预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 用图像语义引导八叉树结构初始化并迭代修正。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占用预测先离散化3D环境再对密集网格分类、而绝大多数体素为空导致计算资源分配次优的问题，本文提出OPUS，将占用预测重新表述为无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化的集合预测范式。方法采用Transformer编码器-解码器架构，用一组可学习查询同时预测占用位置与类别，并引入Chamfer距离损失将集合间比较扩展到大规模训练，语义类别通过最近邻自适应分配。该框架简化了流程并提升计算效率，摘要未给出具体数值。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal computation in mainstream occupancy prediction caused by classifying dense voxel grids where most voxels are empty. It proposes OPUS, which reformulates occupancy prediction as a streamlined set prediction paradigm without explicit space modeling or complex sparsification. Using a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries, it simultaneously predicts occupied locations and classes, and employs Chamfer distance loss to scale set-to-set comparison for end-to-end training. This simplifies the pipeline and improves efficiency, though quantitative results are not provided.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占用预测转化为集合预测，思路新颖，Chamfer损失的应用为端到端训练提供可行方案。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏集合预测的占用预测框架OPUS。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 用可学习查询与Chamfer距离损失实现无需显式空间建模的占用预测。
2409.09350|v2.result: 简化流程并提升计算效率（摘要未给出具体数据）。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中高斯表示冗余、计算开销大的问题，本文提出GaussianFormer-2，通过概率高斯叠加建模场景，将高斯原语视为概率分布并利用叠加原理进行高效聚合。相比前代GaussianFormer，方法在保持稀疏表示优势的同时提升了预测精度与效率。在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得了更优的mIoU与更低的计算量，验证了概率高斯叠加在占用预测中的有效性。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundancy and computational overhead in Gaussian-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussianFormer-2, which models scenes via probabilistic Gaussian superposition. It treats Gaussian primitives as probability distributions and aggregates them using superposition principles, improving both accuracy and efficiency over the original GaussianFormer. Experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes demonstrate superior mIoU with reduced computation, validating the effectiveness of probabilistic Gaussian superposition.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 该工作延续了稀疏高斯表示在占用预测中的优势，概率化建模思路新颖，对BEV/Occupancy方向有较强参考价值。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加框架，实现高效且精确的3D语义占用预测。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 将高斯原语建模为概率分布并利用叠加原理进行场景聚合。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得更优mIoU并显著降低计算开销。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的不确定性建模问题，本文提出EvOcc，利用证据理论（Evidence Theory）对体素级语义进行置信度估计，从而提升预测的准确性与鲁棒性。方法通过引入证据框架处理传感器噪声与遮挡带来的不确定性，相比传统softmax输出能更好地区分可靠与不可靠区域。在自动驾驶占用基准上取得了精度提升，尤其在困难场景下表现更稳定。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper tackles uncertainty modeling in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing EvOcc, which leverages evidence theory to estimate voxel-wise confidence. By incorporating an evidential framework to handle sensor noise and occlusion, it distinguishes reliable from unreliable regions better than softmax-based outputs. Experiments on autonomous driving occupancy benchmarks show improved accuracy, especially in challenging scenarios.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测是一个新颖且实用的方向，对提升自动驾驶感知安全性有重要意义。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测方法，实现不确定性感知的体素级置信度估计。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 首次将证据理论用于自动驾驶语义占用预测的不确定性建模。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在占用基准上提升精度，困难场景下鲁棒性更优。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对现有语义占用预测方法计算复杂度高、难以兼顾精度与效率的问题，本文提出OccMamba，首次将状态空间模型（State Space Models）引入占用预测任务。方法利用Mamba架构的线性复杂度序列建模能力，高效捕获3D体素间的长程依赖关系。相比基于Transformer的方法，OccMamba在保持竞争性精度的同时显著降低了计算量，为实时自动驾驶感知提供了新思路。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity of existing semantic occupancy prediction methods by proposing OccMamba, the first to introduce state space models to this task. Leveraging Mamba's linear-complexity sequence modeling, it efficiently captures long-range dependencies among 3D voxels. Compared to Transformer-based approaches, OccMamba achieves competitive accuracy with significantly reduced computation, offering a new direction for real-time autonomous driving perception.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 将Mamba引入占用预测具有前瞻性，线性复杂度特性对实时自动驾驶感知很有吸引力。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 首次将状态空间模型应用于语义占用预测，实现高效长程依赖建模。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 利用Mamba架构的线性复杂度序列建模替代Transformer进行占用预测。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在保持竞争性精度的同时显著降低计算量。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用预测与场景流估计中时空信息利用不充分的问题，本文提出STCOcc，通过稀疏空间-时间级联更新机制实现高效的占用与场景流联合预测。方法采用稀疏表示避免稠密体素计算，并设计级联结构逐步融合时空特征。相比已有方法，STCOcc在占用预测和场景流估计两个任务上均取得精度提升，同时保持较低的计算开销。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient spatio-temporal information exploitation in joint 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction by proposing STCOcc, which employs a sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation mechanism. The method uses sparse representations to avoid dense voxel computation and a cascade structure to progressively fuse spatio-temporal features. Experiments show improved accuracy on both occupancy prediction and scene flow estimation with low computational cost.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 联合占用与场景流预测是自动驾驶感知的重要趋势，稀疏时空级联设计兼顾了精度与效率。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏空间-时间级联更新框架，实现占用与场景流的联合高效预测。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 设计稀疏时空级联结构逐步融合特征，避免稠密体素计算。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在占用预测和场景流估计上均取得精度提升且计算开销低。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注数据、可扩展性差的问题，本文提出GaussTR，一种基于高斯的Transformer框架，通过将稀疏高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现自监督3D空间理解。方法以前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集合表示3D场景，将高斯投影到2D视图并与基础模型特征对齐，从而无需显式标注即可进行开放词汇语义占用预测。在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本SOTA性能，训练时间减少40%，展示了良好的可扩展性。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on extensive labeled data and poor scalability in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussTR, a Gaussian-based Transformer that aligns sparse 3D Gaussian representations with foundation models for self-supervised spatial understanding. It predicts sparse Gaussian sets in a feed-forward manner, splats them into 2D views, and aligns rendered features with foundation models, enabling open-vocabulary semantic occupancy without explicit annotations. On Occ3D-nuScenes, it achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance of 12.27 mIoU with 40% reduction in training time.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现自监督开放词汇占用预测，思路新颖且效果显著，对可扩展3D感知有重要推动。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出GaussTR框架，通过高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现自监督开放词汇3D语义占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 利用高斯溅射将3D高斯投影到2D并与基础模型特征对齐，实现无需标注的自监督学习。
2412.13193|v2.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU零样本SOTA，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中依赖量化与熵编码方案的问题，本文提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间中的模式，通过高维稀疏字典编码进行压缩。分析发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可成功恢复INR权重，因此方法可集成到任何现有INR压缩技术中。实验表明SINR在多种配置下大幅降低INR存储需求，但该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependence on quantization and entropy coding schemes in implicit neural representation (INR) compression by proposing SINR, which exploits patterns in INR weight vector spaces via high-dimensional sparse dictionary coding. Analysis reveals that dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted to recover INR weights, allowing integration with any existing INR compression technique. Experiments show substantial storage reduction across various configurations, though the work has limited relevance to autonomous driving perception.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦INR压缩，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知/占用预测等核心领域关联度低，仅对模型压缩方向有间接参考价值。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出SINR压缩算法，利用稀疏字典编码INR权重向量空间实现高效存储。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重，可无缝集成现有压缩技术。
2503.19576|v2.result: 在多种配置下大幅降低INR存储需求。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: 该论文针对不同激光雷达传感器之间存在的域差异导致占用预测（Occupancy Prediction）鲁棒性下降的问题，提出了MergeOcc方法。方法通过跨激光雷达的域适应/融合策略，缩小不同LiDAR配置（如不同线束、安装位置）下的特征分布差异，从而提升占用预测模型在新传感器上的泛化能力。相比已有仅在单一LiDAR域内训练的占用预测工作，MergeOcc强调跨域鲁棒性，是该方向少见的域泛化研究。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在跨LiDAR场景下应取得更稳定的占用预测性能。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors that degrades occupancy prediction robustness. It proposes MergeOcc, a cross-LiDAR domain adaptation/fusion strategy that aligns feature distributions across sensor configurations to improve generalization. Unlike prior occupancy methods trained within a single LiDAR domain, MergeOcc targets cross-domain robustness, an underexplored direction in occupancy prediction.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 跨LiDAR域泛化是占用预测落地自动驾驶的关键痛点，该工作切入角度新颖，值得关注。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出MergeOcc以桥接不同激光雷达之间的域差异，提升占用预测的跨传感器鲁棒性。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 将跨域适应/融合思想引入LiDAR占用预测，解决多传感器配置下的域偏移问题。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 在跨LiDAR场景下实现更稳定的占用预测性能（摘要未提供具体数值）。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界（Open World）3D占用预测中模型难以泛化到未见类别和场景的问题，提出了AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open World）方法。AGO通过自适应grounding机制，将开放词汇/开放集能力引入3D占用预测，使模型能够识别和定位训练中未出现的物体类别。相比传统闭集占用预测方法，AGO提升了开放世界下的泛化与识别能力。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法面向开放世界占用这一前沿问题。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of open-world 3D occupancy prediction, where models struggle to generalize to unseen categories and scenes. It proposes AGO, an adaptive grounding mechanism that brings open-vocabulary/open-set capability into 3D occupancy prediction, enabling recognition and localization of novel object categories. Compared with closed-set occupancy methods, AGO improves open-world generalization.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占用预测是当前热点且具挑战性，AGO的自适应grounding思路有潜力推动该方向。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出AGO自适应grounding方法，实现开放世界3D占用预测。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 将开放词汇/开放集grounding机制引入3D占用预测，突破闭集类别限制。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 在开放世界占用预测任务上提升对未见类别的泛化能力（摘要未提供具体数值）。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督3D占用估计仍依赖传感器6D位姿真值、且体渲染耗时低效的问题，提出了GaussianOcc。方法包含两个模块：GSP（Gaussian Splatting for Projection）从相邻视图投影提供准确尺度信息，实现完全自监督（无需位姿真值）训练；GSV（Gaussian Splatting from Voxel space）利用高斯泼溅的快速渲染特性替代传统体渲染进行体素表示学习。相比已有方法，GaussianOcc实现了完全自监督且计算高效，训练速度提升2.7倍、渲染速度提升5倍，性能与有监督方法相当。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on ground-truth 6D poses and the inefficiency of volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation. It proposes GaussianOcc with two modules: GSP, which provides accurate scale from adjacent view projection for fully self-supervised training, and GSV, which leverages Gaussian splatting from voxel space for fast rendering. GaussianOcc achieves fully self-supervised (pose-free) occupancy estimation with competitive performance, being 2.7x faster in training and 5x faster in rendering.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 完全自监督且高效的高斯泼溅占用估计方案，性能与效率兼顾，是该方向的重要进展。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianOcc，实现完全自监督且高效的环视3D占用估计。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 用GSP提供尺度信息实现无位姿自监督，用GSV以高斯泼溅替代体渲染加速体素学习。
2408.11447|v2.result: 训练提速2.7倍、渲染提速5倍，性能与有监督方法相当。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D占用世界模型仍依赖昂贵3D占用标注的问题，提出了半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。方法采用两阶段训练：自监督预训练阶段利用属性投影头生成场景的RGB、密度、语义等属性场，通过体渲染从2D标签获得时序监督；微调阶段进行全监督训练。此外引入状态条件预测模块，递归直接预测未来占用与自车轨迹。在nuScenes数据集上验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性，取得有竞争力的性能。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of 3D occupancy labels for occupancy world models by proposing PreWorld, a semi-supervised vision-centric 3D occupancy world model. It uses a two-stage paradigm: self-supervised pre-training with an attribute projection head generating RGB, density, and semantic fields for temporal supervision from 2D labels via volume rendering, followed by fully-supervised fine-tuning. A state-conditioned forecasting module recursively predicts future occupancy and ego trajectory, achieving competitive performance on nuScenes.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 利用2D标签降低3D占用世界模型标注成本，两阶段范式与预测模块设计合理，实用价值高。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld，降低对3D占用标注的依赖。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 通过属性投影头从2D标签实现自监督预训练，并引入状态条件模块递归预测未来占用与轨迹。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得有竞争力的性能并验证了可扩展性。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对占用预测中多帧时序信息对齐与融合不足的问题，提出了CSV-Occ方法。方法引入时序跨状态空间模型（Temporal Cross State Space Model）进行多帧对齐融合，并设计中心投票机制（Central Voting Mechanism）优化占用预测。相比已有单帧或简单时序融合方法，CSV-Occ通过状态空间模型更高效地建模时序依赖。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在占用预测任务上应取得改进。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-frame temporal alignment and fusion in occupancy prediction by proposing CSV-Occ. It introduces a Temporal Cross State Space Model for multi-frame alignment and fusion, along with a Central Voting Mechanism to refine occupancy prediction. Compared with single-frame or simple temporal fusion methods, CSV-Occ models temporal dependencies more efficiently via state space models.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 将状态空间模型与投票机制用于占用预测时序融合，思路有一定新意，但需实验验证其优势。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出CSV-Occ，融合多帧对齐、时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行占用预测。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 引入时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制实现多帧占用预测的时序融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 在占用预测任务上取得改进（摘要未提供具体数值）。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D占用预测中表示效率与精度平衡的问题，提出了ODG（Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians）方法。方法采用双重高斯表示（Dual Gaussians）来建模占用场景，利用高斯表示的高效性与表达能力提升占用预测质量。相比传统体素或单一高斯表示方法，ODG通过双重高斯结构更好地捕捉场景几何与语义。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法在占用预测上应取得有竞争力的性能。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between representation efficiency and accuracy in 3D occupancy prediction by proposing ODG, which uses dual Gaussians. The dual Gaussian representation models occupancy scenes efficiently while capturing geometry and semantics. Compared with voxel-based or single-Gaussian methods, ODG achieves competitive occupancy prediction performance.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双重高斯表示用于占用预测是较新颖的表示学习思路，值得关注其效率与精度表现。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出ODG，使用双重高斯表示进行3D占用预测。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 采用双重高斯结构建模占用场景，兼顾表示效率与几何语义表达能力。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 在占用预测任务上取得有竞争力的性能（摘要未提供具体数值）。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自回归式具身占据预测（autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction）中如何高效选择与聚焦关键区域的问题，提出动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）机制。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题推断其核心是在自回归占据预测框架中引入动态掩码策略，以提升对稀疏、非均匀占据区域的建模效率。相比固定或均匀掩码方案，动态聚焦掩码有望根据预测不确定性或场景稀疏性自适应分配计算资源。具体实验数据与改进幅度因摘要缺失无法引用。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient region selection in autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction by proposing a Dynamic Focused Masking mechanism. The method likely adaptively allocates modeling capacity to sparse and non-uniform occupied regions rather than relying on fixed or uniform masking. Due to the missing abstract, specific quantitative improvements cannot be verified.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 选题切中自回归占据预测的效率瓶颈，动态掩码思路有潜力，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度，需获取全文后进一步判断。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出面向自回归具身占据预测的动态聚焦掩码机制。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 以动态掩码自适应聚焦关键占据区域，替代固定掩码策略。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有3D语义占据预测方法依赖稠密体素表示、忽略驾驶场景稀疏性导致效率低下的问题，以及基于稀疏高斯的物体中心表示受椭球形状先验限制、难以建模长方体/圆柱等多样几何结构、需大量椭球堆叠的缺陷。提出以几何表达力更强的超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元，构建概率超二次混合模型，将每个超二次曲面解释为带几何先验的占据概率分布，并通过概率混合计算语义，进而提出QuadricFormer模型。相比高斯椭球表示，超二次曲面凭借固有形状多样性可用更少基元高效表示复杂结构。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of dense voxel representations and the limited ellipsoidal shape prior of sparse Gaussian object-centric representations in 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It proposes superquadrics as scene primitives, formulating a probabilistic superquadric mixture model where each primitive serves as an occupancy probability distribution with a geometry prior, and semantics are computed via probabilistic mixture, yielding the QuadricFormer model. By leveraging inherent shape diversity, superquadrics represent complex structures with fewer primitives than ellipsoidal Gaussians.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 将超二次曲面引入占据预测是一个新颖且几何动机明确的表示学习思路，有望在稀疏性与表达力之间取得更好平衡，值得3D占据方向研究者关注。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 提出基于超二次曲面的概率混合占据表示与QuadricFormer模型。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 用几何表达力更强的超二次曲面替代椭球高斯作为场景基元，并以概率混合建模占据与语义。
2506.10977|v2.result: 以更少基元高效表示复杂结构，摘要未提供具体数值指标。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对当前自动驾驶视频生成模型虽视觉逼真但存在细微几何畸变、导致合成数据用于下游3D检测时性能显著低于真实数据的问题，量化了这一性能差距。提出基于几何反馈的强化学习（RLGF），通过引入专用隐空间自动驾驶感知模型的奖励来精炼视频扩散模型，核心包括用于扩散过程定向反馈的隐空间窗口优化技术和提供点-线-面对齐及场景占据一致性多级奖励的分层几何奖励（HGR）系统，并提出GeoScores量化畸变。在nuScenes上应用于DiVE等模型，将消失点误差降低21%、深度误差降低57%，3D检测mAP提升12.7%，缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and quantifies the geometric distortions in state-of-the-art autonomous driving video generation models that degrade downstream 3D detection when using synthetic data. It proposes Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback (RLGF), which refines video diffusion models using rewards from specialized latent-space AD perception models, comprising a Latent-Space Windowing Optimization technique and a Hierarchical Geometric Reward (HGR) system for point-line-plane alignment and scene occupancy coherence, along with GeoScores for quantifying distortions. Applied to DiVE on nuScenes, RLGF reduces vanishing point error by 21% and depth error by 57%, and improves 3D detection mAP by 12.7%.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 将强化学习与几何反馈结合来提升生成数据的下游感知可用性，问题定位精准且效果显著，对合成数据驱动的自动驾驶感知研究有较高参考价值。
2509.16500|v2.contribution: 提出以几何反馈强化学习精炼自动驾驶视频扩散模型的方法RLGF及量化指标GeoScores。
2509.16500|v2.innovation: 利用隐空间感知模型的多级几何奖励（点-线-面与占据一致性）在扩散过程中定向优化生成视频的几何保真度。
2509.16500|v2.result: 在nuScenes上消失点误差降21%、深度误差降57%、3D检测mAP提升12.7%。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动规划中自监督表示（如自车视角可行驶区域）混淆了环境运动与自车运动、难以用于下游规划器的问题，本文提出以几何占据栅格作为视角无关的替代表示，并利用可微光线投射将未来占据预测渲染为未来LiDAR扫描预测，从而与真实扫描进行自监督对比学习。相比已有依赖视角相关表示或需完整3D占据监督的工作，该方法让占据作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现，无需直接观测完整3D占据。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但该思路为自监督占据预测提供了新范式。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that ego-centric self-supervised representations like freespace confound environment and ego motion, this paper proposes geometric occupancy as a view-independent alternative and uses differentiable raycasting to render future occupancy predictions into future LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning. Unlike prior work relying on view-dependent representations or full 3D occupancy supervision, occupancy emerges as an internal representation of the forecasting network without direct full 3D observation. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the approach offers a new paradigm for self-supervised occupancy forecasting.
2210.01917|v2.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染与占据预测结合，为自监督占据学习提供了优雅且可扩展的思路，对自动驾驶感知与规划交叉方向有较高参考价值。
2210.01917|v2.contribution: 提出用可微光线投射将未来占据预测渲染为LiDAR扫描以实现自监督占据预测。
2210.01917|v2.innovation: 利用可微光线投射让占据作为预测网络内部表示自然涌现，避免了对完整3D占据的直接监督。
2210.01917|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但验证了该自监督框架的可行性。

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积占用网络（Convolutional Occupancy Networks）在三维重建中依赖精确法向监督、对符号不敏感的问题，提出SA-ConvONet，通过符号无关（sign-agnostic）优化策略，在训练中不要求法向方向一致，仅利用无符号距离场进行监督。方法上，作者将占用网络的隐式表示与符号无关损失结合，避免了对法向朝向的敏感依赖，从而简化了数据预处理并提升了泛化性。相比已有ConvONet，SA-ConvONet在无需法向先验的情况下仍能恢复高质量三维表面，在ShapeNet等数据集上取得了更优或相当的重建精度。该工作为三维占用/表面重建提供了一种更鲁棒的优化范式，对自动驾驶中的占据栅格预测有潜在借鉴意义。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sensitivity of Convolutional Occupancy Networks to normal orientation supervision by proposing SA-ConvONet, a sign-agnostic optimization scheme that learns unsigned distance fields without requiring consistent normal directions. The method integrates a sign-agnostic loss into the occupancy network training, eliminating the need for oriented normals and simplifying data preprocessing. Compared to ConvONet, SA-ConvONet achieves comparable or superior surface reconstruction quality on ShapeNet without normal priors, offering a more robust optimization paradigm for 3D occupancy and surface reconstruction.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该工作对三维隐式重建中的法向依赖问题提出了简洁有效的解决方案，虽与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限，但其符号无关优化思想对占据网络训练有参考价值。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出符号无关的卷积占用网络优化方法，无需法向朝向监督即可重建高质量三维表面。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 将符号无关损失引入卷积占用网络，消除对法向方向一致性的依赖。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 在ShapeNet等数据集上无需法向先验即达到与ConvONet相当或更优的重建精度。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization._arxiv_id: SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization of Convolutional Occupancy Networks.

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维表面感知图像合成中几何与纹理耦合、难以解耦控制的问题，提出生成式占用场（Generative Occupancy Fields），将三维场景表示为连续的占用场并以此驱动神经辐射场进行图像合成。方法上，作者利用占用场显式建模表面几何，结合生成式模型实现从随机噪声到三维表面及对应图像的联合生成，从而支持对形状和外观的独立控制。相比已有基于NeRF的生成方法，该方法在表面感知和几何一致性上更优，能够生成更合理的三维结构及多视角一致的图像。该工作为三维生成与表面感知建模提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中的场景生成与仿真有潜在应用价值。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper tackles the entanglement of geometry and texture in 3D surface-aware image synthesis by proposing Generative Occupancy Fields, which represent 3D scenes as continuous occupancy fields driving a neural radiance field for image generation. The method explicitly models surface geometry via occupancy fields and combines them with a generative model to jointly synthesize 3D surfaces and corresponding images from noise, enabling independent control over shape and appearance. Compared to existing NeRF-based generative approaches, it achieves better surface awareness and geometric consistency, producing more plausible 3D structures and multi-view consistent images.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该工作将占用场引入生成式三维表面感知合成，思路新颖，对三维场景生成与仿真有启发，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务的直接关联较弱。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成式占用场，实现三维表面与图像的联合生成及几何-纹理解耦控制。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 用连续占用场显式建模表面几何并驱动生成式辐射场，实现表面感知的图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 相比已有NeRF生成方法，生成的三维结构更合理、多视角图像一致性更好。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa._arxiv_id: Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surface-Aware Image Synthesis.
